dramabox.title: Deny Me, Dragon King
dramabox.norm_title: deny me dragon king
dramabox.description: Human Lyra stumbles on Dragon King Kael and shares a passionate night. Tricked by a fake prophecy, he casts her out—only for Lyra to bear his half-dragon daughter Amber. Years later, she returns seeking a healer to save her sick child. Old sparks reignite, jealous rivals plot, and hidden blood ties surface as they fight for their family and broken love.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Tempest：The Last Mecha
dramabox.norm_title: tempest the last mecha
dramabox.description: Broken by his parents' deaths, Colt Thorne, the Mech King, hides as a lowly janitor after being saved by Freya. But when Freya, the woman he secretly loves, is betrayed and forced into a lethal mech duel, Colt must unleash his hidden identity. Unlocking his legendary 100% Neural Sync, he commands The Tempest to crush his enemies and save the world from an extinction-level alien swarm!
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Love The Way You Lie
dramabox.norm_title: love the way you lie
dramabox.description: Molly’s sister didn’t just swipe her boyfriend Connor—she also snatched her inheritance, leaving Molly high and dry. Fueled by alcohol and vengeance, Molly hatches a wild plan: seduce Connor’s attractive uncle, Adrian. Little does she know, her half-baked scheme works a little too well, because Adrian soon finds himself head over heels for Molly.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: My Billionaire Patient Is My Baby Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: my billionaire patient is my baby daddy
dramabox.description: Ella is tricked by her divorce-seeking husband Arthur into sleeping with a stranger on their wedding night, and later gives birth to twins, with one dumped on a hospital bench by him. Fisher, the stranger and a billionaire, finds him and raises him. Years later, Ella serves as Fisher's physical therapist in his estate, looking for her missing son. As the truth unravels, Ella finds her other son, and heals both him and Fisher. The family of four is eventually reunited.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: No More Blood For My Vampire First Love
dramabox.norm_title: no more blood for my vampire first love
dramabox.description: She gave him her heart, only to be used as a pawn to win her cruel stepsister. Shattered, the gifted Keeper Allie walks away—straight into the devotion of an ancient Original who has waited two centuries for her.  Watching her reign alongside a far superior man, her ex falls to his knees begging for a second chance. Too late. She destroys her enemies and chooses true love, leaving the boy who broke her choking on regret.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Betrothed to a Beggar, Crowned a Dragon Queen
dramabox.norm_title: betrothed to a beggar crowned a dragon queen
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her fiancé and mocked by her family, Lyra chooses a penniless, hornless stranger as her destined mate. But "Ethan" is actually Aurelian, the legendary Dragon God in disguise. As jealous Astrid turns to forbidden magic and deadly enemies close in, Lyra must fight for love, dignity, and her true power—until the discarded daughter rises from humiliation to become the Dragon Queen.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: My Trash Pup Is Fenrir
dramabox.norm_title: my trash pup is fenrir
dramabox.description: Rayne, a mysterious beast tamer raised in the mountains, returns to civilization with his scruffy stray dog, Max. When he reunites with Elena—the girl he promised to marry fourteen years ago—he discovers she is now engaged to a powerful nobleman. As the Barbarians threaten her city, Rayne must uncover his true identity, awaken Max’s hidden power, and protect the woman he never stopped loving.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: My Weak Little Dog Is a Legendary Sky Lion
dramabox.norm_title: my weak little dog is a legendary sky lion
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her lover Corrin and best friend Ophelia, Amber was stripped of her bloodline and brutally murdered. Reborn on the day she chose her bonded beast, she refuses the powerful Corrin and instead bonds with a lowly white dog Aerion, who tried to save her in the past life and later reveals his true form—the legendary Sky Lion. Just as Amber begins her revenge against the betrayers, a darker conspiracy unfolds, revealing the ultimate mastermind pulling the strings.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Wet Hot Summer with the Boy I Lost
dramabox.norm_title: wet hot summer with the boy i lost
dramabox.description: On the last day of school, Skye bets her biggest bully she'll lose her virginity to the hottest guy, Luke, over the summer. But shy Skye has never even been kissed. When her irresistibly hot neighbor Grayson offers to teach her how to win Luke over, sparks fly between them instead. Soon, Skye realizes the one guy she swore she'd never want is the one she can't resist.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Forbidden Fling With My Bestie's Dad
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden fling with my bestie s dad
dramabox.description: After catching her fiancé cheating on the flight to her best friend's tropical wedding, grad student Mia drunkenly hooks up with Damien, a mysterious silver-fox billionaire, only to discover he's the bride's father. Forced to hide their forbidden attraction throughout a chaotic wedding weekend, they face jealous exes, secret encounters, and vengeful sabotage that could destroy the ceremony.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him
dramabox.norm_title: he broke the heart that saved him
dramabox.description: Mia sacrifices everything for her dying lover Vance, never knowing he is Cloud City's greatest heir. To return the future to him, Mia walks away resolutely without telling him she's pregnant. Years later, their child's tragic fate crosses their paths again. Yet vicious lies turn him against her, driving their boy to his death. Since then, Mia has lived in the pain of losing her son, while Vance, upon discovering the truth, will be left to bear the crushing weight of regret.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Kneel Before The Dragon Queen
dramabox.norm_title: kneel before the dragon queen
dramabox.description:
After seven years in hiding, Dragon Queen Veya 
returns disguised as a humble healer, only to be 
betrayed and humiliated by the man she once loved. 
When she enters a marriage of convenience with 
powerful Duke Kael Frostwing, her enemies mistake 
her for a powerless commoner—until Veya reveals 
her true identity and reclaims her throne.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Poisoned by His Love
dramabox.norm_title: poisoned by his love
dramabox.description: On her half-sister Victoria's wedding day, 25-year-old nurse Lily Watson is forced into a deadly bargain. Victoria is set to marry Dominic Castellano, a ruthless mafia king rumored to have killed his last wife. But when Victoria flees, Dominic's hitmen threaten Lily's family. To protect them, Lily takes Victoria's place at the altar and becomes the bride of a man she fears may be a killer.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Shifter Academy: Taming Three Wild Mates
dramabox.norm_title: shifter academy taming three wild mates
dramabox.description:
What could possibly go wrong when a human girl spends mating season at a school full of apex predators? Everything.
Ivy only wanted to finish her education. Instead, her scholarship to Shifter Academy comes with a catch: she's the fated mate of not one, not two, but three of the strongest shifters on campus: Ronan, Leon and Talon.
Three alphas. One impossible choice. Her heart has chosen. It's love at first slap.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Silence! Boss Lady Speaks
dramabox.norm_title: silence boss lady speaks
dramabox.description: Eleanor, a reclusive heiress returning from Africa, is mistaken for a penniless charity worker and publicly humiliated by her ex and his family. But when a mysterious CEO, Sebastian, sees something rare in her and proposes marriage, their union sends shockwaves through high society. As her enemies push too far, Eleanor fights back—revealing her true identity as Thunder Lady, the secret CEO of the world’s most powerful investment syndicate.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Revenge Puck
dramabox.norm_title: revenge puck
dramabox.description: Lucy has just been cheated on and dumped by her ex-boyfriend and hockey star Adam. She makes a deal to fake date his biggest hockey rival, Blake, to throw off his game until the end of the playoffs.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: My Brother's Wrath Awaits
dramabox.norm_title: my brother s wrath awaits
dramabox.description: After surviving an abusive mafia father, Aurora spends her life calming her volatile brother Lucian, now the city's most feared mafia boss, who violently punishes anyone who disturbs her peace. When Lucian's iancée mistakes Aurora for a maid and tortures her, Lucian is manipulated into hurting Aurora. As Aurora disappearsinto the underground black market, Lucian uncovers the devastating truth and unleashes his wrath on everyone responsible - even himself.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: The Unrivaled Overlord
dramabox.norm_title: the unrivaled overlord
dramabox.description: Theo Larsen, alias the Overlord, commands a Wolf Army of a million strong. Shrouding his identity, he ties the knot with Sarah Welsh, the daughter of the prosperous Welsh family, securing the future of Glory Group before ascending to the pinnacle of his life.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Fortunes Unveiled: My Husband Is a Big Shot
dramabox.norm_title: fortunes unveiled my husband is a big shot
dramabox.description: On the first day of Chinese New Year, Jay Wade pays a visit to his wife's family, only to be ill-treated with contempt. Little do they know that Jay is, in fact, the chairman of Win Corp, one of the top ten companies in the world.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: A Breath Away From Forever
dramabox.norm_title: a breath away from forever
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Callista Summers rescued Jeremiah Fuller when he was drugged. She then pursued her career abroad, driven by her initial self-doubt as a housekeeper. Over time, Callista became a renowned designer and a devoted mother to her son, Scotty Fuller. When she learns of Jeremiah’s kidney failure, she selflessly returns to donate her kidney, saving him once more. However, misunderstandings breed animosity between them.
dramabox.author: Webfic

dramabox.title: Falling for my Slum Billionaire Husband
dramabox.norm_title: falling for my slum billionaire husband
dramabox.description: In order to the be rightful heiress, Alexandra had a contract marriage with Bradford, a young man from slum. She gradually fell for him and realized there's something special about his family. When she's in danger and faced the insults from her enemies, Bradford came to save her and his family finally revealed that they are the richest family in the whole country!

dramabox.title: Countdown: Games of the Reaper
dramabox.norm_title: countdown games of the reaper
dramabox.description: What if you could see the day everyone dies—but no one believed you? Evan Vale wakes to numbers above people’s heads, counting down to zero. Then the deaths begin: a stranger crushed, a plane lost. Only one woman trusts him and escapes. Now her number has appeared. To save her, Evan must face Death in three impossible games, where the final price is oblivion. Can one man outthink eternity?

dramabox.title: From Powerless Nobody to Supreme Sage（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: from powerless nobody to supreme sage dubbed
dramabox.description: Ethan Reed was deemed a powerless nobody. During a summer hike, he accidentally stepped into an ancient teleportation array and was transported to the cultivation world. After surviving and training in secret for a thousand years to become a supreme sage of the six realms, he finally returned to Earth. With only one day having passed on Earth during his millennium away, everyone still views him as a worthless loser, unaware that he has returned to control all things.

dramabox.title: MIDNIGHT KING
dramabox.norm_title: midnight king
dramabox.description: Three years ago, the Kessler family killed Kai’s brother and framed him, destroying his life. Three years later, Kai hides his true identity. By day, he is a meek, bullied "loser" clerk at Kessler Corp. By night, he transforms into the "Phantom," an undefeated, masked racing king in the underground street racing scene.

dramabox.title: Awakened: The Legend Returns
dramabox.norm_title: awakened the legend returns
dramabox.description: Young Logan gives up his sister for adoption to save her life. Twenty years later, Logan falls into a coma unexpectedly. His fiancée Grace stands by him unwaveringly. His sister, now a CEO, finally finds Logan and helps him and Grace shut down their condescending relatives.

dramabox.title: The Bad Boy's Honor Student
dramabox.norm_title: the bad boy s honor student
dramabox.description: Leo, a prodigy from a small, underprivileged town, earned a full scholarship to Columbia Law School. He planned to confess his feelings to his good friend Mason at the campus carnival—only to mistake someone else and pour out his love publicly to Hunter, heir to one of America’s wealthiest conglomerates and captain of the ice hockey team. At that moment, Hunter was locked in a bitter feud with Brooke, a well-born socialite.

dramabox.title: Tides of Betrayal, Rise of a Fishing Empire（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: tides of betrayal rise of a fishing empire dubbed
dramabox.description: Skilled young captain Simon Levine helps his uncle, Titus Levine, earn $568,000 at sea. However, he receives only $30,000 in return, while his parents are mistreated. Striking out on his own with an old boat, he makes huge catches through talent and grit. Titus hires someone to impersonate Simon, but they fail. Simon builds a fishing empire from scratch and leads his hometown to prosperity.

dramabox.title: The Ace Pilot Who Saved the Skies
dramabox.norm_title: the ace pilot who saved the skies
dramabox.description: Tycoon Graham Carter secretly boarded an economy flight to throw off rivals, while Ethan Miles was requested to captain the flight through severe thunderstorms. However, an arrogant female pilot forced Ethan out of the cockpit and took command. When the plane plunged into a massive thunderstorm, threatening everyone's lives, Ethan stepped up to turn the tide and save all onboard.

dramabox.title: For Richer, For Poorer, Regret Hits Harder（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: for richer for poorer regret hits harder dubbed
dramabox.description: In 2005, Simon Jett cannot afford the monetary wedding gift. His girlfriend, Celine Lark, tries to help by asking her family to approve their marriage without the money. Simon is touched but refuses Celine’s kindness. He returns to his family, only to discover that his parents gave the compensation money to his siblings and left him with nothing. Heartbroken, he cuts ties with them and sets out to build a new life and fortune with Celine, his devoted girlfriend.

dramabox.title: The Brother I Never Forgot
dramabox.norm_title: the brother i never forgot
dramabox.description: In the 1990s, poor teen Ethan Stone nearly quit school over tuition. His childhood friend Caleb Miller trekked miles and gave all his savings to fund Ethan’s studies, leaving school to work instead. They lost touch for decades. Years later, successful Ethan finds Caleb trapped in debt after betrayal by his partner and wife, barely supporting his daughter. Ethan travels far to help him recover assets, restart his business, and pull the father and daughter out of trouble.

dramabox.title: I Can See How Much Time They Have Left
dramabox.norm_title: i can see how much time they have left
dramabox.description: Ethan Grant, an ER doctor who sees people’s death-and-disease countdowns, races against death to save critical patients with superior mesenteric artery dissection and splenic rupture. His rule-breaking rescues spark conflicts with conservative superiors yet earn trust from reserved senior Claire Stone. Facing anonymous reports and rumors while treating a brain-tumor-stricken girl, he proves himself through professionalism and empathy and finds unexpected romance.

dramabox.title: Legend Slice Dad
dramabox.norm_title: legend slice dad
dramabox.description: Leo, a goofy pizza guy, is actually "Dead Hand," a legendary overpowered mutant. When his daughter Ellie is kidnapped by the corrupt SMB for her unique blood, Leo drops his disguise. Teaming up with Captain Stella, he battles through mercenaries, black markets, and mutated monsters to crush Director Vance's evil experiments.

dramabox.title: My Janitor dad is the Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: my janitor dad is the alpha
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Kane, the Alpha, defeated Vampire Prince Vlad on the border battlefield, only to be cursed by him. Kane had to mate with a woman to survive. While he was unconscious, a mysterious woman saved him. After retiring, Kane hid his identity and became a security guard at Winter Group, all to find his savior.Five years later, CEO Sophia Winter brings her daughter Emma into the building. Kane recognizes at a glance that Sophia may be the woman who saved him.

dramabox.title: Five Years of War, A Shattered Reunion
dramabox.norm_title: five years of war a shattered reunion
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Victor Stone fought bloody battles on the battlefield day and night, clinging to one single wish: to survive and return home to his beloved baby daughter. Five years later, he has achieved great fame and renown. Millions of Sabria soldiers regard him as their supreme leader. But when he eagerly anticipates reuniting with his little girl, he discovers that the daughter who once warmed his heart has grown cold toward him.

dramabox.title: Loving Her Was My Biggest Mistake
dramabox.norm_title: loving her was my biggest mistake
dramabox.description: Ethan fell in love with Vivian at first sight back in college. To support her dreams, he gave up a promising future to work as her secretary. After a drunken night, their relationship blurred into a four-year arrangement of being a secretary by day and a bedmate by night. When Vivian's first love finally returns, Ethan realizes she never loved him. He resolutely resigns to forge his own path in AI development, leaving a remorseful Vivian behind.

dramabox.title: From Powerless Nobody to Supreme Sage
dramabox.norm_title: from powerless nobody to supreme sage
dramabox.description: Ethan Reed was deemed a powerless nobody. During a summer hike, he accidentally stepped into an ancient teleportation array and was transported to the cultivation world. After surviving and training in secret for a thousand years to become a supreme sage of the six realms, he finally returned to Earth. With only one day having passed on Earth during his millennium away, everyone still views him as a worthless loser, unaware that he has returned to control all things.

dramabox.title: The Hidden King
dramabox.norm_title: the hidden king
dramabox.description: For five years, Chris Wolf lived as an ordinary man, hiding his true identity while secretly using his vampire royal powers to rebuild his wife Selina's bankrupt family business. But Selina, ashamed of his apparent uselessness, demands a divorce. On the night she ends their marriage, the truth comes out: Chris is not only the heir to the vampire throne, but the son of Zeus himself, king of the gods. The Werewolf Council kneels. The southern nobles bow.

dramabox.title: Betrayed by Love, Backed by a Trillion
dramabox.norm_title: betrayed by love backed by a trillion
dramabox.description: For six years, Ethan Carter — heir to Haicheng's richest family — hid his identity to marry for love, handing his wife Claire Sutton control of everything. On their anniversary, he catches her affair with "hairstylist" Ryan Hayes — who've conspired to drain his fortune via forged contracts and deepfakes, planning to strip him bare. Then his father's will reveals: a broken marriage means he inherits a trillion-dollar empire.

dramabox.title: The Ruins I Left, The Home I Must Save
dramabox.norm_title: the ruins i left the home i must save
dramabox.description: Ethan Stone, a 1980s gambler, causes his wife Elena's suicide, his brother's crippling, and his mother's blindness. He dies alone. Reborn on their parting night, he vows to repent. He guides villagers to harvest the mountains. When gangster Victor Kane threatens, Ethan goes undercover for local police, smashing the gambling ring. Then he seizes new opportunities, prospering his family and village, rewriting their tragedy.

dramabox.title: Too Late for Tears, Too Late to Love
dramabox.norm_title: too late for tears too late to love
dramabox.description: Victor Carter builds a business empire and puts his wife, Elena, at the top of the industry. But at the company gala, he sees her fawn over a young assistant while barely sparing her husband a glance. Victor cuts her off. Soon, her new lover scams her out of everything. Victor moves on, takes Carter Corp higher, and finds someone who truly matches him.

dramabox.title: Father of the Underworld
dramabox.norm_title: father of the underworld
dramabox.description: Former gang leader Vincent hides as a hot dog vendor to protect his daughter Isabella. Her abusive husband and rival Viper Gang threaten their family. When Isabella is kidnapped, Vincent mobilizes his allies to defeat the gang, sticks to moral rules, and returns to an ordinary peaceful life.

dramabox.title: A Decade of Songs Wasted on Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: a decade of songs wasted on betrayal
dramabox.description: For ten years, Adrian Stone wrote hundreds of hit songs for his wife Vivian Hayes, turning her from an unknown cover singer into a music diva. Madly in love with Vivian, he catches her flirting on the piano with Ryan Reed, his mother’s illegitimate son, in their villa. Devastated, Adrian cancels all free song authorizations for her. Thinking he is just playing hard to get, Vivian and Ryan keep provoking him again and again.

dramabox.title: Kindness Betrayed: Drown in Your Folly
dramabox.norm_title: kindness betrayed drown in your folly
dramabox.description: Ethan Stone risks his fortune to protect a village from a deadly flood, buying land to keep its people safe. Instead, they accuse him of fraud and drive him out. The flood destroys everything, and the villagers lose their savings to scammers. Meanwhile, Ethan helps Oakglen strike it rich from rare-earth mining. Now, the people who cursed him beg for forgiveness—but Ethan has already risen to the top.

dramabox.title: The War God Who Came Back for His Family
dramabox.norm_title: the war god who came back for his family
dramabox.description: The Northern War God, Grant Kane, returns in secret to find Claire Blake, the woman who once saved his life. He is stunned to learn that she has raised their daughter alone for five years, facing gossip and hardship as an unwed mother. Determined to make up for lost time, Grant protects Claire and their daughter at every turn. From humiliating arrogant relatives to winning over powerful enemies, the hidden War God proves that no one can stand in the way of his family.

dramabox.title: A Love Left Behind
dramabox.norm_title: a love left behind
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter’s mother needs emergency surgery, but he can’t afford it after borrowing from everyone he knows. He turns to his girlfriend, Claire Wells, but she refuses, convinced he’s lying. By the time Ethan finally gets the money, his mother is gone. Heartbroken, he leaves and discovers Claire had been withholding his bonuses and commissions for years. When they meet again, Ethan is a powerful industry leader with a new fiancée.

dramabox.title: The Letter He Let Her Burn
dramabox.norm_title: the letter he let her burn
dramabox.description: Claire burns Ethan's college letter, forcing him to support her. Ethan agrees, but secretly knows he can afford both and the letter can be reprinted. He collects proof. At her celebration, he reveals she burned her own letter. Not revenge, just moving on and living well.

dramabox.title: Dumped for Dirt, Crowned by Gold
dramabox.norm_title: dumped for dirt crowned by gold
dramabox.description: In the early 1990s, Ethan Crane spends his savings on wasteland in Pudong. His fiancée Mia Perry dumps him publicly. He stays, builds a business, wins workers' trust, outsmarts corrupt rivals, and rides policy winds to rise from nothing.

dramabox.title: The Heir Behind the Apron
dramabox.norm_title: the heir behind the apron
dramabox.description: Heir to a fortune, Adrian Ward hides his identity to build a restaurant from scratch for his girlfriend's dream — even turning down a $150M poaching offer from heiress Vivian Blake. When the restaurant goes viral, his girlfriend Claire Mason credits chef Ryan Slade instead, growing close to him. Heartbroken, Adrian walks away — right before his true identity comes out.

dramabox.title: The Heir They Never Knew
dramabox.norm_title: the heir they never knew
dramabox.description: Heir to the Hale family fortune, Lucas Hale breaks with his family for wife Vivian Reed, secretly funding her company while posing as an ordinary salesman. But Vivian, swayed by her mother, stays entangled with her old flame Ryan Caine — even missing Lucas's dying mother's final moments to visit Ryan's mother's mild cold. Lucas finally sees the truth and returns to his family, divorcing her.

dramabox.title: The Year of Surprise
dramabox.norm_title: the year of surprise
dramabox.description: Leo Carter, 6, travels alone to his grandparents' home, surprising Elaine Turner. Jealous second grandmother Cuiying schemes against her, but Leo outwits her: answering tricky questions, upgrading outfits, clearing Elaine with video, and finding a doctor for great-grandpa. At the clan ceremony, Leo helps his grandpa become leader. When parents find him, his stories rekindle his dad's memories, and they quit work to reunite.

dramabox.title: Final Decision System: World Cup Comeback
dramabox.norm_title: final decision system world cup comeback
dramabox.description: In the 2002 World Cup, disabled cleaner Ethan Stone is humiliated by his fiancée and unlocks the Final Decision System. He can control match results, traffic lights and property projects. By foreseeing World Cup outcomes, he gains his first bucket of gold, helps a gang boss find a valuable iridium mine, and forges a sworn bond with Greyhaven’s top tycoon. This summer, he rises from rock bottom and reshapes his entire fate.

dramabox.title: Divorced and Untouchable: Reclaiming My Empire
dramabox.norm_title: divorced and untouchable reclaiming my empire
dramabox.description: For five years, Ethan Hayes hides his true identity and endures a loveless marriage to save his family’s empire. When he finally walks away, he reclaims his fortune and reunites with his first love, Alyssa Foster. But his jealous ex-wife Vivian will stop at nothing to win him back—even faking a pregnancy and crashing their wedding. When her lies unravel, she loses everything.

dramabox.title: Into the Trap: The Ultimate Counterplay
dramabox.norm_title: into the trap the ultimate counterplay
dramabox.description: Ivy League PhD and rising tech star Ethan Grant shocks millions by livestreaming himself smashing a jewelry store. But instead of running, he calls the police and begs to be arrested. His fiancée, mentor, and aging parents all desperately try to stop him, yet Ethan refuses every way out, repeating only one thing: "I'm going to prison.

dramabox.title: The Secret of Her Pregnancy
dramabox.norm_title: the secret of her pregnancy
dramabox.description: After years of infertility, Evan Linton and his wife, Megan Foster, are desperate for a child. When Evan's younger brother, Caleb, returns home after his business fails, he claims he knows a secret method that could help Megan conceive. Desperate for a miracle, Megan secretly follows Caleb's plan behind Evan's back—setting off a chain of shocking misunderstandings that no one sees coming.

dramabox.title: The Breakup That Hid His Love
dramabox.norm_title: the breakup that hid his love
dramabox.description: Claire Stone is stricken with heart failure. Evan Cole is a compatible heart donor. He acts like a cruel lover and ends their relationship before donating his heart, living in agony with an artificial heart. Knowing nothing, Claire treats him as a faithless man and taunts him. After her friend uncovers the secret, overwhelmed with regret, Claire rushes to find Evan. She meets a terminally ill Evan, who passes away in her embrace.

dramabox.title: Blind Game, Endless Regret
dramabox.norm_title: blind game endless regret
dramabox.description: Ethan Reed gives up his sight for Claire Hart, only to discover that their three-year romance was a cruel revenge game. With an electronic eye supplied by his junior, he pretends to remain blind and quietly watches Claire set one final trap. Instead of begging for mercy, Ethan turns her scheme into his escape. By the time Claire realizes whom she has lost, he may already have chosen the woman who helped him see the truth.

dramabox.title: Betrayal Unveiled at the Summit
dramabox.norm_title: betrayal unveiled at the summit
dramabox.description: Ethan Miller, a brilliant core technician who single-handedly developed the "Skyvault" project, faces public humiliation when his boss steals his credit and he discovers his wife's infidelity. Refusing to be crushed by double betrayal, Ethan meticulously plots his revenge. During the project's grand launch, he exposes their crimes to the world, making the traitors pay dearly while achieving his own ultimate redemption and defending his professional integrity.

dramabox.title: Hooked on Greed: The Seeds of Undoing
dramabox.norm_title: hooked on greed the seeds of undoing
dramabox.description: Just as Ethan Morgan turns his fish farm into a thriving business, a powerful local bully steals it for almost nothing. Cutting corners with illegal chemicals and cheap feed, the new owner destroys the entire operation and ends up bankrupt and behind bars. Refusing to fight over the past, Ethan starts over, builds a thriving aquaculture empire, and becomes the industry's top supplier.

dramabox.title: Master of the Deep: Fortune Awaits
dramabox.norm_title: master of the deep fortune awaits
dramabox.description: After losing his parents in a tragic shipwreck, Ethan Hayes inherits crushing debt instead of a future. Everything changes when a mysterious power awakens within him, granting him unmatched abilities at sea. From rare seafood and sunken treasures to deep-sea expeditions, Ethan builds a thriving maritime empire. But as his power grows, so does the truth behind his parents' mysterious deaths.

dramabox.title: Powered by Honor, Driven to Succeed
dramabox.norm_title: powered by honor driven to succeed
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole poured his savings into saving his uncle Damon Grady's failing auto shop and turned it into a thriving business. Three years later, Damon and his wife forced him out with a measly payout. Their greed soon destroyed everything they had built. Starting over, Ethan opened his own repair shop and earned success through honest work and unmatched skill.

dramabox.title: 26 Years a Bond
dramabox.norm_title: 26 years a bond
dramabox.description: At 19, top student Gavin Gould sacrificed his dream college acceptance and tuition to save his 7-year-old sister's hand after a tragic crash. Seeing his desperation, Clara Blake extended a lifeline, saving his family and pushing him to keep studying. 26 years later, Gavin has built a global empire, while Clara has hit rock bottom. Now, the self-made tycoon steps into the dark to repay the debt of a lifetime.

dramabox.title: I Was Her Husband, But She Loved a Memory
dramabox.norm_title: i was her husband but she loved a memory
dramabox.description: Billionaire Adrian Foster has doted on his wife Claire Monroe for three years, unaware she still loves her dead first love, Ethan Miles. When new artist Liam Grant looks like Ethan, Claire's obsession returns. She gives Adrian a fake watch, the real one to Liam. Exposed, Adrian humiliates Liam at work, but Claire defends him. Adrian demotes Liam, who fakes an injury to frame him. Claire demands Adrian care for Liam. Heartbroken, Adrian decides to divorce.

dramabox.title: Bluff to Power, Claim It All
dramabox.norm_title: bluff to power claim it all
dramabox.description: Evan Stone unlocks a bizarre system that turns his father's wild lies into reality—as long as Evan claims them as his own. Overnight, he masters hundreds of extraordinary skills, from priceless artifact appraisal and billion-dollar investing to elite combat and miracle medicine. With unstoppable abilities, he crushes his enemies, dumps his cheating ex, and wins over a stunning CEO.

dramabox.title: The Bear That Hid Her Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: the bear that hid her betrayal
dramabox.description: Tessa Parker, who once hated teddy bears, betrays her marriage for desire and hides her affair inside a teddy bear costume. After discovering the truth, her husband Ethan Gould chooses to leave and punish Tessa and Derek Vance for destroying their marriage. After losing Ethan, Tessa finally sees Derek’s true colors, faces the consequences, and learns the value of marriage and the price of betrayal.

dramabox.title: The Lies You Tried to Mute
dramabox.norm_title: the lies you tried to mute
dramabox.description: After losing his hearing saving Nora Jensen, Ethan Quinn falls deeply in love and builds a family with her, their child completing their home. When Ethan regains his hearing through treatment, he rushes to tell Nora—only to discover her affair. Disillusioned, he reveals his true identity as the world's wealthiest man. As expected of someone selfish, Nora regrets her betrayal, but there's no way back to the man who once loved her above all else.

dramabox.title: Her Engagement, My Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: her engagement my revenge
dramabox.description: Regenton's wealthiest woman, Claire Carter, tracks down construction worker Ethan Kane with her daughter Chloe in tow—revealing he's the lost head of Dragon Hall, who surrendered his ring years ago to protect his family from assassins. Having lost his memory, Ethan refuses to believe a word. Just then, his girlfriend makes a shocking move of her own.

dramabox.title: Her Cold-Hearted Choice Sealed Her Doom
dramabox.norm_title: her cold hearted choice sealed her doom
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter and Megan Price were married until her mother forced a divorce amid rumors that Ethan’s father was imprisoned for solicitation. At a banquet, Megan publicly insulted Ethan and his father, declaring they were finished forever. Finally the truth emerged: the man she called a lecher, Gavin Carter, was the influential Chief Carter. Her own father Miles Rowan was the one behind bars. By signing the divorce papers, Megan threw away her chance at a privileged life.

dramabox.title: The Secret Hidden Beneath the Cellar
dramabox.norm_title: the secret hidden beneath the cellar
dramabox.description: Growing up, Evan Carter watched his ugly father, Hank Carter, bring home a different beautiful woman almost every few days. Every one of them despised Hank at first, but after entering the mysterious cellar, they became obsessed with him and refused to leave. Now that Evan has grown up, he can't even find a wife. Determined to uncover the cellar's secret and use it to find himself a wife, he ignores his father's desperate warnings to stay away.

dramabox.title: Wake the Legend, Pay the Price
dramabox.norm_title: wake the legend pay the price
dramabox.description: Twenty years after leaving the underworld behind, Rex Carter has built a quiet life raising his adopted daughter. But when a reckless thug threatens his family, the legend everyone thought was gone is forced back into action. As old enemies return and buried secrets resurface, Rex must face the past one final time to protect the future.

dramabox.title: The Heir He Never Knew
dramabox.norm_title: the heir he never knew
dramabox.description: Gordon Sutton, a hidden billionaire, lives as a househusband but is scorned by his son's family. On his birthday, he takes back his company. At the return party, his son tries to suck up to a tycoon, only to find it's his own father. Gordon's billions go to Claire Vaughn and her daughter. After going broke, the son blackmails and kidnaps, but later takes a bullet to redeem himself. Gordon forgives and starts anew with Claire.

dramabox.title: Burn the Bridge, Bury the Past
dramabox.norm_title: burn the bridge bury the past
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter built a bridge for his village with everything he had. But greed shattered loyalty when a villager led the seizure of his land and the demolition of his home. His mother Helen Moore suffered a heart attack from the shock. Begging for justice fell on deaf ears. So Ethan did what no one expected—he destroyed his own bridge and walked away, taking his family with him.

dramabox.title: Race to Glory: A Legend Reborn
dramabox.norm_title: race to glory a legend reborn
dramabox.description: Legendary motorcycle racer Ethan Stone dies before reaching the top—only to wake up in the body of a teenage racer. Building unbeatable bikes from scrap, he storms through underground circuits and national championships on his way to MotoGP, where the world is about to meet its next racing legend.

dramabox.title: Harvest of Kindness: The Orchard’s Guardian
dramabox.norm_title: harvest of kindness the orchard s guardian
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole takes over a struggling cherry orchard, where an unexpected visitor changes everything—a black bear named Bruno, the very one he once rescued from a trap. Grateful in the sweetest way, Bruno becomes the orchard's unlikely guardian, and their heartwarming videos take the internet by storm. As orders pour in, Ethan turns one viral friendship into a thriving business that transforms his hometown.

dramabox.title: No One Returns
dramabox.norm_title: no one returns
dramabox.description: Daredevil Jax Hale ignores a deadly past and buys a cursed car. He takes girlfriend Tessa, friends Evan and Chloe, and hitchhiker Iris on a mountain trip. They arrive at Lockmere, an abandoned village where nothing is as it seems. Reality bends as they encounter ghostly apparitions and a malevolent force. Trapped with no escape, they must uncover the village's dark secret before it consumes them all.

dramabox.title: All Under My Command
dramabox.norm_title: all under my command
dramabox.description: Modern office worker Dorian Graves is thrust into Eldoria, where he rises to become the feared Chief of the Eastern Depot, the legendary “Nine Thousand Years”. Crushing corrupt officials, repelling Norwyn, and leading campaigns against barbarian tribes, he builds unrivaled authority. Admired by both the Imperial Consort and the Princess, Dorian drives bold reforms, strengthens the empire, and forges the legacy of a ruthless eunuch ruler.

dramabox.title: The Cue That Rewrote Fate
dramabox.norm_title: the cue that rewrote fate
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole, a five-time billiards champion, was framed by rival Adrian Cross and faded into obscurity. Years later, working as a waiter under a new name, he's forced to pick up his cue again when friends are threatened by tycoon Victor Parker's thugs. He defeats pros, exposes Adrian's old treachery, and in a televised showdown, lands the legendary "Five-in-a-Row" to reclaim his honor—then chooses a quiet life with Lily Ward, guardian of his own legacy.

dramabox.title: From Dirt to Dignity
dramabox.norm_title: from dirt to dignity
dramabox.description: Caleb Mason, a 40-year-old rural bachelor, has been mocked by family and neighbors all his life. Meek, he never fights back. One day, he finds a rare silver coin, sells for 6 million. Wealth brings dignity but exposes greed of father, brother, relatives. They swarm with fake love. Caleb says no. He sets boundaries, refuses to be used, starts over.This a tale of money, humanity, self-respect.

dramabox.title: Unchained Overlord: The Final Settlement
dramabox.norm_title: unchained overlord the final settlement
dramabox.description: Ethan Stone sacrificed three years in prison to protect the woman he loved, only to be betrayed the day he walked free. Armed with extraordinary healing skills and unmatched strength learned behind bars, he saves lives, rises to power, and crushes everyone who stood in his way. As the truth behind his imprisonment finally comes to light, those who betrayed him lose everything.

dramabox.title: From Rejected Groom to Legendary Healer
dramabox.norm_title: from rejected groom to legendary healer
dramabox.description: Ethan Clark is humiliated during a blind date, only to meet his true match, Ivy Hayes. Grateful for Ethan once saving his life, Ivy's father insists they marry and gifts him a luxurious estate. While Ivy resists, Ethan shocks everyone with his unmatched medical skills, predicts her car accident, and wagers he can cure the city's richest man in seven days. As his true brilliance is revealed, Ivy begins to regret pushing him away, while her best friend sets her sights on him.

dramabox.title: Giving Up Immortality for My Daughter
dramabox.norm_title: giving up immortality for my daughter
dramabox.description: As the world’s only cultivator on the verge of ascending to immortality, Dylan Hayes discovers he has a five-year-old daughter. Giving up eternal ascension without hesitation, he returns to the mortal world to become a full-time dad. While outsiders mistake him for a fraud, Dylan possesses absolute, invincible power. When an almighty cultivator crosses paths with a cold corporate executive, a hilarious and thrilling legendary journey begins.

dramabox.title: Seollal War: The Homecoming Son-in-Law is a Secret Chaebol（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: seollal war the homecoming son in law is a secret chaebol dubbed
dramabox.description: Kim Myeong-woo, the CEO of Hongo Group, the largest conglomerate in the country, visits his hometown to attend his wife's grandfather's 70th birthday. He has been hiding his true identity for years. When he tries to reveal who he is to his wife of three years, he is insulted and scolded. No matter how badly the others treat him, he remains unfazed. When his true identity is declared, everyone is in for the shock of their lives.

dramabox.title: My Best Order Is Love
dramabox.norm_title: my best order is love
dramabox.description: Tim Smith is just an ordinary food delivery driver, but he lives life with unwavering passion and heart. On his way to a blind date, he unexpectedly saves the city's wealthiest mogul from a life-threatening crisis. Moved by Tim’s genuine kindness and sincerity, the tycoon decides Tim is the only man fit for his daughter, Zoe Stone, who never loves any man.

dramabox.title: King of Gamblers: Love Never Returns（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: king of gamblers love never returns dubbed
dramabox.description: The King of Gamblers, Axel Frost, honors his dying mentor’s request to protect the Dugan family for three years—marrying Faith Dugan in the process. Hiding his true identity, he quietly safeguards the family, only to face their constant scorn. Three days before the three-year mark, Faith’s friend betrays her. Axel steps in to turn the tables one last time and leaves. Only after he is gone does Faith realize what she’s lost and tries to find him.

dramabox.title: The Ultimate Bomb Disposal Expert
dramabox.norm_title: the ultimate bomb disposal expert
dramabox.description: Ethan Hayes, a world-class bomb disposal expert, unexpectedly rebirths back to the age of eight. Facing the tragic moment when a deadly bomb is set to kill his father and aunt, Ethan uses his future expertise and unmatched skills to alter fate. Racing against time, he takes control of the city's ultimate lifeline, determined to rewrite history and protect those he loves.

dramabox.title: Dreadfall: Surviving the Nightmare
dramabox.norm_title: dreadfall surviving the nightmare
dramabox.description: A butcher shop echoes with eerie chopping at midnight. Every passenger on the last bus has the same face, and a figure in funeral clothes wanders the freezing rain. Dragged into a mysterious Urban Legends Live Room, Evan Reed must survive deadly paranormal scenarios, uncover hidden rules, and find a way out before he becomes part of the legend himself.

dramabox.title: No Good Deeds Go Unrewarded
dramabox.norm_title: no good deeds go unrewarded
dramabox.description: Delivery driver Ethan Stone saves retired Chief Hayes when the old man suffers a sudden heart attack, emptying his savings to cover the medical bills. Instead of gratitude, the Hayes family's four wealthy children mistake him for the one who caused it and come down on his entire family. In court, Ethan is nearly forced into a guilty plea — until the old chief wakes up, storms into the courtroom, and tears into his own children to clear Ethan's name.

dramabox.title: When Love Meets Its End（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: when love meets its end dubbed
dramabox.description: John Dylan, heir to Brown Corp, hides his identity while dating Chloe Lowe. Influenced by her greedy friend Leah, Chloe fights with John over money. When Frances Brown arrives with lavish gifts, Leah and Chloe mock him—until Hubert Stone confirms his identity. Realizing her mistake, Chloe fabricates lies to save face, but John sees through her.

dramabox.title: They Thought I Was Just an Employee
dramabox.norm_title: they thought i was just an employee
dramabox.description: I was a martial arts champion who built a boxing gym with my brother Ethan Reed. We trained thousands of students and earned $5 million. We agreed to split the profits 50/50, but he only gave me $100,000 at year-end, saying, “You’re just an employee. Even a dog could do your job!” He thought I was easy to crush, but I had built deep bonds with the students and staff. The day I leave is the day the gym falls apart.

dramabox.title: The Last Ride Ends at Her Ruin（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the last ride ends at her ruin dubbed
dramabox.description: The Keller couple adopted Caleb Dale, who eventually marries their daughter, Nina Keller, and manages the family company with dedication. Yet, Nina sees him only as a useless live-in husband. Her willfulness leads to her parents getting into a fatal accident. Despite being a top doctor, Nina refuses to save them. Caleb must lay them to rest with dignity and find a way to hold the heartless Nina accountable.

dramabox.title: Love Left to Bleed（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: love left to bleed dubbed
dramabox.description: Sean Floyd warns his wife, Grace Hall, that Survey Point No. 1 is dangerous, yet she chooses to trust her first love, Eric Klein, and ends up in an accident. When Sean risks his life to save her, he ends up hanging from a cliff—along with Eric. As he desperately hopes for Grace to rescue him, she saves Eric instead and lets Sean fall into the abyss. Miraculously, he survives the fall and later comes across a social media post of Grace and Eric flaunting their relationship.

dramabox.title: Immortal Descends: Curing My Mute Wife（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: immortal descends curing my mute wife dubbed
dramabox.description: Michael Coltrane, an immortal from the Celestial Realm, possesses the body of a notorious mortal gambler to escape his creditors. No longer the man he once was, he uses his awakened powers to protect his mute wife, Evelyn Coltrane. Using his cultivation, he makes a fortune through stone gambling, opens a clinic, exposes a quack doctor, subdues powerful magnates, and crushes dangerous gangs.

dramabox.title: The Security Guard No One Saw Coming（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the security guard no one saw coming dubbed
dramabox.description: After nineteen years of cultivation in the mountains, Ethan Carter is sent into the mortal world to complete his final trial. A chance encounter with CEO Claire Bishop leaves him burdened with a huge debt and working as a security guard at her company. Hiding extraordinary martial arts and fortune-reading skills, Ethan resolves one crisis after another while searching for his long-lost family—and discovers that fate has prepared far more than enlightenment.

dramabox.title: Infinite Evolution: No Limit to Power
dramabox.norm_title: infinite evolution no limit to power
dramabox.description: When humanity mysteriously shrinks to the size of insects, civilization collapses into a deadly world where everything is a predator. College student Ethan Cole awakens the Infinite Evo System, evolving by devouring biomass and stealing the powers of fallen Awakeners. Fighting alongside Claire Stone, he must survive mutants, the infected, and a fanatical cult while gathering alien crystal cores before humanity's last hope is lost.

dramabox.title: Once a Legend: Back in the Game
dramabox.norm_title: once a legend back in the game
dramabox.description: Once the most feared man in the underworld, Logan Cross leaves prison determined to start over. Now a truck driver, he wants nothing more than a quiet life with his wife. But when trouble comes looking for him, Logan refuses to fight—even as his former brothers stand ready to follow his lead. He walked away from the underworld once. This time, he's determined never to go back.

dramabox.title: His Paycheck, Her Pennies
dramabox.norm_title: his paycheck her pennies
dramabox.description: Wealthy heiress Elena Hart marries engineer Logan Carter for love, only to spend three years surviving on a tiny allowance while his mother, Linda Graves, controls every paycheck. When Elena collapses from malnutrition, Logan follows the money, demands repayment, and finally stands up to his family. But as he fights to repair their marriage, a mysterious transfer uncovers the truth about his identity.

dramabox.title: My Whole Family Are Hidden Big Shots
dramabox.norm_title: my whole family are hidden big shots
dramabox.description: After crossing over from the Mystic Realm, Vincent Bell's family secretly becomes modern-day elites. His mother serves as a governor, his father develops cutting-edge technology, and his actress sister stars in fantasy dramas. Forced to protect a tech company's CEO, Kathryn Carter, while posing as an ordinary employee, Vincent accidentally adds her to the family group chat. She thinks they're all bragging until she discovers every member of his family is a true powerhouse.

dramabox.title: Answer to No One: My Way or No Way（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: answer to no one my way or no way dubbed
dramabox.description: My name is Chad Gain. Reborn today, I choose a different life. Once a coward, I now choose to be a thug. Rising from a restaurant waiter to an underground kingpin, I crush bullies and outsmart powerful enemies. I live by one rule—touch my people, and I end you. The moment I stop backing down, the world starts making way for me.

dramabox.title: Fireroad: No Man's Land
dramabox.norm_title: fireroad no man s land
dramabox.description: Ethan Hayes, a retired special forces soldier, takes on a 300,000-yuan job to save his comatose sister: escort a "package" through no man's land to the border. The package turns out to be Claire Miles, a pampered heiress. The two clash from the start, surviving desert bandits and a death-trap town, falling for each other along the way. But Claire's past hides a dangerous secret — and the truth behind who put Ethan's sister in a coma is starting to surface.

dramabox.title: When My Online Boyfriend Turned Out to Be Immortal
dramabox.norm_title: when my online boyfriend turned out to be immortal
dramabox.description: Born in 1900, immortal cultivator Ethan Vale finally meets his online girlfriend, Claire Blair, after a year of chatting, only to be mistaken for a Gen Z youngster. As he quietly displays unimaginable power and protects Claire from one deadly crisis after another, he sacrifices everything to save her. Twenty years later, when Claire has become a powerful cultivator herself, a simple message—"Wanna date online?"—brings fate full circle.

dramabox.title: The Security Guard No One Saw Coming
dramabox.norm_title: the security guard no one saw coming
dramabox.description: After nineteen years of cultivation in the mountains, Ethan Carter is sent into the mortal world to complete his final trial. A chance encounter with CEO Claire Bishop leaves him burdened with a huge debt and working as a security guard at her company. Hiding extraordinary martial arts and fortune-reading skills, Ethan resolves one crisis after another while searching for his long-lost family—and discovers that fate has prepared far more than enlightenment.

dramabox.title: When Love Missed Its Moment（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: when love missed its moment dubbed
dramabox.description: In his past life, Howard Judd married Willow Murphy, but she used him as a blood bank for her first love, Simon Wade. Howard died with a broken heart. When he is reborn at their wedding, he steps aside to let Willow marry Simon while he leaves the country. He pursues his dream in a foreign country and thrives as a designer with Sera Jordan's help. Howard finds new love, while Willow's regret comes far too late.

dramabox.title: I Didn't Know I Was Already Invincible（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: i didn t know i was already invincible dubbed
dramabox.description: Logan Carter, the world’s mightiest warrior, was mentally broken by his family to live as a useless outcast. He left his mountain to cancel his arranged marriages for immortality, but his four wealthy fiancées came to him unannounced. Three shamed him publicly, while only Vivian Evans stayed loyal. All mocked the plain nobody, unaware he ruled the realm unrivaled. After easily defeating countless elite masters, Logan learned he was an immortal living among mortals.

dramabox.title: The Heart He Gave, The Love She Broke
dramabox.norm_title: the heart he gave the love she broke
dramabox.description: The successful Rachel Quinn is asked to call the person she is most thankful to in an interview. She calls her ex-husband, Harvey Smith, who once left her for money. He asks to borrow $30,000. She hangs up in disgust, unaware that he needs the money for an artificial heart transplant. Later, her boyfriend humiliates Harvey, who is working as a waiter, and forces him to drink. The manager anxiously steps in and reveals Harvey can't drink because he once donated his heart...

dramabox.title: The Immortal's Judgment: Heaven's Wrath at His Command
dramabox.norm_title: the immortal s judgment heaven s wrath at his command
dramabox.description: The immortal Liam Hodge spends five years in the Well family to repay a debt of gratitude. He shields the Wells from heaven's wrath with his disabled body. When they betray him, disaster strikes and ruins their family. Courted by powerful forces, Liam rises beyond their reach—while the Well family's regret comes too late as their downfall is sealed.

dramabox.title: My Farewell to Forever
dramabox.norm_title: my farewell to forever
dramabox.description: Given a second chance at life, Charles Grant wakes up as his 27-year-old self. He has a son, a daughter, and a wife who is the world’s richest woman, Lynette Stone—the woman every man dreams of. The first thing he does after returning is deliver their divorce agreement to the woman he truly loves. This time, he chooses to let Lynette go—and, in doing so, finally sets himself free.

dramabox.title: Her Dirty Game, His Clean Revenge(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: her dirty game his clean revenge dubbed
dramabox.description: Caleb Sloan's wife, Jasmine Fuller, claims she's a germaphobe. So, they eat separately throughout their three years of marriage. One day, Caleb catches her sharing a meal with her young assistant. He watches in shock as she finishes his leftover food without hesitation and realizes that her "germophobia" applies only to him. Humiliated and furious by her blatant double standard, Caleb snaps.

dramabox.title: A Legacy of Honor, A Promise Unbroken
dramabox.norm_title: a legacy of honor a promise unbroken
dramabox.description: After his father’s death, Eren Kross—the feared mercenary king—returns home to inherit hundreds of billions in shares. Instead of a welcome, he is met with schemes and hostility from within his own family. His half-brother challenges him, his cousin plots against him, and deadly forces close in.

dramabox.title: Nine Times a Farewell
dramabox.norm_title: nine times a farewell
dramabox.description: Gavin Stone's wife constantly abandons him for her returned first love. Her returned first love even makes a bet with Gavin: if he gets abandoned nine times, Gavin must get divorced. On a rainy night, a single phone call makes his wife strand Gavin on the road for the ninth time. Heartbroken, Gavin finally walks away and signs the divorce. As he closes that toxic chapter, he unexpectedly finds redemption in Vivian, a girl who has secretly loved him for years.

dramabox.title: The Beautiful CEO Comes Calling with Her Daughter
dramabox.norm_title: the beautiful ceo comes calling with her daughter
dramabox.description: To uncover the truth about his mother's death, Ien—once a legendary special forces operative—hid his identity and became a taxi driver. On one routine pick‑up, he accidentally ended up in a one‑night stand with Bella, a stunning young CEO. Four years later, Bella arrived at his doorstep with their daughter in tow and married him.

dramabox.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: The Secret Heir's Trial of Love
dramabox.norm_title: hidden in plain sight the secret heir s trial of love
dramabox.description: To temper Ethan Hayes’s temperament and resilience, as well as to find a daughter-in-law who values character over wealth, the Hayes Family deliberately concealed their immense fortune from Ethan Hayes. Thus began Ethan Hayes’s remarkable journey of self-testing.This life of living under an undisclosed identity smoothed out Ethan Hayes’s impetuosity, and more importantly, allowed Ethan Hayes to meet his true love, a woman who holds no regard for material riches.

dramabox.title: Supreme Healer Returns: Time to Tremble
dramabox.norm_title: supreme healer returns time to tremble
dramabox.description: James Sanchez, a prodigy in both martial arts and medicine, enters the world at the behest of his three stunning mentors to honor a marriage pact and seek revenge. Watch as he navigates complicated dynamics between a fiery CEO and a seductive best friend while crushing those who have ever looked down on him.

dramabox.title: The Fastest Blade: A Man's Last Stand
dramabox.norm_title: the fastest blade a man s last stand
dramabox.description: Jonathan Finch is the greatest fighter, but he loses his family because of his arrogance. Heartbroken, he hides away in a tavern. Five years later, he falls in love with Emily Lombard, the daughter of the tavern's owner. They defend the family's secret brewing recipe from ruthless enemies. With her help, he overcomes his trauma, unleashes his true strength, protects the tavern, and faces the powerful hidden force behind the attacks.

dramabox.title: All For The Winner
dramabox.norm_title: all for the winner
dramabox.description: After witnessing his father’s murder as a child, Ethan Cross conceals his prodigious card skills to honor his father’s dying promise: “Never gamble.” But he never abandons his secret quest to hunt down his father’s killer. Rescued years later by Claudia, the owner of Paradise Casino, Ethan goes undercover as a bartender there—lying low while chasing clues.

dramabox.title: She Rules a Realm, I Rule Her Heart
dramabox.norm_title: she rules a realm i rule her heart
dramabox.description: To save his best friend Ryan Drake, Ethan Cole revealed his secret of immortality, only to be kidnapped and taken to Serpent Isle by Ryan, who intended to steal his immortal fate. Ryan never knew Serpent Isle’s ruler Claire Vance was Ethan’s ex-wife: 500 years prior, she saved bandit-wounded Ethan traveling for the imperial exam and fell in love with him.

dramabox.title: Tales from the Convenience Store
dramabox.norm_title: tales from the convenience store
dramabox.description: At Braston Court, a cozy neighborhood between the old and new city, a new convenience store opens. More than just a shop, it has blossomed into a vibrant hub for the community. Daily, the enthusiastic crew—the manager, cashier, and delivery guy—welcomes a colorful parade of patrons: lost kids, quarreling couples, struggling dreamers, and homesick workers.Here, you’ll find relatable moments and unexpected magic.

dramabox.title: 404 Error: You Lost My Love
dramabox.norm_title: 404 error you lost my love
dramabox.description: For five years, Hugo gave up his dream career to care for his sick wife, Sheila. But while he devoted his life to her, she humiliated him, ignored him, and chose her wealthy ex over her husband. Heartbroken, Hugo files for divorce and leaves on a dangerous deep-sea mission. Only after he's gone does Sheila realize she lost the one man who truly loved her. But when she finally wants him back... will she be too late?

dramabox.title: No More Lies, No More Games
dramabox.norm_title: no more lies no more games
dramabox.description: Ethan Dawson uncovers his fiancée's ultimate betrayal: she only pretends to love him to secure a luxury life for her secret lover within the Dawson family. Heartbroken but awakened to the scheme, Ethan refuses to be their financial pawn. Dumping the liar, he turns his back on her and decides to marry the true heiress, Olivia Nolan.

dramabox.title: Drift King: Back for the 10th Crown
dramabox.norm_title: drift king back for the 10th crown
dramabox.description: Former nine-time drifting champion Jack has lived in seclusion for five years after losing his partner David to sabotage. To protect David's daughter Megan and her racing base, he shows his superb driving skills again. He defeats rivals, exposes the villain and clears up misunderstandings. Finally, Jack and his teammates head for the race to chase the tenth championship.

dramabox.title: Time Doesn't Pause for Regret
dramabox.norm_title: time doesn t pause for regret
dramabox.description: 20-year-old Jason Marsh falls deeply in love with the older Cheryl Abel, only to become a substitute for her first love, Lucas Gegg. Lucas sabotages their relationship the moment he returns from abroad, leading to Jason and Cheryl’s divorce. When Jason gradually finds love with someone else, Cheryl finally realizes her true feelings and tries to win him back. At the same time, she discovers that Lucas is the one behind everything.

dramabox.title: You Begged for Freedom, Now You Beg for Me
dramabox.norm_title: you begged for freedom now you beg for me
dramabox.description: Lim Do-yun, a live-in son-in-law, transforms his in-laws' failing business into an empire, only to be mocked by his wife, Kang Eun-hee. Obsessed with her first love, Eun-hee ignores Do-yun's pleas when her parents are critically injured and even destroys their surgical consent forms, leading to their deaths. Cast aside after the funeral, Do-yun strikes back. Armed with a secret will and a devastating transfer agreement, he destroys her wealth, status, and reputation

dramabox.title: I Didn't Know I Was Already Invincible
dramabox.norm_title: i didn t know i was already invincible
dramabox.description: Logan Carter, the world’s mightiest warrior, was mentally broken by his family to live as a useless outcast. He left his mountain to cancel his arranged marriages for immortality, but his four wealthy fiancées came to him unannounced. Three shamed him publicly, while only Vivian Evans stayed loyal. All mocked the plain nobody, unaware he ruled the realm unrivaled. After easily defeating countless elite masters, Logan learned he was an immortal living among mortals.

dramabox.title: Slumdog Gridiron-God
dramabox.norm_title: slumdog gridiron god
dramabox.description: A gifted young athlete, Anthony, must pass a brutal football tryout to secure a college running back spot—the only way to move his family out of a rundown motel and keep them from being torn apart. Standing in his way is Jennifer, the powerful head of Child Protective Services, whose own son is competing for the same position and will stop at nothing to eliminate him.

dramabox.title: Above You, Beyond You, Gone From You
dramabox.norm_title: above you beyond you gone from you
dramabox.description: Jude Fenn, the heir to the richest man, hides his identity to help his girlfriend, Lana Holt, establish herself in the art world, even rejecting an arranged marriage for her sake. After being mocked for his apparent lack of status, he is forced to separate from Lana for four years. During that time, Lana falls for someone else, while his fiancée, Mila Lind, remains loyal and supportive. When Lana betrays him at a homecoming banquet, Jude finally lets go of the past.

dramabox.title: Just an Assistant, Secretly Untouchable
dramabox.norm_title: just an assistant secretly untouchable
dramabox.description: Super soldier Logan Steele goes undercover as CEO Claire Carter’s personal assistant to protect her and the Panacea-1 capsules. dramabox.title: The Day I Leave, Her Empire Collapses
dramabox.norm_title: the day i leave her empire collapses

The patriarch of the Hale family sends out an encrypted message to ask Leon Carter for help. Grateful for the favor the patriarch did to him in his early days, Leon promises to protect the Hale family for five years and marries Claire Hale, the eldest daughter of the family.

dramabox.title: Our Love, Burned Out (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: our love burned out dubbed

Zack reaches his breaking point when, on the anniversary of his mother's death, she leaves him for Braxton—again. Only after losing him does Sarah realize her mistake, but by the time she tries to win him back, Zack has moved on, and their love becomes an irreversible regret.

dramabox.title: Awakening the Blade: One Sword to Rule Them All

dramabox.title: The Almighty Playboy: Legend in Disguise
dramabox.norm_title: the almighty playboy legend in disguise

dramabox.title: You Signed My Termination, I Signed Your Defeat (DUBBED)

Jacob walks away without hesitation and teams up with CEO Susie Koch to rebuild his career. Using his abilities and wit, he outsmarts his former fiancée and her lover.

dramabox.title: Eyes on Treasure, Hands on Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: eyes on treasure hands on fortune

As rivals try to bring him down, he steadily builds a vast fortune and earns widespread recognition. Craig rises from an ordinary delivery worker to a legendary figure in the antiques world.

dramabox.norm_title: the midnight bus three rules to survive

When a greedy colleague steals his shift and vanishes, Ethan refuses to back down, determined to drive again and uncover a massive conspiracy behind the horrors.

dramabox.title: Defying the World for My Phantom Lover
dramabox.norm_title: defying the world for my phantom lover

As a dark case involving five youth deaths points to high-level police corruption, Logan drops his guard. Ready to fight the system and the world, their clash turns into a deep, life-or-death redemption.

dramabox.title: From Intern to the CEO's Husband
dramabox.norm_title: from intern to the ceo s husband

Growing up, he believed he was a left-behind child and threw himself into his studies with relentless drive; during college, he worked multiple part-time jobs to satisfy his girlfriend Tessa Lane’s extravagant demands.

dramabox.title: Out of the Shadows, All In Again
dramabox.norm_title: out of the shadows all in again

His brother-in-law falls into a gambling trap, loses everything, and hides in shame. Then the Blake family’s empire is nearly wiped out by the same scheme. To save them, Ethan returns for one final showdown where he outplays the current king, winning billions for the Blakes and earning Claire Blake’s heart.

dramabox.title: Road to Survival: Fortress of the Apocalypse
dramabox.norm_title: road to survival fortress of the apocalypse

Daniel Walker, an adopted son betrayed by his family in his past life, once gave everything—only to be cast aside and left to die. Now reborn at the start of the apocalypse, he awakens Apocalypse Squad System. He upgrades his war vehicle, gathers supplies, and builds his own force as he prepares for survival.

dramabox.title: The Invincible Bodyguard(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: the invincible bodyguard dubbed
dramabox.description: Seth Page, merely a security guard, unintentionally offends a billionaire heiress and has since been harassed by her investigation and the threats posed by her followers—but if this goes on, his true identity might be exposed.

dramabox.norm_title: immortal descends curing my mute wife

Using his cultivation, he makes a fortune through stone gambling, opens a clinic, exposes a quack doctor, subdues powerful magnates, and crushes dangerous gangs.

dramabox.title: Fishing Up Fortune: Catch Big, Live Bigger!
dramabox.norm_title: fishing up fortune catch big live bigger

When his mother-in-law pressures him to get a divorce, he uses the system to protect his family and stand his ground. As he gains wealth, property, and influence, he overcomes workplace bullying, exposes dishonesty, and defends his loved ones. Leo grows from an ordinary employee into a responsible man who leads his family toward a better life.

dramabox.title: Earth-King Returns from the Shadow
dramabox.norm_title: earth king returns from the shadow

But as enemies come after them, he slowly regains his lost artifacts and divine power. The man everyone looks down on is about to rise again, this time to protect the mother and daughter who saved him.

dramabox.title: Sorry, but Mercy Ends Here (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: sorry but mercy ends here dubbed

dramabox.title: The Fortune She Lost to Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: the fortune she lost to betrayal

Shocked, Victor discovers his daughter’s betrayal and her cruel plan to drive her loyal and devoted husband out of the family. During his homecoming banquet, Victor secretly makes a decisive layout.

dramabox.title: His Duty Is Protection, His Power Is Absolute
dramabox.norm_title: his duty is protection his power is absolute

He gathers evidence against those with bad intentions and makes them face the consequences. This time, he will protect his family and grasp the fulfilling life he should have had.

dramabox.title: Unstoppable: I Am the Exception to Destiny
dramabox.norm_title: unstoppable i am the exception to destiny

As Tyler uncovers a dark secret hidden for over a decade, his four powerful seniors—each a legend in her own field—unite to crush every obstacle with just one word from him.

dramabox.title: Awakening: The Cruelty of Special Class Admissions
dramabox.norm_title: awakening the cruelty of special class admissions
dramabox.description: Students in a special essay class at Seungho High School spend their vacation together, leading to a mysterious, suspenseful college admissions thriller.

dramabox.title: Breaking Heaven's Law, Conquer All He Saw
dramabox.norm_title: breaking heaven s law conquer all he saw
dramabox.description: After an online scammer empties his bank account, Evan Cruz gains something far more extraordinary: the Primordial Vessel. Bound by a cosmic contract—never be fooled again—he’s thrust into a world where legends walk among mortals and nothing makes sense. His only anchor? An unlikely ally named Nezha, who keeps saving his life. What could possibly go wrong?

dramabox.title: My Poor Husband Is A Big Shot

Just as Jared finally lets go of Emily, she suddenly starts chasing him instead.

dramabox.title: Ox of Destiny: Turning Famine to Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: ox of destiny turning famine to fortune

With hard work, courage, and the ox by his side, Carl fights off villains and rises from poverty to rewrite his fate.

dramabox.title: Reborn Villain Heir Turns the Script Around

Armed with his family's power and knowledge of the future, Arthur becomes the true master of the story.

Gaining wealth and power overnight, he crushes those who once humiliated him and stands up against injustice for his classmates. In the end, he finds both love and success.

dramabox.title: When Time Unlocks Love
dramabox.norm_title: when time unlocks love
dramabox.description: Abandoned by her first love, Im Eun-ju impulsively accepts Kim Woo-jin's proposal. Woo-jin gives up his dream of becoming a doctor and becomes a stay-at-home husband to develop a cure for Eun-ju's allergy. Despite his devotion, Eun-ju remains indifferent toward him. When her first love returns, Woo-jin voluntarily divorces her so she can reunite with him. By the time Eun-ju realizes her mistake in letting him go, he has long since left her world to pursue his dream.

dramabox.title: Awakened from Disgrace, Rose to Glory
dramabox.norm_title: awakened from disgrace rose to glory
dramabox.description: Mark Lowe, once an immortal, is punished and transmigrates as the head of the Lowe family—one of the legendary Four Great Martial Families. Branded weak and disgraced, he inherits a family on the brink of collapse, along with a gifted wife, Clara Lane, the one holding everything together. With a confident smirk, Mark casts aside his former cowardice. Dual cultivation or not, he couldn't care less. Restoring the family's glory, however, has become his mission.

dramabox.title: System-Built City: I Construct, I Command, I Control
dramabox.norm_title: system built city i construct i command i control
dramabox.description: Charles Grant, a failing student at a third-rate academy, suddenly becomes a construction foreman—and discovers he has a building system with magical properties. A toilet he casually builds turns into a "treasure for the constipated," and a simple footbridge becomes a "bridge for criminals to confess their sins." That's right—whatever he builds, he decides its rules!

dramabox.title: Our Love, Burned Out
dramabox.norm_title: our love burned out
dramabox.description: Once a couple envied by all, Zack Sachs and Sarah Jones's relationship teeters on the edge. He gives everything to her, yet she keeps putting her depressed childhood friend, Braxton Tate, first. Zack reaches his breaking point when, on the anniversary of his mother's death, she leaves him for Braxton—again. Only after losing him does Sarah realize her mistake, but by the time she tries to win him back, Zack has moved on, and their love becomes an irreversible regret.

dramabox.title: Rewound in Time, Master of the Board
dramabox.norm_title: rewound in time master of the board

After that single game, 49 years pass in the mortal world, and Ronan is given a magical peach that transforms him into a ten-year-old again. In 2025, Ronan returns home as a child, unsurprisingly facing doubts and numerous obstacles. He proves his identity by solving the Labyrinth Go, saves his wife with the magical peach, and uncovers a deeper family conspiracy.

dramabox.title: Making the Cut Was Just the Beginning
dramabox.norm_title: making the cut was just the beginning

Upon getting a second chance at life, he enters the interview as a last-minute candidate and is hired with a record-high score. At work, he outmaneuvers a hostile supervisor and earns the trust of the new CEO, which helps him climb the corporate ladder in a flash. When Joan learns about this, she regrets what she did.

dramabox.title: Vengeance Awaits His Return(DUBBED)

dramabox.title: Kissing The Wrong Brother
dramabox.norm_title: kissing the wrong brother
dramabox.description: To win her crush's heart before graduation, nerdy Maria asks his dangerously charming older brother to coach her in romance—only to realize she might be falling for the wrong brother. What starts as simple tutoring soon turns into something more, as he becomes the one she never saw coming.

dramabox.title: Fate Woven in Revenge（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: fate woven in revenge dubbed
dramabox.description: Claire Wells, a general’s daughter, survives her family’s brutal massacre. Concealing her identity, she returns to the capital as the chancellor’s daughter. Gentlelooking yet sharpminded, she wins the emperor’s favor in the palace and edges closer to power.Trapped in political schemes and tangled feelings, she finds her enemies linked to imperial power. Driven by vengeance, she wages a fateful fight between bloodstained revenge and true love.

dramabox.title: You Can't Escape Me You Can't Escape Me
dramabox.norm_title: you can t escape me you can t escape me
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole, an ordinary ad designer in Brooklyn, lives a quiet life until his new neighbor Liam Hayes moves in—and Ethan begins to feel intense pleasure and pain that aren't his own. Liam has possessed a rare empathic ability since age fifteen, when he first sensed Ethan's existence and began a decade-long obsession, recording every detail of Ethan's life in journals and covering his walls with photos.

dramabox.title: Switched Engagement
dramabox.norm_title: switched engagement
dramabox.description: After learning her fiancé Ethan Mason only entered their arranged marriage to get over his first-love breakup, Claire Reed grows disheartened and chooses a new marriage partner: Liam Mason, the Mason family’s notorious dissolute third son. What she does not know is Liam has long loved her in secret. Unaware Reed Corp once rescued Mason Corp, Ethan fails to realize Liam is Mason Corp’s real heir.

dramabox.title: Into the Abyss
dramabox.norm_title: into the abyss
dramabox.description: Chloe, a Chinese-American mixed-race girl, lived as a dependent in a conservative, blended white middle-class family, where a forbidden love grew between her and Austin, her stepbrother with no blood relation. At first, Austin approached her out of resentment toward Chloe's mother, feigning deep love while gradually taking control of her. After the truth was exposed, Chloe resolved to go to Paris for her studies and sever all ties.

dramabox.title: My Loser Mate is the Lycan King
dramabox.norm_title: my loser mate is the lycan king
dramabox.description: For fifteen years, everyone thought Nathan Blackwood was just a worthless son-in-law, but no one knew that he actually gave up the throne for love. When his partner and daughter betrayed him for another man, even sending him off to the silver mines to die, Nathan finally stopped holding back. He returned with full force as the King of Werewolves—uncovering the betrayal, reclaiming the throne, and ultimately choosing the woman who, just like him, firmly chose him.

dramabox.title: The Lion King in My Bed
dramabox.norm_title: the lion king in my bed
dramabox.description: Kane, lion prince of the Golden Pride, is betrayed and reduced to cub form—saved by human Luna. As he heals and shifts, they bond. Black Lion assassins hunt them; they flee, fight, and separate to protect each other. Luna grows fierce; Kane awakens ancestral power, avenges his clan, and claims his throne. In the end, he proposes to Luna. She becomes queen. Their war ends in peace and forever love.

dramabox.title: The mob boss spoils his pregnant wife
dramabox.norm_title: the mob boss spoils his pregnant wife
