dramabox.description: Damon Blackwood, the ruthless mafia don who has never touched a woman at thirty, mistakes innocent college student Lily for an escort during a rainstorm. After one brutal night, he casts her out with a priceless watch. One month later, Lily discovers she is pregnant with twins—but her drug-addicted brother's debts force her parents to sell her to a dealer. Seven months later, she collapses in Damon's own bar, and the Patek Philippe on her wrist reveals the truth.

dramabox.title: The Eternal Blood Pact
dramabox.norm_title: the eternal blood pact
dramabox.description: Queen Chloe of the Vampire Clan was betrayed by her beloved Karl in her past life, who tore out her heart and left her to die. Reborn as a low-ranking vampire, she is forcibly bound by a blood pact to Edgar, a cold, domineering pure-blood prince. Driven by vengeance after rebirth, Chloe initially sees Edgar merely as a tool to stage her comeback. She waits for the chance to escape and avenge herself against the traitorous Karl and Isabella.

dramabox.title: Her Second Life Without Him
dramabox.norm_title: her second life without him
dramabox.description: In her past life, Claire Hayes devoted herself to household duties and stayed loyally by Adrian Wells and their two daughters. Yet she ended up alone and miserable. Reborn, the very first thing Claire does is file for divorce. She walks away, leaving both her husband and children to Tessa Reed. After Claire’s departure, Adrian and the two girls finally see Tessa Reed’s true colors, but it is already too late. Meanwhile, Claire Hayes embarks on a brand-new life of her own.

dramabox.title: The Racer I Should Hate
dramabox.norm_title: the racer i should hate
dramabox.description: At university, poor mechanic Leo is rivals with Alaric—a mafia heir and top F1 racer—until they strike a deal: Leo tutors Alaric to help him pass an exam, and Alaric helps Leo pursue his crush Ethan. As they spend time together, Leo finds himself drawn to the dangerous Alaric, while gentle Ethan also shows interest. After a jealous misunderstanding, a drunken kiss with Alaric makes Leo realize his true feelings.

dramabox.title: My Secret Billion‑Dollar Identity
dramabox.norm_title: my secret billion dollar identity
dramabox.description: On their 3rd wedding anniversary, Vivian Carter intends to reveal her billionaire-heiress identity to husband Adrian Dalton and grant him equity in Dalton Corp. But Chloe Parker storms into Vivian’s villa with her friends, ruining her property, beating and degrading her by labelling her the mistress. When Chloe is about to disfigure Vivian, Adrian Dalton shows up and kneels before her, proving Vivian is his lawful wife.

dramabox.title: The Lord's Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: the lord s obsession
dramabox.description: Emperor Leonardo, obsessed with saving his commoner girl Alicia, forced her into marriage and imprisoned her. He then brought in a look-alike substitute, who, out of jealousy, harmed the heroine nearly to death. When the truth was uncovered, the emperor was filled with remorse and ultimately died together with the heroine—a twisted, tragic tale of royal obsession and cruel love.

dramabox.title: Married Broke，Loved Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: married broke loved billionaire
dramabox.description: To escape her abusive stepfather, a fashion designer agrees to a flash marriage. Her "broke" husband claims he's impotent—relieved, she thinks: perfect, a paper marriage! But he's actually Zack Hamilton, heir to a $100 billion empire. His poverty and impotence are just a test to see if she's a gold-digger. She has no idea the "broke" man she married is New York's ultimate billionaire.

dramabox.title: Love in the air
dramabox.norm_title: love in the air
dramabox.description: Joyce fell in love at first sight with Captain Hank as she sought to overcome her fear of flying. The two entered into a three-year contract marriage, but after the wedding she gave everything yet was met with cold neglect. On their third anniversary, after catching Hank in an ambiguous situation, she was involved in a car accident and lost her memory. Upon recognizing the reality of the past, she resolved to divorce him.

dramabox.title: Taming the Enemy General
dramabox.norm_title: taming the enemy general
dramabox.description: After years of war, the two countries finally make peace. Crown Prince Elian of Silveron is sent to the enemy country as a hostage, but unexpectedly reunites with Ash, the enemy general he’s secretly had a crush on for years. Faced with the prince's straightforward and passionate pursuit, cautious and reserved Ash keeps pulling back because of age, rank, and the positions of their countries, but gradually, he starts falling too.

dramabox.title: The Moon Laurel
dramabox.norm_title: the moon laurel
dramabox.description: Cynthia is the spirit of a century-old laurel tree. To save her fiancé Luke, she drained all her magical power and helped him become the Second Royal Magus. In his hunger for status and power, Luke abandoned Cynthia. He framed her as a mere "flower vendor" and plotted to cut down the laurel tree that housed her true form.At this perilous moment, Arthur, the Chief Magus, stepped forward. He protected Cynthia by taking her as his wife, and the two were united in marriage.

dramabox.title: True and Fake Daughters Team Up
dramabox.norm_title: true and fake daughters team up
dramabox.description: Ellie is the real daughter who was switched at birth in the Bourne family. Eighteen years later, she returns to the Bourne household. Everyone thought she would compete with the Bourne family's fake daughter, Amber, but surprisingly, the first thing she does when she gets home is cling to Amber's leg. During their time together, Amber is moved by Ellie's genuine feelings, and the two sisters team up to take down the jerks in their lives.

dramabox.title: Sexy Professor Or Secret Husband
dramabox.norm_title: sexy professor or secret husband
dramabox.description: On her 21st birthday, broke college student Ava Wright drunkenly marries a mysterious billionaire who pays her tuition, only to discover a year later that her cold, brilliant new professor is the same man. As forbidden attraction ignites, neither realizes they're already husband and wife.

dramabox.title: The Last Mermaid: My Enemy King Begs for Forgiveness
dramabox.norm_title: the last mermaid my enemy king begs for forgiveness
dramabox.description: After human king Lucius wipes out the merfolk, he enslaves Ilyia, the princess who once saved his life. As a fatal curse consumes her, he discovers the truth behind her sacrifice and his queen’s betrayal. But when he finally begs for forgiveness, love and redemption have come too late.

dramabox.title: My Billionaire Uncle Rides Me Crazy
dramabox.norm_title: my billionaire uncle rides me crazy
dramabox.description: Alice joins a motorcycle journey led by her billionaire uncle, Puchi. When a storm strands the family overnight, their forbidden attraction crosses the line. Bound together by a new business venture, Alice willingly follows him into a dangerous new life.

dramabox.title: She Is My Cure
dramabox.norm_title: she is my cure
dramabox.description: After being used as Subject Seven in her stepfather's illegal experiments, Evelyn is rescued by her cold stepsister Camilla—Subject One. Bound by blood, desire, and shared trauma, the two women uncover a deadly conspiracy, expose a monstrous scientist, and become each other's cure.

dramabox.title: The Mermaid's Forbidden Spell: Mutual Redemption of Atlantis
dramabox.norm_title: the mermaid s forbidden spell mutual redemption of atlantis
dramabox.description: The deep-sea kingdom of Atlantis is facing a chasm crisis unlike any in a thousand years. They need to arrange a marriage with the Sea Witch clan to use their secret arts to seal the rift; otherwise, the entire royal city will fall into a pitch-black abyss. The crown prince, Samuel, was appointed by his mother, the queen, to marry the Sea Witch princess Morgana when he was young. His adopted brother, Leander, is actually the orphan of the late Sea God general.

dramabox.title: Her Forbidden Alphas
dramabox.norm_title: her forbidden alphas
dramabox.description: Her fiancé chose another woman. His best friend chose her. Celine used Cassian to get back at Damian—but Cassian knew and stayed anyway. Seven years of lies, stolen kisses, and two Alphas fighting for her. But when the Moon Court forced her to pick one, Celine refused. She chose herself first. Then she chose Cassian—on her own terms. No more playing victim. She's done being the prize. Now she writes her own rules.

dramabox.title: Claimed by the Galaxy King
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by the galaxy king
dramabox.description: After catching her husband cheating, Nora thinks her life can't get worse—until she's abducted by aliens and claimed by Kairos, their dangerously irresistible King. Desperate to return to her son, she vows to escape. But when hatred turns into forbidden desire, will she still want to leave?

dramabox.title: The Fox Queen’s Hybrid Princess
dramabox.norm_title: the fox queen s hybrid princess
dramabox.description: Queen Celeste of the Fox Clan is rescued by wandering werewolf warrior Ronan after a border ambush. They fall for each other in a snow‑bound cave. She secretly gives birth to Aurora, a hybrid daughter wielding both fox and wolf powers, hiding her for five years. When political rivals stage a coup, Aurora awakens immense power. Celeste reveals her daughter’s identity, forms a sacred bond with Ronan, crushes rebellion and unites the two clans against outside threats.

dramabox.title: Cross The Line with Me, Zaddy
dramabox.norm_title: cross the line with me zaddy
dramabox.description: Determined to win the heart of her father's best friend, Gabrielle boldly sets out to seduce the one man who's sworn to resist her.

dramabox.title: The Royal Luna's Return
dramabox.norm_title: the royal luna s return
dramabox.description: After betrayal destroys her family, Amy Gareth returns as a powerful Silver Wolf to reclaim her stolen son and seek revenge, only to reunite with Alpha Darius Augustus and rediscover love.

dramabox.title: Bound by the Demon Lord: Obsession 100%
dramabox.norm_title: bound by the demon lord obsession 100
dramabox.description: Otome gamer Chloe Quinn is mistakenly trapped in a deadly demon realm as an assassin. To survive, she must romance Damian Vance, a ruthless Demon Lord whose hatred turns into obsession. But when she learns he is a real man imprisoned in the game, love becomes their only way home.

dramabox.title: Betrayed by Love, Crowned by Glory
dramabox.norm_title: betrayed by love crowned by glory
dramabox.description: Elena, who hid the identities of a billionaire heiress and a genius medical doctor, married ordinary doctor Nathan for love. But after a series of car accidents, her husband used the only ambulance to save his first love, causing her unborn child to die. Heartbroken, she shed her disguise and made a high-profile comeback as both the heir to SE Medical Group and a legendary medical genius, rising from betrayal and pain to reclaim everything that belongs to her.

dramabox.title: She Came, the Lovely Little Red Hood
dramabox.norm_title: she came the lovely little red hood
dramabox.description: Orphan Ruby is born without a wolf and is treated by the wolf clans as a bad omen. She is shunned and bullied, but in truth she carries the rare Little Red Hood bloodline, with the power to heal, break curses, and see the future. Kelly, the Ice Wolf Alpha's mistress, takes Ruby in as a maid and torments her endlessly. The wolf-fang amulet that holds the secret of Ruby's birth is stolen by Kelly's daughter, Abigail. With nowhere left to turn, Ruby runs away.

dramabox.title: Don’t Mess With Your Secret Billionaire Hubby
dramabox.norm_title: don t mess with your secret billionaire hubby
dramabox.description: James hides his billions and spends 2.3 billion buying a famous lingerie group to quietly fulfill his wife Vivian’s design dream. He plays an ordinary husband, only to get betrayed by her with spa therapist Derek. Drunk on career success, Vivian scorns her “useless” spouse and throws away his sincere love. At the star‑studded acquisition press conference, every illusion shatters.

dramabox.title: The Wolf King Serves Me
dramabox.norm_title: the wolf king serves me
dramabox.description: A betrayed wolf king loses his memory and powers, and is accidentally saved by a girl from a remote farm, who raises him as a 'wild dog.' As they spend time together, they form a mysterious blood pact and gradually develop feelings for each other. As the wolf king's powers awaken and the girl's hidden saint bloodline emerges, they join forces to fight usurpers, witches, and vampires, ultimately reclaiming the throne and changing each other's destinies.

dramabox.title: Marked by the Mermaid Princess
dramabox.norm_title: marked by the mermaid princess
dramabox.description: During an arctic storm, a young marine biologist accidentally rescues a critically injured merman prince, but ends up swallowing a crucial sacred pearl of the merfolk. His body is forcibly transformed, and he becomes pregnant with a mysterious deep-sea life. From that moment on, he not only has to endure intense physical mutations but also relies on merfolk powers to stay alive.

dramabox.title: The Bride of the Dragon God
dramabox.norm_title: the bride of the dragon god
dramabox.description: Grace, a pureblood sorceress, loses her chastity and forces her mute half-sister Liya to take her place as bride to the Dragon God Naz. After forming a blood bond with Naz, Liya is hunted by assassins sent by Grace. She and her mother Molly fall from a cliff and find refuge in a monastery, where Liya secretly gives birth to dragon twins Leo and Luna. To protect them, Mother Superior Amelia seals the Dragon Queen's token with magic, and Liya hides for seven years.

dramabox.title: Wasted Devotion, Rightful Love（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: wasted devotion rightful love dubbed
dramabox.description: For ten years, Elena Hart loved Ethan Reed — until she catches him crossing lines with her comatose sister, Vivian Hart. Elena chooses to marry childhood protector Adrian Hale instead, but Ethan and Vivian retaliate, sabotaging her career. Fiercely protected by Adrian, Elena rises from ruin. When Vivian's true face is exposed, Ethan's regret comes far too late.

dramabox.title: Big Molly The Billionaire's Only Cure
dramabox.norm_title: big molly the billionaire s only cure
dramabox.description: Molly Hart runs a hot dog truck with her foster parents. Adrian Blackwood, heir to the Blackwood Group, hasn't eaten for days—no chef or doctor can help. A hot dog from Molly's truck unexpectedly revives him. He tracks her down, offering money to keep the supply. But what starts as a transaction slowly becomes real dependence—and love.

dramabox.title: My Wolf Queen Girlfriend
dramabox.norm_title: my wolf queen girlfriend
dramabox.description: Lyra, heir to the Wolf Clan throne, becomes Kai's "girlfriend" to repay him for saving her life. They survive clan conflicts and wolf hunts, fall in love, and defeat villain Sable. Lyra is crowned queen, and Kai transforms into a werewolf to protect her and their worlds.

dramabox.title: Almost Lovers
dramabox.norm_title: almost lovers
dramabox.description: Elena returns from her prenatal checkup only to find her husband rubbing oil on his first love's belly. When she suffers a severe allergic reaction, he locks her away and ignores her pain—she loses the baby. Heartbroken, she leaves and starts over with Andrés. Months later, Eduardo asks her to meet at Love Bridge, where they once vowed forever, and threatens to jump unless she forgives him. Will Elena take him back, or let him fall?

dramabox.title: When a Twilight Soul Meets her First Light
dramabox.norm_title: when a twilight soul meets her first light
dramabox.description: Elena is framed and loses her job, then catches her boyfriend cheating. Devastated, she meets sweet younger Ray at a bar. They share a night. She leaves at dawn—only to discover Ray is her best friend's younger brother. What she doesn't know: Ray has secretly loved her for years. Now he's determined to be her official boyfriend.

dramabox.title: Clumsy Cupid
dramabox.norm_title: clumsy cupid
dramabox.description: "Half-god assassin EVA and rookie Cupid LEO fight Lucifer, finding love that saves humanity."

dramabox.title: The Cage of Love
dramabox.norm_title: the cage of love
dramabox.description: Silas, president of the Donovan Group, is drugged at a club and loses control, sleeping with Lucien—a passerby he believes is a stranger. The next morning, Silas throws a check at him, hoping to end it. What he doesn't know is that this was a trap Lucien had spent five years carefully planning. For half a decade, Lucien has secretly stalked him, collected his personal belongings, and hacked into his security systems.

dramabox.title: Against All Chains, We Found Each Other
dramabox.norm_title: against all chains we found each other
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Elena Hart was framed overseas by her sister. After meeting Ethan Frost, she gave birth to their baby against her family’s will and was cast out, raising the child on her own.Ethan, the powerful heir of a wealthy group, never forgot her. When they meet again, sparks instantly re‑ignite. Together they fight family plots, rival threats and betrayals. Ethan stands firmly by Elena’s side as they overcome every obstacle.

dramabox.title: The Pirate King's Virgin Princess
dramabox.norm_title: the pirate king s virgin princess
dramabox.description: A runaway princess. A ruthless pirate king. When Yelena saves the wounded Cassian Thorn, she never expects to become the captive bride of the most dangerous man on the seas. Yet beneath his cold exterior lies a wounded heart, and their forced union slowly transforms into an unforgettable love.

dramabox.title: My Fiancé Chose My Sister, So I Married Hades
dramabox.norm_title: my fianc chose my sister so i married hades
dramabox.description: When Aphrodite discovers her fiancé Apollo has chosen her sister Eris, she walks away from their love and offers Eris her place. Instead, Aphrodite marries Hades, the feared Lord of the Underworld. What begins as a loveless marriage soon turns into an unexpected romance, as Hades becomes her fiercest protector. But when the truth of Aphrodite’s past is revealed, Apollo realizes too late what he has lost.

dramabox.title: Their Hidden Princess
dramabox.norm_title: their hidden princess
dramabox.description:
After a mysterious dream reveals two men who could be her fated mate, Princess Zora comes to Blackstone Academy with one mission: find her true love to avoid an arranged marriage. 
Posing as a wolfless nobody, she plans to keep a low profile. Instead she catches the attention of Maximus and Ethan, the most powerful Alpha best friends. When fate chooses one heart and temptation pulls toward another, Zora discovers that finding true love is a lot messier than destiny promised.

dramabox.title: From Scorn to Forever Yours
dramabox.norm_title: from scorn to forever yours
dramabox.description: Pregnant and widowed, Elena Foster is brought to the Larkin Manor, only to learn that her late husband was the family's eldest son. There she meets Logan Larkin, the feared second son who has just returned from the frontier. Though Logan despises her at first, Elena refuses to surrender her dignity. Her strength gradually changes his heart, turning prejudice into unwavering devotion.

dramabox.title: The Serpent Empress's Secret Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the serpent empress s secret bride
dramabox.description: Trapped in a cruel marriage to a tyrant king, Queen Helena vows to resist the deadly allure of the Temple's chained Serpent Princess to preserve her honor. But as royal betrayals strip away everything she loves, she surrenders to the creature's intoxicating devotion. Together, they shatter their chains, burning the old kingdom to ashes so their love, and a new realm, can rise from the blood and fire.

dramabox.title: Taken By Hades
dramabox.norm_title: taken by hades
dramabox.description: Persephone saves Hades and is taken to the Underworld as his consort. Their forbidden bond turns into love, forcing them to defy both realms and rewrite the laws of life and death.

dramabox.title: My Poor Husband is a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: my poor husband is a billionaire
dramabox.description: Stella had a one-night stand with a stranger and mistook the man as someone who had plunged her into a prostitution scandal and ruined her life. Three years later, Stella married a man named Ethan in a flash and the two soon fell in love. However, gradually Stella found Ethan similar to the man three years ago. Even worse, Ethan had been hiding his CEO identity from Stella. Unable to accept the truth, Stella divorced Ethan.

dramabox.title: My Racing Nemesis Kissed Me
dramabox.norm_title: my racing nemesis kissed me
dramabox.description: Ethan, a racing navigator, is paired with his arch-rival Lucas as a new duo. He is shocked to discover Lucas has a crush on his sister, but during an ice-breaking plan, Ethan realizes Lucas actually likes him. A BL romance between racing rivals.

dramabox.title: Love Under Contract
dramabox.norm_title: love under contract
dramabox.description: Jennifer Sullivan, a lawyer, becomes a spy for Isaac Marks in order to save her sister. In the midst of love, hate and conspiracy, she gradually uncovers the truth of the arson case, and when the murderer is finally caught and Isaac reforms, Jennifer decides to let go of her past and make a fresh start with Isaac.

dramabox.title: The Fated Encounter, Love in Disguise
dramabox.norm_title: the fated encounter love in disguise
dramabox.description: Nina Shaw and Winston Harris, a couple who get married under false pretences to escape their engagements. At the very beginning, they hide their identities from each other, and their lives and work are constantly in turmoil. After joining the Harris Group, they encounter a variety of problems, including difficulties with colleagues and theft of designs. As the story unfolds, misunderstandings are gradually resolved and their relationship heats up in the midst of all the trial

dramabox.title: My Fiancé Auctioned Me, So I Chose a Better Man（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: my fianc auctioned me so i chose a better man dubbed
dramabox.description: Before her wedding, Vivian Wells is humiliated when her fiancé auctions her off to please another woman. Refusing to be shamed, Vivian turns the tables and offers her marriage to the highest bidder. While everyone expects no one to step forward, Logan Bishop appears and claims her without hesitation. What begins as defiance soon reveals a long-hidden devotion, leaving the man who betrayed her drowning in regret.

dramabox.title: Fate Woven in Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: fate woven in revenge
dramabox.description: Claire Wells, a general’s daughter, survives her family’s brutal massacre. Concealing her identity, she returns to the capital as the chancellor’s daughter. Gentlelooking yet sharpminded, she wins the emperor’s favor in the palace and edges closer to power.Trapped in political schemes and tangled feelings, she finds her enemies linked to imperial power. Driven by vengeance, she wages a fateful fight between bloodstained revenge and true love.

dramabox.title: Dangerous Speed and Forbidden Vows
dramabox.norm_title: dangerous speed and forbidden vows
dramabox.description: Claire Stone, a fallen heiress, is treated by her birth mother as a bargaining chip to sustain her lavish lifestyle and betrothed to Victor Kane, a domineering tycoon who holds obsessive controlling tendencies. On her wedding day, she makes a bold escape, only to stumble into the territory of Ethan Harper, an underground racer. No one knows this cold blooded man harbours a secret double identity. Thus begins their dangerously intoxicating, all consuming romance.

dramabox.title: Opposites Beneath One Roof
dramabox.norm_title: opposites beneath one roof
dramabox.description: Molly Carter, a quirky ace bartender, accidentally rents the ancestral home of stoic TCM heir Ethan Foster. Free‑spirited nightlife lover clashes with disciplined health‑oriented scholar. Uninhibited she finds herself through cocktails; grounded he savors time with herbs. Two contrasting souls tangle under one old roof, sparking a boundary‑defying romance between tradition and modernity.

dramabox.title: Fake Dating My Rich Nemesis
dramabox.norm_title: fake dating my rich nemesis
dramabox.description: It's a romantic drama where two longtime rivals are forced into a fake relationship for their own personal reasons. What starts as a strategic arrangement quickly becomes more complicated as old grudges, unexpected attraction, and hidden emotions blur the line between pretending and falling in love. In the end, they must decide if risking their hearts is worth more than winning the game.

dramabox.title: Return of the Hidden War Queen
dramabox.norm_title: return of the hidden war queen
dramabox.description: A warrior goddess bearing the bloodline of the Holy Maiden dutifully conceals her identity and becomes betrothed to the commander of the Holy Knights to repay a life-saving debt; however, upon his triumphant return, he brings back a pregnant lover. She decisively breaks off the engagement and makes a powerful comeback, fighting side-by-side with the true savior who has long harbored a secret love for her—the Warrior Prince—to slay her enemies and reclaim true love.

dramabox.title: Pearls From A Broken Heart
dramabox.norm_title: pearls from a broken heart
dramabox.description: Stuck in a loveless marriage for four years, Orabelle changed everything about herself to win her husband's love. But it turns out that he was never hers to win—his heart had belonged to his stepsister all along. Now he'll spend every moment trying to win her back, but is it too late or has she already moved on?

dramabox.title: My Unborn Baby's Mind‑Reading Helped Me Win a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: my unborn baby s mind reading helped me win a billionaire
dramabox.description: Pregnant by the city's most powerful billionaire after one accidental night, broke country girl Mia expects nothing but a paycheck and a goodbye. Then her unborn daughter starts talking—and somehow knows everyone's darkest thoughts. With a scheming first love determined to destroy her, Mia has one tiny secret weapon on her side. What begins as a deal for an heir may just turn into love, power, and a life she never dreamed possible.

dramabox.title: My Dead Ex Bought My Virginity
dramabox.norm_title: my dead ex bought my virginity
dramabox.description: Five years after her boyfriend Sebastian died saving her in a horrific crash, Chloe is kidnapped and sold at an underground auction—only to be bought by Lorenzo Bianchi, a ruthless mafia heir with Sebastian’s face and none of his memories. Chloe knows the man she loved is still inside him. But as enemies close in and his fiancée tries to kill her, Lorenzo must choose: trust the woman haunting his heart—or lose her all over again.

dramabox.title: The Luna's Return: Daddy Is An Alpha King
dramabox.norm_title: the luna s return daddy is an alpha king
dramabox.description: Scarlett, a CEO, had a night with a mysterious man four years ago and gave birth to Lily. She finds the father in a garage—Ethan, the Alpha King of the werewolves, hiding from vampires. Lily awakens pure wolf blood. At a gala, Ethan reveals his trillion-dollar heir identity, and his family backs them. They fight the vampires, rescue his mother, and reunite as a family.

dramabox.title: She Rebuilt Her Empire, One Decade Earlier
dramabox.norm_title: she rebuilt her empire one decade earlier
dramabox.description: After foreign chip competition bankrupts her company, entrepreneur Claire Wells is beaten to death by debt collectors — then reborn in the 1980s. She falls for and marries Graham Stone, a chip researcher left disabled by a car accident. Running a restaurant to fund his research, she helps him shatter a foreign tech monopoly using knowledge from her future.

dramabox.title: The Side Character Who Refused to Lose
dramabox.norm_title: the side character who refused to lose
dramabox.description: Successful and happily engaged, Claire Hayes wakes up trapped inside a manipulated comic world — cast as the doomed side character. Her fate is scripted for tragedy: her beloved fiancé, Victor Hale, is destined to fall for another woman, Emily Reed. Determined to rewrite her own story, Claire launches a desperate plan to escape her assigned downfall.

dramabox.title: The Chef Who Charmed the Throne
dramabox.norm_title: the chef who charmed the throne
dramabox.description: Modern chef Lana Blake wakes up as a candidate for the imperial harem selection in ancient China. Hoping to fail the selection with her outrageous stinky tofu and collect her stipend home, she instead catches the interest of the food-averse Emperor Julian Hart — landing a palace rank and control of the royal kitchen instead.

dramabox.title: The Ascetic Holiness and My Secret Child
dramabox.norm_title: the ascetic holiness and my secret child
dramabox.description: Left for dead after a Saintess steals the child she had with Holy Pope Michael, herbalist Eve infiltrates the temple five years later as a handmaid. There, she saves an abused beggar boy, who is proven by a magic mirror to be her lost son. Helped by her son and the Pope's mother, Eve repeatedly crosses paths with the aloof Pope. Amid dark conspiracies and forbidden passion, they clear their misunderstandings and fall in love, and the humble handmaid becomes the Pope's wife.

dramabox.title: The Fox President Mistook the True Love
dramabox.norm_title: the fox president mistook the true love
dramabox.description: Drunk Alice has a one-night stand with fox CEO Miller, but leaves her roommate's résumé—causing mistaken identity. She becomes his secretary, grows professionally, uncovers the truth, and finds love.

dramabox.title: Silver Moon Contract
dramabox.norm_title: silver moon contract
dramabox.description: Cyrus Ashborne, a vampire Omega, was wed to wolf shifter Kael Ironfang as a peace treaty. Rejected at first sight, they unexpectedly formed a fated bond. Crown Prince Silas, obsessively in love with Cyrus, forged letters and imprisoned Kael to drive them apart. After bloodshed and trial, Silas was exiled. Cyrus and Kael completed their soul mark, bridging their clans and finding lasting peace.

dramabox.title: Can't Pay the Bill? I Own the Bank
dramabox.norm_title: can t pay the bill i own the bank
dramabox.description: Charlotte's husband thinks she's a penniless wife he can humiliate—until one unpaid dinner bill exposes the lie he's been living. The woman he betrayed is the hidden heiress who secretly built his empire. Now Charlotte is done hiding. As she takes back her name, power, and fortune, the man who threw her away is about to learn just how expensive betrayal can be.

dramabox.title: A Hasty Marriage With a Hidden Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: a hasty marriage with a hidden billionaire
dramabox.description: Left jilted on her wedding day, Claire Carter spots Ethan Hayes in the crowd and impulsively marries him in a flash marriage. Ethan is a high‑power CEO hiding his real status. Yet every time he tries to confess his true identity, random mishaps keep happening, landing him in funny, embarrassing situations. Fate keeps throwing twists at the newlyweds. Pretending to be average while holding real power, Ethan shifts between two identities to whole‑heartedly win over his wife.

dramabox.title: His Promise, Her Forever
dramabox.norm_title: his promise her forever
dramabox.description: Damon Cross promised to care for Blair Stone until she grew up and married. To Blair, marrying anyone but him felt the same. She thought his love was nothing but duty and a promise. But beneath his restrained exterior, he adored her beyond measure. On her wedding day, his dowry to her was an entire subtropical island, with snow falling across the sky.

dramabox.title: Reborn, I Married the Man Who Was Meant to Die（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: reborn i married the man who was meant to die dubbed
dramabox.description: After being murdered by her jealous cousin, Claire Carter is reborn on her wedding day. Her cousin insists on swapping marriages, so Claire willingly marries Ethan Hayes, the man who died young in her past life. But this time, Ethan survives and grows stronger by the day. As the Hayes family thrives, her ex-husband loses everything without Claire's magical fragrance, while her cousin suffers an even worse fate.

dramabox.title: She Danced, He Surrendered
dramabox.norm_title: she danced he surrendered
dramabox.description: Top influencer Claire Frost is transported to another era and thrown into Floria Hall by the ruthless Julian Ward. Using her modern knowledge, she turns every crisis into a chance to survive. When Julian tries to cage her heart, she fights back with wit. One breathtaking dance captivates the entire city. She refuses to be his captive, driving the proud lord mad with love. In the end, he bows to her, offering his kingdom for her eternal love.

dramabox.title: Black Swan, Burning Heart
dramabox.norm_title: black swan burning heart
dramabox.description: After a gunshot, Claire Reed is reborn. Logan Shaw, once a thug from Mireham Ward she despised, is now a feared underworld king. This time, he is her bodyguard. By night, they burn with desire; by day, they are strangers. Betrayed and crippled by Adrian Carter in her past life, Claire now plays a seductive Black Swan, plotting her revenge while Logan risks everything to protect her.

dramabox.title: My Body, His Soul
dramabox.norm_title: my body his soul
dramabox.description: After being drained by her family, Chloe Carter dreams of changing her fate through a talent show. But on debut day, an accident swaps her soul with entertainment mogul Ethan Gould, sending them both one month back. To protect their original futures, they become contract lovers and search for the truth behind the swap. As attraction and trust grow, they uncover the secret to switching back.

dramabox.title: Mistaken for a Nobody: My Secret Wealthy Husband
dramabox.norm_title: mistaken for a nobody my secret wealthy husband
dramabox.description: Claire Benn, a top-tier scientist and the beloved wife of billionaire Derek Grant, spent years in Antarctica researching a rare disease treatment. While away, Derek adopted three children. Upon Claire's return with her groundbreaking research, her adopted children mistook her for a poor stranger at the airport, subjecting her to public humiliation and cruelty instead of welcoming her home...

dramabox.title: A Deal with the Football Captain
dramabox.norm_title: a deal with the football captain
dramabox.description: Shy college nerd Dora has loved soccer star Leo for years, but her heartfelt confession ends in public humiliation. When charismatic team captain Juanda offers to help her win Leo's heart in exchange for uncovering a mysterious money trail threatening his career, an unlikely partnership begins. As danger, betrayal, and buried secrets emerge, Dora discovers the man she truly needs may be the one who’s been beside her all along.

dramabox.title: Loving You Was Just A System
dramabox.norm_title: loving you was just a system
dramabox.description: Ellie Blair dies after donating her heart to Alexander Whitmore's first crush. Only then does Alex realize he had already fallen for her long ago. Overwhelmed with guilt, he chooses to end his own life—only to unexpectedly transmigrate into the system and enter Ellie's world. Determined to make amends and win her back, he tries everything to regain her love, yet uncovers the cruel truth behind the unconditional love he thought Ellie had for him.

dramabox.title: Love Drained Her, Freedom Awaited by the Water
dramabox.norm_title: love drained her freedom awaited by the water
dramabox.description: When Claire Blake’s mother fell seriously ill and needed surgery funds, her seven-year boyfriend Victor Kane refused to help and called her a gold digger, resulting in her mother’s death. Claire discovered Victor faked poverty to split expenses with her, spoiled his childhood sweetheart with luxury gifts, and embezzled her salary. She sued Victor and left him without hesitation. Claire returned to her hometown to run fish ponds and rebuild her life.

dramabox.title: Pursued by My Daughter's Classmate
dramabox.norm_title: pursued by my daughter s classmate
dramabox.description: Divorced for years, career-driven Elaine has raised her daughter on her own. Her life is comfortable, yet emotionally barren. Everything changes when Jace, her daughter’s twenty-year-old classmate, publicly confesses his feelings for her. Caught between social judgment and Jace’s genuine affection, Elaine’s resistance slowly begins to crumble. As he sees through the walls she’s built to hide her longing, the cracks in her carefully guarded heart finally begin to show…

dramabox.title: Love kills. Lust heals
dramabox.norm_title: love kills lust heals
dramabox.description: Kyle, the Alpha of the Night Wind Wolf Pack, was stricken with a fatal curse. His wolf instinct guided him to find the Purifying Vessel—a being with a crescent moon birthmark on the back of their right shoulder—before his thirtieth birthday. A close encounter with this vessel could ease his pain, and intimate relations would lift the curse entirely. Yet, the vessel would perish from the backlash.

dramabox.title: The Man She Trusted, The Family She Found
dramabox.norm_title: the man she trusted the family she found
dramabox.description: Ava Stone was abducted at a young age and grew up in an orphanage. She ran a snack shop to support her boyfriend. After graduation, her boyfriend schemed a fraudulent marriage to seize her property, arranging a grand proposal on her birthday. Unexpectedly, her three long-lost elder brothers showed up to reunite with her.

dramabox.title: Wrong Marriage, Fated Mate
dramabox.norm_title: wrong marriage fated mate
dramabox.description: A wolfless young woman, psychologically abused by her toxic fiancé until she can no longer shift, loses her memory in despair and is taken in by a formidable Alpha of the Nightshade Wolf Clan. Cherished by her fated mate, she rebuilds her identity, awakens her supreme bloodline, and rises stronger than ever, leaving her ex consumed with regret.

dramabox.title: Her Second Life Without Me
dramabox.norm_title: her second life without me
dramabox.description: Victor Hawke loses Sienna Carter after their loveless marriage ends in divorce. Betrayed and wounded, Sienna gives up her inheritance of Carter House and leaves Santon forever. Struggling as a street artist, she survives Adrian Keller’s threats and rises from despair. Ten years later, she becomes a world-famous Chinese artist, while Victor spends his life in a frozen frontier, regretting the woman he lost.

dramabox.title: My Ex's Brother Teaches Me to Puck
dramabox.norm_title: my ex s brother teaches me to puck
dramabox.description: When med student Lily gets dumped for  being "the most unfuckable girl on campus," she teams up with her ex’s brother, Mason Clark, to learn the art of "sex appeal." However, as their lessons draw them closer emotionally as well as physically, Lily realizes Mason was the one all along. But when her ex discovers she’s moved on, the rivalry between the brothers explodes. Will the brothers be able to mend their bond and Lily be with Mason? Or will her ex tear them apart?

dramabox.title: Vengeance in the Harem
dramabox.norm_title: vengeance in the harem
dramabox.description: Claire Wells led a peaceful life with her daughter until the girl was killed by Noble Consort Vera Voss. To avenge her child, Claire secures a position in the palace as the Consort’s newly hired wet nurse. Bearing an uncanny likeness to the Elder Princess and plotting meticulously, she draws the Emperor’s attention and rises steadily within the harem. She survives all of Vera’s vicious traps and retaliates in turn, finally achieving her vengeance.

dramabox.title: Wasted Devotion, Rightful Love
dramabox.norm_title: wasted devotion rightful love
dramabox.description: For ten years, Elena Hart loved Ethan Reed — until she catches him crossing lines with her comatose sister, Vivian Hart. Elena chooses to marry childhood protector Adrian Hale instead, but Ethan and Vivian retaliate, sabotaging her career. Fiercely protected by Adrian, Elena rises from ruin. When Vivian's true face is exposed, Ethan's regret comes far too late.

dramabox.title: Rise to Glory: A Debt of Gratitude
dramabox.norm_title: rise to glory a debt of gratitude
dramabox.description: Harper Jensen gets into Northby University just as her longtime benefactor, Gavin Foster, loses everything. His company collapses, his home is seized, and his family is left broke. Harper takes them in at her country home, where the once-privileged family must start from scratch. But their rebellious son, Ethan, is her biggest headache. Harper takes charge and vows to whip him into shape—or else.

dramabox.title: The Day I Let Go
dramabox.norm_title: the day i let go
dramabox.description: Claire Sloane is blindsided when her longtime boyfriend secretly marries another woman just before their wedding. She hides her pregnancy and walks away, only to be framed and humiliated until tragedy strikes. Then her wealthy birth family finds her, giving Claire a chance to start over. Her ex soon learns the truth and begs for another chance, but Claire is done. He loses everything, while she builds a new life.

dramabox.title: Left for Dead, He Became My Shelter
dramabox.norm_title: left for dead he became my shelter
dramabox.description: Elise Frost, once a renowned healer, is framed and left for dead after losing everything. Rescued by a kind hunter, Ethan Stone, she hides her past and struggles to survive in the wilderness. As she uses her skills to rebuild their lives, a fragile bond grows between them. What began as a temporary arrangement slowly turns into something real, as two broken souls find healing, purpose, and a place to belong.

dramabox.title: My Ex Wanted Her, But I Chose Better
dramabox.norm_title: my ex wanted her but i chose better
dramabox.description: Jewelry designer Claire Wells hides her heiress identity while dating Victor Grant for four years. Pregnant and planning their wedding, she discovers his affair with Sienna Park, who once claimed to be pregnant with his child. Claire ends the relationship and marries Julian Hale, her longtime admirer. When Sienna steals Claire’s designs, Claire exposes her at a contest. Sienna faces ruin, while Victor regrets losing Claire. Claire and Julian find true love and marry.

dramabox.title: Ancient Prince, Modern Domination
dramabox.norm_title: ancient prince modern domination
dramabox.description: Clara Stone plans to sacrifice herself to recover a secret list for her organization amid family troubles. She meets mafia leader Ethan Hayes by accident and is rescued by him after being mistreated by House Hale. Working as a maid in House Hayes, she finds Lucas Hayes, Ethan’s cousin, is the real list holder at his engagement party with Tessa Hale. Lucas identifies her as his childhood friend, leaving Clara caught between two brothers, her mission and tangled romance.

dramabox.title: Wounds Beneath the Mask
dramabox.norm_title: wounds beneath the mask
dramabox.description: Six years ago, Evan Carter struck a deal with Hale House to shield the Reed family. In exchange for their protection, he suffered severe wounds, leaving him with a short lifespan. Six years later, they met again. When Claire pressed him for the truth, Evan, knowing his time was running out, chose to hide it, breaking her heart. Claire forced him to perform their old lion dance again. Evan pushed through the agony, but his wounds left him on the brink of death.

dramabox.title: From Strangers to Us Again
dramabox.norm_title: from strangers to us again
dramabox.description: Five years later, Claire Reed crosses paths with Adrian Hayes again. She has long since moved on, treating him like a complete stranger, while Adrian has turned into a devoted suitor desperate to win her back. When he learns her unexpected miscarriage five years ago was triggered by heartbreak over his departure, Adrian is consumed by overwhelming grief. Their tangled emotional bond reignites once more.

dramabox.title: Lethal Vows
dramabox.norm_title: lethal vows
dramabox.description: In a modern city where humans and vampires coexist uneasily, top hunter Scarlett hastily marries Sebastian, a seemingly frail actuary, to pass the Hunter’s Guild’s background check. Both hide their true identities and pretend to be ordinary spouses around each other. Scarlett is a ruthless vampire slayer who acts as a timid, delicate housewife at home, while her husband is actually the thousand-year-old Vampire King hiding from his royal duties as a regular human.

dramabox.title: I Heard It All... My Cold Billionaire Husband's Hidden Heart
dramabox.norm_title: i heard it all my cold billionaire husband s hidden heart
dramabox.description: Gemma Snow has secretly loved Elliot Ziegler for years. One day, an arranged marriage makes her dream come true. However, after Elliot abandons Gemma on their wedding night, she grows disheartened. Soon, their loveless three-year marriage pushes her toward divorce. Misled into believing he loves someone else, Gemma decides to let go—until she hears his thoughts at an unexpected moment.

dramabox.title: Kissing The Wrong Brother
dramabox.norm_title: kissing the wrong brother
dramabox.description: Shy, bookish Ariadna has one goal before graduation: win the heart of her longtime crush. Hoping to gain confidence, she turns to his charming older brother, Emilio, for lessons in love. But as fake dating sparks a very real passion, Ariadna finds herself torn between the dream boy she chased for years and the brother she never saw coming.

dramabox.title: HOA, You've Been Overthrown By The Queen Of Crownstone
dramabox.norm_title: hoa you ve been overthrown by the queen of crownstone
dramabox.description: When Anya, the adopted granddaughter of a powerful real estate matriarch, inherits a coveted Manhattan co-op building, she expects a fresh start. Instead, her fiancé Cole dumps her for her entitled cousin Elena, believing she deserves the inheritance, and they turn the HOA against Anya. As Anya fights to protect her home, she falls for Jack, the hidden heir to a rival development dynasty. But Jack must defy his family, who demand he marry another woman to save their empire.

dramabox.title: Goodbye, My Ungrateful Family
dramabox.norm_title: goodbye my ungrateful family
dramabox.description: Steven gave up his career for the woman he loved, only to watch her grow closer to another man. Haunted by a vision of a future where his family chooses someone else, he leaves before his heart can break. Now, the wife who ignored him will do anything to bring him home.

dramabox.title: The Prey Who Broke My Seal
dramabox.norm_title: the prey who broke my seal
dramabox.description: Elias Vale, the orphan of a fallen noble family, was publicly humiliated and abandoned at a wealthy clan’s engagement banquet for lacking a contractual mark. Adrian Blackthorne, heir to the most powerful sigil clan, stepped in to save him.Adrian thought he had picked up a delicate, beautiful prey he could easily manipulate and exploit. He offered Elias a temporary companion’s contract to help him pass his family’s inheritance trial.

dramabox.title: The Wreckage We Called Love
dramabox.norm_title: the wreckage we called love
dramabox.description: Adrian Carter once died saving his wife, Claire Hale. Reborn at the start of their marriage, Claire returns haunted by regret, while Adrian is consumed by old wounds. Hiding behind his secretary Sienna Hayes’s name, he pushes Claire to the brink with cruel games of revenge. When she finally chooses to leave, Adrian sees the truth too late. Will their love survive the storm of hatred, regret, and redemption?

dramabox.title: Echoes of Eternity: Until the Stars Remember
dramabox.norm_title: echoes of eternity until the stars remember
dramabox.description: A forbidden love between two immortals sparks a curse spanning three lifetimes. Cast into the mortal world with no memory, he is consumed by resentment and turns on the woman he once loved. She escapes, raises their gifted child, and returns as a fearless warrior seeking revenge. When an ancient relic restores their memories, father and child become bitter enemies, while their mischievous little one schemes to reunite them.

dramabox.title: Chained Wings
dramabox.norm_title: chained wings
dramabox.description: Archangel Lucien and fallen lord Draven are enemies. On the battlefield, Lucien hesitates, and Draven captures him, breaks his wings, and imprisons him in darkness. Through torture and degradation, Lucien endures humiliation. He attempts escape but is caught and branded. A dark tale of obsession and captivity between two divine beings.

dramabox.title: The One Scent I Can't Resist
dramabox.norm_title: the one scent i can t resist
dramabox.description: "A top-tier Alpha CEO who suffers from pheromone rejection syndrome never allows any Omega to approach him—yet he unexpectedly discovers that the only pheromone he does not reject comes from his business archrival: the very man who claims to be a Beta."

dramabox.title: The Husband Who Kept Two Secrets
dramabox.norm_title: the husband who kept two secrets
dramabox.description: Six years ago, Claire Foster and Ethan Carter had one night together. She gave birth to twins but was told the boy died. Now a chef, Claire saves a boy with the same rare blood type: unaware he's her son. The boy, Ming, lives with Ethan and wants a mom. Ethan, hiding his identity, marries Claire. As they live together, Claire slowly uncovers the truth about Ethan and the child.

dramabox.title: Revenge Gone Wrong: I Kissed My Roommate
dramabox.norm_title: revenge gone wrong i kissed my roommate
dramabox.description: After a sexual harassment incident drives assistant director Yoo Ji-in out of the industry, she reunites with her old friend Baek Min-woo, who has lost everything to a rental scam and a breakup. To take revenge on the director who ruined her career, Ji-in starts a fake romance video channel with Min-woo. What begins as a staged romance for revenge slowly turns into something real, as the two navigate love, revenge, and life under one roof.

dramabox.title: Nanny to the Mafia Single Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: nanny to the mafia single daddy
dramabox.description: Mafia godfather Victor closes his heart off to love after the unexpected death of his wife. But when Jennifer, his daughter's nanny, enters his life, he finds himself losing control and giving in to feelings he never expected. As their passionate push-and-pull romance unfolds, the two must overcome misunderstandings and survive brushes with death before finally finding their way to each other.

dramabox.title: His Hidden Melody
dramabox.norm_title: his hidden melody
dramabox.description: After a night of losing control following her celebration banquet, music queen Kira finds herself entangled with ice hockey star Evan. Upon waking, she only wants to walk away—but is pushed back toward Evan step by step by scandals, her fiancé's betrayal, and the interests of high society. The more coldly distant she becomes, the more aggressively he pursues her. She wants to protect her reputation and career; he insists on tearing through her carefully constructed armor.

dramabox.title: The Weight She Gave, the Love She Found
dramabox.norm_title: the weight she gave the love she found
dramabox.description: Claire Hart, born with superhuman strength, gained 60 pounds to donate bone marrow to her fiancé. He recovered, then betrayed her for her wealthy best friend. Homeless, she saves the Ross family's young son and becomes his nanny. In their home, she regains her health. The CEO, Ethan Ross, gradually sees her true worth and falls for the resilient woman.

dramabox.title: Billionaire in the Making: The Fake Heiress's Masterplan
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire in the making the fake heiress s masterplan
dramabox.description: Workaholic Claire Carter wakes up in a novel as a fake heiress. The original heiress was ruthless, scheming against the real heiress for money and love. Claire has a better idea: keep her “broke” husband, the future billionaire. Instead of grinding at work, she invests in his company. Her over-the-top devotion wins him over, and soon he’s working nonstop to give his beloved wife everything she wants!

dramabox.title: The Sweetest Substitute, Forever His Only One（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the sweetest substitute forever his only one dubbed
dramabox.description: Switched at birth, Rhea Roth grows up in poverty and is finally brought home at 19. Her family brings her back only to force her to marry a man believed to be dead, in place of the fake heiress. Everyone assumes her life is over—but the powerful man, who is supposedly dead, is very much alive.

dramabox.title: The Loser Janitor is the Ultimate Legend
dramabox.norm_title: the loser janitor is the ultimate legend
dramabox.description: Twenty years ago, Grand Lord Cyril ended an alien invasion but lost his wife. He vanished into a janitor's life, raising his son and refusing wealth or titles. After saving a girl, he's set up on a date with her mother—a tycoon. Mocked as unworthy, he stays silent until he reveals his identity, humbling his tormentors. The aliens return, and corporations debate whether to save the poor.

dramabox.title: Pregnant with the Dragon King's Triplets
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant with the dragon king s triplets
dramabox.description: Sold by her family to abusive suitors for magical spring water, fox attendant Sylvia — thought unable to bear children — turns up pregnant with triplets after a night with a stranger who's secretly the Dragon King, Cassius. As he shields her from family, rivals, and jealous coworkers, an attack meant to kill her instead reveals she's the long-lost princess of the Nine-Tailed Wolf Clan. Villains fall; Cassius claims her as his queen.

dramabox.title: The Husband They Swore I Didn't Have
dramabox.norm_title: the husband they swore i didn t have
dramabox.description: After a whirlwind Paris marriage, Ava Collins returns to New York and is trapped again by the ex, childhood friend, and sister who betrayed her. When their lies cost Ava her unborn twins, her secret husband—global billionaire Lucas Graves—arrives to protect her. As Ava rebuilds her life, Lucas exposes every betrayal and makes the people who mocked their marriage pay.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire Lawyer’s Secret Clinic
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire lawyer s secret clinic
dramabox.description: Due to childhood trauma, Leonardo suffers from a rare sexual dysfunction—until he unexpectedly reacts in the presence of emergency physician Elena Rossi. To cure his condition, he enters into a secret "treatment agreement" with the debt-ridden Elena. What begins as awkward physical contact gradually deepens into emotional dependence. Meanwhile, the power struggle within the Moretti family explodes—his cousin Vincent and uncle Salvatore covet the family inheritance, and the ..

dramabox.title: Fire on Ice
dramabox.norm_title: fire on ice
dramabox.description: A fiercely competitive hockey rivalry turns dangerously intimate when underdog Luke's obsession with his rival Felix crosses the line between hatred and desire, putting their careers, family expectations, and reputations at risk.

dramabox.title: Unloved No More: An Empire of Her Own
dramabox.norm_title: unloved no more an empire of her own
dramabox.description: After seven years of marriage, Claire Reed is done begging for Damon Black’s love. When she sees her husband and daughter light up for another woman, she finally walks away. She divorces Damon and throws herself into building a life of her own. Only then do Damon and their daughter realize what they lost—and desperately want Claire back.

dramabox.title: The Sin of Loving You
dramabox.norm_title: the sin of loving you
dramabox.description: After eight years of suffering, Clara Hale gets a second chance at the moment her nightmare began. This time, she cuts ties with Adrian Gordon, the man she was never supposed to love, humiliates his perfect girl, and takes down everyone who hurt her. But when Clara walks away for good, the man who once treated her like nothing finally breaks down: “Clara, please. Don’t leave me.”

dramabox.title: Riches in Disguise: The Factory Girl Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: riches in disguise the factory girl heiress
dramabox.description: After seven years at the factory, Claire Grant is pressured to settle down. She begs her secret boyfriend Evan Reed to go public, but he hides behind company rules and chooses a young intern instead. Claire walks away, quits her job, and returns home to marry someone else. Evan soon regrets losing her—until he discovers the “factory girl” he dumped is actually a billionaire’s daughter, now married to a handsome heir eight years younger.

dramabox.title: The Longing Behind His Mask
dramabox.norm_title: the longing behind his mask
dramabox.description: After faking her death for a decade, Clara Wells infiltrates the Crown Prince’s palace as a painter under a new identity. Trapped in a deadly power struggle, she faces Vivian Crane’s ruthless schemes and a shadowy mastermind. But the prince’s “frail and cursed” facade hides a secret. As old feelings resurface, Clara and Victor join forces to expose their enemies and protect the throne.

dramabox.title: A Kiss After Midnight
dramabox.norm_title: a kiss after midnight
dramabox.description: Clara Reed thought Ryan Hayes was the man she’d marry—until she caught him cheating with her stepsister, Taryn Davis. Heartbroken, she meets billionaire Victor Carter at a bar. Their night together was supposed to mean nothing, but every encounter pulls them closer. What starts as a reckless mistake soon becomes a love neither can escape.

dramabox.title: I Loved You in Life, You Loved Me in Loss
dramabox.norm_title: i loved you in life you loved me in loss
dramabox.description: Seven years after Han Eunbyeol vanishes, Lee Jaehoon gets a call from their young daughter, only to learn that she’d passed away long ago. Holding her empty urn, he realizes the only part of her left in this world is the child they share. Grief nearly drives him to follow her in death, but for his daughter’s sake, he chooses to persevere. Even so, one heartbreaking truth remains: the one person who gave his life meaning is already gone.

dramabox.title: Hooking A CEO Daddy for Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: hooking a ceo daddy for mommy
dramabox.description: Julian Morgan, a cold billionaire heir, is forced to produce an heir—but the only woman he ever wanted disappeared after a one-night stand. Then a boy appears... with his face. "Be my son. I'll pay you." "Deal. But my mom can't know." A perfect secret—until Julian meets the boy's mother working in his factory... and realizes she's the woman he's been searching for.

dramabox.title: His Athlete Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: his athlete boyfriend
dramabox.description: Damian and Zane—captains of Oak Valley High's football and soccer teams—are known rivals. An accidental kiss during practice ignites Zane's relentless pursuit, as he has secretly loved Damian for years. When Damian spots the initials "D.K." on Zane's ring box, he becomes convinced that Zane is pursuing Daisy, the head cheerleader—and interprets every moment of ambiguity as the provocations of a romantic rival.

dramabox.title: The Witch and Her Hunter
dramabox.norm_title: the witch and her hunter
dramabox.description: Celeste was a normal professor—until she discovered she is a witch, forced to marry Declan, a witch hunter born to kill her kind. To defeat a deadly warlock threat, Celeste and Declan must form a blood bond and fight side by side just to survive. But resisting their dangerous attraction may be even harder. Then Celeste's long-lost sister orders her: Marry him. Earn his trust. Kill him on your wedding night. Celeste must choose: blood or love.

dramabox.title: Beyond Trial
dramabox.norm_title: beyond trial
dramabox.description: Julian, a grassroots litigator from the slums, and Alistair, a wealthy heir, are bitter rivals in law school. They are forced to team up to investigate a corporate pollution case and grow fond of each other amid constant tension, only to find that Alistair’s own family is behind the crimes. Resolutely abandoning everything, Alistair exposes his family’s criminal evidence.

dramabox.title: Meant to Love You Forever
dramabox.norm_title: meant to love you forever
dramabox.description: After catching her fiancé cheating with her stepsister, Claire Grant has a one-night stand with his uncle, Adrian Foster. A month later, she discovers she’s pregnant, and Adrian proposes a marriage of convenience. But when Claire learns she’s only a replacement for his lost love, their marriage falls apart. After a crash leaves her childless and Adrian amnesiac, Claire refuses to walk away, determined to help him remember the love they once shared.

dramabox.title: A Little Miracle Called Love
dramabox.norm_title: a little miracle called love
dramabox.description: Six-year-old Ava Morgan turns her estranged dad Ethan Carter’s world upside down when she uncovers a shocking family secret: her birth mother is still being held captive. With her big heart and clever ways, Ava brings her broken family back together. But their reunion sparks a bitter battle over love, loyalty, and the family fortune.

dramabox.title: A Sage's Mind, A Modern Heart
dramabox.norm_title: a sage s mind a modern heart
dramabox.description: Lively museum intern Ethan Stone bonds with a mystic ward at the tomb of Julian Wise — ancient China's most legendary strategist — and seemingly inherits his 1,800-year-old genius. Solving cold cases, outwitting rivals, and reinventing his hero's ancient inventions, Ethan wins scholar Claire Hart's heart while reviving history for modern audiences. His brilliance isn't magic — it's a lifelong obsession finally paying off.

dramabox.title: The Doomed Villainess: His One and Only
dramabox.norm_title: the doomed villainess his one and only
dramabox.description: After dying as the doomed villainess in someone else’s story, Vivian Carter wakes up with a second chance. Betrayed by her family and fiancé, she decides to take back everything they stole. At her side is Logan Hayes, the childhood friend who never abandoned her. From now on, Vivian won’t play the role written for her.

dramabox.title: Her Unspoken Despair
dramabox.norm_title: her unspoken despair
dramabox.description: Before meeting Ethan Stone, Claire Wynn was a formidable business leader from a prominent family. She took over the family conglomerate from her grandfather and brought it to new heights with her capability. The clear-eyed college student Ethan pierced her hidden despair with one remark: “Hollow unfulfillment lingers in your eyes.” Claire denied it, yet she could not stop thinking about him.

dramabox.title: I Wish I Never Knew You
dramabox.norm_title: i wish i never knew you
dramabox.description: Claire Harris, from a humble background, fell sincerely in love with Victor Carter. Victor promised to devote his life solely to her and marry her as his primary wife. However, within five years, Claire received news that Victor would wed Violet Sawyer to strengthen his influence. Seeing Victor lavish all the former tenderness on Violet, Claire became completely disillusioned. She chose to leave Pingyang City for good, ensuring Victor would never locate her.

dramabox.title: The Alpha Judge Who Lost His Omega
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha judge who lost his omega
dramabox.description: For three years, Omega Noah Lane gave everything to Alpha Judge Damon Blackwell, sacrificing his body to stabilize Damon’s deadly pheromone disorder. But when Noah loses their unborn child and Damon chooses his ex-lover over saving him, Noah breaks their bond and walks away. As Damon’s world collapses without the Omega he thought was replaceable, Noah uncovers a dark conspiracy that could destroy the Blackwell empire.

dramabox.title: The Concubine Who Became the Noble Wife
dramabox.norm_title: the concubine who became the noble wife
dramabox.description: Claire Wells was taught by her aunt Marian Cole to become the perfect concubine, never expecting to enter the Hale household as the lawful wife of Victor Hale. With the schemes she learned and her sharp wit, Claire overcomes many conflicts and challenges. Once doubted by everyone, she rises to become the respected lady of the house. Victor is drawn to her intelligence and vibrant spirit, and their relationship grows from mutual suspicion into true love.

dramabox.title: Raise an Ancient King to Be My Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: raise an ancient king to be my boyfriend
dramabox.description: A mysterious holy chalice transforms modern girl Elena Moro into the savior of an ancient kingdom. By sending food, medicine, and modern knowledge across time, she saves the kingdom from ruin and becomes its goddess. But when Elena falls for its handsome young king, Varik, can their forbidden love bridge a three-thousand-year divide?

dramabox.title: Commander In Clone
dramabox.norm_title: commander in clone
dramabox.description: Branded a terrorist, Eve Taylor is hired to seduce Lucian Adkins, the future President, yet an assassination attempt exposes a sinister clone conspiracy. When Lucian's identical clone steals the presidency, Eve must help the wounded Commander reclaim his power, survive political betrayal, and confront an irresistible love.

dramabox.title: Goodbye My Heartless Duke
dramabox.norm_title: goodbye my heartless duke
dramabox.description: Once a free-spirited noblewoman, Isabelle Laurent became the perfect Duchess of Ravenel, only to be trapped in a loveless marriage. When her husband Adrian's childhood confidante returns and frames her for a tragedy that destroys her family, Adrian chooses the wrong woman. Heartbroken but awakened, Isabelle fights back with the very laws that imprisoned her. Would she be free?

dramabox.title: I Was Third on My Husband's List
dramabox.norm_title: i was third on my husband s list
dramabox.description: Olivia sees floating lists above people's heads—ranking who matters most. On her husband's list, she's No2. Then a stranger's name creeps higher, pushing her to No3. She discovers he has given away her gifts, erased her existence, and lied to both women. She divorces him. Ryan's regret is devastating—he loses everything, begs for her return, but it's too late. Olivia rises: a promotion, a new city, and Daniel, whose list places her at No1—and her happiness at No2.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Don’s Virgin Wife
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia don s virgin wife
dramabox.description: Surgeon Mia, burdened by OCD, faces divorce from her husband. She enters a secret club to change herself. Mafia leader Nick sees her on stage and saves her from danger. A passionate forbidden love soon develops between them.

dramabox.title: Mr. CEO Vampire Wants Me Everyday
dramabox.norm_title: mr ceo vampire wants me everyday
dramabox.description: Isabel, an ordinary office worker struggling with her mother’s medical bills, rescues thousand-year-old vampire Lucas trapped by holy fire on a rainy night. Drawn by her unique destined blood, Lucas abducts her to his castle, revealing he is her company’s hidden CEO. Isabel resists his obsessive possession and learns she is a half-witch. Her childhood friend Simon, a half-vampire, emerges as Lucas’ rival.

dramabox.title: Obsession for a Shadow
dramabox.norm_title: obsession for a shadow
dramabox.description: Claire Harper’s beloved Evan Parker died in a car accident five years ago, leaving her with an unhealed wound in her heart. By chance, she meets Adrian Sloan, who bears an uncanny resemblance to Evan. Obsessed with this likeness, she marries Adrian and showers him with endless affection. Yet Adrian repeatedly crosses Claire’s boundaries alongside his lover Megan Pierce.

dramabox.title: The Dancer the Marshal Could Not Forget
dramabox.norm_title: the dancer the marshal could not forget
dramabox.description: Evan Morgan, aidede camp to the Young Marshal, is framed and paraded in public on charges of treason. To gather money to save her brother, Elise Morgan is forced to sell herself at the Belmont Club. Wyatt Carter, the Young Marshal, seeking to overturn the Morgan family’s false conviction, stumbles into Elise’s room by accident, and the two end up sharing an intimate encounter.

dramabox.title: Proof of Love, Proof of Nothing（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: proof of love proof of nothing dubbed
dramabox.description: Chelsea Sandler and Sean Barnes are childhood sweethearts, but in college, he sets his sights on someone else. He later pretends to return to their marriage, yet their three years together are a lie—he never cuts ties with the other woman, and even their marriage certificate is fake. Fifteen days later, Chelsea boards a plane abroad, leaving him behind for good.

dramabox.title: Slept with His Best Friend and Found True Loved
dramabox.norm_title: slept with his best friend and found true loved
dramabox.description: Suffering from nyctalopia, Serena Hayes senses her boyfriend Oliver Gu has two drastically different personalities—either a frivolous playboy or a gentle, refined man. The pen she lost accidentally ends up with Lucas Vance, her company’s biggest client. To uncover the truth, Serena draws close to Lucas and stumbles upon their hidden deal. Oliver uses Serena as a rebound to provoke his ex Taylor Xu, who left the country long ago, sneaking out every night to meet her.

dramabox.title: The Virgin Succubus and the Archmage
dramabox.norm_title: the virgin succubus and the archmage
dramabox.description: Amelia, the world’s last virgin succubus, is weak and desperate to save her sister from debt. She crosses paths with Jonathan, a powerful wizard tormented by dark dreams. He offers protection in exchange for her company, but their growing love is threatened by ancient legends that say a wizard must drain a succubus to gain ultimate power.

dramabox.title: My Cat Became My Girlfriend
dramabox.norm_title: my cat became my girlfriend
dramabox.description: To pay off her family’s debts, impoverished college student Serena Hayes takes a job as the personal secretary of Lucas Vance, CEO of Vance Group, and moves into his mysterious manor filled with cats. She hides a secret that she is a cat-human hybrid; her cat ears and claws will show when she loses control. Her scratch carries a unique toxin that poisons Lucas, and only she can cure it.

dramabox.title: The Addiction of You
dramabox.norm_title: the addiction of you
dramabox.description: When Elena Carter's father dies in what authorities call a tragic accident, she refuses to believe it. Two years later, her search for the truth uncovers a deadly conspiracy tied to one of the country's most powerful families. Standing between her and the truth is Adrian Harper—a rising political star willing to bury the past to protect the woman he's about to marry.

dramabox.title: One Touch Too Dangerous
dramabox.norm_title: one touch too dangerous
dramabox.description: On their seventh wedding anniversary, Claire Carter catches her husband, Elliot Sawyer, cheating with married woman Chloe Walsh. Seeking revenge, Claire grows close to Chloe's husband, Logan Hughes, only to uncover the pain behind his icy facade. As desire replaces suspicion, Logan sees through Claire's plan yet plays along, while she pulls him into a dangerous game of love, lies, and revenge.

dramabox.title: Warning！Teacher is Too Tempting（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: warning teacher is too tempting dubbed
dramabox.description: Park So-hee, from Doctors Without Borders, disguises herself as a soon-to-graduate college student to repay Shin Mi-sook, who once helped her, and becomes Han Do-won's tutor. Do-won looks down on So-hee and boasts he'll kick her out in three days, but she stands her ground. His friends suggest he seduce her, saying his father will then kick her out, but So-hee instead traps Do-won in her own scheme.

dramabox.title: My Sugar Daddy Is The Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: my sugar daddy is the alpha
dramabox.description: After a brutal werewolf battle, Alpha Declan Reed meets Heather, a kind herbal healer burdened by debt and hardship. As she endures harassment, family troubles, and workplace bullying, Declan repeatedly steps in to protect her. What begins as sympathy soon grows into love. Together, they face ruthless enemies, dangerous conspiracies, and the jealousy of Declan's former fiancée.

dramabox.title: Until Love Found Me
dramabox.norm_title: until love found me
dramabox.description: Lily Reed has spent years pining for Ryan Hayes, the boy she's admired since childhood. But to Ryan, her devotion is nothing more than a joke to entertain others. Heartbroken, Lily drowns her sorrows in a drink and unexpectedly crosses paths with the steady, enigmatic Julian Carter. As two strangers grow closer, an unexpected romance begins to bloom.

dramabox.title: Volleyball Captain My First Serve
dramabox.norm_title: volleyball captain my first serve
dramabox.description: Jenny Taylor is a cleaner at the home of her wealthy stepbrother Chris Riggins, where she is bullied by Chris's girlfriend Natalie. Chris repeatedly protects her, and the two gradually develop feelings for each other—from an accidental kiss to an intimate encounter in the bathroom. Natalie sets up a scheme for her ex-boyfriend Aiden to drug and assault Jenny, but the attempt fails, and Chris calls off his engagement......

dramabox.title: The Love She Forgot,  The Children Who Returned
dramabox.norm_title: the love she forgot the children who returned
dramabox.description: After a one-night stand with Julian Harrow, Clara Linden gives birth to triplets. No one knows the triplets are immortal gods undergoing mortal trials. Fearing the children would ruin Clara's future, Mrs. Linden abandons them. Years later, the triplets return to find their parents, exposing hidden schemes and bringing Clara and Julian back together. Together, they become the happy family they were always meant to be.

dramabox.title: Prince, You Loved the Mermaid Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: prince you loved the mermaid too late
dramabox.description: To save her true love, Triton, from eternal sleep, mermaid princess Melia strikes a deadly bargain with the Dark Witch—she must complete one hundred tasks for the ruthless Prince Lysander, who takes her devotion for granted and repays her with cruelty. When the final task demands the ultimate sacrifice, Melia vanishes without a trace. Only after losing her does Lysander realize who truly stood by his side. But is his awakening already too late?

dramabox.title: Lost It To Ex`s Evil Brother
dramabox.norm_title: lost it to ex s evil brother
dramabox.description: After catching her boyfriend engaging to her high school bully, a heartbroken Gabby has a wild one-night stand with his arrogant brother, Rex. Fired and evicted, she accidentally ends up as Rex's roommate. Desperate for a fresh start, Gabby lands her dream job as a CEO's secretary. But on her first day, she's shocked to discover her new billionaire boss is none other than her infuriating roommate—Rex!

dramabox.title: Veiled Reunion 30 Years Later
dramabox.norm_title: veiled reunion 30 years later
dramabox.description: Wendy waited thirty years for her husband Edward, who had gone to war. He returns as the CEO of Davies Group but believes she has remarried, so he hires her as his assistant without revealing his identity. Through daily contact, both sense a familiar connection. After many misunderstandings and with help from a friend, an old photo finally reveals the truth—Mr. Davies is her long-lost husband. Despite decades of separation, they reunite and reaffirm their love.

dramabox.title: How To Tame A Goddness
dramabox.norm_title: how to tame a goddness
dramabox.description: Selene, a mortal slave abused by War God Gaius, is taken to the Underworld by Hades, who finds her able to ease his cursed headaches, leading to their love. At their engagement, villain Freya frames Selene and tries to burn her alive, but Selene awakens as the reincarnation of Gaia, wielding the Earth's primordial power. She punishes Freya, reforms the War Domain, and marries Hades, while Gaius redeems himself by dying to protect her.

dramabox.title: She Scammed The CEO Then Married Him
dramabox.norm_title: she scammed the ceo then married him
dramabox.description: To save her mother from an alleged mob threat, Amelia fakes her identity as Amy Clarke, gets hired at Greer Corp, and marries CEO Noah under her brother Trevor’s orders—planning to sabotage the company. Noah later realizes she is the woman who saved him in a car accident years ago, but knows nothing of her scheme. Torn between love and lies, Amelia confesses, only to learn Trevor’s “mob” was all a con. Noah fights back, the villains are arrested, and the two reconcile.

dramabox.title: A Marriage of Lies: Secrets He Buried
dramabox.norm_title: a marriage of lies secrets he buried
dramabox.description: When her husband's longtime driver retires, Vivian Stone discovers a hidden compartment inside Adrian Carter's Bentley containing proof of his affair, secret assets, and mistress. Faced with a ruthless divorce, she teams up with her lawyer best friend to expose him and fight back. Adrian is arrested and loses everything, while Vivian wins back her life.

dramabox.title: The Baby Was Accidental, But His Love Wasn't
dramabox.norm_title: the baby was accidental but his love wasn t
dramabox.description: Blind Mia Carter flees her cruel father with her mother. A one-night stand with eye surgeon Ethan Grant leaves her pregnant. They marry in haste for the baby. Ethan seems cold but has loved Mia in secret for years. After her father's schemes, amnesia, and mistaken identity, Mia sees their marriage as his deliberate love. Meanwhile, his billionaire brother Gavin Grant is her mother's first love, waiting thirty years.

dramabox.title: Every Death Brings Me Back to You
dramabox.norm_title: every death brings me back to you
dramabox.description: While working as an NPC at a tourist attraction, Sophie Lane suddenly wakes up as the Fourth Mistress of a powerful Marshal and becomes trapped in a deadly three-day time loop. Every time she dies, she starts over. She soon discovers Ethan Carter is trapped in the same nightmare. Fighting side by side, they uncover deadly conspiracies, break the cycle, and fall for each other.

dramabox.title: Addicted to the Forbidden（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: addicted to the forbidden dubbed
dramabox.description: For ten years, Claire Sutton endured the Winton family’s cruelty, drawing the attention of Julian Winton, a man trapped in the same darkness.
