Two wounded souls found solace in each other amid love and revenge. He broke his family’s chains for her, and she thawed his frozen heart. Reborn as the legendary designer, Claire rises from the ashes, reclaims her life, and shines brighter than ever.

dramabox.title: The Lies We Wear, The Love We Hide
dramabox.norm_title: the lies we wear the love we hide
dramabox.description: To pay her daughter's medical bills, Clara Hayes poses as a socialite and agrees to a fake engagement with Miles Carter. At the family meeting, she finds Miles' brother Logan is her ex-boyfriend and her child's father. Logan's obsession returns; he won't let her go. Miles also hides his own feelings. Past mistakes and awkward roles entangle them in a love triangle.

dramabox.title: New Year, New Lie, New Love
dramabox.norm_title: new year new lie new love
dramabox.description: Claire Carter, a 28-year-old designer pressured to marry, accidentally ties to a Spring Festival dating system. She gets a silver gacha with a custom robot. She opens it and meets Eliot Reed, perfect but clumsy. During a funny trip, she goes from fake task to real love, while he wakes to self-awareness. She discovers he's a rare model that can gain a heart through love. But the system hides a bigger secret.

dramabox.title: Rewriting the 80s: The Villainess Flips the Script
dramabox.norm_title: rewriting the 80s the villainess flips the script
dramabox.description: After waking up in the body of a notorious troublemaker, Nora Stone is determined to rewrite her fate by putting her career before love. But thanks to her manipulative sister Chloe, Logan Hawke is convinced she's nothing but a heartbreaker. As Nora keeps proving everyone wrong, Logan realizes the biggest mistake wasn't trusting her—it was losing her. Now he'll do anything to win her back.

dramabox.title: Love's Final Countdown
dramabox.norm_title: love s final countdown
dramabox.description: Childhood sweethearts Celia Hayes and Evan Pierce were days away from forever—until success changed him. After becoming CEO of Summit Corp, Evan falls for his assistant, Vera Knox. Shattered by his betrayal, Celia disappears without a trace. When Evan comes home to her goodbye letter, he realizes too late that the woman he took for granted is gone for good.

dramabox.title: My Billionaire Husband Dreamed of Cheating on Me
dramabox.norm_title: my billionaire husband dreamed of cheating on me
dramabox.description: Alvin Cross, a billionaire, once had a nightmare that he cheated on his wife Valerie and ruined everything. He swore it would never come true, yet he still indulges his assistant Molly, lets Valerie suffer a miscarriage, and even locks her up for days. When Valerie wakes up from the pain, she signs the divorce papers, moves her family business to London, and starts a new life.

dramabox.title: Bonded to the King I Once Saved, Now He Hates Me
dramabox.norm_title: bonded to the king i once saved now he hates me
dramabox.description: Years ago, Tessa saved a wounded golden beastkin on a snowy night, but he vanished at dawn, leaving only a broken silver clasp. Years later, she accidentally fell into Blackridge territory, where Chief Nolan captured her, searching for his savior without recognizing her. A forced mate bond tied them together, yet Nolan kept doubting and hurting her. Framed by jealous Bianca and her selfish ex Eric, Tessa survived trials and proved her innocence.

dramabox.title: My Love Ships Sailed Without you
dramabox.norm_title: my love ships sailed without you
dramabox.description: Mi Barco Del Amor Zarpó Sin Ti" is an intimate romantic melodrama where love is tested by silence, sacrifice, and emotional neglect. Beneath everyday routines, heartbreak quietly grows until resilience replaces devotion. As the pain deepens, the story evolves from quiet endurance into a journey of self-worth and emotional awakening, proving that true strength lies not in revenge, but in walking away with dignity.

dramabox.title: Her Second Life: Lights, Camera, Payback
dramabox.norm_title: her second life lights camera payback
dramabox.description: Entertainment heiress Karen Greene plans to start as an assistant, but her celebrity boyfriend kills her and her unborn child in a car crash. Reborn with a thirst to set things right for herself, she uses her intelligence and courage to conquer the entertainment industry, support her best friend, launch a male model's career, and rescue an underage girl. She ultimately takes control of two entertainment empires and finds true love.

dramabox.title: No Rose Without Thorns
dramabox.norm_title: no rose without thorns
dramabox.description: To avenge her murdered parents, Sophia Hartwell assumes a fake identity and infiltrates the home of her enemy, the powerful Ravencroft family. She deliberately gets close to the obsessive heir, Cameron Ravencroft, and gathers evidence of her father's past crimes. Aware of her manipulation, Cameron willingly lets her use him. Torn between a bloody family feud and undeniable attraction, they become trapped in a painful romance fueled by revenge and love.

dramabox.title: You Can't Fire Genius
dramabox.norm_title: you can t fire genius
dramabox.description: Leona, the legendary stock guru K, saves Vanderbuilt Investment but gets fired by arrogant heir Oliver. Rival CEO Bellock knows her real identity and invites her to cooperate with equity and marriage. Assistant Reshika steals her data to pretend to be K, and teams up with expelled master J to frame her repeatedly. Leona defeats all schemes with superb trading skills, acquires Vanderbuilt, Will she get success？

dramabox.title: Hot Marshal Begs for Marriage（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: hot marshal begs for marriage dubbed
dramabox.description: For years, Zoe Lane harbored a secret love for Yuri Sheen, longing to marry him. However, Vivi Jenkins, leveraging Yuri's debt of gratitude to her mother, deceived Yuri into marriage. Exploiting Yuri's protective instincts, Vivi succeeded in her scheme. Yuri trusted Vivi and unwittingly became an accomplice to Vivi's actions. As Zoe grapples with the news of her terminal illness, She proposed a divorce and is consequently driven out of her home.

dramabox.title: Hired as His Wife, Loved as His Forever
dramabox.norm_title: hired as his wife loved as his forever
dramabox.description: After being kicked out with nothing, Nora Lane answers a strange ad seeking a stepmother and accidentally enters the Reed family's billionaire world. Her sincere, unconventional parenting wins over the rebellious heir and catches Adrian Reed's attention. To give his son a complete family, Adrian proposes a contract marriage. But their fake marriage soon turns real, as he spoils her relentlessly.

dramabox.title: Own the Crown, Shut You Down
dramabox.norm_title: own the crown shut you down
dramabox.description: Three months before her wedding, Vera Stone meets her fiancé’s female best friend—a shameless copycat who steals her style, plays the victim, and turns everyone against her. When the woman shows up in the exact same wedding gown, Vera calls off the ceremony and shocks the crowd by revealing she’s the CEO of the world’s most powerful fashion empire. Her ex comes crawling back, but Vera is done for good.

dramabox.title: Her Second Chance as a Stepmom
dramabox.norm_title: her second chance as a stepmom
dramabox.description: Claire Warren once became the villainous stepmother who hurt her three stepchildren, believing they were her husband’s illegitimate kids. Her cruelty led to Stella Steele’s death and Damian Steele losing his legs. After being reborn into the story, Claire knows the future and turns her fate around. She cares for Victor Steele and his siblings, winning their hearts, especially by nursing Stella through illness and becoming the beloved mother figure they never had.

dramabox.title: Exposing His Lies, Watching Him Burn
dramabox.norm_title: exposing his lies watching him burn
dramabox.description: For years, Claire Stone believed she had the perfect marriage—until she uncovered her husband Victor Kane's affair. While he keeps spinning lie after lie, Claire says nothing and patiently sets her trap. On his birthday, with everyone watching, she shatters his perfect image once and for all.

dramabox.title: Where Love Was Always Meant to Be（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: where love was always meant to be dubbed
dramabox.description: For ten years, Claire Carter anonymously funded Logan Foster, concealing her true identity. But Logan's betrayal—fathering a child with another woman and giving her their home—broke her. She left, unmasked the lies, and returned to her world. There, she reunited with the one who knew her first, and finally understood what being loved truly means.

dramabox.title: Your Hidden Heart
dramabox.norm_title: your hidden heart
dramabox.description: On the eve of becoming an immortal, an abbot of the Monastic Order named Yu I-hyeon has an accident and wakes up in the body of a notorious woman facing divorce. Before she can recover, she is told to leave while having a check thrown onto her face. As I-hyeon laments the Sim family's tragic fate, she has no idea they can hear her thoughts. With her unexpected guidance, Sim Yu-chan exposes his enemies and changes his family's doomed fate.

dramabox.title: Sleeping with My Father's Enforcer
dramabox.norm_title: sleeping with my father s enforcer
dramabox.description: After escaping an abusive foster father, broke Los Angeles girl Jessica learns she is the missing heir to an Italian mafia empire—and that Lucien, the dangerous stranger she spent one reckless night with, is her father`s adopted son and enforcer. Their forbidden desire ignites as betrayal, kidnapping, and murder tear the family apart, forcing Jessica to claim the throne and rule beside the man she refuses to lose.

dramabox.title: Rejected Luna Becomes the Supreme Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: rejected luna becomes the supreme alpha
dramabox.description: For five years, Sera Blackwood hides her Lycan blood and true identity, helping her Alpha husband rise while he despises her as a weak Omega. After he divorces her for her scheming half-sister, Sera drops the mask, reclaims her family empire, exposes her mother's murder, and makes every betrayer pay—while her regretful ex-husband begs for a second chance she may never give.

dramabox.title: Fiancé Made Me a Bald Bride to Please His Ex
dramabox.norm_title: fianc made me a bald bride to please his ex
dramabox.description: It was my wedding morning when my fiancé Adrian Weston dropped a shocking demand: I must shave my head to follow the so-called Weston family generational tradition that blessed marriages. Trusting him after seven years together, I agreed. While my hair tumbled to the ground, I spotted hidden amusement in his eyes. Later, I overheard Adrian chatting with Ryan in the hall. He admitted the family tradition was a total lie.

dramabox.title: The Bride You Lost, Kneel To Her Crown
dramabox.norm_title: the bride you lost kneel to her crown
dramabox.description: Clara Wells was ready to marry the love of her life—until she found her custom wedding gown on another woman. Betrayed and humiliated, she walked away and married the man who had loved her all along. Years later, she returns as Mrs. Grant, only to have her ex mistake her for a housekeeper. They have no idea they've just crossed the one woman they should never have underestimated.

dramabox.title: Love comes from creation
dramabox.norm_title: love comes from creation
dramabox.description: Gifted art student Mia lost her parents young and was raised by her greedy, cold stepmother Tina. Forced into an engagement with wealthy Darius to fund her studies, she is merely Tina’s tool for fortune, while Darius is shallow and lecherous. Mia seeks escape through art, until she meets Westley, her reserved oil painting professor—who turns out to be Darius’s father. Forbidden passion blooms between them.

dramabox.title: Falling for Her Scoundrel Bodyguard
dramabox.norm_title: falling for her scoundrel bodyguard
dramabox.description: CEO Claire Stone wakes up to find a stranger in her bed—and pays him thirty million to disappear. But he comes right back, marriage contract in hand, and talks his way into becoming her bodyguard. What starts as a payoff turns into something neither of them expected.

dramabox.title: My Fiancé Auctioned Me, So I Chose a Better Man
dramabox.norm_title: my fianc auctioned me so i chose a better man
dramabox.description: Before her wedding, Vivian Wells is humiliated when her fiancé auctions her off to please another woman. Refusing to be shamed, Vivian turns the tables and offers her marriage to the highest bidder. While everyone expects no one to step forward, Logan Bishop appears and claims her without hesitation. What begins as defiance soon reveals a long-hidden devotion, leaving the man who betrayed her drowning in regret.

dramabox.title: My Cruel Mate
dramabox.norm_title: my cruel mate
dramabox.description: Caliana is sold by her bankrupt family to Edward, a cruel Alpha with no genuine affection. Thus begins her grueling training to become a Luna. How will she overcome all obstacles to secure her standing, win the heart of this brutal mate, and ultimately claim her own pack, emerging as the Luna of her clan and of herself?

dramabox.title: The Fae Prince's Secret Heir
dramabox.norm_title: the fae prince s secret heir
dramabox.description: Six years after a fateful night with a masked stranger, Aria enters the Blood Elf palace with her son—unaware that Prince Lucian is the boy’s father. But mistaken identities and an ancient dragon marriage pact threaten to keep them apart.

dramabox.title: The Confidant Behind the Screen
dramabox.norm_title: the confidant behind the screen
dramabox.description: Elise Reed, a web novelist stepping out of her inner world, and Leo Cole, a factory second-generation heir fallen from grace, become each other's secret confidants. Sharing their deepest vulnerabilities online, they heal one another through words despite missing each other offline time and again. Finally, amidst the bustling city traffic, they cross paths and shout out a love confession far more passionate than any romance novel.

dramabox.title: Three Kids, One Secret Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: three kids one secret daddy
dramabox.description: After her mother dies in a car crash covered up as drunk driving, Claire Carter learns the real culprit is the untouchable Martin Benson. To appease his family, her father sends her to Martin's bed—but she ends up with Julian Benson instead. Five years later, Claire returns with three kids and proof of the truth, determined to make everyone pay.

dramabox.title: Beyond the 99 Forgiveness
dramabox.norm_title: beyond the 99 forgiveness
dramabox.description: Brooke Sterling spent three years loving her husband, Mason Masters, who treated their marriage as a tool to make his ex jealous. After ninety-nine disappointments, she filed for divorce and left. She found happiness with Sullivan Brooks. Mason begged at her wedding, but she chose the man who had always loved her. He learned: love is lost one disappointment at a time.

dramabox.title: Pregnant Before He Knew My Name
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant before he knew my name
dramabox.description: After secretly saving the gravely injured Prince Adrian Hale, palace maid Nora Green leaves without revealing her name. Soon after, she discovers she's pregnant. Believing she deliberately seduced him, Adrian pushes her away, while Nora silently endures endless humiliation until he finally realizes she is the woman who once saved his life. After uncovering the truth about Nora's hidden identity, Adrian crushes the conspiracy against her, and the two live happily ever after.

dramabox.title: The Stranger Who Made Us Family
dramabox.norm_title: the stranger who made us family
dramabox.description: Mia Sutton adopts an amnesiac elderly woman and works as a bartender to pay for her treatment. Her ex-boyfriend and his sister bully her relentlessly. Amid the cruelty, she meets Victor Carter，her ex's uncle. A bond forms. Then comes the revelation: the old woman is Victor's long-lost mother.

dramabox.title: Kiss From the Cursed Prince
dramabox.norm_title: kiss from the cursed prince
dramabox.description: Skylar, a seemingly powerless princess, flees her jealous queen stepmother and meets cursed prince Lucian in the forest. He turns dwarf by day and burns in fire at night. After falling in love, they fight the queen and his vengeful fiancée. When Skylar sacrifices herself for him, his curse breaks, and her hidden world-controlling power awakens to defeat the thunder clan, ending with their wedding.

dramabox.title: Who Dares Hurt My Wife?
dramabox.norm_title: who dares hurt my wife
dramabox.description: Damien Crosby marries Claire Reed in a flash marriage the day he leaves prison. Few know they share a complicated past. Destroyed by three powerful families, Damien acts secretly as a masked figure to help Claire establish herself in business. As the ancestral feuds of Crosby House come to light, their contractual marriage grows into true love. When his hidden identity is exposed, can he settle old family grudges and keep his beloved?

dramabox.title: I Married the Fool They Mocked, Then Won It All
dramabox.norm_title: i married the fool they mocked then won it all
dramabox.description: In 1980s rural village, Clara Hayes works for five years to support her fiancé, Evan Carter. After being mistaken for the top scorer, Evan dumps her and demands a huge dowry. Heartbroken, Clara marries the ridiculed shepherd Logan Walker. Then the truth comes out: Evan was never the top scorer—he ranked last. Clara and Logan build a happy life together, while Evan loses everything and lives with regret.

dramabox.title: Her Mission, His Kingdom
dramabox.norm_title: her mission his kingdom
dramabox.description: After a mission goes wrong, special agent Claire Hayes is transported to ancient times and becomes the foolish daughter of a noble family. She saves the legendary God of War Prince Julian Hart from assassins and is hired to escort him back to the capital. Facing endless schemes, they join forces and fall in love. When the Crown Prince plots to seize the throne, Claire and Julian expose his crimes. Julian carries on Claire’s legacy and protects their kingdom forever.

dramabox.title: When the Clock Strikes Love
dramabox.norm_title: when the clock strikes love
dramabox.description: Ethan Gordon and Emily Carter, an ambitious business duo, share a quiet spark after a tipsy night. At work, their loyalty and courage foil corporate schemes and safeguard their brand. Off-duty, they return home together, fending off family pressure to marry and fighting to preserve a beloved ancestral house. Through shared trials and everyday moments, their bond deepens into genuine affection. On New Year’s Eve, under a blaze of fireworks, Ethan confesses his love.

dramabox.title: My Boss, My Secret Lover
dramabox.norm_title: my boss my secret lover
dramabox.description: Claire Stone has been Adrian Hale’s assistant for three years, always keeping a professional distance. But after a drunken night, she accidentally sleeps with her cold CEO. Furious, Adrian searches the world for the woman who dared to cross him, determined to make her pay. He never expected the bold woman he’s been looking for has been right by his side all along.

dramabox.title: Bound to the Triplet Alphas
dramabox.norm_title: bound to the triplet alphas
dramabox.description:
New school, deadly fate. The moment Lyra arrived, three
glowing chains shot from her body, binding her to three
Alpha brothers. "She' s ours,"  they growled. But she can
only choose one. Breaking the other two chains will
mean war.

dramabox.title: The Bodyguard Who Owned the Empire
dramabox.norm_title: the bodyguard who owned the empire
dramabox.description: Retired special forces Logan Hale obeys his mentor to protect Claire Stone. After a shared night, Claire offers cash; Logan shocks her by flaunting more. He works as her bodyguard. When Claire is forced to engage Derek Ward, Logan wrecks the ceremony, injuring Derek and triggering retaliation. He thwarts wiretapping and kidnapping. Secretly heir to a top conglomerate, he juggles Aegis Unit infighting and business plots, meeting Sienna Wells.

dramabox.title: Married to My Hidden Love
dramabox.norm_title: married to my hidden love
dramabox.description: Claire Clarke and Adrian Knox enter a rushed marriage due to family pressure without ever meeting. Fate keeps bringing them together through unexpected events, and they slowly fall in love. Just as they decide to end their absurd marriage and pursue the people they truly love, they discover that the person they’ve been searching for is the very one they married from the start.

dramabox.title: The Baby With Million-Dollar Eyes
dramabox.norm_title: the baby with million dollar eyes
dramabox.description: Sophie Carter can see the true value of everything. Rescued from traffickers by special forces soldier Megan Hale, she returns to Seaton with Megan and helps revive a failing pawn shop. Sophie uncovers priceless treasures in fake antiques and impresses Adrian Carter, who hires her as a consultant and Megan as his bodyguard. Using her gift, Sophie saves Carter Group from bankruptcy and finds a brighter future with Megan.

dramabox.title: The Bodyguard I Married Owns the Security Empire
dramabox.norm_title: the bodyguard i married owns the security empire
dramabox.description: A female tech CEO in a business marriage was saved by a night security guard. She married him to fend off a hostile takeover. He turned out to be a master of combat and hacking, commanding a security empire presumed dead.

dramabox.title: The Stolen First Husband（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the stolen first husband dubbed
dramabox.description: Soo-a and Seo-jun have been married for three years. On their wedding anniversary, Soo-a discovers that her younger sister, Eun-a, has returned from abroad and is in bed with Seo-jun. Shocked and devastated, Soo-a demands a divorce and returns to her position as the head of the Madly Group.As she begins to take revenge on Eun-a and those who tormented her, she gradually clears up the deep misunderstandings between herself and Seo-jun.

dramabox.title: Captured by My Fiancé’s Brother
dramabox.norm_title: captured by my fianc s brother
dramabox.description: Go Su-hyeon travels to the capital to avenge her mother under the guise of honoring her engagement to the commander-in-chief's second son. There, she unexpectedly crosses paths with Han Ju-won, her fiancé's elder brother, who shamelessly pursues her despite knowing her identity. Every step Su-hyeon takes toward vengeance draws her deeper into Ju-won's grasp. He has only one warning for her. "Don't run. You're mine."

dramabox.title: Stitched Hearts to the Billionaire’s Late Regret
dramabox.norm_title: stitched hearts to the billionaire s late regret
dramabox.description: Years ago, Ava secretly sacrificed everything to save her sick lover, Ethan, and pretended to be a gold digger to force him home for treatment. Five years later, their son Noah died saving Ethan's grandmother. Humiliated by Ethan's fiancée while Ethan remained blind to the truth, Ava finally revealed everything. Ethan deeply regretted his actions, but Ava refused to forgive him.

dramabox.title: Crown of Betrayal: The Goddess Awakens
dramabox.norm_title: crown of betrayal the goddess awakens
dramabox.description: To awaken godhood, one must sacrifice the one they love most. Vivian Alden trusted her fiancé, Adrian Cole, only to be betrayed by him and her sister, Claire, who stole her divine power and left her for dead on the battlefield. Three years later, Vivian returns with powers beyond the gods. Hiding her identity, she patiently sets the perfect trap to make them lose everything they stole.

dramabox.title: Fated Once More: Justice Comes Due
dramabox.norm_title: fated once more justice comes due
dramabox.description: After being betrayed by the man she loved and murdered alongside her family, Clara Barton is given a second chance. Determined to rewrite her fate, she rejects the engagement that doomed her, outsmarts every trap, and builds her own power. With the man who once died protecting her now by her side, Clara exposes every conspiracy and makes those who destroyed her family pay.

dramabox.title: Her Sister Said No, She Said "I Do"（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: her sister said no she said i do dubbed
dramabox.description: Sent down the mountain by his master with nothing but a jade pendant and a marriage mission, Ethan Reed unexpectedly saves Claire Harper from assassins—only to discover she's the younger sister of his fiancée. When the heiress breaks off the engagement, Claire volunteers to marry him instead. One seeks to fulfill his master's order, while the other hopes to save her family's company. But fate has far greater plans for them.

dramabox.title: The Alpha King’s Secret Hybrid Baby
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha king s secret hybrid baby
dramabox.description: Eva has kept her hybrid daughter hidden for five years—until the child runs straight to the ruthless Alpha King and calls him Daddy. Now their secret could ignite a war, or finally make them a family.

dramabox.title: My Girlfriend's like a Brotome
dramabox.norm_title: my girlfriend s like a brotome
dramabox.description: Farmhand Lane triggers a curse that turns his best friend Evan into a woman, compelled to bear his child. Despite Lane's attempts to flee, Evan pursues him. She gives birth with Evan's smirk, locking them in an eternal soul bond.

dramabox.title: Married a Stranger: He's My Baby's Father
dramabox.norm_title: married a stranger he s my baby s father
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Claire Stone was set up by her boyfriend and ended up spending a night with Ethan Carter by a twist of fate. She raised their son Owen alone. Five years later, pressured by her mother to marry, she flash-marries Ethan — with no idea he's her child's biological father. As the marriage goes on, real feelings grow between them. When Owen's true parentage comes to light, it only brings them closer.

dramabox.title: From the Shadows to the Stage
dramabox.norm_title: from the shadows to the stage
dramabox.description: Two souls who crawled out of darkness found each other when they needed someone most. Elena Reed fought fiercely to reclaim Ethan Stone's justice, while Ethan became the strength that carried her toward her dreams. Years later, Elena becomes a celebrated singer with sold-out concerts and endless fame. Standing in the spotlight, she reaches out her hand and tells him, "If you won't come to me, I'll walk toward you.

dramabox.title: His Loss, His Brother's Bride
dramabox.norm_title: his loss his brother s bride
dramabox.description: After three years together, 30-year-old doctoral researcher Elena Blair is pushed into a blind date by her younger boyfriend, Tyler Hayes, who calls her old and tainted. She walks away for good, only to meet his older stepbrother, Callum Wells. What begins as a practical match soon becomes the love she never knew she deserved. But as Tyler refuses to let go, who will Elena choose?

dramabox.title: One More Night to Love
dramabox.norm_title: one more night to love
dramabox.description: Adrian Kane looks like an ordinary 24-year-old, but he's spent a century trapped under a curse that lets him live only after sunset. Before dawn, he must win the genuine love of a woman or lose both his humanity and his life. A master of seduction hiding behind endless nightlife, Adrian has grown tired of fleeting romances. Now, he'll risk everything to break the curse once and for all.

dramabox.title: Love Left Behind, Regret Comes Last（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: love left behind regret comes last dubbed
dramabox.description: Claire Hayes is finally found by her birth family, but only her childhood sweetheart, Ethan Cole, ever feels like home. After ten years together, they marry—yet he keeps choosing his stepsister Lydia over her. Broken, Claire walks away, only to be kidnapped by Lydia. At a cliff, Ethan thinks she's bluffing... until she falls. Believing she's dead, he spirals into regret. But Claire survives, saved by Julian Wells, the man who's loved her all along.

dramabox.title: Drowned in His Devotion
dramabox.norm_title: drowned in his devotion
dramabox.description: Claire Hart wanted a quiet life. But after an unexpected marriage, she discovers that her gentle, devoted husband is actually Victor Kane, a billionaire whose name commands both respect and fear. As Victor openly claims Claire as his wife and draws her into his world, she is swept into a whirlwind of wealth, family secrets, and dangerously possessive love.

dramabox.title: Maybe It Was Always You
dramabox.norm_title: maybe it was always you
dramabox.description: Mia Clark, a quiet illustrator, reunites with Ethan Hayes after seven years when her younger sister causes trouble at school. Back in high school, Mia confessed her love to Ethan, but a misunderstanding and a stolen rabbit doll drove them apart. Now Ethan is her sister’s teacher—and secretly a powerful investment partner who has never stopped loving her. As old feelings return, the truth behind the moon lamp and the seven-year-old letter finally comes to light.

dramabox.title: His Sweetest Exception
dramabox.norm_title: his sweetest exception
dramabox.description: Evan Hale is Bayton University’s untouchable golden boy—wealthy, devastatingly handsome, and impossible to tame. When transfer student Elsie Blair snatches the cigarette from his lips in front of the entire campus, everyone expects a disaster. Instead, Evan becomes dangerously obsessed with the only girl who has ever challenged him, and their explosive attraction soon turns into a game neither of them can control.

dramabox.title: Super System Makes Girls Fall for Me
dramabox.norm_title: super system makes girls fall for me
dramabox.description: Broke college student Oh Seung-yoon works three jobs just to survive—until a mysterious System changes everything overnight.  From invisible nobody to women’s dorm manager, he suddenly finds himself living under the same roof with three campus goddesses… all starting to fall for him. From nobody to the most wanted guy on campus—the fantasy begins now.

dramabox.title: My Human Husband Is a Hybrid King
dramabox.norm_title: my human husband is a hybrid king
dramabox.description: In a world ruled by vampires and werewolves, human Rina Smith is betrayed by her fiancé and cast into a forbidden forest, only to be saved by Cyrus Blackwood, the mysterious Hybrid King. Bound by fate, their unexpected marriage awakens a dangerous love as Rina discovers secrets of royal blood, hidden powers, and a destiny that could change the supernatural world forever.

dramabox.title: Bet on the Disabled Girl: The Golden Boy Goes Crazy
dramabox.norm_title: bet on the disabled girl the golden boy goes crazy
dramabox.description: A quiet girl hides her years-long crush behind the sharp scent of sour oranges—until her childhood friend returns with a new girlfriend and a cold demeanor. Forced to watch from the sidelines, she decides to bury her feelings and move on. But as old memories resurface and hidden truths come to light, he begins to question everything he thought he knew. Can he win her back before the last sour orange falls?

dramabox.title: She Stole My Thoughts, So I Made Her Pray at a Dragon Pact
dramabox.norm_title: she stole my thoughts so i made her pray at a dragon pact
dramabox.description: The night before Liora Bell claimed she could speak to beasts, I dreamed of my own death. I was Asterfell Academy`s top beast-speech interpreter, trained to translate the voices of dragons, griffins, and shadow wolves. In the dream, Liora stole my position as chief interpreter, took every honor from the royal dragon pact ceremony, and left me to clean the griffin stables. Everyone called her a genius. They called me jealous, useless, unwilling to give newcomers a chance.

dramabox.title: Eclipse Bond: Moon Falls for the Sun
dramabox.norm_title: eclipse bond moon falls for the sun
dramabox.description: Luna, a commoner, makes a contract with Asher, a wealthy heir with a fatal bloodline disease, to save her grandmother. At first a transaction, they fall in love. Conspiracies and misunderstandings drive them apart. Seven years later, Asher searches for her and finds her. They uncover past mysteries and awaken their bond, hoping to break fate's chains.

dramabox.title: Meant for Your Love
dramabox.norm_title: meant for your love
dramabox.description: On the night before her wedding, Claire Monroe’s fiancé Adrian Hale publicly agrees to run off with his first love, and Claire cancels everything. Her cold, distant coworker Ethan Lawson, who has secretly loved her for three years, finally makes his move. He saves her medical records, posts only for her to see, and drives away every suitor.

dramabox.title: Love Found, But Not in Time（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: love found but not in time dubbed
dramabox.description: After Gwen Stone marries Mark Gregg, Ellie Stone sows discord between them and cruelly takes Gwen's child, unaware that Gwen herself is already on the brink of death. When Flynn Moore—mistakenly believed to be in love with Gwen—arrives, her true identity is finally revealed. With a new future unfolding before her, Gwen leaves with Flynn, while Mark realizes his true feelings only when it's far too late to change anything.

dramabox.title: The Wolf King's Forbidden Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the wolf king s forbidden bride
dramabox.description: Lina, poor and invisible, is saved by mysterious Lucien. She falls for him but discovers he hides a secret—he belongs to a supernatural clan and her role is not accidental. She is both key and sacrifice. As another stranger draws her deeper, she must uncover the truth. Lucien may not be her savior but her destroyer.

dramabox.title: The Princess and the Bartender King
dramabox.norm_title: the princess and the bartender king
dramabox.description: Princess Alessia was assassinated by her fiancé and fell into a pool. Bartender Rafael saved her. She hired him as her bodyguard, unaware he is the Falcon King who went missing three years ago.

dramabox.title: In the Silence of Loving You
dramabox.norm_title: in the silence of loving you
dramabox.description: After reuniting with her high school first love Ryan Knox, Elise Hart quits her job and falls for the younger Evan Miles. During an investment deal, she meets Ryan’s best friend Derek Hale, who has secretly loved her since high school. Determined to win her, Derek tears Elise and Evan apart. What begins as revenge slowly becomes a dangerous, irresistible love that consumes them both.

dramabox.title: A Freedom Found in Love
dramabox.norm_title: a freedom found in love
dramabox.description: Claire Hale grows up under strict control and dreams of freedom. After meeting Ethan Carter, a wandering businessman with a dangerous air, she schemes to force him into marriage and escape her family. But Ethan is no ordinary merchant—he is a powerful warlord, and her bold move was part of his long-planned design. What begins as a marriage for freedom turns into a battle of wills, and together they stand to protect their home and country.

dramabox.title: Warning！Teacher is Too Tempting
dramabox.norm_title: warning teacher is too tempting
dramabox.description: Park So-hee, from Doctors Without Borders, disguises herself as a soon-to-graduate college student to repay Shin Mi-sook, who once helped her, and becomes Han Do-won's tutor. Do-won looks down on So-hee and boasts he'll kick her out in three days, but she stands her ground. His friends suggest he seduce her, saying his father will then kick her out, but So-hee instead traps Do-won in her own scheme.

dramabox.title: The Foster Son of the Iron Crown
dramabox.norm_title: the foster son of the iron crown
dramabox.description: Ethan, a foster son trampled for fifteen years, secretly holds a bronze ring and a guild. His true father was a legendary commander. When the duke's son tries to poison him, he reveals his power, reforms finances, wins the miners' loyalty, and rebuilds the Dragonspine Legion. The duke's daughter, who once helped him, becomes his ally. He was the true player all along.

dramabox.title: The Man Inside Her Robot
dramabox.norm_title: the man inside her robot
dramabox.description: Ethan Mercer, founder of Aura Robotics, was set up by his wife and assistant and killed. Reborn on the day of his company's IPO, he takes revenge on those who betrayed him.

dramabox.title: How to Tame Four Alphas
dramabox.norm_title: how to tame four alphas
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her fiancé and stepsister, wolfless Layla is forced into the Lycan Palace, where four cursed Alpha princes must choose a mate to preserve the royal bloodline. Her scent calms Kael, the First Prince. Her touch enthralls Lucius, the Second Prince. Her blood subdues Vesper, the Third Prince. Even Raven, the imprisoned Fourth Prince, is drawn to her. When all four choose Layla, she is trapped in a forbidden harem—and a deadly battle for the throne.

dramabox.title: The Playboy Who Only Vows to Her
dramabox.norm_title: the playboy who only vows to her
dramabox.description: Claire Sloan, jilted by her unfaithful fiancé and left battered from a car crash, finds an unlikely savior in Grandma Hale, who takes her under her wing and molds her into the Vice President of Hale Group. Evan Hale, the family's wild-card playboy, is thunderstruck the moment he spots Claire in the corporate office. Grandma, who has grown deeply fond of Claire, orchestrates every opportunity to bring the two together.

dramabox.title: A Decade of Pain, A Lifetime of Love
dramabox.norm_title: a decade of pain a lifetime of love
dramabox.description: Emily Sloan, a poison tester, survived a decade of torture in a poison lord's lair. Forced by her stepmother to wed General Adrian Hale as a substitute bride to cure him, she braces for more pain. Instead, the Hale household showers her with love, and the cold general awakens to shield her fiercely. Together, they stand united. The once-lowliest girl rises to become the revered mistress of the house.

dramabox.title: Marked by Fate, Spoiled by Him
dramabox.norm_title: marked by fate spoiled by him
dramabox.description: To save her ill sister, Claire Stone accidentally crosses paths with Victor Royce, CEO of the Royce Group, at a hotel. She later learns she is pregnant with twins. When Victor’s mother spots a birthmark on Claire’s shoulder, she deems Claire her destined daughter‑in‑law and pushes them together. Victor marries Claire under a one‑year contract, but genuine love blossoms as he defends her against workplace schemes and past entanglements.

dramabox.title: Reborn Before My Wedding, I Exposed His Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: reborn before my wedding i exposed his betrayal
dramabox.description: In her past life, Sienna Hayes mistook Victor Carson for her savior, only to discover after marriage that he had teamed up with her stepsister Chloe Lane to ruin her. Her true savior was Ronan Vale, the bodyguard who had always protected her. Reborn one day before marrying Victor, Sienna vows to expose their scheme and protect her true love. At her wedding, she reveals Victor’s betrayal and destroys their plan, finally finding happiness with Ronan.

dramabox.title: A Second Drive at Love
dramabox.norm_title: a second drive at love
dramabox.description: Once a formidable business mogul, Clara Park is betrayed by her ex-husband and left with crushing debt. To save her daughter, she becomes a designated driver. On a freezing night, she offers warm water and a mint candy to Adrian Hayes, a CEO with stomach pain. That small gesture wins his guarded heart. He protects her, clears her name, and her warmth heals his lonely years. From driver to true love, a mint candy binds their destiny.

dramabox.title: The Sharp Blade Won His Silent Heart
dramabox.norm_title: the sharp blade won his silent heart
dramabox.description: Claire Monroe, a weapons master, transmigrates into an ancient foolish girl. She plans to dump her scumbag boyfriend and enjoy freedom, but finds she must marry by 20 or face jail. She spots Adrian Carter, a prince's son, handsome and prone to blushing. She sets her sights on him. His princely mansion is threatened by 100,000 soldiers? No worry—war is her specialty.

dramabox.title: She Loved Me When I Was a Beggar
dramabox.norm_title: she loved me when i was a beggar
dramabox.description: Victor Kane, chairman of DreamCore Group, disguises himself as a beggar to find someone who truly loves him. While his ex and former classmates shun him, Emily Grant stands by his side, proudly calls him her fiancé, and gives him all her savings. Touched, Victor plans to reveal his identity at their wedding. But when others expose his “beggar” status, Emily’s mother cancels the wedding, and the couple is torn apart by a heartbreaking misunderstanding.

dramabox.title: Trapped by the Feral Billionaires
dramabox.norm_title: trapped by the feral billionaires
dramabox.description: The wealthy Sterling Lycan royal family's three Alpha heirs suffer a deadly curse: without their fated mate, they will go feral and die by 30. Debt-ridden human Elara unknowingly carries Siren blood, whose addictive scent is their only cure—yet also a deadly poison. What begins as ruthless extraction of her essence spirals into obsessive devotion. But as the brothers fight for her favor, a vampire conspiracy emerges—one that wants her blood to destroy the Lycan throne forever

dramabox.title: The Cursed Princess and Her Beast Mates
dramabox.norm_title: the cursed princess and her beast mates
dramabox.description: Sylvia, a 21st-century homebody, is transported into a beastman romance comic as a cursed princess who ages long before her time. Rejected by everyone, she's forced to choose defeated beastmen as husbands. Instead of one, she takes the three weakest. Why? A hidden Affection System lets her restore her youth, unlock powerful abilities, and earn rare rewards by raising their affection. Can Sylvia change her fate—and win their hearts before it's too late?

dramabox.title: Prince, Cinderella Forsakes You

dramabox.description: Transported to a brutal beast realm as a living energy source, Serena Blake works as a tamer to stay alive. Hoping to save this collapsing world by subduing orcs, she is chased by a rutting giant butterfly right away. Her casual soothing power tames the galaxy’s deadliest SSS‑level criminal, turning his rage into soft gasps. Fierce orcs weaken at her scent. Refined leaders, cat‑eared princes, fluffy creatures and timid serpent nobles beg for her touch.

dramabox.title: The Dragon Bride They Chained to the Siege Tower
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon bride they chained to the siege tower
dramabox.description: Princess Cassia is forced into a peace marriage—then betrayed by her brother, chained to a siege tower as a human shield, and branded a traitor. Her blood awakens Kaor, an ancient red dragon. She escapes, frees prisoners, and forms the Ash Legion with Rhys, an enemy commander who refused to shoot her. Together they conquer fortresses, free enslaved dragons, and expose royal conspiracies. Each dragon she frees burns years from her life—and Rhys hides a devastating secret.

dramabox.title: Reborn Goddess The God King’s Nine Divine Heirs
dramabox.norm_title: reborn goddess the god king s nine divine heirs
dramabox.description: Pure-blood goddess Sera is framed by her best friend and fiancé, and killed in the Chaos Forbidden Land. Reborn, she borrows divine genes from the disgraced God King Titan—conceiving nine children. As the Divine Mother, she storms the Holy Mountain, exposes the hypocritical order, overthrows the corrupt bloodline system with Titan, and protects her nine godlings.

dramabox.title: The Sun God's Beloved
dramabox.norm_title: the sun god s beloved
dramabox.description: Kallydia, the head priestess of the Temple of Philotia, is endlessly exploited by her mother to support her three younger brothers—even forced to seduce the Sun God in exchange for gold coins. A trap of enchanted incense leads to a night of entanglement with the Sun God Helios. She flees in panic the next morning, leaving behind only a silver moon armband engraved with her name.Helios had already grown fond of her, but after being stirred up by his colleague Thalia......

dramabox.title: War Rings
dramabox.norm_title: war rings
dramabox.description: Ordinary college student Jack, long bullied on campus, picks up a mysterious alien ring after a brutal beating—awakening powers and being pulled into the secret organization Star Shield. Forced to balance student life and battlefield missions, he grows from a self-protecting victim into a capable fighter alongside researcher Lucia and veteran Arthur. But every ring upgrade erodes his mind, and alien parasites have already infiltrated his campus.

dramabox.title: My First Night With The Vampire Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: my first night with the vampire billionaire
dramabox.description: Dead-broke Isabelle is fired, then nabbed by vampire Lucas—who claims she's his destined slave. She fights back, discovers she's a half-blood witch, and finds Lucas is secretly soft. Her sister schemes, her childhood friend betrays her. As she dies mid-transformation, can she break the curse and win her twisted fate?

dramabox.title: Black Blood's Awakening
dramabox.norm_title: black blood s awakening
dramabox.description: Arion Black was prophesied at birth as the "Anti-Magic Vessel"—the final piece to the Demon Lord's conquest. His parents died sealing the Demon Lord and entrusted him to Headmaster White, who abandoned eight-year-old Arion in the slums out of jealousy. Ten years later, the Queen summons all noble heirs back to the Academy. Arion returns, scorned by all—but nobody knows the seal on his power is crumbling. Anti-magic is awakening. And the Demon Lord's prison is cracking open.

dramabox.title: Dragon Crown Rise of Henry
dramabox.norm_title: dragon crown rise of henry
dramabox.description: Henry, the third prince of the dragon clan, was once protected by his father and brothers—until the invasion of human commander Caesar shattered his homeland and slaughtered his people. Risking everything, he awakened the long-lost power of the Ancestral Dragon. Through trials at the Starlight Mage Tower, cosmic relic expeditions, the inheritance of the Dragon Soul, and the coronation of the Dragon Emperor, he evolved into a Dragon God.

dramabox.title: I Accidentally Claimed Four Royals With A Kiss
dramabox.norm_title: i accidentally claimed four royals with a kiss
dramabox.description: Modern girl Sylvia is transported to a magical world as a powerless nobody. Desperate, she binds a "Love Contract System"—only by kissing powerful mages can she survive and share their power. She kisses icy genius Adrian, awakens immense magic, then bonds with elves, dragons, and shadow lords. But the contract hides a secret that could unleash an ancient evil. With dark forces closing in, can Sylvia balance the backlash and her true heart?

dramabox.title: The Nobody Was a Legend
dramabox.norm_title: the nobody was a legend
dramabox.description: Ten years ago, humanity repelled the alien civilization known as the "Ash Apostles" in the Battle of Meridian Gate. Hero Adam Kane sacrificed himself to save the world and was enshrined as the legendary "Ashbreaker." A decade later, corruption and conspiracy fester beneath the surface of peace—military-industrial conglomerates and the government colluding to bury the truth of the war. Living under a new identity as a mechanic, Adam returns to his homeland.

dramabox.title: Demon Queen Returns From Hell
dramabox.norm_title: demon queen returns from hell
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her family and sacrificed to the Demon King for her adopted sister, Lady Sora was supposed to die. Instead, she returns from the Demon Realm with forbidden power—and a proposal from the Demon King himself. Now, as everyone who betrayed her prepares for a grand wedding, Sora is ready to crash it, expose the truth, and make them regret ever choosing Agnes over her.

dramabox.title: Don't Kiss the Archangel Ordered to Kill You
dramabox.norm_title: don t kiss the archangel ordered to kill you
dramabox.description: Framed as a fallen angel, gifted healer Eva flees Heaven with Cassian, the archangel ordered to execute her. As forbidden love ignites, they descend into Hell to rescue her father and expose a conspiracy that could open the Gates of Hell—and destroy Heaven itself.

dramabox.title: Seven Seals Broken: The Archmage Returns
dramabox.norm_title: seven seals broken the archmage returns
dramabox.description: In 1926 London, legendary mage Evan Crowne loses his parents to dark magic, and his powers are sealed within the Seven Seals. Three years later, he lives in hiding as a stable hand for the Aster family. When the Blackwoods threaten to destroy the Asters and force Celia into a magical marriage, Evan can no longer stand aside. As Celia faces ruin, the Seven Seals begin to break—and the legendary mage finally returns.

dramabox.title: Abandoned in a Horror Game, Adopted by the Final Boss
dramabox.norm_title: abandoned in a horror game adopted by the final boss
dramabox.description: Follows Nora, a teen abandoned by her parents in a collapsing closed-beta horror game for their adopted sister Vivian. Instead of dying, she is taken in by Damien, the ruthless Dungeon Lord, who raises her as his daughter and makes her the dungeon's heir. Three years later, her former family returns seeking the Boss's heart, forcing Nora to confront her past and choose between the toxic family that discarded her and the monstrous one that chose her.

dramabox.title: Genius Dragon Rider
dramabox.norm_title: genius dragon rider
dramabox.description: In the Northern Sea, two schools coexist—the sacred covenant of equal human-dragon bonds and the corrupt art that enslaves dragons. Four-time champion Kaelen was betrayed by his junior Lovell and the Elder Council; his Moonlight Spirit Dragon Frost shattered into pieces, and Kaelen fell. His remnant soul was reborn as Ailan, a "cursed" outcast boy, who swore to gather the fragments, seek revenge, and restore order.

dramabox.title: Ice Dragon’s Thoughts Drive Her Husbands Obsessed
dramabox.norm_title: ice dragon s thoughts drive her husbands obsessed
dramabox.description: Workaholic Lira dies and transmigrates into a beast-world ice dragon villainess, framed by the nine-tailed fox princess. Hated by four top alphas—Cian, Kael, and Elian—she awakens a purification system. Her inner thoughts are heard by all four. She saves feral beasts, shatters the princess's schemes, and turns hatred into devotion. She uncovers a royal conspiracy, rises as a goddess, and finds peace with her four lovers and brother.

dramabox.title: THE 72-YEAR-OLD LandLord
dramabox.norm_title: the 72 year old landlord
dramabox.description: 72-year-old widower Marcus, cheated by his tenant Brenda, signs a deal with the devil Diablo on his deathbed: every time he shocks a woman, he regains two months of youth. From knocking out a boxer to helping his tenants escape loan sharks, workplace harassment, and an eight-year cold case, Marcus grows younger while mending broken lives. But as he nears his prime, he discovers the contract hides a darker truth — one even Diablo won't reveal.

dramabox.title: The Tidal Saintess and Her Three Champions
dramabox.norm_title: the tidal saintess and her three champions
dramabox.description: Mermaid princess Aria is betrayed by her fiancé Aiden and stepsister Meryn, stripped of her bloodline by King Oren, and thrown into the abyss—but awakens tidal power and bonds with the abyss entity Silas. To avenge her mother and expose her father's plot, she allies with human King Kaelen, her half-brother Brett, and three guardians. She overthrows the tyrant, gives birth to a crossbreed daughter Angela, and ends centuries of war with a golden tail, building peace on ruins.

dramabox.title: Crimson Covenant
dramabox.norm_title: crimson covenant
dramabox.description: College student Selene awakens the long-lost Ashworth silver blood—revealing she is the reincarnation of the original vampire ancestor. Hunted by five clans, she faces betrayal, genocide, and the chains of a thousand-year prophecy. Fighting between destruction and rebirth, she breaks the cycle, overthrows the old vampire order, rewrites the Crimson Covenant, and ends the eternal loop by mortal choice.

dramabox.title: Conquer Wall Street With Magic
dramabox.norm_title: conquer wall street with magic
dramabox.description: When Sterling Group is attacked and Chairman Jonathan falls comatose, illegitimate son Alex returns. Dismissed as a failure, he's actually the youngest Archmage—using truth spells and alchemy to fight corporate and magical attacks. Tycoon Arthur Cromwell wants the "Stone of Truth." Bound by magic law, Alex must save both worlds without exposing magic.

dramabox.title: Her Three Royal Suitors
dramabox.norm_title: her three royal suitors
dramabox.description: Aurelia, a temple priestess's daughter, is stripped of everything after refusing to marry the God King's son. She makes a marriage pact with the cold Frost King Eirik to reclaim her power—but is drawn into a conspiracy to usurp the God King. Three rulers clash over her: the Northern King, the new God King, and her long-lost childhood friend. A battle for power and love across three realms begins.

dramabox.title: Possessed by My Ex's Dragon Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: possessed by my ex s dragon uncle
dramabox.description: Isabella is betrayed by her fiancé Damian and given to Kaiser—the exiled Dragon King. He takes her by force, then announces marriage. She discovers he's the injured boy she saved years ago, and he has loved her ever since. Damian and her stepsister scheme against her. Kaiser protects her, and their unborn dragon baby saves them. One year later, they are crowned king and queen, sharing a kiss under the sun.

dramabox.title: Rescued by a Mermaid Princess, She Insists on Marrying Me
dramabox.norm_title: rescued by a mermaid princess she insists on marrying me
dramabox.description: Luna, heir of the mermaid kingdom, saved human researcher Kai three years ago—forbidden love crossed species. Her adopted sister Siren, consumed by grief, steals the throne and frames humans. Surviving imprisonment and a deadly curse, Luna reunites with Kai. They uncover the truth behind the war, face betrayal and hatred. Their love becomes the final sacrifice that ends centuries of conflict and brings peace to both worlds.

dramabox.title: Marked by Him I Became the Dragon Clan's Forbidden Toy
dramabox.norm_title: marked by him i became the dragon clan s forbidden toy
dramabox.description: Slayer Stella is betrayed, cursed with dragon blood—dragon prince Silas's soul lives in her heart. She allies with Silas, escapes with elf prince Logan. Grant serves the Void God. Stella and Silas become Dragon Knights, unite three races, destroy the Void God. Stella finds her parents, bonds with Silas—from avenger to guardian.

dramabox.title: The Second Breath
dramabox.norm_title: the second breath
dramabox.description: A thousand years after humanity's extinction, vampire baron Knox and wolf hunter Aurora are rivals and lovers. When Aurora's mother is condemned by the Wolf King's Pureblood Decree, Knox performs the forbidden "Shared Life" ritual to help Aurora win the Twin Moon Heart—but the ritual is a one-sided sacrifice, transferring every wound Aurora takes to Knox. As betrayal and tragedy strike both sides, the two are forced to publicly turn against each other......

dramabox.title: Abandoned Dragon， Ascendant Queen
dramabox.norm_title: abandoned dragon ascendant queen
dramabox.description: Elian, condemned as magicless, was saved by her mother Selene and adopted by Kaelen. Twenty years later, she awakens Golden Dragon blood, returns to expose Leora, exile Marcus, and become Queen. Leora allies with dark sorcerer Morgaine, sparking war. Elian awakens Dragon God power, defeats evil, saves her parents, and is crowned Sovereign.

dramabox.title: Hidden Seals, Broken Pact
dramabox.norm_title: hidden seals broken pact
dramabox.description: Poor miner Aiden enters Starfall Academy with his only friend Ash—a broken-winged baby dragon. Noble Lucius bullies them, but Aiden discovers silver nails sealed inside Ash, tied to his mother Elena's 18-year-old injustice. He uncovers the Voss family's illegal dragon experiments. Bound by symbiosis, they expose the schemes, abolish forced contracts, and free all enslaved dragons.

dramabox.title: The Road of Return
dramabox.norm_title: the road of return
dramabox.description: In a war-torn world, Kane, a former elite soldier who once lived as a legend, has buried his past. Forced to protect the mysterious alien girl Roxi—who may be his daughter—he journeys to find her mother. Along the way, the warrior inside awakens. In the end, he stops the war and redeems his past.

dramabox.title: The Omega's Command
dramabox.norm_title: the omega s command
dramabox.description: He is the only Omega in the entire military camp, crushing every Alpha with perfect scores just to join the legendary team Raven and stand beside his idol, Ares Thorn. But on the day he earns his place, the man waiting for him is not Ares. It is Logan Frost, an ace sniper and the legal husband assigned to him by the matching system, kneeling before him with roses in his hands. Before Ethan can refuse, Ares steps out from behind Logan, grips Ethan's chin in front of......

dramabox.title: Kiss of the Rose and the Thorn
dramabox.norm_title: kiss of the rose and the thorn
dramabox.description: Vampire Selene, raised in isolation, is married off to comatose heir Julian. On their wedding night, she feeds on him—and he awakens. Julian protects her from threats, and they discover they can read each other's minds. Both abandoned by their families, they join forces to overthrow the two houses.

dramabox.title: The Archmage Reborn: Betrayed by My Disciple
dramabox.norm_title: the archmage reborn betrayed by my disciple
dramabox.description: Reinhardt, the kingdom's greatest archmage, is betrayed by his disciple Cecil and the crown. With his final breath, he casts a reincarnation spell and awakens as Leon Grey, the eight-year-old son of a ruined border baron. Using his past knowledge, he rebuilds his magic, drives off attackers, revives dead farmland, heals his dying mother, and reclaims stolen mines—saving his new family.

dramabox.title: Exiled: I Am the White Moonlight of All Races
dramabox.norm_title: exiled i am the white moonlight of all races
dramabox.description: Exiled mermaid princess Lindsey, cursed and dying, awakens the Sea God's holy song—summoning four fallen heirs: dragon Caesar, fallen saint Lorne, elf Ceylan, and vampire Cain. Healing them one by one, she binds all four through resonance. With her four lovers, she breaks an 18-year curse, reclaims divine power from her jealous sister, and ascends the throne as Sea God.

dramabox.title: North Dragon Rise After Rejection
dramabox.norm_title: north dragon rise after rejection
dramabox.description: K, a dragonborn, travels to the royal capital with an ancestral contract to wed Princess Isabella. He endures harassment from the queen and mages, foils half-orc and dark elf schemes, joins elf forces to crush the orc army, quells a rebellion, marries the princess, and safeguards the continent's peace.

dramabox.title: After They Sacrificed Me, My Three Sisters Wept Bitterly Upon Olympus
dramabox.norm_title: after they sacrificed me my three sisters wept bitterly upon olympus
dramabox.description: Divine son Silas was once cherished by the Three Fates. After the demon Laius arrived, his fortunes took a sharp turn for the worse. Laius schemed and framed him at every turn, sowing constant misunderstandings that left Silas suffering endless false accusations and harsh treatment.When a cataclysm engulfed the three realms, a sacrifice was needed to seal the rift in time‑space. Silas volunteered to sacrifice himself. Yet before the sacrifice, he endured repeated misjudgme...

dramabox.title: Bound By Magic
dramabox.norm_title: bound by magic
dramabox.description: To obtain the magical elixir that could save her dying mother, 18-year-old muggle girl Diana is forced into a contract marriage with Lucian—the academy's feared chief, rumored to be brutal and dangerous, yet secretly a hidden dragon prince. She believes she has married a monster, but amid the fierce power struggles at the academy, she discovers that this dragon tyrant, who never understood love, is willing to defy the entire magical world's ancient rules for her.

dramabox.title: The Secret Mermaid Maid of the Mad Dragon King
dramabox.norm_title: the secret mermaid maid of the mad dragon king
dramabox.description: A bullied maid hiding her Siren Queen bloodline must risk everything to cure a poisoned,mad Dragon Prince,sparking a forbidden romance that will burn down empires.

dramabox.title: My Broke Mercenary Is the Dark Lord
dramabox.norm_title: my broke mercenary is the dark lord
dramabox.description: Evelyn thinks she's being sacrificed to the terrifying Dark Lord, so she spends one last night with her broke mercenary lover, Kyle. What she doesn't know? Kyle is the Dark Lord himself. When her family betrays her, steals her inheritance, and even tries to kill her, Evelyn discovers her "doomed marriage" may be the first choice that was ever truly hers.

dramabox.title: The Pureblood’s Lethal Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the pureblood s lethal bride
dramabox.description: Agent Bailey marries pureblood Count Cassian to assassinate him—but a life-bond forms between them, awakening her "Primal Blood." She discovers her boss Marcus killed her father and imprisoned her mother to use her blood to summon the demon god Cain. Together, Bailey and Cassian fight vampire elders, seize the holy sword, slay a frost dragon on the icy plains, and forge their love. But the demon god rises—war for the world begins.

dramabox.title: Her Fool Was the Hidden King
dramabox.norm_title: her fool was the hidden king
dramabox.description: Gwendolyn spent three brutal years protecting a brainless fool, mistaking him for her dead fiancé Alden. She had no idea he was actually his twin brother who used forbidden magic to save the Aethelgard and became mindless, Alaric, the world's supreme sovereign. Now cured, Alaric hides his sanity to silently ruin everyone who abused her. But when her family forces her to marry, the disguise shatters. He asks: Will you marry me, not as his widow, but as my queen?

dramabox.title: The Last Sealkeeper
dramabox.norm_title: the last sealkeeper
dramabox.description: Dockworker Kael Varr has a secret: he can communicate with dragons. When the Deep Tide Guild plots to enslave dragons and conquer the North Sea, Kael teams up with warrior Freya to stop them. He rallies freed dragons and rebels to defeat the guild, averting the apocalypse, but a new threat awakens from a hatched dragon egg.

dramabox.title: Dragonblood Alchemist
dramabox.norm_title: dragonblood alchemist
dramabox.description: Adrian Vane—the empire's greatest alchemical genius and inventor of Dragonblood Alchemy—was betrayed and killed by his own disciple, Sebastian Kraven. His soul was bound to an F‑rank iron puppet, A.V.001, in his own lab, where he unexpectedly discovered that the puppet body could perform alchemy directly, without any alchemical array. For three years, Adrian hid in a scrapyard, using scrap materials to upgrade his new body through alchemy while waiting for a chance to......

dramabox.title: One Night Had Hades Begging for More
dramabox.norm_title: one night had hades begging for more
dramabox.description: Persephone wakes pregnant after a forbidden night with Hades—carrying his stolen death essence. Demeter gives the baby to Hades, erases Persephone's memories and powers, and sends her to the mortal world. Years later, Hades finds her as a florist. His power fades, the Underworld collapses—only sleeping with her can restore him. She mistakes him for a blind date and marries him on the spot. Now Hades has her under his roof—and wants her every night.

dramabox.title: Three Princes Regret Deeply, I'm Already Dragon Queen
dramabox.norm_title: three princes regret deeply i m already dragon queen
dramabox.description: Dragon princess Leora heals three princes with her divine scales but is impersonated by servant Sylvia. For five years, the princes favor Sylvia and humiliate Leora. Heartbroken, she abandons them and marries their uncle—new Dragon King Darien. At the wedding, the princes try to ruin it with Sylvia. Darien arrives in time. Truth reveals Leora was their real savior. The princes are left with endless regret.

dramabox.title: Bound to the Elf King My Sister's Bride Price
dramabox.norm_title: bound to the elf king my sister s bride price
dramabox.description: When Lyriel, an orphan of the Voss family, is forced by her cruel cousin Seraphina to take her place as a sacrificial offering to the elves, she discovers that the sacrifice is not slavery—but becoming the bride of the Elven King Aerixtan. Though Aerixtan already has a bondmate, Carina, and claims he will never love Lyriel, they slowly fall for each other.

dramabox.title: I Dumped Zeus: The God King's Regret
dramabox.norm_title: i dumped zeus the god king s regret
dramabox.description: Furious at Zeus's betrayals, Hera divorces him and descends to the mortal world—running a flower shop and punishing cheating men as a "Breakup Master." She meets gentle Leo and begins to rediscover love. Misunderstood and powerless, Zeus watches another man win her heart. Unable to reveal the truth, he must learn love not as a god—but as a man.

dramabox.title: The Jade Queen Rises, Dragons Kneel
dramabox.norm_title: the jade queen rises dragons kneel
dramabox.description: Born under a forbidden prophecy and hidden from a ruthless emperor, Yara grows up unaware of her true bloodline. When a mysterious jade cuff awakens her bond with dragons, she enters the deadly Dragon Trials and challenges the cruel Lady Tali. With Duke Edgar at her side, Yara must uncover her past, free the dragons from fear, and rise as the legendary Jade Dragon Queen.

dramabox.title: Starfall: Save My Wife, Save Earth
dramabox.norm_title: starfall save my wife save earth
dramabox.description: During a space disaster, squad leader Gideon crashes on deadly Asuran. His wife Seraphina is taken by Star Reavers, key to the Ancients' plan to destroy Earth. With mystic Zariel's aid, Gideon unlocks armor, allies with alien clans, and discovers he is the lost king of the Ancients—a weapon hidden on Earth. He rejects godhood, unites all races, kills the High Priest, and saves Seraphina. But the Ancient Mother awakens—a greater war looms.

dramabox.title: The Trap of Immortality
dramabox.norm_title: the trap of immortality
dramabox.description: The demigod hero Leon bore divine blood that kept him ageless, yet his beloved Calyxa was fated to age and die. Unwilling to be nothing more than a fleeting guest within his endless lifespan, Calyxa chose to walk away. Years later, she reappeared, still youthful‑faced, claiming she had discovered a way for mortals to achieve immortality. Desperate to reclaim his love, Leon ventured into the Temple of Eternity, hidden within the rifts of Tartarus......

dramabox.title: The Little Fallout Whisperer
dramabox.norm_title: the little fallout whisperer
dramabox.description: In a post-nuclear wasteland, Bonnie, a girl who can talk to animals, is abandoned by her aunt and adopted by kind Hazel. She uses her gift to save her family, becomes an apprentice to renowned healer Silas, and resolves animal mysteries. Rival Nora poisons her out of jealousy. Bonnie responds with sincerity, turning Nora into an ally. They walk the healer's path together.

dramabox.title: My Twins' Beggar Daddy Is the Sea God
dramabox.norm_title: my twins beggar daddy is the sea god
dramabox.description: Sea God Kael descends to find his destined one, loses power and memory, becomes a beggar. Mortal Eliana saves him; they fall in love. Returning to his realm, time shifts—she waits seven years, raises twins alone, framed and forced into sea sacrifice. Kael returns, saves his family, and unleashes his divine wrath.

dramabox.title: They Took My Angelic Grace, Until I Awoke My Seraph Wrath
dramabox.norm_title: they took my angelic grace until i awoke my seraph wrath
dramabox.description: Cast down from Heaven with no memory, Seraphina trusts Adrian, the man who teaches her how to live—and calls him husband. But his love is a lie. He drains her divine grace to save Scarlett, while Elias pretends to protect her only to imprison her for himself. Now both men want her blood, her bone marrow, and her power. When Sera finally tries to escape, a hand closes around her ankle in the rain. Can an angel trapped by human greed ever break free?

dramabox.title: Whoever I Choose Will Be King
dramabox.norm_title: whoever i choose will be king
dramabox.description: Elena Ashford, the lost true heir of House Ashford, is prophesied to become Elarion’s next Elven Queen. Forced to marry Prince Adrian, she refuses his humiliation and chooses Rowan Vale instead—a feared northern commander hiding a claim to the throne. As prophecy, bloodline, and military power collide, Elena must decide who deserves the crown—and her heart.

dramabox.title: Dumped by the Prince, Crowned by the King
dramabox.norm_title: dumped by the prince crowned by the king
dramabox.description: In the elven kingdom, Elana is betrayed by her sister Serene and fiancé Prince Caelum. They poison the king; Serene leaves Elana's mother in a coma. Elana turns to King Celepharn—Caelum's father. She saves him from a monster attack, wins his trust, and becomes queen. At Caelum's wedding, Serene sees Elana return—not as her victim, but as her stepmother. Revenge begins.

dramabox.title: One Wrong Hug, the Dragon King Claimed Me
dramabox.norm_title: one wrong hug the dragon king claimed me
dramabox.description: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Eleanor accidentally discovers she can calm the Dragon Lord Kevin's violent dragon nature. When she rescues his orphaned niece Aria, the three grow into an unexpected family. As betrayal, danger, and old wounds close in, Eleanor and Kevin must learn to trust love instead of fearing losing it.

dramabox.title: From stable boy to soccer god
dramabox.norm_title: from stable boy to soccer god
dramabox.description: Alex, once the "God of Spirit-ball," won a match but lost his kidnapped brother. Guilt-ridden, he became a stable hand. Forced into a noble's death match, he won easily. When dark magic was used, he saved the city lord's daughter Elysia instead of dodging. She redeemed his freedom—on one condition: help her family win an impossible match.

dramabox.title: Don’t Touch Our Mafia Father
dramabox.norm_title: don t touch our mafia father
dramabox.description: Twin forest witch heirs Lily and Leo enter New Eden City seeking their destined ones. Adopted by mafia godfather Dominic Moretti, they use magic to heal his sick brother Ethan and mad aunt Luna, help the Moretti family overcome a power crisis, and find their long-lost mother. A fantasy tale of healing, family, and fulfilling their witch bloodline destiny.

dramabox.title: The Fallen Elf Princess
dramabox.norm_title: the fallen elf princess
dramabox.description: Princess Elowen's kingdom is destroyed by High Priest Wre. Her mother sacrifices herself to save her. Captured and cursed, Elowen leaps from a tower into King Sylvester's arms. They share a passionate night; she flees. Sylvester finds her, helps unlock the Sacred Stone's power. Elowen destroys Wre, rises from fallen princess to Queen of the realm.

dramabox.title: Make a Wish: Fall in love with Djinn
dramabox.norm_title: make a wish fall in love with djinn
dramabox.description: Djinn Cassian breaks the ultimate law to revive a drowned baby and is cursed by Death. Eighteen years later, the girl Aria makes her first wish and enters a contract marriage with him. If she makes all three wishes, Cassian is freed—but Death claims her soul. Their fake marriage turns to real love, and both vow to sacrifice themselves for the other.

dramabox.title: Final Sequence: Lord of the Abyss
dramabox.norm_title: final sequence lord of the abyss
dramabox.description: In a Cthulhu-ravaged apocalypse where god-granting Sequence Seeds are hoarded by ruling powers, humanity clings to scattered islands terrorized by deep-sea horrors.When villains slaughter his community and slay his loved ones, enraged Glen swallows his hidden Sequence Seed to unlock the supreme forbidden Sequence 0 power, embarking on a brutal path of vengeance and ascension...

dramabox.title: The Mystery of the Ocean's Daughter
dramabox.norm_title: the mystery of the ocean s daughter
dramabox.description: Jenny, exiled after a night with God King's son William, raises son Eden alone. Eden's blood curse requires William's blood. Jenny infiltrates the palace. Witch Fiona plots against Eden. William saves him, learns the truth. Fiona schemes, but William exposes her, defeats her, and cures Eden. Family reunited, happily ever after.

dramabox.title: She Smashed My Dragon Baby, I Smashed Her Life
dramabox.norm_title: she smashed my dragon baby i smashed her life
dramabox.description: Delaney, the dragon god's favorite daughter, falls for human Dylan. Her father seals her divine power for three years as a test. As a CEO, she silently builds Dylan's company behind the scenes. In their third year, Delaney carries a dragon egg. Dylan cheats with her secretary Daphne. At an auction, Delaney clashes with Daphne—and Daphne targets the soon-to-hatch dragon egg in a jealous rage.

dramabox.title: Titan’s Rebirth: I Bore Nine Natural Laws for the God King
dramabox.norm_title: titan s rebirth i bore nine natural laws for the god king
dramabox.description: Alicia, betrayed and killed, is reborn. She refuses the scumbag, ventures to the Abyss, and gives birth to nine Titan cores from King Alexander. Rachel's plot is exposed. Hera threatens her for the Eternal Flower Seed. They discover it sustains earth's seals and a sealed Throne of Void. Together, they protect their children and unlock the ancient throne's secret.

dramabox.title: Saintfall
dramabox.norm_title: saintfall
dramabox.description: Eden, discarded daughter of the Saintly Bloodline, is framed for blasphemy and beaten to death in prison by her brother. As she dies, a twelve-winged archangel awakens within her—she is the tenth incarnation of an angelic descent. Three days later, she rises, transformed. She returns, humiliates her stepmother, slaps her brother, and at the Holy Banquet summons three angelic artifacts. All kneel. Those who crushed her now tremble.

dramabox.title: My Brother's Contract Girlfriend is My Mermaid Bride
dramabox.norm_title: my brother s contract girlfriend is my mermaid bride
dramabox.description: Harper, a diva hiding her mermaid identity, returns to find her boyfriend Rhett engaged to her rival. She poses as his brother Leo's contract girlfriend. Rhett's jealousy burns—he claims to hate her but never let go. When her secret is exposed and she begins to turn to foam, he learns the truth: she never betrayed him. Now he kneels to save her. Can he defy fate?

dramabox.title: The Elf Princess in the Maid's Dress
dramabox.norm_title: the elf princess in the maid s dress
dramabox.description: Elvira, an elf princess, flees an arranged dragon marriage and binds a life-death contract with Prince Cain. Disguised as a maid, she uncovers her parents' sealed past. Together they defeat Duke Gregory's conspiracy to revive the Demon King. Elvira learns she is the Demon King's seal. They sacrifice their souls to win, are crowned king and queen, and purify the demonic energy. But at their daughter's birth—has the remnant poison truly vanished?

dramabox.title: I Swallowed the Zerg Overmind's Egg
dramabox.norm_title: i swallowed the zerg overmind s egg
dramabox.description: In a wasteland arena, F-rank Ryker fights to save his sister Lena from a genetic disease. Desperate, he swallows a Zerg Overmind's egg—and awakens terrifying power. He rises, but slowly transforms into something inhuman. He uncovers a conspiracy: his parents' deaths and Lena's illness are part of an empire's fusion experiments. As war and swarm engulf the city, can Ryker keep his sanity and save his sister?

dramabox.title: When My Husband Became My Father-in-Law
dramabox.norm_title: when my husband became my father in law
dramabox.description: After war, wolf prince Jacob and King Edward are cursed—bodies swapped, both poisoned. Only Queen Evelyn's touch can save them. A witch gives her seven days to choose one. She uncovers the truth: Jacob plotted it all to seize power. Betrayed, Evelyn teams with Edward to turn the trap against him. A wolf clan war of power, betrayal, and redemption begins.

dramabox.title: Vengeance of the Wolf King
dramabox.norm_title: vengeance of the wolf king
dramabox.description: Wolf King Alexander finds a tortured white wolf on his border. Wiping her face, he sees the golden totem—passed only through his bloodline. His only child is Princess Vivian, married to human Emperor Arthur three years ago. But the human court just announced the Empress safely gave birth. If this tortured wolf is the real princess, who is on the throne sending letters in her name?

dramabox.title: The Cure They Covet
dramabox.norm_title: the cure they covet
dramabox.description: She is the only "cure" in the abyss, imprisoned by dragon, serpent, siren, deer, and lion lords. Their endless battles push the abyss toward collapse. Realizing she won't be a trophy, she chooses to become their master. She is their only salvation—and their end. They thought they possessed the cure, never realizing they had fallen for their own destroyer.

dramabox.title: The Underdog Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: the underdog strikes back
dramabox.description: King Odysseus gains god-slaying power from Chaos to overthrow Zeus. He returns home, saves his son, exposes plots, and cures his realm's plague by striking a pact with Circe. Olympus turns his son against him, but Odysseus and Penelope launch their campaign against Mount Olympus.

dramabox.title: The Inferno Warlord's Secret Healer Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the inferno warlord s secret healer bride
dramabox.description: Healer Seraphina saves cursed Hellfire leader Drake, unaware of his identity, and gives birth to twins. Exiled by her family, she raises them alone. Years later, wounded Drake is found by the twins and falls for Seraphina at first sight, proposing. Together they face family conspiracies, power struggles, and dark magic. They discover they are each other's long-lost love. Drake inherits the Northern Lordship, and the family of four finds happiness.

dramabox.title: Goodbye Fiancé I Choose the Vampire King
dramabox.norm_title: goodbye fianc i choose the vampire king
dramabox.description: In a world of elite vampire clans, ordinary Raina is saved by noble Justin and becomes his fiancée. His ex Ellie returns, frames Raina repeatedly.
