Justin always takes Ellie's side and demands Raina give up her training spot. Heartbroken, Raina finally chooses to leave forever.

dramabox.title: The Dragon Rider
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon rider
dramabox.description: Mike Clover is the luckiest swordsman alive — every monster he fights is either already half-dead or about to get hit by a rockslide.On his fake "slay a dragon" mission, Mike finds a starving boy in the woods. He gives the boy some bread. The boy won't leave.Turns out, the boy is actually a dragon — the most powerful kind. And when his power wakes up?Mike's not the one riding the dragon. The dragon's riding him.

dramabox.title: Kneel! I'm the Son of Zeus
dramabox.norm_title: kneel i m the son of zeus
dramabox.description: Apollo, the son of Zeus and God of the Sun, descends to the mortal world disguised as a humble stable boy. After breaking his betrothals to three arrogant princesses, he chooses Daphne, the so-called cursed witch who once saved his life. As he heals her scars and vows to make her his bride, Apollo reveals his divine identity—and brings every scheming king, false saint, and cruel rival to their knees.

dramabox.title: The Lycan King's Secret Bond
dramabox.norm_title: the lycan king s secret bond
dramabox.description: Alice is a fragile rabbit shifter hiding one deadly secret: every wound she suffers is transferred a hundredfold to William, the supreme Lycan King. When his jealous fiancée discovers Alice in his private chamber, she drags the "lowly rabbit" to a public execution. She thinks killing Alice will protect her crown. She doesn't know every blow is killing her King—and the woman she calls prey may be his true fated mate.

dramabox.title: Ex Drained Me For His Mistress's Child, His Brother Made Me Queen
dramabox.norm_title: ex drained me for his mistress s child his brother made me queen
dramabox.description: White petals turn to black thorns. The wedding altar is a hunting ground for my sacred blessing. My elven prince fiancé holds his pregnant lover and sneers that he only marries me to feed her baby my power. They pin me to cold stone, tear the golden Life Dew from my chest, and siphon my soul with the Iron Crown. Broken, I crumple as they mock that no one will want me again. The Elven King steps forward, claiming me as his own. I vow all who stole my power will pay dearly.

dramabox.title: The Spartan War God Returns
dramabox.norm_title: the spartan war god returns
dramabox.description: Betrayed by brother Damocles, Spartan General Agis's soul enters teen Areus to protect widow Selene. He rises in the arena, shatters blades, and unleashes past fury. Damocles sells Sparta to Athens. Agis defeats invaders, ruins his brother, but awakens in his original body—the rebirth was a projection. The real Areus is cornered. The God of War returns for vengeance and Sparta.

dramabox.title: Patient Zero，Back from the Dead
dramabox.norm_title: patient zero back from the dead
dramabox.description: The explosion that created the world's first superhumans was no accident. The only survivor didn't die—he came back. Inside the killer's own school. Hiding the power she fears most. And he's not here to learn. He's here to make her fall...

dramabox.title: The Guardian on Trial: The Lion King's Reversal
dramabox.norm_title: the guardian on trial the lion king s reversal
dramabox.description: Golden Lion King Galon is forced to kill his foster father, High Priest Orion (possessed by an ancient god), to protect his kingdom—and is branded a traitor. At the public trial in the Pantheon of Beasts, sister Sofia presides as brother Leo, foster mother Margaret, ex-girlfriend Claire, and others accuse him. When his Golden Blood ignites with ancestral fire, memory visions reveal the truth: Galon never betrayed anyone—he silently protected them all at his own cost.

dramabox.title: My Son Is the Zombie King
dramabox.norm_title: my son is the zombie king
dramabox.description: When the zombie virus swept the land, civilization fell.They call him the king of the dead. His father calls him son.The world wants him dead. His father wants him alive.But Leo isn't just the cure — he's the weapon they can't control...

dramabox.title: The Dragon's Return:  Reclaiming My Throne
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon s return reclaiming my throne
dramabox.description: In a world ruled by bloodline, Kaelen—Red Dragon heir—cannot shift. His brothers cripple him, defile his bride, and exile him to the Dead Volcano. There, primal dragon blood awakens, forging him into an arch-dragon of devastating power. Ten years later, as war crushes his clan, he returns as a cold hunter. He watches his brothers grovel, his ex regret—then reveals his true form and claims the throne.

dramabox.title: The Exiled Dragon Queen
dramabox.norm_title: the exiled dragon queen
dramabox.description: Abandoned at birth, Renata is raised by the Black Dragon King. She awakens the Primordial Dragon Soul, returns to her clan—mother enslaved, aunt seized power. She defeats the Blue Dragons in three moves, all kneel. She rejects her father's regret. Crowned Dragon Queen, she ends centuries of war.

dramabox.title: Kneel! That's the Dragon Rider
dramabox.norm_title: kneel that s the dragon rider
dramabox.description: After secretly saving the continent, legendary Silver Dragon Rider Arthur returns to his fiancée, only to find she has chosen an Elven noble instead—just as the Elven Queen who has spent years searching for him becomes the target of a conspiracy that could destroy her reign.

dramabox.title: My Twin Gave Birth, But My Crystal Says She's Dead
dramabox.norm_title: my twin gave birth but my crystal says she s dead
dramabox.description: When Freya, the foxfolk's greatest seer, discovers her twin sister is already dead, she exposes the woman impersonating the queen. Betrayed by the royal family and hunted by dark magic, Freya must uncover the truth, avenge Chloe, and save the foxfolk kingdom.

dramabox.title: From Scorned Bride to Elf Queen
dramabox.norm_title: from scorned bride to elf queen
dramabox.description: In the Elven Kingdom, spirit orbs bind fates—but Catherine's match is stolen by her stepsister and lands with Lawrence, a disabled painter mocked by all. Framed for poisoning the Sacred Tree, she faces sacrifice until Lawrence reveals himself as the rightful Crown Prince. Together they expose the conspiracy, growing from an arranged match to devoted partners. A tale of resilience and love, proving strength lies in standing together.

dramabox.title: The Mad Prince and the Emperor's Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the mad prince and the emperor s bride
dramabox.description: After ten years of pretending to be insane, Prince Lucian joins forces with Seraphina, a noblewoman trapped in a forced royal marriage, to expose a tyrant’s deadly conspiracy. But taking the throne is only the beginning. With rebellion, debt, political division, and foreign invasion threatening the Empire, they must choose between absolute power and a new order where even an Emperor must obey the law.

dramabox.title: The Demon s Vulnerable Brider
dramabox.norm_title: the demon s vulnerable brider
dramabox.description: Human girl Lilith saves Devil King Lucifer and is taken to the Abyss. While bearing his child, she is slain by dragon princess Aleia. Lucifer preserves her soul with his Sin-Core and reincarnates her as orphan Evelyn. When Evelyn awakens past memories in the伯爵's manor, she chooses to return to the Abyss freely—to reunite with a now-respectful Lucifer as equals, raise their child anew, and bring dawn to Hell.

dramabox.title: The Discarded Prince Awakens the Sea
dramabox.norm_title: the discarded prince awakens the sea
dramabox.description: Sea God's son masters water magic and seeks his mother. He saves his sister, enters the palace, but his brother doubts him. Undead army invades; his power amazes all. A witch manipulates his brother, abducts royals. He awakens his bloodline; his father Poseidon arrives. They defeat the Lich King, restore peace, and reunite the family.

dramabox.title: For the One Who Died for Me
dramabox.norm_title: for the one who died for me
dramabox.description: Princess Stephanie, reborn after betrayal, exposes her scheming fiancé and maid, revokes their power, and redeems her bond with beastman prince Morgan. She clears his name, defeats the dark witch, restores the kingdom's magic barrier, and marries Morgan, uniting humans and beastmen forever.

dramabox.title: Rise of the Mage-God
dramabox.norm_title: rise of the mage god
dramabox.description: Rowan accidentally merges with the First Wight King's Divine Blood. To protect the one he loves, he pretends to be a powerless apprentice mage. When the Crimson Wall crumbles and the Holy Sword shatters amid world-ending ruin, his iridescent true form descends in thunderous majesty. With a single stroke, he remakes heaven and earth, compelling all the blind, powerful nobles across the realm to kneel and kowtow.

dramabox.title: My Ex Became a Monster, I Became Dragon Queen
dramabox.norm_title: my ex became a monster i became dragon queen
dramabox.description: After being murdered by her husband in her past life, Evelyn is reborn and refuses to save him. She marries Cassian, the loyal Dragon Prince who truly loves her. As her ex-husband and deceitful sister face a cursed fate, Evelyn rises from discarded bride to the future Dragon Empress.

dramabox.title: My Brother Took My Name. The Dragon Wants Blood.
dramabox.norm_title: my brother took my name the dragon wants blood
dramabox.description: Forced to fight under his brother's name, Kane Rowan returns from the Northern Front as a legendary Nine-Ring Marshal. Betrayed by his family and former fiancée, he gives up his identity—only to reclaim his power, expose the truth, save the kingdom from a dragon invasion, and make his enemies pay.

dramabox.title: I Married His Archrival
dramabox.norm_title: i married his archrival
dramabox.description:
To lift the curse trapping my fiancé Cedric, I gathered ten thousand thorny herbs and scaled a thousand tall trees for sacred fruit, left with raw nails and blistered feet. After three years tending his enchanted slumber, he finally woke—only to pick my maid Mira.
Elven betrothals are unbreakable magical oaths. Cedric wrongly believes Mira saved him from a birthday lake accident, though I was the one who dove in.

dramabox.title: The Dragon Heir's Plus-Size Mate
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon heir s plus size mate
dramabox.description: Mocked all her life for her curves, Elena never imagined they might be the key to saving the Dragon Heir. Chosen as Trevor Harden's personal maid, she enters Stormspire only to face his deadly mating curse, his cold rejection, and a jealous rival determined to destroy her. But when Elena's touch makes the black veins of his curse disappear, Trevor asks the question that could change both their lives: Is she his fated mate?

dramabox.title: Ten Years a Farmer, One Day Above the Immortals
dramabox.norm_title: ten years a farmer one day above the immortals
dramabox.description: After spending ten years as an ordinary farmer in the cultivation world, Ethan Reed finally awakens his long-overdue system. A rusty hatchet can instantly kill immortal masters, while an ordinary mosquito coil wipes out entire demon armies. As sect leaders and immortal emperors line up to serve him, Ethan unknowingly turns his humble farmhouse into the most feared place in the cultivation world, proving that even the simplest tools can rule the heavens.

dramabox.title: The Wolf's Eternal Curse
dramabox.norm_title: the wolf s eternal curse
dramabox.description: Kaelen, the sole surviving pureblood werewolf of his clan, was hidden as a serf after Judgment Knight Raimond slaughtered his people. Years later, awakening his bloodline, he enters the Abbey of the Divine Path, but soon clashes with the corrupt inquisitor Kuhn, exposing his identity and drawing the Sword of Divine Oath—while attracting the greedy Empress Marie and his mother's killer Raimond.

dramabox.title: A Bedbug Devouring the Wizarding World
dramabox.norm_title: a bedbug devouring the wizarding world
dramabox.description: North American mercenary king Seth dies and transmigrates into a bedbug in a magical world, binding an "Infinite Devouring Evolution System." He partners with Scarlet, a "squib" witch, and devours dark wizards, magical beasts, and even gods, evolving into a terrifying Purple Crystal Sovereign Dragon. They crush the Supreme Temple and defeat the Grand Inquisitor. Seth regains a perfect human form and heads to the stars—but countless horrors are awakening beyond the heavens.

dramabox.title: Billionaire Luna: Taming My Alpha Mates
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire luna taming my alpha mates
dramabox.description: Aria, a princess, is transmigrated into a world where she is despised by her four alpha mates. She gains a spending system that doubles her returns. She exposes plots, rescues her mates, and awakens SSS golden bloodline. She destroys the black tide organization, purifies the world tree, becomes queen, and brings peace.

dramabox.title: The Hidden Hand Behind the Gods
dramabox.norm_title: the hidden hand behind the gods
dramabox.description: Posing as a minor, unassuming immortal, Eldon Ward secretly guides fallen ancient powers through reincarnation, raising them as his disciples. After 300 years of quiet planning, his plan nears completion — his students are none other than Sun Wukong, Nezha, Erlang Shen, and Red Boy. As ancient grudges resurface, he leads his reborn team to overturn heaven's false order.

dramabox.title: The Last Seven Tears of The Mermaid Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the last seven tears of the mermaid bride
dramabox.description: To marry Prince Lucian, Mermaid Ariel sacrificed her voice and accepted a fatal curse: when her last enchanted pearl shatters, she becomes sea foam. But as his mute Queen, she faces only his icy indifference and cruel abuse from his mistress Selina, and stepmother Iris. With just seven pearls left, time is running out. Will Ariel cling to an empty, unrequited love, or shatter the cage and escape?

dramabox.title: Fleeing The Future I Saw With Him
dramabox.norm_title: fleeing the future i saw with him
dramabox.description: In an elite academy where power rules, ordinary girl Sophie unexpectedly awakens an extremely rare ability—Future Sight. But the very first future she sees shows her passionately kissing none other than Damien, the school's coldest and sharpest-tongued student council president.Convinced this could never happen, Sophie decides to stay far away from him—but fate has other plans. That very night, her mother remarries, and Damien becomes her new stepbrother!

dramabox.title: My Useless Husband Is the Supreme Dark Lord
dramabox.norm_title: my useless husband is the supreme dark lord
dramabox.description: Hiding his identity as the Supreme Dark Lord, Arthur lives a quiet life growing tomatoes. One day, the Elven Queen Selena escapes into his garden and claims him as her fiancé to flee a forced marriage. Entering the Royal Court, Arthur shatters enemies' traps one by one, and reveals his true self to save Selena. Together, they uncover the truth of the royal massacre and crush both the traitorous Regent Azrael and his plot. In the end, they get married and unite their realms.

dramabox.title: Rise of the Night Raven
dramabox.norm_title: rise of the night raven
dramabox.description: When the savage Outlaws storm Obsidian City with wild magic, the boss of House Orion demands an enforcer from all of the city's magic syndicates. Much to everyone's amusement, the infamous playboy Kato Corlis steps up to face them. Secretly a masked vigilante seeking justice for his murdered sister, Kato's true power is revealed as he destroys his enemies one by one, until the whole city learns that he is the legendary Night Raven.

dramabox.title: Fallen Duke, Awakening the Trident of the Sea God
dramabox.norm_title: fallen duke awakening the trident of the sea god
dramabox.description: Once-glorious Duke Winston family falls. Arthur, the last heir, scorned by all, is humiliated at the awakening ceremony. On the brink of ruin, he awakens the broken Poseidon Trident—an ancient divine relic. With a three-day bet, he enters the deadly beast forest, fights bloodily, unlocks godly power, crushes mockers, rises from nothing, and restores his family's honor.

dramabox.title: After Dad Locked Me in the Closet, I Saw Mom's Ghost
dramabox.norm_title: after dad locked me in the closet i saw mom s ghost
dramabox.description: Five years after dying in childbirth, Iris returns as a ghost and discovers that her real daughter, Annie, has been abused and neglected while another girl is cherished in her place. With little time left, Iris helps Annie reach her grandmother, confronts the husband who failed them both, and finally frees her daughter to grow up loved, safe, and unafraid.

dramabox.title: The Dragon King Threw Me Away—Then Found Our Twins
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon king threw me away then found our twins
dramabox.description: After being betrayed and thrown off a cliff by her mate, Dragon Queen Mia survives, changes her face, and raises their twins in secret for sixty years. When her sick daughter needs a sacred dragon scale, Mia returns to the Dragon Palace—only to face the Dragon King who still loves her, a jealous rival, and the curse that tore their family apart.

dramabox.title: The False Divine Bond
dramabox.norm_title: the false divine bond
dramabox.description: Layla, former high priestess of Delphi, was betrayed and thrown off a cliff. Near death, she awakened Kyle, the underworld lord sealed by Zeus, trading her soul for revenge. She returned to crush her enemies, grew from allies to lovers with Kyle, became Queen of Styx, cleared his name, reclaimed her voice, and restored peace.

dramabox.title: By Day, My Dragon
dramabox.norm_title: by day my dragon
dramabox.description: In a world bonded to dragons, Ila, mocked for 19 years, is chosen by Kaelan, the last ancient dragon cursed to shift forms by day and night. They flee the Church, uncover the truth of dragon extinction, and defeat Vess, who sought Kaelan's power. Ila restores the land and frees Kaelan. But an older darkness awakens.

dramabox.title: The Devil King
dramabox.norm_title: the devil king
dramabox.description: In war-torn Smoto City, lightning-wielding hero Kael slays Devil King Terramon, only to be betrayed by his rival Leon and lover Vera, who steal his power, frame him, and cast him into the abyss. Left for dead, Kael inherits the Devil King's cursed power and four King's Marks. Rescued by slum warrior Valena, he hides his identity while mastering his forbidden strength. He must reclaim his honor, unmask traitors, and halt the apocalyptic Gates of Hell.

dramabox.title: The Beastbind
dramabox.norm_title: the beastbind
dramabox.description: Talia, a master beast tamer, loses everything to betrayal. Rebuilding at a failing menagerie, she catches the eye of Gerard, a buyer secretly the crown prince. They expose corruption, win a national competition, and fall in love. When Gerard's royal engagement is revealed, Talia storms the wedding with magical beasts, proves her worth, and becomes Crown Princess.

dramabox.title: My Brother Hunted Me, Not Knowing I Was His Lost Sister
dramabox.norm_title: my brother hunted me not knowing i was his lost sister
dramabox.description: I became a winged white tiger to save my brother—now he hunts me for my mutant core, not knowing I'm his lost sister. Standing beside him is a girl who's stolen everything from me. I try to approach him but he blasts me with his power, leaving a burn across my back. When he finally recognizes me, the only reversal cure has a 4.7% survival rate. I choose to risk everything to become human again, while the girl who betrayed me works to erase me forever.

dramabox.title: His Lost Cat Mate With Twin Cubs
dramabox.norm_title: his lost cat mate with twin cubs
dramabox.description: After one forbidden night, Alicia raises twin cubs alone. To save them, she marries a poor soldier—never knowing he is both their father and a prince.

dramabox.title: Please Save Mommy, Mr. Sun God
dramabox.norm_title: please save mommy mr sun god
dramabox.description: After seven years apart, Sun God heir Lucian discovers that his mortal lover Cecilia is alive—and that their hidden daughter, Amaya, is a powerful demigod. As Cecilia's lost memories return and a jealous goddess threatens their lives, Lucian must defy Olympus, uncover the truth, and win back the family he failed to protect.

dramabox.title: The Dung Picker Who Raised a Dragon
dramabox.norm_title: the dung picker who raised a dragon
dramabox.description: Chosen as a dragon prince's bride, cowherd Joanna survives cruelty, a false pregnancy, and a deadly court conspiracy. After Darian betrays her, she seizes control of the Dragon Nest, exposes a noble rebellion, and rises from an unwanted farm girl to the kingdom's Dragon Queen—on her own terms.

dramabox.title: Exile the War God, Watch the Court Fall
dramabox.norm_title: exile the war god watch the court fall
dramabox.description: Kane, the legendary Blood War God of the Crimson Court, has never lost a war in five hundred years. He rescued Elizabeth when she was seventeen, protected her through countless battles, forged alliances in her name, subdued rival clans, and placed her on the throne of the Thirteen Clans. But after Kane negotiates a ceasefire with the Wolf Tribes, he becomes a political threat. Manipulated by her Royal Secretary,

dramabox.title: Hades’ Little Warrior Takes on the Mafia
dramabox.norm_title: hades little warrior takes on the mafia
dramabox.description: Lucien, an underworld gatekeeper, fled to the mortal city Vesper with his daughter Mira to live normally. He saved heiress Valerie, who proposed a contract marriage. Adrien Hawthorne kidnapped Valerie and sent assassins. Mira fought fiercely; Lucien erased memories. Mira exposed cousin Gavin's frame-up. Adrien arrived with enforcers. Meanwhile, underworld ferryman Charon sent Ronan—threatening their peace.

dramabox.title: Scrap Titan
dramabox.norm_title: scrap titan
dramabox.description: In a cyber-wasteland where neural implants control powerful mechs, a ruthless conglomerate plots to enslave humanity through a hidden neural network. Born unable to receive implants, low-tier mechanic Ray discovers Rusty, a century-old fully mechanical mech. Piloting it with his bare body, he rises through underground gladiatorial arenas, exposes the Ouroboros conspiracy, and destroys the global control matrix, breaking humanity free from technological bondage.

dramabox.title: Son of Odin Ragnarok
dramabox.norm_title: son of odin ragnarok
dramabox.description: In the frozen North, teenage blacksmith Eric and his sister Lily are inseparable. To save Lily from a forced marriage, Eric enters a warrior tournament. His divine power awakens, his spear erupts in golden thunder, and Odin reveals Eric's true heritage. Eric defeats Loki's schemes, sacrifices his right eye for wisdom, frees a frost dragon, and embarks on his quest to Ragnarök.

dramabox.title: The Man with the Deadly Touch
dramabox.norm_title: the man with the deadly touch
dramabox.description: A massage apprentice, Ethan Cole, gains touch-based power to read meridians after a meteor strike. He enters an underground fight ring—but it's a trap by Yan Xu, who hunts fighters for eternal life. Framed for murder, Ethan joins Iris Hart to uncover the truth. They defeat Zhao Qiwen, learn the conspiracy, and find his martial purpose. Storming Yan's lair, Ethan seals his energy points with massage techniques, destroys the fiend, and clears his name.

dramabox.title: Blood of the Beast Queen
dramabox.norm_title: blood of the beast queen
dramabox.description: Evelyn, once reviled as the "daughter of calamity," was offered as a sacrifice to the Dragon's Abyss. Her golden blood made the dragon withdraw. Black Knight Drevin, cursed and sealed in dragon form for centuries, protected her in a past life. She refused tyranny, revived the continent, and freed her beloved. But an ancient dragon older than time awakens in the abyss.

dramabox.title: Marked by the Twin Wolf Kings
dramabox.norm_title: marked by the twin wolf kings
dramabox.description: On a stormy night, an Omega named Chloe gets into a car accident while en route to a mountain resort with her fiancé, Andrew, to enjoy their first heat cycle. The Alpha King, Essen, uses magic to erase Chloe’s memory and imprisons her. Held captive, Chloe mistakenly believes he is her Alpha fiancé, unaware that Essen is a half-human, half-wolf hybrid who was exiled by his twin brother, Andrew, and now seeks revenge against his family.

dramabox.title: Kneel Before Me, My Ex-Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: kneel before me my ex alpha
dramabox.description: Rejected and enslaved by her Alpha, Alia awakens as the last Lycan heir and tears down the pack that broke her. Rising from abused Omega to Empress, she must face war, betrayal, and a ruthless council—while deciding whether Kairen is truly her fated mate or merely another man seeking her power.

dramabox.title: My Blind Daughter Walked Into a Mutant Zoo
dramabox.norm_title: my blind daughter walked into a mutant zoo
dramabox.description: Blind Lily enters a mutant zoo that can restore sight. Her mother Claire follows, and the zoo forces her to confess the truth: she caused Lily's blindness by a medication error three years ago. Lily knew all along. The zoo trades Lily's sight for Claire's confessions and physical costs. Claire turns into a beast, but Lily recognizes her by touch and leads her through the gate. The price resets; they return to human life.

dramabox.title: Blood Of The Dragon Bride
dramabox.norm_title: blood of the dragon bride
dramabox.description: She was an abandoned daughter, thrown to monsters. Her golden blood made beasts bow. He is a beast hunter with a five-century blood debt, yet the only man who would kneel for her. She refused the throne and freed all beasts. But an ancient eye in the abyss awakens, whispering of chaos without a king.

dramabox.title: Prometheus Reborn: You Chained the Wrong Goddess
dramabox.norm_title: prometheus reborn you chained the wrong goddess
dramabox.description: Prometheia, Goddess of the Divine Flame, saved her adoptive mortal family from annihilation with the Divine Flame—only to be framed by her jealous stepsister, betrayed by the family she rescued, and tortured in prison for three brutal years. Once freed, Prometheia vows to take back everything they stole. When her enemies cast her out again, the Divine Clan arrives to kneel before the woman mortals called a prisoner. Now, with her true power awakening, every traitor will pay.

dramabox.title: Bound to My Brother's Alpha Rival
dramabox.norm_title: bound to my brother s alpha rival
dramabox.description: Luna, Princess of the Wolf Clan, is born into a 300-year blood feud. Her brother lies dying at Conall's hand. To save him, she enters enemy territory—and accidentally triggers a Fated Mate bond with Conall—the sworn enemy of her pack. Now she's torn between the brother who craves revenge and the mate she can't resist. When her brother finds the enemy's mark on her skin, Luna must choose—family loyalty, or fated love.

dramabox.title: Claimed by My Enemy's Son
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by my enemy s son
dramabox.description: Jasper loses his family in a massacre and is left for dead—until scientist Silas rebuilds him as his perfect cyborg weapon. Posing as Silas's humanoid robot, Jasper infiltrates the estate of Coleman, the world's richest, ruthless tycoon, ready for revenge. But under Silas's control, vengeance twists into obsession, and their bond over revenge sparks desire neither man can suppress. Now Jasper and Silas must outsmart Coleman before he destroys them—and save each other in time.

dramabox.title: Hearing the Fluff-Ball's Mind, I Shook the Elf Realm
dramabox.norm_title: hearing the fluff ball s mind i shook the elf realm
dramabox.description: After being deceived into losing her elf promotion and magic, Elara unexpectedly hears a fluff-ball plant's inner thoughts. She forms a blood contract with the divine beast to regain her power, overturns the trial, and exposes the villains' lies. As her hidden Life Goddess bloodline awakens, Elara crushes every plot, punishes the traitors, and sets out to restore the ancient Goddess's Domain.

dramabox.title: The Jade That Made Him a Legend
dramabox.norm_title: the jade that made him a legend
dramabox.description: After a landslide kills his parents and brother, and his family's inn nears collapse, Evan Cole's girlfriend Tessa Boyd abandons him for wealthy heir Ryder Kane. In despair, Evan awakens an ancestral jade pendant, gaining mystic power and healing arts from immortal Selene Vale. From ruin to cultivation master, he rises to protect his family and shatter every enemy in his path.

dramabox.title: My Girlfriend Was Never Alive
dramabox.norm_title: my girlfriend was never alive
dramabox.description: Ethan Reed brings his girlfriend Mia Hayes home to meet his parents. The moment Claire Ward sees Mia, she warns Ethan that Mia is not human and will drain his life force in the night. She gives him a silver needle for protection. Ethan ignores her warning and gets intimate with Mia that night, only to see her reveal her terrifying true face. He grabs the needle in panic, but it has already been snapped in two.

dramabox.title: The Useless Bride, the Dragon King's Craving
dramabox.norm_title: the useless bride the dragon king s craving
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her fiancé and offered to the Dragon King as a sacrifice, powerless fox Lyra expects death—until she discovers the feared king, Draven, is the mysterious mate who saved her. As enemies conspire against them, Lyra awakens hidden frost powers and fights beside Draven to protect their bond and reclaim the throne.

dramabox.title: Pregnant with the Dragon Lord's Last Heir
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant with the dragon lord s last heir
dramabox.description: Lila Reed, a widow from Blackstone Harbor's slums, falls into the dragon sacred grounds while fleeing Governor Barlow and meets Kael, the Dragon King no woman can approach. She bears his child—the last royal-blooded heir—and becomes the only one able to awaken the royal dragon egg. To protect her son, she serves as a dragon-raising maiden in the Dragon's Nest Sanctuary, unraveling secrets about his origins while Kael discovers her strength and kindness......

dramabox.title: Matchmaker from the Grave
dramabox.norm_title: matchmaker from the grave
dramabox.description: 22-year-old Emily is abused by her stepmother and stepsister, forced to live in a cold barn as a free servant. After an accidental fall, her blood awakens her three-hundred-year-old vampire ancestor, Violet van Horn. With her grandmother's magical help, Emily stuns everyone at the graduation ball, falls in love with school heartthrob Liam, crushes her stepsister with the Memory Palace technique in a public bet, exposes her stepmother's cruelty, and discovers from her......

dramabox.title: Vampire Origin and Her Three Tycoonst
dramabox.norm_title: vampire origin and her three tycoonst
dramabox.description: Lilia, the amnesiac progenitor of vampires, spends one night with three powerful men at a peace banquet, who fall madly for her and protect her loyally. She collects four sacred relics to regain her memories, defeating the greedy elder Vlad and fanatical prince Dracula. She learns the blood empress Karina, her former maid, betrayed her. Fully awakened, Lilia defeats Karina, balances three races and rules alongside her three lovers.

dramabox.title: No Longer Your Princess
dramabox.norm_title: no longer your princess
dramabox.description: After enduring toxic thorns for her fiancé, Princess Luna is betrayed when he mistakes a scheming mistress for his savior, taking away Luna's healing gem and bridal chamber. At the altar, Luna shatters her vow ring, sacrificing herself to Hades to ascend as Underworld Queen, leaving her repentant lover to rot in agonizing guilt.

dramabox.title: Ex Wants Me as His Mistress, Unaware I'm the Elven Queen
dramabox.norm_title: ex wants me as his mistress unaware i m the elven queen
dramabox.description: After breaking off her engagement to the unfaithful Caelan, Liora quietly becomes the Elven Queen. When Caelan returns, demanding she become his wife—or even his mistress—he has no idea who she really is. As his arrogance turns to obsession and regret, Liora stands beside King Alwin, reclaiming her dignity, love, and crown.

dramabox.title: The Prince Took My Crown For His First Love, So I Left
dramabox.norm_title: the prince took my crown for his first love so i left
dramabox.description: For ten years, Marina gave Prince Dorian everything: her loyalty, her love, even her crown. But when his first love returns, Dorian casts Marina aside and gives another woman her place. Then Marina discovers she is carrying his heir. For one fragile moment, she dares to hope their child might change his heart, until an "accident" at the royal blessing ceremony forces Dorian to choose between them. Who will he save?

dramabox.title: I Married The Sleeping Prince, His Soul Chose Me
dramabox.norm_title: i married the sleeping prince his soul chose me
dramabox.description: Born cursed for seeing souls, Evelyn is sent to marry a comatose crown prince after his fiancée abandons him. Only Evelyn can hear Adrian`s wandering soul, and her devoted care slowly awakens his heart and body. When his fiancée steals her credit, Adrian wakes to expose the lie, fulfill his promise, and make Evelyn his Crown Princess.

dramabox.title: Divine Blood in Dust
dramabox.norm_title: divine blood in dust
dramabox.description: Goddess Hebe descends to marry Jason, but is betrayed and abused. Deceived by Medea, Jason treats her like a slave. Her brothers Ares, Apollo, and Hermes reveal her identity. Hebe reclaims her divinity, strips Jason of his power, and returns to Olympus triumphant as her tormentors rot in misery.

dramabox.title: Master of the Unstoppable: My Disciple Makes Me Invincible
dramabox.norm_title: master of the unstoppable my disciple makes me invincible
dramabox.description: Adrian Reid is the weakest master at Waycrest Sect, on the verge of being cast out after years without a disciple. Then he takes in Vivian Voss, the reincarnation of a legendary empress, activating his secret system. As Vivian grows stronger, Adrian earns double rewards from her progress. When a disgraced heir joins them, their journey becomes a thrilling quest for revenge.

dramabox.title: Ruin the Empire, Make Me Stronger
dramabox.norm_title: ruin the empire make me stronger
dramabox.description: Burned-out office worker Julian Reed wakes up as Valora’s emperor with one goal: wreck the kingdom and cash out $1 billion. He trashes royal traditions, turns the palace into a playground, cashes in on cheesy love poems, and even launches a milk tea canal project. Yet every ridiculous stunt is hailed as genius. Instead of collapsing, Valora gets richer and stronger, turning Julian’s reckless schemes into an economic miracle.

dramabox.title: Portal of Fortune: My Supplies Turned the Tide
dramabox.norm_title: portal of fortune my supplies turned the tide
dramabox.description: Darian’s troops are trapped on an island, starving and surrounded by enemy forces. At their darkest hour, General Julian Knox reaches modern-day Ethan Reed through an ancient well. Ethan sends clean water, emergency rations, and modern gear, turning the tide and helping Julian defeat the enemy with no losses. Grateful, Julian sends Ethan a fortune in captured treasure, giving him a whole new life.

dramabox.title: Bane of the Dead: Under the Blood Moon
dramabox.norm_title: bane of the dead under the blood moon
dramabox.description: Damon Stone awakens as the leader of the Saffron Order in a world consumed by a blood moon and a zombie plague. As warriors awaken strange powers and darkness swallows the land, Damon commands ancient talismans to break the curse and turn the tide. He seeks no throne—only to crush the forces of darkness and restore hope to a broken world.

dramabox.title: Evil Hunter: Dragon Hunt
dramabox.norm_title: evil hunter dragon hunt
dramabox.description: Lord Whitmore, leading Evil Hunter-Six Division, investigates a case of a divine dragon locked in a well in a Yorkshire village. A mysterious man tries to stop him. Who is he and what is his plan?

dramabox.title: Sacrificed Maid: The Vampire Count’s Beloved
dramabox.norm_title: sacrificed maid the vampire count s beloved
dramabox.description: Sophia trades her freedom for her father's life, becoming a sacrificial maid bound to the ancient vampire count Orr. To her surprise, he dotes on her deeply. Plotted against by his jealous sister, she is framed for treason. He nearly kills her, then sets her free. When enemies attack, she seals a blood pact with him, awakening his power and saving him. The gloomy castle becomes their warm haven.

dramabox.title: The Modern Mind in Ancient Robes
dramabox.norm_title: the modern mind in ancient robes
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter time-travels to ancient times and is tricked into becoming a eunuch. When a northern kingdom challenges the empire to a poetry duel, Ethan uses his modern wit to win, earning the Empress's favor. One night, he discovers her secret and becomes her trusted servant, rising to become the most powerful eunuch in the court.

dramabox.title: The Ultimate Return: Unleash the Invincible
dramabox.norm_title: the ultimate return unleash the invincible
dramabox.description: Victor Stone, a legendary warrior, returns to Blyra to save his homeworld, only to find his powers sealed. Still unstoppable, he takes down enemy agents, wipes out a massive scam operation, and crushes every monstrous threat in his path. When a dark force from beyond the stars descends, Victor breaks an ancient seal and unleashes his full power, driving it back with a single punch. With Blyra safe, his family reunites and peace is restored.

dramabox.title: Godfall: Heaven’s Reckoning
dramabox.norm_title: godfall heaven s reckoning
dramabox.description: After reaching enlightenment, Ethan Hale realizes the truth he once believed was a lie. He reunites his old companions and sets out on one final journey to uncover what really happened. Once a rambling monk, Ethan becomes their leader and fiercest fighter. Logan never backs down, Benny struggles with his past, and quiet Gavin keeps watch from the shadows. One by one, Ethan brings them home, until the truth behind their forgotten journey finally comes to light.

dramabox.title: Slaying the Heavens, Breaking the Chains
dramabox.norm_title: slaying the heavens breaking the chains
dramabox.description: After five years of swallowing every insult, Damon Cross finally unlocks immense power through a mysterious system. He returns to settle the score with Chloe, only to be pressured into surrendering his secret techniques. When Vivian Knox summons a celestial enforcer to punish his defiance, Damon kills him with a single strike and delivers a chilling warning: “Come one, come all. None will survive.”

dramabox.title: God of Dragons - The Last Ride
dramabox.norm_title: god of dragons the last ride
dramabox.description: After hiding his identity as a humble ranch hand, the Dragon God Aron vows to protect Lyra and her daughter. When a ruthless warlord seizes their dragon ranch, Aron must reveal his legendary power, avenge Herrick's death, and win back the family he swore to protect.

dramabox.title: The Year of Surprise
dramabox.norm_title: the year of surprise
dramabox.description: Wyatt Stone gave his life to defeat the Demon Emperor, only to wake a thousand years later in the Sword Heaven Sect. Elena Stone is reborn too, but she has forgotten him. When he senses evil energy inside the sect, he uncovers a shocking truth: the revered sect leader is a demon. A final showdown restores peace to the land.

dramabox.title: Division 9: I Became the Zombie King
dramabox.norm_title: division 9 i became the zombie king
dramabox.description: In 3050, broke vlogger Eli Cross is killed by a vampire—only to wake up as a zombie bound to a mysterious Evolution System. Hiding his undead identity, Eli infiltrates Division 9, a secret agency hunting supernatural threats. With every battle, he grows stronger, unlocks terrifying powers, and rises from a powerless nobody to become the legendary Corpse King—while ancient forces awaken to stop him.

dramabox.title: Rejected By Four, Claimed By My Enemy Hades
dramabox.norm_title: rejected by four claimed by my enemy hades
dramabox.description: Supreme Witch Violet sacrifices immense magic to save four supernatural lords, who fall for shapeshifter Pandora's dark tricks. They slay her spirit lynx Mona and strip all her witchcraft. Secretly guarded by Underworld Lord Hades with ancient soul magic, Violet picks him as her spouse. Once Pandora's malice is exposed, the four drown in remorse.

dramabox.title: Aelithia Returned as a Goddess
dramabox.norm_title: aelithia returned as a goddess
dramabox.description: Aelithia, born with a rare divine core, was framed by her stepmother Vessela as a curse and thrown into a forbidden abyss at age seven. For seven years she trained in secret, reforged her core, and returned to destroy the Malister family and the Archmage Council. She ended the dark reign with divine power, achieving revenge and redemption.

dramabox.title: The Merman Prince's Runaway Mate
dramabox.norm_title: the merman prince s runaway mate
dramabox.description: Hal is snatched from land by merman prince Ken and taken to the undersea kingdom, where he regains lost memories and rekindles their romance after mending old misunderstandings. Ken’s scorned fiancé Niah — a secret dark sorcerer who once tricked Hal into fleeing — plots revenge with pirate Jack to destroy the merman clan. Hal claims his birthright as palace guardian, wields the legendary trident, and helps Ken defeat their foes...

dramabox.title: Apotheosis of Elara
dramabox.norm_title: apotheosis of elara
dramabox.description: Elara, a goddess of Olympus, chose to hide her divine powers and marry into the mortal king Cedric's court as a humble orphan girl, in order to stay by his side. For years, she silently protected the kingdom from disasters, only to be met with betrayal—her husband not only impregnated his first love Mira, but his mother also constantly humiliated her.

dramabox.title: Fantastic Beasts and the Night Keeper
dramabox.norm_title: fantastic beasts and the night keeper
dramabox.description: Richard, a broke, sharp-tongued black-market vet, gets evicted from his rundown flat and is hired at an astronomical rate by the mysterious noblewoman Catherine to be the night keeper of Ashford Manor. His plan is simple: coast through the shift, collect his paycheck, and get out. But when he stumbles into a forbidden zone to save a mortally wounded Abyssal Royal Squid, he inadvertently completes the seal on an S-class calamity—and the overflow magic floods straight into him.

dramabox.title: My Dead Uncle Left Me £500M and 7 Nights to Live
dramabox.norm_title: my dead uncle left me 500m and 7 nights to live
dramabox.description: Alex, a poor painter, inherits a castle and millions with one condition: he must stay alone for 7 days. On the first night, he repairs a painting and unknowingly defeats an S-class dragon. He discovers his paintbrush can reshape reality. He faces demonic paintings, gains power, and becomes humanity's last defense against demons.

dramabox.title: The Peerless Goddess
dramabox.norm_title: the peerless goddess
dramabox.description: Hercules, a demigod, was betrayed by his father Zeus and his soul imprisoned. His sister Athena, deceived for a thousand years, discovers the truth. She becomes a goddess-slayer, fights through hell, and restores Hercules. Together they shatter the false thrones and rewrite Olympus in blood.

dramabox.title: Step Aside, I Am The Princess Of Atlantis
dramabox.norm_title: step aside i am the princess of atlantis
dramabox.description: Princess Naga of Atlantis went incognito for four years for love, willingly playing the role of an "ordinary" girl by Kraken's side. But in return, he teamed up with her own best friend Siren—physically abusing her and mocking her with cruel words: "A poor wretch like you doesn't deserve him?" Heartbroken, Naga turns around and impulsively marries a "fisherman" named Osiris—only to discover that this unremarkable man is none other than the legendary Sea King himself, and Sire

dramabox.title: Dorm Lockdown: Fangs of Terror
dramabox.norm_title: dorm lockdown fangs of terror
dramabox.description: After seeing a giant snake devour someone, Emily Hart begs the dorm supervisor to unlock the door, but Chloe Price turns everyone against her. Ignoring Emily's warning, Chloe heads to the bathhouse, where the snake attacks. As Emily fights to survive, Ms. Lewis sends Mia Lane away and locks Emily outside the electrical room, unaware another giant snake is already inside.

dramabox.title: When Lucifer Kneels for Love
dramabox.norm_title: when lucifer kneels for love
dramabox.description: After seven years of grief, fallen angel Lucifer discovers his human wife, Selene, is alive—and they have a daughter, Aurora. As Heaven, Hell, witches, and a jealous angel threaten his family, Lucifer must battle divine curses, betrayal, and his own rage to reclaim the love he lost and protect his queen.

dramabox.title: Left to Zombies, Now Their King Claims Me
dramabox.norm_title: left to zombies now their king claims me
dramabox.description: Betrayed and thrown to a zombie horde and left for dead, amnesiac Miles stumbles into Shelter Eleven-only to be locked in by Gabriel, a beautiful, terrifying mutant who calls him ""mine."" Gabriel remembers the boy Miles used to be, even when Miles remembers nothing. The monster holding him captive becomes his fiercest protector. ""Outside is hell. In here, I am God. Stay and be mine... or go out, and become one of them...

dramabox.title: Duke Ex Threw Me Away, His Uncle Made Me His Queen
dramabox.norm_title: duke ex threw me away his uncle made me his queen
dramabox.description: A half-mermaid, sold as a wife and scorned for her glowing scales, is rescued by a prince who uncovers the truth: she sacrificed her own body to save the duke who rejected her. Now, she must choose between the man who threw her away and the one who gave her back her dignity.

dramabox.title: Ancient Flame: Reborn Hope
dramabox.norm_title: ancient flame reborn hope
dramabox.description: Mocked for awakening an obsolete F-rank Flame Card, Lucas Gray discovers that fire is humanity's only weapon against a global plant apocalypse. With gifted scout Lena Blue, he uncovers a sentient root network ruled by the Mother Plant. As cities fall, Lucas inherits the ancient Flame King power and leads humanity's counterattack. After Lena sacrifices herself, he awakens the mythic World-End Flame.

dramabox.title: Soul Witch:the god demon eye
dramabox.norm_title: soul witch the god demon eye
dramabox.description: Seraphina, a god-demon symbiont, had her memories sealed and guarded the world. During divine punishment, her identity was revealed. Facing a demon invasion, she sacrificed herself to destroy the demons. Elion, the elf prince, abandoned his throne to guard her coffin, not noticing the stone coffin had quietly cracked.

dramabox.title: From Underdog Fisherman to Ocean Tycoon
dramabox.norm_title: from underdog fisherman to ocean tycoon
dramabox.description: After being dumped by a gold-digger, underdog fisherman Ethan Reed accidentally adopts a three-year-old dragon girl. To spoil her new dad, the little dragon uses divine powers to flood his nets with rare seafood and oceanic treasures. Escorted by the dragon and a cold female CEO, Ethan slaps down villains, rises to become a billionaire, and builds the world's greatest marine empire.

dramabox.title: The Lost Monster Hunter Returns
dramabox.norm_title: the lost monster hunter returns
dramabox.description: When ten-year-old Erling, the son of legendary hunter Karl, is kidnapped during a beast raid, his memories are erased with a forbidden elixir and he is replaced by another boy. Renamed Viggo, he grows up as an abused thrall while the imposter Gunnar is raised as Karl's beloved heir. Eight years later, Viggo enters the Hunter Trials to win his freedom, unaware he is fighting beside the father who has searched for him for years.

dramabox.title: Her Words Come True
dramabox.norm_title: her words come true
dramabox.description: Born with a rare Life Magic, Elara chooses silence to avoid the devastating cost of her power, earning a reputation as a mute village girl. Sold by her greedy father to the dying Duke heir Cassian as part of a prophecy, she is expected to become nothing more than a sacrificial bride.Instead, Cassian treats her with kindness, dignity, and respect. As Elara secretly uses her magic to keep him alive, a deep bond forms between them.

dramabox.title: Burning Touch of His Wings
dramabox.norm_title: burning touch of his wings
dramabox.description: Gutter girl Laila is saved by six-winged Duke Alaric, who killed her mother years ago. She plots revenge but he protects her, teaches her, and she discovers her mother chose death and entrusted her to him. They fall for each other. His fiancée arrives, forcing Alaric to whip Laila. She survives, rallies the oppressed, and returns. After a final confrontation, they reconcile and build a new world.

dramabox.title: From F-Rank Nobody to Master of Reality
dramabox.norm_title: from f rank nobody to master of reality
dramabox.description: After the apocalypse game digitizes the world, Ethan Cole awakens the hidden Concept Master class, but is labeled an F-rank loser. When the magic tide strikes, he reveals overwhelming power and builds a strange trading hub where anything can be exchanged. Hunted by global forces, Ethan uncovers a terrifying truth: Earth is a cosmic prison. He challenges its warden, reshapes the universe, and finally returns to ordinary life.

dramabox.title: When My Otome Heroes Came Alive
dramabox.norm_title: when my otome heroes came alive
dramabox.description: Game designer Eleanor is betrayed by her boyfriend and stepmother. She activates her game, and three characters—Hollis, Edmond, and Phineas—manifest as her devoted protectors. They help her destroy her enemies and expose their crimes. Soon, a mysterious force called "Blackmare" emerges, threatening her with a larger conspiracy.

dramabox.title: The Eight-Year-Old Captain
dramabox.norm_title: the eight year old captain
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole, a top aviation legend in his past life, is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. He knows the flight will crash. Trapped in a child's body, he must stop the disaster and save his father before it's too late.

dramabox.title: Frostfang Blade
dramabox.norm_title: frostfang blade
dramabox.description: Northern commander Reyne is betrayed by his deputy Cassius, left disabled and mentally impaired. He is taken in by Selena. After three years, he recovers, awakens wolf god power, gathers three relics, defeats the Martin family, and seals the ancient Nyx into a blade. But the seal is slowly weakening.

dramabox.title: Rejected Once, Revered Forever
dramabox.norm_title: rejected once revered forever
dramabox.description: Evan Hart, a hidden immortal, kills Victor Storm and saves Vera Hale, a Valkyrie. He descends to break off an engagement but is scorned by his betrothed. Vera defends him publicly and marries him instead. During a selection, his talent shocks the Marcus Vale and Darius Vane. After betrayal and Vera's near-fatal injury, Evan awakens, destroys the Darius Vane and unites with Vera.

dramabox.title: The Last Dragon Exposed the Fake Princess Who Stole Her Blood
dramabox.norm_title: the last dragon exposed the fake princess who stole her blood
dramabox.description: For five centuries, the last Dawn Dragon has guarded Asterlan`s crown. When the kingdom`s first princess in a hundred years is born, she senses the child is an impostor. As a dark conspiracy steals the true princess`s Dragonheart Blood, the dragon awakens to expose the lie, break an ancient curse, and save the royal heir.

dramabox.title: The Supreme Immortal's Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: the supreme immortal s revenge
dramabox.description: Lucian Ryder attained the peak of Grand Ascension in just decades. Threatened by the leaders of the Nine Dales, he was coerced into crippling his cultivation when they targeted his beloved Selene Frost. Refusing to surrender, Selene sacrificed herself.To bring her back, Lucian travels to Alderon Haven to claim the Longevity Lotus. He meets Claire Wynn, Selene’s long-lost younger sister. Upholding Selene’s last request, he devotes himself to protecting Claire.

dramabox.title: Ghosts Beg Me to Spare Their Lives
dramabox.norm_title: ghosts beg me to spare their lives
dramabox.description: Ling Yuan is pulled into a weird game and unlocks a ferocity system, transforming into horrors. He clears dungeons, rescues friends, kills A-class enemies, and cooperates with the Bureau. He meets a weird bride. As version 2.0 arrives, he faces a city-wide invasion.

dramabox.title: The Family That Never Was
dramabox.norm_title: the family that never was
dramabox.description: After a family dinner, elderly Helen Brooks discovers her granddaughter, daughter-in-law, and son vanish one by one after entering the bathroom. Even stranger, everyone, including her neighbors, insists they never existed and accuses Helen of being an intruder, a liar, and a dementia patient. Trapped between reality and illusion, Helen must uncover the truth hidden within her fractured memories.

dramabox.title: Nothing Stays Hidden from Me
dramabox.norm_title: nothing stays hidden from me
dramabox.description: In 1990, poor young Logan Carter rescues a mysterious black cat and gains an extraordinary gift for finding rare treasures hidden in the mountains. Starting with matsutake hunting alongside his disabled but determined father, he meets businesswoman Tessa Sloan. Together, they uncover priceless herbs, century-old ginseng, and other wonders, helping Logan rise from poverty to prosperity while leading his village to a better life.

dramabox.title: Divorced by My Wife, Revealed as a Legend
dramabox.norm_title: divorced by my wife revealed as a legend
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole, the young master of Skyfall Sect, is a martial arts prodigy skilled in mysticism and medicine. Once an orphan saved by Claire Young’s kindness, he married her to repay her and helped her small cosmetics shop with his senior sister’s support. Thinking he was a failure, Claire divorced him, unaware of his true identity. Hearing the news, his four senior sisters come to him, all wanting to marry him.

dramabox.title: The Scam That Changed My Fate
dramabox.norm_title: the scam that changed my fate
dramabox.description: After falling victim to an online romance scam, Ethan Cole drowns his sorrows—only to become bound to a celestial embryo, the embodiment of Heaven's Will. Wishing to "never be fooled again," he accidentally rewrites its divine power. When Ethan answers a bizarre scam text claiming to be Nezha, he unexpectedly gains a legendary ally. Together, they begin a journey to rewrite fate and defy the heavens.

dramabox.title: The Fool God
dramabox.norm_title: the fool god
dramabox.description: Ancient goddess Selena returns to reclaim nine sacred relics from corrupt families. With commander Kane's help, she encounters mortal sacrifices and chooses to stay, sealing the relics in a temple for all to use, rather than disappearing again.

dramabox.title: None of You Knights Deserve Me
dramabox.norm_title: none of you knights deserve me
dramabox.description: Silver Dragon Princess Sophia revokes her bond with three knights after head knight Dylan lets her nearly die to avenge his lover Vivian. Her love letter is exposed at her Ascension Ceremony ; Dylan falsely confesses to shield Vivian. Condemned by all three, Sophia erupts in half-dragon form, banishing them. Abyss Dragon heir Ashton proposes. Dylan learns Sophia saved his life—Vivian took credit. They beg forgiveness; Sophia refuses, reigning beside Ashton.

dramabox.title: Enemies With Benefits
dramabox.norm_title: enemies with benefits
dramabox.description: Viking warrior Rick and elf prince Eli are centuries-old enemies. After a battle explosion, they lose memory and are mistaken for lovers by villagers. They fall in love but later regain memory. Eli leaves, pregnant, and gives birth. Four years later, their son is kidnapped, they join forces, reconcile, and settle as a family.

dramabox.title: The Ultimate Ascendant: Power Knows No Equal
dramabox.norm_title: the ultimate ascendant power knows no equal
dramabox.description: Dorian Vale awakens in a legendary realm as a destined holy pilgrim, but an overpowered system turns him into an unrivaled force after a single beginner quest. Realizing the world's greatest prophecy is built on lies, he refuses to follow fate. By hunting monsters and villains for rewards, he grows even stronger, gathers powerful allies, and launches an all-out war to shatter destiny itself.

dramabox.title: The Little Star That Brought Us Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: the little star that brought us fortune
dramabox.description: On a snowy night, three-year-old Maisy Hayes is freezing to death when her celestial lucky spirit awakens. At the same time, Clara Reed, the desperate Princess of Northwatch Manor, rescues her. The once-glorious Northwatch Manor is now collapsing: Prince Gavin Hayes is poisoned and comatose, their eldest son is disabled and embittered, and the family is drowning in massive debts while enemies close in.

dramabox.title: Awakening: The Mortal God
dramabox.norm_title: awakening the mortal god
dramabox.description: Betrayed by the woman he loves and exiled by his own family to die, Alexis, a "worthless" mortal, survives hell to save his dying mother. In the brutal Temple Selection, Alexis fulfills a prophecy when he awakens as Zeus' true heir. He crushes elite rivals and obliterates the newly awakened Hades. Now a True God, he ventures into a deadly realm to resurrect his loved ones—unaware that a vengeful Hera is plotting his downfall. Will he conquer fate, or burn alongside Olympus?

dramabox.title: Stellar Vanguard: The Last Stand
dramabox.norm_title: stellar vanguard the last stand
dramabox.description: Earth has already fallen. After four alien civilizations unite to exterminate humanity, Adrian Knox becomes the world's only survivor. Given one last chance, he returns to the beginning of the invasion. Instead of fighting alone, he quietly shapes the people around him, turning ordinary survivors into humanity's greatest weapon—and rewriting a future once thought inevitable.

dramabox.title: Stockpiling for Doomsday: Level Up to Survive
dramabox.norm_title: stockpiling for doomsday level up to survive
dramabox.description: Five years before the apocalypse, Damon Voss is branded insane for stockpiling supplies no one believes he'll need. Locked away in a mental hospital, he waits for the end of the world. When it finally arrives, he breaks free, gathers loyal allies, farms Evolution Crystals, and rises to power. This time, he'll outlive the apocalypse—and rule it.

dramabox.title: Ragnarök: God of Spring
dramabox.norm_title: ragnar k god of spring
dramabox.description: Mocked. Exiled. Stripped of his powers by Odin. Baldur, son of Thor, was thrown away like trash. But the "weakling" just awakened the World Tree’s ancient power! Now, he’s slaughtering the World Serpent, saving his father, and storming Asgard to take back his mother. When Ragnarök hits, the arrogant gods who discarded him will beg on their knees for his salvation!

dramabox.title: The Untamable Slave - Rise of the Fallen King
dramabox.norm_title: the untamable slave rise of the fallen king
dramabox.description: Max, the Dragon Emperor, is poisoned and crippled by his wife Cassia and adoptive son Lucius, then thrown into the abyss to die. He survives, resurfaces five years later as a mute fisherman, and is forced into the gladiator pits where a duchess stakes her entire bloodline on him. Fighting his way back through the arena, Max exposes proof of the betrayal, reclaims his throne, and executes Cassia and Lucius before the entire empire.

dramabox.title: Avengers: The Blade of the Dragon Knight
dramabox.norm_title: avengers the blade of the dragon knight
dramabox.description: To investigate the massacre of her family, Gloria infiltrates the Dragon Knights. She develops a bond with the Marquis's adopted son, Cassian, and forges a soul-binding contract with the pure-blooded dragon, Cyprus. As all secrets are simultaneously unveiled, the entire kingdom's chessboard is set ablaze by dragonfire.

dramabox.title: Oh, My Karma Goddess
dramabox.norm_title: oh my karma goddess
dramabox.description: The Mountain Goddess, Ok Do-yeong, falls into a century-long slumber after her divine heart is stolen. When she finally awakens, she discovers that the scattered fragments of her heart are hidden within Lee Chan, a brilliant young heart surgeon. To reclaim her power, she has no choice but to remain by his side. As they confront dangers and long-buried secrets together, a love that transcends the boundary between goddess and human begins to bloom.

dramabox.title: Wolf Rule:Ember Reign
dramabox.norm_title: wolf rule ember reign
dramabox.description: Reborn with apocalypse memories, Loretta bonds with a despised wolf cub instead of a divine beast. The wolf grows into a golden-maned king that devours rules. In a clash, only one dynasty rises from ashes.

dramabox.title: From Mudblood to Atlantis' Owner
dramabox.norm_title: from mudblood to atlantis owner
dramabox.description: In Atlantis, only godblood mermaids may live; mudbloods are crushed at birth. Princess Rosalie is a mudblood, hidden by her mother's dark magic. On her delivery day, husband Xavier discovers the truth and kills her. Reborn, she rejects Xavier and marries a mute slave instead, mocked by all. But he is no slave—he is Pure Godblood, the rarest and most powerful bloodline in Atlantis.

dramabox.title: Necro-Station
dramabox.norm_title: necro station
dramabox.description: After the sun is destroyed, Ava, a spaceship janitor, gains powers from ancient bones. She fights parasitic creatures that turn crew into undead. She protects human embryos and her love Raine. Possessed by a demon, she resists to defeat the parasite queen, triggering self-destruction. She saves Raine and embryos but stays behind to perish with the demon.

dramabox.title: Awakened by a Kiss: The Pharaoh is My Roommate 2
dramabox.norm_title: awakened by a kiss the pharaoh is my roommate 2
dramabox.description: Ella awakens a pharaoh who has slumbered for a thousand years with an unexpected kiss. The two grow fond of each other amid cautious probing, yet they are drawn into a tangled web of ancient Egyptian curses and fate. As Season 2 unfolds, a new crisis looms: the pharaoh’s powers begin to fade, and shadowy hidden forces stir into action.

dramabox.title: The Immortal Slave
dramabox.norm_title: the immortal slave
dramabox.description: Kane, former God of War, is enslaved and stripped of magic but possesses rare anti-magic Titan blood. He dominates the arena with pure combat skill, meets fallen princess Elia, joins rebels, kills tyrant Victor, defies divine punishment, defeats void lords, and shatters the simulated universe, freeing all. He retires with friends.

dramabox.title: The Wolf Cub I Raised Tempts Me Endlessly
dramabox.norm_title: the wolf cub i raised tempts me endlessly
dramabox.description: In the post-apocalyptic year of 2360, Alphas ruled the world, leaving Omegas to hide and survive in the shadows. Yves, a cautious and enduring Omega, rescued Luke, a severely injured wolf cub, on a freezing snowy night. He poured everything he had into raising the little wolf, nurturing him with all his heart.

dramabox.title: Tides of the Deep
dramabox.norm_title: tides of the deep
dramabox.description: Siren, a saint, flees into the deep sea to escape sacrifice and is saved by the sea god Leviathan. They uncover the church's lies and fall in love. When Leviathan dies protecting her, Siren becomes the Queen of the Abyss and resurrects him. Later, they discover a cosmic eye awakening, hinting at greater danger.

dramabox.title: Crown of Redemption
dramabox.norm_title: crown of redemption
dramabox.description: Princess Garcia Hodge was once a tyrant who humiliated and abused the five consort candidates sent by different races. After a prophetic dream in which she saw humanity fall and herself executed, she awakens determined to change her fate. She inherits the “Purification and Pacification” power of the First Queen and sincerely repents to the five men — Elvin (elf prince), Kane (human prime minister’s son), Drake (dragon heir), Selene (merman prince), and Logan.

dramabox.title: Think again! That alchemist is my lost prince
dramabox.norm_title: think again that alchemist is my lost prince
dramabox.description: Fifteen years ago, a bloody rebellion erupted in the Holy Radiance Empire. Empress Victoria fled with her six-year-old son, Prince Arthur. In a desperate bid to draw away the pursuers, Arthur split the royal crest, the Star Emblem, in two. He fell off a cliff, lost his memory, and was forced to grow up among the commoners. Fifteen years later, Victoria ascended the throne as Empress and mobilized the empire's resources to find her son.

dramabox.title: The Lost Son Returns as a Demigod
dramabox.norm_title: the lost son returns as a demigod
dramabox.description: Lost in a sea storm, Heron is saved and raised as the demigod Heracles. Twenty years later, he returns as a Lord. Finding his poor parents tormented by cruel relatives and arrogant nobles, Heron conceals his true identity. He ultimately unleashes his divine wrath, stripping the oppressors of their status and wealth to protect his family.

dramabox.title: Who Is the Real Me?
dramabox.norm_title: who is the real me
dramabox.description: 2030: Mirror Tech launches “Perfect Mirror” androids. Sole tester Elena Carter gets Erin Carter—identical in looks, DNA & memory. At first, Erin brings ease and company. But Erin’s awakening breeds self-awareness and jealousy, disrupting her life and sparking crises. A battle over “the real Elena” erupts. Elena turns from reliance to defiance; Erin wavers between mimicry and selfhood. They break copy bonds, coexist, expose Mirror Tech’s secrets, unearthing the truth.

dramabox.title: The Six-Year-Old Treasure Hunter
dramabox.norm_title: the six year old treasure hunter
dramabox.description: Six-year-old Mila Grant has X-ray vision. She enters the antique world to help her dad Evan Grant. With her golden eyes, she spots fakes and finds treasures, befriending Henry Cole and Claire Hart, but earning the envy of tycoon Victor Crane. She foils his plots, defends justice, and brings Evan and Claire together. In the end, she helps her family gain wealth, love, and loyal friends, lighting up their lives with her innocence and wisdom.

dramabox.title: Five Tots' Daddy Hunt
dramabox.norm_title: five tots daddy hunt
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, Greenser witch Layla shared a fateful night with nobleman Asher Theran, resulting in the birth of quintuplets. After years in seclusion, she leaves the forest with her children to find their father when Asher begins searching for her to break a bloodline curse. As love rekindles, the family uncovers a conspiracy from the past, breaks the curse, and finds their happily ever after.

dramabox.title: Hidden Gold, Divine Powers, and My Rise to Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: hidden gold divine powers and my rise to fortune
dramabox.description: Following his father’s final wish, Ethan Reed buries his ashes in his family’s ancestral plot, unknowingly awakening a dormant golden dragon beneath the earth. Bestowed with extraordinary powers including clairvoyance and water manipulation, Ethan discovers a hidden gold mine and embarks on a path to immense wealth. As he builds his empire, he finds support in Nora Hale. Together, they defy all odds to secure his legacy and claim a life of glory.

dramabox.title: The Immortal Upgrade: Power Beyond Measure
dramabox.norm_title: the immortal upgrade power beyond measure
dramabox.description: After transmigrating into a lowly servant at Kelton's alchemy workshop, Ethan Carter spends his days cleaning herbs and discarding failed pills. With a useless mixed spiritual root, he thinks immortality is impossible—until he unlocks an unlimited fusion system. Any item can be upgraded through synthesis. Trash pills become treasures, weak skills become legendary arts, and ordinary fruits become ancient wonders.

dramabox.title: Beyond The Mortal: Save, Reload, Repeat
dramabox.norm_title: beyond the mortal save reload repeat
dramabox.description: After gaining the power to rewind time, Claire Blake rewrites her fate one save at a time. Bad start? Reload. Lose the tournament? Reload. Deadly secret realm? Reload until she claims every treasure without a scratch. Even against enemies far stronger than her, she keeps retrying until the impossible becomes possible. System, let's check the script... it's time to break the plot.

dramabox.title: Grain of Eternity
dramabox.norm_title: grain of eternity
dramabox.description: In a wasteland world ravaged by dark energy, Layla, a survivor guarding humanity’s gene bank, stumbles upon the horrifying truth: this world is nothing but a sadistic comic manipulated by capital. She is the tool‑protagonist, doomed to die a billion times in agony. The creator god Aurel, who loves her deeply, is stripped of his authority and reduced in dimension by the System for protecting her.

dramabox.title: Return to Neverland
dramabox.norm_title: return to neverland
dramabox.description: Wendy Darling, now a pragmatic mother in a failing marriage, crash-lands back in Neverland while searching for her missing son. There she finds Peter Pan aged and wounded, a ruined island, and her boy twisted into Hook’s protégé. To save her child, Wendy must reclaim the belief she abandoned—and decide if growing up means losing magic, or finding a new kind of forever.

dramabox.title: THE TYRANT'S FORBIDDEN BRIDE Cursed to Breed the Dragon King's Demon Heirs
dramabox.norm_title: the tyrant s forbidden bride cursed to breed the dragon king s demon heirs
dramabox.description: Elara is torn from her modern life into a cursed kingdom where the brutal Dragon King executes every barren bride in two moons. A mysterious system offers a deal: bear five royal heirs, and she returns to Earth.She shocks the court with her swollen belly—carrying not one, but five royal children. Branded a demon bride by a scheming concubine and corrupt augur, she wagers her life on a heavenly sign.As the tyrant’s fury softens into devotion, Elara’s resolve to leave crumble

dramabox.title: Dragon Secret Heart
dramabox.norm_title: dragon secret heart
dramabox.description: Elite policewoman Stella accidentally travels to a fantasy world ruled by dragons, becoming Ella, a lowly human maid. She discovers that the tyrant Aurelian, despite his cold exterior, is actually childish and endearing on the inside—and unexpectedly gains the ability to hear his inner thoughts.

dramabox.title: Black Feather: Stolen by the Golden God
dramabox.norm_title: black feather stolen by the golden god
dramabox.description: In the realm of Norse myth, Sifja—a handmaiden of the Black Feathers—is mistaken by Adrian, a prince of the gods, and shares a single fateful night with him, after which she gives birth to Fenrir, a child of the Golden Feather bloodline. Her jealous stepsister, Verna, usurps her identity, seizes both the infant and the sacred token, and exiles Sifja to the Shadow Realm.

dramabox.title: The Boy Without Destiny
dramabox.norm_title: the boy without destiny
dramabox.description: Cast aside as ordinary, Rowan never imagined he was born for destiny. But when the legendary chain Gleipnir chooses him, he becomes the only one capable of stopping Fenrir and the coming of Ragnarok. Now, the forgotten son must rise to save the Nine Realms.

dramabox.title: Claimed by Fire and Claw
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by fire and claw
dramabox.description: "Running from the dragon sacrifice, Lina ducks into a dark cave—only to stumble right into the cursed, blazing heat of the Dragon King, Dorian. That one wild night magically erases the cursed scar on her face and forges an unbreakable Soulbond between them: ""What you feel, I feel."" Panicked, she flees, but falls straight into the hands of her scumbag fiancé, who betrays her and sells her off to the black market.

dramabox.title: The Curse of the Midas Touch
dramabox.norm_title: the curse of the midas touch
dramabox.description: In her past life, the female lead saved a homeless man — actually the Wine God in disguise. He gave her a goblet. Drinking from it gave her the Midas Touch, but each use cost her life force. Used as a pawn by a powerhungry prince, she was exploited and ultimately killed by her jealous sister. With her last breath, she turned her sister's family to gold — and died. After her death, the Wine God revealed she was his daughter. He reversed time and gave her a second chance.

dramabox.title: Out of My Novel, Into My Heart
dramabox.norm_title: out of my novel into my heart
dramabox.description: Rejected after a disastrous blind date, Ethan Cross pours his frustration into a fantasy web novel. But when his heroine, Selene Frost, suddenly steps out of its pages and forces him to rewrite her tragic fate, everything changes. They strike a deal: he'll rewrite her story, and she'll teach him cultivation. Together, she ascends to immortality in the novel, adapts to the real world, and the two gradually fall in love as they rewrite both their destinies.

dramabox.title: Leveling Without Limits, Grinding To Godhood
dramabox.norm_title: leveling without limits grinding to godhood
dramabox.description: After transmigrating to a futuristic world, Ethan Cole awakens a powerful system that lets him master any combat skill without limits and train inside a hidden dimension where time moves faster. Born with nothing in a world overrun by monsters and dark cults, Ethan rises through relentless effort, crushing powerful foes, hunting terrifying beasts, and proving that true strength can surpass even the mightiest machines.

dramabox.title: The Apex Hunter
dramabox.norm_title: the apex hunter
dramabox.description: Eight years after slaying the dragon that threatened the Empire, legendary hunter Rayne has disappeared, living in secret as a humble blacksmith. But when a new threat emerges and the family he swore to protect is endangered, he's forced back into battle. With his true identity on the verge of being exposed, the legendary Apex Hunter must embrace his destiny one last time.

dramabox.title: The Invincible Blacksmith
dramabox.norm_title: the invincible blacksmith
dramabox.description: Young blacksmith Kane journeys to Arandil to fulfill his father's dying wish—marrying Princess Grace—only to be scorned and rejected. When the beastkin army lays siege, Kane reveals breathtaking swordsmanship, defeating their champions one by one. As his true identity as the legendary Sword Master comes to light, he must rescue Grace from captivity, confront his father's killer, and prove that honor and love transcend birthright.

dramabox.title: The Dragon King's Succubus Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon king s succubus bride
dramabox.description: Sent to seduce the Dragon King Xavier, succubus Seraphina recognizes that he is the man who saved her life. She volunteers as his bride, and as passion grows, she learns his secret: cursed for saving her, Xavier will die unless he finds true love before the next full moon. When a rival exposes her real identity, Xavier dumps her yet comes to save her at the execution.

dramabox.title: Heads Will Roll! She's Marie Antoinette
dramabox.norm_title: heads will roll she s marie antoinette
dramabox.description: When Holy Roman Empress Marie returns to Versailles after years away, she expects to reunite with the man she once loved. Instead, she is publicly humiliated, betrayed by her fiancé, and drawn into a ruthless court where loyalty is bought, love is tested, and every smile hides a knife. As a mysterious prince offers an unexpected alliance, Marie must decide whether to reclaim her heart, or her throne.

dramabox.title: No More Limits, Above All Realms
dramabox.norm_title: no more limits above all realms
dramabox.description: I was once the weakest disciple of Skyveil Sect, spending ten thousand years in seclusion to reach an impossible limit. When I emerge, my sect lies in ruins. I crush the realm's strongest experts with ease, and the sect hails me as its savior. Fine. Skyveil Sect is under my protection now. But when the hidden mastermind unleashes an ancient relic, it reveals a message from my master: "Had enough fun? Come home.

dramabox.title: Plagueborn: Wings of Doom
dramabox.norm_title: plagueborn wings of doom
dramabox.description: Branded as nothing more than a worthless Plague Dragon, Rylan Drake is bound in a life-sharing pact with his master, Eva Stone. Hunted by the Stone family's schemes, Roswyn assassins, and enemies far beyond his level, Rylan fights back by evolving through devouring and wielding plague as his greatest weapon. With every battle, he shatters prejudice, protects Eva, and stands between Solaia and destruction.

dramabox.title: The Beastmaster Dad: Legends Answer My Call
dramabox.norm_title: the beastmaster dad legends answer my call
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Ethan Carter and his daughter Mia were abandoned in the wilderness, where he awakened a god-tier beast-taming system and raised ordinary animals into legendary SSS-ranked guardians. Now he returns with an unstoppable army, crushing anyone who threatens his family. But when the wife who vanished without a word suddenly reappears, Ethan must protect his loved ones with the ultimate power of beast mastery.

dramabox.title: Supreme Spirit: The God Above Gods
dramabox.norm_title: supreme spirit the god above gods
dramabox.description: Once the sovereign of all gods, Victor Crown spends countless lifetimes searching for his lost daughter. When he awakens as the Spirit Guardian summoned by his daughter, the academy dismisses him as its weakest soul. But when a prodigy summons a mighty god, Victor looks up and says, "Get down here." To protect his daughter, he begins reclaiming the power that once made him supreme.

dramabox.title: The Eternal Conqueror: None Shall Defy
dramabox.norm_title: the eternal conqueror none shall defy
dramabox.description: After transmigrating to the Aurel Empire, Damon Carter befriends Emperor Victor and remains unchanged for thirty-five years. As the empire falls and Victor nears death, Damon buries him on the battlefield of Barrowmere, forging his body with the resentment of countless fallen souls. Victor is reborn as an apex undead, and together they slaughter every enemy to build an empire that will stand for eternity.
