dramabox.title: The Stolen Heir
dramabox.norm_title: the stolen heir
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Duke Reinhardt Augustus spent a night with half-elf Sylvia by a moonlit lake, and she later bore a daughter, Liana. Sylvia's half-sister Veronica used her lost necklace to impersonate her and passed off her own son as the Duke's heir. Five years later, Sylvia brings Liana to the capital for better magical education. Reinhardt, suspicious of his false heir, hires Sylvia as an apothecary.

dramabox.title: Mock Me Harder, Make Me Stronger
dramabox.norm_title: mock me harder make me stronger
dramabox.description: After waking up in the cultivation world, Ethan Cole becomes a low-ranking disciple of the Silverbrook Sect. Everything changes when he unlocks a bizarre system that grows stronger with every insult thrown his way. The more he's mocked, the more unstoppable he becomes. Rising from an overlooked nobody to a legendary prodigy, Ethan crushes powerful foes, defeats evil, and shakes the cultivation world to its core.

dramabox.title: The Alpha King’s Substitute Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha king s substitute bride
dramabox.description: In an era when humans and werewolves forged sacred covenants, the royal human houses of the Western Continent drafted a marriage treaty to secure peace between the two races. The eldest daughter of a duke, who was meant to wed the werewolf prince, fled the wedding at the last minute.

dramabox.title: The Beggar King A Greek Curse
dramabox.norm_title: the beggar king a greek curse
dramabox.description: After being imprisoned by Zeus for three ages, Titan heir Orion Titanos falls to the mortal world with the mind of a child. Rescued by Argos priestess Elena, he lives as her seemingly foolish live-in husband while secretly restoring his divine powers. As enemies force Elena to end their marriage, Orion awakens his true Titan form, crushes every foe, protects the woman he loves, and forges a new order.

dramabox.title: Survival Supermarket in Apocalypse
dramabox.norm_title: survival supermarket in apocalypse
dramabox.description: When the apocalypse begins, Luna unlocks an interstellar supermarket system that exchanges zombie crystals for survival supplies while protecting customers with an energy barrier. Together with AI assistant Xiao Jiu and trusted allies, she expands her business, fights mutant creatures and zombie hordes, and helps restore peace, turning her supermarket into humanity's symbol of hope.

dramabox.title: Tarot Relics: High Priestess Rising
dramabox.norm_title: tarot relics high priestess rising
dramabox.description: Two thousand years after the ancient seals imprisoning the 72 Demon Gods begin to fail, orphan Lilwyn discovers she is the chosen vessel of the High Priestess, one of the sacred Major Arcana Tarot cards. Haunted by voices from every antique she touches, her fate changes when she meets the mysterious librarian Colin, whose presence silences the whispers. As demons led by the escaped Buer hunt the sacred Tarot holders, Lilwyn awakens her true power.

dramabox.title: The Dragon King Chose the Wrong Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon king chose the wrong bride
dramabox.description: In this life, the female protagonist is the last bearer of the true dragon bloodline. Her legitimate elder sister, who looks exactly like her, usurps her identity, marries the Dragon King, and becomes queen. Their mother is brutally murdered as a result. But only the true dragon bloodline can withstand the Dragon King's blood, give birth to a true dragon heir, and defeat the evil Cold King.

dramabox.title: Viking Dragon Queen
dramabox.norm_title: viking dragon queen
dramabox.description: This is the story of Eleanor, princess of the Frostwolf Clan, who rises from a despised ordinary apprentice to become the strongest dragon rider and the wife of a legendary chieftain. Eleanor is born with the rare ability to communicate with dragons. She is intelligent and resilient, yet always keeps a low profile.

dramabox.title: Claimed by the Tentacle King
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by the tentacle king
dramabox.description: Aria, a bankrupt socialite, was put up for auction by her gambler fiancé as collateral. In that moment of desperation, she accidentally awakened Casper, a deep‑sea sea monster. He strangled the gambler, then took Aria away, believing her to be the “pearl” he had been searching for over a thousand years. This hidden global tycoon imprisoned her aboard a luxurious yacht, unleashing a possessive, obsessive love.

dramabox.title: Abyss of Betrayal: The Throne of Darkness
dramabox.norm_title: abyss of betrayal the throne of darkness
dramabox.description: When the Demon Lord ravages the world, Gael Benson, the eldest disciple of Serenade Sect, ventures alone to seal away the evil. Before he leaves, his master promises him his daughter's hand in marriage and the leadership of the sect if he returns alive. A thousand years later, Gael finally comes home, only to be scorned and cast aside by the very sect he sacrificed everything to protect. Betrayed and disillusioned, he vows to make them pay.

dramabox.title: Definitely Not The Dragon God
dramabox.norm_title: definitely not the dragon god
dramabox.description: Aris has spent his life as an academy's lowest servant, cursed with blood that makes every dragon fear him. But when a drop of that blood hatches a legendary dragon egg, his life is turned upside down. Hunted by powerful enemies and burdened with a destiny he never asked for, Aris must uncover the truth before the world does.

dramabox.title: The Bride of Black Harbor
dramabox.norm_title: the bride of black harbor
dramabox.description:
In Black Harbor, a chilling legend haunts the fog-shrouded coast: on stormy nights, a monster rises from beneath the Blackcliff Cliffs to claim dying brides.
On her wedding day, Evelyn Ashford was betrayed by her husband and pushed into the sea. A year later, Evelyn returned with the mysterious "Black Dragon Duke" Dante, who was feared throughout the harbor. As darkness closes in, can these two broken souls save each other?

dramabox.title: Now His Secret Is My Weapon
dramabox.norm_title: now his secret is my weapon
dramabox.description: After a failed overdose, housewife Sophia wakes up in her husband Matthew’s body—and he’s stuck in hers.She fights his battles at work, destroys his mistress Christy, and turns his career around. He suffers her monster‑in‑law Janet and the cruel weight of domestic life. But when cheating accusations and secrets ignite a full‑blown crisis, they realize swapping bodies might be the least of their problems.

dramabox.title: The Cursed Forest God Worships Me
dramabox.norm_title: the cursed forest god worships me
dramabox.description: Chloe, a Hollywood A-list actress, was betrayed by her husband and buried alive. Her blood awakened Silas, an ancient Dark Druid who had slumbered for a thousand years. She offered her soul in exchange for the power of revenge, making a high-profile comeback to reclaim everything that was hers. The two discovered that they shared a fated bond stretching back to ancient Rome.

dramabox.title: The Gift Bride of a Mafia Don
dramabox.norm_title: the gift bride of a mafia don
dramabox.description: Raven is given by her father as a "gift" to mafia don Lorenzo, who ignores her and lets his staff bully her. But Raven fights back cleverly, and her grit slowly wins Lorenzo's cold heart. Just as love blooms, her childhood sweetheart Cassian plots to take her away, while Lorenzo's jealous old flame Trisha returns to destroy her. To protect Raven, Lorenzo risks his life and gives up his power—and Raven finally realizes her true feelings.

dramabox.title: My Demon Lord, Your Shepherd Girl Has Run Away Again
dramabox.norm_title: my demon lord your shepherd girl has run away again
dramabox.description: Abandoned on an island by her father, King John, Ingrid is recalled as her stepmother Martha and stepsister Lilith covet her betrothal to Lucifer, King of Hell. Scorned as an ignorant shepherdess, she secretly speaks to all things and wields great healing power. Lucifer disrupts her revenge: she once hid him, unaware of his identity, then fled. Seeing through her act, he grips her chin and claims her as his own. This time, he won't let her escape.

dramabox.title: Walker Love Tale
dramabox.norm_title: walker love tale
dramabox.description: When the apocalypse strikes suddenly after school, Mia saves a stranger—only to be wounded by the very person she rescued. On the verge of death, a graceful figure steps through the zombie horde: the Zombie King, whose crimson eyes lock onto her and command, "Come with me." To her shock, this fearsome king is Damian—who has secretly loved her for years. Even more bizarre, his elegant noble parents greet her politely as "daughter-in-law" and offer her raw meat.

dramabox.title: Shared Pain With The Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: shared pain with the billionaire
dramabox.description: Sofia and Lucas—the hidden heir to the Sterling Group—enter a whirlwind marriage bound by a shared-pain connection. Lucas secretly protects her, but when his identity is exposed, old family grudges and misunderstandings plunge their marriage into crisis. Villains Chad and Bianca fabricate false material to seize power, colluding with Sofia's mother in a conspiracy. Sofia refuses to rely on the wealthy family—she holds a press conference to clear her name.

dramabox.title: Mr.CEO, your mute wife called
dramabox.norm_title: mr ceo your mute wife called
dramabox.description: To avenge the car accident that destroyed her life eight years ago, Chris disguises herself as a mute and marries Nathan Sterling—the illegitimate son of the Sterling family—as a substitute bride. She uses a voice-changing phone to pose as a kidnapper and carry out her revenge—unaware that Nathan has long seen through her disguise, and that he is actually the president of MART Entertainment, the very man she has been secretly investigating.

dramabox.title: Flash Marriage Sweet Love
dramabox.norm_title: flash marriage sweet love
dramabox.description: To save her late grandmother's bakery, Lila marries a stranger named Silas in a paper-only deal—both hiding secrets. He carries her flour, stands by her side, but never reveals who he really is. Until the dessert gala, when a rival frames her in front of the entire city. Silas steps onto the stage, and the room goes silent: he's Sinclair—the most powerful man in the city. A contract marriage, a twenty-year fate sealed by a lemon tart.

dramabox.title: The Male Slave is a Girl: The Lion King's Fated Mate
dramabox.norm_title: the male slave is a girl the lion king s fated mate
dramabox.description: Disguised as a man to survive as a human slave, Rowan unexpectedly awakens a dormant Spirit Bloodline, saving Lion King Kairos from a beast-curse consuming him from within. Caught in a relentless push-and-pull of desire and defiance, the two fall in love across the boundary of species. Together they shatter the Wolf Clan's conspiracy, and Rowan rises from slave to Lion Queen, commanding the submission of all beasts.

dramabox.title: The Alpha's Runaway Luna
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha s runaway luna
dramabox.description: After a forbidden night with Alpha King Damian, abused Omega Ivy discovers she’s pregnant—only to be sold as a sacrificial bride by her own family. When her vicious stepsister steals Damian’s royal ring and claims to be his destined Luna, Ivy runs for her life. But Damian has spent five months hunting for the woman he can’t forget… and the heir she doesn’t know belongs to a king.

dramabox.title: CEO Daddy, Break My Mommy Out!
dramabox.norm_title: ceo daddy break my mommy out
dramabox.description: Billionaire Tyler Vance survives life-threatening injuries thanks to a blood donation from young Lily. When he publicly promises to repay her, she stuns everyone by calling him Dad and begging him to save her mother. Her plea leads Tyler to Serena Sumner, the woman from his past, now trapped in a psychiatric hospital. But bringing Serena home is only the beginning: someone wants her silenced, and she may never forgive the secret that cost them eight years.

dramabox.title: Secretly Dating the Billionaire Dad of My Mean Bully
dramabox.norm_title: secretly dating the billionaire dad of my mean bully
dramabox.description: Sarah catches her boyfriend cheating with rich mean girl Grace. She sleeps with billionaire CEO Ryan by mistake, thinking he's a male escort. She becomes his intern at Smith Group. Grace bullies her, unaware Sarah is the woman her father loves. Ryan protects her. John and Grace scheme repeatedly—all fail. Wedding-day car crash reveals Grace isn't Ryan's real daughter. Sarah rises from ugly duckling to ruling the empire at his side.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Games with My Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden games with my stepbrother
dramabox.description: Following his father's death, William went to live with his mother and was forced to see his arch‑rival stepbrother every day. Worse still, their secrets were exposed to each other on the very first day of living together. The newly‑arrived William soon became his stepbrother's plaything. Not only was he blackmailed by the latter, but they also got caught up in a cat‑and‑mouse game of chase and evasion.

dramabox.title: Privilege Supreme
dramabox.norm_title: privilege supreme
dramabox.description: The chaebol heir Alaric was drugged at a party by his assistant but was unexpectedly saved and got involved with part-time server Elias. Alaric offered to support him, but Elias refused. Later, Elias became his assistant after a car accident and holding evidence of a conspiracy. Spending so much time together, they developed feelings, but Elias was forced to leave quietly due to pressure from Alaric's stepmother involving family and business.

dramabox.title: Accidentally Pregnant By The Eagle Eye
dramabox.norm_title: accidentally pregnant by the eagle eye
dramabox.description: At 35, Joyce May visits a fertility clinic to freeze her eggs, only to become accidentally pregnant by billionaire security CEO Zach Langston. Determined to raise their son alone, Joyce resists Zach as he forces his way into their lives. But jealous exes, a contract marriage, and a kidnapping draw them closer. When Zach risks everything to protect Joyce and their child, their accidental family may finally become real.

dramabox.title: Beneath the Beggar’s Dust, the Archmage Supreme I Married
dramabox.norm_title: beneath the beggar s dust the archmage supreme i married
dramabox.description: Once the greatest mage alive, Lysander Frostbane was betrayed, poisoned, and silenced. His lover stole his power, his friend took his fame. Now he wanders as a mute carnival trickster, wanting only to fade into obscurity. Then a runaway wolf-princess crashes into his life. Together they run, bicker, and survive. He chose to be nothing. For her, he'll become everything.

dramabox.title: Hear Dragon Tongues, Rule The Empire
dramabox.norm_title: hear dragon tongues rule the empire
dramabox.description: Abandoned at birth and raised as a lowly servant, Gina has no idea she is the true Dragon Saintess—until she discovers she can speak Draconic and hear every beast's voice. When the feared Dragon Emperor Eric chooses her over the kingdom's beloved "Saintess," Gina uncovers a twenty-year conspiracy that stole her bloodline and throne. With enemies closing in and an empire at war, can a servant girl reclaim her destiny—and rule beside the dragon who chose her?

dramabox.title: The Duke's Living Cure
dramabox.norm_title: the duke s living cure
dramabox.description: Sold at auction as nothing more than a living blood bag, silver-blooded Noah is bought for a fortune by the feared half-machine Duke Victor—the very monster his blood can keep alive. Their desperate bargain soon becomes a life bond. But when the truth is revealed that Noah was never meant to be a cure, Victor faces an impossible choice—save himself by sacrificing Noah, or lose everything to protect the one person who taught a monster how to be human. Which will he choose?

dramabox.title: Oops, I Tamed the Commander Everyone Dreaded
dramabox.norm_title: oops i tamed the commander everyone dreaded
dramabox.description: On a sandy planet where humans live at the bottom, Lyra enters the Obsidian Palace for Kael the Commander's mate test to repay his boyfriend Ethan's gambling debts, only to discover she's the only fated mate to Kael. After that, Lyra foils the plot hatched by Serena, a scheming heiress to a great house, to destroy her, severs her ties with the once kind but now hard-hearted Ethan, and stabilizes Kael's dying star core successfully, being the only one he obeys on the planet.

dramabox.title: Spoiled By My Husband's Enemy
dramabox.norm_title: spoiled by my husband s enemy
dramabox.description: After sacrificing her racing career for her injured husband, Lily Carter is betrayed by him and his mistress. She walks away, returns to the track, and teams up with racing legend Lane Harrison. As she fights to reclaim her championship and uncover the truth, Lily finds new love—and leaves her past in the dust.

dramabox.title: A Dare to Kiss My Bad Boy
dramabox.norm_title: a dare to kiss my bad boy
dramabox.description: Avery Parker transfers to elite Crestwood School hoping to reunite with her childhood crush, Nathan. Instead, a humiliating accident makes her the target of campus gossip and brings her into constant conflict with Jaxson Hale, the school's notorious bad boy. As bullying, secrets, and rivalries unravel, Avery discovers Nathan isn't who she imagined, while Jax's unexpected loyalty challenges everything she believes about love, trust, and second chances.

dramabox.title: Mermaid’s Broken Vow
dramabox.norm_title: mermaid s broken vow
dramabox.description: Fifteen years ago, the mermaid princess Miranda saved a drowning boy named Arthur. At his invitation, she gave up her fish tail and came to the human world, where Arthur swore he would never abandon her. Ten years later, seeking to advance his career, Arthur proposed to Isabella, the heiress of a financial conglomerate. He also tore off Miranda's royal scale—the one that protected her heart—as a gift for his new lover, causing Miranda to lose their child. Betrayed and heartbr

dramabox.title: Hidden Queen of Chaos: Secret of the Light Tribe
dramabox.norm_title: hidden queen of chaos secret of the light tribe
dramabox.description: Bred with mighty Chaos magic and raised by Duncan, Irene pretends to be a helpless Muggle servant to find her family in the pure-blood-dominating Light Tribe. Separated from her mother Morgana by tyrant uncle Victor years ago, she gradually reveals her power while saving Leon repeatedly.She frees her cursed mother, crushes treasonous elders, stops corrupted Chloe and conquers invading Abyss Lord Samael.

dramabox.title: The Snake Lord's Virgin Boy
dramabox.norm_title: the snake lord s virgin boy
dramabox.description: Clay, the youngest and coldest genius physician in the Veperian Empire, is known as the "Right Hand of God." Obsessed with poisons and forbidden formulas, he despises desire and emotional weakness. Tasked with creating a potion to suppress the notorious Serpent King Silas's devastating heat cycle, Clay accidentally tastes his own creation—only to discover that it is not a cure at all, but a dangerous elixir that unleashes the deepest desires hidden within the soul.

dramabox.title: The Trillionaire Brother`s Pampered Kitten
dramabox.norm_title: the trillionaire brother s pampered kitten
dramabox.description: Evangeline Valerius, a pampered white cat princess, is spoiled by her trillionaire brother Dominic. When rival Brandy Vane and the Obsidian matriarch try to poison her with onion and torture her with shock-cuffs, Dominic rescues her and destroys both families financially. Evangeline publicly exposes their crimes, leading to Brandy's imprisonment and the Obsidians' collapse. Rejecting the repentant Asher Obsidian, she keeps loyal attendants Tristan and Leo.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire's Secret Bride Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire s secret bride strikes back
dramabox.description: Gavin West secretly married Claire Carter and they have a daughter. While Gavin is away on business, his younger brother helps an imposter impersonate his wife to bully Claire and frame her daughter. Facing continuous framed-up scandals, fake charities, and public backlash, Claire strikes back with her true identity and exposes the imposters. When Gavin finally returns, he defeats the conspirators, clears her name, and proudly reveals their marriage to the world.

dramabox.title: Avengers: A Walk to Forever
dramabox.norm_title: avengers a walk to forever
dramabox.description: Rebecca, a quiet Harvard student, unexpectedly reconnects with Hudson, the boy she has secretly loved for years. Their chance reunion blossoms into a heartfelt romance as they navigate personal challenges and decide on a future together.

dramabox.title: Straight Until Tempted by My Hockey Rival
dramabox.norm_title: straight until tempted by my hockey rival
dramabox.description: Ice hockey rivals Asher and Quinn are forced to share a room while competing for Team USA's captaincy. Off the ice, both secretly fall for each anonymous online crush—only to discover it's each other. As rivalry turns into attraction, misunderstandings, family pressure, and fierce competition test their bond. In the end, they realize their greatest opponent has always been the one they can't bear to lose.

dramabox.title: The Swapped Bride of Dionysus
dramabox.norm_title: the swapped bride of dionysus
dramabox.description: Two Cretan princesses, Ariadne and Phaedra, get a second life after Dionysus reverses time to undo the past tragedy. In their first life, Phaedra evades the flawed Theseus and flees in disgrace, while Ariadne becomes queen and is killed by the resentful Phaedra. Reborn, Phaedra claims the royal marriage and forces Ariadne to wed a beggar. Yet the beggar is Dionysus in disguise.

dramabox.title: Scoring With My Brother's Rival
dramabox.norm_title: scoring with my brother s rival
dramabox.description: If there's one thing in this world Jenny would never do, it's defy her brother Samuel. But then Javier appears—the arrogant, too-hot-for-his-own-good soccer star who's her brother's worst enemy—and shatters all of good-girl Jenny's principles. Faced with Javier's seduction and "rescue" attempts, Jenny finds it hard to say no to him. This man who bursts into her world teaches her how to lie to her own brother.

dramabox.title: Cover Story
dramabox.norm_title: cover story
dramabox.description: In a quirky high school, two werewolf boys bond over a book and stumble into a sweet, unexpected romance. As they flip through life's pages together, they discover that love, like a good story, gets better with every chapter.

dramabox.title: Tempted by My Best Friend’s Billionaire Dad
dramabox.norm_title: tempted by my best friend s billionaire dad
dramabox.description: Lisa Moon, an orphaned law student, takes a yacht waitress job and meets Christian Grey, her best friend' s estranged billionaire father. Despite their differences, their attraction grows as he protects her and hires her as his assistant. But when his ex-wife sparks a scandal, Christian denies their romance to protect Lisa. Heartbroken, she leaves—until he returns a year later to reveal the truth and seek a second chance.

dramabox.title: The Love That Found Its Way Home
dramabox.norm_title: the love that found its way home
dramabox.description: Clara Wells loved Evan Hale, never knowing he was a dynasty heir. Their twins was born premature. Evan's father saved the son, declared the girl dead, and told Evan both were gone. Years later, Clara raised their daughter in secret. The truth came out. Evan found her—not across oceans, but nearby. The distance collapsed. Two hearts beat as one. With two children, they leave the past behind. No more distance. Just a family, finally home.

dramabox.title: Double Patty
dramabox.norm_title: double patty
dramabox.description: Hyun-ji, an aspiring news anchor struggling to find a job, meets Kang-woo, a former wrestling prospect who now works at a burger restaurant. As they share their challenges and dreams, the two gradually encourage each other to pursue their goals.

dramabox.title: Hidden Child I Stole the CEO’s Heart Again
dramabox.norm_title: hidden child i stole the ceo s heart again
dramabox.description: Six years ago, Luna Vance walked away from the love of her life after her family suddenly fell apart. Pregnant and alone, she gave birth to their daughter, Mila, who was later diagnosed with a serious heart condition.Now a self-made tech billionaire, Felix Crawford never expected to see Luna again — until he runs into her working at an exclusive nightclub, struggling to support their sick child on her own.

dramabox.title: Contract Lover
dramabox.norm_title: contract lover
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, ordinary girl Emily was framed at an engagement party and had an unexpected encounter with a mysterious man. She got pregnant and was expelled from her family, raising her son Jack alone while struggling to make ends meet. Seven years later, Emily works at a hotel to support her son and reunites with the mysterious man—top wealthy CEO Henry.

dramabox.title: As You Like It
dramabox.norm_title: as you like it
dramabox.description: Dessert shop owner Emily falls for underground boxing ace Noah after he rescues her. Bonded over homemade macarons, the two build a sweet romance. When a rival's foul play leaves Noah critically injured and hopeless, he ends their relationship. Yet Emily stands by him through his painful recovery. Fully healed, Noah returns to claim the championship. He later reduces his fights to run their dessert shop with Emily.

dramabox.title: Delivered by Destiny (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: delivered by destiny dubbed
dramabox.description: Certain she is about to marry her childhood sweetheart, Nam Yun-ju arrives in her wedding dress only to discover she has been set up by Kim Ye-na. Yun-ju impulsively proposes to delivery driver Han Do-yun, who, surprisingly, accepts. What she does not know is that he is actually the CEO of a powerful corporation. As Yun-ju faces sabotage, threats, and kidnapping attempts at work, Do-yun quietly protects her while she fights to rebuild her life.

dramabox.title: Second Chance in Serendipity
dramabox.norm_title: second chance in serendipity
dramabox.description: On his first day back from abroad, Noah Lang falls into a trap set up by his stepbrother, Max Lang, narrowly escaping a fatal car accident. Thankfully, a passerby named Susan Scott selflessly saves his life. Determined to repay her kindness, Noah searches tirelessly to find her. When they finally reunite, it turns out to be Susan's worst day—she has just been betrayed by her best friend, Yolanda Hall, and her boyfriend, Ian Baker.

dramabox.title: Love Through All Seasons
dramabox.norm_title: love through all seasons
dramabox.description: Successful lawyer Jade Blanc lives by discipline and control—until a sudden medical diagnosis and relentless family pressure push her to the edge. One impulsive night in a bar, she sleeps with Bryce Hogan, a charming stranger far younger than her, believing it will end there. It doesn’t.

dramabox.title: Acting for Real: He Fell First
dramabox.norm_title: acting for real he fell first
dramabox.description: To escape a mountain of debt, Daisy enters a high-stakes secret deal with the powerful tycoon Julian Sterling. The terms: a one-year "contract marriage" where Daisy must play the flawless socialite wife. As she navigates his complex family web and high-pressure business world, the boundary between acting and reality begins to blur. What started as a cold transaction turns into a deep, fated passion as the billionaire falls first for his pretend bride.

dramabox.title: Move to Countryside, Marry a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: move to countryside marry a billionaire
dramabox.description: Newly graduated nurse Louise marries Troy in place of her adoptive sister to save her dying adoptive father, believing him to be an ugly rural farmer. She is shocked to find him young, handsome, and secretly a billionaire hiding in the countryside. Their three-month contract marriage turns real as Louise’s kindness wins his heart. After her sister’s scheme to steal him is exposed, the two overcome misunderstandings and villains, finally falling in love truly.

dramabox.title: The CEO's Secret Lover(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo s secret lover dubbed
dramabox.description: One night, LS Corp intern Han Ji Eun gets drunk and has a one-night stand with the company's CEO, Bae Seo Jun. She flees in panic but accidentally leaves behind her friend Oh Yun Ju's resume. Seizing the opportunity, Yun Ju takes her place to stay by Seo Jun's side, while Ji Eun becomes his secretary due to her plain appearance. As Seo Jun grows suspicious, Yun Ju schemes against Ji Eun to keep the secret hidden.

dramabox.title: Delivered by Destiny
dramabox.norm_title: delivered by destiny
dramabox.description: Certain she is about to marry her childhood sweetheart, Nam Yun-ju arrives in her wedding dress only to discover she has been set up by Kim Ye-na. Yun-ju impulsively proposes to delivery driver Han Do-yun, who, surprisingly, accepts. What she does not know is that he is actually the CEO of a powerful corporation. As Yun-ju faces sabotage, threats, and kidnapping attempts at work, Do-yun quietly protects her while she fights to rebuild her life.

dramabox.title: Brother’s Rival, My Secret Lover(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: brother s rival my secret lover dubbed
dramabox.description: Kind-hearted Cha Eunhye transfers to the city. Her older brother warns her to stay away from bad men, especially rich and handsome ones like his rival, Bak Seonghun. She swears to stay away, but as she is a novice in romance, she struggles to resist his charm. Meanwhile, he's intrigued that she seems immune to him.

dramabox.title: After Prison, Falling for the Billionaire Single Dad
dramabox.norm_title: after prison falling for the billionaire single dad
dramabox.description: Framed by her stepfather after a one-night encounter with the CEO, Grace is imprisoned and separated from her child. She rebuilds her life as a cleaner at the CEO's company, unaware that he is secretly raising the child that she thought was dead. As they grow closer and fall in love, the truth behind her past slowly reveals itself – that the child he's raising was hers!

dramabox.title: Twin Matchmakers: Billionaire Dad's Love Quest
dramabox.norm_title: twin matchmakers billionaire dad s love quest
dramabox.description: After a one-night stand, Melody found herself pregnant and abandoned by her family. She endured the hardship of giving birth to twins, a boy and a girl, only to be told by the nurse that they had passed away. Six years later, while working at a shoe store, she was harassed by the manager. In desperation, she lied about being married.

dramabox.title: Escape with Boss's Baby
dramabox.norm_title: escape with boss s baby
dramabox.description:
Hermione, a genius computer doctor hiding her billionaire identity, works as Chris’s assistant and secretly loves him. She secretly saves his hacked company as the legendary Dr. Tea. But Chris gets engaged to Lucy, who falsely claims to be Dr. Tea.
Heartbroken and pregnant, Hermione leaves. She later returns as the wealthy Garcia heiress. Chris pursues her, uncovers Lucy’s lies, and at the wedding, exposes the truth, rejects Lucy, and proposes to Hermione.

dramabox.title: Keeping His Baby and His Heart
dramabox.norm_title: keeping his baby and his heart
dramabox.description: When janitor Bella Hart is drugged and ends up hiding on billionaire Austin Blaze's private jet, one wild night leaves her pregnant with the only heir of a man who thought he'd never have children. Now he's pulling her into his luxurious world, and he'll protect her and the baby with everything he has.

dramabox.title: Love Survives the Lie
dramabox.norm_title: love survives the lie
dramabox.description: After a passionate night between Shea Lacy and Ian Jurd, Shea's sister, Gigi Lacy, impersonates her as Ian's one-night stand partner. Six years later, Shea becomes Ian's legal counsel, and over time, they fall in love. Fearing that Shea might take her place as Ian's lover, Gigi frequently attempts to sabotage their relationship. However, Ian always intervenes just in time, preventing Shea from suffering any harm or misunderstanding.

dramabox.title: Sex Education By My Best Friend
dramabox.norm_title: sex education by my best friend
dramabox.description: After a humiliating party, college student Emma turns to her childhood friend Chase, a charming playboy, to help rebuild her confidence. They agree to a simple rule, no kissing, but as they grow closer, feelings begin to develop. When the rule is broken, Emma must choose between the crush she once chased and the love that has been in front of her all along.

dramabox.title: From Mail-Order Bride To Billionaire's Wife
dramabox.norm_title: from mail order bride to billionaire s wife
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her family and boyfriend, Anjelica marries as a mail-order bride to Eric, who appears to be a poor Montana farmer but is actually the CEO of the Hawkins Group. Under Eric's protection, she step-by-step counterattacks those who have hurt her.

dramabox.title: BillionHeir's Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: billionheir s obsession
dramabox.description: Two powerful brothers fall for the same woman inside a ruthless old-money dynasty. As their forbidden love triangle unravels hidden crimes, shocking betrayals, and a stepmother's deadly schemes, one question remains-when the truth comes out, who will survive?

dramabox.title: Brother’s Rival, My Secret Lover
dramabox.norm_title: brother s rival my secret lover
dramabox.description: Kind-hearted Cha Eunhye transfers to the city. Her older brother warns her to stay away from bad men, especially rich and handsome ones like his rival, Bak Seonghun. She swears to stay away, but as she is a novice in romance, she struggles to resist his charm. Meanwhile, he's intrigued that she seems immune to him.

dramabox.title: Taming Mr. Champion
dramabox.norm_title: taming mr champion
dramabox.description: Rita, a minor actress, was cheated by her boyfriend. At the same time, Mrs. Nelson was also troubled by Maggie, a scheming woman around her son, a famous racing driver. The two women, who were both troubled, hit it off and started a cooperative relationship. In order to treat her grandmother's illness, Rita accepted Mrs. Nelson's commission and pretended to be him fiancée to pursue Reginald's and destroy his relationship with Maggie.

dramabox.title: Craving My Brother's Best Friend
dramabox.norm_title: craving my brother s best friend
dramabox.description: After accidentally emailing a steamy fanfiction to her new roommate—who happens to be her brother's best friend—Alison must navigate rising sexual tension and her brother's strict "Bro Code" to get the guy of her dreams.

dramabox.title: Mafia's Tender Torture
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s tender torture
dramabox.description: Vesper, who is determined to raise money to save her father, finds Raymond, the boss of the Hell Gang, to become his contracted lover. However, Vesper doesn't know that Raymond has been secretly in love with her for many years. How can they overcome the misunderstandings between money and love...

dramabox.title: The CEO's Secret Lover
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo s secret lover
dramabox.description: One night, LS Corp intern Han Ji Eun gets drunk and has a one-night stand with the company's CEO, Bae Seo Jun. She flees in panic but accidentally leaves behind her friend Oh Yun Ju's resume. Seizing the opportunity, Yun Ju takes her place to stay by Seo Jun's side, while Ji Eun becomes his secretary due to her plain appearance. As Seo Jun grows suspicious, Yun Ju schemes against Ji Eun to keep the secret hidden.

dramabox.title: Boss, Your Ex-Con Bride Is Back
dramabox.norm_title: boss your ex con bride is back
dramabox.description: Framed and jailed, Evelyn hides Lucien's son to protect him. Six years later, they reunite and battle betrayal, custody threats, and a scheming rival for love and family.

Will love emerge from their tangled fates, or will deception tear them apart?

dramabox.title: Heart of Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: heart of obsession
dramabox.description: Under unexpected circumstances, Sean Mace falls for Clara Gray at first sight and pursues her relentlessly. However, Clara rejects him, harboring deep hatred for his role in her father’s suicide. Undeterred, Sean refuses to give up and ultimately forces her into marriage through ruthless means. Once wed, Clara does everything to make Sean despise her, yet, to her surprise, she finds herself falling for him instead.

dramabox.title: A Love Paid in Tears
dramabox.norm_title: a love paid in tears
dramabox.description: After returning to her biological family, Jane Gray does everything she can for them, only to be set up by her brother to sleep with a stranger. However, by chance, she spends the night with Hans Bale, the CEO of Bale Corp, and soon marries him despite only knowing him for days.

dramabox.title: Let It Be Me
dramabox.norm_title: let it be me
dramabox.description: Charlotte's parents passed away, and she was adopted by her uncle and aunt. As they grew older, her uncle arranged for Charlotte to marry Mike from the Davis family for the sake of a business partnership. In reality, Mike is a playboy and often has sexual relations with Ella. Upon discovering this, Charlotte angrily cancels her engagement with Mike and marries a homeless man named Jackson whom she found on the street.

dramabox.title: His Unveiled Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: his unveiled obsession
dramabox.description: Madeline Scott is framed for her father’s death by her scheming stepmother and stepsister, who aim to seize Scott Corp. Just as their lies gain traction, she turns the tables by exposing flaws in their accusations. When Zayn Scott’s will is revealed, naming Madeline as chairperson upon marriage, she shocks everyone by declaring she’ll wed Liam Larson in seven days.

dramabox.title: A World Within: Defying Her Fate
dramabox.norm_title: a world within defying her fate
dramabox.description: Upon transmigrating into a novel, Lena Dale finds herself inhabiting the body of a minor character. This character’s husband, Nathan Morgan, is exiled with his family the day after their wedding. When the Emperor summons Nathan to the palace, Lena uses her supernatural storage space to prepare an antidote for him in advance and secretly stocks up on valuable resources from the national treasury, her family home, and Northhold Manor.

dramabox.title: In His Obsession, She Belongs
dramabox.norm_title: in his obsession she belongs
dramabox.description: Fiona Joel has been engaged to her fiancé for four years. During that time, he has slept with dozens of women. Although Fiona pretends to be hurt by his infidelities, she secretly feels relieved, knowing she will marry into a wealthy family without having to fulfill the role of a devoted spouse to a man she doesn't even like. To even the score, she spends a night of passion with a stranger while waiting for the elevator, and the mysterious man accepts.

dramabox.title: Love's Trenches (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: love s trenches dubbed
dramabox.description: Mia Bale, the daughter of the wealthiest family, works as an intern in her family's company. Unexpectedly, she encounters Ken Leed, the CEO of a collaborating company who is also her former boyfriend, having vanished without explanation three years ago. As Mia tries to reconcile with Ken, she faces obstacles from Lily Cork, who exacerbates misunderstandings between them.

dramabox.title: Glory on the Line: The Taste of Triumph
dramabox.norm_title: glory on the line the taste of triumph
dramabox.description: Born and raised in isolation, Fiona Smith carries more than just her grandfather's extraordinary culinary techniques—she harbors a burning desire to escape the mountain that has been her silent prison. When a twist of fate brings her into the orbit of Ethan Parker, the cutthroat restaurateur of River Dine, she sees an opportunity for more than just a job—she sees a chance at redemption.

dramabox.title: Regret Is Only the Beginning
dramabox.norm_title: regret is only the beginning
dramabox.description: Yara Lennox, the chairwoman of Yova Corp, tragically spends her final moments in remorse at the thought of her agony and loss of wealth being caused by the man she loved most—the son of her family housekeeper. It is only when she breathes her last breath that she finds out that the feared boss of the top company has only stayed single for her. Given another chance at life, Yara vows to ensure vengeance against everyone who has ever done her harm.

dramabox.title: Ashes to Riches, Love to Dust
dramabox.norm_title: ashes to riches love to dust
dramabox.description: Faye Good, a janitor who wins one billion dollars in the lottery, eagerly travels to the city to share the life-changing news with her son, Will Good. However, her excitement quickly turns to heartbreak as she is humiliated by Will, his wife, and her mother-in-law. Will, full of disdain, even chases her away and severs ties with her. It is only after learning about the lottery that he begins to regret his harsh decisions.

dramabox.title: Unexpected Knot: My Husband Is a Tycoon (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: unexpected knot my husband is a tycoon dubbed
dramabox.description: Forced into marriage by her manager at the shoe store, Olivia Sullivan quickly weds a divorced father with two kids. While she expects an ordinary married life, she soon discovers that her husband is, in fact, the wealthiest man in the city!

dramabox.title: Spices of Fate
dramabox.norm_title: spices of fate
dramabox.description: Mandy Jones, a contestant in the modern Master Chef competition, unexpectedly finds herself transported to the olden times as a neglected concubine in the Regal Residence. There, her exceptional cooking skills quickly draw attention, and a romantic connection begins to blossom between her and Prince James Cavill after a series of misunderstandings.

dramabox.title: A Contractual Marriage? Hell No!
dramabox.norm_title: a contractual marriage hell no
dramabox.description: Keira Snow wakes up in shock, realizing that she had forced herself onto Nolan Blair, the CEO of her company, the night before. Overcome with guilt and pressure, she considers quitting her job. But her heartless parents have other plans, pushing her into a marriage arrangement she has no say in. Reluctantly, Keira decides to go along with it.

dramabox.title: In Love, We Bloom
dramabox.norm_title: in love we bloom
dramabox.description: After being cruelly betrayed by her unfaithful fiancé, single mom Sabrina Ashwood is left to rebuild her life for the sake of her young daughter, Megan. In a twist of fate, she enters a marriage of convenience with the enigmatic and successful Jordan Guilford. As they navigate a life full of unexpected trials, misunderstandings, and emotional turbulence, Sabrina discovers that Jordan has been secretly supporting her all along.

dramabox.title: Love Off-Script: A Heart That Strays
dramabox.norm_title: love off script a heart that strays
dramabox.description: Sage Webb, a time traveler, has journeyed through countless Smallverses alongside her loyal RoboCat. She is finally ready to settle in Harmonia, where she can retire and leave her mission-filled life behind. However, a bug in the system reroutes her to another Smallverse, casting her as the evil supporting character. Determined to secure her peaceful post-retirement life, Sage has no choice but to complete the story of this Smallverse.

dramabox.title: Against All Odds: A Family Restored
dramabox.norm_title: against all odds a family restored
dramabox.description: In order to treat her son, Caleb Clark, who has leukemia, Lucy Clark returns to the city where she broke up with her ex, Damon Hall, seven years ago. Attending a press conference, Damon immediately leaves for the train station in search of Lucy upon hearing about her return to Hael. Then, at the hospital, Caleb coincidentally sees Damon and suspects that he is his father due to his resemblance with the man in his mother’s album, so he tries to confirm his guess with Lucy.

dramabox.title: The Feast of a Reclaimed Life
dramabox.norm_title: the feast of a reclaimed life
dramabox.description: After being cheated on in her marriage, Chelsea York “sells” her husband for two million and one dollars before starting a new life. Armed with her excellent cooking skills, she opens a restaurant and wins the heart of Jaden Grant, the CEO of Grant Corp. As she faces harassment from her ex-husband and May Adler, a wealthy socialite, Chelsea grows closer to Jaden, whose mother supports their budding relationship.

dramabox.title: The Melody of Your Heart
dramabox.norm_title: the melody of your heart
dramabox.description: Yuna Juliana, who was born with a congenital heart condition, is pressured by her parents to marry Steven Zephyr. During the wedding, Samuel Heath interrupts to halt the ceremony. Yuna thinks Samuel was sent by her friend Lumi Quon, so she escapes with him. Thinking Samuel is a handyman, Yuna asks him to marry her to escape her family's marriage expectations.

dramabox.title: Don't You Sleep with Me
dramabox.norm_title: don t you sleep with me
dramabox.description: Clara agrees to marry her best friend's fiancé, per her request, only to find out that he is her former crush! In order to protect her best friend's marriage, she racks her brain for all kinds of excuses to avoid intimate contact with Miles, but somehow keeps falling into a deeper trap.

dramabox.title: Once and Forever: Destined to Be
dramabox.norm_title: once and forever destined to be
dramabox.description: Sevina Scott was the heir to the Scott family from Jalore. She trained in martial arts as a child, and after her parents passed away, she inherited a great deal of wealth. She was engaged to her cousin, but his family betrayed her, and she was eventually killed by her aunt. After she transmigrated, she became Sevina Scott in the modern world. She married Brian Grant, but he did not like her, and she was mistreated by the servants and Lydia White.

dramabox.title: Daddy Mommy Don't Divorce
dramabox.norm_title: daddy mommy don t divorce
dramabox.description: Dexter, the president, and Lilian, a recent graduate, spend the night together after their families move to get a marriage license without ever meeting. Six years later, Dexter comes back from abroad and hires Lilian as his personal assistant. What they don’t know is they are husband and wife both trying to get a divorce from each other. But with the help of their adorable son Danny, the two will realize their destiny and gradually fall back in love.

dramabox.title: Designs of Destiny
dramabox.norm_title: designs of destiny
dramabox.description: Six years ago, Helen Solman was framed by her stepmother and sister, accidentally became pregnant, which caused her father’s death, and her family’s company was taken over by her stepmother. She was also kicked out of the house. Six years later, Helen’s daughter, Yanne, has telepathic powers and helps her mother join Union Group as an assistant to the CEO, Alvin Lawson.

dramabox.title: My Poor Husband is A Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: my poor husband is a billionaire
dramabox.description:
Stella had a one-night stand with a stranger and mistook the man as someone who had
plunged her into a prostitution scandal and ruined her life. Three years later, Stella
married a man named Ethan in a flash and the two soon fell in love. However,
gradually Stella found Ethan similar to the man three years ago. Even worse, Ethan
had been hiding his CEO identity from Stella. Unable to accept the truth, Stella
divorced Ethan.

dramabox.title: The Waiter Who Stole My Heart
dramabox.norm_title: the waiter who stole my heart
dramabox.description: The female lead catches her fiancé cheating at their wedding and ends up marrying a waiter on the spot. The waiter is secretly a domineering CEO, hiding his identity while inspecting his subordinate hotel. She ends up married to him for no reason and has to support him financially. Both leads are CEOs, strong in their own right. Whenever the female lead's company faces a crisis, the male lead steps in to resolve it.

dramabox.title: Crash Landing Into Love
dramabox.norm_title: crash landing into love
dramabox.description: After catching her unfaithful boyfriend with her stepsister, Bonnie Blair impulsively marries a stranger, only to discover he is Edward Hart, the wealthiest man in Syrena. Strangely, Bonnie, who has a rare allergy to physical contact with men, finds herself immune to Edward’s touch. Little does she know, their intertwined story began a decade ago in a car accident, and fate has inexorably linked their paths ever since.

dramabox.title: Please Marry Me, Mr. Johnson
dramabox.norm_title: please marry me mr johnson
dramabox.description: To lift the curse that doomed her to die before turning 26, amateur priestess, Sharon Baker, packed her belongings and descended the mountain. She was determined to marry her destined lover! However, fate had its challenges. Her fated partner, Samuel Johnson, was a cold and aloof CEO with an unyielding rule. "One must keep his distance from women and dogs.". Marriage seemed impossible.

dramabox.title: Romance Is All Around
dramabox.norm_title: romance is all around
dramabox.description: Sophie Sage, the eldest daughter of the Sage family, is under immense pressure as she prepares to marry Ron Baker. However, despite her all-out efforts for love, Ron backs out at a critical moment, getting cold feet and suddenly disappearing just a few days before the wedding…

dramabox.title: Love Me All You Like
dramabox.norm_title: love me all you like
dramabox.description: When an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, Sara finds herself pulled into Elliot’s world of luxury and privilege. As he repeatedly steps in to help her—saving her from an ex, offering her a place to stay, and supporting her during family conflicts—their connection deepens. Despite their differences, Sara and Elliot decide to marry, confronting the realities of their contrasting worlds and discovering love where they least expected it.

dramabox.title: Timeless Romance: Where Hearts Blossom
dramabox.norm_title: timeless romance where hearts blossom
dramabox.description:
Hannah Snow, the kind and resilient owner of Snowfall Pavilion, crosses paths with William Reed, a Crown Prince who has mysteriously time-traveled from the past. Initially puzzled by his regal demeanor and baffled by his unfamiliarity with the modern world, Hannah suspects he may be suffering from a mental condition. However, she eventually feels pity for him and takes him in to care for him.

As time passes, their relationship blossoms into a tender, joyful connection.

dramabox.title: Fists of Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: fists of vengeance
dramabox.description: In the martial arts world of Xembourg, the Morgan family style has long been revered as the pinnacle of martial prowess. However, Sage Morgan, the sole successor of the Morgan family martial arts, went into hiding after a devastating attack by a Japanese force years ago. Four years later, the same Japanese organization returned, vowing to challenge the fighters of Xembourg. Bearing the weight of his lineage, Sage faces the three top fighters of the Japanese group alone.

dramabox.title: Love in the Lap of Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: love in the lap of fortune
dramabox.description: From D-list to dynasty, the universe has a funny way of writing love stories. Just ask Mabel Manson, a struggling actress whose life script gets completely rewritten one extraordinary night. Suddenly blessed—or cursed—with memories she can't explain, she finds herself in an accidental marriage to the captivating Jayden Foley. But what starts as a comedy of errors quickly transforms into a masterclass in destiny as a mysterious birthmark reveals Mabel's true heritage.

dramabox.title: Steel and Grace: The Queen of War
dramabox.norm_title: steel and grace the queen of war
dramabox.description: After earning countless merits, General Luna Reid returns quietly, only to have her engagement to the top scholar, Samuel Gaston, called off. Samuel is in search of someone who can build an era of peace and prosperity alongside him—and that person is General Reid. However, he is unaware that Luna is, in fact, the very general he’s been seeking. Despite narrowly missing each other several times, they eventually come together and lead the nation into a harmonious era.

dramabox.title: How to Divorce a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: how to divorce a billionaire
dramabox.description: A female lawyer is unexpectedly hired by her estranged billionaire husband to be his divorce attorney. Amidst a series of misunderstandings, they rediscover their feelings for each other.

dramabox.title: A Leap Through Time: Thriving in the '90s
dramabox.norm_title: a leap through time thriving in the 90s
dramabox.description: As a Gen Z screenwriter who has been single for life, Hailey never imagined she would one day wake up as a hated young widow in the 1990s. She starts with a straw mat for her husband's funeral, two young stepchildren left by her late husband, and an empty house. Without a penny or a grain of rice to her name, the family is forced to survive on wild greens. As if poverty was not enough, she is also labeled a fox spirit and scorned by her mother-in-law and the entire village.

dramabox.title: The Genius Reboot
dramabox.norm_title: the genius reboot
dramabox.description: Once a celebrated genius, Lana Judd's tragic mistake shatters her life's work. Death should have been the end of her story. Instead, it's only chapter one. Reborn as a powerless factory worker, Lana endures relentless bullying from those who mistake her quiet calculation for weakness. Refusing to be confined by her new circumstances, she reignites her spark, defying expectations at every turn.

dramabox.title: Surrendering to Your Heart
dramabox.norm_title: surrendering to your heart
dramabox.description: Sue Leed, a bright and independent village girl, endures constant oppression from her family. Not only do they refuse to support her education, but they also attempt to force her into an unwanted marriage. Determined to reclaim her future, Sue escapes and, in a twist of fate, finds herself in the luxurious car of Hans Good, a wealthy CEO. Although Hans is typically indifferent to romance, he is instantly captivated by Sue.

dramabox.title: Timeless Love: From Embalmer to Princess
dramabox.norm_title: timeless love from embalmer to princess
dramabox.description: Carol Scott is a beautiful embalmer who has never been in a relationship because of her career. One day, while working on a handsome male corpse, she accidentally time-travels to ancient times and finds herself as a crown princess in the bathtub of the crown prince, Jay Reed. Jay instantly becomes enraged by her sudden appearance.

dramabox.title: Waking Up Married To My Crush!
dramabox.norm_title: waking up married to my crush
dramabox.description: Jasmine awoke to find herself married her college crush Patrick – who is both handsome and wealthy! Yet, she quickly discovers that her marriage is sinking. A tragic accident had damaged her brain, erased the last few years of her life, trapping her at the age of 21. Determined not to spend her 25th year as a love-struck, subservient wife, Jasmine decides to reclaim her sparkle. This transformation gives Patrick a new perspective on Jasmine, he starts to fall in love with her

dramabox.title: Crown of the Reborn: Vengeance Awaits (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: crown of the reborn vengeance awaits dubbed
dramabox.description: On the day of Cade Bale’s wedding, Sue Shaw takes her last breath. Her downfall started when she invited him to go to school in the same Maybach as her out of kindness. Despite Cade being the son of the Shaws’ driver, Sue lent him her card, gifted him luxuries, and even handed over the company her father had left for her. Enjoying everything given by her, Cade got in a relationship, doting on his girlfriend while treating Sue as his maid.

dramabox.title: You Are My Destiny
dramabox.norm_title: you are my destiny
dramabox.description: Sabrina Clark happened to see her younger sister, Rebecca Clark, cheating with her husband. Heartbroken and furious, she went to a bar alone to drown her sorrows. Unexpectedly, the shameless couple grabbed the chance to humiliate her cruelly. When she was alone, helpless, and downhearted, things took a turn for the better. Charles York, her first love, played the knight to the rescue. He gave her warmth and power.

dramabox.title: Resurrection of Love
dramabox.norm_title: resurrection of love
dramabox.description: Reina Swenson was arrested and imprisoned on the day of her engagement five years ago, bearing the burden of being accused of killing Yvonne Coelen, Tristan Lancer's first love. After being released from prison five years later, she faced endless humiliation from her fiancé. Despite being engaged, she lived in the Lancer family like a servant, suffering Tristan's relentless torment.

dramabox.title: Whispers to His Mind
dramabox.norm_title: whispers to his mind
dramabox.description: Amidst the chaos of the hospital, skilled surgeon Linda Brown finds herself time-traveling to the Astren era due to a mysterious pendant. There, she becomes Prince Brad's princess consort and the chancellor's daughter, who shares her name. Ten years have passed since Linda heroically saved Brad Miller from drowning—a man she has harbored feelings for ever since.However, the tides turn when Mindy Black, with the Empress's scheming support, usurps Linda's position.

dramabox.title: Veiled Secrets: A Love Unraveled
dramabox.norm_title: veiled secrets a love unraveled
dramabox.description: Sandra Steele, the illegitimate daughter of the prime minister, accidentally spends a night with the abstinent regent, Duke Joshua. She then finds out that she is pregnant with twins a month later. Facing the tragic death of her mother and the pressure from her father to become someone else's concubine, Sandra has no choice but to reveal her pregnancy, yet she is brutally beaten for it.

dramabox.title: My Perfect Robot Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: my perfect robot boyfriend
dramabox.description: Over-aged single lady Stella Lawrence who has had many failed blind dates chanced upon a perfect robot boyfriend one day. Having just lost her job, Stella scored an interview with Mysteria Animation Studio with the robot’s help and met the CEO of Mysteria, Jerry Tucker. Through all the ups and downs, twists and turns that life has to offer, Stella eventually makes a choice between loving a human or a robot.

dramabox.title: Falling for the Secret Heir
dramabox.norm_title: falling for the secret heir
dramabox.description: On her wedding night, Callie Jensen's husband elopes abroad with her best friend. Devastated and on the verge of giving up, she takes on a charming boy toy she meets at a bar and stays with him for three years—until her husband returns. Callie offers the boy toy a check and ends the relationship. However, they soon cross paths again, and she finally discovers that the seemingly immature boy she once knew is actually a powerful and influential billionaire.

dramabox.title: Twilight Serendipity
dramabox.norm_title: twilight serendipity
dramabox.description: Willow Clark, a middle-aged woman working as a cleaner in a bar, struggles to support her severely ill mother and her daughter, who has just been accepted into college. In a surprising twist of fate, she meets Jason Zahn, the chairman of Sheydon Group, who has been betrayed, and they spend the night together. A month later, Willow discovers she is pregnant. To complicate matters, her gambling ex-husband reappears, demanding money.

dramabox.title: Beyond Betrayal: Her New Dawn
dramabox.norm_title: beyond betrayal her new dawn
dramabox.description: While concealing her identity as the world's top artist and the daughter of Jaxon's wealthiest family, Kate Snow embarks on a three-year relationship with Cedric Muhl. However, their bond shatters when Joan Larson, a manipulative woman, frames Kate to win Cedric for herself. Choosing to align with Joan for the sake of his family's future, Cedric humiliates Kate and even resorts to physical violence against her.

dramabox.title: Mr.Right & Ms.Wrong
dramabox.norm_title: mr right ms wrong
dramabox.description: Tristan loses his sight in an accident and becomes emotional closed off and cold. Ashley, needing to care for her sick father, is forced into an arranged engagement with a blind Tristan. Mistaken for a servant, she endures his harsh treatment. But as they spend time together, their hearts begin to open, and an unexpected love grows between them, bringing healing and hope to their lives.

dramabox.title: Behind Her Veil
dramabox.norm_title: behind her veil
dramabox.description: After disguising myself and leaving the mountains, I somehow ended up with three fiancés?! Not only that, another girl has taken my place! Little do they know, I’ve got many secret identities that can turn their lives upside down, from treasure appraisal to commercial war. I’ll reclaim everything that was mine, one by one! But somehow… I can’t shake these three men off!

dramabox.title: Love's Reprise
dramabox.norm_title: love s reprise
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Nicole Swanson’s parents divorced, and her ruthless father kicked her and her brother out of the house. Desperate to save her ailing brother who had a heart condition, Nicole took a bold risk, sneaking into Donald Corvan’s room to secure the funds they needed.Now, five years later, Nicole returns with her two adorable children, determined to reclaim everything she lost. But fate leads her back to the most powerful man in Riverrun City—Donald Corvan.

dramabox.title: Rescue Me With Love
dramabox.norm_title: rescue me with love
dramabox.description: When Casey Trent, a college student, spends a night with CEO Ralph Colton, neither of them expects it to kickstart a slow-burn love story. As Ralph’s affection for her deepens, he helps pull her out of the misery caused by her family and protects her when she faces humiliation at the hands of a lecherous man during a blind date she is forced to attend. Their bond strengthens, and Casey begins to recognize his feelings for her, along with his sense of responsibility.

dramabox.title: Spoiled by Four Billionaires
dramabox.norm_title: spoiled by four billionaires
dramabox.description: Yvonne, who had no family of her own, financially supported her boyfriend Josh through his college years. However, once Josh found success, he left her for Clair, a woman with deep pockets. Together, Josh and Clair made Yvonne's life miserable, not realizing that Yvonne was actually a lost daughter of the wealthy Hoffman family. When her three powerful brothers and her fiancé finally located her, they rallied to her side to help her exact revenge on Josh.

dramabox.title: My CEO, My Last-Minute Groom
dramabox.norm_title: my ceo my last minute groom
dramabox.description: When an ordinary girl marries a wealthy man, the stark contrast in their backgrounds and social statuses creates a formidable barrier between them. Faced with numerous challenges, will Rhea Gray and Ezra Ford be able to overcome these obstacles and remain together until the end?

dramabox.title: All Hail the Princess
dramabox.norm_title: all hail the princess
dramabox.description: Upon traveling through time, a genius named Victoria Griffin finds herself as the Princess Royal of Valdoria, a figure known for being ridiculed by the nation. As she looks around, she realizes she is in her room, having just humiliated the Primus. At that moment, the prince, who seeks to consolidate the High Court’s power for himself, rushes in with the emperor to accuse her of bringing bad luck to the country.

dramabox.title: A General's Era-Leaping Odyssey
dramabox.norm_title: a general s era leaping odyssey
dramabox.description: Once a powerful general blessed with supernatural strength in a past life, he found himself unexpectedly transported to the modern world; he had also swapped genders! As if that wasn’t enough, fate played another cruel trick—she unknowingly became the secret wife and bodyguard of her former enemy from her previous life. To make matters worse, her supernatural strength had mysteriously vanished.

dramabox.title: Runaway to Romance
dramabox.norm_title: runaway to romance
dramabox.description: The daughter of the Lauriers, Claire Laurier, and the son of the Griffins, Jonathan Griffin, both ran away from home to avoid an arranged marriage. However, in a twist of fate, they start falling for each other. Where will their story lead next?

dramabox.title: My Ex-Wife, The Secret Mogul
dramabox.norm_title: my ex wife the secret mogul
dramabox.description: Four years ago, the poisoned Clare married Lucas under the guise of an ordinary woman to cure her condition and to help him fend off his grandfather's pressure to get married. After the death of Lucas' grandfather, George, and Clare's poisoning was cured, Clare frequently asked for a divorce. Lucas granted her request after a misunderstanding.

dramabox.title: From Rings to Riches: Triumphs in the '80s
dramabox.norm_title: from rings to riches triumphs in the 80s
dramabox.description: Gina Scott—the champion of kickboxing—accidentally time-travels to the 80's. There, she marries Alex Lowe instead of a violent and dominating guy to avoid giving into her selfish parents' request. After her marriage, she defends herself against her vicious mother-in-law, raises her children, and earns money for Alex to open a new factory. Besides that, she also sells her fried chicken recipe, shrimps, and even makes stylish clothes.

dramabox.title: Mr. Holt, the New Intern Is Your Wife
dramabox.norm_title: mr holt the new intern is your wife
dramabox.description: In a desperate bid to pay for her grandmother's surgery, Sherry Sutton agrees to an arranged marriage orchestrated by Sue Watson. But due to a fateful mix-up, she ends up marrying Elijah Holt—the heir of Holt Group. A year later, they meet again as strangers, unaware of their shared past. As they overcome life's challenges, an undeniable spark brings them closer until the truth is revealed—they've been married all along.

dramabox.title: Her Veiled Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: her veiled vengeance
dramabox.description: To exact her revenge, Jill Reed marries into the Baker family while pretending to be a naive and foolish girl. However, her secrets can’t stay hidden forever. Over time, Matt Baker discovers that she is not only the student of the master of medicine but also a skilled pianist, a covert investor, and a powerful hacker. Confounded and frustrated, he eventually can’t resist questioning her about what other secrets she might be hiding.

dramabox.title: Falling for My Ex's Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: falling for my ex s uncle
dramabox.description: As soon as Tony Cohen reclaims his status as a member of the richest family on earth, he breaks up with his girlfriend, Yelena Lowe, who grew up in the same orphanage as he did, and gets close with a wealthy girl. However, Yelena remains calm and even extends her best wishes, as she is now his aunt-in-law.

dramabox.title: Chasing My Rejected Wife
dramabox.norm_title: chasing my rejected wife
dramabox.description: Love, lies, and mistaken identities! … As Aileen Smith navigated her new life at work, she unexpectedly fell deeply for her boss—THE BILLIONAIRE. But Aileen had been married for a year, although she and her husband's encounters were so scarce they could barely recall each other's faces. Through a series of jaw-dropping twists, Aileen was stunned to discover that the captivating CEO was, in fact, her husband...

dramabox.title: When Fate Calls Again
dramabox.norm_title: when fate calls again
dramabox.description: Tiffany Shelton was wronged in her youth, leading to a fateful night with CEO Adrian Grimshaw. That night changed her life, leading to the birth of her daughter, Vivi, and estrangement from her family. Determined to succeed on her own, Tiffany ventured out to forge her own path. With the support of Mr. Harrison Grimshaw, she started her own company and embarked on a challenging journey.

dramabox.title: Love's Bittersweet Symphony
dramabox.norm_title: love s bittersweet symphony
dramabox.description: Despite Daphne Tate’s loyalty and efforts to win over Caleb Meyer for the past five years, he ultimately abandons her without mercy. Instead of crying or causing a scene, she simply says goodbye, hoping to never see him again. However, when a wealthy suitor shows interest in her, Caleb becomes furious, leaving Daphne bewildered. What does he want?

dramabox.title: Wait, My Secretary Is My Wife?!
dramabox.norm_title: wait my secretary is my wife
dramabox.description: Thanks to Sam Good’s grandmother, Sam Good and Sue Judd get married despite knowing very little about each other. After their wedding, they part ways and only reunite a year later at Sam's election event for secretary, where Sue becomes his personal secretary. Remarkably, neither of them recognizes the other. Despite several attempts by Lana Bale and Sam’s mother to sabotage their relationship, Sam and Sue gradually fall for each other.

dramabox.title: Snatch an Emperor to Be My Husband
dramabox.norm_title: snatch an emperor to be my husband
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her partner, Diana Locke marries David Jepson to honor her grandmother’s dying wish, only to learn that he is the heir to a vast fortune. However, David’s odd behavior and inability to fit in lead Diana to suspect he might have a mental impairment. In truth, David is a king from ancient times who has traveled to the modern era. Grateful to Diana for saving his life, David vows to protect her, and together they vanquish their enemies.

dramabox.title: Love on Duty
dramabox.norm_title: love on duty
dramabox.description: Two months ago, Ariel Smith suffered a severe fall down the stairs, resulting in the loss of her sight. Compounding the tragedy, her father, Daniel Smith, was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Aware that his time was running out, Daniel hired a renowned underground boxer named Zach Swanson to protect his daughter, offering a substantial payment. Tragically, shortly after the contract was signed, Daniel was killed in a car accident.

dramabox.title: Married at First Sight
dramabox.norm_title: married at first sight
dramabox.description: After being abandoned by a deceitful man, Kate Steel marries Evan Lake, a man she barely knows, and her life undergoes a dramatic transformation. As a genuine bond begins to develop between them, Kate uncovers a startling truth: she is the long-lost daughter of the Wood family and should have been living in luxury, not poverty.

dramabox.title: Eternal Embrace: My Boyfriend Is a General
dramabox.norm_title: eternal embrace my boyfriend is a general
dramabox.description: Chloe Sue, a modern-day archeologist, saves a random man on the sidewalk one day. This man turns out to be the Cavalry General of the Greater York Dynasty, Ethan Shaw. They travel back in time to Greater York and develop feelings for each other after a series of hijinks. Together, they fight against the Royal Duke, Walter Cabot, who is eyeing the position of crown prince for himself.

dramabox.title: Love's Detour to Destiny
dramabox.norm_title: love s detour to destiny
dramabox.description: Mia Cole has been married to Joe Holt for three years when she catches him in bed with Sue Cole on the day of their third wedding anniversary. After seeking a divorce, Mia reclaims her title as the founder of MY Corp and overcomes Sue, resolving the misunderstandings between herself and Joe. Having gone through thick and thin together, they finally end up as a happy couple.

dramabox.title: In Love's Twilight
dramabox.norm_title: in love s twilight
dramabox.description: Serena Shelton, the eldest daughter of the Shelton family, lost her mother at a young age. After her mother’s passing, her father’s mistress took over. In a bid to reclaim the Shelton Group, founded by her mother, Serena reluctantly agrees to marry Cyril Hawkins, the eldest son of the wealthiest family, in place of her half-sister, Chloe. A year ago, Cyril was attacked and left mentally impaired. Serena expects her life to become even more difficult.

dramabox.title: Fateful Reunion: Love's Double Blessing
dramabox.norm_title: fateful reunion love s double blessing
dramabox.description: When Stella King becomes pregnant, Renee King accuses her of having a baby with Ian Payne. This accusation infuriates Kyle Ford so much that he refuses to answer Stella’s calls, even when she urgently needs surgery just before delivery. Renee threatens Stella to sign the divorce papers. She then lies to Kyle, claiming Stella wants to leave him for Ian. Seven years later, Stella returns from abroad with her children, Phillip King and Anne King.

dramabox.title: A Destined Reunion
dramabox.norm_title: a destined reunion
dramabox.description: Five years ago, the scheming Cynthia Tipton used Sonia Tipton's terminally ill mother to force her into spending a night with a stranger in her place. Nervous and afraid, Sonia mistakenly entered the CEO's room. Afterward, Cynthia handed Sonia a bank card and warned her to keep the incident a secret. Cynthia then walked into the CEO's room and successfully replaced Sonia as the CEO's fiancée, gaining the wealth and status she had always dreamed of.

dramabox.title: Love and Sorcery: A Mystical Adventure
dramabox.norm_title: love and sorcery a mystical adventure
dramabox.description: Kyle Young is not only the son of the richest man on earth, but also one who has a great secret that he himself is unaware of, while Chloe Carter is a girl who practices Spiritual Arts and is told to protect Kyle. As the villains try laying their hands on him,Chloe counteracts with her techniques and wit, occasionally fending the enemies off in Kyle’s house amid the fun times they spend together.Gradually,the bond between Kyle and Chloe thickens, and love surfaces in the air.

dramabox.title: Back to the 80s（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: back to the 80s dubbed
dramabox.description: Julie Stein wakes up from her sleep, expecting just another ordinary day. However, to her surprise, she finds herself in the 80s, a totally different era from where she belongs. Not only is she a disowned daughter of a wealthy family to whom she has no blood connection, but she is also supposed to marry an old man with two children, in place of the family’s biological daughter.

dramabox.title: Rejected Luna's Prince
dramabox.norm_title: rejected luna s prince
dramabox.description: Rejected by her mate upon discovering her pregnancy, Willa leaves the Blue Ridge Pack to raise her son, Emmett, alone. Meanwhile, her fated mate, Prince Dracos, embarks on a relentless quest to find her. Will their love conquer the secrets and dangers that threaten their future?

dramabox.title: Eternal Remedy of Love
dramabox.norm_title: eternal remedy of love
dramabox.description: In an accident, Vivian Muhl, the revered doctor of the Xain Dynasty, finds herself transported into the body of a mistreated young lady framed by her stepsister. Here, she crosses paths with Andrew Parker. Leveraging her unmatched medical expertise, Vivian not only flourishes in this new era but also vows to confront anyone who dares to harm her.

dramabox.title: A Windfall of Fortune and Love
dramabox.norm_title: a windfall of fortune and love
dramabox.description: Having her old house torn down, Tiana Yates receives compensation money and spends it on her mother’s medical bills. Unfortunately, she soon finds out about the affair between her boyfriend, Kevin Hunt, and Ella Neal. However, she manages to encounter the God of Fortune, who makes her the only person unaffected by global inflation. Little does she know, Kevin intends to kill her mother to claim insurance compensation for"accidental deaths,"which he plans to carry out himself.

dramabox.title: At Her Behest: The Lady's Dominion
dramabox.norm_title: at her behest the lady s dominion
dramabox.description: Released from a three-year imprisonment in jail in place of her boyfriend, Jim Norman, Ciara Lopez learns that she is the Lady of Dragon Hall. She plans to marry Jim, but he is set to wed her best friend, Fanny Todd. Meanwhile, Ciara discovers that her father has endured harassment from loan sharks for the past three years because of her. Determined to uncover the truth, she visits the Emperor Hotel and witnesses Jim’s cold-bloodedness firsthand.

dramabox.title: Affection from Dual Tycoons
dramabox.norm_title: affection from dual tycoons
dramabox.description: Five years ago, trainee Hazel Fairley was sabotaged by her best friend, losing her chance to debut. By a twist of fate, she had a one-night stand with CEO Dominic Sterling and gave birth to a daughter. Five years later, Dominic acquires Galaxus Group and encounters Hazel, not realizing she is the woman from that night. As they get to know each other, they develop feelings for each other.

dramabox.title: Soul Swapped: The Heiress and the Pauper
dramabox.norm_title: soul swapped the heiress and the pauper
dramabox.description: Sera Stone was a smart and kind employee. Through a chance encounter, she swapped souls with Kiara Allen, an arrogant woman from a rich family. Connor York, a young and promising CEO, noticed Kiara's unusual behavior. However, he could not help but fall in love with her and began to pursue her…

dramabox.title: Shadows to Spotlight: The Diva's Resurgence
dramabox.norm_title: shadows to spotlight the diva s resurgence
dramabox.description: Hazel Rhode possesses a charming voice. She could have become a famous singer, but due to her appearance, she can only serve as a substitute for the popular celebrity Stella Holt, enduring daily humiliation from her. However, to prevent this secret from ruining her chance to marry into the Jenkin family, Stella pays others to kill Hazel and her sister. Devastated, Hazel considers giving up when she is rescued by Liam Jenkin, the top star.

dramabox.title: Triple Bond of Love
dramabox.norm_title: triple bond of love
dramabox.description: Because of a misunderstanding, Athena White leaves her boyfriend despite being pregnant. Six years later, she returns from abroad, and her three children encounter Caleb Parker at the airport, who is there to pick someone up. At this moment, her eldest child blurts out a question without much thought, asking, "What is Daddy doing here?"

dramabox.title: Sealed With a Kiss
dramabox.norm_title: sealed with a kiss
dramabox.description: Evie Blake finds herself on a blind date set up by her stepmother, only to encounter a narcissistic man.
