In a bid to puncture his overconfidence, she seizes the collar of the tall and handsome Ian Welch, planting a bold kiss on him right in front of her date. While her date storms off in a fit of rage, showcasing Evie's triumph, she unwittingly sets herself on a path fraught with unforeseen challenges.

dramabox.title: Love, Once Again
dramabox.norm_title: love once again
dramabox.description: Yuliana Lester and Jules Greene were a dream power couple: doctors at a prestigious hospital. Their good friend, Dr. Eastin Donald, invented VR goggles for Yuliana to practice traditional medicine. However, the goggles malfunctioned and dragged the three of them into an alternate universe. In this universe, Yuliana became the princess of Daylegro, Jules became a general, and Eastin became a highly respected doctor.

dramabox.title: Flickers of Yesterday: Reigniting Love
dramabox.norm_title: flickers of yesterday reigniting love
dramabox.description: Even after ten years, Cedric Olson cannot forget Mabel Upton, the girl who saved him a decade ago. Believing Mabel to have passed away, Cedric is unaware that she survived her stepmother’s schemes but lost her memories and now goes by Mabel Tobin. When they reunite, Cedric sees her as a substitute for the Mabel he once knew. Mabel, on the other hand, marries Cedric to fund her grandmother’s surgery.

dramabox.title: The Unveiled Heiress: Return of the Queen
dramabox.norm_title: the unveiled heiress return of the queen
dramabox.description: Jane Reed, the daughter of a wealthy family, hid her identity and married Terry Horton, CEO of Horton Corp. She became Amber Carter's blood donor and was constantly humiliated. Heartbroken, Jane divorced Terry and returned to her wealthy family. When Terry found out the truth, he began a difficult journey to win her back.

dramabox.title: Grades of Glory
dramabox.norm_title: grades of glory
dramabox.description: Lily Cage comes from a poor background. Believing in her father’s words that education is the best way out of poverty, she puts her all into her studies and eventually achieves great grades, subsequently earning everyone’s respect.

dramabox.title: Captive to Love
dramabox.norm_title: captive to love
dramabox.description: Phillips Morgan and Audrey Moore divorce after five years of contractual marriage because Phillips' former lover, Claris Moore, re-enters his life. Despite not having feelings for Claris, Phillips mistakenly believes she is the girl who once gave him hope during a dark period of depression. Hence, he feels obligated to take care of her and marry her. Little does he expect Audrey to return five years later with their son. What exactly is going on?

dramabox.title: Love's Lucky Seven
dramabox.norm_title: love s lucky seven
dramabox.description: Ruby Smith is a talented writer famous for her mystery novels. She dreams of writing love stories, but she has never been in a relationship. One day, she meets a man wearing a pink-arrow brooch on his chest who claims to be Cupid. With the seven items he gives her, Ruby attracts seven handsome elites. After each spends two days with her, will she finally find her Mr. Right?

dramabox.title: Jilted to Jewel: The Rejected Bride's Rise
dramabox.norm_title: jilted to jewel the rejected bride s rise
dramabox.description: On her wedding day, Maya York discovers that her fiancé, is having an affair with her sister. She even learns that she is adopted and is subsequently thrown out. However, she soon finds out she is the sole heir of the prestigious Stone family. Back at her true home, Maya is doted on by the CEO of Stone Group. She also meets her new fiancé. However, her adoptive family continues to challenge and humiliate her. So Maya decides to make them pay for their mistreatment.

dramabox.title: The Sweet Symphony of Love
dramabox.norm_title: the sweet symphony of love
dramabox.description: Keira Windsor is one of the most successful voice actresses, yet her parents force her to marry a wealthy man named Zach Parker, who they believe is useless and physically impaired. As the arrangement is confirmed, Keira believes her future is ruined. However, on her wedding night, she discovers that Zach is neither disabled nor useless. He is not cool and quiet either. To her utter surprise, he is actually the mysterious man who has been supporting her all along!

dramabox.title: Wait, I'm Dating a CEO?!
dramabox.norm_title: wait i m dating a ceo
dramabox.description: Willow Foley's world shatters when she finds her boyfriend cheating in a KTV room. In a spontaneous act of revenge, she kisses a stranger named Nathan Graham. Drunkenly mistaking him for a male escort, she suggests he be her sugar baby. Her vulnerability surprisingly touches Nathan. The next day, fate takes a hilarious turn when Willow spots Nathan at Lyras Corp. Assuming he's there for her, Nathan is forced to hide the fact that he is the CEO.

dramabox.title: The Eternal Weave of Love
dramabox.norm_title: the eternal weave of love
dramabox.description: Elle Lopez is the wife of Darl's prince, Kevin Hart. When Kevin's brother kills the king to claim the throne, it sparks a battle that also threatens Elle's life. In an effort to protect her, Kevin tragically loses his own life, and Elle loses all hope after the loss of her loved one. However, this isn't the end for Elle. She awakens in the modern era as the wife of a wealthy man named Kevin Webb.

dramabox.title: When True Love Shines Through
dramabox.norm_title: when true love shines through
dramabox.description: Renowned jewelry designer Winnie Hart returns from abroad, keeping her identity a secret. She inadvertently ruins Luke Smith’s date, unaware that he is the heir to Smith Corp. To compensate him and seek her family's lost treasure, the "Heart of the Lost," Winnie marries Luke. Both hide their true identities from each other and begin life together under the same roof.

dramabox.title: Love's Mysterious Veil
dramabox.norm_title: love s mysterious veil
dramabox.description: After years of living with her adoptive parents, Xandra Stone is finally reunited with her birth family. However, one day, she discovers her fiancé having an affair with her sister. Furious, Xandra confronts them, only to be scolded by her father. Disheartened, she seeks solace at a bar with her best friend, Nancy Key. Under Nancy's impulsive influence, Xandra marries the heir to the wealthy family. With both of them harboring their own secrets, what will happen next?

dramabox.title: Fierce Grace: Braving the Betrayal（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: fierce grace braving the betrayal dubbed
dramabox.description: For the sake of her boyfriend, Kyle Jensen, Myla Young sacrifices her studies and pursues a career abroad. She founds Rosa Corp, which rapidly ascends to become the world's leading company within seven years. Secretly supporting Kyle's education, she ensures his success, even securing him a position at Foster Corp in Osian. However, upon her return to reveal the truth and propose to Kyle, he publicly ends their relationship to pursue another wealthy woman.

dramabox.title: Shattered Promises
dramabox.norm_title: shattered promises
dramabox.description: In the surgery room, Maya Dunn’s boyfriend, Ronan Schulz, forces her to get an abortion, saying he will forgive her for cheating on him if she obeys. Maya insists that the child is his, but Ronan does not believe her. He mercilessly removes the wedding ring from her finger, a ring he had placed there just an hour earlier at their wedding ceremony.

dramabox.title: Whispers of the Past
dramabox.norm_title: whispers of the past
dramabox.description: Ruby Nolan has been married to Jeff Paule for three years, and they have a son. However, this doesn’t stop her from being intimate with multiple men. One day, she suggests a divorce to Jeff, and soon after, she gets into a terrible car accident that erases her memory of the past five years.Upon awakening, Ruby undergoes a profound transformation.

dramabox.title: When We Meet Again
dramabox.norm_title: when we meet again
dramabox.description: The feisty and popular celebrity, Quiana Swift, returns from abroad after three years, following malicious rumors about her. Participating in a dating show, she unexpectedly reunites with her ex-husband, Tristan Shaw, a prominent figure in the industry.Only after overcoming schemes from her rivals and being shielded by Tristan multiple times, do they reconcile and flourish together in both their careers or personal lives.

dramabox.title: My Professor Is My Alpha Mate
dramabox.norm_title: my professor is my alpha mate
dramabox.description: When Lila kisses a stranger to get back at her cheating ex-boyfriend, she has no idea she's just locked lips with Colton Denizen, a billionaire and her esteemed college professor. Their passionate yet secretive relationship leads them into a thrilling adventure. Together, they must unravel the mystery and bring down the elusive Rogue King. Lila and Colton's bond is tested in ways they never imagined. Will their love survive the secrets and perils they uncover?

dramabox.title: Love's Prologue
dramabox.norm_title: love s prologue
dramabox.description: To help resolve her father’s company funding crisis, Grace Regen marries Harold Smith despite not really knowing him. However, because he’s unhappy with being forced into the marriage, Harold leaves home and disappears for a whole three years without even meeting his wife. But life is full of surprises—they fall in love when they finally meet each other three years later.

dramabox.title: The Stunning Resurgence: Becky 2.0
dramabox.norm_title: the stunning resurgence becky 2 0
dramabox.description: Becky Silva, the plump heiress girl who has been doted on by many, gets rejected by her crush because of her looks. Now, she is back after transforming into a gorgeous and fit young woman.

dramabox.title: Alpha’s  Perfect  Love
dramabox.norm_title: alpha s perfect love
dramabox.description: Alpha Liam finds out that his mate, Dora, is a regular human who hates werewolves to her guts. To be with her, Liam keeps his werewolf identity a secret and pretends to be a regular human, not knowing that a mystery child is going to reveal a deep secrete of them from 5 years ago…

dramabox.title: Love's Trenches
dramabox.norm_title: love s trenches
dramabox.description: Mia Bale, the daughter of the wealthiest family, works as an intern in her family's company. Unexpectedly, she encounters Ken Leed, the CEO of a collaborating company who is also her former boyfriend, having vanished without explanation three years ago. As Mia tries to reconcile with Ken, she faces obstacles from Lily Cork, who exacerbates misunderstandings between them.

dramabox.title: The Long-Awaited Encounter
dramabox.norm_title: the long awaited encounter
dramabox.description: Six years ago, on the day of her coming-of-age ceremony, Janet Smith, the eldest daughter of the Smith family, found herself drugged by her father, Neo Smith, and her sister, Roxy Smith. In a daze, she unwittingly spent the night with Yael Lawley, the CEO of Lawley Corp. This scandal orchestrated by her own family led to Janet's expulsion from her home. Now, years have passed. What will transpire between Janet and Yael when they cross paths once more?

dramabox.title: Back Alive: Marrying My Once-Enemy
dramabox.norm_title: back alive marrying my once enemy
dramabox.description: In her past life, Sage Morgan chose the wrong man to be with, and the price she had to pay was her very own life—death from a staged fire. Reborn, she's back with a vengeance, vowing to marry the wealthy playboy she once clashed with, who is also the same man who risked everything to save her from the deadly fire.

dramabox.title: Fierce Grace: Braving the Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: fierce grace braving the betrayal
dramabox.description: For the sake of her boyfriend, Kyle Jensen, Myla Young sacrifices her studies and pursues a career abroad. She founds Rosa Corp, which rapidly ascends to become the world's leading company within seven years. Secretly supporting Kyle's education, she ensures his success, even securing him a position at Foster Corp in Osian. However, upon her return to reveal the truth and propose to Kyle, he publicly ends their relationship to pursue another wealthy woman.

dramabox.title: Love's Redemption: Winning Her Heart Back
dramabox.norm_title: love s redemption winning her heart back
dramabox.description: Born into a wealthy family, Belle Smith has been showered with affection her whole life. She later marries Ezra Ford and assumes the role of a housewife. However, she finds herself despised and bullied by her mother-in-law. Each time she feels wronged, all she can do is cry alone in a corner.Meanwhile, her husband shows no concern for her, even after learning about the mistreatment she endures.

dramabox.title: How to Snatch a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: how to snatch a billionaire
dramabox.description: Tired of dull blind dates, Harley impulsively kisses a handsome stranger passing by. But he won't let go easily, sparking an unexpected romantic encounter.

dramabox.title: The Heiress' Revengeful Comeback
dramabox.norm_title: the heiress revengeful comeback
dramabox.description: Three years ago, Taylor Hunt, heiress to the wealthy Hunt family, embarked on a journey to find the one who saved her life. In a twist of fate, she wed into the Xavier family, only to be ensnared in a web of humiliation and bullying. Now, she returns home with a steely resolve—to make her tormentors pay. With fiery determination, she plots revenge against her callous mother-in-law and unveils the deceit of her unfaithful husband and his mistress.

dramabox.title: Hitched to My Ex's Boss
dramabox.norm_title: hitched to my ex s boss
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Louis Goodridge, a gigolo, plotted against Yvonne Smith, the daughter of Damnon City's wealthiest family. He manipulated her into spending a night with Chris Hensley, resulting in her pregnancy. Louis then married Yvonne to keep her under control, causing her to forsake her identity and sever ties with her family. Yvonne believes Louis' lie that her baby has died. However, Louis ultimately betrays her for another woman, pressuring her into accepting a divorce.

dramabox.title: Love on Air: Ready to Broadcast!
dramabox.norm_title: love on air ready to broadcast
dramabox.description: What happens when the CEO of an entertainment company marries the top agent in secret? With each passing day, the urge to make an official announcement of their marriage intensifies in his heart.

dramabox.title: I Wish It Were You
dramabox.norm_title: i wish it were you
dramabox.description: Bound by a family alliance, Isabel found herself reluctantly married to a stranger named Jared. Despite being wed for a year, their encounters were so scarce they could barely recall each other's faces. As Isabel navigated her new life at work, she unexpectedly fell deeply for her boss—the billionaire Lorenzo Bellini. Through a series of jaw-dropping twists, Isabel was stunned to discover that the captivating Lorenzo was, in fact, her husband Jared in name...

dramabox.title: From Red Carpet to Dirt Road
dramabox.norm_title: from red carpet to dirt road
dramabox.description: Yvonne Shaw was a popular celebrity before she accidentally travels back in time and becomes a villager in the 1980s, where she gets caught red-handed in an affair by her fiancé. However, this is all part of her fiancé’s scheme to call off their marriage! To preserve her reputation, Yvonne decides to marry the man she was found in bed with, unaware that her seemingly ordinary husband is the director of the Steelworks Factory!

dramabox.title: Happily Ever After: Spoiled by My Billionaire Husband
dramabox.norm_title: happily ever after spoiled by my billionaire husband
dramabox.description: Abby Yates is devastated when she discovers her sister and fiancé's affair. Driven by impulse, she hastily marries Levi Lawson, a billionaire she barely knows, and their lives plunge into a whirlwind of dramatic twists and turns. With newfound determination, Abby fights back against those who have taken advantage of her, reclaiming what rightfully belongs to her. Levi stands by her side, offering unwavering support as she faces bullying and oppression from her own family.

dramabox.title: Pampered by My Ex-husband's Billionaire Friend
dramabox.norm_title: pampered by my ex husband s billionaire friend
dramabox.description: After a divorce with the CEO of Paul Corp, Edith Cohen leaves with a fortune in her hands and offers a handsome pay to whoever she deems fit to father her child. Her assistant introduces her to a male model who seems perfect in every aspect—except that he is her ex-husband’s friend, the powerful and ruthless CEO, Roman Kent! Rumor has it that he rarely involves himself with women, so why did he agree to the offer? Meanwhile, her ex-husband unexpectedly proposes remarriage.

dramabox.title: Unveiling Ms. Lynch's Secret Identities
dramabox.norm_title: unveiling ms lynch s secret identities
dramabox.description: After her father's passing, Yancy Lynch, a girl from the countryside, is brought to the city by the affluent Watson family, who had arranged her marriage. Mr. Watson allows her to choose from his three sons, and the selected one receives a twenty percent stake in Watson Corporation. The city is abuzz with talk, and online users claim she's not worthy.

dramabox.title: Oops! I married a CEO by mistake
dramabox.norm_title: oops i married a ceo by mistake
dramabox.description: Abigail lies dead in the hospital, while her fiancé Kyle and stepsister Chloe gloat over their murder of her.	Overhearing their evil plan, Abigail later comes back to life and immediately marries a broke model named Henry as revenge.	Abigail thinks her marriage is all just a play, but when she faces betrayal and difficulties, Henry secretly helps her. However, just as things are getting real between them, she finds out a shocking secret about Henry’s identity...

dramabox.title: Oops! Mr. Lawson Got the Wrong Girl
dramabox.norm_title: oops mr lawson got the wrong girl
dramabox.description: After a round of drinks, Sara Joy, an intern at Lawson Corp, acts under the influence of alcohol and has a one-night stand with her boss, Ted Lawson. Upon waking up, she leaves immediately unnoticed but fails to cut ties cleanly as she accidentally leaves her best friend’s resume in the room. Taking advantage of this, Mandy Fox impersonates Sara and moves into Pine View, living under the same roof as Ted.Meanwhile, Sara hopes to maintain a low profile as an ordinary intern.

dramabox.title: Back to the 80s
dramabox.norm_title: back to the 80s
dramabox.description: Julie Stein wakes up from her sleep, expecting just another ordinary day. However, to her surprise, she finds herself in the 80s, a totally different era from where she belongs. Not only is she a disowned daughter of a wealthy family to whom she has no blood connection, but she is also supposed to marry an old man with two children, in place of the family’s biological daughter.

dramabox.title: From Acquaintance To Forever
dramabox.norm_title: from acquaintance to forever
dramabox.description: On the day Elis Fields saves Tristan Sharp’s life, her father brings his mistress and illegitimate daughter to the house. He forces Elis' mother to sign the divorce papers and expels them from the Fields family. Devastated, Elis’s mother ends up in the hospital. Desperate for funds for medical expenses, Elis seeks help from various people, but to no avail. With no other option, she approaches her father and his mistress for assistance.

dramabox.title: Blessed with Twins: Mysterious Daddy Spoils Big Time
dramabox.norm_title: blessed with twins mysterious daddy spoils big time
dramabox.description: Cute kids helped their genius doctor mom with her job, and a cool, domineering president showed up to beg for a place to stay.

dramabox.title: Love's GPS: Tracking You Down
dramabox.norm_title: love s gps tracking you down
dramabox.description: After her parents' divorce and her father's subsequent remarriage, Yvonne Hawkins found herself grappling with the overwhelming burden of covering her mother's mounting medical bills. In a moment of desperation, she turned to her boyfriend for financial aid, only to be callously betrayed as he sold her off to a wealthy older man.In her frantic attempt to escape, Yvonne accidentally barged into Juvian Scott's room.

dramabox.title: Love on Top: The Commander's Remorse
dramabox.norm_title: love on top the commander s remorse
dramabox.description: Sonia Goodwin witnessed the brutal murder of her biological mother by her father and stepmother at a young age. The Armstrongs were the ones who saved her from her terrible situation. After she grew up, she vowed to return to the Goodwins to avenge her mother. In the process of doing that, she met Caelan Wright, the young Commander of the Governor’s Mansion.

dramabox.title: In Love with Mr. Mysterious
dramabox.norm_title: in love with mr mysterious
dramabox.description: To escape her parents' relentless pressure for her to marry, Selina Smith hastily enters into a marriage with Calvin Craig, a man known for his frugality.She needs someone to do her house chores, after all. Hence, marrying a handsome man who will do it for her seems to be a pretty good deal. As they settle into their new home, they strike a deal: Selina focuses on her career while Calvin takes charge of domestic duties.

dramabox.title: When the Superstar Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: when the superstar strikes back
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Mira Jade's life crumbled when a devious couple plotted against her, resulting in the loss of everything she held dear. In a twist of fate, she found herself endowed with the safeguard of a Superstar System.Now, half a decade later, Mira returns in a blaze of splendor. Determined and resolute, she sets out on a path of vengeance, making it clear that she will settle scores with those who orchestrated her downfall.

dramabox.title: Unexpected Knot: My Husband Is a Tycoon
dramabox.norm_title: unexpected knot my husband is a tycoon
dramabox.description: Forced into marriage by her manager at the shoe store, Olivia Sullivan quickly weds a divorced father with two kids. While she expects an ordinary married life, she soon discovers that her husband is, in fact, the wealthiest man in the city!

dramabox.title: Wham, Bam, Love Struck Here
dramabox.norm_title: wham bam love struck here
dramabox.description: Dressed in plain attire, Joel Price is about to visit his grandmother when he is hit by a car driven by Melody Carson near a guard post. Melody thinks she ran over a security guard and is dismissive of him, but the kind-hearted Mary Carson brings him to the hospital. When Mary visits her mom, Joel's mom takes a liking to her and wants to make Mary her granddaughter-in-law. However, Mary refuses.

dramabox.title: Shadows and Roses
dramabox.norm_title: shadows and roses
dramabox.description: Aelia Brown once believed she was blissfully wedded to the perfect man for three years, only to realize that he was the one who orchestrated her life's downfall. Under the facade of marriage, he cunningly played with her emotions and plotted to take over her family's fortune. Even the child she carried became his pawn. Reborn into a new life, Aelia is determined to tarnish his reputation and exact revenge on those who caused her harm!

dramabox.title: Unscripted Romance: In Love With My Substitute Wife
dramabox.norm_title: unscripted romance in love with my substitute wife
dramabox.description: To help her sister Lena Taylor elope, Yvette Taylor reluctantly agrees to her stepfather Michael Taylor's request to marry into the Jones family on Lena's behalf.

dramabox.title: Fated to Encounter
dramabox.norm_title: fated to encounter
dramabox.description: Bebe Long not only confronts betrayal from her boyfriend but also weathers slander from his mistress. Frustrated, she finds herself in a situation where she ends up sleeping with a man she believed her bestie had arranged for her—unaware that he's actually a big shot. Surprisingly, the man showers her with affection, and they even have a flash marriage. Little does Bebe know that the shotgun marriage is all part of the man's plan.

dramabox.title: Boundless Romance: Allure Behind the Masks
dramabox.norm_title: boundless romance allure behind the masks
dramabox.description: Everyone thinks Sophie Lewis is nothing more than an ordinary and extremely unattractive person. Little do others know that behind her unassuming facade, she not only wields the power of a mysterious CEO but also conceals a rare beauty. Eventually, she marries a man thought to be physically challenged, only to discover later that he is, in fact, a wealthy and able-bodied billionaire.

dramabox.title: She’s the Apple of Their Eye（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: she s the apple of their eye dubbed
dramabox.description: Emily, the daughter of the illustrious Porter family, had her world upended when she learned she wasn't her parents' biological daughter. When the true Porter family heiress returned to claim her birthright, Emily was kicked out of the family. After rejoining her biological family, she discovered she was the heiress of the nation's wealthiest dynasty. She had five exceptional brothers who showered her with affection, two adoring parents, and a wealthy CEO fiancé.

dramabox.title: The Dare That Bites
dramabox.norm_title: the dare that bites
dramabox.description: What Jane Horner regrets the most is getting entangled with her unfaithful fiancé's elder brother, Sean Young, to retaliate against him. Initially, she plans to provoke her fiancé, James Young, and leave as soon as it's done.  While Jane tries to escape, Sean keeps getting closer to her. Later, someone witnesses Sean, the rumored unruly man, holding an umbrella for someone on a rainy night, with half of his body soaked by the rain.

dramabox.title: Flash Marriage with My Werewolf Husband
dramabox.norm_title: flash marriage with my werewolf husband
dramabox.description: To escape her abusive stepfather, Lisa takes the offer from a law firm in New York, where she unexpectedly flash-marries her boss. As she juggles work, she wants to bring the werewolf who once attacked her to justice, her boss becomes more and more suspicious… Caught between his mounting suspicion and her undeniable attraction to him, Lisa struggles with her next move.

dramabox.title: Your Bride Is A Hunter, My Vampire Lord
dramabox.norm_title: your bride is a hunter my vampire lord
dramabox.description: Vampire hunter Bianca's mission: pose as a vampire bride and assassinate a millennia-old vampire. To succeed, she must make Elijah fall in love to weaken his heart. However, she discovers he's not the evil creature she thought; his purity rivals humans. Unknowingly, Bianca falls for her target.

dramabox.title: In Love With My Money-Minded Wife
dramabox.norm_title: in love with my money minded wife
dramabox.description: In an attempt to extract information from Jake Swartz, Tracey Cornell reluctantly agrees to a two-year marriage with his grandson, Arthur Swartz. Initially, Arthur and Tracey harbor mutual dislike, with plans to divorce after two years. Yet, to Arthur's surprise, he unexpectedly falls in love with Tracey, previously believing his affections were reserved solely for his childhood savior. Following a series of incidents, he realizes his genuine feelings for Tracey.

dramabox.title: Where Our Love Unfolds
dramabox.norm_title: where our love unfolds
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Olivia Steward fell victim to a scheme and found herself abandoned by a man who, in haste, left behind a token and disappeared. Now, five years later, she ventures into the city with her twin children to make a living.Whether she's selling alcohol or working as a cleaner, that man appears to be the influential figure in charge. Even during her visits home to see her family, he unexpectedly shows up!

dramabox.title: A Second Chance at Love
dramabox.norm_title: a second chance at love
dramabox.description: Luna Caddel thought she had wedded a perfect man. Unbeknownst to her, the man conspired with her cousin to destroy her family and pushed her to her doom. After a rebirth, she resolves to ruin the despicable pair and tear the man’s family asunder. Therefore, her first action is to reject the scum and marry her nemesis. Unexpectedly, her once mortal enemy lavishes her with great affection in marriage.

dramabox.title: When A Substitute Wife Seeks To Lose Favor
dramabox.norm_title: when a substitute wife seeks to lose favor
dramabox.description: Stella Payne, the second daughter of the Paynes, acts dumb to uncover the truth behind her mother's death.On the way to the arranged marriage, Stella falls victim to a car accident orchestrated by her stepmother but is rescued by Joseph Chambers. Unbeknownst to her, Joseph is the heir of the prestigious Chambers family and the secret owner of Shadow Villa. As the revenge plan unfolds, their interactions lead to a mutual understanding.

dramabox.title: Love Blooms in Contracted Hearts（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: love blooms in contracted hearts dubbed
dramabox.description: One tipsy night at a company getaway, Cecilia Caine and Liam Lamberth unexpectedly hooked up. However, she was aware that the CEO had feelings for someone else, so she quietly slipped away, thinking their night meant nothing. Little did she know, Liam had different plans—he wanted to marry her. Desperate for cash, Cecilia reluctantly agreed and endured his unreasonable demands.

dramabox.title: Adorable Quinn
dramabox.norm_title: adorable quinn
dramabox.description: In the face of familial pressure, Quinn Astor finds herself in dire need of money. Enticed by the promise of a handsome salary, she cleverly disguises herself as a man to secure the position of the president's assistant at a globally renowned top-500 company. Meanwhile, the president, Albert Miller, driven by his grandmother's relentless matchmaking endeavors, decides to hire a male assistant to fend off her attempts.

dramabox.title: A Woman Scorned（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: a woman scorned dubbed
dramabox.description: Carynn Hughes was always the black sheep of her family. Her father did not like her, her stepmother was cruel, and her stepsister seduced her fiancee, Archiebald Murray. After a chance encounter with the powerful Jayden Lewis and his ill grandfather on the same day, she was given the opportunity to start a new life. Although her parents blamed her for Archiebald’s affair with her stepsister, Carynn manages to turn them into the town’s laughingstock during their engagement.

dramabox.title: Spoiling My Sweet Wife to Her Core（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: spoiling my sweet wife to her core dubbed
dramabox.description: On the day of the engagement, Anne Miller was framed in a cheating scandal. Her fiance, Shawn Smith, was furious and vowed never to marry Anne. She knew that her pretentious step-sister, Elsa Miller, was the mastermind behind it all. Shawn believed entirely in Elsa's lies. Devastated, Anne died with resentment and regret.A soul of a heroine—who shared the same name as Anne—transmigrated into Anne Miller's body and swore to avenge her.

dramabox.title: Princess Rowena Lance
dramabox.norm_title: princess rowena lance
dramabox.description: When the young Rowena Lance met Caspian Humpfrey, a captivating and unforgettable young man, she gave everything up and decided to follow him to the Great Avendell in the name of love. However, a tragic misunderstanding and a power struggle for the Great Avendell throne tore the two young lovebirds apart.

dramabox.title: To My Future Wife
dramabox.norm_title: to my future wife
dramabox.description: On Mia Park's first day at Wilson Group, she married a man she had only met once, fulfilling her grandmother's wish. However, her husband, Tim Shaw, disappeared right after the marriage and never reappeared. Left alone, Mia quickly moved on and focused on her career.“That's outrageous! After a year of disappearance, the first thing he wants upon his return is a divorce? What on earth? Fine, let’s get a divorce!” Mia complained, then noticed something peculiar.

dramabox.title: Apple of His Eyes
dramabox.norm_title: apple of his eyes
dramabox.description: Bryson Hunt, the heir of Capital City's top family—the Hunt family, had been searching for the girl who had rescued his life for years. The girl had given Bryson one half of an emerald pendant, while she kept the other half. When Bryson got word that the girl was in Tolm City, he secretly hurried to Tolm City. At the same time, Celeste Johnson was betrayed by her fiance, Zach Lore, and her older sister, Queenie Johnson.

dramabox.title: Married a Secret Millionaire as a Substitute
dramabox.norm_title: married a secret millionaire as a substitute
dramabox.description: In order to pay for her mother's medical expenses, Olivia Walker, the illegitimate child of the Walker family, marries a poor ex-convict in place of her sister. She has no idea that this man is, in fact, Andrew Smith, the richest person in Cascadia. Their lives then take a sweet but dangerous turn.

dramabox.title: A Woman Scorned
dramabox.norm_title: a woman scorned
dramabox.description: Carynn Hughes was always the black sheep of her family. Her father did not like her, her stepmother was cruel, and her stepsister seduced her fiancee, Archiebald Murray. After a chance encounter with the powerful Jayden Lewis and his ill grandfather on the same day, she was given the opportunity to start a new life. Although her parents blamed her for Archiebald’s affair with her stepsister, Carynn manages to turn them into the town’s laughingstock during their engagement.

dramabox.title: She’s the Apple of Their Eye
dramabox.norm_title: she s the apple of their eye
dramabox.description: Emily, the daughter of the illustrious Porter family, had her world upended when she learned she wasn't her parents' biological daughter. When the true Porter family heiress returned to claim her birthright, Emily was kicked out of the family. After rejoining her biological family, she discovered she was the heiress of the nation's wealthiest dynasty. She had five exceptional brothers who showered her with affection, two adoring parents, and a wealthy CEO fiancé.

dramabox.title: Spoiled by My Husband, Whom I Married Unintentionally
dramabox.norm_title: spoiled by my husband whom i married unintentionally
dramabox.description: Quincy Yates endured a childhood of neglect. Her parents planned to marry her off to a wealthy old man. During her escape from this unwanted future, Quincy's path intersected with that of James Xavier, the CEO of Xavier Corp. With his help, she confronted her contemptuous parents and reprimanded her scheming foster sister. Ultimately, she discovered that she was the long-lost daughter of the esteemed Harrison family, destined to find wealth in both love and familial bonds!

dramabox.title: Sweetheart Wife
dramabox.norm_title: sweetheart wife
dramabox.description: Four years ago, Queenie Young was framed by Sandy Young and driven abroad by her father. She coincidentally rescued Shane Lawson abroad.Returning home four years later, Queenie found her fiance, Sam Fowler, cheating on her with Sandy. She impulsively married her best friend, Xander Lawson, but Xander took the wrong ID card because he was drunk. They accidentally registered Queenie's marriage with the male lead, Shane.

dramabox.title: Two Wives for Double The Sweetness
dramabox.norm_title: two wives for double the sweetness
dramabox.description: Cece Lawrence was robbed of her child, identity, and lover by her twin sister... Zaid Bander realized the truth behind all of this after it was too late, and it was not as simple as it seemed.

dramabox.title: Daddy, We’re Secret Billionaires
dramabox.norm_title: daddy we re secret billionaires
dramabox.description: Seven-year-old genius Daisy hides her identity as heir to a top-tier family. Secretly manipulating stocks and a conglomerate, she quietly supports her ordinary father, Richard—humiliating the rich kids who look down on him and helping him get closer to Lila. In the end, she reveals herself as the wealthiest shadow figure, shaking Los Angeles business circles.

dramabox.title: Bound to Three Alpha Wolf Kings
dramabox.norm_title: bound to three alpha wolf kings
dramabox.description: Celeste, last heir of the Moon Witch bloodline, is abducted by Alpha King Silas—one of three wolf kings cursed by Feral Madness. Their only hope is their shared fated mate: her. Trapped and forcibly marked, she plots escape with her imprisoned grandmother. A relic backfires, leaving her pregnant with triplets by all three kings. To protect them, she awakens her Black-Winged Witch powers, crushes the invading army, saves the Bloodpack, and is crowned Wolf-Queen.

dramabox.title: The Exiled Luna and Her Golden-Eyed Daughter
dramabox.norm_title: the exiled luna and her golden eyed daughter
dramabox.description: Cast out by her Alpha husband with her "wolfless" daughter, Selene is left with nothing. But her daughter Lyra possesses the legendary Golden Sight, allowing her to see treasures hidden beneath worthless stones. As mother and daughter strike one fortune after another, the pack that abandoned them soon realizes—they threw away their greatest treasure.

dramabox.title: Kneel! The Truth Desert Seraph Awakens
dramabox.norm_title: kneel the truth desert seraph awakens
dramabox.description: Branded a child of calamity, Seraphina was abandoned in the Endless Desert by her own mother and left to die. Years later, she returns to the Holy City, where her adopted sister Vivian is worshipped as the chosen savior. But when the cursed outcast survives execution by fire and awakens as the legendary Six-Winged Seraph, everything changes. Now, the girl everyone feared must claim her destiny—and prove that the true savior was never Vivian.

dramabox.title: The Sex Tape Wasn't Mine
dramabox.norm_title: the sex tape wasn t mine
dramabox.description: When top saleswoman Sophia Carter is framed with a scandalous sex tape, she fights through public humiliation, betrayal, and corporate corruption to expose the real woman on screen, uncover a deadly conspiracy, and build a company where no woman must trade her dignity for success.

dramabox.title: Claimed by the Gangster Queen
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by the gangster queen
dramabox.description: A rogue mob heiress kills the Iron Fang boss, crashes into a girl, and gets shot mid-chase. With the girl's help, she digs the bullet out raw. Betrayed all her life, she falls for the girl's quiet kindness. She protects her from thugs, but the girl's blind sister warns her away. Her father forces her to marry his pick—or he'll destroy everything she loves. She'll fight the underworld to keep her—but will it be enough?

dramabox.title: Stolen Royal Blood: From Colosseum Prey to Imperial Princess
dramabox.norm_title: stolen royal blood from colosseum prey to imperial princess
dramabox.description: During Princess Valeria's succession rites, Queen Helena is betrayed and framed by her husband Marcus and sister Cassia—who feed the girl to beasts. Helena saves her daughter but is enslaved. Rescued by Emperor Titus, Valeria becomes Rome's finest warrior. Eighteen years later, she returns to Strigium, uncovering a conspiracy of family and foes. Her quest for truth becomes vengeance—and the reclamation of her throne.

dramabox.title: Reborn Queen
dramabox.norm_title: reborn queen
dramabox.description: Chloe Blackwood spent twenty years building a global empire, only to be stabbed and left to die by her housekeeper Marta—while her husband and three daughters believed the lies and abandoned her. When she wakes three years in the past, she cuts ties with her ungrateful family, ends their financial support, and starts over with the two people who truly care for her. Armed with memories of her past life, she builds a new empire.

dramabox.title: Wolf of Wall Street’s Girl
dramabox.norm_title: wolf of wall street s girl
dramabox.description: Chloe, a top anchor and legendary designer "Miss Y," saved teen Leo years ago, then funded him for three years before ending it with a cheque. Leo is actually Liam Sterling, Wall Street's all-powerful tycoon. Their reunion sparks his pursuit. Chloe battles her cheating fiancé, a fake heiress, and her biased family—clearing her mother's murder conviction. Liam reveals his seven-year secret love and stands by her. They defeat all foes, marry, and welcome their son.

dramabox.title: Brains! Love! Success! She Takes It All!
dramabox.norm_title: brains love success she takes it all
dramabox.description: When Renata Jennings can't stand losing to brilliant Juniper Keaton, she makes her charming childhood friend, Neil, seduce Juniper and ruin her focus. But Juniper is three steps ahead, playing the perfect mark. As Renata gets ready to expose Juniper's downfall on results day, she has no idea the real trap has already been set for her. What was meant to be revenge may become her ultimate humiliation.

dramabox.title: The Hidden Heiress Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: the hidden heiress strikes back
dramabox.description: Vivian Tyler, world's top billionaire and sole heiress, builds her penniless husband Julian into a business tycoon. But at a grand opening, his mistress Bianca publicly humiliates Vivian via viral livestream, exposing the betrayal. Disillusioned, Vivian no longer hides her identity. She exposes Julian and Bianca's hypocrisy—and destroys the very empire she built for him.

dramabox.title: From Wild Beast to House Pet My Beast Tamer Wife
dramabox.norm_title: from wild beast to house pet my beast tamer wife
dramabox.description: Wealthy heir Andrew is forced to marry Jayda—a wild animal tamer who once saved his family. He's cold and rule-bound; she's fierce and untamed. They clash nonstop—until a mountain race reveals her as a track goddess. When a landslide traps him, she pulls off an impossible save. In that moment, Andrew's icy heart shatters. The untamed beast meets her match—and he surrenders, tamed by her alone.

dramabox.title: After I Remarried, My Wolf Men Brothers Went Mad
dramabox.norm_title: after i remarried my wolf men brothers went mad
dramabox.description: Brianna, a frail werewolf princess, is guarded by Jaren and Colin, who vowed to marry her. They later make a wager, pretending to pursue Zoe to test her. Zoe exploits this, poisoning Brianna with peanuts. Blinded, Jaren and Colin abuse and imprison her. Desperate, Brianna flees to Marcus, the Vampire Monarch—her childhood betrothed. He heals her, sees her suffering, and marries her. At their wedding, Jaren, Colin, and Zoe are stunned to see the bride is Brianna.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire's Super-Strong Nanny
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire s super strong nanny
dramabox.description: After saving her ungrateful fiancé's life only to be betrayed, super-strong Nora becomes a nanny to a billionaire's traumatized son. Her courage and kindness heal the boy, win over his guarded father, and help her reclaim her career, dignity, and a family of her own.

dramabox.title: They Called Me Trash—I'm the Creator
dramabox.norm_title: they called me trash i m the creator
dramabox.description: Mocked as a worthless turtle and betrayed by her dragon fiancé, orphan Lucia awakens as the legendary Black Tortoise—and the lost Creator. At a brutal beast academy, she exposes stolen bloodlines, crushes every trap, rejects a faithless love, and rewrites a world where birth determines worth.

dramabox.title: The Intern They Humiliated Is the True Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the intern they humiliated is the true heiress
dramabox.description: Clarissa Vanderbilt goes undercover as an intern at her family’s luxury jewelry salon—only to be humiliated, assaulted, and framed for theft by a cruel manager and a fake heiress. But every insult is caught on camera. When Clarissa finally reveals her true identity before millions of viewers, the impostors’ lies collapse, exposing a conspiracy that reaches deep into her own family. Now, the real heiress is ready to reclaim her empire.

dramabox.title: The Lycan King's Hunter Mate
dramabox.norm_title: the lycan king s hunter mate
dramabox.description: Betrayed, Chloe flash-marries Sebastian—secret Lycan heir. She mistakes him for her father's killer. He saves her, but she loses their baby. Blackened, she shatters fake heir Alexander's schemes, outmaneuvers him, traps him into confessing murder, and strips him of power. With Sebastian, she defies blood laws and becomes queen.

dramabox.title: Bird in A Cage
dramabox.norm_title: bird in a cage
dramabox.description: Chloe, a pet trainer, is treated as a useless trophy wife by tech billionaire Adrian. On their divorce day, he crashes and suffers cognitive dislocation—now he only responds to her pet commands. Once the humiliated ex-wife, she's now the only one who can control him. Forced to stay, she finally confronts all the buried wounds of their broken marriage.

dramabox.title: Her Obedience Buried, Her Wrath Awakened
dramabox.norm_title: her obedience buried her wrath awakened
dramabox.description: Wrongfully framed and killed by Chloe Carter in her past life, Claire Carter is reborn with a firm resolve. She refuses to be the docile, powerless girl who lets others manipulate her anymore. Determined to expose Chloe’s hypocritical true colors to her family, Claire decides to fight fire with fire against the scheming adopted sister. Soon after returning home, she once again falls victim to Chloe’s deliberate framing and sabotage.

dramabox.title: The Janitor Mom is a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: the janitor mom is a billionaire
dramabox.description: Miranda's the richest woman alive, but she played janitor for 20 years to raise Clara right. Then Clara gets bullied by spoiled rich girl Ashley: ice water dumped on her, cake smashed in her face, and her mom's necklace thrown in the fire. Tyler flips the blame. Necklace red-hot, inches from her face, then Mom storms in with her crew and wrecks everyone.

dramabox.title: One night with my billionaire CEO
dramabox.norm_title: one night with my billionaire ceo
dramabox.description: Everyone treats Bella like a doormat—she never dares to refuse. One drunken night, she accidentally conceives the child of a top conglomerate CEO. A contract marriage pulls her into a wealthy family. Once a pushover, she now refuses to be manipulated. She sheds her people-pleasing mask, fights against family power struggles, and grows into her own person. Will she stay a caged wife—or rise and shine on her own terms?

dramabox.title: The Abyss: A Mother’s Wrath
dramabox.norm_title: the abyss a mother s wrath
dramabox.description: Erin, a former military experiment codenamed "Abyss," has two personalities: gentle Erin and bloodthirsty psychic Abyss. She suppressed her powers for three years to see her deaf daughter Sophie. But her daughter is killed by greedy relatives. The news shatters her—Abyss fully awakens. Red eyes burn in the dark. This time, she stops holding back. Revenge is her only choice.

dramabox.title: Anaconda Island: A Nest of Lies
dramabox.norm_title: anaconda island a nest of lies
dramabox.description: Karin thinks her fiancé Wilford is proposing on a private island—but he's brought her as bait. A BioGene scientist, he lures a giant python with their body heat. As eggs hatch and a larger mate hunts them, Karin must stop being prey. With wounded hunter Gerry, she fights to survive. She kills Wilford, escapes—but the real nightmare begins when she realizes the island's terror may have already reached the mainland.

dramabox.title: Beneath the Halo
dramabox.norm_title: beneath the halo
dramabox.description: Seraphina Thorne, heir to the Thorne family, is imprisoned by her uncle's family for five years. Her songs and works are stolen by her cousin. To protect her sister Lia, she feigns madness, gathers evidence, and summons Lucion—the judgment angel she saved fifteen years ago. Together, they expose the fraud, reclaim her inheritance, and uncover a forbidden human ritual conspiracy hidden within the Holy Court.

dramabox.title: The Starving Little Girl Who Saved Her Tribe
dramabox.norm_title: the starving little girl who saved her tribe
dramabox.description: During the ice age, four-year-old Alya, an orphan with her mother's bone-carved wolf fang necklace, travels to the modern world. She brings back food, clothes, tools, and medical knowledge to her dying tribe. Trading bone carvings for supplies, she leads her people from hunger to prosperity, heals old hatreds, and grows into a top surgeon. She discovers a mysterious bloodline connection between the two worlds.

dramabox.title: Unsilenced：Soul Slaughters
dramabox.norm_title: unsilenced soul slaughters
dramabox.description: Six-year-old genius Ella survives a serial killer's attack. Twenty years later, as a top prosecutor, she recognizes his signature in new murders. Haunted but unbroken, she hunts the demon who destroyed her childhood. After a deadly cat-and-mouse game, she brings him to justice. Her triumph goes beyond vengeance—she spearheads legal reform to ensure such predators never escape punishment. The victim becomes the architect of justice.

dramabox.title: Stars Secret Keeper
dramabox.norm_title: stars secret keeper
dramabox.description: Julian Thorne, a lonely Hollywood actor and wealthy heir, is trapped by his controlling family. Aria Miller, a photography student, becomes his assistant to save her family. Through her lens, she sees his true self; he secretly protects her. Fighting his mother's schemes and class barriers, they heal each other, break free, and find love in the light.

dramabox.title: Hidden Heiress & Secret Vow
dramabox.norm_title: hidden heiress secret vow
dramabox.description: Struggling lawyer Anna signs a secret marriage contract with cold heir Lucas to save her dying mother. Thrown into a power struggle for inheritance, she faces relentless attacks from her stepmother, ex-fiancée, and family conspiracies. From suspicion and rivalry to standing together, they tear open the family's dark secrets, break free from chains, and choose to walk side by side—as equals.

dramabox.title: Heiress? Wait, I'm Also the Class Genius（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: heiress wait i m also the class genius dubbed
dramabox.description: Park Seung-ji is raised in an orphanage and studies relentlessly to gain admission to Kaldor University Law School and become a prosecutor. After an accident reveals that she is the true heiress of the wealthy Kim family, she is snubbed by her relatives and framed by the fake daughter who has taken her place. Despite it all, she ranks at the top of her law school class and achieves perfect exam scores with Han Tae-young's help.

dramabox.title: The Zero-Talent Nanny Raised Beast Kings
dramabox.norm_title: the zero talent nanny raised beast kings
dramabox.description: Thrown into a beast-filled alien world with zero magic or combat skills, preschool teacher Mia Harper must save a notorious, nearly bankrupt academy—or lose her soul. Her students are five powerful cubs branded dangerous, unwanted, or uncontrollable. As ruthless nobles, corrupt officials, and old scandals threaten to tear them apart, Mia fights to protect the children, rebuild their broken school, and prove that care can be stronger than any bloodline.

dramabox.title: Sorry, No Dragon Heiress Here
dramabox.norm_title: sorry no dragon heiress here
dramabox.description: Sera is the lowest servant at a dragon riders' academy—a girl whose blood is so tainted that no dragon would ever choose her. But when that same "poison" blood hatches the legendary Sovereign dragon egg, the powerless maid becomes the most dangerous woman in the realm. Now hunted by the very lords who once spat on her, Sera must claim a destiny written in blood—and make every enemy who wronged her pay.

dramabox.title: Exiled at Ten, Returned as the Beast Empress
dramabox.norm_title: exiled at ten returned as the beast empress
dramabox.description: Banished to the frozen north as a child hostage, Kaira returns ten years later as the Frostcrown Queen, ruler of twelve beast clans. Armed with hidden wealth, loyal warriors, and a royal bloodline, she enters a hostile court to reclaim her throne, expose a dark conspiracy, and make every traitor pay.

dramabox.title: Pregnant with the Curse Dragon King's Triplets
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant with the curse dragon king s triplets
dramabox.description: Poor herbalist Ella goes to an underground auction to save her dying mother and accidentally has a one‑night encounter with Dragon Emperor Kellan, who suffers a sterile curse. Surprisingly, she bears three dragon eggs. Facing slander from her ex‑lover Leon, schemes of nobles and royal rebellion, Ella relies on her courage and potion talent. Kellan gradually learns to love and protect her.

dramabox.title: I Came to Fight, Now Cherished by Billionaires
dramabox.norm_title: i came to fight now cherished by billionaires
dramabox.description: Tough-minded Gemma endures a brutal foster childhood until her billionaire birth parents bring her home. Unused to kindness, she struggles to fit in. Ian's arrogant girlfriend Bella bullies her, even knocking Sunny unconscious when she tries to protect Gemma. Pushed too far, Gemma fights back, igniting a massive family conflict.

dramabox.title: Reborn Heiress Taking Back What’s Mine
dramabox.norm_title: reborn heiress taking back what s mine
dramabox.description: Her father and best friend betrayed her at her mother's funeral. They stole everything—her home, her dignity, her mother's ashes. They forced her to kneel and eat off the floor. But Anna had one thing they didn't know: her mother's will. On her 18th birthday, she took it all back. Then she let them destroy themselves—spending, lying, betraying each other. When they broke, she didn't kneel. She stood. Winning isn't about making them kneel. It's about never kneeling again.

dramabox.title: Kicked Out On My Wedding, My ONS Billionaire Spoils Me
dramabox.norm_title: kicked out on my wedding my ons billionaire spoils me
dramabox.description:
Midway through our ring exchange, my mother clanged a silver spoon against her wine glass, drawing everyone’s gaze. She loudly claimed I earned money filming adult films.
My fiancé flew into a rage, striking me across the face and slipping my wedding ring onto my sister’s hand. My mother fabricated the vicious lie and drugged me to sabotage the wedding, plotting to replace me with my sister so she could land this wealthy husband.

dramabox.title: His Game, My Rules
dramabox.norm_title: his game my rules
dramabox.description: Claire, a project director, is ruined by a trap contract—then murdered by her husband Ethan and his boss Vanessa after catching them together. Reborn two days before signing, she doesn't strike fast. Instead, she uses compliance, contracts, and evidence as weapons across marriage, business, and criminal fronts—making the betrayers destroy everything they desired.

dramabox.title: My Three Knights Killed Me,Then Fell for Me
dramabox.norm_title: my three knights killed me then fell for me
dramabox.description: They nailed her to a cross and watched her die. Now she's trapped in a seven-day loop—forgiven by her three knights, or dead forever. Alice doesn't kneel. She unlocks their power, takes the hits meant for them, and drags them through poison, fire, and salt. By the time they reach the sanctuary, they've stopped hunting her. They're fighting to keep her. But the final seal isn't blood—it's truth. And the one person who hasn't forgiven Alice... is Alice herself.

dramabox.title: You Chose My Twin, I Chose the Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: you chose my twin i chose the billionaire
dramabox.description: All her life, Sarah Carter has been treated as her twin sister's replacement. When her fiancé lets Vivian steal her wedding, career, and even identity, Sarah finally walks away. In London, she rebuilds her future, finds her own voice, and meets billionaire Alexander Whitmore. But as her past comes chasing after her, Sarah must prove that she belongs to no one—and that choosing herself is the greatest victory of all.

dramabox.title: Falling For Her: Trapped by My Obsessed  Billionaire Ex
dramabox.norm_title: falling for her trapped by my obsessed billionaire ex
dramabox.description: Years ago, Alice was forced to abandon her girlfriend Vivian. Now Vivian is a billionaire, while Alice is destitute—her husband Charles drove her father to death and seized the fortune. Hiding her identity, Alice takes a job and accidentally becomes Vivian's private muse. They rekindle, team up to take down Charles, reclaim Alice's legacy, and finally tie the knot.

dramabox.title: Trash the Pilot, Marry the Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: trash the pilot marry the billionaire
dramabox.description: Claire, the anonymous hero captain who once saved hundreds on Flight Pearl, hid her identity and supported her fiancé Leo for six years. On his promotion day, Leo embraced Samantha and tossed Claire aside. Heartbroken, she ended it and agreed to an arranged marriage with Wyatt Sterling, billionaire CEO of the Airline Group.

dramabox.title: Oops, The Mafia King is Trapped in My Body
dramabox.norm_title: oops the mafia king is trapped in my body
dramabox.description: What happens when a broke college student and a billionaire mafia boss accidentally swap bodies? The answer: absolute chaos. I’m Chloe, and I’ve just woken up as Lorenzo Moretti—the most dangerous man in the city. While I’m busy rocking his custom suits, blowing through his millions, and dodging assassins, that arrogant mob boss is trapped in my body, enduring the torment of mean girls at university!

dramabox.title: Forbidden Pulse in the Rain
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden pulse in the rain
dramabox.description: Sam's brother dies. Her boyfriend Noah and best friend Olivia murder her, staging suicide. She time-travels back to university with mind-reading powers. Aaron, also reborn, senses her danger. With his protection and their growing bond, Sam exposes the traitors, transforms her life, and rises from victim to queen.

dramabox.title: Jailbreak: Cat Heiress Outclawed
dramabox.norm_title: jailbreak cat heiress outclawed
dramabox.description: Wrongly convicted heiress Piper La'Paw breaks out of Scratchgate Penitentiary after learning her father has been kidnapped. Hunted across Purr Haven, she joins forces with her loyal childhood friend Huntley and an unlikely crew of feline criminals. To save her father and reclaim her name, Piper must expose a deadly conspiracy involving her scheming stepmother and the former fiancé who betrayed her.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Desire：My Affair with Father-in-Law
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden desire my affair with father in law
dramabox.description: Lawyer Sophia marries John, the heir of the Corleone family, only to discover John's illicit affair with his stepmother Mia. In despair, she develops a forbidden attraction to the family head, Benjamin. The two become deeply entangled in passionate love, and this forbidden romance provokes insane revenge from John, Mia, and Benjamin's ex-wife...

dramabox.title: My Kept Man is Actually a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: my kept man is actually a billionaire
dramabox.description: Hollywood star Elena stays loyal to boyfriend Chris, believing he's lost his fortune. A rival sabotages her career—until Chris reveals he's the rightful heir to the Sterling dynasty. They crush showbiz schemes and inheritance plots. Elena wins an Oscar, Chris claims his empire. They step into their happy ending side by side.

dramabox.title: The Rejected Daughter Is a Magic Prodigy
dramabox.norm_title: the rejected daughter is a magic prodigy
dramabox.description: Elise Blackwood, born into a pure-blood family that forbids girls from learning magic, is despised by her father Cygnus, who favors her brother Orion. Her mother helps her escape, then is imprisoned and tortured. Determined to save her mother, Elise masters magic, defeats the family's enemies and Voldemort, and rises as the most revered mage in the Magic Academy.

dramabox.title: My Death Countdown: The Royal Family's Regret
dramabox.norm_title: my death countdown the royal family s regret
dramabox.description: Cassia, the eldest princess of Serenos blessed with the power to foresee death, is imprisoned in the North Tower for 18 years, branded as an ill omen by the royal family. On her 22nd birthday, her own death date appears on her palm. As she calmly prepares for her end, she is unexpectedly saved by her brother, the Prince Regent. As the truth unfolds, her family strives to atone for their mistakes.

dramabox.title: What She Took From Me
dramabox.norm_title: what she took from me
dramabox.description: Isabella, mistress of the Howard family, goes incognito with her son—only to discover her husband Edward with Agnes. Their young son Thomas is abused to death. Shattered, Isabella rises from despair, wielding her family's power to tear through lies and exact bloody revenge for her child.

dramabox.title: My Sister is the Grand Supreme
dramabox.norm_title: my sister is the grand supreme
dramabox.description: Iris and Layla are sisters from an ordinary magical family. Iris is actually the legendary Ancient Star Magic Supreme, but because she was sealed by the Lord of the Abyss, her power has only recovered to about 30%. To protect her sister from being hunted by the Abyss, she deliberately hides her identity and lives like a regular mage, with only a few of her followers who fight alongside her knowing who she really is.

dramabox.title: Release the queen's daughter
dramabox.norm_title: release the queen s daughter
dramabox.description: Dragon slayer Natalie gives up her throne to protect her adopted daughter Lily. But she returns the girl to her birth mother Iris—falling into a trap to steal her heart. Learning Lily is imprisoned and dying, Natalie dons the crown, storms the castle, shatters the lies, and vows to save her daughter. No one who hurt her will escape.

dramabox.title: The Secret Billionaire's Unexpected Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the secret billionaire s unexpected bride
dramabox.description: Kind-hearted delivery driver Scarlett marries Ethan, who pretends to be a poor nobody—but is actually the CEO of Empire Group. Living together, they grow close. Ethan secretly helps her through workplace crises. When his identity is exposed and his ex-fiancée and rivals scheme against them, Scarlett faces life-threatening danger and realizes her true feelings. Together, they rebuild trust and find their way back to each other.

dramabox.title: The Avenging Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the avenging heiress
dramabox.description: Bella, leader of the Shadow Alliance, is released from prison. To uncover the truth behind her framing three years ago, she accepts marriage to Ryan, heir of the Moonlight Alliance. With her bodyguard Allen's protection, she crushes conspiracies and strikes back ruthlessly. She eventually discovers Allen is an undercover agent. Together they resolve the crisis and find love.

dramabox.title: Enough Pretending, the Duchess Is Our Star General
dramabox.norm_title: enough pretending the duchess is our star general
dramabox.description: Sita, born under the sign of the Evil Ones, sought a secret treasure through a wormhole and was recovered by the Campbell family as Countess. For eighteen years, impostor Caroline and her brother set traps to drive Sita away. Sita spoke little, played along—and quietly became the sole heir to the Duke's estate.

dramabox.title: Dragon Lord Supreme
dramabox.norm_title: dragon lord supreme
dramabox.description: The illegitimate child Layne, who suffered constant abuse from the nobility, carries the blood of ten thousand dragons. He becomes a disciple of the first Dragon Tamer King, shines in the royal tournament, discovers the truth about his dragon-princess sister from the Dragon Realm, fights against the Dragon Realm Lord and the corrupt nobles, and ultimately awakens the power of the dragon god to overturn the continent's monopoly order.

dramabox.title: Rebirth I Saved My Daughter From Crocodiles
dramabox.norm_title: rebirth i saved my daughter from crocodiles
dramabox.description: On a swamp camping trip, Sara warns her family of crocodiles—but is mocked by her mother-in-law, sister-in-law, and cowardly husband. When her nephew is dragged underwater, Sara saves him, only to be blamed for the attack. Humiliated, she removes her ring and files for divorce. As crocodile attacks make headlines, her wealthy father Vincent arrives. Sara rejects their apologies, reclaims her life, and rises as an independent, powerful woman.

dramabox.title: My Contract Wife is Actually a Fashion Genius
dramabox.norm_title: my contract wife is actually a fashion genius
dramabox.description: Genius designer Sophie is humiliated at her wedding when her best friend Vivian strips her naked in church. To save her grandmother, she signs a one-year contract marriage with cold CEO Alex. Amid family traps and rival schemes, they grow close. Alex discovers Sophie is the mysterious savior who once saved his life—and the genius designer he's been searching for all along.

dramabox.title: The Billion-Dollar Heir's Six-Year Secret Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the billion dollar heir s six year secret bride
dramabox.description: Ethan Voss, heir of the Voss Group, hides his identity and falls for commoner Clara. After a car accident leaves him comatose, they are separated for six years. Clara raises their daughter alone. Ethan awakens, secretly arranges a grand wedding to humiliate those who mocked Clara, reveals his true identity, and finally reunites with Clara for a happy ending.

dramabox.title: Speed and Love
dramabox.norm_title: speed and love
dramabox.description: College lovers Lola and Ryan are torn apart when he fakes a breakup due to a fatal heart condition. Five years later, Lola is an F1 star; Ryan, now a billionaire CEO, disguises as a mechanic to win her back. Lola tries to "keep" him. Rivals scheme, frame her, and even cut her brakes. Ryan secretly uses his empire to save her, nearly dying himself. After surgery, he survives. Together, they claim the top.

dramabox.title: The Alpha's Redemption
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha s redemption
dramabox.description: Jessica, commander of the Blood Moon Legion and holder of the "Silver Moon Soul" honor, marries commoner Damon to honor her parents' wish. For three years, she manages everything—but is belittled by his mother, sister, and Damon himself. When Damon brings back his first love Blair, the marriage ends. Jessica leaves, rebuilds her career, and finds love with Howard, who has secretly loved her for years. Love and career both flourish.

dramabox.title: Fake Angel's Final Fall
dramabox.norm_title: fake angel s final fall
dramabox.description: Billionaire Sarah, disguised as a plain woman, hopes for a quiet wedding. Her future daughter-in-law Hailey humiliates and shoots her, dumping her in a pool. Sarah survives, refuses her son's help, and poses as a waitress at the engagement gala. Before the elite and media, she exposes Hailey's fraud, embezzlement, and attempted murder. The villain is ruined. Sarah reclaims everything.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire‘s Double Life
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire s double life
dramabox.description: Victoria, secret founder of a private military empire, hides her identity to raise daughter Emma. When Emma is bullied by Isabella's daughter, Victoria fights back. CEO Alexander steps in; they grow close. As enemies close in, Victoria's true power is revealed. When Emma is injured, a paternity test shows 99.9999% match with Alexander. What secret has been hidden for eight years?

dramabox.title: I’m Not a Forsaken Wolf, I’m the Lord
dramabox.norm_title: i m not a forsaken wolf i m the lord
dramabox.description: Luna, ruler of the Silvermoon Sanctuary, hid her identity and married mortal Kael, secretly making him Wolf King. As she prepared to reveal herself, Kael returned from war with a new woman—flaunting her before the court. Her illusions shattered. Now done playing the devoted wife, Luna unleashes her hidden dominion's full power, taking ruthless revenge on the cheating king and his mistress. They will remember who truly holds power.

dramabox.title: Reborn As the Revenge Queen
dramabox.norm_title: reborn as the revenge queen
dramabox.description: Sam's brother dies. Her boyfriend Noah and best friend Olivia murder her, staging suicide. She time-travels back to university with mind-reading powers. Aaron, also reborn, senses her danger. With his protection and their growing bond, Sam exposes the traitors, transforms her life, and rises from victim to queen.

dramabox.title: My Father is the Dragon King
dramabox.norm_title: my father is the dragon king
dramabox.description: For twenty years, Dragon King Adrian has searched for his lost daughter. Sophie, a bullied half-blood, is betrayed by her fiancé, who plans to sacrifice her heart. When a broken dragon-egg shard reveals her true identity, Sophie becomes Luna, the lost dragon princess. Father and daughter unite to destroy their enemies and expose the traitor who stole the throne.

dramabox.title: Marked the Wrong Twin
dramabox.norm_title: marked the wrong twin
dramabox.description: Luna, CEO of Apex Group, returns to find her twin sister Clara trapped in an abusive marriage—Jack controls her with violence, drugs, and finances. Luna strikes back ruthlessly, crushing Jack in business. She meets Sebastian, a hidden wolf clan heir. They fight side by side, falling for each other. Luna frees Clara, restores her dignity, and claims an equal love of her own with Sebastian.

dramabox.title: Ex Locked Me in an Asylum, Then Went Mad When I Married His Enemy
dramabox.norm_title: ex locked me in an asylum then went mad when i married his enemy
dramabox.description:
“Let me out!” I slam my fists against the psychiatric ward glass, screaming my Alpha orchestrated the crash that killed my cub. The doctor dismisses my cries as grief-fueled delusions and paranoia, claiming vulnerable Lunas invent such horrors.
I am not insane. My Alpha wed me solely to tear me from my former fiancé, handing me over to my sister instead. Three years of affection were nothing but endless lies.

dramabox.title: Bow Down! The Dragon Queen Has Returned!
dramabox.norm_title: bow down the dragon queen has returned
dramabox.description: Reborn after betrayed and murdered by her fiancé Victor, Mia, a once blind yet gifted Dragon Tamer, regains her sight. Bent on avenging her slaughtered clan and rescuing her captive parents, she allies with Sebastian, who was also secretly reborn. Against greed-fueled villains and Dragonbane Dark Magic, Mia unlocks the Dragon Origin Power and exposes royal conspiracies. In the end, she builds a new future side by side with Sebastian.

dramabox.title: Claimed by the Pharaoh
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by the pharaoh
dramabox.description: A former priestess, Nefer was imprisoned and bled dry by Setra, who stole her blood to fake divine favor. Pretending amnesia, she seduces Pharaoh Thutmose and rises from captive to Queen. On her wedding day, she exposes Setra's lies, commands sacred scarabs, and reclaims her mother's necklace. With Thutmose's love, Nefer defeats her enemies and becomes Egypt's true Queen.

dramabox.title: Definitely Not the Mage Supreme
dramabox.norm_title: definitely not the mage supreme
dramabox.description: Lyra believes her hands are cursed—every spell she touches goes wrong. But that "curse" is the rarest power in Arcos: she steals any magic she touches. Hunting the truth of her bloodline, she enters the deadly Ascension Trials, where a masked stranger keeps saving her life. He is Cassian Nox, the ruthless Lord Regent hiding his face—and the empty throne he guards was always hers. From enemies to something more, they must survive a kingdom that wants her dead.

dramabox.title: The Godmother returns to the throne
dramabox.norm_title: the godmother returns to the throne
dramabox.description: Female-led revenge thriller: Sierra, a seemingly abandoned wife, is secretly the underworld's supreme Godmother. Insulted by Liam and Isabella, she reclaims her throne through public humiliations and identity reveals. With loyal ally Alexander, she transforms rejection into absolute dominance—driven by justice, not just revenge.

dramabox.title: My Billionaire Queen Sister
dramabox.norm_title: my billionaire queen sister
dramabox.description: Incognito heiress Chloe is mistreated by snobbish bride Victoria at brother Leo's wedding. Leo cancels the wedding to defend her. Victoria allies with Leo's rivals to seize his company via Wall Street—but Chloe secretly controls Wall Street. She reveals herself, destroys their assets, jails them, and siblings conquer Manhattan together.

dramabox.title: The Tiny Girl Who Conquered Hollywood（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the tiny girl who conquered hollywood dubbed
dramabox.description: Mia Stone, an ancient girl, falls into a modern film set. She doesn't know acting, but her real hunger and suffering make every role unforgettable, from a nobody to child star, finally winning an Oscar. After each shoot, Mia brings supplies back to her starving village. Her five brothers, once too poor to marry, become sought-after men. Her sister-in-law, who once wanted to leave, becomes her biggest fan. The family survives famine and thrives.

dramabox.title: My Wild Bride Is the Big Boss
dramabox.norm_title: my wild bride is the big boss
dramabox.description: Blake Hardy has cancer. Determined to secure his family's future, he seeks the help of the powerful Arcadia to ensure that his spoiled son, Cedric Hardy, can inherit his legacy. Paige Fisk, Arcadia's new leader, returns to Juset as Cedric's fiancée, tasked with protecting him while settling old scores with the ungrateful people she once helped.

dramabox.title: Beast Trials: The Last True Tamer
dramabox.norm_title: beast trials the last true tamer
dramabox.description: A beastless orphan enters the realm's sacred Beast Trials to discover who she is, only to be humiliated and targeted by a corrupt noble house—until untamable creatures bow, a powerful commander chooses her, and the realm learns she is the First Beast's heir.

dramabox.title: Chatty Fated Lover
dramabox.norm_title: chatty fated lover
dramabox.description: Chatty Marina accidentally knocks down mute boy Austin, and her endless chatter slowly unlocks his trauma-shut heart. Eighteen years later, sister Bella impersonates Marina to win Austin’s engagement. Marina becomes a cleaner at his company, then his personal interpreter using her linguistic gift. Austin grows fond of "Annie," suspects his fiancée is fake, and together they expose Bella, finally uniting.

dramabox.title: The Heiress Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: the heiress strikes back
dramabox.description: On her birthday, Wall Street Sterling Group chairwoman Serena discovers her husband Hunter used her trust fund to buy a luxury car for Chloe. At a crash scene, Chloe humiliates Serena, not knowing she's the real wife. At a charity gala, Serena makes a stunning appearance, publicly exposes Hunter and Chloe's affair, files for divorce and asset seizure—making the betrayers pay.

dramabox.title: The Return of the Abyss Princess
dramabox.norm_title: the return of the abyss princess
dramabox.description: Kaelia, the true heiress of Coral Sea, was swapped at birth by maid Melra and raised in hardship. Returning to Coral Castle, she faces fake heiress Merala and biased brother Egil. Feigning weakness while wielding wit as her blade, she strikes back step by step. She steals Merala’s betrothed—merman prince Oseros—exposes plots, seizes commerce authority, and finally ascends as Coral Sea’s ruler.

dramabox.title: Can't Survive in the Wasteland of Your Love
dramabox.norm_title: can t survive in the wasteland of your love
dramabox.description: After nuclear war turns the world into a barren wasteland, Katia fights to find food for her family. But her husband, John, steals their last remaining supplies to support his mistress, leaving his own daughter to die.Heartbroken, Katia leaves everything behind. Saved by a mysterious stranger, she gradually falls in love with him—believing he's nothing more than a refugee.Then, thousands of soldiers fall to their knees as a single voice echoes across the desert: “Commander!

dramabox.title: Cut Ties, Heiress Ace the SAT
dramabox.norm_title: cut ties heiress ace the sat
dramabox.description: With her adoptive brother Ethan Hayes's support, she becomes a top SAT scorer and a gifted fashion designer, while the Bennett family crumbles under their own pride and infighting. Lillian's crimes are finally revealed, but the Bennetts realize too late. Claire rises from the ashes, embraced by true family and a brilliant future.

dramabox.title: Ten Years of Betrayal,One Perfect Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: ten years of betrayal one perfect revenge
dramabox.description: On their tenth anniversary, Victoria catches husband Ethan cheating with assistant Sabrina—who flaunts her mother's rare scarf. Sabrina fakes pregnancy, the public blames Victoria. She teams with top lawyer Liam, uncovers Sabrina's fraud: fake pregnancy, embezzled millions. Evidence exposed, Sabrina jailed, Ethan bankrupt. Victoria rejects his plea and rises to new heights. Then Liam proposes. From betrayal to queen, she writes her own comeback.

dramabox.title: I Married the Hidden Lion King
dramabox.norm_title: i married the hidden lion king
dramabox.description: To escape wolfman Julian’s control, rabbit-girl Luna accidentally bonds with lion King Leon during the Moon Festival. Hiding his identity, Leon protects her as they uncover conspiracies and fall in love. Luna grows from timid to resilient, becomes lioness queen, exposes villains, rescues her sister Lily, and starts guarding the forest.

dramabox.title: The Test That Lost Her
dramabox.norm_title: the test that lost her
dramabox.description: Claire Harlow gave up her dream job to marry poor Adrian Landon. For three years she served his family—unaware they were secretly rich, testing her. At a banquet, his mother revealed the truth, but Claire chose divorce and walked away with nothing. With a mentor's help, she rebuilt as a consultant and rose to a shining business star.

dramabox.title: Notes of Freedom
dramabox.norm_title: notes of freedom
dramabox.description: Once a star pianist, Claire Allen abandoned her career for love as a housewife. She caught her husband buying jewelry for his ex and chose divorce despite his scorn. Invited to perform at a banquet, she returned to music. Regaining her masterful skills, she made a fierce comeback, silenced critics, and rebuilt a brilliant life.

dramabox.title: Ruining My Billionaire Husband
dramabox.norm_title: ruining my billionaire husband
dramabox.description: Chloe, the secret heiress to an old-money dynasty, marries Liam in disguise and quietly leverages her family's power to make him a Silicon Valley billionaire. On their second anniversary, she comes home early—and finds him in bed with his secretary Jade. Hiding outside, she records Liam plotting to fake accounts, transfer marital assets, and cast her out. Without confronting him, she walks away alone.
