dramabox.title: Bound by Blood
dramabox.norm_title: bound by blood
dramabox.description: Lily, a young bakery worker, saves Mafia boss Salvatore with her rare blood, sparking a dangerous connection. After being sold by her stepmother, she’s rescued by him and thrown into a world of luxury and violence. As they grow closer, they face betrayal, jealousy, and violence from those around them, including his delusional 'fiancée' Bianca. Despite everything, their bond strengthens, culminating in their marriage and the birth of twins, marking a happy end.

dramabox.title: Crown Forged by Her Own Hands
dramabox.norm_title: crown forged by her own hands
dramabox.description: Claire Stone stays calm and composed amid devastating betrayal and malicious slander. Instead of breaking down or dwelling on her pain, she fights back on her own and holds fast to her principles. Faced with deadly traps set by unseen masterminds, she bravely confronts dangers, unravels intricate schemes, and exposes the real culprits.

dramabox.title: The Rebel Girl Was Actually My Mom
dramabox.norm_title: the rebel girl was actually my mom
dramabox.description: After a fatal car crash, billionaire couple Ethan Hayes and Avery Stone awaken in the bodies of two high school students attending their own children's school. To protect their heirs from a scheme that turns them into failures and steals the family empire, Avery becomes the school's toughest rebel while Ethan hides behind the image of the top student. Reunited in secret, the couple plots the ultimate comeback before it's too late.

dramabox.title: The Woman Who Rised from the Ashes
dramabox.norm_title: the woman who rised from the ashes
dramabox.description: Claire Hayes endured three years of abuse from her gambling husband Derek Caine and his mother, even sold by her own parents. She fights back with recordings, gets rescued by a mysterious man, joins a livestream company and rises to sales director. She exposes her tormentors, builds evidence, and in court sends them to prison. She reclaims her wealth, achieves career success, and walks alongside her savior, transforming from doormat to queen.

dramabox.title: The Chains of Blood, My Path to Peace
dramabox.norm_title: the chains of blood my path to peace
dramabox.description: Claire Carter pours everything into supporting her family, yet only receives coldness and misunderstanding. Overwhelmed by disillusionment, she walks away decisively. Back in her hometown, she revives her passion for calligraphy to build a fresh life, where she met Walter Reed. When her relatives keep troubling her, Claire stays true to herself, calmly setting the record straight and defending her boundaries with Walter’s support.

dramabox.title: She Hunted Demons to Uncover the Truth
dramabox.norm_title: she hunted demons to uncover the truth
dramabox.description: As an elite demon hunter of the Warden Bureau, Elise Avery travels across Nocton, the Boreal Wastes, and Crownia, slaying demons while searching for her missing father, Nolan Avery. She exposes Victor Sykes' conspiracy, reclaims her stolen eyes and immortal bones, and uncovers the fake Third Princess's plot. But the deeper she digs, the more she realizes her father's sacrifice hides a far greater truth that could decide the fate of the Crown House.

dramabox.title: The Tiny Girl Who Conquered Hollywood
dramabox.norm_title: the tiny girl who conquered hollywood
dramabox.description: Mia Stone, an ancient girl, falls into a modern film set. She doesn't know acting, but her real hunger and suffering make every role unforgettable, from a nobody to child star, finally winning an Oscar. After each shoot, Mia brings supplies back to her starving village. Her five brothers, once too poor to marry, become sought-after men. Her sister-in-law, who once wanted to leave, becomes her biggest fan. The family survives famine and thrives.

dramabox.title: The Son I Failed, The Fate I Rewrote
dramabox.norm_title: the son i failed the fate i rewrote
dramabox.description: Claire Hayes was murdered by adopted son Ryan Carter, husband Victor and her mother‑in‑law in her past life. Reborn, she finds Ryan is Victor’s illegitimate child and she wronged her biological son Eli. She disowns vicious Ryan to atone for Eli. Claire defends Eli and exposes Ryan’s bullying, gambling and fraud. At a birthday banquet, she names Eli the sole heir. The Carters conceal assets and drive her out with nothing. She escapes with Eli.

dramabox.title: Reborn Sisters: The Heiress Wins
dramabox.norm_title: reborn sisters the heiress wins
dramabox.description: After their mother's death, Marigold and Marlow Percy face a cruel choice—only one can leave with their grieving grandmother. Believing wealth awaits, Marlow departs, only to find an ordinary life. Years later, envy consumes her when Marigold marries into the wealthy Warren family. In a fit of rage, she kills her sister before taking her own life.

dramabox.title: Twin Flowers, One Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: twin flowers one vengeance
dramabox.description: Fifteen years ago, Holly Baker gave up her spot to be adopted by a wealthy family, letting her twin sister Claire Baker take her place. Now, Holly lies in critical condition after being driven to attempt suicide by those in power. Returning home in triumph, Claire finds her beloved sister near death — and vows to destroy everyone responsible.

dramabox.title: Eden Protocol
dramabox.norm_title: eden protocol
dramabox.description: Cold doctor Lena wakes with a red chip on a lawless island. Bound to ex-mercenary Damon in a glass room, she trades poison for power, betrays Grace to survive. Sister appears as executioner. Father's tape reveals Lena is Eden's "completed form." She burns Eden to ashes. Survivors flee. City screens: EDEN 2.0. The game never ends.

dramabox.title: Scorned by Seven, Chosen by One
dramabox.norm_title: scorned by seven chosen by one
dramabox.description: Wealthy heiress Claire Gould was raised with seven family-sponsored students. Three years ago, Chloe Parker, the driver’s daughter, arrived. Her persistent slander turned the seven against Claire.Heart-broken after seeing them kneel to confess love to Chloe, Claire cut all ties. At her birthday party a month later, she announced her marriage to Julian Hale, the paralyzed young master of Kenton’s Hale House. The seven were consumed by regret once the truth came out.

dramabox.title: Alpha Stole Me At My Wedding
dramabox.norm_title: alpha stole me at my wedding
dramabox.description: Evelyn, who saw her mother killed by a werewolf, planned to marry Riley for her inheritance. Her boss Karen—an Alpha—was her fated Mate. He exposed Riley's affair with her stepsister and married Evelyn. After learning Karen saved her 15 years ago with his wolf blood, she forgave him. Karen made her his Luna, and they had a child.

dramabox.title: Titan serpent
dramabox.norm_title: titan serpent
dramabox.description: Evelyn's Titanostatin mutates a python into giant Nyx. Victor steals it, triggering chaos. Pearl, Evelyn's python, is released and mutates. Evelyn awakens Pearl via broadcast; Pearl fights Nyx. Victor dies. Peace returns, but a giant crocodile stirs in the lake.

dramabox.title: 9-Year-Old girl Captain，Saving the Skies
dramabox.norm_title: 9 year old girl captain saving the skies
dramabox.description: In her past life, Eleanor Vance was a top female pilot and engineer. Reborn as nine-year-old Daisy, she saved a crashing plane with her past-life skills—shocking the world. But rivals, imposters, and media pressure followed. With age-defying expertise, Daisy fought back and returned to design, creating a new aviation legend.

dramabox.title: Raising My Husband’s Non-marital Child
dramabox.norm_title: raising my husband s non marital child
dramabox.description: Berenice Lancaster discovers husband Daniel Brown and his protégé Bella swapped her newborn daughter Laura for Kevin. She hides fury, spoils Kevin, secretly raises Laura. Twenty years later, she feigns handing Kevin her empire, lures Daniel and Bella to force her out. At their wedding, she exposes the swap, ruins them. Justice served; Laura inherits.

dramabox.title: Love Landed With the Amnesiac Heir
dramabox.norm_title: love landed with the amnesiac heir
dramabox.description: "Lance, an Air Force special-operations officer and heir to the Ashton Family, survives a mission-related plane crash and is rescued by Nora, a small-town doctor. When he awakens, he realizes he has lost his memory. Nora’s adopted sister, Karin, claims credit for Nora’s heroism after finding out who Lance is. She informs the Ashton Family that Lance is dead and assumes the role of the Ashton family’s heiress since the family is grateful she at least tried to save their son.

dramabox.title: Betrayed by the Prince, Crowned by the Sea
dramabox.norm_title: betrayed by the prince crowned by the sea
dramabox.description: Vesper saved human Caius, trusted him, and revealed her kind's secrets—only to be betrayed. He poisoned her voice and led a massacre of her sirens. Vesper survived, spent three years regaining her song, infiltrated the palace in disguise, and dismantled Caius's power. She freed her people and reclaimed the sea. Instead of killing him, she left Caius trapped on the shore, tormented by guilt, while she led her clan back to the deep.

dramabox.title: My Lover, My Target
dramabox.norm_title: my lover my target
dramabox.description: Sameen Carter, a policewoman carrying a deep blood feud, becomes the “contract lover” of Vincent Corleone, a feared mob boss and the prime suspect in her parents’ murder. At first, she plans to use the mission to manipulate his feelings and gather evidence against him. But inside this dangerous and intimate relationship, Sameen begins to see that Vincent is not the cold-blooded monster she imagined. Instead, he shows her real love, pain, and vulnerability.

dramabox.title: Too Hot to Handle
dramabox.norm_title: too hot to handle
dramabox.description: Raised in Shalor, Tessa Grant returns home to a fake sister stealing affection and three biased brothers. When the fake sister tears the phoenix qipao sewn by her orphanage grandmother Mrs. Doyle, Tessa retaliates by dumping spicy maoxuewang over her head. The fake heiress then kidnaps Mrs. Doyle to blackmail Tessa—her own brother sees it all and still sides with the fake sister.

dramabox.title: The Long Way Home
dramabox.norm_title: the long way home
dramabox.description: For ten years after marrying far away, Claire Miller was barred from visiting her family by her in-laws. When her mother was diagnosed with lung cancer, her desire to return home intensified, only to face strict control, blocked funds, and obstruction from her husband Trent Carter and mother-in-law. With her family's help, Claire finally saw the truth of her marriage, broke free to protect her daughter, and returned home to reclaim her life.

dramabox.title: KO,The MVP Heriess Is Back
dramabox.norm_title: ko the mvp heriess is back
dramabox.description: Claire was reborn three years ago, framed by her adopted sister Violet, and coldly treated by her six brothers. She left her family, rose to fame as "Silver Fox" in esports, and got into a top university. She exposed Violet's schemes, cut ties with her brothers, and found true freedom with school doctor Adrian.

dramabox.title: Reborn to Seize My Own Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: reborn to seize my own fortune
dramabox.description: Mia Miller escapes her fishing village and sails alone to Harboris to avoid being married off to a simple-minded man from a nearby village. In her previous life, she shared a decade with Ethan Grant; after his tragic death, she endured twenty years of solitary living. Reborn in May 1960, she rejects her destined fate. Following five days of preparations, she crosses the sea, lands close to Ravenwall, takes up cheap accommodation, and sets out to secure a foothold in Harboris.

dramabox.title: She Raised Pigs, Then Ran an Empire
dramabox.norm_title: she raised pigs then ran an empire
dramabox.description: Claire Grant gave up her career to care for her pregnant daughter — until she overhears her daughter mocking her in English as a former "pig farmer." Furious, Claire flips the table, returns home, and reclaims her role as CEO, cutting off everything she'd quietly given her daughter. When her son-in-law's company crisis leads him straight to her mansion, the family is stunned.

dramabox.title: I Divorced the Man Who Never Chose Me
dramabox.norm_title: i divorced the man who never chose me
dramabox.description: CEO Claire Stone endures ten years of mistreatment from her in-laws. Greedy relative Diana Wells repeatedly takes advantage of her, even stealing her hearse for a wedding and ruining the ceremony. When Diana crashes the car, her husband Ethan Hayes still takes her side and even locks Claire out, keeping her from seeing his dying mother. Armed with proof, Claire divorces him and holds them accountable. She starts a charity fund and finally lives for herself.

dramabox.title: Don't Be Afraid, I'll Back You Up
dramabox.norm_title: don t be afraid i ll back you up
dramabox.description: Wealthy Auric Bay Guild Leader Vivian Clarke sacrificed family for national duties, leaving her son unattended. Upon completing her last official task, she comes home to a nightmare: her son lies comatose, while daughter-in-law Lily is coerced by her mother into a political marriage with a local tycoon. Vivian wastes no time punishing the vicious relatives and exacts full retribution.

dramabox.title: Sweetest Twist: Divorced and Destined for Love
dramabox.norm_title: sweetest twist divorced and destined for love
dramabox.description: Claire spends six years helping her husband build a life, only to be cast aside once he lands a steady job. Penniless, she leaves with her son, Milo. A chance act of kindness leads to an unexpected marriage. At her ex-husband’s wedding, everyone laughs at Claire for being a divorced mom—until three luxury cars arrive to take her home with lavish gifts.

dramabox.title: Love Shines Bright, Dream Takes Flight
dramabox.norm_title: love shines bright dream takes flight
dramabox.description: Claire Carter earns a spot at Creston University, but her parents refuse to help, saving their money for her brother instead. Her uncle Frank sells the family’s only cow to fund her education. Claire never forgets what he did for her. She works her way up, builds a successful career, and repays his kindness many times over—helping his family move to town and start a new life. The girl once saved by a single cow finally gets the future she dreamed of.

dramabox.title: Rejected Luna, Rise of the Supreme Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: rejected luna rise of the supreme alpha
dramabox.description: After her Alpha husband rejects her as a worthless Omega, Sierra Blackwood sheds her disguise and returns as a powerful Lycan heiress. As she reclaims her family empire and exposes her stepmother`s deadly crimes, her remorseful ex must fight to earn her trust—and a second chance.

dramabox.title: Caged in My Husband’s Killer’s Arms
dramabox.norm_title: caged in my husband s killer s arms
dramabox.description: After years of blindness, Chloe regains her sight and discovers she's pregnant—then sees her devoted husband murdered by his twin brother, Damian. Trapped behind the lie of her blindness, Chloe must endure the nightmare of the killer wearing her husband's face and sleeping beside her, testing every nerve in her body and every inch of her self-control...

dramabox.title: Vow Beyond Hatred
dramabox.norm_title: vow beyond hatred
dramabox.description: Reborn in a blood pool, Claire Voss disguises herself and becomes a concubine at her foe’s Regent Court. She manipulates Ethan Ward with Gu spells, yet finds the enemy’s daughter is her long-lost sister. The sisters unite and ally with Ethan Ward. They slay Victor Kane in a brutal final battle. Claire devotes her remaining years to protecting her injured sister, proving protection and rebirth stand above hatred.

dramabox.title: A Bitter Reckoning, A Harvest of Greed
dramabox.norm_title: a bitter reckoning a harvest of greed
dramabox.description: Clare Hayes returns home and steps in when middlemen lowball local farmers, leaving their garlic scapes to rot. She livestreams day and night, sinking her own money into storage, packaging, and promotion until the harvest sells out. But at the celebration, the very people she helped turn against her, accusing her of profiting from the village. They seize control, forcing Clare out. She pulls her support, and their greed leaves the harvest rotting in the fields.

dramabox.title: Fluent in Revenge: The Interpreter Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: fluent in revenge the interpreter strikes back
dramabox.description: Claire Evans is a top interpreter whose job and boyfriend are stolen by Tessa Doyle, a receptionist who suddenly claims to be fluent in eight languages. Everyone mocks Claire while praising Tessa as a genius—until Claire discovers Tessa’s “translations” are actually stolen from her thoughts. At a high-stakes business pitch, Claire shows up with an unexpected trick. The moment Tessa takes the stage, chaos erupts.

dramabox.title: Too Little, Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: too little too late
dramabox.description: Claire Blake tends the family for ten years and discovers her husband Adrian Carter is a secret millionaire. Adrian neglects their daughter Lily Carter for his ex and her son. Heartbroken, Claire files for divorce and leaves with Lily. Lily gives Adrian a second chance but is hurt again. Adrian finally realizes his mistake and repents, hoping to be a good father, but Lily has fully given up on him.

dramabox.title: Priceless Pickles: A Lesson in Gratitude
dramabox.norm_title: priceless pickles a lesson in gratitude
dramabox.description: Claire Hart spent three years paying for Ryan Cole’s education, only to be punished after he reported her over a jar of pickles. His betrayal left teachers afraid to go the extra mile for students. When Ryan’s grades crashed, a private school lured him away, but he failed the college entrance exam. Claire quit teaching and built a successful business, while Ryan’s hard fall finally taught him gratitude.

dramabox.title: Bag the Billions, Watch Them Break
dramabox.norm_title: bag the billions watch them break
dramabox.description: Talia Hart and Claire Winter have spent ten years trapped in a novel, only to lose everything when the original heroine ruins their final mission. They fake their deaths and return to modern life with a billion-dollar payout—until their remorseful exes drag them back. With a power that makes every wrongdoer suffer the consequences of their own actions, they sit back and watch their enemies tear each other apart.

dramabox.title: Crowned by Revenge: Her Rise to Power
dramabox.norm_title: crowned by revenge her rise to power
dramabox.description: Claire Wells was sacrificed for her sister and spent ten years in a loveless marriage to Julian Caine, only to be poisoned when he took the throne. Reborn with a second chance, Claire refuses to die for anyone. She exposes her sister’s affair with Julian, takes revenge on both, and joins forces with Damon Reed to seize power. Together, they tear down the old order and usher in a new era—with Claire as its first woman ruler.

dramabox.title: She Sold It All and Started Over
dramabox.norm_title: she sold it all and started over
dramabox.description: After her mother is insulted by her husband and his family, Claire Carter decides to sell the house she bought before marriage and divorce. Facing threats and pressure, she calmly collects proof of his infidelity. She leaves the marriage behind and rebuilds a peaceful life with her mother.

dramabox.title: The Price of His Lies
dramabox.norm_title: the price of his lies
dramabox.description: Claire Carter gave up her career to lift her penniless husband to real estate mogul. She secretly buys a luxury penthouse as a surprise. But he has already promised it to his mistress. At the signing, the mistress insults Claire, not knowing she is the owner. When the husband arrives and realizes the humiliated woman is the wife who made him, he is shattered with regret.

dramabox.title: Retake My Revenge: A Second Chance to Ace
dramabox.norm_title: retake my revenge a second chance to ace
dramabox.description: Clara Hayes was betrayed by her birth family and died from exhaustion in her past life. Reborn, she sees through their lies and uses their hush money to enter an elite high school. Targeted by Sophie Lane, Clara fights back with talent, wins top honors in physics, and becomes the region’s top science student. She exposes their scheme, sends her birth father to prison, and starts fresh at college.

dramabox.title: If I Can't Go Home, No One Will
dramabox.norm_title: if i can t go home no one will
dramabox.description: On the second day of the Lunar New Year, married daughters return to their parents' home. But Elena Miles, married for eight years, is forbidden by her in-laws to visit her own family. Instead, she must cook and serve her two sisters-in-law, who are also visiting. Treated as the lowest in the house, Elena finally snaps. If she can't go home, then no one else will either.

dramabox.title: The Viking Bride's Dragon Curse
dramabox.norm_title: the viking bride s dragon curse
dramabox.description: Cursed Viking chieftain Erik believes Daisy is the woman who once saved his life. To escape a curse that dooms his first wife and child, he takes innocent Mia as his sacrificial bride. But after Mia and their child die, Erik discovers Mia was his true savior—and the woman he had come to love. Six years on, the resurrected Mia becomes a widely recognized dragon tamer. When Erik learns she lives, he vows to win her back.

dramabox.title: Kneel! My Wife Is the Valkyrie!
dramabox.norm_title: kneel my wife is the valkyrie
dramabox.description: The Valkyrie Sigrun marries a mortal out of gratitude, believing he's the one who saved her, only to be betrayed by him. After leaving the mortal, she hastily weds a crippled outcast—only to discover he is the God of Light, whom she cast down to the mortal realm ten thousand years ago. Now, with Ragnarök looming, Sigrun learns the God Key—a new god born of a Valkyrie's blood—may be the only hope of saving the Nine Realms, but its power can only be awakened by her true one.

dramabox.title: I Left as a Nobody, Returned as a CEO
dramabox.norm_title: i left as a nobody returned as a ceo
dramabox.description: Claire Carter was raised by Walter Carter after he took her in as an orphan. But Brenda Carter constantly abused her and forced her to give up her place at Seavon Univ so her daughter, Tessa Carter, could attend. Six years later, Claire returns as a successful CEO, ready to reward her hometown. Everyone mistakes Tessa for the CEO, and she gladly steals Claire’s identity. But when Tessa abuses Walter for her own gain, the real CEO is already on her way home.

dramabox.title: Girl of Fortune: Destined for the Crown
dramabox.norm_title: girl of fortune destined for the crown
dramabox.description: Born to a powerful family and foretold to one day become queen, little Ava is switched at birth and abandoned in the wild by Vivian. She survives and is adopted by a struggling scholar, whose fortunes change overnight. Ava’s uncanny luck soon becomes famous, drawing the child into the palace. But Vivian discovers her true identity and plots to silence her. When Vivian’s brother stages a coup, Ava and her adoptive father must save the kingdom.

dramabox.title: The Fool No More: Awakening the Overlord
dramabox.norm_title: the fool no more awakening the overlord
dramabox.description: Vivian Drake, leader of the Phoenix Order, loses her memory after being betrayed and badly wounded. Reunited with her brother Ethan, she lives as a “fool” for five years while he cares for her. When his longtime girlfriend is taken by a spoiled heir and Ethan is relentlessly humiliated, Vivian’s memories return. The “fool” is gone—and everyone who hurt her brother will pay.

dramabox.title: Global Heiress Strikes Back As Her Rival's Stepmom
dramabox.norm_title: global heiress strikes back as her rival s stepmom
dramabox.description: "Aria, the heiress to a world‑class financial conglomerate, lived incognito as a food delivery driver for four years solely to preserve her boyfriend Owen’s pride. Unable to bear seeing her suffer, her father promised Owen a ten‑billion‑dollar deal to make him the richest man in North America. Brimming with hope for a happy future, Aria instead caught Owen cheating with her best friend Grace.

dramabox.title: Out of the Ashes: Reclaiming My Legacy
dramabox.norm_title: out of the ashes reclaiming my legacy
dramabox.description: After an accident leaves Claire Stone disfigured and amnesiac, House Drake takes her in and marries her off to playboy Victor Stone in Tessa Ward’s place. But on their wedding night, Tessa turns on Claire and throws her to the streets. Rescued by Adrian Drake, Claire survives and returns to the Stone family, ready to crush her enemies and reclaim the empire that’s rightfully hers.

dramabox.title: Take the Crown, Own the House
dramabox.norm_title: take the crown own the house
dramabox.description: Movie star Claire Stone wakes up in ancient times in the body of a dying noblewoman. With a husband who can’t wait for her to die and children with agendas of their own, she fights back with modern wit and fearless style. She takes down mistresses, shuts down a gambling ring, raises her family her way, and shakes up the royal court—becoming a legend on her own terms.

dramabox.title: The Legend Awakens: No Mercy Given
dramabox.norm_title: the legend awakens no mercy given
dramabox.description: Legendary fighter Clara Foster once served her country before retiring to a quiet life with her daughter. When an old ally asks her to take down a spy ring, she refuses—until she learns the thugs targeting her daughter are part of it. Clara returns to action, but the spies join a foreign power and kidnap her daughter. At the border, Clara faces an old enemy and wipes out the entire network.

dramabox.title: He Betrayed My Heart, I Won the World（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: he betrayed my heart i won the world dubbed
dramabox.description: Sandra Gould completes her studies with the support of the Klein family. To repay their kindness, she sacrifices her dream of attending an elite university and stays to support Joe Klein, who repeatedly favors Vivian Shelby over her. Joe assumes Sandra will never leave him—but he doesn't know about the secret agreement she made with his mother. When Joe finally wastes all one hundred chances he has, Sandra marries another man and rises to the top, while he spirals into ruin.

dramabox.title: Destiny Swapped, The True Heiress Returns
dramabox.norm_title: destiny swapped the true heiress returns
dramabox.description: Swapped for 16 years, junkyard-raised Claire Carter is the true Carter Family heiress. Her wealthy family brings cold parents, a scheming imposter, a rude brother and a misunderstanding eldest brother. Calm and strong, she fixes the biased household, protects herself from intrigues and redeems the fractured family with a stunning comeback.

dramabox.title: I Took His Luck Back, Then He Begged
dramabox.norm_title: i took his luck back then he begged
dramabox.description: After discovering that her billionaire boyfriend used her sacred unicorn to propose to his first love, Arin—the last elf hiding among humans—withdraws the blessing that built his empire. As Travis's luck and body collapse, Arin learns Tristan Drago was her true savior. When greed turns to kidnapping and fire, true love becomes the only magic that can keep her in the human world.

dramabox.title: Please Marry My Fiancé
dramabox.norm_title: please marry my fianc
dramabox.description: Madeline thought her fiancé Caleb loved her, until he let her best friend Sophie take her place picking wedding dresses. For five years, the pair controlled every choice of hers—her job, home decor, even her wedding ring—while Caleb spent her savings spoiling Sophie. After realizing their toxic manipulation, Madeline cut everything off, took a high-level overseas job, and gathered all financial and audio evidence.

dramabox.title: Shadows in the Palace of Desire
dramabox.norm_title: shadows in the palace of desire
dramabox.description: Vivian Rowan wakes from a prophetic dream to find Adrian Valen, a hostage, bears the face of the emperor who killed her. She draws close to change her fate, but their alliance becomes forbidden love. As Adrian rises, Vivian uses her visions to survive palace intrigue. When she chooses death to save his throne, he pulls her from the flames. “You don’t get to leave me.” Together, they defy fate.

dramabox.title: Lottery of Greed: Karma Comes Calling
dramabox.norm_title: lottery of greed karma comes calling
dramabox.description: At a company gala, Claire Stone is promoted to partner and awarded a fortune in stock. A coworker gives her a fake lottery ticket as a prank, but her husband Ryan and his mother think it’s real. Their greed explodes. Ryan leaves Claire for her pregnant best friend, and the three blow borrowed money on luxury. Claire quietly plays along, divorces Ryan, and waits. Three days later, the “winning” lottery ticket is exposed as a fake.

dramabox.title: Mistress, How Dare You Touch the Elf Queen's Daughter
dramabox.norm_title: mistress how dare you touch the elf queen s daughter
dramabox.description: An ancient elven queen who had retired from the mortal world sealed her divine power for love. She married a human husband and bestowed elven fortune upon him, helping him rise to become a corporate tycoon. Hoping to give her half‑elven daughter an ordinary childhood, she chose to be a gentle full‑time mother.Tragedy struck when her daughter was falsely accused of theft by classmates at a chocolate factory and subjected to mass bullying.

dramabox.title: The Heiress at Forty-Five: Born to Lead
dramabox.norm_title: the heiress at forty five born to lead
dramabox.description: At 45, Claire Grant learns she is the Sawyer family’s long-lost heiress. Returning with her husband and two gifted sons, she is met with hostility from Vivian Sawyer, the daughter who took her place. Claire refuses to beg for acceptance. As Vivian’s schemes escalate, she begins reclaiming her name, her family, and the future of the Sawyer empire.

dramabox.title: Dear Son, Mom is the Real Boss（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: dear son mom is the real boss dubbed
dramabox.description: Nam Seo-ji is a top finance expert from a prestigious university. After her husband's death, she raises her son, Bae Seo-hyeok, alone. She devotes herself to saving the struggling Bae-Nam Corp and restores it to its former glory. But Seo-hyeok arrogantly takes credit for the company's growth and treats her like an ordinary employee. He even allows his girlfriend to humiliate Seo-ji at work. His ingratitude causes Seo-ji to leave the company and cut ties with him.

dramabox.title: She Sees Without Sight
dramabox.norm_title: she sees without sight
dramabox.description: Claire Stone, a former medic blinded on duty, accidentally got into serial killer Adrian Knox’s car one night. Her extraordinary senses exposed his identity, letting her escape. Obsessed with Claire, Adrian stalked her and made threatening calls. He broke into her home to intimidate her. Claire acted as bait. She was lured to Adrian’s villa. In total darkness, her sharp senses and combat skills helped her overpower him before police arrived, exposing all his crimes.

dramabox.title: My Immortal Great-Grandma: Justice Descends
dramabox.norm_title: my immortal great grandma justice descends
dramabox.description: After being framed and expelled by his wealthy rival, Ryan Mercer, Ethan Carter loses everything—including the woman he loves, Olivia Sloane. Forced to survive as a delivery driver, his fate changes when his immortal great-grandmother, Vivian Carter, reappears. Furious to see her descendants abusing their power while her own blood suffers, she sets out to bring down the elite and reclaim Ethan's rightful future.

dramabox.title: She Left Me for My Cousin, I Became Royalty
dramabox.norm_title: she left me for my cousin i became royalty
dramabox.description: Elisa, a pure-blooded elf, is rejected by her mother every year in favor of her scheming cousin Drusilla. After being adopted into the royal Lady Rowena's family, she becomes a titled Lady and finds true love. When her mother's cruelty is exposed, she finally chooses herself.

dramabox.title: After Divorce, Three Aces Chase Me
dramabox.norm_title: after divorce three aces chase me
dramabox.description: Secret billionaire heiress Melissa works as a cleaner for her husband Jeffrey, only to be betrayed and framed by him and his lover Jocelyn.After she chooses divorce, her three wealthy childhood friends step forward. These top tycoons all propose, promising to shield her.

dramabox.title: Star Surge: Sing To Your Death
dramabox.norm_title: star surge sing to your death
dramabox.description: In the energy-starved dystopian nation of Aurelia, a gifted girl from the poorest Sector enters Star Surge, a brutal televised singing competition where performers fight for fame, survival, and citizenship. When she discovers the government is harvesting emotional energy from contestants and audiences, she must choose between becoming Aurelia's next manufactured superstar or destroying the system before it destroys everyone she loves.

dramabox.title: She Defended Him,  Then Took Him Down
dramabox.norm_title: she defended him then took him down
dramabox.description: To get life-saving asthma medicine for her daughter Mia, lawyer Vivian Stone is forced to defend Ryan Carter, the son of Seaton's richest man, who is accused of assaulting a woman. But Ryan and his gang target Mia instead. After seeing what they did to her daughter, Vivian reveals who she is and publicly cuts ties with the Carter family. When the trial begins, The public is on the Carter family's side. Then Vivian walks in. This time, she's the lawyer for the victim.

dramabox.title: The Gangster Trapped in Grandma's Body
dramabox.norm_title: the gangster trapped in grandma s body
dramabox.description: Victor Slade, the ruthless debt collector of Sarton, wakes up in the body of sixty-year-old Ellen Price. Trapped in a frail body but armed with street smarts, he refuses to back down. He crushes greedy sons, humiliates abusive relatives, outplays gamblers, and even rallies seniors into an unstoppable squad. With a fearsome reputation reborn, one rule spreads across Sarton: never mess with Ellen Price.

dramabox.title: Fighting For Her
dramabox.norm_title: fighting for her
dramabox.description: Champion "Phantom" Jax did five years for manslaughter. Now she's a street punching bag, with only her girlfriend Mia still by her side.When her coach is held at gunpoint, Jax is forced back into the underground circuit—a betting puppet winning fights that only tighten the noose. Then Mia takes the bullet meant for her and falls into a coma.That coma was the last straw. Jax burns her bridges and steps into the ultimate cage. Tank Voss, the underground king, thinks he's hunt

dramabox.title: His Mistake, Her Move
dramabox.norm_title: his mistake her move
dramabox.description: After a 24-hour all-nighter to secure a project, Claire Vaughn steps out to buy pads. In the ten minutes she's gone, her fiancé and boss, along with secretary, fires her for abandonment. Seeing through their secret affair, Claire calls Damon Carter, a CEO: "I'll be at your office tomorrow."

dramabox.title: I Was Never Your Second Choice
dramabox.norm_title: i was never your second choice
dramabox.description: To repay a debt of gratitude, Claire Mason spends five years helping the Brooks family reclaim its glory, only to be treated by Ryan Brooks as a stand-in for the woman he loves. When his ex-wife, Vivian Drake, returns and frames Claire, Ryan blindly sides against her. As Claire fights back, Ethan Keller, the junior who has loved her for years, steps in to protect her. When the truth is revealed, Ryan loses everything, while Claire finds both love and success.

dramabox.title: The Return of the Amnesiac Heiress（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the return of the amnesiac heiress dubbed
dramabox.description: To afford her mother's medical expenses, Eun Seong turns to her estranged grandfather for help, only to be told she must sever ties with her mother in exchange, simply because her mother once eloped with an ordinary man. Twenty years after the separation, her mother becomes president of Cheonhae Group, determined to find her lost daughter. Meanwhile, Eun Seong, now suffering from amnesia, throws herself into a relationship with her secretly unfaithful boyfriend of five years.

dramabox.title: Signed & Sealed, Pack Your Bags
dramabox.norm_title: signed sealed pack your bags
dramabox.description: Divorced single mom Claire Reed keeps a low profile while staying in one of her own apartment buildings with her daughter. After politely reminding a tenant to clean up the shared laundry room, she's bullied and humiliated at every turn. But the neighbors picked the wrong woman to mess with. By the time they discover Claire is their landlord, the eviction notices are already on the way.

dramabox.title: Shamed as Fallen, I Named the King
dramabox.norm_title: shamed as fallen i named the king
dramabox.description: In the Kingdom of Aslande, a Royal Hunt is held to determine the prince’s future bride. Scarlett, the daughter of a powerful duke, dreams of a terrifying future: she is framed for losing her virtue, forced into becoming Prince Cedric`s secret mistress, and watches her entire family slaughtered after helping him claim the throne. When the events from her dream begin unfolding exactly as she foresaw, she realizes it was never a nightmare—it was a warning.

dramabox.title: Return the Life You Stole
dramabox.norm_title: return the life you stole
dramabox.description: Henry Carter stole his first wife Sylvia Stone’s identity and achievements. He started a family with Marian Bishop, the woman who benefited from the identity fraud. Twenty-seven years later, Sylvia’s daughter Claire Stone detects academic fraud committed by Henry’s daughter Sophie Carter. Sophie and her mother confront Claire with threats and bribes. The institute then holds a public review hearing. Claire then expose the secrets of the Carter Family to everyone present.

dramabox.title: Justice Prevails
dramabox.norm_title: justice prevails
dramabox.description: Elite lawyer Claire Hart kindly helped eight rural women including Nora Wells win their domestic violence divorce cases, only to be falsely accused of fraud and threatened with violent debt collection. She was wrongfully jailed for two years.After release, with support from the Carter Family, she became the village demolition consultant. She had the perpetrators imprisoned, and cleared her family’s name.

dramabox.title: The Distant Love（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the distant love dubbed
dramabox.description: 18 years ago, Kim Su-yeon's grandmother abandoned her after forcing her to donate blood to her twin brother, Kim Hyeon-woo, whom she favors. Rescued and raised as Choi Ji-seon, she grows up in hardship. As an adult, she unknowingly returns to her birth family’s company. There, she faces humiliation while an imposter steals her identity. When the truth is exposed, she reclaims her place, and the fractured family finally reunites.

dramabox.title: My Mate Sacrificed Our Eight Sons for His First Love
dramabox.norm_title: my mate sacrificed our eight sons for his first love
dramabox.description: Aurora Wood lost eight dragon children, believing each had been rescued by her husband Jude Smith's trusted first love, Elizabeth. After witnessing the truth behind the eighth child's death, she uncovers a horrifying conspiracy: her children were sacrificed to secure Elizabeth's rise as High Priestess. Betrayed by her mate, Aurora escapes, awakens an ancient bond with Dragon King Theo Spencer, and begins a journey of revenge, justice, and rebirth.

dramabox.title: When the Ring Calls Again
dramabox.norm_title: when the ring calls again
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Blair Stone claimed the world title—then a violent act of heroism cost her everything, landing her in prison. Now released and banned from the ring, she claws her way through an underground circuit, only to become a vengeful brother's target. When her best friend is caught in the crossfire, Blair must embrace her alias "Phantom," shattering all enemies with her fists and proving to all that her spirit remains unbroken.

dramabox.title: Masked for Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: masked for revenge
dramabox.description: After top agent Vivian Carter’s sister Mia dies, Vivian crashes Mia’s husband Ryan’s wedding and uncovers Mia’s missing jade pendant containing a chilling note: “I’m alive.” Teaming with mysterious Logan Steele, Vivian discovers Ryan’s conspiracy to destroy her family. Using deadly skills, she battles elite forces, dismantles his criminal network, and gathers irrefutable evidence. She rescues Mia, brings Ryan to justice, and finds love with Logan along the way.

dramabox.title: Avengers: The Diary of a Workshop Veteran
dramabox.norm_title: avengers the diary of a workshop veteran
dramabox.description: Factory expert Teresa Herrera is forced into retirement and replaced by her ambitious mentee who refuses her guidance. She moves on to a new life, but her former company begins collapsing without the one person who truly understood its machines.

dramabox.title: The Legend Unmasked: Back in Power
dramabox.norm_title: the legend unmasked back in power
dramabox.description: Once Valria's greatest champion, Vivian Hart vanished for twenty years to raise the son she took in as her own. But when Dylan Frost abandons her for power, she's reunited with Lucas Ward, the son she lost long ago—now one of the country's most powerful men. Forced back into action, Vivian must expose a deadly conspiracy and prove she's still untouchable.

dramabox.title: Secrets in the Delivery Room
dramabox.norm_title: secrets in the delivery room
dramabox.description: On her first day back from overseas, renowned obstetrician Vivian Shaw delivers a baby in an emergency—only to discover the mother is Anna Reed, the daughter-in-law she's never met. When Vivian notices troubling clues about the newborn's identity, her attempts to uncover the truth spark distrust and family conflict. Refusing to give in to accusations, she relies on evidence and professionalism to expose the truth and protect both her family and her principles.

dramabox.title: Ex and His Mistress Beg for My Ice Apocalypse Prep
dramabox.norm_title: ex and his mistress beg for my ice apocalypse prep
dramabox.description: After her husband divorces her for his mistress and throws her out with nothing, Sylvie rescues a muddy white fox named Buddy. Only she can hear his warning: an ice apocalypse is coming. While everyone mocks her, Sylvie builds a fortress, gathers supplies, and prepares to survive. When the world freezes, the people who betrayed her come begging at her door—but Sylvie’s revenge has only just begun.

dramabox.title: Playing Dumb, Ruling the Village
dramabox.norm_title: playing dumb ruling the village
dramabox.description: Claire Hayes, a cold female agent, wakes up as a mad village girl and a corpse collector in the 1980s. She marries Ethan Mason, the town fool, but discovers he's actually a genius hiding a lost memory. Playing the crazies in public, they secretly scheme to bring down the village chief who has bullied everyone for years. In the end, the once‑cowardly village gets a powerful female leader who changes everything.

dramabox.title: From Outcast to Everything
dramabox.norm_title: from outcast to everything
dramabox.description: Transmigrated into a book as a rejected stepsister, Lily Blake knows her family's tragic ending. Determined to survive, she saves her siblings, builds a food empire from nothing, and breaks down walls with two powerful men—Adrian Hayes, the story's villain, and the male lead. From an outcast to their most cherished person, she lifts her family from poverty and unknowingly becomes the one woman who holds both their hearts.

dramabox.title: I Didn't Mean to Win His Heart
dramabox.norm_title: i didn t mean to win his heart
dramabox.description: To go home, forensic expert Claire Carter must win the heart of her terrifying husband, Prince Evan Arden, and uncover the truth behind a past conspiracy. Armed with a system and a plan, she treats him like a mission—until his piercing eyes begin to see through her. She came to solve a case, not to fall in love. But in the prince's dangerous game, hearts are the only thing at stake.

dramabox.title: How the Tables Turned（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: how the tables turned dubbed
dramabox.description: Ever since Horace Zabel married into the Steele family as a live-in husband, he has been hardworking and devoted to his wife, Xaviera Steele. In recognition of his dedication, Xaviera steps back and entrusts him with Titan Group to help him gain experience and advance his career—only to later discover his betrayal. Behind her back, Horace has secretly started a family with his mistress, Yulissa Cohen.

dramabox.title: The Mute Bride: Ditching the Viscount After Saving His Ruined House
dramabox.norm_title: the mute bride ditching the viscount after saving his ruined house
dramabox.description: Helena Sterling, a mute banker`s daughter, endures three years of scorn as the Viscount`s wife. When a blackmailing cousin threatens Ashbourne, she breaks her silence, exposes decades of accounts, and saves the estate. She divorces Adrian, rebuilds her own banking empire, and defeats a hostile takeover. After mutual growth and loss, they remarry—on her terms, with equal respect.

dramabox.title: Sacrificed to the Vampire, Yet He Kneels Before Me
dramabox.norm_title: sacrificed to the vampire yet he kneels before me
dramabox.description: Evelyn, the first vampire Progenitor, is betrayed by her adopted family and sacrificed to feared lord Damien. He was her loyal servant who searched for her for twenty years. Recognizing her unique crescent mark, he kneels to avenge her. They defeat traitors and foreign vampires, rule the blood realm together, and live peacefully by the lake with their daughter.

dramabox.title: My Alpha Let Our Son Die For His Mistress's Bastard
dramabox.norm_title: my alpha let our son die for his mistress s bastard
dramabox.description: Standing before the grave of her six-year-old son, Noah, Harper discovers a heartbreaking truth—her Alpha husband, Ryker, could have saved their severely injured child, but chose to let him die in order to protect his former lover, Maren, and their illegitimate son, Damian. Even worse, Harper learns that for the past five years, Ryker and Maren have been secretly poisoning her, using a suppressant to keep her powerful royal bloodline and wolf abilities dormant.

dramabox.title: The Princess Who Rose from Ashes
dramabox.norm_title: the princess who rose from ashes
dramabox.description: Born an orphan in Lowden, the poorest slum of Regton, Claire Alden’s beauty becomes a curse. Rescued by the royal family, she becomes most beloved princess. Yet the palace hides a deadly plot: her father imprisons her, her mother tries to kill her, her brother turns a sword on her, and Miles Hart abandons her. Covered in blood and hatred, Claire rises from the dead to seek revenge and bring down the royal throne.

dramabox.title: Table of Reckoning: Payback at Stake
dramabox.norm_title: table of reckoning payback at stake
dramabox.description: Nancy Stone, the reigning international mahjong queen, goes undercover at the run-down Hayes Parlor in Augport to uncover the truth behind her father’s death and fulfill his anti-gambling legacy. When Ethan Hayes is trapped in a crisis, Nancy steps in with unmatched skill and sharp wit, taking on a ruthless prodigy in a high-stakes battle to expose the conspiracy and restore justice.

dramabox.title: Too Late to Be My Forever
dramabox.norm_title: too late to be my forever
dramabox.description: Sophie Hale was once saved by Ethan Wade, and the two fell in love for three years. Just days before their engagement, she overhears Ethan and his friends talking, and her heart shatters. When a text from Ethan’s family-appointed fiancée reveals the truth, Sophie believes Ethan never loved her at all. But after Sophie leaves, Ethan realizes he truly loves her. He rushes to win her back, only to find she is about to marry someone else.

dramabox.title: Eight Years to Trash: Take My Captain, Stewardess
dramabox.norm_title: eight years to trash take my captain stewardess
dramabox.description: After eight years of sacrificing her career and dreams for her pilot husband Ethan, Mia discovers he’s been sharing his cockpit sunsets—and his heart—with a flight attendant. Silently, she erases herself from their life, leaves without a word, and starts over in Morocco. Only when she’s gone does Ethan realize what he’s lost, but Mia has already learned to live without him. A story of quiet betrayal, delayed reckoning, and the fierce act of choosing yourself.

dramabox.title: A Taste of Betrayal: Cooking Up a Comeback
dramabox.norm_title: a taste of betrayal cooking up a comeback
dramabox.description: Claire Harper and Diana Parker ran a small eatery. Claire handled cooking, buying, and operations. In a year, they earned 3 million yuan. Diana claimed she paid all rent and startup, so she gave Claire only a 2,000-yuan gift card, ignoring their bond. Claire swallowed the insult, used the card for gifts, tapped her network, rented the opposite restaurant, and went solo.

dramabox.title: Love Lessons with My Mr. Right
dramabox.norm_title: love lessons with my mr right
dramabox.description: When Judy finally leaves her abusive fiancé, she makes a bold and unexpected move. She proposes to her former college professor, Kevin White, and to her surprise, he says yes! But their sudden marriage sets off a storm of chaos. Her ex‘s obsession, family drama, and a hidden past Kevin is not yet ready to share.

dramabox.title: Forever Begins Now
dramabox.norm_title: forever begins now
dramabox.description: After a one-night stand with a famous movie star, a humble 22-year-old writing student discovers she’s pregnant—thrusting her into a whirlwind of fame, heartbreak, and impossible choices. As her secret threatens both their careers, she must grow from a timid girl into a woman strong enough to fight for love and her unborn twins. Against lies, betrayal, and her abusive past, she and the man she never expected to love learn that sometimes forever begins with a single spark.

dramabox.title: Too Late to Beg_The Fat Heiress’s Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: too late to beg the fat heiress s revenge
dramabox.description: Vivian secretly volunteered for an experimental drug trial to save her three adoptive brothers from a deadly family disease—gaining 130 pounds in the process. Now ridiculed as the “fat heiress” and shoved aside for the family’s newly returned biological sister Stella, Vivian endures humiliation in silence. But when Stella’s cruelty finally crosses the line, Vivian sheds her tears, her weight, and her loyalty—returning as the woman they will all regret losing.

dramabox.title: Weeping Bones
dramabox.norm_title: weeping bones
dramabox.description: After being brutally murdered—her body dismembered and scattered—Bella's soul returns home on Christmas Eve. There, she finds her biological parents, Paul and Evelyn, doting on her adopted sister, Anna, while remaining cold and indifferent toward her, completely unaware that their own daughter is already dead.

dramabox.title: Dumped For Being Ultra-Plus-Size, I Became the Mafia Heir's Addiction
dramabox.norm_title: dumped for being ultra plus size i became the mafia heir s addiction
dramabox.description: Bianca Moretti, mocked for her ultra-plus-size body, discovers mafia heir Dominic Brown's secret obsession: soft, full-figured women. She becomes his personal maid to seduce him, but Dominic is haunted by trauma—his first two wives died beneath him when their cheap silicone implants ruptured. He craves Bianca's body yet fears touching her. Can Bianca break through his shattered defenses and claim the dangerous, irresistible Dominic?

dramabox.title: Live & Ruthless: The Psychic Sees All
dramabox.norm_title: live ruthless the psychic sees all
dramabox.description: After defying the laws of the Skycourt, Mia Stone is banished to the Mortal Vale, where she wakes up as a debt-ridden middle school girl with hopeless parents. Living in a rundown apartment, she protects her gentle sister, Emma Stone, from loan sharks and malevolent spirits, while crossing paths with lovable billionaire heir Ethan Parks. Her psychic livestreams make her an overnight sensation as she destroys cursed talismans, banishes evil, and exposes fraudulent psychics.

dramabox.title: My Scrapyard Hubby is a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: my scrapyard hubby is a billionaire
dramabox.description: Fleeing an arranged marriage, Claire Stone kisses a junk collector to escape her bodyguards, never realizing he's actually Victor Hale, the billionaire CEO she's been trying to avoid. After an unexpected deal leaves her stuck in a fake marriage, Claire moves into his shabby scrapyard—only to discover it's anything but ordinary. As her stepsister arrives to stir up trouble, Victor shuts the gate with a smile: "Welcome to the Hale family estate.

dramabox.title: Roots of Hope: A Heart That Endures
dramabox.norm_title: roots of hope a heart that endures
dramabox.description: After losing her three brothers and her husband, country girl Claire Carter refuses to let tragedy define her. Pregnant and alone, she shoulders the burden of both her own family and her late husband's. Though blamed by her mother-in-law and faced with her sister-in-law's despair, Claire answers cruelty with kindness—saving her from drowning, helping her build a career, and nursing her ailing mother-in-law back to health.

dramabox.title: The Queen Who Raised Her Enemy's Son
dramabox.norm_title: the queen who raised her enemy s son
dramabox.description: Queen Frigga discovers her husband Loki and sorceress Gullveig swapped her newborn daughter with their son. She secretly recovers her daughter Nicole, raising her in hiding while pretending to nurture impostor Bryan as heir. Decades later, when Loki's family seizes power, Nicole reveals herself at her wedding to Bryan — not as his bride, but as Frigga's true daughter and the Nine Realms' most powerful queen. Frigga reclaims everything and embraces freedom.

dramabox.title: The Final Landing: No Return Flight for My Husband
dramabox.norm_title: the final landing no return flight for my husband
dramabox.description: After four years of unrequited marriage, Elise endures a terrifying in-flight emergency, praying for a chance to salvage her relationship if her husband Ethan picks her up. Yet he spends the night accompanying another woman, Mallory, who occupies their home and steals all his care. While Elise travels alone 109 times, struggles with injured eardrums and hidden sorrows, Ethan turns a blind eye to her loneliness and pain.

dramabox.title: No Place for a Tainted Heart
dramabox.norm_title: no place for a tainted heart
dramabox.description: Elena Shaw is envied for having Lucas Kane, a CEO who seems to worship his wife. But behind the perfect marriage, Lucas has been sleeping with young live-in maid Lily. Done with his tainted heart, Elena quietly gathers proof, prepares her divorce, secures her escape abroad, and leaves him a surprise he will never forget.

dramabox.title: Into the Nightmare: No Way Out
dramabox.norm_title: into the nightmare no way out
dramabox.description: A bus full of strangers passes through a tunnel swallowed by thick fog. On the other side, the warm, smiling attendant has become something no one can explain. With a chilling smile, she welcomes everyone to a deadly journey where every stop is a fight to survive. From eerie graveyards to cursed apartment blocks, abandoned hospitals, and sinister hotels, each nightmare is deadlier than the last—and no one is expected to make it out alive.

dramabox.title: Celestial Girl: The Phoenix Within
dramabox.norm_title: celestial girl the phoenix within
dramabox.description: Abandoned as a baby and set adrift in a wooden basin, a newborn girl is rescued by a village woman who takes her in. But her enormous appetite soon becomes more than the family can handle, and she's cast out. Rejected by the entire village, she's eventually taken to the city by a trafficker and ends up working in a wealthy household's kitchen, where an unexpected destiny awaits.

dramabox.title: Behind the Dirty Deals
dramabox.norm_title: behind the dirty deals
dramabox.description: Procurement manager Emma uncovers a supplier's price gouging and use of spoiled ingredients, refusing to compromise despite relentless smears and sabotage. As corruption spreads through the company, she gathers evidence, exposes multiple conspiracies, and helps bring the guilty to justice while reforming the procurement system to protect the business and her colleagues.

dramabox.title: The Shape of a Second Life（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the shape of a second life dubbed
dramabox.description: In her previous life, Celia Green sacrificed her career for her family, only to be repaid with betrayal. Her husband remained devoted to his first love, and even their two children chose the other woman over her. After helping him achieve success, she was cast aside and forgotten. Reborn with a second chance, Celia vows never to suffer in silence again. Determined to reclaim her dreams, she becomes a news anchor and sets out to build a successful life on her own.

dramabox.title: Eve's World
dramabox.norm_title: eve s world
dramabox.description: Elite soldier Kim Seo-yeon (codename EVE) retired to sell fish for her sister with heart disease, rejecting Special Forces General Park Hyun-woo’s return request.Unaware of her sister’s true identity, the girl endured bullying by Lee Soo-ah, and was beaten unconscious by Lee’s gang at home on her birthday.Furious at the truth, Kim revealed her soldier status and punished the bullies severely.

dramabox.title: I Was Framed, Yet I Became Legend
dramabox.norm_title: i was framed yet i became legend
dramabox.description: After being publicly branded a cheater by her scheming fake sister, Lyra is disowned, expelled, and vilified before the entire realm. But when Voidborn monsters shatter the graduation ceremony, she reveals her true power—a Crown-grade Divine Core and a place in the secret Riftguard Order. With the legendary High Warden as her mentor, she rises from outcast to the realm’s greatest guardian, proving that real strength needs no family name.

dramabox.title: Settle the Score, Love No More
dramabox.norm_title: settle the score love no more
dramabox.description: Raised by a single mother, Kathryn Cranham longs for a happy family and devotes herself to caring for both sides after marrying Vincent Whittaker. When her mother needs urgent cancer surgery, Vincent refuses to help and even squanders their savings. He also demands separate parental support. After Kathryn signs the agreement and saves her mother alone, she divorces him. When the final settlement reveals that he owes her far more than she ever owes him, he is full of regret.

dramabox.title: Love in the Second Chapter
dramabox.norm_title: love in the second chapter
dramabox.description: In a rural village during the 1980s, Naomi Hartwell works five years to support her fiancé, Benjamin Sterling, as he prepares for the exam. After he becomes the "top scorer," he breaks off their engagement condescendingly. Naomi marries Gabriel Rockwell, a shepherd whom everyone considers a fool. In the end, the "top scorer" turns out to be someone else with the same name as Benjamin. He, in fact, scored bottom. Meanwhile, Naomi and Gabriel start their new life together.

dramabox.title: I Fed My Celibate Uncle With Wet Dreams
dramabox.norm_title: i fed my celibate uncle with wet dreams
dramabox.description: A professional dream-weaver who inherits a succubus bloodline uses her gifts to heal troubled clients—until she receives an anonymous request from the celibate uncle she has secretly loved since childhood. As she invades his dreams, he recognizes her scent and reveals he has desired only her for years. Their forbidden bond ignites, but it also awakens a vengeful rival from a fractured branch of the bloodline—a grief-feeder who will burn everything to claim the inheritance.

dramabox.title: I'll Watch You Burn, Hands Free(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: i ll watch you burn hands free dubbed
dramabox.description: In her past life, Jenna Judd helped Elliot Grant build his business empire using her family's connections. Once he succeeded, he brought his childhood sweetheart, Ann Lawson into the company and let her wreak havoc, repeatedly forcing Jenna to clean up the mess. Ann's death was her own doing, but Elliot pinned all the blame on Jenna. Now reborn, Jenna sees his true colors and plans to turn his greed against him.

dramabox.title: My Last Divorce, My First Love（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: my last divorce my first love dubbed
dramabox.description: Han Se-young gave up her own career to support her husband, devoting herself entirely to life as a full-time housewife. However, at five months pregnant, she is ensnared in a conspiracy between her husband and his mistress, which leads to a miscarriage and her being driven out of her own home.After the divorce, Han Se-young remarries Kang Si-won, a charming yet mysterious man. Using his vast network and resources, Kang Si-won helps her rediscover herself...

dramabox.title: She Thinks I'm the Mistress, But I'm the Queen
dramabox.norm_title: she thinks i m the mistress but i m the queen
dramabox.description: Mistaken for the Crown Prince’s long-abandoned wife by his ruthless, ambitious mistress Seraphina, newly crowned foreign-born Queen Consort Adelaide is publicly framed and humiliated before the royal court. What starts as a salacious scandal spirals into treason, forged evidence, and deadly conspiracies from scheming nobles.

dramabox.title: Built From Nothing: Her Empire Begins
dramabox.norm_title: built from nothing her empire begins
dramabox.description: Even though Lisa Marks gets betrayed by her business partner and only receives 100 thousand dollars for her efforts, she doesn't succumb to despair. Instead, she rents an abandoned cold storage and establishes her own cold-chain delivery network with the help of her keen eye for quality and her reputation as a businesswoman with integrity. Lisa will face multiple difficult challenges in her business, but she will persevere and emerge as the ultimate winner.

dramabox.title: Breaking: Your Ex-Wife Is a Billionaire Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: breaking your ex wife is a billionaire heiress
dramabox.description: Victoria, a billionaire heiress, gives up everything to marry Ethan, only to be disowned and endure 33 failed IVF attempts before finally becoming pregnant. When Ethan wrongly believes the baby belongs to another man, he abandons her during a devastating accident to save his first love instead. Only after their divorce does he realize he destroyed the woman who sacrificed everything for him.

dramabox.title: Burn My DEAD Husband Alive
dramabox.norm_title: burn my dead husband alive
dramabox.description: Kang A Jin is left with a $15 million debt after her husband, Lee Tae Oh, fakes his own death. Her life is destroyed, and she dies consumed by hatred. Witness her defiant rise as she transforms barren lands with miraculous sweet potatoes, wields medicinal herbs to heal the sick, and confronts those who scorned her. This isn't just about survival; it's about a woman single-handedly saving a world on the brink.

dramabox.title: Scandal
dramabox.norm_title: scandal
dramabox.description: Princess Lilith is cruelly betrayed by her husband Prince Patrick. While she lies unconscious and gravely injured, Patrick cheats on her with his mistress Kalixi right by her hospital bed. Lilith records the truth and dies in despair. Reborn on her wedding day, she resolves to change her fate with past memories and hatred. Pretending to marry Patrick, she secretly allies with Jervis, a double agent with a secret mission to create royal scandals. Their relationship shifts from

dramabox.title: Lord of Ashes: The New York Vendetta
dramabox.norm_title: lord of ashes the new york vendetta
dramabox.description: Elaine, the eldest daughter of the Stewart family, is betrayed by her father, stepmother, and younger brother, leading to her tragic death in a mental hospital — only to unexpectedly regain her life. Returning with the memories of her past life, she forms an alliance with Silas, a ruthless "vulture" of Wall Street.

dramabox.title: Loving You Costs My Life
dramabox.norm_title: loving you costs my life
dramabox.description: At age ten, human boy Ethan was saved by a forest elf, Mia. They grew up together, and Mia secretly blessed him with her luck magic as he struggled in the human world. With her power, Ethan rose to executive status—but if betrayed, Mia would become mortal and die. On their anniversary, Ethan cut off her wings as a gift for Riley, his boss's daughter. Fatally wounded, Mia died in the rain as her 24-hour countdown ended.

dramabox.title: My personal mafia boss
dramabox.norm_title: my personal mafia boss
dramabox.description: Charlotte, the adopted daughter of the Harrington family, was maliciously drugged and framed by her stepsister Isabella at her engagement banquet. After being locked in a tower, she unexpectedly became entangled with William, heir to the Ashford family. As a result, Charlotte became pregnant out of wedlock and was driven out of the house by Isabella. For eight years, Charlotte raised her son Leo alone, living in hardship.

dramabox.title: A Hundred Billion Heartbeat
dramabox.norm_title: a hundred billion heartbeat
dramabox.description: Terminally ill Aria signs a $100 million surrogacy contract with cold tycoon Julian to fund her revenge. As they test each other, feelings grow. At his gala, she outshines everyone and sends her abusive stepfather and birth mother to prison. When her heart fails, Julian spends billions to force a transplant and save her. Misunderstandings clear, and they wed on a private island.

dramabox.title: Hobo Husband is Shadow Lord
dramabox.norm_title: hobo husband is shadow lord
dramabox.description: Heiress Seraphina mistakes her savior, secretly supports scumbag Sebastian for three years, and is humiliated at his wedding. She marries homeless Lucian on a whim—drawing mockery. But Lucian is actually the Shadow Council Chancellor, and her own hidden identity is about to surface. When scheming exes crash the wedding and fake heiresses surface, revenge turns into a deadly game.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire's Runaway Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire s runaway bride
dramabox.description: Fresh grad Ivy flees her forced wedding to a casino boss and impulsively proposes to Victor Blackwood, a man she mistakes for a foreman. He's actually the trillionaire CEO—and agrees to marry her. Eleanor, his grandmother, insists on the wedding. Ivy hides her identity, faces workplace schemes, and uncovers her family's ties to the powerful Sterling Group—all while Victor secretly protects her.

dramabox.title: Kneel Before the Lionheart
dramabox.norm_title: kneel before the lionheart
dramabox.description: Returning war soldier Ronan is publicly abandoned by the woman he secretly helped—she dreams of marrying the legendary Lionheart Commander, unaware that Ronan is him. Heartbroken, he enters a contract marriage with a fallen duchess who chooses him without knowing his identity. When the Abyss invades and royal conspiracies unfold, Ronan reveals himself, saves the kingdoms, and finally sees who truly loves the man beneath the mask.

dramabox.title: Pregnant with the Lycan King's Baby
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant with the lycan king s baby
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her ex and stepsister, then sacrificed by her father to the brutal Lycan King as a breeder, she expected death. Instead, she awakened her wolf blood and made a deal with the cursed king: bear his child for freedom. Enduring bullying, assassination, and his maddening curse, they hurt and protected each other, ultimately crushing the elders' conspiracy and the rival's schemes. Together, they saved the crown and found their happy ending.

dramabox.title: Love Beyond Deal
dramabox.norm_title: love beyond deal
dramabox.description: Poor, resilient Willow meets ruthless tycoon Damian. Their transactional marriage evolves into true love amid misunderstandings, family conflicts, and hidden secrets. Willow discovers she is a lost heiress—and the mysterious Lily Damian has sought for years is none other than her. Love triumphs over all.

dramabox.title: Kissed You at the End of the Night
dramabox.norm_title: kissed you at the end of the night
dramabox.description: Poor, resilient Willow meets ruthless tycoon Damian. Their transactional marriage evolves into true love amid conflicts and secrets. Willow discovers she is a lost heiress—and the mysterious Lily Damian has sought for years is none other than her. Love triumphs.

dramabox.title: Destined Fated Love
dramabox.norm_title: destined fated love
dramabox.description: Influencer Jenny plans a birthday livestream surprise for her boyfriend—but catches him with wealthy adopted Chloe. The backlash goes viral; she's beaten and silenced. Lukas Sterling rescues her. She resembles his childhood fiancée Vivian, missing for twenty years. He offers a one-year contract marriage to handle family pressure. As they grow close, Jenny's true identity emerges—she is Vivian Wentworth.

dramabox.title: Mafia Heiress's Unexpected Husband
dramabox.norm_title: mafia heiress s unexpected husband
dramabox.description: On mob heiress Luna's wedding day, her groom bails. Poor guy Liam, who crashed the wrong wedding, proposes on the spot—she says yes. She hides her underworld identity, spoiling him. He plays poor. Until their rival crashes the wedding, and Liam's trillionaire heir mask shatters. Both hiding their true selves—their marriage spirals out of control!

dramabox.title: After the Cancellation of Engagement, I Bought Her Family
dramabox.norm_title: after the cancellation of engagement i bought her family
dramabox.description: Vampire king Vincent finds fiancée Jessica cheating, breaks the engagement. He meets CEO Chloe, they enter a contract marriage. Jessica schemes with Black. Vincent secretly uses his empire to crush enemies. Werewolf Marcus kidnaps Chloe. Vincent awakens full power, seals the Blood Ghost King with half-vampire Chloe, marries her, and ruins Jessica's family.

dramabox.title: I Married My Cheating Ex's Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: i married my cheating ex s uncle
dramabox.description: Vivian fakes paralysis, exposes cheating fiancé Bryce, and walks away. She marries mechanic Adrian—Bryce's uncle and true Hale heir. Adrian is her real rescuer; Bryce stole the credit. Bryce plots to destroy them. When Adrian is nearly killed, Vivian learns the truth. Their revenge marriage becomes a war for love, fortune, and survival.

dramabox.title: My Nude Chat Partner Is My Boss
dramabox.norm_title: my nude chat partner is my boss
dramabox.description: To pay her mother's medical bills, Luna becomes a masked nude cam host and falls for Mr. Grayson, the private patron who saves her. After graduation, she becomes CEO Will Grayson's assistant, unaware that her strict boss and her online lover are the same man.

dramabox.title: Married to the Devil in Disguise
dramabox.norm_title: married to the devil in disguise
dramabox.description: On her wedding day, Elara suffers double betrayal—her fiancé cheats with her stepsister, and her stepmother alters the will to cast her out. To reclaim her grandfather's trust fund, she must marry within 24 hours. Desperate, she signs a contract with a penniless bartender. But Elara doesn't know this seemingly down-and-out man is actually the mafia don who rules the underworld. As enemies close in, he sheds his disguise and unleashes a bloody revenge in his wife's name.

dramabox.title: The Widow's Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: the widow s billionaire
dramabox.description: After eighteen years of sacrifice, Claire is publicly discarded by her husband Richard and stripped of her home, money, and reputation. She enters a one-year contract marriage with billionaire Alexander Blackwell, rebuilds her career, exposes Richard and Vivian's fraud, and reclaims her life. What begins as a deal becomes real love—and a second chance on her own terms.

dramabox.title: Bound by the Cursed Alpha King
dramabox.norm_title: bound by the cursed alpha king
dramabox.description: After a betrayed Omega servant is publicly humiliated at the royal Marriage Rite, the cursed Alpha King claims her as his Luna to survive tonight's Blood Moon—but she is secretly his true fated mate, the lost Moonveil princess, and the only woman whose bond can contain the beast inside him before it finally breaks the curse.

dramabox.title: The Secret of the Madam and Her Bodyguard
dramabox.norm_title: the secret of the madam and her bodyguard
dramabox.description: Claire Brown, heiress of the White Group, married her parents' killer Ryan under a contract to seek revenge. She hired Frank, a former peacekeeper, as her bodyguard. Amid danger and intrigue, they moved from suspicion to devotion, crossing boundaries of status and hatred. Together, they uncovered the truth behind the fire eight years ago and brought the real culprit to justice.

dramabox.title: The Cowboy King's Promise
dramabox.norm_title: the cowboy king s promise
dramabox.description: A down-on-her-luck barmaid at the local saloon crosses paths with the infamous Cowboy King, the ruthless outlaw who rules the town, when she saves his life. Grateful—and fiercely protective—he sets his sights on making her his. But his devotion comes at a price: she must sign a contract binding herself to him for a year. As their unlikely romance deepens, her loyalty and tenderness begin to soften his hardened heart, teaching him what it truly means to be loved and supported.

dramabox.title: The Perfect Wife Divorces
dramabox.norm_title: the perfect wife divorces
dramabox.description: Melissa signed a five-year marriage agreement with Austin, the president of IW Group, to pay off her father's debts. Once the debts were settled, she filed for divorce, determined to pursue her dream of design. Little did she know, Austin had already fallen in love with her during their time together.At this critical juncture, Matthew emerged, plunging the company into crisis.

dramabox.title: The Heiress & Her Lying Beast
dramabox.norm_title: the heiress her lying beast
dramabox.description: Vivian Lawrence, the least favored and unattractive daughter of the wealthy Lawrence family, enters a contract marriage with Aaron, a man she believes to be cruel, ugly, and disabled, to secure her late mother’s inheritance. Planning to divorce after one year, Vivian is surprised to discover Aaron is not the vicious playboy of the rumors. As they grow closer, she realizes there might be a hidden truth behind his disability…

dramabox.title: Let's Gamble on Love
dramabox.norm_title: let s gamble on love
dramabox.description: In the entire City of Sin, you are the first who wanted me alive. What am I to do?  I'm growing fond of you." When her gambling-addict father sells her to settle his debts, college student Samantha falls into the hands of Isaac, the casino's toxic second master. Her rebellion fuels his sick, possessive obsession, and he locks her in a golden cage with a forced marriage certificate. Will this dark romance of forced proximity ever spark a genuine flame?

dramabox.title: Behind the Glory of the Runway
dramabox.norm_title: behind the glory of the runway
dramabox.description: Alice, haunted by her father's debt and past bullying, transforms into Jasmine, a rising model who captures the heart of Anthony, the playboy CEO of Woolley Group. However, their relationship faces strong opposition from Anthony's sister, who was also Alice's bully. Torn between love, ambition, and retribution, Jasmine stands at a critical crossroads.

dramabox.title: Revenge of the Abandoned Heriess
dramabox.norm_title: revenge of the abandoned heriess
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her deceitful ex and left childless, Mia Gerber craves revenge. Her first step? A strategic marriage to a cold-hearted heir!

dramabox.title: Flash Married To The Billionaire Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: flash married to the billionaire daddy
dramabox.description: When struggling waitress Lila Collins agrees to a contract marriage to protect her daughter, she has no idea her fake husband, Adrian Koch, is a powerful CEO—or the man from a drugged one-night mistake five years ago. As Adrian steps in to protect her from growing danger, small clues from the past begin to surface, revealing a shocking truth: Lila’s daughter may be his child. What began as a deal slowly turns into a family neither of them expected.

dramabox.title: My Crippled Husband is a Hidden Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: my crippled husband is a hidden billionaire
dramabox.description: Ten years after Sophie saved Leon from a car crash orchestrated by his brother Mike, Sophie catches her fiancé Ryan (Leon’s nephew) cheating at their wedding. She impulsively proposes to Leon, who’s pretending to be crippled to uncover the accident’s truth and reclaim his stolen business. Their contractual marriage deepens into love as Leon secretly protects Sophie. After exposing Mike and Ryan’s crimes, Leon reveals he’s a hidden billionaire.

dramabox.title: Married to My Alpha Husband by Contract
dramabox.norm_title: married to my alpha husband by contract
dramabox.description: After being betrayed by her fiancé and best friend on her wedding day, Catherine’s world shatters—until she enters a contract marriage with Matthew, the cold and powerful Alpha of a dominant werewolf clan. What starts as a calculated alliance slowly softens as her hidden Luna identity awakens and a prophecy reveals they are destined mates. Even more shocking—Matthew has secretly loved her for years.

dramabox.title: I Married a Mafia King for a Lie
dramabox.norm_title: i married a mafia king for a lie
dramabox.description: After saving Mafia boss Dante, Mia is forced by a ruthless rival into a contract marriage with him after her brother is kidnapped. As danger brings them closer, love blooms—but hidden truths, betrayals, and a brutal Mafia war threaten everything they have built. When fate tears them apart, Mia must protect their child, survive her enemies, and fight for the future she and Dante deserve.

dramabox.title: Billionaire Daddy's Sugar Baby
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire daddy s sugar baby
dramabox.description: Struggling to pay her mother's crushing medical bills, Bella takes a desperate job as a sugar baby—only to discover her mysterious match is Killian, the powerful billionaire she once fled from in fear.
