As their arrangement turns into real feelings, jealous rival June schemes to expose and destroy Bella. Torn between love and his own rules, Killian pushes Bella away—until both must decide whether risking everything is worth a chance at true love.

dramabox.title: Fake Marriage, True Love
dramabox.norm_title: fake marriage true love
dramabox.description: To repay her father's debts, Mia enters a fake marriage with Louis, agreeing to divorce in two years. They have no contact for the entire time. Two years later, Mia becomes Louis's assistant—neither knowing the other is their spouse. At work, they fall for each other, arousing the wild jealousy of Mia's colleague Tessa, who has always secretly adored Louis.

dramabox.title: Gone 3 Years, Still Got Me Pregnant
dramabox.norm_title: gone 3 years still got me pregnant
dramabox.description: To repay a life-saving debt, Evelyn agreed to suddenly marry Adrian, though she knew almost nothing about him. Before they could even meet, Adrian was sent overseas for a top-secret medical research project and cut off all contact.Three years later, Evelyn became pregnant with Adrian's child at his request.

dramabox.title: Billionaire's Contracted Favor
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire s contracted favor
dramabox.description: Proud designer Lena is desperate for medical expenses, so she signs a one-year marriage contract with cold, controlling CEO Ethan.What begins as a transactional fake marriage soon sparks hidden romance amid forced cohabitation and intense emotional tension. A man who never believed in love and always craved control is gradually softened by her resilience. He goes from a domineering ruler to a man deeply fallen for her.

dramabox.title: The CEO's Tiny Surprise
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo s tiny surprise
dramabox.description: On Christmas Eve, nineteen-year-old Lillian gives birth alone and leaves her daughter at the door of the father, Richard. Five years later, she returns as a cleaner, reunites with her daughter Alice, and enters a marriage with the cold-hearted CEO Richard—one that grows from duty into true love. As her hidden identity as an heiress is revealed, she must navigate conspiracy, jealousy, and family secrets, ultimately protecting those she loves and earning her own dignity.

dramabox.title: Game of Heirs
dramabox.norm_title: game of heirs
dramabox.description: On the day of her 23rd birthday, Karli's foster parents died strangely. She started a contractual marriage with the son of the person in power who inherited his parents' company. She originally wanted to use this to investigate the truth and regain power, but the two fell in love at first sight...

dramabox.title: The Tycoon's Contract Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the tycoon s contract bride
dramabox.description:
To save her father's bankrupt studio, brilliant designer Ella enters a two-year contract marriage with business tycoon Nicholas. He clears her $50 million debt. She
 plays his wife to handle family and business pressures. They agree to keep things strictly professional. But on their wedding night, Ella discovers her old designs covered in Nicholas's detailed annotations.

dramabox.title: Fleeing Husband Please Love Me All Over Again
dramabox.norm_title: fleeing husband please love me all over again
dramabox.description: After deciding to divorce from the business tycoon Alexis due to her inability to tolerate their contractual marriage, the wealthy heiress Vylina fell into the lowest point of her life. Yet, after enduring the heavy blows of life's darkest moments, she ultimately achieved abundant success in both her career and love life.

dramabox.title: Hollywood Staged Romance
dramabox.norm_title: hollywood staged romance
dramabox.description: Ruby, a rookie actress, faces career turmoil when frozen out by her company, then creates a sensation by drunkenly kissing Charles, the Spike Group CEO. He offers her a love contract: a fake relationship to promote his brands.

dramabox.title: Fall Into Sweet Trap
dramabox.norm_title: fall into sweet trap
dramabox.description: A contract marriage, two hearts drawing closer. Caitlin, struggling to survive office politics and her ex-husband's betrayal. Simon, tasked with revitalizing his family's business. When fate leads them into a loveless marriage, will they continue to abide by the contract or bravely pursue their true feelings?

dramabox.title: The Double Life of Mr President
dramabox.norm_title: the double life of mr president
dramabox.description: Claire, a small-town girl working at a fried chicken shop, accidentally stumbles into the hotel suite of U.S. President William. After helping him relieve an aphrodisiac’s effects with her body, she then aids the gunshot-wounded president in evading his pursuers. Grateful, William proposes a contractual marriage—but Claire mistakenly believes he’s just a presidential body double.

dramabox.title: Buying my night?
dramabox.norm_title: buying my night
dramabox.description: On a stormy night, Yun Juyeon saves CEO Lee Jaehyun from a panic attack triggered by childhood trauma, and they spend the night together. But when he regains consciousness, he drives her away, assuming she has ulterior motives. Ten months later, he finds her pregnant and learns the truth. Shakily, he asks, "Is the child mine?" Determined to protect Juyeon, he confronts his scheming family. Living together amid conflict, their wounds slowly heal as love begins to grow.

dramabox.title: The 99th Runaway Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the 99th runaway bride
dramabox.description: Isabella and the rich CEO Dean met by accident and got married. Dean misunderstood that Isabella was forcing him to marry her. Isabella was not happy with the marriage and fled abroad. The misunderstanding between the two worsened. Until two years later, they met again by accident and had various misunderstandings. In the end, can they resolve the misunderstanding and become each other's destined partners?

dramabox.title: Pregnant With My Infertile Alpha King
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant with my infertile alpha king
dramabox.description: College student Serena is bullied at school and mistreated at home by her stepmother and stepbrother. During a routine medical check-up, a mix-up leads to her being artificially inseminated—and she unexpectedly becomes pregnant with the child of Bart, a fearsome, savage, brutal, and allegedly infertile Wolf King. Bound together by the child, they enter into a contract marriage.

dramabox.title: Mr.Johnston,Don’t Torment Her
dramabox.norm_title: mr johnston don t torment her
dramabox.description: Swain Ross and Shane Johnston have been lovers for five years. One day Shane Johnston decided to end the relationship with Swain. Meanwhile, Swain unexpectedly learns that she has only three months left to live due to heart failure. In order not to being implicated in love again, Swain decided to leave Shane, but she didn't realize that a relationship of pain had just begun...

dramabox.title: Flash Marriage to My Billionaire Hobo Hubby
dramabox.norm_title: flash marriage to my billionaire hobo hubby
dramabox.description: Katie, an andrologist, is forced by her mom to marry within a month to secure her family business，while Nate, the CEO of Blake Group, is forced into an embarrassing andrology exam to prove he's "functional". Their unexpected meeting at the hospital pushes them into a contract marriage—without knowing she’s the hidden Reed heiress and he’s undercover as an ordinary employee.

dramabox.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
dramabox.norm_title: till lies do us part
dramabox.description: A mission gone wrong traps an FBI agent in a six-month marriage with a billionaire she was meant to investigate. Now the only thing more dangerous than his secrets... is her feelings.

dramabox.title: Raising a Hikikomori Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: raising a hikikomori heiress
dramabox.description: A beautiful hikikomori second-generation chaebol is dragged out of her house! A contract marriage with a man who promises to help her socialize through a full-on caregiving romance.

dramabox.title: The Virgin's Deal with Her Sugar Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: the virgin s deal with her sugar daddy
dramabox.description: Medical student Charlotte sells herself to cardiac surgeon Noah to save her grandmother. What begins as a financial arrangement gradually develops into genuine feelings. However, their relationship faces numerous trials: Noah's ex-girlfriend Emily shows up with a "love child," Charlotte's grandmother's life is threatened, and Robert's schemes create further turmoil. In the end, the truth comes to light, and the couple ends up together.

dramabox.title: Mop in Hand, World at My Feet
dramabox.norm_title: mop in hand world at my feet
dramabox.description: To support her family, widow Ruth Ziegler entrusts her three-year-old son to her parents and leaves to start a business overseas. After years of hard work, she builds the world's leading chamber of commerce, Vestra Chamber. Yet, upon returning, she chooses to work at her son's company incognito—as a janitor.

dramabox.title: Boss, You're Busted!
dramabox.norm_title: boss you re busted
dramabox.description: After her ex Jack's betrayal left 24-year-old Emma without her child—or her ability to have another—she reinvented herself as a "Scumbag Slayer," taking down corrupt rich men in the shadows. But when her operations racked up $25M in damages to tycoon Arthur's hotels, he cornered her with a deal: a fake marriage to help him ruin his upcoming society wedding.

dramabox.title: My Perfectly Quirky Wife
dramabox.norm_title: my perfectly quirky wife
dramabox.description:
To escape an arranged marriage, a second-generation chaebol and a chaebol heiress enter a contract marriage while hiding their real identities. As they begin living together, the two unknowingly fall in love—each 
unaware of the other's true status.

dramabox.title: Contract Husband: He Is Already Yours
dramabox.norm_title: contract husband he is already yours
dramabox.description: Sophia Sterling was kicked out of her home by her father and had her assets frozen due to her excessive spending. With the help of her best friend Skye, she entered into a contractual marriage with Luke Carter. Initially, she only aimed to get money, but they gradually developed feelings for each other while jointly dealing with Vivian Thorne's provocation and the bankruptcy crisis of the Sterling Group.

dramabox.title: The Tyrant's Bride-to-be
dramabox.norm_title: the tyrant s bride to be
dramabox.description: Struggling with her father's debt, a woman complains about the ending of a web novel, wishing it was more realistic. After expressing her frustration, she suddenly finds herself transported into the novel as the fiancée of the first character to die. Determined to survive, she decides to become the love interest of the main antagonist, a feared tyrant, and proposes a contract marriage.

dramabox.title: Touching Your Heartbeat
dramabox.norm_title: touching your heartbeat
dramabox.description: A contract marriage for the survival of the head of a conglomerate infected with a deadly poison and a poor college girl with the only antidote ability that could save him. A fateful romance that transcends death and misunderstanding, saving each other and leading to true love.

dramabox.title: Losing You Once is Enough
dramabox.norm_title: losing you once is enough
dramabox.description: Emily Lacey, daughter of Norvan's chief judge, has been secretly married to Clive Scott for three years. When her family falls into ruin and goes bankrupt, she leaves him in heartbreak, carrying his unborn children. Only after she walks away does Clive realize he has lost the love of his life—and now he's determined to win her back, begging for her forgiveness with all his heart.

dramabox.title: My Domineering Prince
dramabox.norm_title: my domineering prince
dramabox.description: Amelia, a struggling actress, is betrayed by her manager, losing all her money and finding herself homeless. Just when she hits rock bottom, she encounters Alex, a mysterious man who takes her in. What begins as an accidental invitation to a role-play party turns into a life-changing discovery when Amelia learns that Alex is actually a prince. He proposes a contract for her to pretend to be his fiancée, to save his reputation and avoid a forced marriage.

dramabox.title: Mr. Delaney: Tempted by My Sugar Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: mr delaney tempted by my sugar daddy
dramabox.description: When Bella chooses to go stripping to save her bedridden brother and is humiliated by her peers, she meets her hero, the gentlemanly and handsome tycoon Mr. Delaney, who offers her the chance to become his sugar baby in her most desperate moment of helplessness and despair. But will this be a salvation, or will it lead her to desire and danger?

dramabox.title: Married to the Secret Lycan King
dramabox.norm_title: married to the secret lycan king
dramabox.description: A young, wolfless she-wolf's world shatters when she catches her fiancé cheating the night before their wedding. In a twist of fate, she marries a mysterious stranger—unaware he's the powerful Lycan King hiding his identity. As they navigate a marriage of convenience, sizzling chemistry and dangerous pack politics threaten to expose secrets, ignite passions, and change both their lives forever.

dramabox.title: 30 Days of Hidden Marriage
dramabox.norm_title: 30 days of hidden marriage
dramabox.description: Tessa, a small-town girl with dreams of painting, enters into a shotgun marriage with the domineering CEO Dave due to a marriage contract. The two choose to keep their marriage a secret due to their circumstances. Facing difficulties, misunderstandings, romantic rivals, and life-and-death crises, how long can their marriage last? Can they overcome the numerous obstacles and truly come together?

dramabox.title: Mafia's 90-Day Bride
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s 90 day bride
dramabox.description: Gigi, seeking revenge on the insurance CEO who caused her father's death, offers her only $10,000 to mafia boss Vito to buy his life. Amused by her persistence, Vito proposes she become his bride for 90 days instead. Though he protects her, Vito's cynical nature leads him to refuse life-saving cancer surgery. Disheartened, Gigi believes she's just a pawn. When Gigi nearly miscarries, Vito realizes his love and chooses to fight for life to protect her and their child.

dramabox.title: Trial Marriage to A Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: trial marriage to a billionaire
dramabox.description: Aurora is a top model who had climbed the ladder of fame and made a name for herself in the industry. At the peak of her career, she sacrifices her fame and career to be with Logan. On what was meant to be the happiest day of her life, Aurora finds herself heartbroken and abandoned when her fiancé Logan stands her up at their wedding. Just a day before the wedding, she had learned that Grace (her rival) is pregnant with his child but still hoped against the odds.

dramabox.title: Punished by His Love
dramabox.norm_title: punished by his love
dramabox.description: She was a destitute woman whose life was dependent on others. She was forced to be a scapegoat and traded herself, which resulted in her pregnancy. He considered that she was the ultimate embodiment of evil as she was greedy and deceitful. She tried all her efforts to win his heart but failed. Her departure made him so furious that he searched through the ends of the world and managed to recapture her. The whole city knew that she would be shredded into a million pieces.

dramabox.title: Alpha's Fated Surrogate
dramabox.norm_title: alpha s fated surrogate
dramabox.description: Leah becomes a surrogate to help her boyfriend but is betrayed. She meets Alpha Lucas, her fated mate. Pregnant and heartbroken, she enters the werewolf world and rises as Luna through love and strength.

dramabox.title: My World Ends with You
dramabox.norm_title: my world ends with you
dramabox.description: To avenge his father's death due to medical malpractice, Luca retaliates against Scarlett, the daughter of the attending doctor, by throwing her into a mental hospital for torture and humiliation. But what his heart keeps telling him is...

dramabox.title: Secretly Married to the CEO
dramabox.norm_title: secretly married to the ceo
dramabox.description: An intern accidentally walks into the wrong room and ends up having a one-night stand with a stranger. The next day, she's shocked to discover that the man is actually her boss. Even more unexpected, he proposes to marry her. Thereafter she enters into this complicated contract marriage that is filled with ambiguous entanglements. As Emily dives deeper, it's unbeknownst to her that all of this was meticulously orchestrated by Mason, the boss…

dramabox.title: The Deal with Love
dramabox.norm_title: the deal with love
dramabox.description: Katherine, a single girl with no intimate relationship, gets knocked up to her own surprise, like Virgin Marry. Right upon she gets informed of the pregnancy, her CEO Felix's fiancée jumps out claiming that the mysterious father of the baby is Katherine’s boss, Felix Morgan. However, Mr. Morgan seems to have no clue nor interest in this unexpected baby…

dramabox.title: Sleeping Handsome, Let's Mate!
dramabox.norm_title: sleeping handsome let s mate
dramabox.description: Avery, a struggling call girl, seizes the chance to marry the sole heir of the rich Waldorf family to earn money for her mother's medical bills. However, her future husband, Elliot, is a vegetable. Can Avery fulfill her commitment in this unexpected situation?

dramabox.title: A Heart's Untold Truth
dramabox.norm_title: a heart s untold truth
dramabox.description:
Amelia Russo has loved Shawn Butler for many years, but his heart remains steadfast in its longing for his first love. Determined, Amelia gracefully steps aside to make room for that woman.
Shawn deludes into believing his happiness lies in Amelia's absence and jolts by an unexpected revelation upon receiving her medical card. "Shawn Butler, as the final days of my life trickle away, I no longer choose to waste my love on you."

dramabox.title: From Substitute Bride to Beloved Wife
dramabox.norm_title: from substitute bride to beloved wife
dramabox.description: Mabel was originally the daughter of the wealthy Grant family. However, her happy family was torn apart when she was eight. Since then, her days were hard and challenging.

dramabox.title: Addicted to the Rival Alphas
dramabox.norm_title: addicted to the rival alphas
dramabox.description: Harper, the only human in an elite werewolf academy, hides a severe uncontrollable craving. One desperate night, she gives herself to a stranger—Ryder, the ruthless Alpha who despises humans. He tears the school apart to find her. When golden-boy Liam claims her, a dark obsession awakens in Ryder. Caught between two Alphas, Harper's secret is about to explode. Can she survive?

dramabox.title: His Captive Rose
dramabox.norm_title: his captive rose
dramabox.description: Mafia heir Vance recognizes prison doctor Sera as the girl he saved years ago. Obsessed, he beats her boyfriend Adam and forces their breakup. When prisoners kidnap Sera, they demand Vance's fingers—he prepares to sacrifice them. Adam flees. During a riot, Vance kills Adam, takes Sera by helicopter, and locks her in his world. A story of obsession, betrayal, and a buried childhood bond.

dramabox.title: Too Late, She's Wed to the Beast
dramabox.norm_title: too late she s wed to the beast
dramabox.description: Princess Layla loves Holy Knight Edmund, but after his defeat, she gives up her title and arranges his marriage to her maid, Evelyn, to save the kingdom from the Wolf King Fenrir's sacrifice demand. Betrayed and publicly humiliated by Edmund, who believes Evelyn's lies, Layla offers herself instead. She forms a blood pact with Fenrir, giving half her soul to restore his human form—and finds unexpected love.

dramabox.title: Kiss of Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: kiss of revenge
dramabox.description: To avenge her mother, healer Helena ruthlessly dumps her stonemason boyfriend of three years and approaches Lucas, her enemy's son, using divine blood to cure his illness and infiltrate his family. But just as she nears success, she is stunned to discover—her abandoned ex-boyfriend is her fiancé's brother, Marco. A revenge plan spirals out of control in a deadly love triangle of brotherly rivalry and forbidden love.

dramabox.title: Shared by Rivals, Claimed by Both
dramabox.norm_title: shared by rivals claimed by both
dramabox.description: On a stormy night, werewolf Leo and vampire Vincent's duel crashes into Chloe's clinic. Mistaking them for lovers, she heals them with special bread that cures supernatural wounds. The rivals secretly buy her company to claim the cure, shielding Chloe from workplace schemes. A hilarious, steamy rom-com of supernatural rivalry and pampering begins...

dramabox.title: His Nighttime Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: his nighttime obsession
dramabox.description: Heiress Lydia loses everything—family bankrupt, father dying, sister hunted. She makes a deal with Rian, Dynasty family's ruthless second son: seduce his brother Leo. It's a survival game. But Leo hides a dark secret, and Rian shows her unexpected tenderness. What begins as cold revenge becomes a trap of the heart. In the abyss, they become each other's only salvation.

dramabox.title: The Dragon and the Witch: A Cursed Love
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon and the witch a cursed love
dramabox.description: Cursed dragon Kaelos bonds with witch Elena; she gains dragon traits, he claims her as mate. Husband Max bears her protective runes. Prophecy: Elena kills her true love—Max bears the mark. Kaelos takes Elena; Max steps away. Magic Bureau traps them; Elena, mind-controlled, wounds Kaelos but impales Max instead. Curse breaks. Kaelos regains power, marries Elena. Max survives, reborn.

dramabox.title: He Paid for One Night, Then Wanted Forever
dramabox.norm_title: he paid for one night then wanted forever
dramabox.description: Destitute Haley agrees to a one-night deal with heir Julian to save her dying mother. Auctioned at his sky-high bid, she learns he hunts a trafficking ring. Her friend Ryan is the crime lord. Haley takes a bullet for Julian, wakes to his confession. A five-year crush, tested by conspiracy and death, finds its answer.

dramabox.title: His Father, My Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: his father my daddy
dramabox.description: After her fiancé Leo falls into a river and is presumed dead, a devastated Willa crosses the line with his godfather Magnus on a stormy night. They form an alliance for revenge and grow close. But Leo returns alive, trapping them in a web of ethics and emotions. After deadly clashes with the Blood Axe Gang, they reconcile and accept one another. Yet just as they secretly pledge their love in the garden, a hidden camera captures everything...

dramabox.title: Claimed by 3 Vampire Lords
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by 3 vampire lords
dramabox.description: Believing she's to work, Layla enters a manor but only to discover she is deceived and actually a bride candidate for three vampire brothers—Lucian, Enzo and Elliot. She's supposed to take a deadly trial and, if survives, become the bride. Before that, however, her body is used as a vessel by their uncle Dorian to resurrect his lover and their mother Elizabeth. To save them from her, Layla drives a silver dagger through her heart, but survives with a magic potion in the end.

dramabox.title: Too Late to Love me
dramabox.norm_title: too late to love me
dramabox.description: Sol Windsor, the true princess, was replaced by adopted Daisy. Only Prince Leon was her warmth, swearing to love her forever. He abandoned her for Daisy—she was pushed off a cliff. Leon searched, killed Daisy, but Sol survived and was rescued by Emperor Henry, who loved her silently. At their wedding, Leon begged forgiveness, but Henry declared her his empress. Sol must make her final choice.

dramabox.title: My Vampire First Love Regretted Losing Me
dramabox.norm_title: my vampire first love regretted losing me
dramabox.description: Lilith, born with sacred blood, was raised by vampire brothers Adrian and Louis. When human Charlotte sowed discord, they believed her lies, imprisoned and tormented Lilith. Heartbroken, Lilith agreed to marry vampire prince Dracula, who cherished her. Adrian and Louis later learned the truth, regretted deeply, and disrupted the wedding. The conspiracy was exposed, the brothers exiled themselves, and Lilith and Dracula were crowned Vampire King and Queen.

dramabox.title: Her Vendetta Game
dramabox.norm_title: her vendetta game
dramabox.description: Sofia is the vicious supporting character in a strategy‑based otome game. After gaining self‑awareness, she refuses to be nothing but a stepping‑stone for the player‑transmigrated Summer. She takes the initiative to shatter the original plot, repeatedly foiling traps set by Summer with her system. Navigating among three male leads, she publicly humiliates her rivals at banquets, in the workplace and many other scenarios.

dramabox.title: Offered to the Black Dragon, I Became the Holy-Blood Witch
dramabox.norm_title: offered to the black dragon i became the holy blood witch
dramabox.description: Ivy, the cursed twin, is scorned; Lilia, the other twin, is adored. Caius the phoenix bonds with Ivy but gives his heartfeather to Lilia and forces Ivy to die in Lilia's place before the black dragon. Yet dragon Adrian recognizes Ivy, who saved him as a child. Her blood cleanses his blight, revealing her as the Holy-Blood Witch. Now the world worships Ivy; Caius begs her with his last heartfeather, while Adrian refuses to let her go. Ivy must choose: guilt or love.

dramabox.title: The Governor’s Hidden Love
dramabox.norm_title: the governor s hidden love
dramabox.description: Chloe had been with Christian for five years, but he planned to marry another and humiliated her publicly. She broke up with him. Blake, Christian’s half-brother, had long loved her and pursued her, winning her heart. Christian realized his love too late, losing everything.

dramabox.title: Glass Crown: I Loved the Enemy Heir
dramabox.norm_title: glass crown i loved the enemy heir
dramabox.description: The prince and princess of Aurelia are forced into political marriages with enemy Veyr. Crown Prince Cassian falls for his sister's fiancé Dorian, while Princess Elara falls for Kael, Dorian's guard. On the engagement night, secrets, poisoning, and a tribunal erupt, forcing them to choose between throne and love.

dramabox.title: Tempted by My Brother's Mafia Rival
dramabox.norm_title: tempted by my brother s mafia rival
dramabox.description:
When sheltered virgin Mia Franco transfers to Santa 
Lucia Academy, her brother forbids her from getting 
romantically involved with rival heir Dante DiMarco, but 
she secretly falls for him, leading to escalating desire, 
defiance of her family, and a feud between her brother 
and her lover, Dante.

dramabox.title: Good Girl Turned Bad
dramabox.norm_title: good girl turned bad
dramabox.description: After witnessing her boyfriend Daniel’s betrayal on her birthday, good girl Katelyn decides to take revenge by entering a fake relationship contract with campus heartthrob Xavier to win a couples contest prize for her family’s debts. As they pretend to be a couple in public, real feelings develop—especially when Xavier, who has secretly loved her since she helped him years ago, supports her behind the scenes.

dramabox.title: Lust and Deception
dramabox.norm_title: lust and deception
dramabox.description: To save her sister, werewolf Evelyn accepts a deal with Sebastian, going undercover as a spy at the side of his brother, Lucian.Lucian is her fated mate, yet Sebastian deliberately marks Evelyn, binding her to himself and forcing her into a dangerous love triangle.As secrets surface and loyalties blur, Evelyn is drawn to Sebastian despite knowing his control is calculated and ruthless.

dramabox.title: The Equestrian Star's Cinderella Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the equestrian star s cinderella bride
dramabox.description: After a reckless one-night stand with equestrian champion Phillips Hobbs, hotel maid Cindy Becker is caught in a scandal that forces them into a flash marriage. Bound by pride and passion yet divided by class and circumstance, their fragile union faces relentless tests—from Phillips’ devoted fiancée to the weight of family expectations.

dramabox.title: Stolen Nights with My Fiancé’s Brother
dramabox.norm_title: stolen nights with my fianc s brother
dramabox.description: Evelyn Hart, the dutiful bride-to-be, discovers on the eve of their engagement that she will never capture her fiancé’s heart. Overwhelmed by turmoil, she succumbs to a one-night stand with a stranger—completely unaware that he is none other than her fiancé’s rebellious younger brother, Lucas: the one man she should never lay a finger on. When guilt compels her to flee, Lucas, instead, closes in on her step by step.

dramabox.title: Falling for the Right Brother
dramabox.norm_title: falling for the right brother
dramabox.description: To win the heart of her crush before graduation, nerd Aria enlists the help of his dangerously charming older brother for a crash course in intimacy—only to discover she might be learning how to love the wrong guy. She asked him for lessons in sex and intimacy. And her crush's brother became her love coach.

dramabox.title: My Olympian Brothers Loved Me Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: my olympian brothers loved me too late
dramabox.description: Three centuries' devotion shatters in just three months. Kora, daughter of the Earth Goddess, grows up with love from two powerful gods, Elio and Zephyr, believing that she would marry one of the brothers, until Lyra, a scheming nymph, turns them against Kora with vicious lies. Betrayed, framed and even nearly killed, Kora makes a fate-changing choice: accepting the proposal from Hades, the Lord of the Underworld.

dramabox.title: The Siren Club
dramabox.norm_title: the siren club
dramabox.description: When the powerful Alban family walks free after killing her sister, Ivy joins a secret sisterhood that turns seduction into revenge. As she’s trained to weaponize desire, she’s pulled into a dangerous triangle between a ruthless father and his two rival sons—Ivy will risk everything—even her own life—for the chance to drag the Albans down with her.

dramabox.title: Making of An Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: making of an heiress
dramabox.description: When an ordinary delivery girl Hannah is betrayed by her boyfriend and about to be sold to a debt collector, she's rescued by Cedric, CEO of the Benedon Group, who hires her to impersonate his nephew's missing fiancée Ivy Bailey—only to uncover Hannah might be the real heir while facing suspicion from Ivy's scheming sister Jenna. Most importantly, Cedric seems to have fallen in love with his nephew's fiancée!

dramabox.title: Coaching My Heart at 200 MPH
dramabox.norm_title: coaching my heart at 200 mph
dramabox.description: Ordinary secretary Freya is tasked with stopping playboy Boris from motorcycling. After an accidental kiss reveals her crush on his friend Ethan, she agrees to Boris' "love training"—hiding his rides in exchange for help winning Ethan. As he transforms her image, undeniable chemistry sparks. When Freya learns Boris was her secret savior years ago, who will she choose? Her longtime infatuation or the man who reshapes her destiny?

dramabox.title: My Substitute CEO
dramabox.norm_title: my substitute ceo
dramabox.description: After her first love Patrick vanishes, Sue marries Derrick, who resembles Patrick, out of obsession. A love triangle simmers—Sue torn between her Patrick fantasy and Derrick’s real affection, when a man claiming to be Patrick (actually vengeful rival Zach) appears, it ignites chaos, forcing Sue to confront: is she loving a ghost, a substitute, or her husband before her?

dramabox.title: Don't Regret When She Let Go
dramabox.norm_title: don t regret when she let go
dramabox.description: Bella spends two years pursuing Louis, only to find out he gets close to her to get to her stepsister. Heartbroken, she decides to walk away. Too late, Louis figures out he has fallen for the wrong girl—and regret is eating him alive.

dramabox.title: Bumpkin Virgin and Her Billionaire Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: bumpkin virgin and her billionaire stepbrother
dramabox.description: Country girl Gigi moves into her wealthy new home after her mother remarries, only to walk in on her arrogant stepbrother Xavier in a private moment. What starts as humiliation quickly turns into dangerous attraction. As Gigi becomes the object of school bullying, her loyal childhood friend Noah steps in to protect her, while Xavier grows obsessively protective of the stepsister he swore to hate. Caught between two boys, Gigi must choose between safe love and forbidden desire

dramabox.title: My Miscarriage, His Flirt with Mistress
dramabox.norm_title: my miscarriage his flirt with mistress
dramabox.description: Evelyn thought her pregnancy was a blessing, until she caught her husband stroking his first love's belly. When a medical emergency struck, he locked Evelyn away, leaving her to lose their baby in agonizing isolation. Months after she walked away to rebuild her career in architecture, her toxic ex-husband Edward resurfaces at their "forever" love-lock bridge with a final, desperate ultimatum: forgive him, or watch him jump. Will she save her tormentor, or let gravity take him

dramabox.title: My Son Wanted a New Mom, I Quit
dramabox.norm_title: my son wanted a new mom i quit
dramabox.description: After eight years of marriage, Laura was never loved. Her husband's heart belonged to his first love, and her son saw her only as a nanny. When that first love returned home for her birthday, her son wished she could be his mom instead. Laura finally walked away, to pursue the music career she'd abandoned eight years ago. Her ex-husband and son begged her to return—but it was already too late.

dramabox.title: Tangled Ties and Tipsy Vows
dramabox.norm_title: tangled ties and tipsy vows
dramabox.description: After years apart, Carol is forced by her stepmother and stepsister to marry playboy Grayson instead of her stepsister. A chance encounter with her childhood love Dylan, who now resents her for a past betrayal, complicates things. Dylan pretends to date Carol's stepsister to torment her, but as truths emerge, their tangled relationships take unexpected turns.

dramabox.title: Golden Feather: Temptation Game
dramabox.norm_title: golden feather temptation game
dramabox.description: At the Golden Feather Academy, after being rejected, Queen Celine offers her playboy stepbrother Leo a night with her if he can seduce and destroy the boy who refused her—the president's son, Logic.But when Leo's fake pursuit turns real, Celine loses control of Leo forever...

dramabox.title: Country Heartthrob
dramabox.norm_title: country heartthrob
dramabox.description: Cassie Fisher is a country singer who has just become America's sweetheart. She is secretly married to a megachurch pastor. But when her label hires Knox Maddox, a tattooed bad-boy songwriter who is also hooking up with her sister, to help with her album, the chemistry between them quickly grows out of control. One drunken night turns into a passionate secret affair.

dramabox.title: Trapped by My Four Exes
dramabox.norm_title: trapped by my four exes
dramabox.description: A downtrodden fast-food worker with no memory... is actually the cold-blooded assassin who once played four terrifying billionaires like fools? Three years after a car crash wiped her memory, Chloe is flipping burgers in the slums, struggling to survive. Until one rainy night, she is cornered by four of the world's most powerful and dangerous men—her ruthless billionaire ex-husband, a savage underground fight king, an obsessive genius doctor, and a controlling hacker god.

dramabox.title: Love Love Change
dramabox.norm_title: love love change
dramabox.description: A single piece of candy handed over by a beggar. In that moment, the souls of two friends, Luna and Han byeol, are swapped. At the same time, they fall in love with the same person. The once-perfect relationship between Luna, Han-byeol, and Wooju faces a crack, and their emotions begin to cross paths. Is it a prank of God, or a gift? Does love follow the body, or the heart?

dramabox.title: Torn Between My Stepbrothers
dramabox.norm_title: torn between my stepbrothers
dramabox.description: Hailey has been crushing on Derek for years, only to discover on the day she plans to confess that he is now with her best friend. Heartbroken, she drinks alone and is harassed, but is rescued by Tyler. Mistaking him for Derek, Hailey believes they share a one-night stand—only to wake and realize he is her stepbrother and Derek's older brother.

dramabox.title: Here Comes Mr. Trouble
dramabox.norm_title: here comes mr trouble
dramabox.description: Yu-ri's life flips when her boyfriend and ex-boyfriend start dating each other. She joins them in a polyamorous relationship, leading to a messy, jealous struggle for love. A chaotic triple romance.

dramabox.title: Love, Desire, or Just a Game
dramabox.norm_title: love desire or just a game
dramabox.description: Burdened by debt, photographer Claire Jesson accepts an invitation from her ex-boyfriend, Ethan Osbourn, to join a reality dating show with a $10 million prize. Six ex-couples live together, and a nightly game decides who shares a bed. As new bonds form and old feelings resurface, love and desire blur. Claire is forced to confront her past and choose her future.

dramabox.title: CEO Daddy, Please Don’t Catch Me!
dramabox.norm_title: ceo daddy please don t catch me
dramabox.description: Cheon Jaehui is the heiress of Cheonil Group and the legendary hacker "Dr. T." She hides her identity and works as Do Jihan's secretary for love. After three years, she plans to reveal her pregnancy to him, only to learn he's engaged to a fake Dr. T. She is the victim of a kidnapping and nearly loses her baby, but Jihan accuses her of being the culprit instead. Choosing to disappear with her child, she sparks his desperate pursuit. But can she truly escape?

dramabox.title: Her Forbidden Lovers
dramabox.norm_title: her forbidden lovers
dramabox.description: Being the sole heiress of a business conglomerate, 21-year-old Audrey receives the shock of her life when her dad orders her to be married within a year. He forces her to attend a party with a list of all the potential suitors that are up to his standards. But as Audrey plans her escape from the party, she falls into the hands of the Vanderbilt brothers. Caspian, the older brother, is a hot and sexy womanizer with a heart of gold.

dramabox.title: Love Reset Game
dramabox.norm_title: love reset game
dramabox.description: After discovering her boyfriend's betrayal, Alison fakes amnesia for revenge—never expecting to fall for Carl, the man she's forced to pretend to be her boyfriend. As passion ignites between them, her vindictive best friend spirals into violent jealousy, threatening everything with deadly consequences in this twisted game of hearts and lies.

dramabox.title: Bye Ex, I Got My Jackpot Fiancé
dramabox.norm_title: bye ex i got my jackpot fianc
dramabox.description: After being publicly humiliated by her boyfriend Hugo and his first love Vivian, Elaine learns she was only a substitute. Heartbroken, she reunites with Trevor, the wealthy heir and arranged match she once rejected. With Trevor's support, Elaine reveals herself as the Wesley Group heiress and leaves Hugo behind. When Hugo learns her true identity and Trevor's status, he is filled with regret and tries to win her back.

dramabox.title: Ex's Mafia Daddy Wants Me Bad
dramabox.norm_title: ex s mafia daddy wants me bad
dramabox.description: College student Eleanor is saved at her darkest hour by mafia godfather Lorenzo. After a one-night stand, she soon discovers this domineering yet tender protector is her boyfriend Matteo’s own father. Caught between the boyfriend and his father, she struggles as a forbidden, scandalous love blooms.

dramabox.title: Her Secret, His Regret
dramabox.norm_title: her secret his regret
dramabox.description: Undercover agent Madeleine is forced to betray lover Ethan, who nearly dies protecting her. She secretly donates a kidney to save him but hides the sacrifice, while Emma falsely claims to be the donor. Five years later, reunited with tycoon Ethan—now bitter and engaged to Emma—Madeleine navigates deadly missions. Hayes, a powerful figure with lingering affection for her, lures her with safety and power, pressuring her to choose between him and Ethan. As lies unravel and dange

dramabox.title: Alpha King, This Time I Reject You
dramabox.norm_title: alpha king this time i reject you
dramabox.description: Tara, a wolfless outcast, has always loved Kael—her fated mate and the Alpha King in disguise. But Kael believes her cruel stepsister Olivia saved his life, choosing Olivia and hurting Tara again and again. Heartbroken, Tara rejects their bond and marries the powerful Lucian. On her wedding day, he crashes the ceremony to win her back. But this time, Tara walks away for good, leaving the Alpha King to face a lifetime of regret.

dramabox.title: Why Rich Woman Kills
dramabox.norm_title: why rich woman kills
dramabox.description: At her father's funeral, a woman discovers her husband's secret homosexual affair. Driven by revenge, she begins her perilous plan by igniting a passionate affair with a seductive man—who unexpectedly turns out to be her new assistant and the hidden heir to her rival company. What makes a rich woman turn into an angel of vengeance?

dramabox.title: After Divorce Three Aces Beg to Marry Me
dramabox.norm_title: after divorce three aces beg to marry me
dramabox.description: Melissa Levinson, who hides her identity as the esteemed Levinson Heiress, decides to leave her scumbag husband Jeffrey who’s been repeatedly cheating on her with his colleague Jocelyn. At the same time, the Three Aces, Melissa’s childhood friends—Finn Wallace, a resourceful and billionaire entrepreneur; Marco Diaz, a charismatic tech mogul; and Vinny Marcello, a passionate rapper— all billionaires of their ventures, begin pursuing Melissa at her father’s request.

dramabox.title: Sorry for Confessing!
dramabox.norm_title: sorry for confessing
dramabox.description: A woman, wounded by her unrequited love for a man, impulsively confesses her feelings to three male friends. Assuming she'll be rejected by all of them—of course—but instead, at the very same moment, each one agrees to date her. From a lifelong single to a sudden femme fatale juggling three relationships, she is reborn overnight. Can she possibly navigate this tangled web of love without everything falling apart?

dramabox.title: Tempted By My Ex's Professor Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: tempted by my ex s professor daddy
dramabox.description: After getting bullied and cheated on by her boyfriend, Tom, Evelyn sleeps with Nathaniel, an older gentleman who happens to visit the same bar as her. She realizes soon however that Nathaniel turns out to be her new professor and Tom’s father. Will Nathaniel defend Evelyn and will a spark ignite?

dramabox.title: Tempted by the Wrong Brother
dramabox.norm_title: tempted by the wrong brother
dramabox.description: Encouraged by her best friend, Nora sends an anonymous bikini photo to Chris to get his attention. But she types in the wrong number and accidentally starts sexting with Zachary. Zachary quickly realizes Nora has mistaken him for Chris — but he keeps quiet and plays along.Believing she’s flirting with Chris, Nora grows increasingly close to Zachary, both online and in real life, until Zachary’s jealousy gets the better of him and he finally confesses the truth.

dramabox.title: Mafia's Love Left Me No Way Out
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s love left me no way out
dramabox.description: Rosalia and Nick, the son of a mafia boss, were once a loving engaged couple until a misunderstanding turned them into mortal enemies. Torn between love and hatred, Nick decides to train Rosalia to become the most formidable assassin in the underworld as her path to atonement. After seven years of grueling training, Rosalia begins carrying out missions with exceptional skill.

dramabox.title: Goodbye, My Dad's Best Friend
dramabox.norm_title: goodbye my dad s best friend
dramabox.description: Lena falls in love with Elijah, her dad’s best friend, who has always kept her at a distance for some reason. Accidentally carrying his child, Lena plans to leave him for good but their tangled love traps her.

dramabox.title: The One That Got Away
dramabox.norm_title: the one that got away
dramabox.description: Bella, a prep-school queen, is betrayed when Louis uses her to chase her stepsister Vivian. She transfers to start over—until Louis learns the truth and fights to win her back.

dramabox.title: Destiny's Twist: Loving Against Fate
dramabox.norm_title: destiny s twist loving against fate
dramabox.description: Isabel Lynch will face a fated tribulation when she turns 20 and must marry the destined man to survive. She identifies Miguel Quick by a pendant he wears. Isabel forces Miguel to live together with her. After genuine love blossom between them, Isabel learns that Miguel’s buddy, Ashton Barr, is actually her destined one. Isabel turns her attention to Ashton, which saddens Miguel. It is then she realizes her true feelings towards Miguel…

dramabox.title: Too Late, My Ex-Campus King
dramabox.norm_title: too late my ex campus king
dramabox.description:
Aria accidentally opens her boyfriend Chase's computer – and what she finds shatters her world: dozens of intimate photos of Chase and his first love, Serena. The discovery becomes the final straw. That very day, Aria agrees to her family's plan – to leave L.A. for New York and take over HMS Group.
Unaware of what's brewing in her heart, Chase continues his ambiguous friendship with Serena, blurring every line while convincing himself it's harmless...

dramabox.title: Hearts at Stake, Points on the Line
dramabox.norm_title: hearts at stake points on the line
dramabox.description: Desperate to pay her mother's expensive medical bills, Sofia Murray joins the Secret Housekeeper Club as a maid under a one-month contract. She serves four powerful men, earning points after each session. If she reaches 100 points by the end of the month, she will receive $100 million. The work goes beyond chores, involving intimacy and mind games. As feelings develop, Sofia must choose between money and love before time runs out.

dramabox.title: The Romance of Zero Chance
dramabox.norm_title: the romance of zero chance
dramabox.description: "Noona... I'm Gay!" To catch the attention of Jihee, the untouchable campus queen, Seungyoon blurts out a shocking lie—that he's gay! What starts as a fake coming-out spirals into chaos when Chanyoung is suddenly pulled into the act as Seungyoon's "boyfriend." Add to the mix Jihoon and Changbin, who can't seem to stay out of their business, and you've got a tangled web of feelings, secrets, and confusion.

dramabox.title: Boss Behind the Scenes Is My Husband
dramabox.norm_title: boss behind the scenes is my husband
dramabox.description: Holy moly! How could my husband be the most powerful person on earth?

dramabox.title: A Dangerous Engagement: The Bride He Mustn't Touch
dramabox.norm_title: a dangerous engagement the bride he mustn t touch
dramabox.description:
I ran from the mob at 18. My dad, the mafia king, couldn't find me. And neither could Angelo, my stepbrother, my father's legally adopted son. When my father suddenly died, Angelo found me and brought me back. Though we were never raised together, Angelo saw me as his innocent responsibility. He insisted I marry for my safety and the empire's stability, and took charge of selecting my future husband.
But I wanted Angelo to marry me.

dramabox.title: My Scar, His Debt to Pay
dramabox.norm_title: my scar his debt to pay
dramabox.description: Rachel and Ethan were trapped in a war zone. While trying to save Ethan, Rachel was left with a disfiguring scar on her face. They fell in love and got married, but there was only one evacuation spot. Rachel gave it to the injured Ethan, and Ethan promised he would come back for her—unaware that Rachel later discovered she was pregnant.

dramabox.title: Kissing the Wrong Brother
dramabox.norm_title: kissing the wrong brother
dramabox.description: To win the heart of her crush before graduation, nerd Aria enlists the help of his dangerously charming older brother for a crash course in intimacy—only to discover she might be learning how to love the wrong guy. She asks him for lessons in sex and intimacy. And her crush's brother becomes her love coach.

dramabox.title: Almost Lover
dramabox.norm_title: almost lover
dramabox.description: Evelyn returns from her prenatal checkup to find her husband massaging oil onto his first love's belly. When Evelyn suffers a severe allergic reaction, he locks her in a room and ignores her pain—she loses the baby. Shattered, she walks away and rebuilds at her friend's architecture firm. Months later, Edward finds her at the love-lock bridge where they vowed forever, threatening to jump unless she forgives him. Will Evelyn save the man who destroyed her, or let him fall?

dramabox.title: My Billionaire Lover and Our Forgotten Love
dramabox.norm_title: my billionaire lover and our forgotten love
dramabox.description: Charlotte, an amnesiac former ballet dancer, whose life is turned upside down when the domineering CEO Benjamin appears just as she is about to marry her boyfriend, William. Benjamin's aggressive pursuit and an inexplicable sense of familiarity disrupt Charlotte's peaceful life, triggering fragments of her lost memories.

dramabox.title: Photogenic Scandal
dramabox.norm_title: photogenic scandal
dramabox.description:
Habin, 27, an amateur photographer, secretly poses as famous photographer Miro for shoots with sexy models. What starts as a simple favor spirals into a whirlwind of temptation, jealousy, and complicated emotions.
"Would you rather kiss me or pay the penalty?"

dramabox.title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Among the Stars
dramabox.norm_title: don t miss me when i m among the stars
dramabox.description:
Forced to serve as her sister‘s blood donor since
childhood, Lydia endures cruelty from her family and
betrayal from Ethan, the boy she trusted most. Rising as the youngest astronaut in U.S. history, she reclaims her dignity among the stars, leaving her family and Ethan to a too-late regret and bitter loss.

dramabox.title: Too Wild to Love
dramabox.norm_title: too wild to love
dramabox.description: After returning as an illegitimate daughter, Cara is caught in emotional turmoil between her adoptive brother Brian and wealthy heir Leo. Targeted by Moona’s schemes, she strikes a deal with Leo to save her adoptive father. Despite family opposition and public scandals, their forced proximity ignites mutual feelings. Ultimately, they confess years of hidden longing and defy societal barriers to be together.

dramabox.title: When She Stole My Lover
dramabox.norm_title: when she stole my lover
dramabox.description: Lim Min-young, has been living in pain, having everything taken away from her half-sister. Choi Shi-hyuk, mistakenly mistook the girl he passed by as a child for Lim Hye-ri, leaving a deep wound for Min-young. After abandoning everything and leaving, Min-young meets Hyun-woo. Shi-hyuk finally realized the truth and belatedly tried to catch her.

dramabox.title: Never Come Back
dramabox.norm_title: never come back
dramabox.description: Orphaned, Nam Yujin grows up with the three Nam brothers, with the promise that one of them will marry her on her coming-of-age. But upon the return of their true sister Nam Sua, Nam Yujin loses their love and sinks into desperation. Even when she marries her suitor Ha Jihoon, they deem her as attention-seeking and only regret after unveiling Nam Sua's true colors—but Nam Yujin is never coming back.

dramabox.title: Love as the Price of Treachery
dramabox.norm_title: love as the price of treachery
dramabox.description: The three men who betrayed her beg for forgiveness and confess their love? A love story of a woman, Sia, struggling to find true love and her dreams amid a complicated relationship with three men.

dramabox.title: The Hockey Star Can't Stop Missing Me
dramabox.norm_title: the hockey star can t stop missing me
dramabox.description: Diana, the coach's daughter who secretly powers her boyfriend Benson's rise, is discarded when his ex returns  with a "daughter". Public betrayals from Benson push Diana toward Jake—the man who truly loves her. Amid lies and betrayal, how will she choose?

dramabox.title: The Wrong Twin Got Me Pregnant
dramabox.norm_title: the wrong twin got me pregnant
dramabox.description: After countless fertility treatments, Chanel is finally pregnant --- but the baby daddy is her husband's twin, not her husband. With a billion-dollar empire on the line, Chanel's husband and the family matriarch are willing to go to any length to claim the heir as his own child.

dramabox.title: The Unwanted Wife Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: the unwanted wife strikes back
dramabox.description: When a housewife discovers her fashion mogul husband is cheating, and stealing her designs, she files for divorce and wages a scorched-earth revenge campaign to reclaim the empire she secretly helped build. But exposing his lies means going to war with his scheming mistress, his icy sister - and allying herself with Cyrus Voss, her husband's biggest rival.

dramabox.title: Cinders of a Love Once True
dramabox.norm_title: cinders of a love once true
dramabox.description: An innocent woman, raised alongside two wealthy brothers, finds her life torn apart when a single lie from a scheming maid shatters fifteen years of trust, stealing her love and altering her destiny forever.

dramabox.title: If Only You Loved Me More
dramabox.norm_title: if only you loved me more
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Alex nearly died saving Beth, who donated her kidney to him, causing her blood cancer. While she sought treatment abroad, Alex's secretary Stella lied that Beth had left him and claimed she was his donor. Betrayed, Alex married Beth out of spite, torturing her until her illness returned. After losing everything, Alex learned Beth was his true savior and the heiress of the wealthiest Duncan family.

dramabox.title: Trapped in Dangerous Liaisons
dramabox.norm_title: trapped in dangerous liaisons
dramabox.description: Jang Ji-ah is transported into a romance game world as the villainous rival of the adored heroine, Jo Yeon-seo. Fated for a tragic end, she obeys the system's orders—earning "villain points" while feigning kindness. Between the cold Baek Do-yoon, the obsessive genius Jung Si-woo, the distant friend Daniel, and her fiancé Gu Yul, she artfully sways each man's heart. Amid the chaos of lies and truth, Jang Ji-ah begins to rewrite her fate and reach for freedom.

dramabox.title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: slay to fosters i took his uncle
dramabox.description: Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her family to marry middle-class CEO Liam Foster. Throughout their marriage, she secretly used her family's resources to support Liam's business. However, Natty Parker, the youngest daughter of the Parker family, had long harbored feelings for Liam. She conspired with Liam's mother to set a trap.

dramabox.title: The Devil Wears Desire
dramabox.norm_title: the devil wears desire
dramabox.description: A woman with a failing heart becomes the center of a dangerous love quadrangle, torn between her amnesiac childhood sweetheart, a cold billionaire concealing his true feelings, a ruthless playboy heir, and an obsessive crime lord with a transplanted heart, as she navigates a maze of secret contracts, false identities, and twisted passions in a high-stakes game of love and survival.

dramabox.title: The Forbidden Bloom
dramabox.norm_title: the forbidden bloom
dramabox.description: A successful celebrity and heiress has her perfect life with her husband shaken by the appearance of a woman claiming to be his mistress. This woman reveals a past tragedy involving the protagonist, seeking revenge and trying to destroy her life. As the protagonist fights back with increasingly extreme actions, she risks losing everything, while her husband's growing attraction to the mistress leads to the breakdown of their marriage.

dramabox.title: From Cell to Crown, Lady Kingsley is Back
dramabox.norm_title: from cell to crown lady kingsley is back
dramabox.description: After three years in prison for her boyfriend Damien, Harper is freed and learns she's the long-lost heiress of the powerful Kingsley family. Expecting marriage, she instead discovers Damien is engaged to her best friend, and her adoptive father is tormented by loan sharks. With only James—the man whose life she once saved—by her side, Harper claims her identity, gains powerful allies, defeats her enemies, and finds love anew.

dramabox.title: They Love Me Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: they love me too late
dramabox.description: After her family's bankruptcy, Joy was lovingly taken in by the Reynolds brothers until Megan, the maid's daughter, arrived. Megan's scheming framed Joy, turning the brothers against her. Tired of years of mistreatment, Joy left to marry Nathan, a powerful heir, and start a new life.  Will the brothers realize the truth before it's too late?

dramabox.title: Got Pregnant by Billionaire Brothers
dramabox.norm_title: got pregnant by billionaire brothers
dramabox.description: Audrey, the sole heiress to a business empire, faces her father's ultimatum—find a suitable husband at her debut party. As she plots her escape, she stumbles into the seductive world of the Vanderbilt brothers—Caspian, a notorious playboy with a hidden heart of gold, and Killian, a brooding, tortured soul with hypnotic eyes. A surprise beach getaway turns their friendship into a tangled love triangle.

dramabox.title: The Lust Game: Seduce Me If You Can
dramabox.norm_title: the lust game seduce me if you can
dramabox.description: A virgin signs up for the ultimate seduction show—$5M on the line, no rules but lust. Stuck with her shameless ex, a dangerous lawyer, and a bad boy who knows exactly how to touch her, every task drags her deeper into temptation. To win, she must play with fire... even if it costs her innocence.

dramabox.title: Fated Mate with My Enemy Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: fated mate with my enemy stepbrother
dramabox.description: Selene is forced to become the stepdaughter of her enemies' Alpha and live under the same roof as her arrogant new stepbrother, her mortal enemy—only to discover he might be her fated mate. As she hides the shameful secret that she's lost her wolf, deadly enemies within the pack close in, and forbidden desire turns to loyalty, love, and war.

dramabox.title: Exed Out of My Story
dramabox.norm_title: exed out of my story
dramabox.description: Evelyn Scott, once the heiress of the Scotts, had her place stolen by her half-sister, Lydia. She spent three years chasing Jonas Ford, unaware he was heir to the powerful Ford family—and only approached her because of Lydia. After sacrificing everything and enduring endless betrayal, Evelyn finally lets go of her feelings for Jonas... just when he starts to want her for real.

dramabox.title: Trial Marriage To A Billionaire Season 2
dramabox.norm_title: trial marriage to a billionaire season 2
dramabox.description: In the gripping second season, the aftermath of Logan's scandalous affair with Grace continues to ripple through the lives of everyone involved. Logan, compelled by his mistress’s unexpected pregnancy, finally decides to abandon his fiancée, Aurora, choosing to embrace a tumultuous relationship with Grace. As Grace leverages her pregnancy to control Logan, their volatile bond reveals cracks as they navigate the complexities of love, betrayal, and ambition.

dramabox.title: A Love Once Betrayed
dramabox.norm_title: a love once betrayed
dramabox.description: Andrew Bennett, the stoic heir to the crumbling Bennett fortune, struggles to save his family’s legacy, leaving his wife, Evelyn, feeling abandoned and trapped in a loveless marriage. Vulnerable and yearning for affection, Evelyn begins a passionate but toxic affair with Ryan, Andrew’s childhood friend and a cunning opportunist. When Andrew uncovers the affair, his world shatters.

dramabox.title: Why I Did It
dramabox.norm_title: why i did it
dramabox.description: Tired of her boring job and in need of a fresh start, Zoe moves back to the city she grew up in. The plan was to get a new job, meet somebody and bring back a spark in her life. She meets Mr. Gregory on a solo night out in the city and ends up in his bed. Unknowingly to her, that innocent hookup was about to change her life and bring back that spark she was looking for, but not in a good way.

dramabox.title: The Perfect Husband
dramabox.norm_title: the perfect husband
dramabox.description: Kayla Harrison, an heiress to an oil tycoon is forced to marry her father's best friend and long-term business partner's son, Jack Harrison. Together, they continue their parents' legacy and they are doing well in the industry. Despite being married for three years, Kayla has found it hard to fall in love with Jack who tries his best to be a perfect husband at all times.

dramabox.title: Honey Gold
dramabox.norm_title: honey gold
dramabox.description: Sandra Keith, beautiful, kind hearted and in love with Jade Smith, always wants what is best for her best friend, Amanda Grey. Sandra tries everything in her power to get Jade and Amanda together even though it hurts her. In a final bid to help Jade win the love of his life, Sandra agrees to be with Tony Delvin in order to make Jade a powerful man. With the stench of poverty still hanging around him, Amanda agrees to be with Jade, but she is not invested in the relationship.

dramabox.title: Good For Him
dramabox.norm_title: good for him
dramabox.description: Ava Dickson, beautiful, calculative and some might say cold, fought to win the heart of Adam Hart. Using her father's influence and money, she helps Adam build one of the biggest Shipping companies in the world. Ava's only request to Adam is that he remain faithful and committed to her even though she knows his heart once belonged to Ella Madden. Ella still waits for Adam to come back to her, and she takes her chance when the opportunity presents itself.

dramabox.title: Puppets Of Passion
dramabox.norm_title: puppets of passion
dramabox.description: In high school, Sunny juggled work and school while caring for her sick grandmother. Bad boy Drake teased her to get her attention, unaware she saw him as a nightmare. She agreed to date him only if he changed, secretly planning to transfer. Unbeknownst to her, Drake was her admired hero. Ten years later, now a billionaire, Drake reappears before Sunny's wedding, determined to win her heart. With love, sacrifice, and truth at stake—who will she choose?

dramabox.title: Duty or Desire
dramabox.norm_title: duty or desire
dramabox.description: Rose Barclay is the mistress of a man, named Jon Jackson and acts as the unseen family caretaker. Although Jon’s real-life wife, Lily Jackson, has no idea that Rose is both a call girl and the breadwinner; she keeps Jon and the high-consumption camp running smoothly. When Lily uncovers the shocking truth, she confronts Jon, only to hear his rationalization: Rose’s involvement has however made it difficult to disconnect herself with their lifestyle.

dramabox.title: Twist of Time
dramabox.norm_title: twist of time
dramabox.description: Ethan Arturo receives an unexpected guest, Kyle Crisanto, on the day of his father’s burial. He ends up in a bar after his mother confirms that Kyle is his step-brother. When Kyle joins him at the bar, he notices that Ethan is attracted to a certain waitress, Nathalie Andrés. Kyle urges him to talk to her, but when Ethan does so, Nathalie humiliates him.

dramabox.title: Camouflage
dramabox.norm_title: camouflage
dramabox.description: The movie opens with Mr Edward informing him about his engagement which has already been done by both families. Edward is a reserved gentle man who believes in true love, he believes such love can be found in the simplest and natural state, he decided to act as a twin, his intention is to act as a blind twin (Eden) and the other twin who isn’t physically challenged (Adrain).

dramabox.title: The Hockey Star's Remorse
dramabox.norm_title: the hockey star s remorse
dramabox.description: Six years ago, nerdy Evie spent a magical night with her crush,  hockey star Timothy—only to learn it was all a bet. Now a successful producer, she crosses paths with him again. In front of reporters, Timothy publicly apologizes and reveals he's been waiting for Evie ever since. Within an hour, #FindEvie is trending at number one.

dramabox.title: Divorced with a Secret Baby
dramabox.norm_title: divorced with a secret baby
dramabox.description: Laura, a hidden heiress, marries Aaron, who believes she loves another man and weds him for money. He never touches her. Laura secretly gets pregnant but catches Aaron with the pregnant Sophia and leaves. Aaron regrets everything and tries to win her back, but she lies the child is someone else's. After being shot rescuing her, Laura confesses the truth—the man on the wedding night was her brother, not a lover. Misunderstandings are finally resolved.

dramabox.title: Pregnant with My Brother's Baby
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant with my brother s baby
dramabox.description: After a one-night stand with Devin, who is not related to her by blood, Sabrina discovers that she is pregnant with his child. To avoid subjecting the child to gossip and rumors, Sabrina feels compelled to return to her unfaithful husband. However, Devin keenly senses that something is amiss. After a series of struggles and misunderstandings, the two of them ultimately end up together...

dramabox.title: The Best Mistake Ever
dramabox.norm_title: the best mistake ever
dramabox.description:
A nerdy but smart girl, NIA, has a one night stand with billion-dollar fashion empire
Owner, JAMES, and he mistakes Nia’s best friend, SELINE, for the girl he found
himself infatuated and had relations with. As Seline and Nia serve as his first and
second assistant, the web of friendship and love gets beyond entangled…

dramabox.title: Rebel in Devil's Shackle
dramabox.norm_title: rebel in devil s shackle
dramabox.description: Sold out by someone in dark web, Nina Morgan bumps into mafia lord, Max Luther in the riches’ hunting game. Once an aristocracy, Nina is now dragged into inferno by Max, lost in sweetness and tortures. She finally makes up her mind to leave, but Max confines her no matter how many times she tries. It’s out of love, or of hatred? Overwhelmed by love and forbidden desire, the two hurt each other but simultaneously save each other.

dramabox.title: Dark Web of Desire
dramabox.norm_title: dark web of desire
dramabox.description: Sold out by someone in dark web, Chloe Morgan bumps into mafia lord, Shaun Luther in the riches’ hunting game. Once an aristocracy, Chloe is now dragged into inferno by Shaun, lost in sweetness and tortures. She finally makes up her mind to leave, but Shaun confines her no matter how many times she tries. It’s out of love, or of hatred? Overwhelmed by love and forbidden desire, the two hurt each other but simultaneously save each other.

dramabox.title: In Your Name
dramabox.norm_title: in your name
dramabox.description: Alice's father, a tavern owner and undercover cop, is killed by a gang. They hunt Alice too—until Uncle Hector appears and saves her. He tells her about her father's secret life, then sends her to an orphanage, promising to return in two years. He keeps his word, with a new knife scar, and takes her home. Years later, as a police officer, Alice discovers the man who killed her father was Hector—the man she once dreamed of marrying.

dramabox.title: Stolen by My Fiancé's Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: stolen by my fianc s uncle
dramabox.description: A fallen noble girl, forced by her family to secure a marriage, tries to give herself to her fiancé, only to end up entangled with his powerful uncle, a duke whose rage disorder can only be eased by her touch.

dramabox.title: The Heirless Alpha's Miracle Omega
dramabox.norm_title: the heirless alpha s miracle omega
dramabox.description: Ethan, cursed Alpha of Silver Moon, needs a Luna who can survive bearing his heir. Hope, a poor Omega, enters the mate selection to save her pack—and awakens ancient wolf power. Ethan rejects her at first, but when she risks her life for him, hate turns to obsession. They must break the curse before the mate bond kills her.

dramabox.title: The CEO’s Blind Forbidden Love
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo s blind forbidden love
dramabox.description: Lia White, a blind musician trapped under abusive relatives, is mistaken for a prostitute by billionaire CEO Ethan Hunt after one reckless night. He throws her away—until he learns she's pregnant. Guilt turns to obsession. As he uncovers the truth about her life, his world of faith, control, and morality begins to shatter.

dramabox.title: Her Revenge and His Redemption
dramabox.norm_title: her revenge and his redemption
dramabox.description: Zoe, a young lawyer, is drugged and spends a night with wealthy magnate Nikolai, leaving his mother badly injured. To save her sick brother, she pretends to be his adopted son's girlfriend. Nikolai forces her into a secret relationship in exchange for medical resources. Trapped by schemes and misunderstandings, they hurt each other. Grace's conspiracy is exposed. Nikolai lets go of hatred, reconciles with Zoe, and they embrace true love.

dramabox.title: My orphaned beloved
dramabox.norm_title: my orphaned beloved
dramabox.description: Mafia lord Asher raises Iris, his fallen comrade's orphan. To hide his love, he plays cruel with Chloe. Chloe steals Iris's song, frames her. A drunken night leaves Iris pregnant; Asher traps her. Chloe's brutality costs Iris her baby. The truth shatters Asher, but Iris's heart is dead. She flees, leaving him to eternal regret.

dramabox.title: The Conch's Cry for Help
dramabox.norm_title: the conch s cry for help
dramabox.description: Queen Nephele, once a fisherwoman, is neglected as King Athamas indulges his mistress. On her eighth birthday, Princess Helle is abandoned on a leaking boat by her father and perishes in the sea. Grief-stricken, Nephele exposes her husband's cruelty. Athamas collapses in remorse and leaps into the sea. Clutching Helle's shell necklace, Nephele walks away—her love hardened into eternal farewell.

dramabox.title: Betrayed, Then Wed by the MafiaHeir
dramabox.norm_title: betrayed then wed by the mafiaheir
dramabox.description: Serena, a devoted wife and mother, is betrayed by her ambitious husband for a wealthy heiress. She refuses childhood friend Matteo's love, clinging to her vows. But the mistress pressures her lover to remove his family. They push little Leo from a high-rise balcony. Serena witnesses it. Shattered, she swears vengeance. The gentle wife is gone—a formidable enemy is born.

dramabox.title: Daughter of Poseidon Forsakes you
dramabox.norm_title: daughter of poseidon forsakes you
dramabox.description: Lorde, daughter of the Sea God, is betrayed by her husband Demos and handmaiden Chloris and cast off the cliffs of Mount Olympus. On the brink of death, she learns that Helios, the deposed Sun God, has always loved her. He traded his divine status for her rebirth.Returned to the age of eighteen, Lorde rejects her old betrothal and pursues Helios, only to face a forced marriage arranged by Zeus.

dramabox.title: The Price of Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: the price of betrayal
dramabox.description: Monica revoked Chloe’s penthouse and university spot after Chloe publicly accused her. Instigated by aunt Mae, Chloe lost the house to a 1.5M scam and her education. She became a bar promoter, accidentally killed Mae, and got life in prison. She earned certifications, helped inmates, and was paroled to work at a repair shop and shelter. Monica never opened Chloe’s apology letters. They went their separate ways.

dramabox.title: Redeem Me by Your Name
dramabox.norm_title: redeem me by your name
dramabox.description: Scarred noblewoman Lenora drowns herself, awakening Nerissa, a lake siren who heals her and ignites forbidden love. Together they uncover a monstrous truth: Lenora's husband Cedric is her half-brother, the arsonist who destroyed her family. As they plot revenge, Nerissa's magic fades—only a pure human heart can save her. In the end, love demands the ultimate sacrifice.

dramabox.title: Elven King, You Miss Your True Love
dramabox.norm_title: elven king you miss your true love
dramabox.description: To save the Elven King, the human heroine ventures into the abyss for alegendary herb. She is betrayed, falls into the abyss, survives but loses her voice and her face isscarred. Five years later, she meets the Elven King again, stll lofty and cold. He repeatedly pushes histrue love to the brink without knowing who she is. When the truth finally breaks, he recognizes his wifeand begins the long and painful journey to win her back.

dramabox.title: Never Fall Alone
dramabox.norm_title: never fall alone
dramabox.description: Haunted by trauma, diver Maddox sleeps with junior Teo on comeback night, mistaking him for someone else. Next morning, Teo becomes his new synchro partner. From awkward rivals to lovers, Maddox battles PTSD and career pressure as rival Tyler blackmails them with secret footage. Maddox conquers his demons, wins finals with Teo, and publicly declares their love on the podium—triumph in both sport and heart.

dramabox.title: Butterfly Oath
dramabox.norm_title: butterfly oath
dramabox.description: Sickly Elena marries Alexander Sterling, who once made extreme sacrifices for her. After three happy years, Alexander grows infatuated with Bella, drives nurse Martha to death, and secretly divorces Elena to wed Bella.Devastated, Elena departs for the Swiss Alps. Alexander pursues her, meets a fatal accident on the Matterhorn. In later years, Elena dies quietly surrounded by butterflies, united with him eternally among snow peaks.

dramabox.title: Top World Athletes Fight to Be My Baby's Father
dramabox.norm_title: top world athletes fight to be my baby s father
dramabox.description: Sloane once dated football star Corbin, who left her for a wealthy businessman’s daughter to boost his career. Heartbroken, they split up. Later, she gave birth to their son Arlo alone. The boy was born with a congenital heart disease. When Sloane turned to Corbin for help, she was humiliated. She had to work odd jobs to make ends meet.

dramabox.title: Submitting to His Dark Secret
dramabox.norm_title: submitting to his dark secret
dramabox.description: Amelia, a 20-year-old maid, is fired after stumbling into her billionaire boss Ethan’s private BDSM playroom. Crushed by debt and abandoned by her boyfriend (who is secretly Ethan’s nephew), she collapses. To escape an arranged marriage, Ethan proposes a $1M, one-year fake marriage contract.Living together blurs lines. Ethan plays high-tension psychological games, but when Amelia is kidnapped, he rescues her and claims her publicly.

dramabox.title: The Dragon Slave I Whipped is Now My King
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon slave i whipped is now my king
dramabox.description: Once a proud Saintess, Elena bought dragon heir Arthur with one coin, naming him "Shadow" and tormenting him for two years. After awakening dragon blood, Arthur returned as Crown Prince and took cruel revenge on the fallen Elena, unaware she carried his twin children. Framed by villains, her family fell and her father faced execution. She begged for mercy but suffered constant retaliation.

dramabox.title: Captive In Mafia King’s Embrace
dramabox.norm_title: captive in mafia king s embrace
dramabox.description: Driven by the desperate need to fund her mother’s surgery, Elena, a recent graduate, accidentally crosses into forbidden territory and encounters Dante Moretti, the ruthless King of the New York Mafia. He presents her with a seductive yet lethal ultimatum: become his 11th mistress for a million dollars, or watch her mother die. Trapped within his world of power struggles and dark desires, Elena finds her resistance crumbling.

dramabox.title: Seducing My Western Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: seducing my western daddy
dramabox.description: Jaxson, a 45-year-old ranch king, honors his best friend's dying wish by becoming the legal guardian of his 20-year-old daughter, Blake. Secretly in love with her guardian, Blake is trapped in feelings she knows she shouldn't have and begins a slow, calculated seduction. By day, she plays the sweet, innocent ward, playfully tempting the rugged older man. But by night, she transforms into a mesmerizing exotic dancer to pay off her brother's dangerous debts.

dramabox.title: I Cheated on My Wife Or Did I?
dramabox.norm_title: i cheated on my wife or did i
dramabox.description: A mysterious package arrives, containing proof of an affair—his. But he swears he’s innocent. As he joins forces with his sister-in-law to clear his name, a twisted truth emerges… one that could unravel everything.

dramabox.title: My Mafia Boss's Dirty Secret
dramabox.norm_title: my mafia boss s dirty secret
dramabox.description: Top surgeon Anna loses everything after crossing the mayor—family dead, brother dying. To save him, she surrenders to ruthless mafia heir Marcus, who makes her his spy, his toy… and his secret BDSM lover. Trapped between his dark obsession and his gentle brother Vince, she uncovers the truth: her family's murder was no accident. Betrayal, danger, and forbidden passion explode as she fights to survive the mafia's deadliest game.

dramabox.title: Hold Me In the Dark
dramabox.norm_title: hold me in the dark
dramabox.description: The new intern, Isla, never imagined that the cold and demanding CEO Christian — who shoved her relentlessly on the tennis court during the day — was the same person who broadened her view to unknown territories at night in an exclusive BDSM club. But when the mask comes off and secretive identities assimilate into reality, is this a game she can stay afloat…

dramabox.title: Trapped in Professor's Playroom
dramabox.norm_title: trapped in professor s playroom
dramabox.description: Lena, a dedicated and bookish student, is cruelly dumped by her boyfriend Ryan, who mocks her as a boring, unattractive nerd. Heartbroken and humiliated, she drowns her sorrows at a bar, where she meets the charming and handsome Adrian. One impulsive night leads to a passionate encounter. To Lena's shock, she later discovers that Adrian is none other than Ryan's father.

dramabox.title: Driven Hard by My Ex's Rich Dad
dramabox.norm_title: driven hard by my ex s rich dad
