dramabox.description: College senior Kate works as an assistant on her star boyfriend's pro racing team in order to pay her tuition. But when she catches him cheating, she finds comfort in James, the older, rich and powerful owner of the team, who happens to be her boyfriend's father. What first starts as a game of revenge and an effort to shed her virginity turns into a sexy, dangerous connection between the college-aged girl and the rich, mogul father.

dramabox.title: A Forbidden Deal with My Professor
dramabox.norm_title: a forbidden deal with my professor
dramabox.description: Thea Shale, a struggling medical student, plans to sell her eggs to cover tuition, but a wrong number leads her to Kael Vex, a mysterious man. Kael, intent on dissuading Thea from her decision, arranges a meeting—only to be unexpectedly captivated by her. What begins as a transactional relationship evolves into something far more entangled. Just when Thea thinks their dealings are over, Kael unexpectedly becomes her guest professor...

dramabox.title: Love Survives the Lie (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: love survives the lie dubbed
dramabox.description: After a passionate night between Shea Lacy and Ian Jurd, Shea's sister, Gigi Lacy, impersonates her as Ian's one-night stand partner. Six years later, Shea becomes Ian's legal counsel, and over time, they fall in love. Fearing that Shea might take her place as Ian's lover, Gigi frequently attempts to sabotage their relationship. However, Ian always intervenes just in time, preventing Shea from suffering any harm or misunderstanding.

dramabox.title: Trapped as His Sugar Baby
dramabox.norm_title: trapped as his sugar baby
dramabox.description: Everyone knows that Thomas Anderson, the youngest chairman of the Thomas Group, keeps a mysterious young woman, but no one knows that this woman is the daughter of the enemy who caused the death of Thomas Anderson's parents.Thomas Anderson imprisoned Luna Monroe for four years for the sake of vengeance, and the hatred gradually changed into a forbidden emotion. Luna Monroe's hatred has gradually degenerated into a forbidden emotion. ......

dramabox.title: Love Me Like You Do
dramabox.norm_title: love me like you do
dramabox.description: Emily Grant, heiress to the powerful Grant family, marries under a false identity only to be betrayed by her husband’s affair and framed by him and his mistress. After David rescues her, a fiery one-night stand sparks mutual attraction between them. As Emily divorces to reclaim her corporate throne, a shocking twist emerges: David is both her stepbrother and the rival heir to the Grant fortune. Forbidden desire clashes with cutthroat ambition in a war for love and legacy.....

dramabox.title: Governor, Your First Lady is a Mafia Heiress!
dramabox.norm_title: governor your first lady is a mafia heiress
dramabox.description: Isabella is the heiress of the Mafia. She hides her identity and falls in love with Ethan, who has nothing. On the day of Ethan's proposal, Ethan misunderstands that Isabella is dating a rich man and they break up. Three years later, Ethan becomes the governor and the two meet again. They think the simple misunderstanding can be resolved, but Sophia stirs it up again, making the misunderstanding between them grow even worse.

dramabox.title: Seduce her for Me
dramabox.norm_title: seduce her for me
dramabox.description: Ju-ha, a chaebol heiress, loses her parents in a sudden hit-and-run and undergoes a heart transplant. With her family's wealth gone, her once-loving husband, Gyu-jin, and her mother-in-law begin to despise her. Although she successfully launches a beauty brand on her own, Gyu-jin secretly has an affair with an investor, Ye-ri. Her ruthless in-laws even cause her to miscarry and attempt to steal everything she has built.

dramabox.title: Learning From His Lips
dramabox.norm_title: learning from his lips
dramabox.description: Medical student Charlotte Bloom harbors a dangerous secret—she's been secretly lusting after her young, dashing professor Zane Sharp. Every time trouble finds her, Zane appears just in time—and with each rescue, her feelings and desire for him grow stronger. One unexpected night, while doing a favor for her roommate, she ends up sitting right on Zane's lap. Suddenly, they share a secret. Charlotte begins to notice the special treatment Zane gives her.

dramabox.title: Engraved On Your Heart
dramabox.norm_title: engraved on your heart
dramabox.description: To save Damien's life, Scarlett broke up with him and raised their daughter alone. Now, because of her terminally ill, she pretends to be the villain again, just to send their daughter back to Damien—until the truth comes out and the family is finally reunited.

dramabox.title: Boss, Your Executive Secretary has Resigned
dramabox.norm_title: boss your executive secretary has resigned
dramabox.description: Anne deeply in love with the Jackson, gives up her position as chief jewelry designer to become his personal secretary and secret lover, until she witnesses the Jackson and his first love Melissa being carried naked into an ambulance after carbon monoxide poisoning. After handling the situation, she decides to resign and return to her career.

dramabox.title: Daddy Don't Go, Please Save Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: daddy don t go please save mommy
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, Grace sacrificed everything to save the man she loved, and vanished in a car crash while eight months pregnant.  Now, her secret little daughter unknowingly draws her back into a world of danger and revenge. This time, their story will end differently.

dramabox.title: Mistaken Marriage, Right Husband
dramabox.norm_title: mistaken marriage right husband
dramabox.description: A single mother enters a forced marriage to save her son, only to discover the man she never forgot is her new brother-in-law.

dramabox.title: Lusting For The Hot New Preacher
dramabox.norm_title: lusting for the hot new preacher
dramabox.description: In a small town, a fiercely independent single mom working for the stoic and ambitious new preacher at her Christian church, finds herself in a dangerous dance of forbidden attraction while battling her powerful ex-husband for custody of her son.

dramabox.title: Beach Volleyball Virgin
dramabox.norm_title: beach volleyball virgin
dramabox.description: Jenny Taylor dreams of losing her virginity to her nemesis stepbrother, Chris Riggins, and accidentally kisses him the next day, resulting in public shaming by Chris’s girlfriend Natalie and the rest of the volleyball team. However, Chris suddenly becomes caring and considerate, defending Jenny every step of the way. Could this actually be the start of a taboo relationship?

dramabox.title: Falling for You Again
dramabox.norm_title: falling for you again
dramabox.description: Torn apart years ago by Bruce's prejudiced mother, former lovers Bruce and Julia are thrust back into each other's lives. Bruce is determined to rekindle their romance. But amidst new misunderstandings and relentless outside manipulation, Julia is hesitant and tries to leave the painful past behind. In the end, they are forced to confront the truth, leading them to reconcile and reclaim their destined future together.

dramabox.title: If Time Could Heal Us
dramabox.norm_title: if time could heal us
dramabox.description: Battling lupus, Hazel Crowe hides her pain by pretending to be a gold-digger and breaking up with Chad Luther, unwilling to burden him. Eight years later, Chad returns as a famous esports star with a fiancée, while Hazel—crushed by illness, poverty, grief over her brother's death, and years of misunderstanding—takes her own life. When Chad learns the truth, despair consumes him... until fate grants a chance to return and rewrite their story.

dramabox.title: I Killed My Stepfather with a Kiss
dramabox.norm_title: i killed my stepfather with a kiss
dramabox.description: At her mother's funeral, young actress Violet prays in tears—only to be "comforted" by her stepfather, Maxwell. But no one knows: this man was once the perpetrator of Violet's most traumatic night. She tries to escape, but Maxwell closes in, controlling not only her career but also quietly infiltrating her mother's life—soon becoming her would-be stepfather. At a lavish wedding, Violet is horrified to discover the bride is her own mother—and the groom, her rapist.

dramabox.title: Every Beat Says Your Name
dramabox.norm_title: every beat says your name
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Elena's first love died saving her, and his heart was donated to Harvey Reed. Out of gratitude and guilt, Elena agrees to everything Harvey asks of her—even donating blood and a kidney to Claire Lane. But what she doesn't know is that her first love never truly died. He's been in a coma all this time—and on the very day of her kidney donation, he finally wakes up.

dramabox.title: Our Forever, Cut Short
dramabox.norm_title: our forever cut short
dramabox.description: At 20, Bella Hall marries her father's much younger friend, Jerry Stone. Cold to the world yet tender only to her, Jerry makes her believe in a perfect love—until an old photo album shatters the illusion. She's nothing more than a stand-in for his first love.

dramabox.title: The Last Spark of Us
dramabox.norm_title: the last spark of us
dramabox.description: Audrey has secretly loved her brother's best friend, Zachary, for years. A no-strings affair turns serious when she gets pregnant—until his ex returns with a child, making Audrey think he's already a father. She leaves before hearing the truth, and an accident keeps them apart. Ten months later, they meet again, and Zachary fights for her heart. Now Audrey must choose: walk away or reveal that their child survived.

dramabox.title: A Heart Only for You (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: a heart only for you dubbed
dramabox.description: Desperate to stay with the penniless Gemma Holt, wealthy heir Jerry Cobb cuts ties with his family, who disapprove of their marriage. But when she fails to secure the money for his heart transplant, Gemma lies—claiming she's just a gold-digger—to make him leave her. Years later, Jerry still resents her, unaware they share a child... and that Gemma's time is running out.

dramabox.title: A Heart Only for You
dramabox.norm_title: a heart only for you
dramabox.description: Desperate to stay with the penniless Gemma Holt, wealthy heir Jerry Cobb cuts ties with his family, who disapprove of their marriage. But when she fails to secure the money for his heart transplant, Gemma lies—claiming she's just a gold-digger—to make him leave her. Years later, Jerry still resents her, unaware they share a child... and that Gemma's time is running out.

dramabox.title: Haunted by Shadows of You (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: haunted by shadows of you dubbed
dramabox.description: It has been six years since Jessica Quinn fell deeply in love with the cold and aloof Harlan Spencer at first sight. After much effort, she finally married him, but their two-year marriage remains unconsummated. By chance, Jessica discovers Harlan harbors an unhealthy obsession with his non-biological sister, Talia Spencer, whom he dotes on endlessly.

dramabox.title: The Day Love Was Lost
dramabox.norm_title: the day love was lost
dramabox.description: After a car crash, Lillian Swan loses her memory of Callum Hart, the man she has loved deeply for seven years who never loved her back. Unwilling to watch her dive back into endless pursuit, her friend tells her the truth. So, Lillian moves onto a new life—until Callum finally realizes he has long-developed feelings for her.

dramabox.title: Signed Off, Moved On
dramabox.norm_title: signed off moved on
dramabox.description: Maya Shaw, heiress of Isburg, sacrifices her sight to save Cody Reed and marries him—only to witness his affair with his secretary on the day she regains her vision. Heartbroken, she inherits her mentor's legacy and divorces Cody. But as she begins to thrive in the medical field with Wayne Cox by her side, Cody regrets everything and desperately tries to win her back.

dramabox.title: Where My Love Ran Out
dramabox.norm_title: where my love ran out
dramabox.description: To bury the memory of her first love, Nina Smith marries Felix Lloyd—only to abandon him the moment Liam Young becomes available again. As Nina weaves a web of deceit, Felix's love slowly turns to ice. But when he finally walks away, Nina realizes the man she truly loves has been by her side all along.

dramabox.title: Love That Survives the Hurt(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: love that survives the hurt dubbed
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, Mable Graham donated a kidney to her boyfriend, then left him—afraid she'd become a burden. She raised their daughter, Cora Flint, alone, only to be branded a gold-digger by the man she once loved. Now, with Mable in a coma after a tragic accident, young Cora fights to raise money for her recovery—until Heidi Lane steps in to sabotage her efforts.

dramabox.title: Love Ended in a Dying Note
dramabox.norm_title: love ended in a dying note
dramabox.description: At six, Yael Gould—secretly a wealthy heiress—is adopted by the Judds as Jim Judd's blood donor and chooses to stay by his side. Years later, they marry, but everything changes when Mona Leed returns from abroad. Jim's coldness cuts deep, and when he refuses to save her after a car crash, Yael's heart finally shatters. By the time Jim realizes he's in love, Yael is already out of reach.

dramabox.title: What Broke Wasn't Just the Vow
dramabox.norm_title: what broke wasn t just the vow
dramabox.description: Alicia Blair spends years trying to be the perfect wife to Jasper Kane—only to discover their "perfect" marriage is nothing but a lie. Just as she gathers the strength to leave and files for divorce, Jasper realizes too late that he's truly fallen for her.

dramabox.title: A Breath Away From Foreverd (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: a breath away from foreverd dubbed
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Callista Summers rescued Jeremiah Fuller when he was drugged. She then pursued her career abroad, driven by her initial self-doubt as a housekeeper. Over time, Callista became a renowned designer and a devoted mother to her son, Scotty Fuller. When she learns of Jeremiah’s kidney failure, she selflessly returns to donate her kidney, saving him once more. However, misunderstandings breed animosity between them.

dramabox.title: A Lifetime Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: a lifetime too late
dramabox.description: It is only after Heidi Jaffe's death after donating her heart to Chad Shelby's first crush does Chad realize he had already fallen for her a long time ago. Overwhelmed with guilt, he chooses to end his own life—only to unexpectedly transmigrate into the system and enter Heidi’s world. Determined to make amends and win her back, he tries everything to regain her love, yet uncovers a cruel truth regarding what he thought was Heidi's unconditional love for him.

dramabox.title: You Are Still The One
dramabox.norm_title: you are still the one
dramabox.description: Bound by an arranged marriage to a man she’s never met, Emma, a once-wealthy heiress on the brink of losing everything, returns to the U.S. as the assistant to her ruthless ex-boyfriend, Zachary. Unbeknownst to her, Zachary is plotting revenge for her past betrayal, all while appearing to be married to another woman—a mysterious figure he has been avoiding ever since Emma left.

dramabox.title: You're My Impossible Goodbye
dramabox.norm_title: you re my impossible goodbye
dramabox.description:
In her school days, Winnie Scott fell for Cody Foley at first sight. Lacking confidence, she stepped aside to help her best friend win his heart. But one fateful night changed everything, beginning a secret relationship between Winnie and Cody.
For four years, their love remains hidden—along with the daughter they unknowingly conceived. But when Winnie's best friend returns from abroad, secrets begin to unravel.

dramabox.title: Cause You Were Never Mine
dramabox.norm_title: cause you were never mine
dramabox.description: When Jade's mother falls ill, Jade pretends to cheat with Dexter to avoid burdening Bruce, who was planning to propose. Heartbroken, Bruce breaks up with her. To revenge, Bruce starts his own business with the help of his family. Five years later, as CEO of Morgan Group, he hires Jade, thus beginning a love story of mutual torment that would touch hearts.

dramabox.title: She Who Came Back
dramabox.norm_title: she who came back
dramabox.description: Claire Lynn, the adopted daughter of the wealthy Lynn family, uncovers a devastating betrayal. Her husband is having an affair with her younger sister. During a heated confrontation, her sister kills her in cold blood. In her final moments, Claire learns a shocking truth—she is the biological daughter of the Lynn family. However, fate had other plans. Claire wakes up to find herself back on the morning of her wedding day and is given a second chance at life.

dramabox.title: When Death Becomes My Sanctuary
dramabox.norm_title: when death becomes my sanctuary
dramabox.description: Years after losing contact with her family, young Mona Spark returns home, only to find her place usurped by an adopted girl, Elaine Spark. Over the ten years Mona has spent with her family, she has never felt a true sense of belonging or warmth. Her mother and brother’s disdain for her grows, and to make matters worse, she is diagnosed with terminal blood cancer.

dramabox.title: Hurt Me,Love Me
dramabox.norm_title: hurt me love me
dramabox.description: Even though Katherine and Eric got married, Eric was still entangled with Riley, which caused Katherine great suffering. Despite her pain, Katherine endured it out of guilt and deep love. Unexpectedly, she became pregnant again, but Eric continued to neglect and hurt her. For the sake of their lost child, Katherine decided to divorce.

dramabox.title: Never See You Again
dramabox.norm_title: never see you again
dramabox.description: Born into the prestigious Green family, Judy Green sacrifices her dignity to marry Todd Payne, despite his well-known love for Tasha Jones. Enduring Todd's scorn and relentless humiliation, Judy's life ends tragically on an operating table, her value exploited for his gain. Given a second chance to rewrite her fate, she chooses herself this time—focusing on her career, forging new connections, and embracing her independence.

dramabox.title: Beyond the Heartache
dramabox.norm_title: beyond the heartache
dramabox.description: Love is a battlefield, and Naomi Sloan has been fighting a losing war. For eight years, she's competed with the phantom of Coco Foster—a rival who has always lived rent-free in Ray Kirk's heart. When Ray chooses Coco over Naomi on her birthday, it's the last straw. Heartbroken but resolute, Naomi walks away, channeling her pain into building a brighter future for herself. Meanwhile, Ray is struck by regret, realizing too late that Naomi is the one who truly matters.

dramabox.title: The Day She Was Forgotten
dramabox.norm_title: the day she was forgotten
dramabox.description: On Rey Quinn’s birthday, Nora Gray drives with her daughter, Penny Quinn, towards the venue of celebration, yet unfortunately gets into a car accident with Mary Cole, who is also headed to celebrate Rey’s birthday. Nora and Penny suffer severe injuries and are on the verge of death when Rey, a doctor, arrives at the scene.

dramabox.title: Too Late for a Second Chance
dramabox.norm_title: too late for a second chance
dramabox.description: When Nancy Roberts was diagnosed with stomach cancer, Daniel Smith laughed cruelly. "You must be joking. Cancer? That's the cheapest trick you've pulled yet." When she revealed she was pregnant, his words cut like a blade, "A woman like you isn’t worthy of bearing my child." Even after her car accident, he sneered, "Why aren’t you dead already?" When Nancy finally passed away, Daniel realized what he had lost. His heart shattered into pieces, and he descended into insanity.

dramabox.title: The Masked Nanny: Love Amidst Shadows
dramabox.norm_title: the masked nanny love amidst shadows
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Luna Miller was schemed against and forced to spend a night with an unknown man, resulting in the birth of her child, who was then ruthlessly taken from her. Determined to uncover the truth, she resolutely changed her name to Jenny Lewis and infiltrated the Smiths as a nanny. It was all to get closer to Daniel Smith, the father of the child she both hated and loved.

dramabox.title: Choices of the Heart
dramabox.norm_title: choices of the heart
dramabox.description: After Bianca Jenkins lost her parents in an accident, she took on multiple jobs to fund her sister's eye treatment. Amidst her struggles, her boyfriend of four years betrayed her in order to advance his career. Thus, she became embroiled in the Frost family’s inheritance battle over Horizon Group.

dramabox.title: The Atonement of Love
dramabox.norm_title: the atonement of love
dramabox.description: Ruth Stone was falsely accused of causing Joseph Lake's elder brother's deadly fall and was forced to kneel in front of the mourning hall. Amidst her despair, she also found out that she was pregnant and suffering from late-stage heart failure. Despite these devastating revelations, she refused to divorce Joseph, that is until….

dramabox.title: Redemption of the Heart
dramabox.norm_title: redemption of the heart
dramabox.description: After six years of marriage, Sarah Jordan became nothing more than a caretaker to Joe Fitch, working tirelessly and losing herself in the process. When Joe wanted to drive her away because Mary Grant returned, Sarah filed for divorce. When they met again, Sarah transformed into a confident and successful businesswoman, effortlessly negotiating at the table. Joe Fitch, once the powerful president of the Fitch Corporation, was no longer worthy of standing by her side.

dramabox.title: From Contract Lover to the Billionaire's Bride
dramabox.norm_title: from contract lover to the billionaire s bride
dramabox.description: After being betrayed by her boyfriend, Mason, Chloe meets a handsome man at the bar and tries to seduce him. Just before they get to the point, Chloe recognizes the man she kissed—Ethan Foster, the well-known lawyer in the city, a billionaire, and her ex-boyfriend's brother-in-law. Chloe flees the bar and gets a phone call: her father has been framed by Mason and taken into custody. Mason tells Chloe that no one would dare to take this case except Ethan.

dramabox.title: Forget Me Not
dramabox.norm_title: forget me not
dramabox.description: After a devastating fire robs Sue Leaf of her memory after she saves Andy Leed, the boy she grew up with, she ends up in the care of a farmer who renames her Mia Puck. Years later, Andy, determined to find Sue, plans to build the world’s largest funfair in his search for her. However, fate takes a twist when he discovers that the perfect location for his funfair belongs to Mia and her adoptive father, who are fiercely protective of their land.

dramabox.title: The Sound of Silence
dramabox.norm_title: the sound of silence
dramabox.description: Ever since Mila Scott gets sold out by her father to clear his debts, Mary Zimmer has lived without her mother for 15 years. Now that she is the wealthiest in Jene, Mary searches for Mila together with her husband, Carson Fuller, using a gold locket. All the while, Mila suffers at her in-laws’ home in a remote mountain village. With all her strength, Mila escapes and fortunately meets Mary by coincidence.

dramabox.title: Heart's Compass: Guiding the Way Home
dramabox.norm_title: heart s compass guiding the way home
dramabox.description: On the eve of New Year's, a young girl named Erin is tragically separated from her mother, Joan Dale. Eleven years later, Joan has risen to become the CEO of Erinzo Group, successfully acquiring Tusk Steel Factory and earning a reputation as a formidable factory director. Little does she know, one of her employees is her long-lost daughter, who became blind after an accident and was adopted by the Lanes, who named her Thea Lane.

dramabox.title: The Recrowned Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the recrowned heiress
dramabox.description: After losing her vision in an accident that also claims her parents, Casey Park is adopted by her uncle with intentions of inheriting her deceased parents' assets. However, upon discovering that she is unaware of them, he swiftly betrays her trust by selling her off to a wealthy, ailing man, exploiting her vulnerability and jeopardizing her future.

dramabox.title: Love's Encore
dramabox.norm_title: love s encore
dramabox.description: To get his revenge, Luke Clark masks his identity for years and marries his enemy’s daughter, Nancy Beck. He then abandons her after killing her father. Unable to accept this, Nancy loses hope and ends her life. Meanwhile, Luke learns that her father was not his true enemy. When Nancy opens her eyes again, she realizes she has been reborn. Given a second chance, Nancy decides to stay away from Luke.

dramabox.title: Love Beyond the Veil of Time
dramabox.norm_title: love beyond the veil of time
dramabox.description: After an accidental time travel, Dr. Aurora Yandell finds herself in an ancient era, assuming the identity of the abandoned consort of Prince Hugh Yancey—a man with grudges against her newfound persona. Thrust into a time of the past, Aurora finds herself having to treat a patient with a severe illness while navigating the treacherous intrigues of the royal court. Wrongfully accused of a crime, she narrowly escapes imprisonment.

dramabox.title: When Love Comes Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: when love comes too late
dramabox.description: Willow Silva has been with Steven White for five years, believing that as long as she obeys him, she can one day win his heart. However, the day his fiancée returns to his side is the day she is mercilessly abandoned. With an incurable disease eating away at her life, she chooses to comply with their wishes and leave him. But when she later decides to marry someone else, Steven goes after her as if he has lost his mind.

dramabox.title: All Too Late for His Love
dramabox.norm_title: all too late for his love
dramabox.description: Framed by Amber Clark, Jim Ford misunderstands his wife, Nancy Bell, believing she is unfaithful and responsible for the car accident that nearly killed him in order to be with her secret lover. He wrongly thinks Amber is his savior, which fuels his growing hatred for Nancy. Consumed by hatred for Nancy and gratitude toward Amber, Jim allows Amber to stay in their home, unwittingly giving her the opportunity to further sabotage his marriage.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Allure
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden allure
dramabox.description: What happens when a failed top attorney in need of money and an abandoned son craving higher status meet? Otto Reed promises Kayla Ross a generous payment to become his business spy and pose as his secret lover to infiltrate a family feud. The deal consists of four missions: infiltration, drugging, seduction, and breaking Felix Reed's heart. But the line blurs as love blossoms under assumed identities.

dramabox.title: Tangled in His Vows
dramabox.norm_title: tangled in his vows
dramabox.description: The love-hate entanglement between Wanda Young and the domineering CEO Harold Johnson.

dramabox.title: When Love's Thorn Pierces
dramabox.norm_title: when love s thorn pierces
dramabox.description: Three days before her wedding, Zelda Sawyer is hospitalized after being diagnosed with heart disease. During a visit from her best friend, Joy Sullivan, Zelda passes out after drinking. When she opens her eyes again, she finds Joy dead beside her, the weapon in her own hand. Yes, she has been wrongly accused, and she vows to find the true culprit. Released five years later, she's shocked when Joy's fiancé picks her up.

dramabox.title: Redeeming Love
dramabox.norm_title: redeeming love
dramabox.description: Naomi Scott is compelled to stay by Adrian Young's side due to her uncanny resemblance to his sister. To seek revenge on the Shaws, she pretends to be dumb. However, despite having their own reasons to stay together initially, they soon become each other’s salvation and beloved.

dramabox.title: You're the Radiance of Night
dramabox.norm_title: you re the radiance of night
dramabox.description: Liam Shaw and Nora York were in love years ago before they separated by accident. However, under complex circumstances, they got married without seeing each other. Two years later, they meet again, but Nora finds out that Liam has forgotten about her. Misunderstandings and events emerge as obstacles in their relationship. Will they manage to overcome these challenges and find their way back to each other?

dramabox.title: The Sting of Deceptive Love
dramabox.norm_title: the sting of deceptive love
dramabox.description: Irina Jones finds herself unjustly framed and entangled in schemes. However, her husband, Quinn Moore, refuses to believe in her innocence. He not only doubts her but also sends her to jail, convinced of her guilt.In a desperate bid to save Irina, her mother sacrifices herself, deepening the agony in Irina's already shattered heart and intensifying her determination to seek justice for her deceased mother.

dramabox.title: My Mommy Disappeared!
dramabox.norm_title: my mommy disappeared
dramabox.description: A woman's deception and the hidden female lead who returned with a child five years later. Can the male lead, who was drawn into the scheme, distinguish between the real and fake female lead?The fraternal twins now have two mothers, but are these two children from one person or two? Can emotions overcome deception, and can the male lead choose between the two women to find true happiness?

dramabox.title: Throne Tempest: Her Path to Power
dramabox.norm_title: throne tempest her path to power
dramabox.description: Freya Scott, cherished daughter of the Scott family, was engaged to the kind Michael Lind until Charles Wilde disrupted everything by coercing her family to his side and marrying her against her will. Believing Freya betrayed him, Michael teams up with the Shaw and Jensen families to expose Charles' treason. When Michael becomes king, he keeps Freya as his personal maid, subjecting her to daily mistreatment, unaware that the proof against Charles was provided by the Scotts.

dramabox.title: Etched by Your Painful Love
dramabox.norm_title: etched by your painful love
dramabox.description: Through the love, hatred, and struggles of the songstress Linda, it reflects the lack of autonomy of women during the olden era.

dramabox.title: Love Beyond Words: Mr. Kane's Mute Wife
dramabox.norm_title: love beyond words mr kane s mute wife
dramabox.description: There is a beautiful woman who Asher Kane holds dear to his heart. To him, she is worth more than money or even his own life, and he fiercely defends her against any harm. Then there is another woman, his mute wife, who lacks significant status or achievements. In his eyes, she is merely someone dependent on him for survival. That’s what he believes, at least. However, when she suggests a divorce, he feels an unsettling sensation stirring from deep within his heart.

dramabox.title: Hi, Mr. Capricious（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: hi mr capricious dubbed
dramabox.description: On the day of Aiden Steele's engagement to Isabella Rosewood, Emma Blake was forced into abortion by Aiden’s mother. As the mistress, she was deemed unworthy to bear children for the Steele family.

dramabox.title: Vengeance and Untold Love
dramabox.norm_title: vengeance and untold love
dramabox.description: Ethan mistakenly believed that Scarlett's father had killed his own father, leading him to confine Scarlett in a mental hospital, where she endured torment for two years. Later, Ethan, in an effort to thwart his stepmother Evelyn's scheme, chose to enter into a fake marriage with Scarlett, with a three-month deadline. However, just as Ethan and Scarlett received their marriage license, Ethan discovered the mysterious woman he had slept with, Sophia.

dramabox.title: Hi, Mr. Capricious
dramabox.norm_title: hi mr capricious
dramabox.description: On the day of Aiden Steele's engagement to Isabella Rosewood, Emma Blake was forced into abortion by Aiden’s mother. As the mistress, she was deemed unworthy to bear children for the Steele family.

dramabox.title: Marrying My Ex's Billionaire Father-in-Law
dramabox.norm_title: marrying my ex s billionaire father in law
dramabox.description: After her boyfriend Nolan leaves her for billionaire heiress Bianca, broke waitress Elena enters a contract marriage with Bianca’s powerful father, Dominic Beaumont, to save her sick dad and expose Nolan’s schemes. But revenge turns into forbidden love as Dominic falls for Elena for real, forcing them to face scandal, betrayal, kidnapping, and the truth about what they truly want.

dramabox.title: The Marriage Built on Greed and Lies
dramabox.norm_title: the marriage built on greed and lies
dramabox.description: Claire Hart, a wealthy heiress, leads a stable life with her husband Evan Cole and their daughter Ella. A strange spending record arouses her suspicion of Evan. After lying and shifting blame to his friend Logan Ford, Evan conceals his secret. Claire keeps investigating and later discovers Evan’s ambiguous relationship and illegal interest collusion with company executive Tessa Lane.

dramabox.title: The Love He Forgot, The Price He Paid
dramabox.norm_title: the love he forgot the price he paid
dramabox.description: After a car crash leaves Ethan Dalton with amnesia, Lena Harper devotes herself to nursing him back to health, only for him to wake up remembering nothing of her. Desperate, Lena begs and humbles herself again and again, met only with escalating cruelty. The day she finally gives up and lets go, Ethan's memory returns—along with everything he once felt for her.

dramabox.title: Done Being My Sister's Blood Bank
dramabox.norm_title: done being my sister s blood bank
dramabox.description: For years, Gigi Lane was treated as little more than her sister Julia Lane's personal blood bank, while her family and fiancé chose Julia every time. When Gigi finally walks away, she rebuilds her life through art and finds the love and family she was always denied. But as the truth behind Julia's lies begins to surface, the people who cast Gigi aside realize too late what they lost.

dramabox.title: My Baby's Words Saved Us
dramabox.norm_title: my baby s words saved us
dramabox.description: After a one-night encounter with business heir Victor Carver, Claire Carver becomes pregnant. During childbirth, she suddenly hears her newborn daughter's thoughts and learns the heartbreaking future they once endured because she trusted her manipulative best friend and rejected Victor's help. Given a second chance, Claire chooses to believe her baby, protect her family, and rewrite all three of their destinies.

dramabox.title: Enough！You Messed With The Wrong Sister
dramabox.norm_title: enough you messed with the wrong sister
dramabox.description: Victoria Sinclair and her younger sister, Sophia, were once inseparable—until Sophia fell for the manipulative Ethan. Thinking Victoria was a powerless outcast, Ethan and his secret lover nearly killed her, then imprisoned Sophia to seize the family company. But Victoria was never helpless. With her fiancé, Alexander Kane, she exposes their lies, destroys their scheme, saves Sophia, and reunites with the sister she never stopped loving.

dramabox.title: His Silence Cost Him Everything
dramabox.norm_title: his silence cost him everything
dramabox.description: Laura Miller lost her husband and daughter, raising her son alone. For his wedding, she toils at a site, but bully Victor Crowe forces her to marry him. Her long-lost daughter, now a CEO, appears and saves Laura. The son chooses silence over family. The daughter identifies her mother by a sesame cake and rescues her. The son regrets, but Laura and her daughter disown him forever.

dramabox.title: She Raised Their Blood, She Planned Their Fall
dramabox.norm_title: she raised their blood she planned their fall
dramabox.description: Eight‑months pregnant, Vivian Sloan overhears her live‑in‑son‑in‑law husband and her sponsored impoverished student, learning her baby carries their fertilized egg. She feigns ignorance, gives birth and raises the child devotedly. Twenty‑two years later, after their son Logan returns from overseas study, Vivian transfers all her company shares and assets to him.

dramabox.title: The Price of His Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: the price of his betrayal
dramabox.description: Avery Hayes, the heiress to Hayes Group, believes she has the perfect family until she discovers that her father, Damian Carter, a live-in son-in-law, has secretly built another family with his mistress. When both families collide at a graduation banquet, years of lies unravel. As the truth comes to light, those who betrayed Avery and her mother are finally forced to face the consequences of their choices.

dramabox.title: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him
dramabox.norm_title: he broke the heart that saved him
dramabox.description: Mia sacrifices everything for her dying lover Vance, never knowing he is Cloud City's greatest heir. To return the future to him, Mia walks away resolutely without telling him she's pregnant. Years later, their child's tragic fate crosses their paths again. Yet vicious lies turn him against her, driving their boy to his death. Since then, Mia has lived in the pain of losing her son, while Vance, upon discovering the truth, will be left to bear the crushing weight of regret.

dramabox.title: The Shelter She Never Expected
dramabox.norm_title: the shelter she never expected
dramabox.description: Clara Hart, a poor student, has a one-night with CEO Ethan Blake and flees. He finds her. His sisters support them. She faces bullying; he saves her. Pregnant, he cares for her and gives her a job. His jealous childhood friend schemes, but the Blakes stand by Clara. The villain is punished. Ethan proposes; she accepts.

dramabox.title: He Threw Me Out, Then Lost Me Forever
dramabox.norm_title: he threw me out then lost me forever
dramabox.description: Adrian Grant drives Claire Hayes home to meet his family. She brings gifts, only to learn he expects her to give his sister $180,000. When Claire refuses, Adrian throws her out on Kingsway Motorway. She wakes up at Elmford General and learns she has lost their baby. Heartbroken and betrayed, Claire vows to seek justice for herself and her unborn child.

dramabox.title: The Elite Marriage
dramabox.norm_title: the elite marriage
dramabox.description: Top law firm partner Alessia is publicly abandoned by her fiancé Marcus at their engagement party—he declares he loves her rival Chloe. Humiliated, Alessia turns and marries Dominic, Marcus's business nemesis and a real estate tycoon. Once rivals, they evolve from power struggles to allies—and discover Dominic had secretly admired her for three years. This marriage was his long-planned approach.

dramabox.title: She Thought She Outsmarted Her Mother-in-Law
dramabox.norm_title: she thought she outsmarted her mother in law
dramabox.description: When Vivian Hayes warmly welcomes her son Ethan Carter's pregnant fiancée, Tessa Miller, she is handed a shocking prenup demanding the family's assets, a lavish bride price, and that Ethan's sister Mia Carter leave with nothing—or Tessa will abort the baby. To everyone's surprise, Vivian agrees without hesitation. But what looks like surrender is only the first step in a carefully planned trap.

dramabox.title: His Betrayal Built My Empire
dramabox.norm_title: his betrayal built my empire
dramabox.description: Claire Carter hid her identity as the heiress of Carter Capital for three years, secretly helping her husband Adrian Hayes build Hayes Group from nothing. After giving birth to their daughter, she discovers he's openly devoted to his secretary, Chloe Reed, while humiliating his own wife. At the company gala, Claire files for divorce, pulls Carter Capital's investment, bankrupts Hayes Group, and returns to claim the empire that was always hers.

dramabox.title: When She Stopped Looking Back
dramabox.norm_title: when she stopped looking back
dramabox.description: When Erin finally gets pregnant after years of treatment, her husband Alex freezes the money meant to save their baby—while showering his pregnant mistress with everything. After losing the child, Erin disappears, leaving only divorce papers and an urn. By the time Alex learns the truth and comes crawling back, Erin has rebuilt her life—and chosen someone who chooses her.

dramabox.title: Your Dumped Housewife Is Your Boss
dramabox.norm_title: your dumped housewife is your boss
dramabox.description:
Linda gave up her billionaire legacy for her husband Nick. A ransom call shatters her perfect life: Nick and their daughter have been kidnapped. Rushing to pay the ransom, she's forced to trade her freedom for Nick's mistress Claire. She endures three years of torture in a drug lab.
When Linda finally escapes and returns as the billionaire heiress of the Hastings Group, she's ready to make everyone who betrayed her kneel at her feet.

dramabox.title: Married and 3 Months Pregnant, Turns Out I'm the Mistress
dramabox.norm_title: married and 3 months pregnant turns out i m the mistress
dramabox.description: Three months pregnant, Chloe learns her marriage to CEO Julian was a fake—staged so his real wife Lily could have a child without carrying it. When Julian's mother pushes her down the stairs, she loses the baby. Rescued by billionaire Alexander, she plots revenge. Together they expose the family's fraud, dark secrets, and crimes on TV. Julian is sold into slavery. Lily and Eleanor rot in prison. Chloe becomes the queen of Alexander's empire.

dramabox.title: Hired to Get Fired, Destined to Fall for Him
dramabox.norm_title: hired to get fired destined to fall for him
dramabox.description: After dying from overwork, Claire Carter reincarnates with a Billion-Dollar Firing System, which rewards her with a massive fortune if she is fired from Grant Group. To get dismissed, she acts recklessly at work. Surprisingly, she accidentally solves various company crises, repelling hackers and securing deals, earning the admiration of CEO Evan Grant. She confronts Vivian Stone and Ryan Drake, who plot to seize Evan’s position.

dramabox.title: The Dinner That Unmasked Them All
dramabox.norm_title: the dinner that unmasked them all
dramabox.description: Claire Foster, heiress of the Foster family, left her privileged life behind to live simply. When her daughter suffered a sudden heart attack, she was blocked and humiliated by her father's girlfriend. The Foster family rushed to her side. Claire decided to expose the truth at a family banquet. Layer by layer, the schemes of the girlfriend, her accomplices, and Claire's hypocritical husband collapsed. Every wrongdoer finally paid the price.

dramabox.title: Her Cage of Perfection, Her Path of Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: her cage of perfection her path of revenge
dramabox.description: For three years, Chloe Wells was caged by Adrian Crane’s elaborate trap. At a wedding, she performed mid-air like a nightingale, and a lipstick carrying 20 years of truth fell straight into Evan Hale’s hands. Her accidental-looking fall was a calculated escape at the cost of self-inflicted pain. The Crane family’s twisted controlling nature is laid bare by the surname brand on her back and the imprisoned girls trapped with her.

dramabox.title: The Hitman and the Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the hitman and the heiress
dramabox.description: Tessa Hayes descends from her mountain to find her betrothed Ethan Stone and call off the marriage. Instead, she stumbles into an assassination attempt on him, saves his life, and gets pulled into a web of family power struggles and underworld conspiracies. A girl who hides deadly skill behind a lazy smile. A CEO trapped in a bloody succession war. Together, they uncover the truth behind the blood jade fragments and the massacre that once destroyed her family.

dramabox.title: Came For The Money, Stayed For Him
dramabox.norm_title: came for the money stayed for him
dramabox.description: To save his ill brother, poor basketball prodigy Anderson wanders into the private lab of wealthy heir Campbell and signs a high-value contract. He thinks he's straight, but his body betrays him during compatibility tests. Campbell, who planned to tame him, also loses control.

dramabox.title: Reborn as an Unknown Actres, I Stole the Spotlight
dramabox.norm_title: reborn as an unknown actres i stole the spotlight
dramabox.description: Avery Reed, the fearless daughter of Hatchet Gang, wakes up as an overlooked actress in the modern entertainment industry. Exploited by her adoptive family and framed at every turn, she fights back with grit and wit. Along the way, she meets superstar Julian Knox, a man who looks exactly like her husband from her past life. As hidden identities and long-buried secrets unravel, they find love across two lifetimes.

dramabox.title: Three Knights, One Queen
dramabox.norm_title: three knights one queen
dramabox.description: Orphaned Claire Waller toiled to fund her boyfriend's studies. He returned, humiliated her, and chose a richer woman. That day, three ragged men revealed as her lost brothers: Victor Stone, a CEO, and two powerful siblings,secretly helped her open a shop, recover debts, and expose lies. Claire found success, love, and family.

dramabox.title: The Lost Heir A Christmas Reckoning
dramabox.norm_title: the lost heir a christmas reckoning
dramabox.description: Twenty years after losing his son Arthur, Sterling becomes the richest man on Wall Street but never stops searching. Arthur, a poor mechanic, is attacked by loan sharks. Sterling recognizes the family pocket watch, mobilizes a special ops team, and saves his son.

dramabox.title: Shielded by the Rideshare Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: shielded by the rideshare billionaire
dramabox.description: On her wedding day, Selina catches her fiancé Ben cheating with her half-sister Emily. To escape her family, she impulsively proposes to an "Uber driver"—not knowing he is actually Robert, the hidden CEO of the Akde Group. After marriage, Robert repeatedly stands up for Selina, helping her fight back against her malicious family, workplace sabotage, and her ex-fiancé's revenge. As Robert's true identity slowly emerges, his power struggle with his brother erupts...

dramabox.title: I Came Second In His Love
dramabox.norm_title: i came second in his love
dramabox.description: At their wedding, a star pilot watches her fiancé choose to marry his sister-in-law instead. Heartbroken, she walks away for good—and shocks everyone by marrying his billionaire uncle. As she returns to the skies and rises higher than ever, her ex is consumed by jealousy and regret, spiraling into madness as he realizes he has lost her forever.

dramabox.title: Secretly Pregnant with the Billionaire's Daughter
dramabox.norm_title: secretly pregnant with the billionaire s daughter
dramabox.description: Six years ago, Isabel was framed and fell pregnant by Ethan. Now she works as his assistant. Facing bullying and threats to her child, she fights back. Ethan falls for her. Their child's identity is revealed, the villain is arrested, and they have twins.

dramabox.title: I Married a Nobody, Now He Owns the City
dramabox.norm_title: i married a nobody now he owns the city
dramabox.description: After a scandalous night, Lena is ruined but returns six years later as a billionaire CEO. She hires a construction worker as her contract husband. He is actually the country's most elusive defense tycoon—the man from that night—who has spent six years searching for her.

dramabox.title: Her Billionaire’s Obsessive Devotion
dramabox.norm_title: her billionaire s obsessive devotion
dramabox.description: Pregnant Chloe Dawson is abandoned by everyone she trusts. Ethan Merce arrives to uphold his promise and protect her. As long-buried secrets about her true identity surface, Chloe reunites with her biological family. All past sorrows fade, leading her to a happy ending with the man who chose her again and again.

dramabox.title: Savage Alpha The Boss on My Sheet
dramabox.norm_title: savage alpha the boss on my sheet
dramabox.description: Maurice, New York's youngest CEO, hides a dangerous secret. When new Alpha executive Noah uncovers it, they are pulled into a chaotic spiral of desire and secrets under the full moon. Their connection becomes unstoppable.

dramabox.title: Don't Provoke Him，He’s the King of L.A
dramabox.norm_title: don t provoke him he s the king of l a
dramabox.description: Kane Morgan, founder of Vertex Capital, retired to drive a ride-hailing service to watch over his son Liam after losing his eldest son. Liam is humiliated and kidnapped. Kane reveals his power, returns to his company, and destroys the O'Hara empire. Liam reconciles with his father and finds love with Aurora.

dramabox.title: Beauty and the Western Beast's Summer Lease
dramabox.norm_title: beauty and the western beast s summer lease
dramabox.description: Down on her luck, Southern belle Bella gets sold into a frontier whorehouse, barely escapes, and stumbles onto the ranch of Cole—a brooding millionaire who hasn't spoken in years. They strike a marriage of convenience to help him keep custody of his autistic daughter. They fake being in love until the heat between them makes it impossible to pretend. Two broken people crush enemies together.

dramabox.title: Trapped by the Billionaire Who Owes Me
dramabox.norm_title: trapped by the billionaire who owes me
dramabox.description: A wrong delivery brings a painter to a drugged billionaire. Nine months later, she's dying and he's her only hope. He thinks she's a scammer, she thinks he's a monster. They marry out of duty, fall in love, and overcome family schemes and long-lost secrets to find a soulmate bond.

dramabox.title: My Ex`s Seducing Billionaire Bride
dramabox.norm_title: my ex s seducing billionaire bride
dramabox.description: After fashion designer Mia is humiliated and dumped by Ryan for the powerful Evelyn Sterling, she vows to seduce his glamorous fiancée as revenge. But Evelyn sees through the game—and plays it better. Their dangerous flirtation quickly turns into real desire, forcing Mia to choose between revenge and the woman who may understand her better than anyone. With Ryan at the door, Mia must now survive Evelyn`s rules without exposing their secret.

dramabox.title: Billionaire’s Sudden Wife
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire s sudden wife
dramabox.description: Evelyn, an IT genius, enters a contract marriage with billionaire CEO Landon to inherit her mother's estate. From a fake couple to true love, she uses her hacking skills to solve crises, grows in the high-society game, and ultimately wins love and family recognition.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire I Sued Is My Best Friend’s Father
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire i sued is my best friend s father
dramabox.description: Lena sued real estate tycoon Christian, who was her best friend's father. They teamed up to uncover a demolition scheme. They fell in love, but it cost her friendship. A year later, she returned as a lawyer to expose the scam and reunited with him.

dramabox.title: My Badass Stepmom
dramabox.norm_title: my badass stepmom
dramabox.description: A sharp-tongued pizza girl Luna is hired by billionaire Ethan as a contract wife to tame his rebel nephew Owen. She earns Owen's respect and love, and Ethan, who has history with her, falls for her. The contract marriage turns into a happy family.

dramabox.title: I Became the CEO's Most Beloved
dramabox.norm_title: i became the ceo s most beloved
dramabox.description: Erin Vance, a homemaker, is betrayed by her husband and best friend. She joins a beauty contest with help from Gavin, who secretly is the CEO sponsor. She wins, exposes the betrayers, and is saved from kidnapping by Gavin. They reunite and start a new life together.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Touch: Taming My Stepfather
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden touch taming my stepfather
dramabox.description: To secure her crush, art student Ivy uses a contract marriage to move in with her stepdad Sebastian. She seduces him, forcing him to choose between his IPO and forbidden desire. Scandal drives her away, but he hunts her globally.

dramabox.title: The CEO's Burning Love
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo s burning love
dramabox.description: CEO Bryan, traumatized by a plane crash, is awakened by doctor Sophia. He falls for her, but she has a boyfriend. After he breaks them up, Sophia proposes a two-month casual relationship because he's leaving. Will they overcome?

dramabox.title: The Billionaire’s Second First Love
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire s second first love
dramabox.description: Single mother Grace enters a lavish “Choose a Wife” gala to earn money for her sick daughter—only to find that the host is her ex-boyfriend, billionaire heir Harold Perry.

dramabox.title: When She Stole My Lover（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: when she stole my lover dubbed
dramabox.description: Lim Min-young, has been living in pain, having everything taken away from her half-sister. Choi Shi-hyuk, mistakenly mistook the girl he passed by as a child for Lim Hye-ri, leaving a deep wound for Min-young. After abandoning everything and leaving, Min-young meets Hyun-woo. Shi-hyuk finally realized the truth and belatedly tried to catch her.

dramabox.title: The Love She Carried, The Throne She Seized
dramabox.norm_title: the love she carried the throne she seized
dramabox.description: Lila Lowe insists on remaining childless because she believes childbirth reduces women to mere tools for reproduction. So she refuses to bear a child for her boyfriend, Allen Gray, the richest man in town. In order to change her destiny, Megan Sutton gets pregnant with Allen's baby by accident. She intends to rely on the baby in order to secure a comfortable life, but she keeps facing challenges during her time in the main residence. Will she succeed?

dramabox.title: Diary of a Billionaire's Daughter-in-Law(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: diary of a billionaire s daughter in law dubbed
dramabox.description: Bae Jia has a one-night stand with rich heir Kim Minhyuk, who has poor sperm motility, and becomes pregnant. Due to her friend's and his first love's scheming, she loses the child and dies. Reborn at the moment she discovers the pregnancy, she swears that she will protect her baby and rewrite her fate this time.

dramabox.title: Match Made in the Ring
dramabox.norm_title: match made in the ring
dramabox.description: A perfectionist matchmaker and a billionaire playboy strike a deal: thirty days of a fake live-in romance to protect their secrets. But as sparks fly and chemistry builds, pretend love quickly turns into the one thing neither of them expected—something real.

dramabox.title: My Eight Brothers Landed Helicopters at My High School to Save Me
dramabox.norm_title: my eight brothers landed helicopters at my high school to save me
dramabox.description: Sienna Vanderbilt has eight insanely powerful, billionaire brothers who spoil her rotten. When her misogynist teacher Mona Sutherland humiliates her, destroys her $12 million birthday bracelet, and drives her to the school roof, the brothers descend—helicopters, black SUVs, private jewelers, and scorched-earth lawyers in tow. But taking down Mona is just the beginning. As Sienna fights back, Mona resurfaces with new names, new husbands, and new schemes.

dramabox.title: Help！I Fell For My Billionaire Target
dramabox.norm_title: help i fell for my billionaire target
dramabox.description: Emma is a “Scumbag Slayer” who hunts down corrupt men. During one mission, she crosses paths with billionaire Arthur Wilson, who catches her and blackmails her into pretending to be his lover to ruin his wedding. Their fake relationship turns into a battle of wit and desire, full of tension and attraction.

dramabox.title: The CEO's Maid Turns Out To Be The Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo s maid turns out to be the heiress
dramabox.description: Kelly, a working-class girl, agrees to become a maid for her former lover, wealthy CEO Philip, in order to pay for her daughter’s medical bills. Despite past hurts, they rebuild their relationship, uncover her true identity as a long-lost heir, and ultimately reunite as a family.

dramabox.title: An Office is Just a Bed with a Desk
dramabox.norm_title: an office is just a bed with a desk
dramabox.description: In a modern society divided into Alphas, Betas, and Omegas, Luca—an insatiable Omega with a ferocious appetite—has driven away four boyfriends in a row. When news breaks that Dorian Holt, a dominant Alpha CEO suffering from severe Pheromone Rage Disorder who has already lost three Omega partners under mysterious circumstances, announces an Omega Bonding Lottery, Luca senses his dangerous match. Only someone equally "too much" can handle each other.

dramabox.title: The Fugitive Ballerina and the Billionaire Plumber
dramabox.norm_title: the fugitive ballerina and the billionaire plumber
dramabox.description: Fleeing a traumatic past and the grip of a controlling guardian, Chloe finds comfort in Elliot, a quiet vineyard worker whose tender love helps her heal. Their romance feels like salvation—until the stunning truth is revealed: Elliot is not a humble laborer, but the powerful heir who has secretly loved her all along.

dramabox.title: Step Back! I'm the Hidden King
dramabox.norm_title: step back i m the hidden king
dramabox.description: On a New York-bound flight, Arthur meets Throne Tech heiress Anya, who offers a fake marriage to escape an arranged union. Arthur refuses, yet upgrades her investment bid to $100 billion. Later dumped by his fiancée Serena, Arthur is defended by Anya. At a grand gala, Arthur reveals himself as Titan Group's CEO. He funds Anya, and the two choose to build a new life together.

dramabox.title: Mr. & Mrs. Adams Behind the Masks
dramabox.norm_title: mr mrs adams behind the masks
dramabox.description: A fake marriage, a hidden child, and a one-night secret from six years ago bring two strangers back together in the most unexpected way.

dramabox.title: One fateful Night with My Neighbor Boss
dramabox.norm_title: one fateful night with my neighbor boss
dramabox.description: After a one-night stand with Kim Tae-on, Yoon Ha-jung gives birth to twins. However, her ruthless stepsister, Yoon Se-ra, secretly steals one of the babies and claims the child as her own. She becomes Kim Tae-on's fiancee through deception. Six years later, Yoon Ha-jung returns under a new identity—the famous perfumer, Arta.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Pact
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden pact
dramabox.description: To pay off crushing debts and fulfill her grandfather's will, Evelyn is forced to marry Mark, a man who doesn't love her. Humiliated for years by Mark and his mistress Ruth, she reaches her breaking point.
