dramabox.title: My Million-Dollar Substitute Job
dramabox.norm_title: my million dollar substitute job
dramabox.description: Because her gambling father was in debt, waitress Lily was forced by the gangster boss to pretend to be real estate tycoon Gavin's first love, New York socialite Grace, who had gone to England, in order to steal Gavin's family heirloom, the Rose Heart. Facing Gavin's suspicion, Lily tried her best to disguise herself, and in the process, she fell in love with him. However, just when she was about to get the Rose Heart, the real Grace returned from England...

dramabox.title: A Life That Shines Again
dramabox.norm_title: a life that shines again
dramabox.description: For seven years, Yun Seo-rin has given everything to her billionaire husband and their daughter. On her birthday, she discovers they are celebrating her husband's half-sister instead of her. Realizing she has been abandoned, Seo-rin quietly prepares for divorce and withdraws from both the family and the company. Only then do they understand the depth of what they've lost. Cast aside by both her love and her family, Seo-rin is determined to reclaim her dignity and her life.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire I Dumped is My New Boss
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire i dumped is my new boss
dramabox.description: After junior designer Ava Harrison has a one-night stand with a charming "construction worker," she disappears the next morning—misled by the lies of his manipulative ex-girlfriend. She never suspects the man she ditched is actually William Baker, the billionaire CEO now revealed as her new boss. As old misunderstandings collide with new desires, the question remains: will the truth finally pull them together, or tear their second chance apart?

dramabox.title: Sleeping Tycoon's Magic Bride Pregnant with Twins
dramabox.norm_title: sleeping tycoon s magic bride pregnant with twins
dramabox.description: Desperate college student Isabelle enters a contractual marriage with comatose tycoon Andrew to save her grandfather, resulting in a secret pregnancy. Eight months later, the now-awake Andrew repeatedly encounters but fails to recognize her, leading to tension, hidden identity revelations, and familial conflict. The story culminates in their reunion, the birth of twins, and genuine love.

dramabox.title: Legally Sexy and Mr. Ice Cold
dramabox.norm_title: legally sexy and mr ice cold
dramabox.description: A one-night stand with billionaire Leo Whitney leaves law student Summer Ellis unexpectedly pregnant. Her toxic sister, Angie, steals Summer's identity and becomes Leo's fiancée. Six years later, Summer crosses paths with Leo again—this time with her five-year-old daughter, Melody. As Summer represents Leo in a custody case, the buried truth resurfaces, and love ignites.

dramabox.title: All I Want For Christmas Is My Quarterback Husband
dramabox.norm_title: all i want for christmas is my quarterback husband
dramabox.description:
After being betrayed by her stepsister, who steals her wealthy fiancé, Mia impulsively marries Andy — a humble street cleaner who’s secretly a football superstar and billionaire CEO.
Six years later, when Mia returns home for Christmas, her family’s cruel judgment turns to shock as Andy’s true identity shatters their arrogance.

dramabox.title: Lies Worn as Love
dramabox.norm_title: lies worn as love
dramabox.description: For seven years, Riley Jensen trusted Noah Archer—only to discover he lied about having a split personality disorder and that she had endured relentless torment from Morgan Walker. When the pain finally eclipses her love, Riley divorces him and opens her heart to someone new.

dramabox.title: Not His Choice, Not His Ending
dramabox.norm_title: not his choice not his ending
dramabox.description: Countryside girl Elise Jensen marries Cyrus Fenton in place of her twin, Sylvia, to secure an alliance between the two families. In the next three years, she endures neglect, misunderstandings, and harm, all for the promised pay. But when Sylvia reclaims her place, conflicts and complications arise, eventually bringing the truth to light. When Cyrus finally realizes his love for Elise, she has already started a new life with someone else.

dramabox.title: Reunited with My Three Billionaire Brothers
dramabox.norm_title: reunited with my three billionaire brothers
dramabox.description: After being betrayed on her anniversary, Hailey—a paralyzed young woman—uncovers the devastating truth that her fiancé and friend have been secretly cheating on her. Trapped and humiliated by the cruel couple, she's on the brink of despair until three powerful billionaire brothers appear, claiming she's their long-lost sister. As doubts about their true identities arise, Hailey is ready to teach those who once hurt her a lesson.

dramabox.title: Secret Sugar On Me
dramabox.norm_title: secret sugar on me
dramabox.description: Catherine Rogers—trapped in a loveless marriage to her unfaithful husband—finds forbidden escape in a passionate affair with Abel, a younger man she believes to be nothing more than her kept lover. Their relationship defies age, status, and morality, but when she tries to end it, the truth shatters her carefully constructed facade: Abel is not a disposable secret but Mr. Harris, the city's most powerful billionaire with the ability to destroy her family.

dramabox.title: Got you! Mr. Always Right
dramabox.norm_title: got you mr always right
dramabox.description: Jane's ex and high school rival get engaged, inviting her to humiliate her. Jane hires a "ride-share driver" named Mike as a fake husband, unaware he's wealthy and knows her. Jane enters high society, loved by Mike but facing pressure from wealthy heiress Sissy, who opposes their union, leading to a tangled web of love, family, and jealousy.

dramabox.title: Billionaire Daddy: the Hunt Is On!
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire daddy the hunt is on
dramabox.description: Novice mother Miranda works hard to support her son, but always accidentally offends the black-hearted boss Raymond, and this handsome, rich man, who is cold outside and warm inside, is actually the biological father of the child...

dramabox.title: Supercar Cinderella Story
dramabox.norm_title: supercar cinderella story
dramabox.description: A job-seeking graduate's life takes a turn when her ex-boyfriend becomes a billionaire through cryptocurrency and reappears in her life. As her friends develop feelings for either her or her ex, tensions rise, leading to conflicts. The story explores themes of wealth, love, and friendship as the main character navigates personal growth.

dramabox.title: Taming the Football Bad Boy
dramabox.norm_title: taming the football bad boy
dramabox.description: All-pro tight end Tucker Newsome gets a last-chance contract with a strict morality clause—one misstep and it's over. To keep him in line, he’s paired with ambitious PR intern Samira Rivers, who's hiding a secret of her own. Forced to spend every moment together, their chemistry grows undeniable. They can't hook up. They shouldn't fall in love. And everyone is watching.

dramabox.title: Her Pride & His Prejudice
dramabox.norm_title: her pride his prejudice
dramabox.description: After a humiliating betrayal by billionaire Jonathan Silverstein and his rich friends, photographer Celeste Paige tries to move on—until their paths collide again. As they navigate a tense professional reunion, old wounds and new sparks ignite, forcing them to confront class divides, past lies, and the lingering love neither can deny. Can they rewrite their story, or will pride and prejudice destroy their second chance?

dramabox.title: My Billionaire Sugar Baby
dramabox.norm_title: my billionaire sugar baby
dramabox.description: She thought he was just a charming sugar baby - until he bought her company, crashed her marriage, and dropped to one knee. Now, with her life flipped upside down, she has to choose between pride, power… and the billionaire who never stops loving her.

dramabox.title: After I Had the Billionaire Hobo's Baby
dramabox.norm_title: after i had the billionaire hobo s baby
dramabox.description: After a fateful night with a homeless artist leaves her pregnant, Carly, a resilient single mother, fights to give her son a better life—unaware that the man she once loved in the shadows is a powerful heir entangled in secrets that could change everything.

dramabox.title: A Stormy Marriage
dramabox.norm_title: a stormy marriage
dramabox.description: Anna Kurt, daughter of a global tycoon, leaves home to escape her father's control. Hiding her identity, she marries Jason Zahn, only for him to fall for Emily Shaw, a fake heiress, and seek a divorce. Heartbroken, Anna enters a contractual marriage with Henry Wood, and as they uncover each other's true selves, love gradually blooms between them.

dramabox.title: Single Mom, Billionaire's Bride
dramabox.norm_title: single mom billionaire s bride
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, a fateful night entangled Evelyn with Xavier, the ruthless CEO of GT Group. Now a struggling single mother, she desperately seeks a father figure for her son William while fending off her obsessive stalker - William's teacher Richard. Their worlds collide again when Evelyn saves Xavier's mother from a mugging. Unaware he's William's real father, she enters a marriage contract with Xavier, who's hiding his billionaire identity.

dramabox.title: Summer Honeymoon with My Secret Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: summer honeymoon with my secret billionaire
dramabox.description: At her wedding, Ellie is dumped by her fiancé for a wealthy heiress. In a bold move, she marries a passing janitor, Daniel, inviting him on her luxury honeymoon. But Daniel is secretly a billionaire and the owner of Rainbow Island, escaping his own arranged marriage. They agree to a 7-day flash marriage ending in divorce—but as sparks fly, love might just change their plans.

dramabox.title: My Mile High Billionaire Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: my mile high billionaire obsession
dramabox.description: Aaron's younger brother impersonates him to date and gets engaged to Harper—just to trick her into donating a kidney to the girl he really loves. Heartbroken, Aaron leaves the country for three years, believing Harper chose his brother. But just as Harper is about to go through with the donation, Aaron returns and uncovers the shocking truth. This time, he’s determined to win back the girl who was always his.

dramabox.title: Baby Bump To Billionaire's Wife
dramabox.norm_title: baby bump to billionaire s wife
dramabox.description: To pay tuition, Rosa delivers food and accidentally sleeps with billionaire Jonah under false assumptions. Pregnant and betrayed, she refuses to give in. As the truth unfolds, Jonah protects her, and love blossoms amidst hardship and past trauma.

dramabox.title: Surprise! Baby Daddy Is The CEO
dramabox.norm_title: surprise baby daddy is the ceo
dramabox.description: Kind and resilient Cristy quickly marries 'impotent' Leo after his secret millionaire mother, Lisa, arranges the match. Little does she know, Leo is the CEO of a large company and the father of her children, setting her on a path to unexpected luxuries and life-altering revelations.

dramabox.title: 7 Days Locked With A Call Boy
dramabox.norm_title: 7 days locked with a call boy
dramabox.description: After betrayed by her ex-boyfriend, Ellie went to a bar and mistook a billionaire-Philip Wesley for a callboy. The two were hand cuffed together by mistake, so they were forced to live together for a week,and they gradually fall in love with each other.

dramabox.title: The Divorced Housewife Turned CEO
dramabox.norm_title: the divorced housewife turned ceo
dramabox.description:
Sharon Green, secretly the CEO of MF Group, hides her
identity to avoid making her husband, Martin, feel
insecure. Despite supporting him, she faces betrayal
and humiliation. After divorcing him, she reveals her
true identity at a gala, ends Martin’s business deal, and
reclaims her power, proving she’s a strong,
independent woman.

dramabox.title: Revenge After Death
dramabox.norm_title: revenge after death
dramabox.description: The Carters and the Stewarts are two major families. One of the Carters, Sandra Carter, marries Ethan Zabel, who then cheats on her with her cousin, Selene Carter. To avoid being kicked out of their home, they take Sandra's life by pushing her down a cliff. However, Sandra is reborn as Charlize Stewart, a woman who is entitled to take over Stewart Group but has been missing for days.

dramabox.title: Don’t Hurt My Cat
dramabox.norm_title: don t hurt my cat
dramabox.description: Damien has severe manic psychosis; his only anchor is his black cat Lily. He moves to an upscale neighbourhood for a fresh start, but neighbours Marcus and Elena torment him—setting their dog on Lily, forcing him to kneel, dousing him with alcohol, trampling him publicly. He endures for Lily, but their cruelty escalates. The cat is the last line between his sanity and breakdown.

dramabox.title: Trapped in a Lovers’ Game with My CEO
dramabox.norm_title: trapped in a lovers game with my ceo
dramabox.description: Hotel CEO Vanessa fires maintenance worker Ethan over a safety dispute. Both are locked in a dangerous couple's escape room by a hidden enemy. Forced through deadly intimacy challenges, they must cooperate to survive. The mastermind—Vanessa's fiancé Julian, plotting to seize power. Refusing to escape alone, they record evidence, expose the conspiracy, break free, and cross class lines to be together.

dramabox.title: Bite Me，My Forbidden King
dramabox.norm_title: bite me my forbidden king
dramabox.description: Luna, sole daughter of werewolf hunters, is betrothed to Damon, heir of the wolf clan—but doesn't know she's half-vampire. The night before the wedding, she stumbles into vampire territory and is marked by a stranger: Kael, Damon's father, a vampire-werewolf hybrid king. At the wedding, Damon exposes her bite mark. Both her fiancé and her father want her dead. Kael claims her publicly. Caught between three men and two races, she discovers she's pregnant—with Kael's child.

dramabox.title: Claiming My Sister As My Wife
dramabox.norm_title: claiming my sister as my wife
dramabox.description: Elowen, adopted daughter of the Vesper clan, discovers her fated mate is her brother Rhydian at her Awakening Ceremony. Consumed by desire and shame, she spirals between taboo and hunger. But Rhydian has long known they share no blood—and is quietly weaving a web to trap her by his side forever.

dramabox.title: Chased by My Step‑brother
dramabox.norm_title: chased by my step brother
dramabox.description: Every night, Leo shares intimate dreams with a mysterious man—believing it's just a psychological condition. But when his mother marries into a wealthy family, he discovers the man from his dreams is his new stepbrother, who harbors twisted desires for him. The forbidden game has officially begun.

dramabox.title: Married to My Husband's Brother
dramabox.norm_title: married to my husband s brother
dramabox.description: Bride Ivy witnesses her groom's sudden death at the altar. His brother Kane, a former Special Forces soldier, steps in to complete the ceremony and falls for her at first sight. Together, they fight against conspiracies, media attacks, arson, and kidnapping. After a fire rescue, a shootout, and countless trials, they eliminate their enemies and marry in a sea of white roses. But secrets remain hidden in Alexander's old notebook...

dramabox.title: Falling for the Heir
dramabox.norm_title: falling for the heir
dramabox.description: Aiden Hayes hides his identity as a servant at Sterling Manor, vowing revenge against Lucien for ruining his family. But his path darkens: young master Blake falls for him, Lucien's partner Jasper is drawn into his web, and butler Silas harbors a secret. As hatred and passion intertwine, a ruthless game spirals out of control.

dramabox.title: The Wolf Weapon Belongs To Me
dramabox.norm_title: the wolf weapon belongs to me
dramabox.description: A cold-tongued genius doctor Ian is hunted, awakening the perfect werewolf weapon Hall. One is sharp-tongued and stunning, the other fiercely protective and violent. Together, they flee, fight, and seek revenge amidst fire and smoke, locked in an intense, desperate bond.

dramabox.title: The Metro Games
dramabox.norm_title: the metro games
dramabox.description: Ex-cleaner Ronan, who robbed a mob to save his daughter, boards the Abyss Train—a brutal survival game in carriages themed after the Seven Deadly Sins. He grows entangled with mysterious bridal model Sienna. At the final carriage, he faces the ultimate test: save his daughter or the woman who bled beside him? Who will he choose?

dramabox.title: Falling for My Cowboy
dramabox.norm_title: falling for my cowboy
dramabox.description: Banks, whose brother is in prison, seeks refuge with his father's friend, rancher Jaxson—the man he's secretly loved since childhood. Jaxson resists, but Banks' teasing heats things up: barn chases, bath scrubs, mud fights. By day Banks plays nice; by night he's dancer "Flame" investigating his father's death. Jaxson is gravely injured saving Banks. Finally, he accepts his love. Age and status fall away—they find their happy ending.

dramabox.title: The Pack's Only Daughter
dramabox.norm_title: the pack s only daughter
dramabox.description: Abandoned in the Wasteland as a baby, Crystal is raised by 100 outlawed werewolf mercenaries. Hiding her powerful family, she endures brutal bullying at school—until her Dads storm the city to save her. As conspiracies, mutants, and the Scorpions emerge, Crystal fights for justice, her family, and the future of werewolves.

dramabox.title: The Knight Captain's Temptation
dramabox.norm_title: the knight captain s temptation
dramabox.description: Elro, the last elf, hides his identity and serves as knight captain to Crown Prince Leon. Grateful for Leon's childhood kindness, Elro grows obsessed and tempts him with magic. Forced into a political marriage, Leon battles nobles and threats while drowning in forbidden romance. When Elro's elf aura is exposed and marriage crisis erupts, he abducts Leon. A tragic tale of magic, power, and obsession.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Heat: Caught by My Ex’s Tycoon Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden heat caught by my ex s tycoon uncle
dramabox.description: Top student Sloane is betrayed by boyfriend Preston and roommate Lila. Drugged and stranded, she accidentally spends a night with Preston's billionaire uncle Alistair. After bullying and threats, Alistair shields her. They uncover a buried secret: Sloane's father, an undercover finance agent, was murdered by rival Vivienne. They defeat all villains, welcome a daughter, and build a healing love.

dramabox.title: Stars Fall Silent
dramabox.norm_title: stars fall silent
dramabox.description: Five years ago, rookie actress Iris endured freezing retakes and cancer to pay ex-boyfriend Julian's debt. Framed by Vivian, Julian abandoned her; Iris died alone on Christmas Eve. Five years later, Hartley confessed and evidence proved Vivian's conspiracy. Julian, now A-list, learned the truth, withdrew from acting, founded the Iris Foundation, and atoned. He died peacefully among camellias, reunited with Iris beyond death.

dramabox.title: Sculpted by Desire
dramabox.norm_title: sculpted by desire
dramabox.description: To save his sister, artist Leon endures professor Vincent’s toxic control—money, humiliation, forced art. Learning Vincent’s former student died similarly, Leon refuses to be a replacement. At the Venice Biennale, he exposes their painful truth. They confront, shatter facades, and share a passionate kiss by a sculpture symbolizing destruction and redemption.

dramabox.title: Stranger Things
dramabox.norm_title: stranger things
dramabox.description: Two years after his sister Nora vanished and his best friend died, Nate finds a perfect copy of his world—but his family are monsters in disguise. Nora, alive among them, teaches him rules. Worse, humans supply victims; Nate is marked as a "premium" offering. After escaping, hallucinations land him in a hospital. A note from Nora: "9:00 PM. The door." Is his mind making monsters—or are they using his diagnosis against him?

dramabox.title: Bleeding for Her
dramabox.norm_title: bleeding for her
dramabox.description: In NewElysium, Valerius conspires with demon Balthazar, framing Adam and Alice, killing Saint Lily. Alice becomes a six-winged avenging angel, purging corrupt clergy. Adam, an exorcist bearing seven sins, guards her with self-destructive power. Valerius turns the city against Alice. Adam's black flames shield her. With Father Benedict's truth, their fires unite to defeat Balthazar.

dramabox.title: The Butler's Gambit
dramabox.norm_title: the butler s gambit
dramabox.description: With a twenty-year blood feud burning in his heart, Lian Hale—now Ryan Cole—infiltrates the opulent Voss estate as a butler. He schemes to destroy Selan Voss from within: seducing his wife Grace, drawing dangerous fascination from daughter Elena. But Selan is suspicious, the mansion a web of traps. As buried childhood ties resurface, will Ryan's mask shatter first? And will Elena be his pawn—or the wild card that undoes everything?

dramabox.title: Bound to the Don
dramabox.norm_title: bound to the don
dramabox.description: Axel, a Russian operative, infiltrates mafia don Dante's empire via a rigged cage match. Inside, he's caught cracking a safe—his alibi, a forged love letter, ignites Dante's obsession. Axel takes a bullet for him, earning absolute trust and S-level access. But the deeper he goes, the lines between mission and something darker blur. He came to betray—not to fall.

dramabox.title: Hunter's Prey
dramabox.norm_title: hunter s prey
dramabox.description: A vampire hunter clan is slaughtered by the High Table. Sole survivor Caelus kills an elder, escapes wounded, and takes half-blood noble Aion hostage. To overthrow the corrupt council, Aion forcibly turns Caelus and keeps him as a pawn. From mutual distrust to life-and-death bond, forbidden emotions emerge. To save Caelus, Aion casts a life-sharing ritual—their fates forever bound.

dramabox.title: The Yacht Queen is a Fraud I Am the Billion-Dollar Heiress She Made Kneel
dramabox.norm_title: the yacht queen is a fraud i am the billion dollar heiress she made kneel
dramabox.description: Post-graduation, vain Brittany flaunts her so-called family yacht and sneers at ordinary Serena. The luxury vessel and rare $400,000 vintage wine actually belong to Serena’s billionaire mother. Serena finds out Brittany’s father Glenn is her stepfather, who embezzled millions to support a hidden second family. Brutally bullied and forced to kneel by Brittany, Serena gathers complete fraud evidence.

dramabox.title: Unlawful Desires
dramabox.norm_title: unlawful desires
dramabox.description: An accidental car crash kills Jacqueline, the Nichols' second daughter. Victor, their spokesperson, furious, blames Jensen family, leading to Allison's father and brother's death; her mother and herself are arrested. To vie for Wayne family's commercial land rights, Victor blackmails Allison's mother to have her replace Jacqueline, marrying Alec Wayne, Wayne's third-gen heir. As a Wayne wife, Allison forms an unexpected bond with Eric, fiancé's uncle-in-law....

dramabox.title: Betrayal Cuts Deep, Revenge Hits Hard
dramabox.norm_title: betrayal cuts deep revenge hits hard
dramabox.description: On her third wedding anniversary, Judy Gibson learns of Wayne York's betrayal from his best female friend—and first love—Maisie Quinn. She divorces Wayne and teams up with an old friend, Trevor Olson, to take them down. However, Maisie is hell-bent on destroying Judy at any cost, even if it means double-crossing Wayne. When Wayne finally learns the truth about his "true love," he can only despair over what he once had—and has now lost.

dramabox.title: Divorced at the Wedding Day
dramabox.norm_title: divorced at the wedding day
dramabox.description: Alessia DeLuca returns home after years abroad, widowed and pregnant, to attend her brother Enzo's engagement party. A misunderstanding occurs when Caroline, the bride-to-be's mother, mistakes Alessia for Enzo's mistress. Sophie, the bride, storms into Enzo's mansion and physically confronts Alessia. She drags Alessia to the engagement party, humiliating her in front of the guests. The situation escalates until Enzo arrives to reveal the truth.

dramabox.title: Unrivaled Divine Doctor
dramabox.norm_title: unrivaled divine doctor
dramabox.description: Intern doctor, Harvey York, hit rock bottom when his girlfriend betrayed him. After inheriting his family's medical and martial arts knowledge, his life began to turn around!

dramabox.title: Ultimate Food Deliveryman
dramabox.norm_title: ultimate food deliveryman
dramabox.description: He was once the revered master of the Sky Medical Palace, respected by all. Obeying the orders of his master, he pretended to be a food deliveryman and married into the Lewis family for a year. In this duration, he plowed through countless side eyes and now... His one year duration is up—it is time to turn the tables around!

dramabox.title: Henry's Imprisoned Wife
dramabox.norm_title: henry s imprisoned wife
dramabox.description: Henry Saber's wife finds herself imprisoned—literally—and tortured by his own hands, leading her to give up on their relationship and leave him. However, Henry refuses to let her go, declaring that if she chose to stay by his side, she will stay with him for the rest of her life...

dramabox.title: The Stand-In Wife: Love Meets Its Match
dramabox.norm_title: the stand in wife love meets its match
dramabox.description: A strange marital misunderstanding lands her into marrying a man in wheelchair, sweeping her up into a whirlwind of scandals of the elite as a story of love, hate and revenge unfolds between a cold CEO and a stand-in wife! Love has met its match, and their love will certainly be a turbulent one!

dramabox.title: My Stunning Boss Lady
dramabox.norm_title: my stunning boss lady
dramabox.description: Elena Graywood couldn't understand why her grandfather insisted on her marrying a man from a mountain village. Until, this man revealed to her that he was actually a divine physician with unparalleled medical skills.

dramabox.title: Expelled from Family, Awakened the God of War System
dramabox.norm_title: expelled from family awakened the god of war system
dramabox.description: Dylan Harris is the only son of the Harris family, but his weak martial talent makes him the family’s outcast. The truth? His adopted brother has been secretly draining his spiritual power with a forbidden technique. Betrayed and humiliated, Dylan awakens the powerful God of War System and walks away with the only person who never abandoned him, Mia Brooks. Together, they embark on an epic journey to become the ultimate Martial God.

dramabox.title: The Queen's Return
dramabox.norm_title: the queen s return
dramabox.description: Victoria Sterling catches her husband Richard and her son’s fiancée Chloe in bed—and in their plot to steal her fortune. Richard kills her on the spot.But she wakes up two minutes earlier. This time, she plays it cold. She plants doubt in her son Harrison’s mind, cuts off Chloe’s money, and lets Harrison walk into the betrayal himself.When Chloe fakes a pregnancy to trap both men, Victoria secretly runs a DNA test—the real father is Chloe’s underground lover.

dramabox.title: The Executive Cleaner
dramabox.norm_title: the executive cleaner
dramabox.description: Ethan infiltrates Harrington Group as a cleaner to uncover his father's ruin. CEO Sebastian sees through him—but instead of exposing him, he's drawn into Ethan's fire.Ethan's hatred burns until he learns the truth: Sebastian, at twenty, signed the devastating document under threat of murder. When Sebastian is framed and arrested, Ethan breaks into the estate, steals the coerced confession, and frees him in court.But the war isn't over.

dramabox.title: The Dragon King's True Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon king s true heiress
dramabox.description: The trueborn daughter of the Silver Dragon royal line hides her bloodline for love, only to be humiliated by her fiancé’s entire family and framed by a counterfeit Silver Dragon. She goes underground in the Black Dragons’ Great Furnace, uncovers the Dragon Hunters’ conspiracy, reveals her true identity before the whole assembly, and returns reborn at the side of the Black Dragon King — while her fiancé Darian and the villainess Delia reap what they sowed.

dramabox.title: Left by the Alpha, Loved by the Vampire
dramabox.norm_title: left by the alpha loved by the vampire
dramabox.description: Three years ago, Aria sacrificed her wolf core to save her mate Caleb, but was branded a traitor. Three years later, Aria has fallen to the bottom of the pack and humbly begs for medicine to save her pup. Blinded by lies, Caleb humiliates her again and again, even throwing a potion into a deadly pool of liquid silver and forcing her into the water. Just as Aria is tortured to the edge of death, the Progenitor Vampire finally arrives……

dramabox.title: Pregnant and Abandoned, I Left with Our Baby's Ashes
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant and abandoned i left with our baby s ashes
dramabox.description: Chloe secretly marries wealthy Mason for three years, kept hidden from his family. Eight‑months pregnant, she is publicly humiliated as a mistress at his gala, while Mason sides with Pearl, his childhood confidante. Betrayal piles up: he tears their marriage certificate, leaves her stranded in cold rain, and blames her when Pearl’s scheme costs their unborn baby’s life. Grieving, Chloe begs for her baby’s ashes, secures the divorce, and flees the city.

dramabox.title: She Stamped My Pregnant Belly—Then Begged Me for Mercy
dramabox.norm_title: she stamped my pregnant belly then begged me for mercy
dramabox.description: Nine months pregnant, ranch owner Elena is publicly humiliated by her husband's childhood sweetheart, Chloe, only to discover that Chloe and Mason have sabotaged her cold-chain records and stolen her company seal to seize her ranch. After Mason shoves her into a rack and abandons her bleeding, Elena survives an emergency delivery, gathers the evidence, and fights to protect her child, her business, and her future.

dramabox.title: Unblinded: My Girlfriend and I Slay All
dramabox.norm_title: unblinded my girlfriend and i slay all
dramabox.description: In 1920s Tijuana, blind heiress Irene regains her sight and discovers her husband Rick—a corrupt sheriff—killed her father, stole her inheritance, and imprisoned her son. She pretends to stay blind, plots revenge, and teams up with fierce street girl Rosie. They rescue Irene's son, fall in love, and eliminate Rick—but attract a bigger threat, U.S. Federal Judge Eldridge.

dramabox.title: Lunar wolf

dramabox.title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King
dramabox.norm_title: i gave birth to the strongest alpha werewolf king
dramabox.description: Aurora, a Moon Wolf she-wolf branded as one who could only bear lowly mongrels, is killed by her alpha husband Tristan. Reborn on the alliance marriage day, she is again cursed with the same prophecy. On the full moon, she enters the Fantom Bar and offers herself to the imprisoned ancient Wolf God Fenrir. After one night, Fenrir breaks free and marries her. When her wolf king is born, she shames Tristan and his new bride, rewriting fate with blood and glory.

dramabox.title: she shut down the last army
dramabox.norm_title: she shut down the last army
dramabox.description: After Queen Elara abandons Commander Ronan’s army for an untested zombie-control tower, Astra falls into chaos. Cast out and betrayed, Ronan builds a new refuge in the wasteland. When the city faces extinction, he returns to save its people—while Elara must face her mistakes and lose the man she once took for granted.

dramabox.title: The Veteran’s Promise Ⅱ
dramabox.norm_title: the veteran s promise
dramabox.description: After last season, Ridgeline Farm Supply grows into a community pillar. The Malones return, humiliating Sofia's grandfather. The brothers are dragged into war. Gunner is jailed, Connor demands sixty percent of Jack's company. Colonel Frank Morrison is hospitalized, targeted by the family he swore to protect.

dramabox.title: Don't Mess With That Fat Girl
dramabox.norm_title: don t mess with that fat girl
dramabox.description: I spent five grueling years transforming from a mocked fat girl into an upcoming international model. My global debut lands at the same hotel as my high school bullies' reunion.  Josephine, my tormentor, dug up a humiliating old video and tagged me, while classmates bet I'd never show. I replied calmly and vowed to arrive on time—and make them all pay.

dramabox.title: My Class. My Rules. My Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: my class my rules my revenge
dramabox.description: A former agent with telekinetic powers goes undercover as a high school teacher. He crushes bullies, gangs, and an underground kingpin—only to discover the mastermind behind his daughter's death is a brilliant sociopathic student. He won't just kill him; he'll trap him in a prison of public hatred and make him suffer alive.

dramabox.title: Mess With Her? Seven Five‑Star Generals Are Her Dads!
dramabox.norm_title: mess with her seven five star generals are her dads
dramabox.description: Four-year-old orphan Anna, unable to bear the abuse from her foster parents, flees to a U.S. military base with a keepsake left by her fallen father—searching for the six "dads" in his photo. These six powerful five-star generals, learning that their comrade's daughter has suffered terribly, rage into action—flattening her abusers' lair and bringing Anna home to a billion-dollar estate, where they shower her with love.

dramabox.title: The Exiled Prince's Dragon Blood
dramabox.norm_title: the exiled prince s dragon blood
dramabox.description: Theodore, the Crown Prince of Gold, is deemed a worthless loser by the entire continent for lacking beastman traits—yet no one knows that within him lies a dormant true dragon bloodline. Ten years ago, his father framed him to favor his illegitimate son and exiled him to a brutal island prison. There, the fox clan warrior Kian unlocked Theodore's bloodline seal and entrusted him with his daughter, Princess Ophelia of Veridia.

dramabox.title: 300LBS Heir's Bloody Settlement
dramabox.norm_title: 300lbs heir s bloody settlement
dramabox.description: Serena, heir to Sullivan Group, is betrayed by fiancé Cedric and best friend Lavinia—pushed off a cliff, stripped of her shares. She survives, transforms her appearance, and returns as Soren. Working from within, she outmaneuvers her enemies, secures key deals, and reclaims control. The betrayers turn on each other. Serena restores her family's legacy and finds peace with her grandmother.

dramabox.title: His Handsome Bodyguard is a Girl！
dramabox.norm_title: his handsome bodyguard is a girl
dramabox.description: L.A. heiress Tara escapes an arranged marriage, disguises as a male bodyguard Tyler, and becomes the guard of Julian King. He develops possessive feelings for "him". After an assassination, her identity is revealed. They join forces to defeat enemies and reclaim their families' power.

dramabox.title: In This Life, I’ll Make You Shut
dramabox.norm_title: in this life i ll make you shut
dramabox.description: Max, true heir to the Crowell Group, hides her identity as an intern. Her boyfriend Vincent betrays her for fake heiress Avila. In her past life, Max died in despair. Reborn, she lays a long-term trap, exposes Avila's fraud, and at the company gala, her father reveals the truth, making every betrayer pay.

dramabox.title: Unblessed Overlord
dramabox.norm_title: unblessed overlord
dramabox.description: In a world ruled by Blessings, the unblessed are nothing. Vincent Burns lost everything—his parents murdered before his eyes, his sister taken. To fight back, he underwent a forbidden ritual and became the one thing the blessed fear: an Unblessed—powerless on the outside, deadly within. From the bottom of the underworld, he rises through blood and betrayal, tearing down the tyranny of the Seraphic Court. One man, no blessing, against a system built by gods.

dramabox.title: Father as Vast as the Sea
dramabox.norm_title: father as vast as the sea
dramabox.description: Steven, a legendary godfather, lives as a fisherman to protect his daughter Sofia. Heiress Elena bullies Sofia, publicly humiliates her, and drives her to near suicide. Steven arrives just in time. When Elena's father bows to Steven, Elena realizes the man she tormented belongs to someone even her father fears.

dramabox.title: He Married My Stepsister—Now I'm His Stepmother
dramabox.norm_title: he married my stepsister now i m his stepmother
dramabox.description: After her fiancé marries her stepsister at their wedding, Sophia marries his powerful father to seek revenge. She soon discovers she is a stolen heiress and that her family's deaths were part of Victoria's conspiracy. With William by her side, Sophia reclaims her empire and finds true love.

dramabox.title: Hired as a Lucky Charm, This Cowgirl Defended My Autistic Stepson
dramabox.norm_title: hired as a lucky charm this cowgirl defended my autistic stepson
dramabox.description: Cowgirl Maddie is hired by the wealthy Ashford family as a so-called lucky charm to pay off her late father's ranch debts. She becomes Elias's nominal new wife, tasked with calming his autistic five-year-old stepson Liam. Inside the fancy Beverly Hills mansion, Maddie discovers Liam has long suffered secret abuse from hypocritical tutor Sophia, while the whole family turns a blind eye to the boy's pain.

dramabox.title: The Law God
dramabox.norm_title: the law god
dramabox.description: Lawyer Arthur Vance discovers his client Eric is the rapist who killed his daughter. He secures Eric's death sentence. Eric's father Richard frames Arthur for ruin. With assistant Amy and professor Grant's help, Arthur clears his name and fights Richard's crime syndicate. Richard's kidnapping plot fails. Richard is sentenced to life. Arthur upholds justice.

dramabox.title: I Snapped After They Stole Her Heart
dramabox.norm_title: i snapped after they stole her heart
dramabox.description: Mafia kingpin Arthur takes in Bella, the recipient of his late lover Helen's heart. He indulges her while investigating Helen's fatal car crash. Bella colludes with rivals, fakes heart distress, and blackmails Arthur for prime properties. Just as he signs them over, he learns Bella was complicit in Helen's murder—and his brutal vengeance is unleashed.

dramabox.title: Nanny's Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: nanny s revenge
dramabox.description: Claire Hayes, a wealthy heiress, was drugged, framed as insane, and nearly killed by her mother-in-law Margot and aunt Lydia. She survived with a new face, became a nanny, and returned to the Vance mansion. Her son Liam recognized her instantly. Together, they dismantled the empire from within. Claire exposed the truth—Lydia was the true mastermind. She reclaimed her company, saw her enemies jailed, and returned to her family home as herself, not as Nora or Vance.

dramabox.title: The Fallen God
dramabox.norm_title: the fallen god
dramabox.description: Sun God Solaar is betrayed by his sworn brother, loses memory, and falls to the mortal world. He is saved by a hunter and his daughter Lianna. As his power awakens, he discovers his brother seized his throne. He must hide his identity while protecting those who saved him.

dramabox.title: BOY WITH THE DRAGON PROPHECY
dramabox.norm_title: boy with the dragon prophecy
dramabox.description: After ten years, Michael returns home hiding his identity as a powerful billionaire and dragon heir. When his brother and his fiancée fall victim to a ruthless coal boss, Michael steps in, exposes the town’s corrupt enemies, and unleashes his true power to deliver justice.

dramabox.title: The Alpha's Reckoning
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha s reckoning
dramabox.description: Silver Moon princess Sera is betrayed and saved by Kane, a rival clan heir. She hides her identity for three years but is publicly rejected. She returns to her clan, purges traitors, reclaims her throne, and unites with Lyon to build a federation.

dramabox.title: He Went Home and Changed Everything
dramabox.norm_title: he went home and changed everything
dramabox.description: Ethan Stone signed a confidentiality agreement and couldn't contact his father for five years. On big day, his project succeeded and became a CEO and got engaged. He returned home to find his father humiliated in the village, beaten by his own nephews for money. Ethan rescued him and restored his dignity. He also found his mother, but she refused to recognize him for a richer marriage. Ethan revealed his true status, leaving her in regret.

dramabox.title: The Wife He Found in Two Lifetimes
dramabox.norm_title: the wife he found in two lifetimes
dramabox.description: In his past life, Logan Carter married Tessa Wells, but was deceived for sixty years until his death. Reborn on the day she faked her death, he reclaimed his shares, annulled her identity, and remarried the woman who had silently protected him all along. When Tessa returned with her driver, pretending amnesia and demanding gratitude, Logan saw through her act. He calmly settled old scores and embraced the love that spanned two lifetimes.

dramabox.title: You Chose The Wrong Baby（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: you chose the wrong baby dubbed
dramabox.description: Upon returning from the OB-GYN, Seo Eun-ha finds her husband, Kim Do-yun, tenderly massaging the pregnant belly of his first love. When Eun-ha suffers a life-threatening allergic reaction, he locks her inside and stays with the other woman, causing Eun-ha to lose her long-awaited baby. Now Do-yun's life rests in her hands. Will she save the husband who costs her everything, or will she watch him fall into ruin indifferently?

dramabox.title: The Wild Revenge of the True Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the wild revenge of the true heiress
dramabox.description: Lyra, true Blackwell heiress, was framed by adopted Celestine and abandoned in jungle. Five years later, she returns with power to communicate with animals. She exposes all plots, takes back group control, and gains a fulfilling life with sincere tycoon Silas.

dramabox.title: My Contract Husband Is A Dragon
dramabox.norm_title: my contract husband is a dragon
dramabox.description: Seamstress Sera catches her fiancé cheating. She seduces Duke Alexander Drake that night. He gives her a marriage contract—she gains power to crush her betrayers, he wants her body. But Alex is the last black dragon, and her kiss cures his unstable power. Their one-year deal becomes far more.

dramabox.title: From exile to emperor
dramabox.norm_title: from exile to emperor
dramabox.description: Emperor Alexander crushes the Five-Nation Alliance at the Linde River. On his return, Henry betrays him, surrenders the capital, and Isabel seizes the throne. Alexander is exiled. But the Alliance breaks every promise—confiscating lands, violating Henry's wife, imprisoning his daughter, and firing on civilians. The streets that cheered their "saviors" now echo only with screams of grief. Alexander watches from exile, waiting...

dramabox.title: Reborn: I Shatter False Moonlight
dramabox.norm_title: reborn i shatter false moonlight
dramabox.description: Top heir Jack pours everything into making Cinderella Monica an Oscar winner—but she betrays and kills him with William on award night. Jack is reborn with vengeance. Monica returns with past memories too. This time, Jack sees through her lies, teams with his true savior Jenny, exposes Monica's schemes, reclaims everything, and makes the traitors pay. He and Jenny find love and success together.

dramabox.title: The Vengeance of Her
dramabox.norm_title: the vengeance of her
dramabox.description: Elena's daughter dies from illegal drug trials run by CEO Vera. Elena gets herself imprisoned to reach Vera, who runs the prison's top tier. She fights through layers, exposes the drug conspiracy, and avenges her daughter.

dramabox.title: when love is gone
dramabox.norm_title: when love is gone
dramabox.description: Firefighter Ethan catches wife Chloe cheating with Christian—her first love and her sister Mia's fiancé. He was just a substitute. At the wedding, Ethan exposes the affair. Mia calls it off. Both lose everything. Ethan rises to CEO. Chloe begs forgiveness, refused. Three years later, Mia confesses. Ethan and Mia find happiness.

dramabox.title: Serpent City: Patient Zero
dramabox.norm_title: serpent city patient zero
dramabox.description: Framed by a medical giant, ex-journalist Marcus tracks a fungus-mutant snake outbreak to a Cold War bioweapon project. He teams with biologist Nami and defected agents, destroys underground labs, kills the alpha serpent, and arrests his brother Victor, restoring peace.

dramabox.title: I'm the Hated Heir Four Men Can't Resist
dramabox.norm_title: i m the hated heir four men can t resist
dramabox.description: Three years after a near-fatal ice-lake accident, Adrian returns branded a murderer. Four men—possessive Lucien, jealous Ronan, restrained Sebastian, and watchful Elias—are pulled back into his orbit. Desire and suspicion collide. Adrian follows clues to the real architect of the disaster, but a fresh act of sabotage proves the danger is not over.

dramabox.title: After Their Betrayal, l Became Whole
dramabox.norm_title: after their betrayal l became whole
dramabox.description: Betrayed by the four adoptive brothers she loved most, framed by the scheming Lina, and burned alive at the Flame Tribunal—Aelia wakes to a second chance at life. This time, she owes them nothing. Armed with memories of her past, she rises at Academy and wins the devotion of Theodore, the empire's most powerful knight. As Lina's lies unravel and her brothers crawl back in regret, Aelia delivers the reckoning they earned—and finally becomes whole.

dramabox.title: The White Wolf Queen'S Loyal Lycans
dramabox.norm_title: the white wolf queen s loyal lycans
dramabox.description: Selena, the prophesied White Wolf Queen, is betrayed by her fiancé and twin sister, who push her off a cliff. She survives, awakens three Lycan Kings sealed for centuries, and returns for revenge with her loyal mates.

dramabox.title: Tit for Tat
dramabox.norm_title: tit for tat
dramabox.description: Hugo's wife Sophie is about to give birth. On the way to the hospital, they are forced off the road by wealthy brats. Hugo endures humiliation to protect her. But the brats have just brought ruin upon their own family, the Westons.

dramabox.title: Her Name Was Nora
dramabox.norm_title: her name was nora
dramabox.description: 18-year-old Nora is murdered by Grace. Her ghost haunts the estate, watching her parents believe Grace's lies. Evidence slowly accumulates, exposing Grace's plan and Wade's execution of the murder.

dramabox.title: The Double Life of My Fiancee
dramabox.norm_title: the double life of my fiancee
dramabox.description: Vivian, an unloved heiress, is humiliated in an arranged match. Her stepsister steals her mother's dance studio. She decides to take revenge by pursuing Ethan—who has secretly loved her for ten years. Their mutual schemes spark real feelings amid a brewing family war.

dramabox.title: Make my cheating husband pay the price
dramabox.norm_title: make my cheating husband pay the price
dramabox.description: Pregnant Catherine catches husband Jesse cheating with Mia. They assault her and her disabled father-in-law. Business tycoon John Morgan rescues her. Catherine gathers evidence, sends Jesse and Mia to prison, and later accepts John's proposal.

dramabox.title: Kidnapped by My Enemy
dramabox.norm_title: kidnapped by my enemy
dramabox.description: On the night before her wedding, Elena is kidnapped by Luca, her fiancé's enemy. She discovers she was never a bride but a sacrificial pawn to be killed within 30 days. Her family wants her dead. With nowhere else to go, she flees with Luca, fights to survive, and reclaims her identity.

dramabox.title: When the Pawn Strikes
dramabox.norm_title: when the pawn strikes
dramabox.description: On the eve of disembarking, Evan Redd loses everything in a fixed bet orchestrated by his co-workers. That money was for his wife Claire Voss's father, her hospital delivery, and their newborn. Claire, pregnant, joins the gamble to recover the loss, but the plotters escalate, aiming for total destruction. Finally, Claire drops her pretense and strikes back with full force.

dramabox.title: Seven Cursed Relics Before Time Runs Out
dramabox.norm_title: seven cursed relics before time runs out
dramabox.description: After inheriting Crown Loft, Ethan Stone discovers his grandfather's chilling rule: collect seven cursed relics within a year or face a deadly fate. As he investigates a cursed bronze lamp tied to a family massacre, he joins forces with Mia Ward, who senses cursed objects, rare-book restorer Claire Sloan, and Riley Grant, whose father once served Ethan's grandfather. Together, they uncover Umbral Hall—and the truth behind his grandfather's disappearance.

dramabox.title: Apocalypse I Synthesized My Zombie Sister into a Queen
dramabox.norm_title: apocalypse i synthesized my zombie sister into a queen
dramabox.description: Three years after a mysterious purple fog turns half of humanity into zombies, survivor Jack awakens a powerful Zombie Synthesis System. When he discovers that his beloved younger sister Mia has also been infected, he refuses to kill her and instead vows to evolve her until she regains her memories.

dramabox.title: Crown of Starfire
dramabox.norm_title: crown of starfire
dramabox.description: Noah Sterling, the Sterling clan's prodigy, awakened a Black Gold Core at thirteen. But a fire drained it, making him a "Dead Core" outcast. At his awakening test, his fiancée rejected him, his cousin crushed his pride, and he lost inheritance. Then his mother's ring awakened; Orion revealed half his core was stolen—the rest sealed the Eclipse Flame, a city-destroying blaze. Using that fire, Noah reforged his body, made elixirs, broke arrays, slew enemies.

dramabox.title: The Duchess They Cast Away
dramabox.norm_title: the duchess they cast away
dramabox.description: Commoner-born Eleanor protects her duke husband Adrian, but he misjudges and abandons her. She leaves. He discovers she was his masked savior and a lost imperial heir. As a rebellion threatens, he sacrifices everything to protect her—seeking not her love, but forgiveness.

dramabox.title: After Ragnarok, Thor Became a Dad
dramabox.norm_title: after ragnarok thor became a dad
dramabox.description: After dying in Ragnarok, Thor's soul inhabits a mortal gambler, living with his wife Elena and daughter Mia who has leukemia. Mia's blood attracts demons. Thor recovers Odin's thunder, allies with others, defeats Mammon, cures Mia, and restores peace.

dramabox.title: The Alpha King's Half-Blood Twins
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha king s half blood twins
dramabox.description: Anne, a human, falls for Lycan King Fenrir, bearing half-blood twins. Exiled by prejudice and Mara's schemes. Five years later, the twins' wolf blood awakens, dragging the family back into power struggles and deadly pursuits. Fenrir uncovers the truth of the past, protects his family, and takes revenge on the real mastermind.

dramabox.title: Fated To The Lycan King
dramabox.norm_title: fated to the lycan king
dramabox.description: Leila witnesses her parents' murder by the Wolf King Colt, her fated mate. She learns her father was innocent, and Colt hates pure-blood supremacy. The true mastermind is his half-sister Snell. Leila kills Snell, and Colt gives up the throne for love.

dramabox.title: My Husband's Secret Wife
dramabox.norm_title: my husband s secret wife
dramabox.description: On our third wedding anniversary, a livestream catches my husband lying in bed, gently kissing another woman—then I discover she has a marriage certificate with his name on it, dated the exact same day as mine. For three years, Trevor controlled, humiliated, and lied to me. When his betrayal costs me my baby and my mother, I stop begging for answers. I start collecting evidence. He thought I was powerless. Now I’m going to destroy everything he built.

dramabox.title: Bloodbound: Vampire Cop
dramabox.norm_title: bloodbound vampire cop
dramabox.description: Cop Arthur is executed by a gang who kill his pregnant wife. A red bat bites him—he rises as a vampire. Seeking revenge on boss Omi, Arthur clashes with him. Omi gets silver dust, a silver gun, and holy water from a Black Witch. Arthur nearly dies but is saved by Officer Rosa—granddaughter of a White Witch and a werewolf. With Rosa's help, Arthur kills Omi. Omi reveals the real mastermind: mad scientist Lucio, an artificial vampire who wants a world full of vampires.

dramabox.title: The Call That Never Connected
dramabox.norm_title: the call that never connected
dramabox.description: To satisfy his Wall Street fiancee's class pride, Leo misses 99 desperate calls before his father's death. When he learns he once drove past and chased away his own father's funeral procession, he turns into a cold avenger and destroys a century-old financial dynasty at his own wedding.

dramabox.title: Stand Down! She's a Secret General
dramabox.norm_title: stand down she s a secret general
dramabox.description: When Jane Kaybar, a legendary billionaire and national hero known as the Iron General, discovers veterans are being abused at the care home she founded, she disguises herself as a nurse and goes undercover. As she exposes the corrupt staff exploiting the veterans, she draws the true villains into the open—and systematically takes them down one by one.

dramabox.title: The Queen of the Underworld s Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: the queen of the underworld s revenge
dramabox.description: Hela, betrayed by Loki, is reborn with Freya's help. She exposes Loki's lies, teams with exiled warrior Kyle, and manipulates enemies. They awaken Freya, forge a god-slaying blade, and defeat the fire giant, ending Ragnarok and ruling Helheim together.

dramabox.title: Queen of Curse Breaking
dramabox.norm_title: queen of curse breaking
dramabox.description: Witch Ryan discovers she is the swapped heiress of the Summers family. She goes to Manhattan, saves her sister-in-law, and heals Lucas, a Sterling heir cursed. They are soulmates. With her skills, she exposes schemes and reclaims her place.

dramabox.title: Project Zero Awakens
dramabox.norm_title: project zero awakens
dramabox.description: Genesis Tech has spent years conducting illegal experiments to create the ultimate human weapon. Zero, its most successful subject, escapes during the final trial, forcing the company to destroy the entire island facility. Three years later, he is rescued by sisters Amy and Emil. As his memories return, Zero begins a deadly hunt for his creators—while the leaked experimental serum threatens to unleash a far greater disaster...

dramabox.title: My Husband Sold Me for a Dollar, I Was the Auctioneer
dramabox.norm_title: my husband sold me for a dollar i was the auctioneer
dramabox.description: After her husband auctions her for one dollar to please his first love, pregnant Wall Street genius Evelyn Carter reveals her hidden identity as the legendary auctioneer Nightingale. Rescued by billionaire heir Julian Hawthorne, she exposes their lies, reclaims her fortune and career, and begins a new life.

dramabox.title: The Bastard Princess and the Doomsday Dragon
dramabox.norm_title: the bastard princess and the doomsday dragon
dramabox.description: Lyra, a hidden bastard princess, is sent as a sacrificial bride to awaken the doomsday dragon. The dragon bows to her. She allies with commander Kael, frees slaves, and builds an army. She joins forces with her sister to abolish slavery and burn the dragon-bone throne, becoming the first Ash Queen.

dramabox.title: Swapped to a Prisoner, Married to Hades
dramabox.norm_title: swapped to a prisoner married to hades
dramabox.description: Betrayed and sacrificed, Moira is reborn. She lets her stepsister take the war hero and instead marries a blind prisoner—actually Hades. She forms a bond with him, gains power to judge souls, and discovers the sacrificial system is a divine conspiracy. She becomes Queen of the Underworld and marches on Olympus.

dramabox.title: My Sister Took the Prince, So I Married Apollo
dramabox.norm_title: my sister took the prince so i married apollo
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her family and husband, Elena is reborn on her wedding day. She lets her stepsister take the prince and marries a poor poet—secretly the deposed Sun God Apollo. Together, they break a sacrificial cycle, overthrow a usurper god, and rise as rulers of both mortal and divine realms.

dramabox.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: The Heiress Mom
dramabox.norm_title: hidden in plain sight the heiress mom
dramabox.description: Kathleen DuPont, heiress to the world’s richest family, hides her identity to marry Jerry Byers for love. She raises their son, Brian, into a famous child prodigy, only for father and son to humiliate her. After the divorce, Kathleen joins forces with David Dell, makes them pay for their betrayal, and builds a powerful new life at his side.

dramabox.title: The Champion She Buried
dramabox.norm_title: the champion she buried
dramabox.description: Five years ago, world champion Adrian took a doping charge to save his son and wife's company. He went to prison while his coach seized the league. Released, he uncovers a drug program targeting young athletes. He must fight his drugged son, bring him back, and defeat the coach together, rebuilding his family on truth.

dramabox.title: Bloodbound Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: bloodbound heiress
dramabox.description: Selena Lunaris, exiled for ten years, awakens the supreme Royal Alpha bloodline. She returns to find her mother stripped of power and tormented. Her father and his mistress have usurped the throne. With the Moonstone Pendant and her awakened power, she exposes lies, punishes traitors, and reclaims her rightful throne.

dramabox.title: He Took Our Daughter's Womb to Save His Bastard Son
dramabox.norm_title: he took our daughter s womb to save his bastard son
dramabox.description: When my seven-year-old daughter Eva was rushed to the ICU, my husband Damian threw a lavish birthday party for Leo, his illegitimate child with his widowed sister-in-law Evelyn. The ballroom sparkled with champagne and a nine-tier cake as guests celebrated Leo, while Eva bled on an operating table—Damian had authorized removing her uterus, doctors claiming her blood would sustain Leo.

dramabox.title: Ranch of Lust
dramabox.norm_title: ranch of lust
dramabox.description: Trapped in a toxic marriage, ranch heiress Evelyn's desires ignite with young farmhand Luke. Their forbidden affair is a trap—husband Arthur blackmailed Luke to frame her for infidelity and steal her estate. But Luke betrays his employers, captivated by Evelyn. Empowered by lust and vengeance, Evelyn crushes the conspiracy, sends Arthur to prison, and seizes her power. A tale of betrayal, forbidden passion, and ruthless revenge.

dramabox.title: The Forsaken Prince: Dragon Slayer's Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: the forsaken prince dragon slayer s revenge
dramabox.description: Framed by his stepmother and cast off a cliff, Kieran, Camellia's eldest prince, awakens unrivaled Dragon Slayer power. When he returns and slays a dragon attacking the kingdom, the credit is stolen by Prince Cassian. Kieran watches coldly as Seraphina and Cassian throw a grand victory feast, drawing a horde of dragons to Camellia. His revenge begins.

dramabox.title: Rose of Seoul: Revenge Reborn
dramabox.norm_title: rose of seoul revenge reborn
dramabox.description: In her past life, obese Jung Soo-min was bullied and killed by chaebol heiress Kang Yu-jin. Reborn as orphan Han So-eun, she binds a heart-value system. She uses her voice to work at a high-end club, seduces four men connected to Kang, transforms her appearance, exposes Kang's crimes, and destroys her alliance. She eventually lets go of hatred and finds redemption with those she saved.

dramabox.title: The Husband Who Let Her Fall
dramabox.norm_title: the husband who let her fall
dramabox.description: Tech genius Nathan marries Ivy and funds her world, but she trusts her ex, a con artist, and humiliates Nathan. When she damages priceless artifacts and signs an unpayable contract, Nathan freezes all accounts and walks away. When his hidden empire is revealed, she is left with nothing—can she win him back?

dramabox.title: Bloodline Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: bloodline betrayal
dramabox.description: Elias, a top vampire hunter, rescues Caleb as a brother. But Caleb is a pureblood vampire prince who has searched for Elias for centuries. He manipulates Elias, eliminates everyone close to him, and finally turns Elias into a vampire, imprisoning him. When Elias stabs him with a holy nail, Caleb sacrifices himself to lift the curse. Years later, a boy identical to Caleb appears, starting the cycle again.

dramabox.title: The Fae Wife Who Made Them Kneel
dramabox.norm_title: the fae wife who made them kneel
dramabox.description: Seraphina was mocked as a powerless, infertile wife while her husband betrayed her with his magic mistress. They thought they could discard her. She is the last heir of the Elder Bone bloodline. She shattered her disguise, unleashed her magic, cut off their funds, left her cheating husband in ruins, and reclaimed her empire.

dramabox.title: Carrying The Alpha's Triplet Pups
dramabox.norm_title: carrying the alpha s triplet pups
dramabox.description: Alpha Christian was saved by Emma as a child. Years later, he attacked her pack and caught her escaping a forced marriage. She mistook him for a Beta, shared an intimate night, and later discovered she was pregnant with his triplets. He rescued her, declared her Luna. She passed three trials and earned the goddess's blessing. Their triplets were born safely and they lived happily.

dramabox.title: Shattered Covenant
dramabox.norm_title: shattered covenant
dramabox.description: Grala, bearer of the ancient Holy Light origin, rescued the abyssal demon Lucius but was imprisoned by him via a soul contract. Pregnant with his child, she was persecuted by the angel Miloda, her child died, and she was disfigured. In desperation, she awakens her Holy Light power, breaks the contract, takes revenge, casts her enemies into the abyss, traps Lucius in an illusion, and leaves to seek a new life.

dramabox.title: When I Meet Another Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: when i meet another alpha
dramabox.description: Ten years ago, Sophia begged Liam to stay. He said she'd crawl back. She never did. Now she rules every pack in the South, while that Alpha who ignored her has been waiting alone for ten years.

dramabox.title: The Mermaid Queen’s Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: the mermaid queen s revenge
dramabox.description: The East Sea Princess, who can heal all, is betrayed by her fiancé and half-brother. She is stripped of her golden scales and joins the Land King, becoming human by giving up her heart. She leads an attack on the sea to make her betrayers regret.

dramabox.title: Mistaken for My Brother-in-law's Sex Doll
dramabox.norm_title: mistaken for my brother in law s sex doll
dramabox.description: Lucy, a pawn in an arranged marriage, is betrayed by her husband and stepsister. One night, mafia boss Ethan mistakes her for a sex doll. Under his cold domination, she awakens. She decides to become his perfect toy and use him to destroy everyone who betrayed her.

dramabox.title: The Counterattack of the Fat Wife Queen
dramabox.norm_title: the counterattack of the fat wife queen
dramabox.description: A modern med student transmigrated into obese Queen Theresa, killed by white lotus Lia. In the cold palace, she used a cross-time device to buy modern goods, lost 50kg, and saved the king with surgery. She crushed Lia, the dowager, and traitorous nobles with tech weapons, exposed conspiracies, then left palace life to travel with the king and find freedom.

dramabox.title: From Abandoned Wife to the Dragon King's Pampered Mate
dramabox.norm_title: from abandoned wife to the dragon king s pampered mate
dramabox.description: I caught my husband in bed with his mistress—and instead of apologizing, he threw a vibrator at my face and called me "trash". After seven years of sacrificing everything for Silas, I was dragged out of my own home and abandoned in the freezing rain by the man I loved and the woman who stole him from me. Broken and desperate to save my dying mother, I accepted a nanny job. I never expected my new employer to be Dorian Ashford—the terrifying Dragon King.

dramabox.title: Crushing My Unfaithful Wife
dramabox.norm_title: crushing my unfaithful wife
dramabox.description: Lucas finds his wife Lynn gave his custom supercar to her lover. He is humiliated at his father-in-law's party. He gathers evidence of her affair and asset transfers, reveals his true financial power, and divorces her, reclaiming everything.

dramabox.title: You Can Steal My Cure, Not My Gift
dramabox.norm_title: you can steal my cure not my gift
dramabox.description: Evelyn, heir to the Holy Healing Institute, is reborn to stop her foster sister from stealing her remedies. She sets traps, exposes the impostor, and during a plague, she saves the poor with cheap medicine, finally revealing her sacred seal and reclaiming her life.

dramabox.title: Accused of Killing the King, Chosen by Two Dragons
dramabox.norm_title: accused of killing the king chosen by two dragons
dramabox.description: The emperor dies after drinking poison from Mariela. Accused of regicide, she is sentenced to burn. Two royal dragons descend and bow to her unborn child. To protect her heir and find the true killer, she travels to seven cities and ultimately claims the throne.

dramabox.title: The Heiress's Mannequin Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: the heiress s mannequin revenge
dramabox.description: Heiress Mia, drugged and imprisoned by her husband and mistress, awakened Oriana—a century-old witch sealed in a mannequin. They pacted: Mia used dark magic to sew the betrayers into wig models, sealed in mini cases. But this was just the start. On a steam train to the colony, the mannequin's eyes glowed gold—what next: a token, or deeper despair?

dramabox.title: The Gold-Digging Queen's Guillotine
dramabox.norm_title: the gold digging queen s guillotine
dramabox.description: Princess Isabella returns to the capital with a plague remedy for her father King Arthur. His fiancée Margaret humiliates her, burns her mother's portrait, and tries to burn her alive. King Arthur arrives in time, learns the truth, and saves her.

dramabox.title: The Quarterback's Ransom
dramabox.norm_title: the quarterback s ransom
dramabox.description: After five years apart because of a doctor's conspiracy, a football superstar and his lost lover reunite to expose the truth, reclaim their love, and fight for the championship.

dramabox.title: Buried by My Bride, Back as the Racing King
dramabox.norm_title: buried by my bride back as the racing king
dramabox.description: Racer Caleb is betrayed by his fiancée and partner, who send his car off a cliff. He disappears. Five years later, he returns as a tow-truck driver, joins Sofia's failing team, and races to reclaim his legacy and expose the conspiracy.

dramabox.title: The Blood Pact Hunter
dramabox.norm_title: the blood pact hunter
dramabox.description: At her Bloodline Awakening, Luna is found to have "no bloodline" and is humiliated. Her teacher reveals she carries a Twin-God bloodline sealed by enemies. After her teacher's death, she awakens it, returns for revenge, and defeats the Norse gods, slaying Odin before being saved by the World Tree.

dramabox.title: Broken Vow, Rising Wolf
dramabox.norm_title: broken vow rising wolf
dramabox.description: Lyra Vane, the last Alpha of Mooncrest Pack, buried her power and lived as a wolfless Omega after her mate Damien betrayed her. When she picks up her blade for revenge, her true mate Lucian, Alpha of Icefang Pack, arrives.

dramabox.title: Scheming Maid' s Taming Game
dramabox.norm_title: scheming maid s taming game
dramabox.description: Orphan Serenna's boyfriend is killed by heiress Arianna. She infiltrates the Moretti estate as a maid to seek revenge. Three Moretti brothers—Damon, Roman, and Luca—are drawn to her, but her enemy is their blood. Revenge and desire intertwine.

dramabox.title: I Chose The Monster In The Hollow
dramabox.norm_title: i chose the monster in the hollow
dramabox.description: Lyanna is executed when her newborn bears no sigil. Reborn, she awakens First Blood as High Queen but must bind within days or die. Rejected by all, she enters the Hollow, meets Rowan, survives trials, and forms a true bond. She returns to find Veronica has stolen her crown. Grayson abandons her, but Rowan saves her. They defeat traitors, and she declares no one kneels. They have children, but Rowan dreams of another marked woman, hinting deeper secrets.

dramabox.title: Displaced War God
dramabox.norm_title: displaced war god
dramabox.description: Kevin, a former ace pilot, retires after his squad is wiped out. When aliens return, he is mocked and sentenced to death. His mech awakens, saves him, and he returns to battle as the War God.

dramabox.title: Blazing Track:DawnLight
dramabox.norm_title: blazing track dawnlight
dramabox.description: Genius mechanic Leo is framed by his lover and a rival, serving seven years in prison. He returns to find his dream shop stolen and his foster father's ashes used as leverage. He partners with Harris Autosports, designs cars with hidden flaws that destroy his enemies' empire. He wins the championship, sends enemies to prison, and becomes a top designer and partner, winning both career and love.

dramabox.title: Revenge Of The Potions
dramabox.norm_title: revenge of the potions
dramabox.description: Selene, a witch from the witch-hunting era, encounters Lucia's soul and vows revenge after Lucia's death. In seeking revenge, she saves four kings of vampires, werewolves, dragons, and mermaids. They all fight to warm her bed.

dramabox.title: The Cursed Alpha and His Virgin Groom
dramabox.norm_title: the cursed alpha and his virgin groom
dramabox.description: Cursed by the Moon Goddess, Alpha Arthur must find his fated mate with the Moon Mark before 30. He searches for years, believing his mate must be a woman. After a car accident, he meets a young man and discovers the mark on him. Desperate to survive, he forces the young man to stay. Their obsession and resistance slowly turn into a love written by fate.

dramabox.title: Fate Bond：he True Drogon's Mermaid Love Prison
dramabox.norm_title: fate bond he true drogon s mermaid love prison
dramabox.description: Joshua and Draven share a blood feud over their fathers' deaths, yet they are fated Sentinels and Guides. A conspiracy by the Merman King and Wolf King framed the dragon clan. They uncover the truth, gradually put aside hatred, join forces to expose the scheme, and from forced bonds and torture, they heal each other and become soulmates.

dramabox.title: The Day I Quit, Their Company Collapsed（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the day i quit their company collapsed dubbed
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole was the one holding the company together — until his work was stolen and he was deliberately pushed aside. Claire Grant saw everything but chose to stay silent. Humiliated and fed up, Ethan quit. The moment he left, everything fell apart. Their biggest client demands him by name. Now the company is in chaos, and the people who once ignored him are desperate to find him.

dramabox.title: Banished Prince, Builder of an Empire（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: banished prince builder of an empire dubbed
dramabox.description: After dying from overwork, Adrian Vale wakes up as a crown prince in a hostile court. Betrayed and cast out, he chooses exile over humiliation — refusing to break his promise to Riley Mercer. In a land others abandoned, Adrian uses modern knowledge to rebuild, protect his people, and rise against those who wronged him. From exile to power, he carves his own path to glory.

dramabox.title: Spent My Boss’s $3 Million on Six Hot Male Stripper
dramabox.norm_title: spent my boss s 3 million on six hot male stripper
dramabox.description: Evelyn, a middle-aged accountant who had kept the books for her company for twelve years, was framed by her boss Victor for three million in dirty money and kicked out by her husband Mark. She didn't cry. Instead, she took that money and bought out the city's hottest male model club—transforming herself from a doormat everyone stepped on into a full-fledged queenpin.

dramabox.title: Wolf Foster
dramabox.norm_title: wolf foster
dramabox.description: Ruby is a colorful puppy who falls into a wolf den and is adopted by wolf queen Akalia as her daughter. In a world where werewolves remain in animal form until age 18, Ruby grows up with loving siblings. On her coming-of-age day, she is kidnapped by the wizard Hugo. She learns her true identity: she is Akalia's biological daughter, stolen at birth and accidentally transformed into a dog by a potion. After becoming human, she fights alongside her mother and allies against dark

dramabox.title: Wild Lord I Bit a Kobold Chief to Death
dramabox.norm_title: wild lord i bit a kobold chief to death
dramabox.description: A modern soul transmigrates to medieval militia captain Leon. He leads refugees, trades with kobolds, saves elf druid Freya, and allies with tribes. They defeat boar-men, train troops, and resist noble invaders. Humans, kobolds, and tribes unite to build a peaceful homeland.

dramabox.title: Taken by the Dragon King
dramabox.norm_title: taken by the dragon king
dramabox.description: On her wedding day, Grace is kidnapped by a dragon and declared his destined bride. The Dragon King gives her one month to fall in love. Jealous Ava tries to kill her, but Grace is the true queen the dragon race has awaited.

dramabox.title: My Father Is the Ashen Lord
dramabox.norm_title: my father is the ashen lord
dramabox.description: Fourteen years ago, Aldar, the legendary mage known as the "Lord of Ashes," single-handedly drove back a dragon—but at the king's victory feast, he stole the royal Life Gem to save his newborn daughter Erin, who was cursed to die. He then vanished into obscurity, becoming a powerless janitor at a magic academy, enduring fourteen years of humiliation and abuse just to keep his daughter safe.

dramabox.title: Boxing Queen Takes Back Her Manor
dramabox.norm_title: boxing queen takes back her manor
dramabox.description: Nova was a boxing champion who controlled her emotions with medication. When squatters took over her father's home and crossed the line, she unleashed the suppressed fighter within.

dramabox.title: The Lost Dessert Queen is Back！
dramabox.norm_title: the lost dessert queen is back
dramabox.description: Pastry champion Lila was framed by her friend Vanessa and disappeared, while her boyfriend Ethan believed she abandoned love. Four years later, she works as an oven girl under a false name. Vanessa kidnaps her daughter to force a confession, but Lila exposes Vanessa's years of lies in front of cameras.

dramabox.title: Little Red Hood: Return of the Wolf Princess Ⅱ
dramabox.norm_title: little red hood return of the wolf princess
dramabox.description: Orphan Ruby, born without a wolf, carries the rare Little Red Hood bloodline. She escapes abuse and is adopted by the Fire Wolf King. She uses her powers to heal and break curses. But when Abigail arrives with Ruby's stolen amulet, claiming to be the lost princess, Ruby must face the challenge.

dramabox.title: My ex-husband became a dog
dramabox.norm_title: my ex husband became a dog
dramabox.description: Andrew, the CEO who deceived Claire, breaks his oath and turns into a hideous dog, helplessly watching Claire, the Code Queen, reclaim her peak.

dramabox.title: The Godmother Returns，All Kneel in Punishment！
dramabox.norm_title: the godmother returns all kneel in punishment
dramabox.description: Vivian, the ruthless Godmother, returns after three years with a cure for her daughter. Her husband, nanny, and daughter's fiancé have abused her daughter into madness. She attends a banquet to reclaim her identity and make all wrongdoers pay.

dramabox.title: The Warlord of North Border
dramabox.norm_title: the warlord of north border
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, House Varel was annihilated. Wounded Kaelen was sent to the Northlands. Over seven years, he rose to become the legendary Northlands Holy Knight Commander, granted the title of Supreme Commander. Regaining his memories, Kaelen returns to Lorraine Capital with the ancient holy relic Thunder Anvil of Judgment—to claim blood debt from traitorous foster daughter Selena, corrupt nobles, the Holy Light Church, and the幕后 Supreme Magic Council.

dramabox.title: Abandoned by the Duke, I'm the Divine Seraph
dramabox.norm_title: abandoned by the duke i m the divine seraph
dramabox.description: After a contest with Pope Pari, Percy wins approval but declines the papacy to search for his origins. He rescues his sister and reaches the Cohen family, which is invaded by the Ross family. He defeats the invaders, encounters the fallen mage Cru, and later faces the transformed evil dragon Fiona. He awakens the Sun God's blessing, heals Mia, and defeats Fiona. He refuses the papacy again to hunt Cru.

dramabox.title: 100 Days Captive
dramabox.norm_title: 100 days captive
dramabox.description: Dr. Nora is kidnapped during her honeymoon by mafia don Kane, whom she saved five years ago. He makes a bet: she must fall in love with him in 100 days. She resists but discovers her husband betrays her. She plays along while seeking escape, but every attempt is within Kane's control.

dramabox.title: The Wife He Regretted Losing
dramabox.norm_title: the wife he regretted losing
dramabox.description: Adeline hides her identity to marry Ethan for six years, but he mistreats her. When their daughter is attacked, Ethan takes the last blood bag to save his first love's son. Mother and daughter leave, Adeline returns to her family, rebuilds her career, and finds love with Grayson. Ethan regrets but it's too late.

dramabox.title: My Groom & Stepmom Cheated, I Made Them Famous
dramabox.norm_title: my groom stepmom cheated i made them famous
dramabox.description: On her seventh wedding day, Amelia catches her husband Ethan and stepmother Natalie cheating. They frame her, and her family takes their side. She falls to her death, but is reborn. She swaps birth control with laxatives, locks them in, and livestreams their public humiliation.

dramabox.title: Reborn With My Son, We Rewrite Our Fate
dramabox.norm_title: reborn with my son we rewrite our fate
dramabox.description: After being betrayed and forced out by her ex-husband Ryan Carter and his mistress, Claire Lane gets a second chance at life with her son, who carries memories from his past life. After saving a billionaire, she gains the protection of his family.
