Determined to rebuild her life, Claire returns to her dream of attending a top university while gathering evidence against Ryan and his mistress.

dramabox.title: Reborn，I Choose That Omega
dramabox.norm_title: reborn i choose that omega
dramabox.description: Ava, heir to rare white wolf blood, was killed by her half-sister Chloe and lover Blake in her past life. Reborn on the mate-selection ritual, she abandons the deceitful Blake and chooses imprisoned primordial werewolf Ron. They expose the Alpha’s genocide crime, abolish cruel slavery laws, defeat villains and build an equal new pack.

dramabox.title: Your Unwanted Bride Is A Queen Now
dramabox.norm_title: your unwanted bride is a queen now
dramabox.description: After ten years devoted to Prince Orion, Princess Livia is cast aside for his scheming childhood sweetheart. Done begging for love, she volunteers to marry Kaine, the feared ruler of the frozen Northmarch. But the "barbarian" king gives her something Orion never did—respect, power, and a place beside him. Now Orion wants her back. Too bad Livia is no longer his forgotten fiancée—she's a queen.

dramabox.title: The Ex-Wife’s Regret: My Secret Legend Husband
dramabox.norm_title: the ex wife s regret my secret legend husband
dramabox.description: Space hero Ryan retires for love, playing house-husband for three years—only to be scorned and betrayed by his wife Vanessa. Heartbroken, he reclaims his identity for a top-secret space mission and makes a stunning comeback. When Vanessa regrets and chases him, Ryan has already found true love with Selina, an admiral's daughter. Those who trampled his dignity will pay.

dramabox.title: Crushing on My Nemesis
dramabox.norm_title: crushing on my nemesis
dramabox.description: After a $500 bet ruins her relationship, timid Eleanor sleeps with a stranger. He transfers to her class the next day—an Olympic gold medalist and the boy whose life she ruined by reporting him in childhood.

dramabox.title: Swapped Brides, Divided Destinies
dramabox.norm_title: swapped brides divided destinies
dramabox.description: A marriage swap sends two noblewomen down completely different paths. Claire Stone marries Lucas Hale and rises through courage and wisdom, helping him bring peace to the kingdom while building a legacy of her own. Meanwhile, Tessa Stone is reborn consumed by revenge, placing her fate in the hands of Ethan Pierce and another prince. As one woman earns glory through independence and the other falls through obsession, their choices reshape the future of an empire.

dramabox.title: Every Life Debt Comes Due
dramabox.norm_title: every life debt comes due
dramabox.description: Ten years after his grandfather's mysterious disappearance, Adrian Graves arrives blindfolded with a ledger that records every debt of fate. Armed with a judgment brush and bound by unbreakable rules, he hunts down those who stole lives, power, and destiny. As each old debt is collected, a far greater conspiracy hidden within the imperial capital begins to unfold, forcing Adrian into a final reckoning.

dramabox.title: Betrayed, He Unleashed His Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: betrayed he unleashed his fortune
dramabox.description: Ethan Hayes hides his billionaire heir identity and marries Sofia Stark as an ordinary employee. For three years, he pays her generous monthly living costs, yet only gets endless schemes. Manipulated by her best friend Chloe, Sofia greedily demands his money, forges debts, and frames him for cheating to leave him bankrupt. Crushed by betrayal, Ethan finally fights back. He exposes his true status and dominates his foes with wealth and power.

dramabox.title: SSS-Rank:The Slum-Born Thunder God
dramabox.norm_title: sss rank the slum born thunder god
dramabox.description: Nate Ryder is believed by everyone to be a failed awakener, but in truth, he has awakened the world's top SSS-level Thunder God talent. Born into a poor family—his father a mechanic who sold his blood to afford a serum and his mother bedridden for years—Nate endures relentless bullying from A-rank prodigy Tyler Ashworth and the academy's corrupt administrators, who crush his father's hard-won serum and try to strip him of his right to compete.

dramabox.title: Blazing Her
dramabox.norm_title: blazing her
dramabox.description: Ava is betrayed by her boyfriend and stepsister, forced to a man's bed, but escapes and meets Ethan, who recognizes her as a childhood protector. They marry to escape her family. After his father is killed, Ethan publicly humiliates Ava to protect her. She leaves and starts her own business. After being kidnapped and rescued by Ethan, they reconcile and reunite.

dramabox.title: The Saintess of Wasteland:Returns for Survival
dramabox.norm_title: the saintess of wasteland returns for survival
dramabox.description: Emily Thorne——Daughter of the mayor of Rust Town——rises against the tyrannical Thorne Family in a lawless wasteland that devours the weak. She fights to protect the people, and as the Genesis Saintess, brings life back to a world long buried in death.

dramabox.title: Her Brother Rules Cyberspace
dramabox.norm_title: her brother rules cyberspace
dramabox.description: In Cyberspace, the mysterious Reaper punishes anyone who threatens Ella Morgan. She has no idea that the man beneath the mask is Cole—a clone of the brother she lost. When Cole discovers that Ella is secretly being abused by her soon-to-be husband for the sake of their family's legacy, he swears to make everyone who has laid hands on his sister pay in blood. But with enemies closing in, can brother and sister reunite and reclaim what was stolen from them?

dramabox.title: I Was Offered to the Beast King
dramabox.norm_title: i was offered to the beast king
dramabox.description: Noah is sold as a peace sacrifice to the beast kingdom. The beast king Avaris, instead of killing him, declares him his fated mate. Noah discovers the true conspiracy comes from the human council. He awakens hidden royal blood, joins forces with Avaris to expose the truth, and becomes the legal consort of the beast king, rebuilding peace between species.

dramabox.title: The Last Paladin
dramabox.norm_title: the last paladin
dramabox.description: A thousand years ago, Holy Knight Aldric led his order to seal the vampire ancestor Malchior, bearing a blood curse and guarding Black Marsh Castle alone ever since. Developer Clara arrives to demolish the castle for a new city, inciting villagers to besiege it for compensation money.

dramabox.title: Buried in the Desert, Saved by the Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: buried in the desert saved by the billionaire
dramabox.description: Vivian Hartley, heiress to the world's richest family, nearly dies in the Sahara after her fiancé betrays her, steals her research, and leaves her for dead. With one dying call, she reaches Adrian Blackwood—the ruthless billionaire who has loved her in silence for years. As Adrian tears apart the conspiracy against her, Vivian fights to reclaim her work, her life, and a love she never saw coming.

dramabox.title: Mr. Walker, Your Ex-Wife is Your Boss
dramabox.norm_title: mr walker your ex wife is your boss
dramabox.description: Emily Johnson, a hidden identity bestselling novelist (pen name Momo), marries CEO Ronan Walker but is neglected. She divorces after finding him "close" to actress Vivian. She returns to acting and meets producer William, who seeks revenge for Ronan's past accident. Misunderstandings clear: Ronan and Vivian are purely business (Vivian donated bone marrow for William's daughter), and Ronan always loved Emily. They reunite.

dramabox.title: Woops!Olympus Beauties WantApollo' s Son
dramabox.norm_title: woops olympus beauties wantapollo s son
dramabox.description: Leon (Asclepius), the god of medicine, hides his divine power and lives as a despised live-in son-in-law in the Hart family for a year to repay a debt to the dying patriarch Ed—promising to marry his daughter Anna and cure her fatal illness—but is framed by the steward Mia and cast out, while Carl, heir to the Locke family, pursues Anna to seize the Hart business and Mia secretly swaps Leon's medicine for poison.

dramabox.title: My Ex's Sister Is Mine
dramabox.norm_title: my ex s sister is mine
dramabox.description: Viola catches boyfriend Julian cheating with Sebastian at a manor ball. She fakes amnesia, gets close to his sister Livia, who protects her from acid. As the world's richest heiress, Viola punishes the cheaters—one jailed, the other paralyzed. Livia finds a recording proving Viola's act, tries to leave, but Viola holds her. They unite and take control together.

dramabox.title: The Hidden Heiress of Beastmaster Academy
dramabox.norm_title: the hidden heiress of beastmaster academy
dramabox.description: Vera, the true princess of the Stellar Kingdom, disguised herself as a common apprentice at the Beastmaster Academy to escape the royal court. She faced the fake princess Selene who stole her identity. With royal blood and ancient sacred beast Dusty, she fought back, revealed the truth, and rose from student to ruler who protected the continent.

dramabox.title: Watch Out! Hands Off My Rolls-Royce
dramabox.norm_title: watch out hands off my rolls royce
dramabox.description: Ming Jiwon, a wealthy heiress, hides her identity and spends seven years helping her boyfriend, Oh Myeongsik, build his company. In return, she is betrayed, framed for a drunk-driving accident caused by actress Choi Sena, and dies a tragic death. Reborn one year before her death, Jiwon uses her wealth and influence to destroy Myeongsik’s empire, expose Sena’s lies, and turn their fake suicide scheme against them.

dramabox.title: My Ex Is an Alpha, My Future Is a King
dramabox.norm_title: my ex is an alpha my future is a king
dramabox.description: After the Duke's death, his brother Richard stole everything and blinded his daughter Cordelia. To protect her lover Luke, she broke his heart. He returned as war hero Luciano Thorne to claim her, intending revenge. Seeing her scars, hatred turned to obsession. The truth emerged, he restored her sight and crowned her Duchess again.

dramabox.title: My Ex Took My Dragon Egg—Now He Kneels at My Feet
dramabox.norm_title: my ex took my dragon egg now he kneels at my feet
dramabox.description: After her ex-husband steals her dragon egg and casts her out, Emma returns pregnant as Victor's true wife. Mistaken for a spy, she is tortured while her son is abused and her identity is stolen. When tragedy awakens her golden-dragon power, Emma unleashes brutal revenge—and makes Victor kneel for forgiveness.

dramabox.title: Addicted to My CEO Doctor
dramabox.norm_title: addicted to my ceo doctor
dramabox.description: Renee, a neglected housewife, struggles with pent-up desire due to her husband's favoritism toward her sister. She seeks help from Dr. Damian, who sees through her pain and childhood trauma. He becomes her boss and protector. He defends her from humiliation, drugging, and kidnapping. Renee divorces, overcomes a doppelganger crisis, and marries Damian. She becomes pregnant, and they build a healing family together.

dramabox.title: Kneel Before the Dragon King
dramabox.norm_title: kneel before the dragon king
dramabox.description: Ten years after his dragon eyes and scales are stolen, the disgraced Dio returns as a supreme mage. He destroys the family that betrayed him, rescues his imprisoned mother, and wages war on the empire—reclaiming his power and ascending as the world's Dragon King.

dramabox.title: The Born-Mute Queen of Magic
dramabox.norm_title: the born mute queen of magic
dramabox.description: Mute heiress Seren was abandoned by father Dorian and adopted by shadow lord Kaelan. Blessed with primal sacred flame, she seeks her birth mother, exposes the schemes of Vesper and Odette, fights dark sorcerer Tiberius, fulfills the ancient prophecy, unites realms and guards all her loved ones.

dramabox.title: He Gave My Wedding to His Ex
dramabox.norm_title: he gave my wedding to his ex
dramabox.description: On her wedding day, Ava watches her husband hand their million-dollar venue to his ex. Betrayed and humiliated, she reveals her identity as the Sterling heiress, files for divorce, and fights back against their lies, exposing a conspiracy that threatens her family and empire.

dramabox.title: The Beater Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: the beater billionaire
dramabox.description: Leonard, hidden trillionaire behind Star Capital, drives a pink economy car to keep a low profile. After being humiliated at Austin Technologies, he withdraws investment, bankrupting it. He later crushes rival families, protects wife Sofia with $50M, reveals he’s Quantum Fund’s top shareholder, and rescues her from kidnappers. True kings need no showy cars.

dramabox.title: I Made Him Rich, He Made Me Dead
dramabox.norm_title: i made him rich he made me dead
dramabox.description: Clara, heiress to a media empire, is betrayed and murdered by Damian. She is reborn five years earlier, decides to expose Damian's lies, reclaim her company, and punish all betrayers. She also rekindles her love with her true fiancé Adrian, rewriting her destiny.

dramabox.title: The King of the violent  neighborhood
dramabox.norm_title: the king of the violent neighborhood
dramabox.description: The legendary overlord of the arms trade, Horace Vance, is known to the world only as “the Quartermaster”. He lies low among ordinary folks, making a living running a barbecue stall in a crime‑ridden neighborhood. When local thugs come to extort protection money, gangs and his loyal subordinates rush over to defend him. Yet Horace keeps his immense power well‑hidden, wishing only for his newly‑graduated son Beau to live a quiet, peaceful life.

dramabox.title: The Lost Princess Becomes First of the Holy Academy
dramabox.norm_title: the lost princess becomes first of the holy academy
dramabox.description: After discovering she is the lost princess, herbalist Althea enters the Holy Academy to uncover her mother's murder. Hunted by her false sister and a corrupt queen, she awakens forbidden purification magic—and falls for Lucien, the cursed headmaster who may hold the key to her destiny.

dramabox.title: The Sea Queen Returns: My Ex Begs Me Back
dramabox.norm_title: the sea queen returns my ex begs me back
dramabox.description: After her fiancé abandons her for a pregnant rival, Margo marries Kaiser, the feared Lord of the Shadow Abyss. Three years later, she returns as his Sea Queen, exposing her ex's betrayal, clearing her father's name, and rebuilding Silver Bay—while her remorseful ex begs for the love he threw away.

dramabox.title: Murphy's Daughter Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: murphy s daughter strikes back
dramabox.description: In a collapsed future Earth, Ark designer Lynn hides her identity but suffers abuse from her husband and his family. Her daughter is ill, and her parents find a new planet. Her identity token is stolen. Former rival Anthony protects her, exposes the plot, and Lynn reclaims control, leaving for humanity's new home.

dramabox.title: When She Stopped Chasing His Love
dramabox.norm_title: when she stopped chasing his love
dramabox.description: Camilla and her sister Malola study piano. Camilla is gifted but deaf in one ear, so her parents give up on her. Malola is noticed by rich heir Dylan, who sponsors her abroad. Camilla convinces Malola to accept, gaining a chance to learn piano. Three years later, Malola returns, and Camilla has become Dylan's substitute lover. Camilla decides to leave, and producer Cyrus paves her new path. Dylan starts to regret after she leaves.

dramabox.title: The Villain Zone's Last Hero
dramabox.norm_title: the villain zone s last hero
dramabox.description: Abandoned in the Villain Zone for 23 years as a "powerless" heir, Ethan Cross is reclaimed by his disgraced hero family for a publicity stunt. With his hidden nullifying power, he exposes their corruption, battles an alien conspiracy, and leads the Zone's outcasts to save humanity—at the cost of becoming the world's last hero.

dramabox.title: Red Phoenix: Rise From Mars
dramabox.norm_title: red phoenix rise from mars
dramabox.description: When the savage Morg army descends on the Martian city of Solara, Rio Sora—the city's most infamous playboy—steps forward to face them alone, shocking a world that has always dismissed him. Secretly a masked warrior burning for revenge against the family who murdered his sister, Rio begins dismantling his enemies one by one, growing in power and favor until he can finally reveal his true self and destroy those who took everything from him.

dramabox.title: The Genius They Thought Was Crazy
dramabox.norm_title: the genius they thought was crazy
dramabox.description: Heiress Vivian uncovers a plot by her fiancé Tristan and his lover to have her declared insane and steal her fortune. She pretends to lose her mind, secretly gathers evidence, and turns their schemes against them. A battle of love, power, and revenge unfolds—where the hunter is never who they expect.

dramabox.title: The Billionaire's Forbidden Secret My Sister's Baby Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: the billionaire s forbidden secret my sister s baby daddy
dramabox.description: Medical tycoon Rowan caused a car accident to kidnap Julian and imprisoned him for ten years. Silas meets the amnesiac Julian on Wall Street and discovers his sister is pregnant with Julian's child. Julian regains his memory and teams with Silas to destroy Rowan's empire.

dramabox.title: Collar Stained With Blood
dramabox.norm_title: collar stained with blood
dramabox.description: Former revolutionary assassin Sylvie was abused by a general. She escaped, was taken in by a priest, but the priest was killed. She rescued young Benny, trained him for a decade. They evolved from master and slave to soulmates, hunting down the general. Benny died protecting her. Sylvie killed the enemies, carried his body to the sea, and slit her own throat to join him.

dramabox.title: Don’t Touch My Prisoner
dramabox.norm_title: don t touch my prisoner
dramabox.description: Leo, a convicted felon, took the blame for stabbing his stepfather to protect his underage sister and was sent to Blackstone Prison. There, he encounters the prison's attending physician, Adrian. Leo mistakenly believes that Adrian has designs on his female lawyer and ex-girlfriend, Natalie, and treats him with open hostility. In reality, from the very beginning, Adrian has harbored an intense possessiveness and deep infatuation for Leo himself, secretly filling sketchbooks..

dramabox.title: King Of Mars：From Red Dust He Rises
dramabox.norm_title: king of mars from red dust he rises
dramabox.description: Max, a Martian prince born with extraordinary powers, witnesses his mother being poisoned and his throne usurped by his uncle Silas. Cast into the wilderness and left to die, Max survives and sets out on a path of vengeance and rescue.He joins forces with a team of mercenaries and, amid the brutal arenas of Mars, awakens his power of “Reversal.” Step by step, he exposes Silas’s conspiracy and ultimately returns to the palace to reclaim the throne and secure the future of...

dramabox.title: Revenge On My Husband Who Locked Me in a Container
dramabox.norm_title: revenge on my husband who locked me in a container
dramabox.description: Marissa, heiress of the Foster Group, is betrayed by her husband Nolan and best friend Mandy. While pregnant, she is locked in a container and thrown into the sea. She survives and is rescued by her brother Charles, who faked his death. They crash Nolan and Mandy's wedding, expose their crimes, and the betrayers turn on each other, revealing their full plot.

dramabox.title: The Godfather’s Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the godfather s bride
dramabox.description: Three years after retiring injured, mafia godfather Leon returns to protect Evelyn, daughter of his savior. He battles the Voss Group, defeats assassins, and leads Evelyn to become the new godmother. Together they build a new order after crushing the invaders.

dramabox.title: The Western Godfather: Rise of the Moonblood
dramabox.norm_title: the western godfather rise of the moonblood
dramabox.description: Eric, the Falcone family's abandoned son, returned from the West only to be rejected again. When rivals besieged his family, he saved his mother and sister. On the full moon night, he awakened the Wolf God's bloodline, defeated Mac, and became the new King of the Werewolves.

dramabox.title: That Mechanic is the God of Mecha
dramabox.norm_title: that mechanic is the god of mecha
dramabox.description: Codename "Reaper," Adam is the only living 6th-gen mech pilot. After his parents' murder, he hides as a lowly mechanic guarding his childhood sweetheart Amelia. When threats emerge, he unleashes his full power and seeks revenge.

dramabox.title: They Abused The Wrong Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: they abused the wrong heiress
dramabox.description: Ava Hart returns home in disguise to test the woman her billionaire father plans to marry—only to uncover a “charity queen” stealing lifesaving treatment from sick children. Mistaking Ava for a nobody, Vanessa and her son imprison, torture, and humiliate her. Their biggest mistake? The girl they're destroying is the one person who can take away everything they've schemed for.

dramabox.title: What If I'm One Hell of A Fighter
dramabox.norm_title: what if i m one hell of a fighter
dramabox.description: After his father dies, Kane is taken in by Eve, a gym owner. Bullied as a janitor, he hides his skills until gangsters threaten the gym. Kane defeats them but is forced into an underground death match against the world champion—and wins, securing millions. Eve's kidnapped father is already dead. Kane avenges him. Months later, the gym thrives. Kane and Eve find family and purpose together.

dramabox.title: Dead to My Daughter, Heir to an Empire
dramabox.norm_title: dead to my daughter heir to an empire
dramabox.description: To marry into wealth, Chloe tells everyone her mother is dead—and humiliates Erin, the poor cleaner who sacrificed everything to raise her. But Chloe has no idea the woman she's desperate to erase is actually the long-lost heir to a powerful empire. When Erin's true family finally finds her, Chloe may lose everything she betrayed her mother to gain.

dramabox.title: Stranded with the Fisherman Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: stranded with the fisherman daddy
dramabox.description: Actress Chloe is framed by her stepmother and fiancé, hit with a $50 million penalty, and forced onto a survival dating show. Her partner, "shabby fisherman" Sebastian, secretly protects her with his son Leo. Love blooms. When villains lure her back to destroy her, Sebastian reveals himself as head of a global shipping empire, buys her agency, broadcasts their arrest, and marries her on a private island.

dramabox.title: AGENT BADBOY
dramabox.norm_title: agent badboy
dramabox.description: FBI ace Buddy, identical to slain mafia boss Barton, goes undercover in the Loguet family to gather arms-smuggling evidence. Using Barton's crescent birthmark, he survives power grabs by young master Luca and tests from Barton's stepmother Suzanne. He falls for Barton's wife Elise, wins over mixed-blood bodyguard Haruko, and outmaneuvers Suzanne to seize the San Francisco docks.

dramabox.title: They Called Her Fool, She Saved Their Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: they called her fool she saved their fortune
dramabox.description: Every member of the Stone family is brilliant, yet youngest daughter Ivy Stone is written off as a fool. Few suspect she has long feigned idiocy, reborn with memories of a legendary top‑tier lawyer from her past life. She hoped for a peaceful, uneventful life. But traitors team up with investors to crash Stone Group. A single contract threatens total ruin and crushing billion‑dollar debt. Right before her father signs, Ivy halts him.

dramabox.title: Retired From Being Used
dramabox.norm_title: retired from being used
dramabox.description: For years, retired Linda Hayes quietly bankrolled her son Derek Carter's family and kept house without thanks. When they mock and berate her over a cheap new dress—even shredding it in a rage—Linda finally stops. She calls her lawyer, reclaims the house and car, cuts off every cent, and drops it all on them at their own celebration banquet.

dramabox.title: The Heart That Was Never Hers
dramabox.norm_title: the heart that was never hers
dramabox.description: Ethan Drake discovers his late love's donated heart never went to his wife, Claire Grant, who has spent years coldly favoring Adrian Cole—even pushing Ethan to donate a kidney for him. Heartbroken, Ethan decides to divorce Claire and find the real recipient. At a gathering, her friends mock Ethan as pathetic, right before Claire opens the envelope he sent her—expecting a kidney form, finding divorce papers instead.

dramabox.title: No Road for Traffickers
dramabox.norm_title: no road for traffickers
dramabox.description: Claire Foster, a PhD student in agricultural science, returns every success to her hometown by funding roads and helping villagers improve their harvests. Consumed by jealousy, her roommate Tessa Kane conspires with traffickers to sell her into the mountains. Claire soon realizes she's being taken back to her own village. As Ethan Cole uncovers the truth, the villagers and Dr. Keller join forces to rescue her and bring everyone behind the crime to justice.

dramabox.title: Ruin All: The Ultimate Beast Linker
dramabox.norm_title: ruin all the ultimate beast linker
dramabox.description: They said winning the arena would earn you a place among the elite. They lied. When Skyhold's masters drained his partner's mind as a living battery, Kyle barely escaped—falling into the Wastes with nothing but a name he can't speak. Taken in by his dead friend's fierce sister, Nova, he hides his true identity and his terrifying power. But to avenge Sam and free millions of caged minds, the strongest Linker alive must rise again—and bring the floating city crashing down.

dramabox.title: Surrender to the Unwanted Virgin Luna
dramabox.norm_title: surrender to the unwanted virgin luna
dramabox.description: Betrayed and humiliated, wolfless Solara is forced by her mate Ronan to beg Alpha King Lawrence to approve their rejection. Unexpectedly, she discovers she's the only woman who can break the Alpha's curse. Lawrence swore he'd never touch his Beta's mate. But forbidden desire takes over, awakening Solara's lost wolf. Ronan realizes too late that the mate he rejected was the woman he'd loved all along—and that he sent her straight into another man's arms.

dramabox.title: Little Mermaid, Stay Away from That Drowning Prince
dramabox.norm_title: little mermaid stay away from that drowning prince
dramabox.description:
I saved a drowning prince, gave up my tail for him, and handed him a fortune big enough to rebuild his ruined life.
Three years later, he called me a brainless fish, gave my dead mother's jewelry to his childhood sweetheart, and ordered me to kneel before her.
So I stopped being his wife.
I went home to the sea—and took back every coin, every shop, every trade route, and every ounce of power he’d built with my name.

dramabox.title: My Brother Thought He Won
dramabox.norm_title: my brother thought he won
dramabox.description: Ethan rose from poverty to become a legend; his brother Cole, adopted into wealth, was consumed by jealousy—believing Ethan stole his destiny. Their rivalry ended tragically. As Ethan drowns, fate rewinds them both to the day they were adopted. Now they have a second chance. Ethan vows not to repeat the past; Cole vows to reclaim what he thinks is his. A battle over wealth, glory, and destiny begins again.

dramabox.title: Window Washer’s Hidden Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: window washer s hidden fortune
dramabox.description: Ethan Shawn, sole heir of a top Long Island family, was raised as a blue-collar worker with his identity hidden. On the eve of a grand wedding, CEO Vivian Richards randomly picks him to pose as her boyfriend—and they end up registering their marriage. When he visits her family, he's humiliated. Then the butler arrives with extravagant wealth, revealing his true identity—plunging everyone who looked down on him into deep regret.

dramabox.title: All Too Well（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: all too well dubbed
dramabox.description: On the day she was diagnosed with liver cancer, Han Ji-eun witnessed her husband Choi Jun-hyuk’s 99th affair and demanded a divorce on the condition that he complete five tasks with her.Choi Jun-hyuk agreed for the sake of his first love, Kang Su-ah, only to repay her with nothing but humiliation. Resolved to take revenge, Han Ji-eun returned as the world-renowned painter Ria and launched her counterattack.

dramabox.title: Absolute Sovereign: The World in My Hands（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: absolute sovereign the world in my hands dubbed
dramabox.description: Julian Hale transmigrates to Highrealm as Julian Hawthorne, who everyone believes is a fool. On his wedding day, the empress tries to break off the marriages she initially granted him. Deciding to shed his pretense, Julian uses his modern knowledge to improve people's lives, crush rebellions, and reform the government. He rises from the kingdom's laughingstock to a highly respected leader.

dramabox.title: The Forsaken War God
dramabox.norm_title: the forsaken war god
dramabox.description: Raine, scorned by his clan as a magic-less good-for-nothing, seeks vengeance for his mother’s brutal death. Taking up the mantle of a war god, he joins forces with a royal court sorceress, cuts his way through the underground guild, and uncovers an abyssal conspiracy bent on toppling the kingdom.

dramabox.title: Thorned Kiss Idols Revenge Darling
dramabox.norm_title: thorned kiss idols revenge darling
dramabox.description: Top hater Sienna publicly slams movie star Julian, but a media storm forces them into a fake relationship. Living together, they go from suspicion to genuine feelings, only to be drawn into a dark capital conspiracy. Through betrayal, breakup, and life-and-death trials, they join forces to expose the plot—and transform from enemies into each other's one true love.

dramabox.title: The Rejected and Unstoppable（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the rejected and unstoppable dubbed
dramabox.description: After traveling through time into the body of the Marsh family's live-in son-in-law, Ethan Wells is subjected to indifference, humiliation, harsh criticism, and constant oppression. Faced with a life-threatening crisis, he finally decides to fight back—using his unique talents to claim his rights and carve out a path to his own redemption, setting the stage for his moment to shine.

dramabox.title: Trust Lost in a Lie
dramabox.norm_title: trust lost in a lie
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter’s wife has cancer. He plans to persuade his parents to sell the old family house to cover her medical expenses. However, his mother asks him to lie and claim that he himself is ill, as a test for his wife. Convinced that his wife would never abandon him, Ethan agrees. Back home, he follows his mother’s words and fakes his own illness. To his shock, his wife files for divorce the very same day. She even brings her mother and prepares to sue him for a divorce.

dramabox.title: My Reborn Life Began with Saving My Wife
dramabox.norm_title: my reborn life began with saving my wife
dramabox.description: After living a lonely life, Lucas Foster is stunned to learn that Claire Carter—the fallen heiress he once saved—became the richest woman and remained single, waiting for him. Reborn on the day his fiancée dumps him, Lucas walks away without regret and rushes to save Claire once again. As the entire fishing village turns against her, he stands by her side, changing both of their fates forever.

dramabox.title: From Scrap Collector to Legend
dramabox.norm_title: from scrap collector to legend
dramabox.description: Half a century ago, legendary treasure master Derek Blake gave everything to protect his nation's priceless relics. Fate transports his soul into the body of a penniless scrap collector in the modern world. Armed with unrivaled appraisal skills and miraculous medical knowledge, Derek rises from the bottom, changes his family's destiny, builds an empire, and dedicates his new life to preserving a civilization thousands of years in the making.

dramabox.title: Reborn as the "Dumb" Heiress—Now I Control a Billion-Dollar Empire
dramabox.norm_title: reborn as the dumb heiress now i control a billion dollar empire
dramabox.description: Reborn as a formerly undefeated New York litigator, Nora pretends to be an heiress with a developmental disability. When schemers plot to ruin her family's empire, she drops her act. Using her sharp legal mind, she defeats internal traitors and powerful tycoons, saving Ashford Holdings and mending her family's bonds.

dramabox.title: After the Mistress Slapped Me, My Secretly Married Husband Went on a Rampage
dramabox.norm_title: after the mistress slapped me my secretly married husband went on a rampage
dramabox.description: Iris is secretly married to billionaire Damian under a contract. Each time Damian sees his alleged mistress Lola, he gives her corporate shares as compensation. At a fancy cocktail party, the delusional Lola publicly slaps and humiliates Iris, then locks her in a storage room and sends the predatory Damon to attack her. Badly injured, Iris defends herself with broken porcelain. Right before disaster strikes, the furious Damian crashes in to save his wronged secret wife.

dramabox.title: Once Fat Girl Enters The Engagement Banquet, Her Fiancé Regrets It
dramabox.norm_title: once fat girl enters the engagement banquet her fianc regrets it
dramabox.description: For five years, Elowen gave Cedric her family's routes, fortune, and heart—only for him to gamble away their engagement and mock her as the "fat bride" he was ashamed to marry. But while the whole port waits to humiliate her, dangerous Captain Kael treats her with the respect Cedric never did. What none of them knows is that Elowen has changed. When she finally steps into the banquet, who will be laughing then?

dramabox.title: They Banished Me, Demons Followed
dramabox.norm_title: they banished me demons followed
dramabox.description: Arthur drains his life‑force to maintain Frostwall’s defenses, holding back abyss demons single‑handed for ten years. Duped by slander, the kingdom expels this pillar of protection and ruins its own shield. Runes die; demons pour in, turning the north into purgatory. The crown begs for mercy, yet wounds run deep. Refusing to serve ungrateful royalty, Arthur balances rage and compassion. He even allies with former foes to face the real world‑eating Void threat.

dramabox.title: Four Sisters Beg For Him Back
dramabox.norm_title: four sisters beg for him back
dramabox.description: Sky, raised in an orphanage, returns to the Quinn family but suffers long-term abuse from his foster brother Blaze and his family. After breaking ties, he uses his rebirth advantage to build a fortune in stocks and a delivery platform. As he rises, his four remorseful sisters beg him to return—but deep wounds remain. Blaze schemes until a final showdown settles everything.

dramabox.title: Return of the Sea God
dramabox.norm_title: return of the sea god
dramabox.description: Alex was the son of Poseidon, the God of the Sea, and the recognized King of the entire coastal continent. To protect the woman he loved, he deliberately concealed his royal identity and disguised himself as an ordinary farmer, quietly spending five years of resources helping the down-and-out Amy family rise into the nobility.Amy, however, only had eyes for power and status. She despised the farmer-like Alex from the bottom of her heart.

dramabox.title: She Stole My Alpha, I Married the Lycan King
dramabox.norm_title: she stole my alpha i married the lycan king
dramabox.description: After rebirth, Elara lets her jealous sister steal the cursed Alpha she once died for and chooses Ronan, a seemingly wolfless rogue. As enemies hunt them and secrets surface, she awakens as the White Wolf—while her hidden Lycan King mate must earn back the trust he betrayed.

dramabox.title: The Vampire Thrall's Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: the vampire thrall s revenge
dramabox.description: Emma escapes an abusive family that raised her as a human blood servant, only to fall for Riley Black, the vampire heiress bound to claim her. When Emma's rare Sunblood reveals a deadly conspiracy, the two women must break an ancient blood pact and fight for a love founded on freedom, not control.

dramabox.title: Zero Second Last Gate
dramabox.norm_title: zero second last gate
dramabox.description: After gaining the power to freeze time for only a few seconds, wasteland mechanic Jace Vale must infiltrate Haven City to rescue his infected sister, Mia. Hunted by Chronos and trapped in a deadly conspiracy, he joins unlikely allies to expose the city’s brutal secret—before its reset engine erases the world.

dramabox.title: After I Lost 80 Pounds, My Online Boyfriend Resold Me
dramabox.norm_title: after i lost 80 pounds my online boyfriend resold me
dramabox.description:
I once weighed 300 pounds, gorging on a whole fried chicken, large pizza, bucket of fries, two liters of soda and a football-sized cake per meal—no store clothes fit me. To meet my online boyfriend Blake, I ran 100 miles daily and survived only on boiled vegetables and water for a year, shedding 80 pounds.
The night before my flight to see him, I scrolled Reddit and spotted his post offering to pass our one-year online relationship to others.

dramabox.title: No Looking Back: I Remarried Your PowerfulUncle
dramabox.norm_title: no looking back i remarried your powerfuluncle
dramabox.description: After her fiancé Adrian betrays her with her stepsister Carmen, Selena, a noble mermaid, is framed, imprisoned and cast out. She escapes and marries his powerful uncle, Marcus. With his support, she rebuilds her fortune, exposes the royal family's lies, and rises from discarded bride to Queen of the Seven Seas—leaving Adrian to regret losing her in the rest of his life.

dramabox.title: The Cleaner Was a Legend
dramabox.norm_title: the cleaner was a legend
dramabox.description: "Five years ago, he was the most dazzling legendary captain in the history of the global football championship. Five years later, he dragged the ground in the stadium where he had shouted his name - framed as a traitor, hiding the truth and the fact that he was the hidden heir of this stadium. Until a team doctor believed him, the buried king stood up again."

dramabox.title: The Apex Triad
dramabox.norm_title: the apex triad
dramabox.description: In a neon-drenched, post-apocalyptic wasteland where ancient legends are reborn in blood and chrome, humanity’s last fragile resistance is cornered by an unstoppable horde of bone-armored werewolves and a ruthless mecha empire. When the cyber-enhanced warriors of the Dawn Army—bound by an unbreakable blood oath—are forced into a brutal, flesh-shredding final stand within a toxic canyon, their desperate strategist proposes a terrifying gamble.

dramabox.title: He Divorced Me—Now I'm Wolf Queen
dramabox.norm_title: he divorced me now i m wolf queen
dramabox.description: After being betrayed, framed for a miscarriage, and forced into divorce, Ivy escapes with her unborn child and discovers her hidden Progenitor bloodline. With exiled Alpha Silas by her side, she fights her cruel ex-husband, exposes a werewolf conspiracy, and rises from discarded mate to the powerful Wolf Queen.

dramabox.title: My mortal husband is Hades
dramabox.norm_title: my mortal husband is hades
dramabox.description: Hades, bored of godhood, hides as a mortal for a vacation. Ten years ago, Persephone was ambushed by Tantalus, who stole her divinity. Fleeing, she bore Hades' daughter, Kole. Now dying, she returns to leave the child with him—unaware her "mortal" husband is the strongest being alive.To seize the girl's divine bloodline and erase all threats, Tantalus sends thunder-priests, demigod assassins, and even Persephone's own kin. Hades' peace shatters.

dramabox.title: Lonely Haven & Fatal Bond
dramabox.norm_title: lonely haven fatal bond
dramabox.description: Kyle is about to lose his parents' hotel. The "Super Landlord System" activates, unlocking powers based on tenant satisfaction. Three female tenants—gang heir Zara, financial elite Iris, and poor college student Mia—arrive simultaneously. Their fates become deeply intertwined from that moment on.

dramabox.title: The Ten-Million Dollar Trap
dramabox.norm_title: the ten million dollar trap
dramabox.description: Emma, a hidden heiress, lives poor to obey her father. Roommate Bella steals $10M from her, then pushes her off a roof. Emma dies—and is reborn before the trip. She sets traps: loses her phone, switches to a brick, lures Bella into buying non-refundable luxury. Bella is exposed, arrested. Jason crumbles. Emma's identity is revealed. This time, the betrayers fall.

dramabox.title: The Blacksmith Is the Hidden Thunder God
dramabox.norm_title: the blacksmith is the hidden thunder god
dramabox.description: "Three years ago, Kael Stormborn, the legendary heir to the Thunder God’s power, lost everything when dark magic eradicated his bloodline. Obeying his father's final command, Kael concealed his identity, buried his divine hammer beneath layers of rust, and became a humble blacksmith for the Silver Fox mercenaries.

dramabox.title: Trash Heir to Arcane God
dramabox.norm_title: trash heir to arcane god
dramabox.description: Kane, formerly the God of Arcane, is reborn as the “trash” heir of the Holy Light family. Despised by his fiancée and bullied by his clan, he actually retains his max-level divine power. He casually turns his maid Amy into a demigod, only to face the Shadow Cult's rebellion and Amy's betrayal during the family's magic trial. Facing his fiancée's broken engagement and everyone's mockery, Kane stops hiding.

dramabox.title: He Hid His Power, She Sealed Her Fate
dramabox.norm_title: he hid his power she sealed her fate
dramabox.description: Lucas Forbes, heir of the Forbes Group, returns home early with top-secret national project files. Outside his villa, he is brutally harassed by his fiancée Vivian Hale and her companion Ryan Cole. Disdaining his impoverished past, Vivian fails to recognize him, mistaking Lucas for a thief. They assault and humiliate him, crushing his suitcase full of confidential documents. Ignoring his identity claims, they tie him up as a dartboard at his welcome banquet.

dramabox.title: HuntedLuna，HiddenPrincess
dramabox.norm_title: huntedluna hiddenprincess
dramabox.description: Separated Silver Moon princess Celine endures three years of torture by Blood Moon leader Ronan. She overhears them planning to steal her unborn cub's soul for their bastard son. Pregnant, she flees. Her father, the Silver Moon Wolf King, finds her and rescues her. They expose the conspiracy, punish the villains. Celine ascends the Silver Throne, guarding peace across all northern wolf clans.

dramabox.title: Secret Love: My Swimming God Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: secret love my swimming god stepbrother
dramabox.description: Transfer student Noah works to pay his mother's medical bills. He shares a night with swimming prodigy and heir Ethan—they become stepbrothers. Trapped by his stepfather Victor, nearly sold off, Ethan protects him. As they train together, feelings grow. Rivals scheme, Victor sabotages. Noah breaks free, stands on the national stage, scarred but striving. Ethan abandons family pride to stand by him. Beyond blood, class, and malice, they race toward a gentle future together.

dramabox.title: A Timeless Love Cooked in Secret
dramabox.norm_title: a timeless love cooked in secret
dramabox.description: Modern top chef Fiona Hart accidentally time-travels to ancient times, becoming the neglected eldest daughter of a prime minister. She is forced to marry Adrian Carter, heir of the Cheng Palace, who misses their wedding night. Fiona settles down in the palace with her superb cooking skills and befriends the disguised Adrian by chance. She repeatedly resolves schemes and provocations from her jealous younger sister with her culinary talent and wins the Divine Chef Competition.

dramabox.title: My Sister Took My Alpha, I Became Wolf Queen
dramabox.norm_title: my sister took my alpha i became wolf queen
dramabox.description: After eight years of control, Laura is betrayed by her Alpha husband and pregnant sister. She allies with rival Alpha Isaac, uncovers the plot suppressing her rare Silver Moon bloodline, and awakens her wolf to destroy the Grant dynasty, reclaim her freedom, and rise as the Wolf Queen.

dramabox.title: Stole My Glory and Fiancé? Now Bow to the Duchess!
dramabox.norm_title: stole my glory and fianc now bow to the duchess
dramabox.description: Illegitimate daughter Cecily Veyne has spent her life in her sister Lavinia's shadow. When Lavinia steals her exam victories—and her fiancé Laurence helps her do it—Cecily is forced to marry the supposedly crippled Duke Evander. But the unwanted match becomes her salvation: Evander is recovering, powerful, and has always wanted her. As Cecily rises at court, those who betrayed her must face the ruin they created.

dramabox.title: Too Late, Prince—I'm Your Brother's Queen
dramabox.norm_title: too late prince i m your brother s queen
dramabox.description: Lilian cared for a mute stranger for three years. He was never mute—just a prince in hiding. He used her to reach another woman. Heartbroken, she married his brother Leon, cursed to become a lion each full moon. On her wedding day, Cassian's world shattered. But Leon never locked her door, never forced her touch. Now Lilian must decide: return to her past, or fight for a future worth living.

dramabox.title: Owned by My Ex's Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: owned by my ex s uncle
dramabox.description: Clara is sacrificed to an investor by fiancé Caleb, but ends up in Victor's room. Victor binds her with contract marriage, while Caleb and stepsister Serena steal her perfume formula. From discarded prey, Clara rises to queen beside Victor—she finds her mother's blood ledger in South Africa, hurls blood diamonds at her wedding, and crushes the old powers. A tale of betrayal, lies, and redemption.

dramabox.title: Fake Contract, True Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: fake contract true heiress
dramabox.description: Six years ago, true heiress Chloe saved poisoned blind tycoon Alexander on a rainy night, but fake heiress Isabella set a fire to kill her, separating her twins. Six years later, Chloe returns to Sterling Manor as a single mother with her genius hacker son Max, signing a contract marriage with Alexander. Facing Isabella's humiliation and schemes, Chloe hides her medical and hacking skills, secretly rescues her abused eldest son Leo, and exposes the fake heiress's crimes.

dramabox.title: Wolf Queen
dramabox.norm_title: wolf queen
dramabox.description: Freya, a talented she-wolf, loves low-rank wolf Remy. He craves power, steals the Moonstone Scepter for rival Raven, and frames Freya—sending her to prison. There, she's beaten but never breaks. The old Wolf King, recognizing her, grants her his power. Freya awakens Siphon ability. She learns her mother is being abused and shifts into wolf form to save her. Justice begins.

dramabox.title: Regret it? I'm the Supreme Prince!
dramabox.norm_title: regret it i m the supreme prince
dramabox.description: Leo, the lost heir to the throne, lives as a humble fisherman after secretly rising to become the world's most powerful mage. Devoted to Fiona for saving his life, he expects love—but she dumps and humiliates him the moment she joins the Royal Magic Corps. When Leo's mother, Queen Eleanor, finally finds him, his true identity begins to unfold. As enemies strike from every side, Leo reveals his supreme power and returns to claim his throne.

dramabox.title: The Underworld Emperor Has Logged In
dramabox.norm_title: the underworld emperor has logged in
dramabox.description: On the day of his class awakening, Adrian Stone unlocks the legendary Emperor of Fengdu System and becomes the ruler of the Underworld. Commanding ghost generals and rebuilding the Book of Life and Death, he wages war against terrifying Western eldritch gods. Armed with both modern firepower and ancient underworld magic, Adrian tears through gods and monsters to rewrite the balance between life and death.

dramabox.title: The Sweetest Caregiver in the Deadliest Nursing Home
dramabox.norm_title: the sweetest caregiver in the deadliest nursing home
dramabox.description: At 17, Ethan Hart is transported into a world overrun by supernatural horrors. Taken in by a mysterious nursing home, he becomes a caregiver and awakens a unique system that rewards him for caring for the elderly. Protected by the system from seeing the world's darkest horrors, Ethan has no idea the gentle seniors he looks after are actually terrifying SSS-level monsters. As danger closes in, the nursing home becomes humanity's strongest sanctuary.

dramabox.title: Speak a Lie, Meet Your Doom（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: speak a lie meet your doom dubbed
dramabox.description: Born the heiress of the richest family, Sharon Quinn grows up away from home and endures years of hardship. She works tirelessly for a decade and earns a second chance at life. With her sharp intelligence and determination, she turns the tables and rises to lead the family. After settling old grudges, she devotes herself to philanthropy, rewriting her fate and bringing hope to others.

dramabox.title: After the Fog
dramabox.norm_title: after the fog
dramabox.description: During her third pregnancy, Olivia heard her unborn child’s voice: husband Sebastian had caused two miscarriages and cheated with her sister Mia. She divorced, but Mia framed her and Sebastian cost her the third child. Olivia left New York, married Ethan, launched her label, and won a top award. Sebastian regretted but was rejected; Mia went to prison. Olivia adopted Luna, then gave birth to a son. She found redemption through career, family, and self.

dramabox.title: After His 99 Mistresses, I Took His Empire
dramabox.norm_title: after his 99 mistresses i took his empire
dramabox.description: Elena marries into the elite Cole family. For five years, she cleans up her playboy husband Ryan's scandals with 99 mistresses while quietly laying her plan to seize power. When his 100th mistress Mia wins his full devotion and grows ruthless, pregnant Elena is shoved into premature birth—but Ryan takes Mia's side completely, shattering all pretense.

dramabox.title: The Vow He Kept in His Second Life
dramabox.norm_title: the vow he kept in his second life
dramabox.description: Reborn in the 1980s, Ethan Rook regrets mistreating his mute wife Clara Shaw, who died saving him. He leaves his cruel family, starts a trade business, discovers Clara is a lost heiress, helps her regain her voice, and earns her family's respect. They marry again and build a happy life together.

dramabox.title: From Doormat to Dynasty
dramabox.norm_title: from doormat to dynasty
dramabox.description: For ten years, Caleb Foster endured humiliation as a live-in son-in-law. Thrown out with nothing, he took a barren hill and sick pigs, discovering a hot spring. He built a fortune raising pigs while his in-laws' farm collapsed from swine fever. When they came begging, he refused. Even the county mayor honored him. His ex-wife Darla Carter came back at midnight, begging for another chance.

dramabox.title: When Rules Become a Death Sentence
dramabox.norm_title: when rules become a death sentence
dramabox.description: When eerie paranormal rules overtake the world, humanity is thrust into deadly rule-based dungeons. Logan Cole gains a special system and enters Sablemere Asylum to survive brutal trials. He follows strict rules, beats a game, and averts a fatal surgery crisis with steady calm and sharp wits. Framed by allies and ambushed by shadow creatures, Logan outsmarts every deadly trap and fights alongside a benevolent guardian. He solves successive puzzles and searches for a way out.

dramabox.title: Curse of the Fallen Prince
dramabox.norm_title: curse of the fallen prince
dramabox.description: To secure her throne, Empress Vivian Rowan secretly executes her own son, Crown Prince Liam Rowan — sparking outrage. Haunted by nightmares of a demonic curse, she summons detective Gavin Ward to investigate. As artisans mysteriously die and rumors of the prince's vengeful ghost spread, Gavin's suspicions deepen — until he's imprisoned, only to return in time to save her from a deadly ritual.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Boss's Foolish Bride Strikes Back
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia boss s foolish bride strikes back
dramabox.description: Ella Vane was never crazy—just chipped. Sold by her family, she escapes to a mafia boss whose touch-rejection disorder only stops near her. One night. One baby. Three months later, her family drags her back for a forced abortion. Kane breaks down the door. Now Ella's awake. She reclaims her mother's company, exposes every lie, and proves she's no one's fool. This time, she fights back.

dramabox.title: From Throne to Takeout
dramabox.norm_title: from throne to takeout
dramabox.description: Betrayed by rival princes for his brilliance, the Crown Prince of Great Qi is thrown into the modern world as a food delivery driver. While facing off against local thugs like Ryan Carter, he rescues and grows close to CEO Vivian Ross. Tracked by mysterious guardian Raven Blake, his true identity is revealed — and chaos follows.

dramabox.title: My Mother-in-Law Fights Dirty For Me
dramabox.norm_title: my mother in law fights dirty for me
dramabox.description: Widowed young, Vivian Stone built her late husband's business into an empire, then stepped back once her son Ethan Sutton married. But when his ex, Riley Hayes, returns from abroad chasing a bigger payday, she seduces Ethan and rekindles their old flame — threatening his marriage. Now Vivian steps back in, ready to protect her family from the woman trying to tear it apart.

dramabox.title: She Rewrote Her Own Script
dramabox.norm_title: she rewrote her own script
dramabox.description: Actress Claire Turner slips into her bathtub during a late-night rehearsal and wakes up inside the very script she was studying — as the timid female lead. But armed with modern confidence, she transforms into a sharp-tongued powerhouse, sparring and falling for the cold male lead, Adrian Carter. Just as they near their happy ending, her stepmother stabs her — can she make it home?

dramabox.title: They Called It Magic, I Called It Science
dramabox.norm_title: they called it magic i called it science
dramabox.description: Top scholar Ethan Reeve wakes in a cyberpunk wasteland 70 years after civilization's collapse, where science is mistaken for ancient sorcery. Armed only with chemistry and physics, he fights off mutant raiders — catching the eye of envoy Luna Fox from humanity's last stronghold. But his trusted guide is secretly a spy, and the real war is only beginning.

dramabox.title: No One Can Take My Home
dramabox.norm_title: no one can take my home
dramabox.description: A decade ago, divorced Claire Hart moved back to her hometown with her daughter. Ten years later, she returned to sell her house, only to find it occupied by strangers. Both parties claimed ownership of the property, and the intense dispute even led to a physical fight. Finally, the Housing Bureau’s official investigation uncovered the truth. Claire successfully retrieved her house, and the illegal occupants were held responsible for their actions.

dramabox.title: The Dragon King's Forbidden Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon king s forbidden bride
dramabox.description: Defeated prince Caelan, blackmailed by his usurper uncle, is sent as a "bride sacrifice" to mad dragon-king Azrahel—who kills every bride by dawn. Caelan's "Silent Flame" calms him; night by night, the king regains sanity. They conspire to expose the truth. After toppling usurpers, the true mastermind Malphas nearly kills Azrahel. Caelan merges souls with him, becoming a golden dragon to win. Azrahel is restored; Caelan is crowned the first male Dragon Consort.

dramabox.title: Blood Ties That Tried to Break Me（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: blood ties that tried to break me dubbed
dramabox.description: Heiress Claire Hale saved her twin Ethan with bone marrow. Back home to host his girlfriend Chloe, she faces a plot for the family fortune. Chloe's fake pregnancy turns Ethan against Claire, and Grandma backs Chloe. Claire and fiance Julian Carter expose Chloe's collusion with an uncle. The villains are caught, and Ethan begs Claire's forgiveness.

dramabox.title: The Starlet Called My Husband's Dog Her Baby
dramabox.norm_title: the starlet called my husband s dog her baby
dramabox.description: Vivienne Vale, a talented actress auditioning for the lead role in Glass Crown for three months, is one signature, away from her dream. Everything derails when rising starlet Lola Hart posts a photo of A-list actor Asher Sterling's golden retriever, Biscuit, with the caption "Mommy's right here," sparking viral rumors that she is Asher's secret partner.

dramabox.title: My Twin Sister Took My Wedding Day
dramabox.norm_title: my twin sister took my wedding day
dramabox.description: Before her wedding, Emma's family demands she give up her groom, her savings, and even her place in the family for her favored twin sister, Sienna. Heartbroken but determined, Emma chooses Lucas and a new life in Zurich. As her old family finally faces the truth, Emma learns what real love, home, and belonging should feel like.

dramabox.title: Second Chance by the Tides
dramabox.norm_title: second chance by the tides
dramabox.description: In his past life, Ethan Hayes’ gambling addiction led to the tragic deaths of his wife and daughter. Reborn in a fishing village in the 1990s, he resolves to turn over a new leaf and protect his wife Claire and their daughter Mia. Gaining special underwater breathing and x-ray vision abilities, he dives into reef caves, isolated islands and deep seas to catch high-value seafood. Starting with a small wooden boat, he grows wealthy against all odds.

dramabox.title: Fired, Framed and Fierce
dramabox.norm_title: fired framed and fierce
dramabox.description: Jessica is the star quantitative trader at TB Securities, but she is unjustlyfired by the new male-dominated CEO, Jackson. Meanwhile, her achievements and identity are falsely claimed by her scheming colleague, Jessie. Jessie takes advantage of Jackson's misjudgment and steals Jessica's trading model, using it to frame Jessica. At the same time, William, the CEO of Charles Securities, steps in to support Jessica and hires her for his company.

dramabox.title: Heir of Divine Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: heir of divine fortune
dramabox.description: Maisy Harris, reincarnated as the God of Wealth, finds her mother Claire Evans ostracized by the Harris family for bearing her. Her birth father Ethan Harris forces Claire to divorce. With her divine wealth power, Maisy guides Claire to fortune. The motherdaughter duo fights back against their oppressors and rises to become the new wealthiest tycoons.

dramabox.title: Never Judge a Housewife
dramabox.norm_title: never judge a housewife
dramabox.description: Once a top student, Claire Hayes becomes a housewife and quietly attends a reunion, eating shrimp while classmates mock her. Tessa Price boasts about working at Orion Group and humiliates Claire for relying on her “unsuccessful” husband. Claire stays calm, knowing her husband is on his way. When Ethan Hayes walks in, everyone is stunned. He is the owner of the billion-dollar Orion Group that Tessa had been bragging about.

dramabox.title: From Killer to Crown
dramabox.norm_title: from killer to crown
dramabox.description: Betrayed and killed, elite modern assassin Claire Harrow wakes inside the body of a foolish, disfigured noblewoman with the same name. She publicly breaks her arranged engagement to Prince Adrian Drake, then turns on the stepmother who tormented her. Her medical skill saves the emperor, her poetry wins foreign envoys, and she rises from mockery to become empress.

dramabox.title: Framed by a Poem, Crowned by Blood
dramabox.norm_title: framed by a poem crowned by blood
dramabox.description: Adopted daughter Claire Carter's birthday poem for the Empress Dowager is twisted into treason. Before she can destroy it, her family's real daughter Vivian Carter steals credit — then disowns Claire and forces her to marry the brutal Prince of Huai. Claire watches calmly as her enemies fall, until she's revealed as the Empress Dowager's true daughter.

dramabox.title: The Daughter They Left Behind
dramabox.norm_title: the daughter they left behind
dramabox.description: Kidnapped as a child, Claire Carter was raised by tycoon Miles Blake. Reunited with her birth family at 18, she's coldly treated due to adopted sister Chloe Carter's manipulation. When kidnappers force the Carters to choose between their children, they abandon Claire without hesitation. Now heir to a business empire, she returns in disguise — only to reject their remorse: "I won't forgive you."

dramabox.title: The Ring That Woke My Ancestor
dramabox.norm_title: the ring that woke my ancestor
dramabox.description: Once a naive husband who trusted everyone, Logan Carter discovers his brother's betrayal during a mahjong game — guided by his ancestor's spirit, awakened through a family heirloom ring. He reclaims his rigged losses, exposes his wife's affair and hidden asset transfers, and divorces her. Then a lottery win and his ancestor's wisdom launch his rise to the top.

dramabox.title: What They Never Knew About Her
dramabox.norm_title: what they never knew about her
dramabox.description: Five years ago, wealthy Clara Wells funded student Mia Blake's education — only to be betrayed when Mia and her husband Derek Pierce abandoned Clara mid-labor, costing her the baby. Penniless, she left with nothing. Three years later, now married to tycoon Liam Carter, Clara runs into Derek at the airport. Mistaking her for a broke ex begging for reconciliation, he humiliates her — unaware she's the wife he's offering $1.4B to find.

dramabox.title: Wagering My Fiancé: I Bankrupted the Other Woman
dramabox.norm_title: wagering my fianc i bankrupted the other woman
dramabox.description: Former Las Vegas Gambling Queen Camille Welch gave up the tables for love—until her fiancé Stephen marries his "best friend" Jenny after a drunken bet. Humiliated in front of their elite circle, Camille joins their dice game and turns the night into a ruthless counterattack, winning back her pride, exposing betrayal, and finding a new love who truly stands beside her.

dramabox.title: The Unrivaled One: Back for Love and Glory
dramabox.norm_title: the unrivaled one back for love and glory
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole returns to the city after years of secret training, only to be sent back by his master before he can complete his journey. Planning to divorce Claire and leave his old life behind, he learns she has feelings for him and chooses to stay. Soon, Ethan’s hidden strength begins to show. He puts arrogant relatives and powerful enemies in their place, earns the family’s respect, and finally clears his path to power and love.

dramabox.title: Ancient Prince, Modern Domination
dramabox.norm_title: ancient prince modern domination
dramabox.description: Damon Norton, once the crown prince of the Sundia Dynasty a thousand years ago, accidentally travels to the modern world as a six-year-old boy after getting drunk. Living in Norton Manor, he is caught up in complicated family ties and internal power struggles. Relying on his wisdom, courage and remarkable talents, he gradually gains a firm foothold in the family and wins the favor and backing of his grandmother Vera Ward.

dramabox.title: My Second Life Made Me Rich
dramabox.norm_title: my second life made me rich
dramabox.description: In his past life, Adrian Stone was a gambler who drove his wife to death. Though he later became an expert in antiques, he lived with regret. Reborn just as his wife is about to end her life, he saves her and vows to change. Using his expert eye, Adrian turns $8 into a fortune by finding a rare bronze ox, trading antiques and jade. He fights ruthless debt collectors, opens Treasure Loft, and rises from disgraced gambler to wealthy family man.

dramabox.title: Awakened, She Rises as the Frost
dramabox.norm_title: awakened she rises as the frost
dramabox.description: The city-state of Os bans female magic. Callista, a frost prodigy, hides as a man for fifteen years after her aunt's execution. Lord Hethias attacks her father Damon and massacres her clan. Callista awakens her ancient bloodline, reveals her identity, slays Hethias, and fights for female mages' rights. She allies with Prince Silas and builds a new order free of gender discrimination.

dramabox.title: My Grumpy Captain, My Sunshine Girl
dramabox.norm_title: my grumpy captain my sunshine girl
dramabox.description: Former England captain Julian, abused by his coach, becomes suicidal. Cheerful Liana saves him; her mother Mary adopts him to help heal. Liana warms his heart, aids him against bullies, and exposes the coach's abuse. Julian secretly trains, returns to win a championship, and reveals a drug conspiracy. He regains his peak, dances with Liana at a charity ball, gives her a bluebell bracelet, and they create a healing family.

dramabox.title: I Tricked the Beast King Into Marriage
dramabox.norm_title: i tricked the beast king into marriage
dramabox.description: The immortal Fae of Greco‑Roman aesthetics rule the marble empire Elyssia. The human kingdom Avennia has paid tributes of servants to them for generations. The dreaded Mad King, transformed into a black lion, lies imprisoned. Only one human tribute slave disguised as a man can soothe him — for she is a lost siren, and his fated beloved.

dramabox.title: Two Wolves
dramabox.norm_title: two wolves
dramabox.description: Betrayed and branded a traitor three years ago, elite soldier Liam fights in underground rings to find the truth. There he meets Hector, a mad scion bent on destroying his own crime family. Two vengeful souls unite. They plot a bloody trap, carve through the family mansion, and together send the godfather, corrupt officials, and the entire empire straight to hell.

dramabox.title: Rise from Ruin: A Fortune from Nothing
dramabox.norm_title: rise from ruin a fortune from nothing
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter is cheated out of his share of the family fortune and left with nothing but a rundown shack. Abandoned by his wife, he discovers silver coins hidden beneath an old family bed. With his new capital, Ethan builds a business from scratch. When a devastating flood hits, he risks everything to save his neighbors. From a castoff to a successful entrepreneur, Ethan rewrites his fate without losing his integrity.

dramabox.title: Feed Their Greed: Watch Me Become God
dramabox.norm_title: feed their greed watch me become god
dramabox.description: Dorian Black is the weakest heir in his sect, until he unlocks a system that returns a thousandfold for everything he gives Adrian Cole. When his fiancée keeps forcing him to give up rare medicines and cultivation opportunities, Dorian gladly lets them go, knowing every sacrifice is part of his plan. As his sickly disciple plays the victim, Dorian quietly turns every setback into power and rises to the top.

dramabox.title: Mecha Era: Infinite Power Awakening
dramabox.norm_title: mecha era infinite power awakening
dramabox.description: Ethan Reid is the school’s only F-rank—and the only guy bold enough to approach the mech girl feared by every S-rank. When Ethan casually asks Tessa Gray to be his girlfriend, her icy composure shatters. But when she storms into his dorm that night, Ethan realizes flirting with the most powerful girl on campus comes with a price...

dramabox.title: The Wind Knows the Noble
dramabox.norm_title: the wind knows the noble
dramabox.description: Dr. Evelyn Carter, a young scientist at Eastbridge Biomedical Institute, is the quiet force behind universal synthetic blood, a breakthrough that could change emergency medicine worldwide. On the day her team receives news that the work has won the Nobel Prize in Medicine, Evelyn refuses a celebration because her family has arranged a first meeting with her fiance, Chase Whitmore, the ambitious CEO of Whitmore Biotech.

dramabox.title: The Last Stand: Defy the Heavenly Will
dramabox.norm_title: the last stand defy the heavenly will
dramabox.description: Lucian Vale awakens in a world ruled by gods and monsters as humanity’s last hope. With mankind hunted and abandoned by the powers above, he refuses to bow. He awakens the strength of those who came before, joins forces with unlikely allies, and leads the survivors against an overwhelming divine force. Against fate itself, Lucian fights to forge a future where humanity answers to no one.

dramabox.title: Grave-Born Vengeance： My Husband Tried to Kill Me
dramabox.norm_title: grave born vengeance my husband tried to kill me
dramabox.description: Born with a physical disability, Victoria Lee finds out her husband Julian Vance is cheating on her with his mistress Fiona Moore. The vicious duo plots to murder her, and they even hook up at her funeral, oblivious that Victoria lived through the attack. She lays low and secretly compiles solid proof, exposing Julian’s financial fraud and attempted murder. Julian gets the death penalty, and Fiona is locked away for years.

dramabox.title: Legacy of the Immortal: I Rule the Heavens
dramabox.norm_title: legacy of the immortal i rule the heavens
dramabox.description: Tessa Stone, Eastria’s revered saint, abandons her homeland for Lumenia with a priceless relic, mocking Damon Vale as a relic of the past. Unaware of his true power, Damon unveils a legendary legacy that ushers Eastria into a golden age. When dark forces descend, Lumenia falls apart. Stripped of her powers and drowning in debt, Tessa begs to return—only to watch Eastria thrive without her, left with nothing but regret.

dramabox.title: The Spy Who Owned Me
dramabox.norm_title: the spy who owned me
dramabox.description: After surviving a deadly attack, innocent Sofie is abducted by ruthless spy Sterling Black. To stay alive, she must become his wife and enter his dangerous world. As betrayal, conspiracy, and enemies close in, their forced marriage turns into a powerful love—and a fight for survival.

dramabox.title: Beg Me, My Mafia Ex-Husband
dramabox.norm_title: beg me my mafia ex husband
dramabox.description: After three years of marriage, Elena was forced by Adrian to abort four times on the grounds that their babies carried a genetic defect. Pregnant again, she discovered his scheme to avenge his old love, Sophia. Turning the tables, Elena let Sophia take her place for the surgery, then fled with proof and her child. After his scheme was exposed, Adrian lost his marriage and faced regret alone.

dramabox.title: Almost Home: When Hearts Remember
dramabox.norm_title: almost home when hearts remember
dramabox.description: Little Annie is separated from her family when their debts force them apart and is adopted by the Mason family as Mia. Treated like a servant, she’s nearly handed over to a ruthless creditor by her adoptive mother and sister. Then her birth mother, renowned Vivian Carter, rescues her and brings her home. But jealous housekeeper Cora Blake schemes to drive Mia away—until Vivian sees through her lies.

dramabox.title: My Second Life, My Rules
dramabox.norm_title: my second life my rules
dramabox.description: In Brenton Court, neighbors share tangled lives shaped by everyday struggles and changing times. Ethan Hale, a kind-hearted cook at Ironvale Works, once trusted the wrong people and ended up freezing to death beneath Greyford Arch. Reborn with a second chance, Ethan vows to rewrite his fate, break free from the Graves House, and build the life, love, and career he truly deserves.

dramabox.title: He Lost His Memory, Not His Power
dramabox.norm_title: he lost his memory not his power
dramabox.description: Logan Stone is sent to Jeston by the Carter Clan to protect genius CEO Claire Carter, who is developing a cancer cure, while searching for his lost memories. After saving star Diana Rose from hijackers, he wins Claire’s respect with his unmatched skills, exposes Martha Doyle as a traitor, and foils Victor Crowe and Adrian Bishop’s schemes. After saving Claire from danger again and again, Logan discovers she is his childhood sweetheart. They finally reunite.

dramabox.title: Left Behind, I Rose Above All
dramabox.norm_title: left behind i rose above all
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter is forced to give up his college spot for his cousin. The woman he loves, Claire Foster, even marries Blake Voss to help her cousin fake depression. Heartbroken by his family and fiancée, Ethan leaves home and enters Aegis University. There, he meets Ava Carter and finds a new love. When Claire finally sees Blake’s true colors and returns to Ethan, he turns her down. Ethan and Ava find happiness, while Claire grows old alone.

dramabox.title: The Price of "Good Luck"
dramabox.norm_title: the price of good luck
dramabox.description: As the Carter family welcomes their new bride, neighbor Debra Barton exploits an old grudge — blocking the wedding car under the guise of "lucky money," then slipping into the bridal room to steal $125,000 worth of gold jewelry. Despite ironclad evidence, she denies everything and shows no remorse — until the bride reports her, and she's arrested.

dramabox.title: Zora: Daughter of Thunder
dramabox.norm_title: zora daughter of thunder
dramabox.description: A prophecy foretells a supreme divine child. King Vos's three pure-blood princes fail the trial, but his half-human daughter Zora, a temple maid, awakens supreme thunder. Queen Mera hides her power and is enslaved. When Sea God Neros invades, Mera is wounded, Zora unleashes her power. Neros forces Vos to strip Zora's power. Mera sacrifices herself, Zora falls and is saved. Three years later, she returns, defeats Neros, rescues Mera, and is crowned Goddess of War.

dramabox.title: At 50, My Career Was Just Beginning
dramabox.norm_title: at 50 my career was just beginning
dramabox.description: Skilled technician Gordon Carter brings his son to fetch the bride from her father's home — the workshop director's family. They demand a steep "door-opening fee," then abruptly ask for $30,000 more just to be called "dad." Despite the Carters' patience, the bride mocks them. Seeing through their greed, Gordon refuses the wedding on the spot.

dramabox.title: Starring in Love: My Billionaire Agent
dramabox.norm_title: starring in love my billionaire agent
dramabox.description: Struggling actress Annie Reed mistakes billionaire investor Ethan Drake for a down-and-out nobody and hires him as her agent. They quickly become the perfect team, and feelings grow between them. But Ethan hides his true identity, fearing she’ll reject him. As his secret comes to light, Annie’s forgotten past does too—she was once a legendary movie star.

dramabox.title: Transmigrated to Dominate:The Comeback System
dramabox.norm_title: transmigrated to dominate the comeback system
dramabox.description: Evan Shaw wakes up inside a romance novel as a useless rich heir. On his wedding night, he catches his fiancée betraying him with his cousin, while his own family humiliates and bullies him. Then his comeback system kicks in. Evan refuses to take it anymore and turns the tables, making every enemy pay for what they’ve done.

dramabox.title: The Diary That Ended Us
dramabox.norm_title: the diary that ended us
dramabox.description: The day his mother dies, Evan Brooks learns his wife Elise Hayes is out meeting her first love — and reading her diary, discovers she's only ever seen him as a stand-in. Five years of marriage, and she never let go of the other man. Heartbroken, Evan walks away. Too late, Elise regrets everything.

dramabox.title: The Truth Behind His Silence
dramabox.norm_title: the truth behind his silence
dramabox.description: When his wife Chloe Blair suffers a sudden amniotic fluid embolism during childbirth, Dr. Ethan Hayes — the only doctor who can save her — sits calmly outside the delivery room playing games. Claiming hospital policy bars doctors from treating family, he lets everyone brand him heartless. But a hidden truth lies behind his cold composure.

dramabox.title: Burned as a Witch, Chosen by the Prince
dramabox.norm_title: burned as a witch chosen by the prince
dramabox.description: In a plague-ravaged kingdom where female healers are burned as witches, Ava survives a deadly fall and is blessed with a miraculous healing gift. After the knight she heals condemns her, Prince Jackson rescues her from the flames. To save the poisoned King and stop a monstrous blood plague, Ava must defy the Church and rise from a hunted healer to a Queen.

dramabox.title: Her Six Billionaire Knights
dramabox.norm_title: her six billionaire knights
dramabox.description: Switched at birth, Lily spends twenty years with the Bennetts until Chloe arrives, exposing Lily is not their biological daughter. The Bennetts grow cold and alienate her, pushing Lily to seek her birth family, the wealthy Carters.Chloe learns Lily once saved Ashton and attempts to steal her identity to marry him. Right as Ashton finds out the truth, Chloe kidnaps Lily. Lily’s parents and brothers rush to rescue her, revealing the Carters’ immense fortune.

dramabox.title: Real Heiress Reborn, Settling The Score
dramabox.norm_title: real heiress reborn settling the score
dramabox.description: After Sylvia Morgan took her kidney and left her for dead, Claire Morgan gets a second chance at life. This time, she’ll expose Sylvia and protect what’s hers. Sylvia fakes kidney failure by secretly taking drugs that destroy her kidneys, all to steal Claire’s. But Claire has a plan. When the surgery begins, the doctors find cabbages inside her instead of a kidney.

dramabox.title: Built Her Up, Watched Her Fall
dramabox.norm_title: built her up watched her fall
dramabox.description: Rural, middle-school dropout Chloe Grant and her mother beg relative Gavin Carter for help; softhearted, he brings her into his media company. Groomed into a top livestreamer, she reveals her true greed when the company preps for IPO — demanding shares and bonuses, then storming out when refused. She mistook luck for skill.

dramabox.title: The Healer Returns: Blood for Blood（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the healer returns blood for blood dubbed
dramabox.description: Anthony Claydon has the Cinder Drake Physique and peerless medical skills. He descends the mountains to find one with the Bloomborn Physique to attain a breakthrough in his cultivation. At the same time, he looks for Sagebeast Jade shards to unlock the mystery of his origin. Anthony's amazing feats help him assemble helpful companions along the way. When he collects all the shards, the truth from 12 years ago finally sees the light of day.

dramabox.title: The Twin Project: Their Failed Daughter Was The Real Success
