dramabox.norm_title: the twin project their failed daughter was the real success
dramabox.description: Raised as the "failed" twin in her parents' cruel social experiment, Laurel Hale was neglected while her sister Lydia received every advantage. When their final livestream exposes the truth, Laurel returns to confront her parents, reclaim her stolen life, and prove that survival was never failure—it was her greatest success.

dramabox.title: The Lost Son of Zeus: His Return
dramabox.norm_title: the lost son of zeus his return
dramabox.description: Hercules, the son of Zeus and Hera, goes missing as a child and is swapped with the mortal Icaris by an envious follower. Eighteen years later, Hercules travels to Olympus to join the Divine Guards to save his beloved, far outperforming Icaris. Unaware of his true identity, Zeus's family, instigated by Icaris, cruelly suppress and exile him. Once the truth is revealed, Zeus's family desperately begs for forgiveness, while Icaris conspires with Hades for revenge.

dramabox.title: Absolute Supremacy: He Answers to No One
dramabox.norm_title: absolute supremacy he answers to no one
dramabox.description: Damon Stone secretly builds his wife Sophie Hart’s company into a rising powerhouse, hiding his true identity as Summit Corp’s chairman. But when Ronan Ward turns Sophie against him, she divorces Damon, believing he’s a useless husband. At Summit Corp’s bidding, Damon finally reveals who he is—and leaves everyone who mocked him stunned.

dramabox.title: Divine Fury: The One Beyond the Heavens
dramabox.norm_title: divine fury the one beyond the heavens
dramabox.description: After years in exile, Julian Carter is rejected by Lumera’s top prodigy, who thinks he’s no longer worthy of her. Unfazed, Julian walks away—only to return to the world when the family that once saved him falls into crisis. In Cortan, he helps Alyssa Moore rebuild her clan and protects her from powerful enemies. As their bond deepens, a shocking announcement spreads: a mysterious emperor will reveal himself in three days and marry a mystery bride.

dramabox.title: The Almighty Sovereign: Stealing Hearts, Crushing Foes
dramabox.norm_title: the almighty sovereign stealing hearts crushing foes
dramabox.description: After years in seclusion, Ethan Cole leaves his mentor Silas Drake’s remote village and steps into the real world. In Jeston, he saves Claire Grant, then catches the eye of the powerful Hayes family, who want him to date their daughter, Emily. But Ethan also wins over Emily’s best friend, Mia, turning their lives into a playful tangle of romance, rivalry, and elite family drama.

dramabox.title: Back to Revenge: The True Heiress Takes All
dramabox.norm_title: back to revenge the true heiress takes all
dramabox.description: Sofia Miller, the true heiress of a billionaire family, is betrayed and killed by her fake heiress sister Chloe Carter and her boyfriend, Adrian Keller. Sofia Miller is reborn with a mysterious power to steal anything. She drains Chloe’s fortune and turns the tables at every turn. As Sofia rises, she uncovers the truth: Chloe’s mother, the family nanny, switched them at birth. Now the real heiress is back—and she’s ready to make them pay.

dramabox.title: No More Secretary, No More Secret Lover（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: no more secretary no more secret lover dubbed
dramabox.description: Sierra Drew has loved Milo Gant for years. At night, she's his lover, but during the day, she's his secretary. When his first love, Elle Cady, returns, Sierra is cast aside and repeatedly set up while he turns a blind eye. Thoroughly disappointed and heartbroken, Sierra leaves. Only then does Milo realize her worth and see through Elle's schemes. But by the time he tries to win her back, she has made up her mind to stay away forever.

dramabox.title: Raised to Betray: A Debt Unpaid
dramabox.norm_title: raised to betray a debt unpaid
dramabox.description: Blackgold Group chairman Henry Grant has spent years living in the countryside, quietly raising orphan Mia Hale as his own. After Mia is reunited with her wealthy birth parents and graduates from an elite university, she slowly turns against the man who raised her. Secretly chosen as Blackgold's future heir, Mia credits her success to her biological family instead. At her wedding, she publicly humiliates Henry—until he reveals the identity that changes everything.

dramabox.title: The Final Balance: Karma at the Counter
dramabox.norm_title: the final balance karma at the counter
dramabox.description: When Emily Hart's ATM card is swallowed after a frustrating encounter with customer service, she discovers money has mysteriously vanished from her account. Just as she's running out of options, the malfunctioning ATM suddenly begins spewing out endless stacks of cash. As chaos erupts and temptation takes over, one impossible moment changes everyone's fate forever.

dramabox.title: The CEO Lost His Memory, Not His Love
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo lost his memory not his love
dramabox.description: Ethan Hayes, CEO of Hayes Group, loses his memory after a car accident caused by a vehicle malfunction. He is rescued by Clara Parker, a fish seller. After six years together, they fall in love, get married, run a fish stall, and have twins. Their family of four lives happily until an unexpected incident shatters their peaceful life.

dramabox.title: The Teacher Behind the Legends
dramabox.norm_title: the teacher behind the legends
dramabox.description: After Graham Hale develops dementia, his daughter Chloe Hale thinks he is just rambling when he points at famous figures on the news and says, “My students.” She later discovers her father was once a village teacher and posts online to find his former students, only to be mocked by everyone. On his birthday, billionaires, engineers, and rocket experts return—the eight mountain kids he taught 20 years ago have all become pillars of Dragonia.

dramabox.title: Reborn to Rule the Savage World
dramabox.norm_title: reborn to rule the savage world
dramabox.description: Overworked office worker Logan Hart dies from exhaustion and wakes up in a primitive era as a dethroned tribal leader on the brink of ruin. Bound to a seemingly useless system, he discovers its true power after saving two desperate sisters. With the system’s help, Logan wins his people’s loyalty, builds a thriving tribe, fights enemies, and transforms a fallen clan into a mighty empire, rising from a disgraced chief to a legendary ruler.

dramabox.title: The Perfect Suspect: Secrets Unfold
dramabox.norm_title: the perfect suspect secrets unfold
dramabox.description: On exam day, top student Claire Stone shocks everyone by confessing to cheating and handing over a cheat sheet with answers to exams that haven't happened yet. Despite securing a spot at Kingswell, she risks losing everything, including the money for her father's surgery. When investigators find the answers match the next day's exam exactly, she's accused of stealing classified test materials—until the impossible truth is finally revealed.

dramabox.title: The Heiress's Immortal Bodyguard
dramabox.norm_title: the heiress s immortal bodyguard
dramabox.description: As a world-ending meteor descends, immortal cultivator Damon Hale returns to Earth after a thousand years away, destroying it with a single strike—but accidentally wrecking a billionaire's aircraft. Hiding his identity, he becomes heiress Sophie Stone's bodyguard. As enemies close in and a mysterious alien threat emerges from the meteor's remains, Damon must protect Sophie without revealing the power that could change the world forever.

dramabox.title: Kindness Turned Away: Her Costly Mistake
dramabox.norm_title: kindness turned away her costly mistake
dramabox.description: Bank teller Chloe Hart accidentally gives Ethan Cole far too much cash. When Ethan tries to return it, Chloe mistakes him for a scammer and publicly humiliates him. He leaves with the money, and only then does Chloe realize she drove away the one honest man who tried to do the right thing.

dramabox.title: Divorced and Loaded: The Billionaire She Cast Away（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: divorced and loaded the billionaire she cast away dubbed
dramabox.description: Andrew Miller, a 45-year-old barbecue stall owner known as the town laughingstock spends 30 years serving his wealthy wife and her family, only to be humiliated endlessly. One night, she appears with her business tycoon lover and forces Andrew to sign divorce papers in public, leaving him homeless and penniless. But everything changes when he discovers he is the sole heir to his late uncle's fortune.

dramabox.title: The Exiled Mech Ace
dramabox.norm_title: the exiled mech ace
dramabox.description: Once the legendary Alpha and the only pilot compatible with Apollo, Mark, is framed after his teammate Steven is killed in an attack on Federal Command. Exiled and reduced to a janitor, he is drawn back into battle when Steven's personal weapon resurfaces, revealing the first trace of a vast conspiracy. As rival bases fall and the Abyss Lord is unleashed, Mark must reclaim Apollo, uncover the truth, and push his sync rate beyond all limits to save Earth.

dramabox.title: Crimson Abyss: The Dark Godfather's Contract Bride
dramabox.norm_title: crimson abyss the dark godfather s contract bride
dramabox.description: Top bounty hunter Katerina seeks revenge for her mentor's murder, entering a vampire-werewolf underworld. Near death, vampire godfather Valerius saves her and forces a blood bond. They unite against enemies, uncover conspiracies, and awaken her Saintess power. They defeat the vampire elder, escape overseas, but the ancient Vampire Progenitor awakens.

dramabox.title: Bride of the Sea God
dramabox.norm_title: bride of the sea god
dramabox.description: Cassandra is framed and thrown into the sea as a sacrifice. Near death, her ancient pendant awakens Triton, son of Poseidon. They form a marriage bond. She returns to reclaim her family estate, but faces the pursuit of the Olympian gods. She rises from sacrifice to stand beside a god, and together with Triton, she breaks the curse on demigods and ascends to godhood.

dramabox.title: Too Late to Miss Me
dramabox.norm_title: too late to miss me
dramabox.description: Anna, orphaned, grew up with the Kane brothers Gordy and Jonathan. She managed their hockey club. Katie schemes and turns them against her. She leaves and becomes manager for Ethan. The brothers realize the truth too late.

dramabox.title: Abandoned by Love, Avenged by Blood
dramabox.norm_title: abandoned by love avenged by blood
dramabox.description: Martial-arts heiress Claire Stone defied her family for Adrian Harlan, bearing his son and surrendering her clan's secret technique. He repaid her by marrying an heiress and tormenting her for years. When her daughter Avery reunites with his long-searching grandfather, the two return to shield her, standing up to the Harlan and Carter families and making every tormentor pay.

dramabox.title: A Knock of Fortune, A Gift of Love
dramabox.norm_title: a knock of fortune a gift of love
dramabox.description: Born with extraordinary luck, Lily Hayes is left mentally disabled after her parents refuse to save her while trying to protect her feverish brother. Four years later, they abandon her to escape their debts. Debt collector Logan Carter takes her in after her luck helps her find a gold ring. When his family tries to sell her off, Logan rescues Lily, walks away from them, and together they build the family they never had.

dramabox.title: Cutting the Power: No Mercy for the Ungrateful
dramabox.norm_title: cutting the power no mercy for the ungrateful
dramabox.description: For seven years, Gavin Stone kept Dunridge Village's water and power running, charging only a token fee. Framed by jealous rivals, he was fined and forced to stop. When the village turned against him, even vandalizing his home, Gavin's son Ethan returned with a lawyer. Together they exposed the truth. Gavin later rebuilt the utility system, charging fair rates while helping those truly in need.

dramabox.title: Framed for Cheating? I'm Gone, Now the King is Broken!
dramabox.norm_title: framed for cheating i m gone now the king is broken
dramabox.description: When Queen Willa's daughter awakens as a leopard instead of a royal black panther, Willa is accused of betraying Shifter King Kael. Stripped of her crown and imprisoned with her children, she escapes with Kael's charming brother—only to uncover a deeper conspiracy. As rebellion erupts, Willa must expose the truth, protect her daughters, and decide whether the king who doubted her deserves a second chance.

dramabox.title: When I Left, the Haunted Houses Woke Up
dramabox.norm_title: when i left the haunted houses woke up
dramabox.description: I spent three years helping my bankrupt boyfriend build Hale Realty into a billion-dollar empire with my psychic gift for haunted properties. But when I discovered Martin cheating with billionaire heiress Vanessa Reed, he called me a fraud and threw me away. Broken but determined, I walked into the rain—until a black Maybach arrived. Damian Blackwood, the world`s most powerful real estate tycoon, offered me a new beginning. Now, those who betrayed me will learn my true worth.

dramabox.title: Shadow Hunter: The Buried King
dramabox.norm_title: shadow hunter the buried king
dramabox.description: In a world where monsters stalk the shadows, he’s dismissed as a worthless “Monster-Hunter.” But when a deadly sorceress drags him into her lethal game, the tables turn. As she believes she’s pulling the strings, he silently dismantles her plans—and everyone else’s. He isn’t just playing the game; he’s rewriting the rules. In this dark dance of deception, who is truly hunting whom?

dramabox.title: Reborn as a Princess: All My Followers Are S-Rank
dramabox.norm_title: reborn as a princess all my followers are s rank
dramabox.description: Lillian transmigrates into a novel as a useless princess and cannon fodder. She awakens an S-rank vampire and gains followers. She steals everything from her enemy Lilia, defeats her, and becomes queen after her mother sacrifices herself to seal an evil spirit. She saves the kingdom and rewrites her fate.

dramabox.title: Weak Fate:Thunder Rise
dramabox.norm_title: weak fate thunder rise
dramabox.description: Evan, once a prodigy, is disgraced with F-rank healing magic, dumped, bullied, and framed for dark magic. He hides thunder power, eventually unleashes it to defeat corrupt lords and rise as a legendary savior.

dramabox.title: Deadwater: The Final Escape
dramabox.norm_title: deadwater the final escape
dramabox.description: After his girlfriend and best friend betray him and leave him to a monster in the lake, Ronan Greer wakes up on the island hours before the massacre begins. His warnings are mocked, but Sophie Lane, the island owner, begins to believe him as each impossible prediction comes true. Then boats fail, people vanish, and something starts circling beneath the water. Ronan has already died here once. Can he escape before the lake claims him again?

dramabox.title: The Hunter's Legacy: Into the Deep Wild
dramabox.norm_title: the hunter s legacy into the deep wild
dramabox.description: In the rugged Alder Range, Ethan Stone walks away from a ruthless hunting boss who has exploited him for years. Relying on his family's hunting skills, he forms his own crew and ventures deep into the wilderness for valuable furs. Despite sabotage, arson, and dirty tactics from his rival, Ethan builds an honest business, provides for his family, and carves out a future of his own.

dramabox.title: Swapped Fate, Fated Love
dramabox.norm_title: swapped fate fated love
dramabox.description: The true heiress Guinevere was swapped at birth and raised in poverty. She returns not for family love, but to reclaim her title and inheritance. Against the fake heiress, biased parents, and loyal brother, she uses wit and strategy. She also draws the cold crown prince Reginald into her revenge chess game, staging a powerful comeuppance.

dramabox.title: From Outcast to Immortal Legend
dramabox.norm_title: from outcast to immortal legend
dramabox.description: Abandoned by the Hayes Clan, Ethan Hayes endures ten years of humiliation while guarding a cemetery. After breaking the seal on his true power, he shocks everyone at the Tournament, only to be betrayed by his own father and cast out again. When all hope seems lost, the old cemetery keeper finally reveals her incredible power and crushes every enemy in his path. As Ethan rises beyond every limit, a war spanning the human, demon, and immortal realms begins.

dramabox.title: The True Heiress, The Rejected Wife
dramabox.norm_title: the true heiress the rejected wife
dramabox.description: Clara Hart gave three years to her husband's family, using her design talent to rescue his failing clothing business. Instead of gratitude, she faced abuse and was framed, then kicked out penniless. Her own parents refused to help. Just when all hope seemed lost, the city's richest family revealed she was their kidnapped daughter.

dramabox.title: Shattered Heirlooms, Hidden Crowns
dramabox.norm_title: shattered heirlooms hidden crowns
dramabox.description: To support her first love's career, Stella Pryce sponsors a TV antique show and brings her husband Ethan Cole's prized possessions onto it, smashing them as worthless junk. In reality, they are invaluable antiques. Disillusioned, Ethan files for divorce and unveils his secret identity. When Stella discovers the devastating truth, she regrets everything and kneels to beg Ethan's forgiveness.

dramabox.title: Code of Justice: No Second Chances
dramabox.norm_title: code of justice no second chances
dramabox.description: Rising scientist Ethan Miller is assigned to protect a top-secret breakthrough. But when his fiancée, Mia Carter, and her friend Vera Hayes falsely accuse a renowned scientist and destroy decades of priceless research, Ethan refuses to cover for them. Using his groundbreaking recovery technology, he restores the lost data, lets them face the consequences, and becomes the nation's youngest top scientist.

dramabox.title: Dangerous！She’s Really Psychotic
dramabox.norm_title: dangerous she s really psychotic
dramabox.description: After losing her mother, Kang Ye-rin suffers years of abuse from her stepfather, Park Dong-chul. When she fights back against his assault, he has her committed to a psychiatric hospital and drugged. However, he later has her released because of her scholarship. After enrolling in an elite high school, Ye-rin faces vicious bullying from the principal's daughter, Han Seo-jin. Refusing to be broken, she fights back and finally reveals the truth about her traumatic past.

dramabox.title: He Left Her, Then Rose to the Top
dramabox.norm_title: he left her then rose to the top
dramabox.description: For three years, Ethan Carter hid his true identity and secretly helped his wife become a business star. But when he returns home and finds her pregnant with her ex's child, he ends their marriage and withdraws every resource he gave her. As his true identity is revealed, her life falls apart. Ethan eventually leaves the betrayal behind and finds a fresh start with Claire Morgan, the woman who truly understands him.

dramabox.title: The Healer Who Saved Them All
dramabox.norm_title: the healer who saved them all
dramabox.description: The Little Medicine King is banished to the mortal world and becomes Ethan Hale’s fiancée, Paige Reed. The Hale family discovers they can hear Paige’s thoughts, exposing Tessa Blake and Victor Ryder’s affair and their plot to cause Ethan’s crash, steal his assets, and destroy the family. As Paige’s inner voice reveals the truth, she earns their trust and heals Ethan’s injured leg. Together, they defeat the villains and protect the Hale family fortune.

dramabox.title: The Secret My Father Buried
dramabox.norm_title: the secret my father buried
dramabox.description: At her father’s funeral, Claire Lane faces a pregnant sponsored student who claims to carry her father’s child and demands the inheritance. With a DNA report, the woman turns relatives against the family. Claire reveals her father’s sealed documents, exposing the truth: her father was actually a woman who lived as a man for years. The student’s fraud is uncovered, and Claire protects her family and her father’s legacy.

dramabox.title: Two Weddings, One Winner
dramabox.norm_title: two weddings one winner
dramabox.description: On his wedding day, groom Logan Carter discovers his fiancée Vivian has been cheating with her ex, Ryan. Logan calmly calls off the engagement and moves on with his true love, Ava. Vivian assumes he's still in the dark—until their wedding collides head-on with his. Logan exposes her affair on video; Ava reveals Ryan's HIV diagnosis. As their scheme unravels, Logan and Ava walk away to their happily-ever-after.

dramabox.title: Dumped Her Groom, Married the Regent Instead
dramabox.norm_title: dumped her groom married the regent instead
dramabox.description: Heiress Claire Grant fakes paralysis to test her fiancé Ryan Walker's loyalty after saving him. Discovering his affair with her best friend before the wedding, she plays along — only to publicly divorce him at the altar and marry the true hero who rescued her, Ethan Sawyer, leaving her ex scrambling to save face by marrying her friend instead.

dramabox.title: Love Lost Its Way, Greed in Their Blood
dramabox.norm_title: love lost its way greed in their blood
dramabox.description: After losing her husband, Vivian Harris devoted her life to raising her three sons, sacrificing everything to give them the lives they dreamed of. When a life-changing inheritance finally offers her a fresh start, she turns to the family she gave everything for—only to discover she no longer has a place in their lives.

dramabox.title: Wealth in Disguise: The Gold Digger's Downfall
dramabox.norm_title: wealth in disguise the gold digger s downfall
dramabox.description: After spending a lifetime building a real estate empire, Elaine Ward and Gordon Stone choose a quiet life working undercover at one of their own properties. But when an ambitious new manager fires and humiliates them to impress the family's wealthy heir, she has no idea she's just driven away the true owners. As partners walk away and her perfect plan unravels, her dream of marrying into the Stone family is about to collapse.

dramabox.title: Househusband's Revenge: Casting Off a Heartless Family（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: househusband s revenge casting off a heartless family dubbed
dramabox.description: On their 20th wedding anniversary, James Wrighy's wife and son fly overseas to celebrate her first love's birthday. When they are kidnapped, he brings the ransom but is forced to stay behind as a hostage so the other man can go free. After waiting three years for rescue, he returns home to find his son calling another man "Dad" and his wife accepting his mistreatment. Heartbroken, he finally walks away, leaving them full of regret.

dramabox.title: I'll Raise The Sun Without You
dramabox.norm_title: i ll raise the sun without you
dramabox.description: After saving the world's energy future with a breakthrough in controllable fusion, CEO Gary returns to find his fiancée Olivia—manipulated by her scheming confidant, William—turning the company against him. They keep humiliating Gary, trying to turn him into an obedient puppet. Now, Gary faces a choice: walk away for good, or strike back to reclaim his company and his love.

dramabox.title: Beyond Extinction: Age of Mutation
dramabox.norm_title: beyond extinction age of mutation
dramabox.description: FBI agent Eli Kane is infected with the man-made Eden Virus. While other infected people break down genetically after enhancement, he gains stable super strength and fast healing.Teaming up with Sonya, Jasper and Lena, he fights CEO Byron, who spreads the virus to build superhumans with the deadly Adam strain.Lena’s sacrifice enables Sonya to develop an antidote. Eli defeats Byron and destroys his lab. Yet a secret signal exposes the Eden Project is ongoing on the Moon.

dramabox.title: Stole My House, Pay The Price
dramabox.norm_title: stole my house pay the price
dramabox.description: A decade after walking away from a painful divorce, Claire Hale returns to sell the home she never gave up—only to find strangers living inside, claiming it's theirs. As the dispute spirals out of control, a shocking investigation exposes the truth. Claire takes back what belongs to her and makes everyone behind the scheme pay the price.

dramabox.title: Star Sigil Dynasty: The Fractured Serpent Ring
dramabox.norm_title: star sigil dynasty the fractured serpent ring
dramabox.description: In her first life, Elara is murdered by her brother, sister-in-law, and mastermind Victor. Reborn before succession, she fails to save her father. Joining forces with her underestimated fiancé Leo, she exposes a decade-long plot to kill the king and seize the kingdom, reclaims the Starmark Ring, and takes her rightful throne.

dramabox.title: Betrayed on Her Wedding Day
dramabox.norm_title: betrayed on her wedding day
dramabox.description: At her wedding, Elena Reed's own sister falsely accuses her, destroying her reputation. Furious, fiancé Victor Kane banishes her to work as a hostess at Noir Lounge, where she endures brutal humiliation for two months. Brought home only to be coldly ignored, Elena is finally pulled from despair by Dr. Shaw, the family physician secretly in love with her for years.

dramabox.title: The Duke's Addiction: Queen of Can-Can
dramabox.norm_title: the duke s addiction queen of can can
dramabox.description: Betrayed and murdered by her scheming lover, the “Can-Can Queen” awakens in her past—right before her downfall. This time, she spurns the penniless poet and claims the powerful Duke who secretly adores her. With his influence as her weapon, she crushes her enemies and transforms from a pawn into a queen. But as she rewrites her destiny, she discovers the Duke’s love runs deeper than she ever imagined. Revenge is sweet, but power is addictive.

dramabox.title: Stranded Together: I Outsurvive the Mistress
dramabox.norm_title: stranded together i outsurvive the mistress
dramabox.description: Survival expert Luna is betrayed by her fiancé David and his secretary Linda on a company retreat. They tie her up before a tsunami to claim insurance and her company. Luna is reborn with memories of the disaster, returns to the retreat, and uses survival skills to build shelter, gather supplies, and fight back. She exposes the truth, with help from geologist Jon, and ensures the villains face justice.

dramabox.title: Rising from theAshes, I Cut All Blood Ties
dramabox.norm_title: rising from theashes i cut all blood ties
dramabox.description: Clara takes the fall for her family's favored adopted daughter and spends years behind bars. The day she walks free, she discovers every song, script, and business plan she created has been stolen by her own family, who have disowned her. No more begging or playing nice. With her buried talent, she fights back to reclaim everything—and they will pay.

dramabox.title: The First Lady's Game
dramabox.norm_title: the first lady s game
dramabox.description: Zeus is mired in a sex scandal, pushing his wife Hera into politics. Hera fends off attacks, wins over his inner circle and even his enemies, and seizes his political standing, power, and network, completing an independent power takeover.

dramabox.title: Whispers of Hope, Dreams of Miracles
dramabox.norm_title: whispers of hope dreams of miracles
dramabox.description: In 1975, young Mia Stone is left with nothing but a mysterious whistle from her missing father. When it opens a gateway to the modern world, she secretly trades for food, medicine, and better seeds to help her struggling family survive. Guarding its incredible secret, Mia changes their destiny and becomes the little lucky star who brings her family back together.

dramabox.title: Greed Drowned Their Home
dramabox.norm_title: greed drowned their home
dramabox.description: Ethan Grant built a flood levee for his village using two million of his own funds. Village couple Darla Trent and Earl Parker tried to extort money by lying in front of trucks to stop the levee from being closed. Enraged, Ethan altered the levee’s path to go behind their house, cutting their property outside the flood barrier. When flash floods hit, the entire village remained protected by the levee, while Darla and Earl’s house was destroyed by the flood.

dramabox.title: She Lost Me Before She Knew Who I Was
dramabox.norm_title: she lost me before she knew who i was
dramabox.description: Ethan Stone devoted himself to his secret marriage for three years, but his wife, Bella Hayes, chose her former lover instead. Heartbroken, Ethan files for divorce and eventually falls in love with Claire Evans. When a powerful tycoon targets Claire, Ethan reveals his true identity as the heir to a trillion-dollar business empire and crushes every threat. By the time Bella regrets her choice, it's far too late.

dramabox.title: The Crown Prince in Disguise
dramabox.norm_title: the crown prince in disguise
dramabox.description: Victor Crown trains in a valley of criminals and killers, defeating opponent after opponent to earn his freedom. He marries Claire Stone in a whirlwind wedding, only to face rejection from everyone around them. As suspicion mounts over his true identity, his power reveals the truth: he's the crown prince himself—and every rival must bow before him.

dramabox.title: Once a War Goddess, Never a Fool
dramabox.norm_title: once a war goddess never a fool
dramabox.description: Vivian Blake loses her memory after Reed House's cruelty leaves her a "fool." When she saves Ethan Reed's life, he marries her out of gratitude—but a minister's daughter wants him for herself, and his own mother and sister push him to divorce. At the divorce banquet, a carriage collision restores Vivian's memory. She keeps playing the fool... until Ethan's sister pushes her luck too far.

dramabox.title: The Girl Who Brought Fortune and Death
dramabox.norm_title: the girl who brought fortune and death
dramabox.description: In a famine-stricken village, orphan Elsie Hale can bring wealth overnight—but everyone who adopts her mysteriously dies on the seventh day. When villager Brent Hale discovers gold teeth hidden in her dead guardian's mouth, he and his wife Tara secretly adopt Elsie, planning to kill her before the curse strikes.

dramabox.title: The Time-Traveling Healer's Impossible Life
dramabox.norm_title: the time traveling healer s impossible life
dramabox.description: Modern doctor Evan Heller wakes up in ancient times, saves a dying king, and is hailed as 'the Healer'—then nearly forced into marrying a princess. Fleeing that fate, he stumbles into the lives of three very different women, helping each fend off unwanted suitors. But as their feelings for him quietly grow, Evan finds himself hopelessly, hilariously outnumbered.

dramabox.title: His Return Was Their Downfall
dramabox.norm_title: his return was their downfall
dramabox.description: After ten years at war, General Rowan Harrow returns to find an impostor, Vivian Harrow, posing as his daughter—while the real Claire has been abused and imprisoned. Rowan rescues her, then clashes with the crown prince and emperor over her treatment. As Vivian's treason and the prince's conspiracy surface, Rowan forces the emperor's abdication, installing Claire as regent.

dramabox.title: A Farce of Love, A Family of Secrets
dramabox.norm_title: a farce of love a family of secrets
dramabox.description: "Claire Hayes and Logan Grant finally remarry after many hardships. But on their wedding night, her ex-husband and lifesaver shows up, begging her to pretend to be his wife to fend off a persistent pursuer. Logan, jealous but grateful, reluctantly agrees and gets the whole family to play along. What follows is a hilarious chain of comedic chaos. Yet beneath all the farce, a long-buried secret about Claire's real identity begins to unravel.

dramabox.title: Shift the Tide, Rule the Realm
dramabox.norm_title: shift the tide rule the realm
dramabox.description: Modern-day Lucas Hart wakes up in the Drayen Empire and nearly loses his head after offending the Empress. To survive, he turns modern knowledge into his greatest weapon, outsmarting corrupt officials, solving impossible crises, and crushing every scheme in his path. Once dismissed by everyone, Lucas rises to become the empire's most powerful strategist, earning the Empress's trust and the Princess's heart.

dramabox.title: Kick Me Out, Lose It All
dramabox.norm_title: kick me out lose it all
dramabox.description: Claire Stone's dessert shop turns a dying mall into the hottest spot in town—until greedy landlord Derek Payne forces her out to make room for an influencer café. But Claire is already one step ahead. She moves her businesses across the street, takes the mall's biggest tenants with her, and watches Derek's empire collapse. When corruption comes to light, Claire finally takes back everything she earned.

dramabox.title: The Hunter's Codex: King of the Wild
dramabox.norm_title: the hunter s codex king of the wild
dramabox.description: After being cast out with nothing but a rundown shack and a sack of grain, Ethan Carter discovers a mysterious bestiary that reveals the hidden riches of the wilderness. From rare game and priceless herbs to legendary catches, every expedition brings a new fortune. As his greedy relatives scheme to steal his success, Ethan builds a life no one thought possible—and becomes the true king of the wild.

dramabox.title: Know His Name, Tremble in Fear
dramabox.norm_title: know his name tremble in fear
dramabox.description: Ethan Cole arrives in Veston to honor an arranged marriage made long ago, only to be dismissed as a nobody. Even his fiancée, Claire Hart, tries to drive him away with an impossible challenge. But as Ethan quietly calls in old allies, powerful figures begin treating him with unexpected respect, leaving Claire to wonder who the mysterious man she almost turned away really is.

dramabox.title: The Harvest I Built on Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: the harvest i built on betrayal
dramabox.description: Claire Reed partners with her brother-in-law Ethan Clark to sell garlic, with a promise to share profits 50-50. But after they earn thirty thousand, Ethan cheats her out of her share, leaving her with only unwanted garlic stalks. Claire walks away and builds her own garlic empire. Ethan's business crashes and he goes bankrupt. Claire's revenge is sweet, and Ethan learns that you reap what you sow.

dramabox.title: The Rise of Daughter from commanding Dragon
dramabox.norm_title: the rise of daughter from commanding dragon
dramabox.description: When her cowardly father and stepbrother sacrifice the women to save themselves, Astrid watches her sister burn and her mother be crippled. Awakening supreme divine power, she leads the women in a brutal uprising, crushes the men who betrayed them, and rises as a queen before whom all men must kneel.

dramabox.title: Out of My House, Out of My Life
dramabox.norm_title: out of my house out of my life
dramabox.description: After seven years of putting her family first, Claire Carter discovers her husband, Ryan Stone, has been hiding his unemployment while secretly draining their savings to pay off the nanny's son's gambling debts. Even worse, his father stands by every lie. Done being everyone's fool, Claire files for divorce, uncovers the truth piece by piece, reclaims everything that belongs to her, and makes everyone who betrayed her face the consequences.

dramabox.title: From Nobody to the Heir of a Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: from nobody to the heir of a fortune
dramabox.description: Billionaire Ethan Reed returns home after learning he has only a month to live, determined to make amends with his estranged daughter and grandson, Ethan Reed. He wants his grandson to inherit his empire, but family wounds run deep. As Ethan rises in the business world with Sofia Hayes by his side, he joins his grandfather to uncover the truth behind his father's death. In the end, justice is served, the family reconciles, and Ethan inherits the empire.

dramabox.title: The Hundredth Oath
dramabox.norm_title: the hundredth oath
dramabox.description: To safeguard the Kingdom of Avaloria, Loki renounces his divinity. Honoring the late king's last will, he vows to help the young Queen Freya rule the kingdom and forgive her a hundred times. Manipulated by Surt, Freya gradually strips Loki of his authority, military command, and dignity. Upon the hundredth betrayal, Loki fulfills the pact. He relinquishes all that remains of his station, hands over the annulment of their betrothal, and resolves to leave the royal court...

dramabox.title: Pregnant by a Fallen God
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant by a fallen god
dramabox.description:
Ella, an orphaned farm girl, marries a beautiful amnesiac
stranger she finds fallen from the sky — and ends up
carrying Zeus's own grandchild. The whole town tries to
burn her as a witch, until the King of the Gods comes
down to settle the score.

dramabox.title: My Poor Grandpa Is Actually a Tycoon
dramabox.norm_title: my poor grandpa is actually a tycoon
dramabox.description: Evan Hart was abandoned by birth father Derek Reed at age one following his mother’s death and adopted by Edwin Hart. As Edwin prepared to pass down his business empire to Evan, Derek came with his family to recognize their blood bond. Evan refused to visit the Reeds without his grandfather. Edwin pretended to live in poverty and accompanied Evan to uncover the family’s plot: they wanted Evan solely to provide blood for his ill stepbrother.

dramabox.title: Her Rules Only Applied to Me
dramabox.norm_title: her rules only applied to me
dramabox.description: After three years of marriage, Victor Stone and Faye Turner always ate separately because of Faye’s obsession with cleanliness. But one day, Victor caught her eating with her assistant and watched her finish his leftovers without hesitation. He finally realized her cleanliness only applied to him. Furious at her double standards, Victor decides to teach her a lesson by dumping all the leftovers into a bowl and making her eat them all.

dramabox.title: They Bought Houses, I Built a Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: they bought houses i built a fortune
dramabox.description: In 2021, the whole village sold everything to buy houses, while Ethan Hayes invested his $1.5 million savings in gold. His mother-in-law called him useless, and everyone mocked him. As gold prices soared, Ethan started an organic farm and a livestream business. By 2026, home prices crashed while gold doubled. He cashed out $30 million and built a company worth over $100 million. His critics could only regret it.

dramabox.title: She Slept With My Billionaire Ex, I Reborn to Marry Her Groom
dramabox.norm_title: she slept with my billionaire ex i reborn to marry her groom
dramabox.description: After dying on a convict ship—sacrificed so her step-sister Augusta could escape with wealthy Cornelius—Margaret Vance wakes on the day Edmund Bramwell is set to propose to Augusta. This time, Edmund chooses Margaret. Together, they expose the fraud and betrayal that destroyed them, dismantle Cornelius's empire, and watch Augusta's sanity crumble.

dramabox.title: From Abandoned Husband to Sword Immortal
dramabox.norm_title: from abandoned husband to sword immortal
dramabox.description: Swordsmith hermit Gavin Stone raised his daughter alone for six years after his wife Claire Marlow abandoned them to pursue the sword path. When Claire joins Sword Pavilion and plans to marry its young master, Gavin takes his sword gifted daughter to seek revenge. Awakening his Supreme Sword Body, he crushes the arrogant Sword Pavilion Lord and his heartless ex-wife with unmatched power, rising as an invincible Sword Immortal.

dramabox.title: Heaven Shall Fall: Leave None Standing
dramabox.norm_title: heaven shall fall leave none standing
dramabox.description: When Liam Stone dies, Eldon Hale refuses to let the story end there. He tears apart the Underworld, marches across Lysora, storms the Nine Heavens, and destroys anyone standing in his way to bring his disciple back. With death defeated, only one battle remains: putting Liam on the throne.

dramabox.title: Divorced into Destiny: Rise of the Heir（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: divorced into destiny rise of the heir dubbed
dramabox.description: After years of humiliation from his wife, Nina Hart, and her family, Vincent Hart discovers he is the sole heir to a vast business empire. Following their divorce, he rises swiftly with the support of his fiancée, Amelia Bennett, as the Harts fall toward ruin. When his true identity is revealed, the Harts are left drowning in regret as the man they cast aside rises far beyond their reach.

dramabox.title: I'm the Heiress - No More Pretending
dramabox.norm_title: i m the heiress no more pretending
dramabox.description: Scarlett is pushed off a balcony by her fiancé and stepsister. She wakes up hours before her wedding and decides to destroy them. She teams up with Liam, who crashes the wedding. She exposes fraud, secures inheritance, and proves she is the true heiress. Mia is exposed, and Scarlett gets engaged to Liam.

dramabox.title: Exiled to the Abyss: Return of the Fire God
dramabox.norm_title: exiled to the abyss return of the fire god
dramabox.description: Three years ago, Fire God Ignis sealed his power to warm Ice Queen Freya's bed, enduring humiliation to suppress her cold poison. She grew strong, exiled him to the Winter Wasteland, and sent killers. Near death, he broke the seal, awakened Chaos Black Flame, and slaughtered them. Freya sought a relic but found her cast-off husband now terrifying. He reclaimed his fire seed, crippling her; the Abyssal God Erebos turned her into an Ice Banshee. Ignis allied with Saintess Lyra.

dramabox.title: My Wolf is the Sun God
dramabox.norm_title: my wolf is the sun god
dramabox.description: Sun god Apollo loses power and becomes a dying wolf. He bites Hecate, triggering a fated bond. They struggle through trials, he regains strength by drinking her blood, she heals with his essence. He evolves and storms the underworld. When Hades unleashes Cronus, they realize their love was fate's plan to stop Ragnarök.

dramabox.title: Rivals on Ice, Lovers in Debt
dramabox.norm_title: rivals on ice lovers in debt
dramabox.description: Team captain Liam and mafia heir Nikolai are rivals. A collision trapped them in a mafia debt. They cooperate to pay debts and save careers, pretending to hate each other but living together and fighting back. Enemies became partners.

dramabox.title: After She Cheated with a Star, I Pulled Her from Every Screen
dramabox.norm_title: after she cheated with a star i pulled her from every screen
dramabox.description: Liam, a live-in son-in-law, used his global theater resources to help his wife Selena. He caught her cheating and was humiliated. On divorce day, theater leaders knelt to him, and he pulled all her films from every screen.

dramabox.title: The Perfect AI Boyfriend I Found After Catching Him Cheating
dramabox.norm_title: the perfect ai boyfriend i found after catching him cheating
dramabox.description: Nora caught her fiancé cheating. She found abandoned AI Aiden, who protected her and helped her fight back. They fell in love. When the company tried to reclaim him, she fought for his ownership and they built a mutual love.

dramabox.title: Devour to Dominate: None Stand Equal
dramabox.norm_title: devour to dominate none stand equal
dramabox.description: Betrayed by his cousin Logan Stone and girlfriend Chloe Drake, wealthy heir Darius Stone is thrown into the jaws of a monstrous serpent. Instead of dying, he awakens as a tiny fish with the Infinite Devour System. Every creature he consumes fuels his evolution, turning prey into predator. Now he'll return for revenge and uncover the truth behind his transformation.

dramabox.title: He Promised Me a Crown I Returned with an Army
dramabox.norm_title: he promised me a crown i returned with an army
dramabox.description: General Valérie returns to find her family slain, parents' souls trapped. King Edmund breaks promise, sides with Holy See. She retakes command, kills foes, but Holy See threatens with parents and army. Allies with Raven, leads forces to capital, destroys Blood-Oath system, executes false king, slays Holy See, renounces crown, establishes free order.

dramabox.title: Too Greedy to Listen, You Signed Your Doom
dramabox.norm_title: too greedy to listen you signed your doom
dramabox.description: Returning home, Ethan Hayes builds an eco-farm and a barrier to keep wild beasts out. Mocked by his uncle and cousin for "wasting" land, he lets them bear the consequences. When a devastating animal invasion destroys their crops, they blame Ethan. Armed with undeniable proof, he clears his name, protects the village, and brings it back to prosperity.

dramabox.title: The Eternal Sovereign: Above All Realms
dramabox.norm_title: the eternal sovereign above all realms
dramabox.description: Blessed with eternal life, Victor Carter spends thousands of years mastering forgotten powers while avoiding the spotlight. But when ancient horrors awaken and the world teeters on the brink of collapse, he has no choice but to return. With countless ages of hidden strength behind him, Victor sets sail to face legendary foes, reshape the fate of the world, and finally break the limits that bind all existence.

dramabox.title: I Was Tortured by the Princess Until My Four Elven Legends Arrived
dramabox.norm_title: i was tortured by the princess until my four elven legends arrived
dramabox.description: Elowen, a quiet girl believed to be a lowborn companion, is tortured by the jealous Princess Maerith inside the Moonveil Court. But when four legendary elven guardians reveal Elowen's true identity as the last heir of the fallen Dawnshield family, everything changes. As an ancient corruption returns and a hidden conspiracy threatens the Heartwood Tree, Elowen must embrace her destiny, uncover her father's legacy, and save the kingdom.

dramabox.title: Path of Ascension: Strength Above All
dramabox.norm_title: path of ascension strength above all
dramabox.description: In 2024, the world changed overnight. The planet began expanding at an impossible rate, cities were cut off, and civilization collapsed. Monstrous beasts overran the ruins while awakened humans learned to wield the power of the stars. Trapped in an isolated town, Ethan Carter must fight to survive in a world where strength is law and mercy gets you killed.

dramabox.title: Infinite Dragon Evolution: Conquer the Heavens
dramabox.norm_title: infinite dragon evolution conquer the heavens
dramabox.description: One moment I was human. The next, I was the Dragon Prince of the Aquaron Dominion. Sounds impressive—until I discovered my empire was already falling apart. My people are hunted for sport, butchered for profit, and too weak to fight back. Luckily, I awakened the Infinite Evolution System. I can evolve not only myself, but every dragon that fights beside me. They wanted my race extinct. I'll make dragons the rulers of every realm.

dramabox.title: Love System Activated: Play to Dominate
dramabox.norm_title: love system activated play to dominate
dramabox.description: Lucas Reed is a shy 22-year-old stuck working the night shift at a convenience store. Dumped for being broke and constantly picked on, he thinks life can't get any worse—until he finds a fallen shard of the God of Love's power on a rainy night. Overnight, he gains extraordinary abilities, turning the ultimate underdog into a man every woman wants... and every rival fears.

dramabox.title: His to Protect, Theirs to Regret
dramabox.norm_title: his to protect theirs to regret
dramabox.description: For eight years, billionaire Graham Hale has honored his late friend's dying wish by protecting Claire Carter. When Claire is brutally bullied by heiress Sophie Mason and left shattered, Graham destroys the families behind the abuse with the full force of his empire. But a powerful elite strikes back. When Claire's life is threatened, Graham declares war—and everyone who touched her will pay.

dramabox.title: Bloodbound Queen-I Kissed the Hunter Who Saved Me
dramabox.norm_title: bloodbound queen i kissed the hunter who saved me
dramabox.description: Vampire Queen Valeria was betrayed by her lover and sister, stripped of power and exiled. She was rescued by hunter Adrian and formed a blood pact with him. She returned to the Night Court to drag her betrayers before the tribunal.

dramabox.title: Dragon Queen of the Arena
dramabox.norm_title: dragon queen of the arena
dramabox.description: Princess Lyra was usurped, falsely accused, and cast into the arena as a slave. She awakened a black dragon Nyxar and planned to return on dragonback to burn down the throne and reclaim her city.

dramabox.title: No Heir, No Crown, Just a Liar
dramabox.norm_title: no heir no crown just a liar
dramabox.description: Before a business trip, Ethan Hayes put Mia Carter in charge of his company, secretly planning a proposal. But intern Vivian Shaw soon appeared, claiming to carry Ethan's child and bullying staff, assaulting Mia and destroying a 3 billion contract. Mia endured, gathering evidence. Ethan returned, investigated, and at a group restaurant exposed Vivian's lies. Then her "husband" appeared, Ethan's infertile adopted brother, Ryan Hayes. The pregnancy was a scam.

dramabox.title: Rejected by My Family, Destined for Greatness
dramabox.norm_title: rejected by my family destined for greatness
dramabox.description: In 2005, Ethan Stone can’t afford the bride price. His girlfriend suggests a way to win his family’s approval, but Ethan refuses to burden her and goes home to borrow $5,000 from the family’s demolition payout. Instead, he discovers every penny has gone to his brother and sister, leaving him with nothing. Heartbroken, Ethan cuts ties with his family in public and, with his loyal girlfriend by his side, sets out to build a business empire.

dramabox.title: My Ancestor Emperor Changed My Fate
dramabox.norm_title: my ancestor emperor changed my fate
dramabox.description: Logan Stone, a broke modern guy, suffers betrayal and disgrace. A mysterious trash can connects two eras, linking him to his deposed royal ancestor. By offering snacks, he obtains miraculous treasures, rewriting his destiny. His bullies become eager flatterers, while love interests suddenly flock to him.

dramabox.title: I Saved Them Once, They Betrayed Me Twice
dramabox.norm_title: i saved them once they betrayed me twice
dramabox.description: After achieving success, Victor Hale returns home to repay his debt. Asked by the village chief, he takes in orphans Ryan Knox and Chloe Voss, spending everything to develop a cure for their illnesses. Misjudging his efforts as a waste of money, they betray him, leaving his company bankrupt. At his lowest point, the villagers and Lucas Carter return to help him. Only after losing everything do Ryan and Chloe realize the drug they rejected was their only hope.

dramabox.title: Blood Ties That Tried to Break Me
dramabox.norm_title: blood ties that tried to break me
dramabox.description: Heiress Claire Hale saved her twin Ethan with bone marrow. Back home to host his girlfriend Chloe, she faces a plot for the family fortune. Chloe's fake pregnancy turns Ethan against Claire, and Grandma backs Chloe. Claire and fiance Julian Carter expose Chloe's collusion with an uncle. The villains are caught, and Ethan begs Claire's forgiveness.

dramabox.title: Puppet No More: Long Live His Fake Majesty
dramabox.norm_title: puppet no more long live his fake majesty
dramabox.description: Modern special agent Cameron Belmore is betrayed and killed on a mission. He then wakes up as the puppet emperor of the Auren Empire, who is a eunuch kidnapped by the empress dowager, Sophia Greenwood, to impersonate the late emperor. Facing a coup, he crushes his enemies with ruthless tactics, strips his rivals of power, and outsmarts an attempt to expose his identity. As he secures the throne, greater palace conspiracies and political battles await.

dramabox.title: TRILLIONAIRE DRAGON MOM'S REVENGE
dramabox.norm_title: trillionaire dragon mom s revenge
dramabox.description: A dragon matriarch descends upon the mortal world when her pureblood daughter, Valyria, is brutally tortured by a ruthless heir and his system-backed lover—who steal wealth from her suffering. With infinite celestial capital and divine fury, Aria dismantles their empire, exposes their lies, and restores her daughter’s honor. A tale of vengeance, sacrifice, and the collapse of false power.

dramabox.title: The Healer Returns: Blood for Blood
dramabox.norm_title: the healer returns blood for blood
dramabox.description: Anthony Claydon has the Cinder Drake Physique and peerless medical skills. He descends the mountains to find one with the Bloomborn Physique to attain a breakthrough in his cultivation. At the same time, he looks for Sagebeast Jade shards to unlock the mystery of his origin. Anthony's amazing feats help him assemble helpful companions along the way. When he collects all the shards, the truth from 12 years ago finally sees the light of day.

dramabox.title: Absolute Sovereign: The World in My Hands
dramabox.norm_title: absolute sovereign the world in my hands
dramabox.description: Julian Hale transmigrates to Highrealm as Julian Hawthorne, who everyone believes is a fool. On his wedding day, the empress tries to break off the marriages she initially granted him. Deciding to shed his pretense, Julian uses his modern knowledge to improve people's lives, crush rebellions, and reform the government. He rises from the kingdom's laughingstock to a highly respected leader.

dramabox.title: Blind and Broke, Now Unstoppable
dramabox.norm_title: blind and broke now unstoppable
dramabox.description: Blind beggar Lena Sutton is granted the divine third eye of deity Dorian Vance, gaining supernatural sight. She sees through rigged dice at gambling dens, foils dealer Gus Rourke's cheating, and outsmarts ruthless proprietress Vivian Crowe's card tricks. Starting with nothing, Lena rises from a starving outcast to a gambling legend, winning half the gambling house's fortune and eventually surpassing even the glamorous owner herself.

dramabox.title: The Mother's Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: the mother s vengeance
dramabox.description: Scarlett Fox, once the top agent Ghost, left her past to guard her sick daughter. When tycoon Victor Thorne abducts her daughter for organ harvesting, she gets weapons and intel from an ally, then marches into his domain for total war—a mother's fury will destroy his evil syndicate.

dramabox.title: The Colors of the '80s, The Shape of Love（DUBBED）
dramabox.norm_title: the colors of the 80s the shape of love dubbed
dramabox.description: Wendy Soren transmigrates into a 1980s-era novel as a supporting character who forces Clinton Hall to marry her, only to meet a miserable end. Determined to change her fate, she refuses to marry him and instead focuses on her studies and building a successful career. However, her jealous younger sister, Hailey Soren, constantly slanders her.

dramabox.title: When I Divorced Her, Ten Nations Knelt
dramabox.norm_title: when i divorced her ten nations knelt
dramabox.description: Noah lived incognito as a son-in-law for three years, helping Vanessa become CEO. She cheated and humiliated him. On divorce day, chamber executives knelt before him, revealing he is the supreme chamber leader. He reclaimed everything he gave her.

dramabox.title: Your Loser Husband Is the God of War
dramabox.norm_title: your loser husband is the god of war
dramabox.description: Adrian has been hiding his true identity for the past years. When his wife Elena, a general, comes back from the borders after years, she is pregnant with the child of General Cassian to humiliate Adrian, and attempts to claim his fortune in the victory ceremony. But it turns out Cassian has been colluding with foreign enemies secretly. In the end, Adrian reveals his identity as the Supreme Commander to protect the Empire, and gets closure on his relationship with Elena.

dramabox.title: The Supreme Archmage Awakened
dramabox.norm_title: the supreme archmage awakened
dramabox.description: Left soulless after saving the world, Arthur Thorne, the Supreme Archmage, is rescued by Princess Elysia and lives for years as a halfwit. But just as Elysia, his loyal wife who protected him for years, is forced into a humiliating marriage by arrogant nobles, Arthur finally awakens. Having regained his godlike mana, he summons his loyal disciples—the Dragon Queen, the Grand Magus, and the Emperor—to crush the villains and lay the world at his wife's feet!

dramabox.title: They Called Her a Curse, He Gave Her a Home
dramabox.norm_title: they called her a curse he gave her a home
dramabox.description: Mocked as a "curse" for foreseeing disasters, little Mia Carter is abused by her foster family. Billionaire Hayden Foster saves her, then adopts her after she saves his life. Her gift protects her new family through crisis after crisis — until the truth reveals she's the lost heiress they've searched for for ten years.

dramabox.title: Once a Killer, Now a Savior
dramabox.norm_title: once a killer now a savior
dramabox.description: Ethan Reed kills a rival boss, spending eight years in prison — during which his father dies and his wife passes away after childbirth. Determined to reform, he opens a barbecue shop, but old rivals return. He builds a shipping company, rescues former gang members, foils a frame-up, saves his fiancée from forced marriage, and mentors prisoners toward redemption.

dramabox.title: Back Off! Her Bodyguard Is A Legend!
dramabox.norm_title: back off her bodyguard is a legend
dramabox.description: Fred York takes a security job while searching for the girl he never forgot. His new boss, icy CEO Scarlet Gould, thinks she hired an ordinary bodyguard. She has no idea Fred is the legendary fighter known as R.S. When a ruthless crime syndicate targets Scarlet and her company, Fred stops hiding. Everyone who looked down on him is about to learn that the quiet guard is the most dangerous man in the room.

dramabox.title: Boyfriend Gifted Me to the Don—My Dad
dramabox.norm_title: boyfriend gifted me to the don my dad
dramabox.description: Drugged and boxed as a gift to New York's most feared Don, Gianna is betrayed by the boyfriend she planned to marry. But her captors have made a fatal mistake: the Don is her father. After reclaiming her identity and taking revenge, she finds fearless new love with Adrian.

dramabox.title: From Manny to the Alpha'mate
dramabox.norm_title: from manny to the alpha mate
dramabox.description: An amnesiac PR fixer hired as a single CEO’s nanny uncovers a staged crash conspiracy and becomes the hidden fated mate of a powerful wolf alpha.

dramabox.title: When Time Gave Me Back My Youth
dramabox.norm_title: when time gave me back my youth
dramabox.description: Suffering from Alzheimer’s, 80-year-old Claire Monroe flees home when her family intends to send her to a nursing home. She boards a mysterious time-travel bus and wakes up as an 18-year-old. Reborn, she gains stardom through singing and acting. Yet her grandson is fatally ill, requiring a life-saving blood transfusion. Ultimately, she sacrifices her newfound youth to save him.

dramabox.title: After Judgment Day: Humanity's Last Star Guardian
dramabox.norm_title: after judgment day humanity s last star guardian
dramabox.description: Five years after saving Earth, Eli—the last Star Guardian—returns powerless and forgotten. Hiding his identity at an elite academy, he protects the terminally ill Hayley while rebuilding his cosmic armor, unaware that ancient monsters are awakening and hunting him once more.

dramabox.title: Dragon Egg
dramabox.norm_title: dragon egg
dramabox.description: Three hundred years ago, the kingdom's savior dragon was betrayed and reduced to ashes, leaving a cursed egg. Prince Cael, stripped of his title for zero magic, picks up the egg and hatches a dragon. Exiled with his mother, he faces bullies but uses his intellect and dragon power to outmaneuver them. When the Ancient Dragon Stele glows, the Grand Priest realizes the dragon bloodline survives, triggering a deadly hunt.

dramabox.title: Pregnant Cinderella: The Prince's Lost Heir
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant cinderella the prince s lost heir
dramabox.description: A curse forces Prince Liam to hold a masked ball to find true love. Ella, a duke's daughter, spends a night with him and becomes pregnant. Cast out, she raises her son Leo alone. Six years later, Liam discovers Leo is his son and fights to protect Ella and their children from curses and conspiracies.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Wife’s Sweet Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia wife s sweet obsession
dramabox.description: She is a mafia queen and underground doctor Dr. X. He is a business genius who fakes being crippled. Betrayed at the altar, they marry each other. She hides her identity, he hides his feelings. Their marriage becomes a dangerous game of secrets and attraction. When her identity is exposed, they must survive enemies and each other.

dramabox.title: She is Owned by the Queen
dramabox.norm_title: she is owned by the queen
dramabox.description: Law student Lena is sold at an underground club to pay her father's debt. Queen Valentina, the club's owner, interrupts the sale and claims Lena. Lena resists, challenges rules, and becomes a pawn in power struggles, slowly making the queen hesitate.

dramabox.title: Stolen Heart
dramabox.norm_title: stolen heart
dramabox.description: After catching his fiancée cheating, Pete becomes blind and unable to walk. Kwan, a grilled pork seller who secretly loves him, impersonates the fiancée to care for him. She helps him recover and donates her eyes. When he discovers the truth, she's been in an accident.

dramabox.title: Cheating Husband, Your Secrets Stream Live
dramabox.norm_title: cheating husband your secrets stream live
dramabox.description: Top gynecologist Clara is betrayed by her cheating husband and his pregnant mistress, and abused by her mother-in-law for infertility. She fights back with wit, medical knowledge, and live-streaming, exposing family secrets and reclaiming her dignity.

dramabox.title: I Proposed to a Stranger at My Wedding-- Season 1
dramabox.norm_title: i proposed to a stranger at my wedding season 1
dramabox.description: Adrian, a hidden billionaire, is forced into an arranged marriage. He disguises as a security guard to escape, but Elena, jilted at the altar, proposes to him. They marry in secret. He protects her from behind as a "poor husband," and their love grows amid schemes and family pressure.

dramabox.title: My Rescued Sheepdog Is An Alpha King
dramabox.norm_title: my rescued sheepdog is an alpha king
dramabox.description:
Kicked out by her family, wolfless Gabriella rescues a wounded white wolf. She feeds him cheap dog food, puts a pink collar on him, and names him Lucky.

But Lucky isn't a pet—he's Darius, the Alpha King, poisoned into wolf form.

When he recovers, he claims her as his Luna at the royal ball. Now Gabriella must survive jealous rivals and the fact that the "stray dog" she's been cuddling is the deadliest wolf in the realm—and he's never letting her go.

dramabox.title: Rent-A-Mom for the Billionaire Twins
dramabox.norm_title: rent a mom for the billionaire twins
dramabox.description: Ruby, a temporary nanny, takes on the impossible job of caring for billionaire Ethan's twin twins who drove away sixteen predecessors. She breaks through their coldness, heals the family, and helps Ethan learn to be a father. What starts as a hired role becomes a real family, and she becomes the home they never had.

dramabox.title: Afer Rebirth,My Hushand Is the Sea God
dramabox.norm_title: afer rebirth my hushand is the sea god
dramabox.description: Elena is killed by her jealous sister on her coronation day. Reborn, she saves a merman—actually Poseidon, Sea God. She faces trials, defeats conspiracies, and becomes Sea Empress. Poseidon shares his divine power with her, and they rule together.

dramabox.title: Hunting His Royal Highness
dramabox.norm_title: hunting his royal highness
dramabox.description: Huntress Ella faked being a blood servant to kill vampire King Lucas and save her sister. She discovered Lucas secretly protected humans against his cruel father. Framed to poison him, Ella took the poison herself, revealed her identity, and joined Lucas—whose progenitor blood awoke—to defeat the plot. They abolished slavery and ruled together.

dramabox.title: Fate of the Dragon’s Bride
dramabox.norm_title: fate of the dragon s bride
dramabox.description: Lydia is forced to marry the "savage" Dragon King Lucian. She flees and meets a dragon-shifter, giving him her virginity. She becomes pregnant, is captured and put on trial. Lucian discovers she is the woman who saved him and descends to claim her as his only bride.

dramabox.title: Bound by His Pain
dramabox.norm_title: bound by his pain
dramabox.description: Half-elf Alice, ostracized by her kin, meets Owen, the hidden city ruler, and they bond through shared pain. To break the curse, they sign a soul pact—only true love can free them. They uncover old secrets, defeat villains, and reconcile family wounds, finally finding love.

dramabox.title: Binding Deception
dramabox.norm_title: binding deception
dramabox.description: Evelyn, trapped in a sexless abusive marriage, mistakes heir Mathias for a gigolo and hires him. He protects and saves her from her husband's schemes. Despite identity misunderstandings and family pressures, she gives birth to twins, all truths are revealed, and they unite.

dramabox.title: The Thief Who Stole My Heart
dramabox.norm_title: the thief who stole my heart
dramabox.description: In 2065, master thief Eve sneaks aboard the Grayson cruise to steal a relic linked to her mother's disappearance. She is revealed as the long-lost daughter and pulled into a reality show. She falls for Caroline, the fake heiress. A heist and forbidden romance spiral out of control.

dramabox.title: Between Us & Our Enemies
dramabox.norm_title: between us our enemies
dramabox.description: Rival agents Felix and Dimitri have fought for five years—locked in life-or-death combat by night, tangled in each other's arms by dawn. Their unspoken rule: mission is mission, bed is bed. But feelings blur the line. When Felix betrays him coldly to protect him from their handler, their cover as lovers on a nuclear-threat yacht mission turns real. After dismantling the conspiracy, they fake their deaths, escape the life, and find healing—two lonely souls, finally home.

dramabox.title: She's The Model Wife, But Paid Me To Seduce Her CEO Husband
dramabox.norm_title: she s the model wife but paid me to seduce her ceo husband
dramabox.description: Desperate single mother Nora accepts a ruthless offer from betrayed billionaire wife Victoria: seduce her cheating CEO husband, Julian, and help expose his greed. Reborn as the glamorous "Arabella Cross", Nora enters a dangerous game of desire, lies, and revenge—where two wronged women stop crying, start hunting, and take back everything stolen from them.

dramabox.title: Crown of Thorns
dramabox.norm_title: crown of thorns
dramabox.description: The Mary family was framed and destroyed. Mary infiltrated the palace to kill Kane, her enemy's son—but the man she met was Marcus, Kane's lookalike stand-in. Beneath his disguise, Marcus was drawn to her pain. As they circled through lies and love, they uncovered a deeper conspiracy. When Kane returned, Mary had to choose between revenge and love—each step toward the thorny crown sealed their fate.

dramabox.title: Wrath of Zeus's Son 2: Secret Protection from the Janitor
dramabox.norm_title: wrath of zeus s son 2 secret protection from the janitor
dramabox.description: Leon, Zeus's son, disappeared to protect his daughter Beryl. He returns as a janitor, hiding his power and enduring her coldness. When the Abyss Lord descends, the world discovers the coward janitor is their almighty savior.

dramabox.title: My Professor Is My Arranged Fiancé
dramabox.norm_title: my professor is my arranged fianc
dramabox.description: To resist an arranged marriage with the Vance family heir, Julian deliberately fails a finance class. His father hires Arthur as his private tutor and confines him until he passes. Julian doesn't know Arthur is his betrothed. In closed spaces, Arthur enforces a punishment contract. Through physical clashes and forced obedience, they break down emotional and physical barriers.

dramabox.title: Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire
dramabox.description: Terminally ill billionaire Adrian Vale gathers his five ex-girlfriends for a reality show to choose his last wife. But it's not a love show—it's a selection for an heir, a business agent, or even a scapegoat to bear his secret. Secrets of children, affairs, and hidden contracts surface. They realize they aren't fighting for love, but for the right to leave the estate alive.

dramabox.title: Bringing Home the Woman in Black Stockings, My Parents’ Secret Is Exposed
dramabox.norm_title: bringing home the woman in black stockings my parents secret is exposed
dramabox.description: Lin Shen, heir to a wealthy family, is raised modestly and unaware of his background. After being dumped, he meets CEO Zhao Yiren, and they pretend to be lovers. Her father tries to humiliate him but is outshone. His ex and rival target him. His parents reveal their true identities, and Lin Shen embraces his new life as a top heir.

dramabox.title: The Supreme Archer Returns
dramabox.norm_title: the supreme archer returns
dramabox.description: Legendary archer Rowan Vance, once known as the "Supreme Archer," went into hiding after his master was killed and he lost an eye. Living as a one-eyed porter and vowing never to kill again, he endured humiliation to protect his wife and son. But when his family is threatened and he learns his master's true killer was Marshal Thale, Rowan breaks his vow—picks up his bow, storms the enemy fortress alone, and kills his enemy with a single curving arrow, avenging his master.....

dramabox.title: Rebooted Revenge: Your Game is Over
dramabox.norm_title: rebooted revenge your game is over
dramabox.description: Wayne Asher gives up his chance to study abroad to marry Ella Lane. On their wedding night, he finds her cheating and suffers humiliation from the Lanes. Heartbroken, he leaves with Sharon Kurt. Two years later, he returns with the Axion Chip, planning to marry Sharon. The Lanes try to ruin him by sabotaging the chip. With Sharon's help, he brings them to justice and finally finds his love and happiness.

dramabox.title: Double Life Of A Guardian
dramabox.norm_title: double life of a guardian
dramabox.description: Kane, a retired special forces ace, concealed his identity and disguised himself as a driver to protect his amnesiac wife Helen, while secretly holding trillions in assets. Helen's company was mired in debt and targeted by scheming business rivals. Kane repeatedly revealed his top-tier identity to resolve crises, ultimately uncovering the truth behind her lost memories, shattering the villain's plot to seize power, and the two lived happily together.

dramabox.title: Primarch Genesis
dramabox.norm_title: primarch genesis
dramabox.description: Once a legendary empire war hero, Kane was betrayed by his best friend and exiled to a trash planet. To clear his name, he pilots the ancient mecha Primarch into the Empire's top mecha academy—uncovering a massive conspiracy. When void beasts invade, he must ally with his enemy, and discovers his mother's star-core bloodline sealed within the mecha's core. He chooses to protect the innocent, rejects power, and soars the stars with Princess Luna.

dramabox.title: Gunslinger Dad：Raising Kids in the Wild West
dramabox.norm_title: gunslinger dad raising kids in the wild west
dramabox.description: In the Wild West, outlaw Morgan Kane fails a train robbery and unexpectedly reunites with his two children. To support them and repay debts, he uses his strength to hunt and gather, transforming from a disgraced gunslinger into a legitimate merchant. He leads the Black Pine Gang toward a new life as an era ends.

dramabox.title: The Scorned Husband Is a Supreme Mage
dramabox.norm_title: the scorned husband is a supreme mage
dramabox.description: Aiden, the Supreme Mage who lived in seclusion for fifteen years, renounced the glory of his kingdom for love and chose to live as an ordinary blacksmith. Yet his wife Elena scorned him for being worthless and betrayed his trust. When the dragon descends, Aiden makes his earth-shaking return as the Supreme Mage. Only then does Elena realize that the man she cast aside is the one the entire kingdom has been waiting for.

dramabox.title: Second Chance as Her Mr. Trash
dramabox.norm_title: second chance as her mr trash
dramabox.description: Cory Judd has had a crush on Zoe Stone for as long as he can remember. Just before graduating from college, he finally confesses—and she accepts him. While celebrating, he gets drunk. But when he wakes up, he finds himself seven years in the future. Not only is he married to Zoe, but he's also ruined their marriage. Zoe is disappointed in him, and their child suffers from psychological trauma that leaves them unable to speak.

dramabox.title: The Gravekeeper Is the Lion King
dramabox.norm_title: the gravekeeper is the lion king
dramabox.description: Jax, a junk collector hiding his identity as the War God's heir, watches Nova—the Aries commander who came to marry him—poisoned and left to die in the arena. Breaking his seal, he awakens the divine mecha Golden Lion and crushes his enemies. With Nova by his side, he rebuilds order—but a colossal interstellar mothership looms over the wasteland.

dramabox.title: My Mech Broke,I Became the Weapon
dramabox.norm_title: my mech broke i became the weapon
dramabox.description: Cole Astra, scorned by his family for a low mech sync rate, awakens an ancient power that lets him absorb mech energy into his flesh. He crushes rivals in the Resource Trials, severs ties with his family, then slays a demigod-class abomination with a sky-piercing tornado, saving the city. Bidding farewell to his mother, he heads to distant battlefields. His odyssey has just begun.

dramabox.title: Speak to Me in Beats
dramabox.norm_title: speak to me in beats
dramabox.description: Chatty 12-year-old Peyton is sent to a ranch to help Wyatt, a mute ranch heir. She uses sign language to break his silence. She discovers his past abuse and encourages him to compete. They support each other and both succeed.

dramabox.title: The Day He Returned to Save Them
dramabox.norm_title: the day he returned to save them
dramabox.description: Ethan Carter once drove his wife Clara Reed to death and let their daughter die. Consumed by regret, he wakes up on the day of tragedy. With future knowledge, he starts a business from nothing and builds a fortune. But making money is easy,but winning back his family is not. Against debts, rivals, and conflicts, he must prove himself with action and rebuild the home he destroyed.

dramabox.title: My Hidden Dragon Awakened
dramabox.norm_title: my hidden dragon awakened
dramabox.description: To save his dying daughter, Kael is humiliated by his ex-wife, then run over—but his royal dragon blood awakens. He becomes the last living dragon. A cold CEO offers a contract marriage to save his daughter; he hides as her assistant. At an elite gala, tycoons and generals kneel: "Welcome back, Your Highness!" His enemies kidnap his daughter. His wings block the sky, divine wrath crushes them. He saves his child, wins the CEO's heart, and claims his throne as the only king.

dramabox.title: Rise of the Pitch GOAT
dramabox.norm_title: rise of the pitch goat
dramabox.description: In a cyberpunk world, Mateo—raised by hidden legend Balthazar—has an AI eye that reads the game. He saves Ivy Thompson and discovers he's the Thompson family's long-lost son via a wolf-head birthmark. Victor destroys his AI eye with an EMP. Mateo overcomes, wins the league with ordinary eyes, and receives a national team call-up for the World Cup. A new journey begins.

dramabox.title: The Son Who Walked Away
dramabox.norm_title: the son who walked away
dramabox.description: Ellen Ward's million-dollar compensation vanished from her bank account, leaving just one dollar. Facing fraud charges and a son who cut ties with her publicly, she was devastated. Enter lawyer Luke Mason, who took her case and unraveled the truth behind the missing fortune.

dramabox.title: My Dad, the Institute Boss
dramabox.norm_title: my dad the institute boss
dramabox.description: Walter, former Director of the York Institute, hides as a repairman—mocked by all, dismissed by his son Nate. When old enemies return, Walter refuses to go back. At Nate's cybersecurity finals, Tyler humiliates Nate for his "repairman" father. Walter intervenes. He tells Nate to unplug the network cable. Everyone laughs—until it turns the failing defense into a stunning comeback.

dramabox.title: War Criminal's Return: King of Mecha
dramabox.norm_title: war criminal s return king of mecha
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, mecha commander Silas confessed to destroying a city and was imprisoned. Now the Sky Wall has fallen, monsters are emerging, and he must pilot a forbidden mech alongside the female commander who testified against him. During neural sync, she sees the truth behind the massacre—and realizes she helped convict an innocent man.

dramabox.title: Cyber Fight King: Reloaded
dramabox.norm_title: cyber fight king reloaded
dramabox.description:
Undefeated champion Jax Rainer vanished from cyber
combat to protect his daughter. When a ruthless rival
kidnaps her and targets his new family, Jax must return
to the arena, reclaim his legendary power, and fight the
most personal battle of his life.

dramabox.title: Spartacus God of the Arena
dramabox.norm_title: spartacus god of the arena
dramabox.description: Rome fears only one name: the War Shadow. To save his poisoned wife, Elara, Spartacus buried his godlike power and disappeared into the arena as a nameless slave. But when Elara’s sister is thrown into a blood-soaked gladiator battle, the legend must rise. Alchemy-born monsters. A traitor wearing his name. An empire ready to burn. To save his family, Spartacus will break his chains—and unleash the god Rome tried to bury.

dramabox.title: Loser Husband Is a Hidden Heir
dramabox.norm_title: loser husband is a hidden heir
dramabox.description: After reuniting with his biological father, Ahn Gyeom-ho is named the heir to Anton Group and appointed CEO of its branch. His in-laws, still ignorant of his identity, continue to belittle him until the façade shatters. But Gyeom-ho soon finds himself facing a far greater threat. As he faces the enemies determined to strip him of the succession, he strikes back, exposes the conspiracy, and sets out to reclaim everything that was rightfully his.
