dramabox.title: TWELVE SOVEREIGN RINGS
dramabox.norm_title: twelve sovereign rings
dramabox.description: time-bending ability and a thousand-year-old secret. When he uses his power to save a stranger, his cover is blown, drawing his ancient nemesis Vittorio and his criminal gang into his quiet life. To protect his wife Lena, he teams up with Jack and defected superhuman Selene to battle through obstacles and destroy the power source statue. In the end, he surrenders his immortality and powers, choosing to live out his days as an ordinary man by Lena’s side.

dramabox.title: The Return of the Storm
dramabox.norm_title: the return of the storm
dramabox.description: Ten years ago, Duncan—the legendary Storm King—buried his identity, sealed his power, and abandoned the skies to keep a promise he made on his wife's deathbed: protect their daughter, Megan, from the enemies who killed her mother. But when the treasure-laden Dead Sea reopens, Megan enters in search of revenge and finds herself thrust into a world of cruelty. Now Duncan must break the seal, face the killer who destroyed his family, and unleash the storm one last time.

dramabox.title: Asleep for Six Centuries My Brothers Kneeling for Forgiveness
dramabox.norm_title: asleep for six centuries my brothers kneeling for forgiveness
dramabox.description: Freya, the adopted daughter of the Randall household, was doted on for ten years. She once believed she had the best family in the world. Yet the warm facade shattered completely upon the return of Anna, the legitimate daughter.She was successively framed for theft and practicing forbidden magic, subjected to whippings and branding. Even her exclusive eighteenth‑year coming‑of‑age ceremony was snatched away.

dramabox.title: The Dragon Lord Returns
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon lord returns
dramabox.description: Once the feared Dragon Lord, Kael hides as a lowly car-wash worker after a devastating injury, secretly helping his wife Vexa rise to power. On the night he plans to reveal his identity, he discovers her affair with Riven, heir of House Vale, and is forced into divorce. Cast aside and ridiculed, Kael marries Nyx, the mysterious wheelchair-bound heiress of House Veyra, punishes those who offend them, and takes back the control of the galaxy.

dramabox.title: Master of Dragons
dramabox.norm_title: master of dragons
dramabox.description: Legendary dragon summoner Hughes gave up all his power to lay low and protect his wife Irene, who once saved his life.But his quiet devotion only lands him divorce papers. Tricked by scheming Karl, Irene writes him off as a useless nobody.At the grand ceremony, elites line up to humiliate him — they have no clue who they’re really messing with…

dramabox.title: The Janitor's Secret: Unmasking the Superstar
dramabox.norm_title: the janitor s secret unmasking the superstar
dramabox.description: A world-famous masked pop star, who faked his death to escape his abusive manager, now lives as a nameless janitor. When a struggling dance agency pins its last hope on him, he must decide: stay hidden forever, or return to the stage and fight for the family he never had.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Queen's Blind Spot
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia queen s blind spot
dramabox.description: Lily, a visually impaired girl, enters a mansion as assistant to SERENA, heiress of the Vitale mafia. Her keen hearing draws her into a power struggle, while her police boyfriend Kai investigates SERENA. Twisted attachment grows between Lily and SERENA amid captivity and abuse. Kai's identity and Lily's accident truth emerge. In a family war, SERENA takes a bullet for Lily.

dramabox.title: Thronebreaker: Gladiator to God
dramabox.norm_title: thronebreaker gladiator to god
dramabox.description: After the Emperor's monstrous pet destroys his village and enslaves his father, stonecutter Cato enters Rome's brutal Gladiator Trial to earn his father's freedom. Mocked as a nobody, he's pushed round after round to the edge of death, each trial awakening more of the divine power and true identity buried inside him. As a hidden conspiracy closes in, Cato rises against the empire's cruelty and corruption, claiming his destiny as the son of Apollo to tear down the system.

dramabox.title: Return of the Midway Hero
dramabox.norm_title: return of the midway hero
dramabox.description: On the eve of Pearl Harbor, pilot Jack proposes to Elizabeth—then war tears them apart. Presumed dead, he returns later, crippled, as the hidden heir to the Harris Group and the son of a Supreme Commander, only to find the woman he loves on the verge of a forced marriage. After saving Elizabeth, Jack is called back to duty again, only to vanish. Believing him dead, Elizabeth insists on holding the wedding—until the church doors swing open.

dramabox.title: Reborn Fisherman: I'll Turn the Tides
dramabox.norm_title: reborn fisherman i ll turn the tides
dramabox.description: In the early 1980s, Vincent Bell's cowardice destroys Amelia Walker's family. Reborn with memories of the future, he is determined to change their fate. He catches a massive haul, pays off his gambling debts, and uses his foresight and sonar skills to become a successful fisherman. He earns the respect of Amelia's father. As he builds a thriving seafood business, he outsmarts his rival, which ignites a fierce battle for control of the village.

dramabox.title: The GOAT Returns: Back to Rule the Game
dramabox.norm_title: the goat returns back to rule the game
dramabox.description: After leading Veloria National Team to victory over Florava in the Global Cup, the captain, Colin Whittaker, is ambushed and murdered by his own vice captain. He is then reborn in the body of a young man with the same name, a down-and-out youth who has not even qualified for the youth training program.

dramabox.title: Warriors in Disguise: Defending Our Homeland
dramabox.norm_title: warriors in disguise defending our homeland
dramabox.description: In 1937, a standard teahouse transforms into a wartime intelligence hub and refugee shelter. Gavin Carter, the brave manager, leads ordinary citizens to the front lines. His feisty wife, Vivian Carter, outsmarts traitors in the rear. From passionate students to Buddhist monks, everyday people rise up against invaders. In times of national crisis, these unsung heroes stand united, fulfilling a legendary oath to never fail their country.

dramabox.title: Don't Mess With The Billionaire Sister
dramabox.norm_title: don t mess with the billionaire sister
dramabox.description: After returning wounded from military service, Sophie goes to meet her brother Chris’s fiancée, Sabrina, but is brutally humiliated by Sabrina’s family, who don’t know who she is. To protect Chris and uncover the truth, Sophie disguises herself as a janitor at his company, exposes Sabrina’s abuse, corruption, and schemes, then reveals her identity at the anniversary gala and takes over as CEO.

dramabox.title: Emperor in Disguise: Judgment at the Banquet
dramabox.norm_title: emperor in disguise judgment at the banquet
dramabox.description: Before leaving his hometown, Liam Lambert promises his fiancée, Tanya Litt, that he will return and make her empress once he becomes emperor. Years later, after founding a new dynasty, he returns home disguised as a commoner. He discovers that Tanya has betrayed him and decided to marry the county magistrate’s son. Humiliated, beaten, and extorted by local officials, Liam hides his identity and sets a trap to expose every corrupt figure at his homecoming banquet.

dramabox.title: Enough! No More Mrs.Nice Wife
dramabox.norm_title: enough no more mrs nice wife
dramabox.description: After three years of being gaslit by her “perfect” husband and his family, Vivian discovers they’re plotting to kill her for her fortune—only to rise from anxious housewife to ruthless CEO, teaming up with a secret mafia–billionaire who’s been in love with her for years to take back her company, her home, and her life.

dramabox.title: A+ in Everything, Especially Payback II
dramabox.norm_title: a in everything especially payback ii
dramabox.description: Glenda Glover returns to her wealthy family armed with genius-level intellect, only to find her entire household trapped in chaotic melodrama. Her cousins include a possessive CEO, a reckless playboy, and a troubled heir obsessed with the wrong woman. While everyone else is consumed by romance and scandal, Glenda focuses on building her business empire. With intelligence and relentless ambition, she turns family chaos into business success and carves out her own path.

dramabox.title: Spoiler Alert: Surviving the Villain's Script
dramabox.norm_title: spoiler alert surviving the villain s script
dramabox.description: Zachary Kean wakes up inside a novel as the doomed villain whose entire family will eventually be wiped out by his younger sister, Aria Kean. Determined to survive, he launches a desperate self-rescue mission before she turns evil. He becomes an overprotective brother to Aria and helps her out in various ways. Can Zachary change his family's and his fate?

dramabox.title: Divorced Queen Returns to The Stage
dramabox.norm_title: divorced queen returns to the stage
dramabox.description: After enduring six humiliating years of her husband Jake’s public infidelity, Anna finally snaps. She files for divorce and reignites her long-abandoned dream—reclaiming her status as a world-class pianist. Enter Ethan, her seemingly ordinary piano teaching assistant who’s actually a billionaire tycoon in disguise. With his unwavering support, Anna stages a breathtaking comeback, humiliates her ex-husband, and reclaims her glory.

dramabox.title: Bow or Be Erased: Defy Her, Face Your Doom
dramabox.norm_title: bow or be erased defy her face your doom
dramabox.description: During the funeral of the powerful Steve Bowen, a mysterious veiled woman suddenly appears, claiming she once made a pact with him a century ago. She demands that the Bowen family's most outstanding descendant become her servant. The Bowens dismiss her, and Steve’s daughter-in-law assumes the young woman is his secret lover. Ignoring all warnings, she rips away the woman’s veil—only to freeze in shock the moment her true face is revealed.

dramabox.title: Don't Mess With Super Mom
dramabox.norm_title: don t mess with super mom
dramabox.description: After quelling external disturbances, the best warrior of the Republic of Valoria, Zoe Miller, returns home. However, she discovers that her daughter has been mistreated by her relatives—David's family. In a fit of rage, Zoe unleashes a massacre at the banquet, accidentally revealing herself to be the legendary Secretary of Defense.

dramabox.title: Break the Oath, Meet Your Doom
dramabox.norm_title: break the oath meet your doom
dramabox.description: To repay a debt of gratitude, Daniel Craig vows to spend three years posing as a foolish son-in-law, enduring the scorn of his wife, Sadie Lane, and her family. Only Sadie's sister, Renee, shows him kindness. When Sadie divorces him, Daniel seizes back his power as the head of the Draven Exchange, reclaiming his rightful place at the top.

dramabox.title: All In on Life: Trading Regrets for Family
dramabox.norm_title: all in on life trading regrets for family
dramabox.description: Zach Lomb was once a top stock investor. He spent his life chasing money and regretted never having a child. After a car crash, he wakes up in the body of a gambler who shares his name. He now has a kind wife and a sweet daughter. Determined to change, he quits his vices and uses his investing skills to dominate the stock market while striving for a happy family life.

dramabox.title: Return of the Racing King
dramabox.norm_title: return of the racing king
dramabox.description: The racing king, Alexander, was framed by his adopted brother Cade during the championship and ended up at the Apollo Club, working as a mechanic. But the Apollo Club was threatened by Cade’s underlings. Alexander had no choice but to return to the racing world — the king of racing is back...

dramabox.title: Mafia Diva: Reborn From The Flames
dramabox.norm_title: mafia diva reborn from the flames
dramabox.description: As a child, Chloe saved a boy named Jonathan. Ten years later, he became a billionaire. To steal Chloe's identity, her sister Rebecca buried her alive. Crawling out from the earth, Chloe was rescued by mafia boss Bernardo, who saw his late granddaughter in her face. Three months later, transformed by surgery, she returned as Bernardo's granddaughter—just as Jonathan and Rebecca announced their wedding.

dramabox.title: Your Crown Was My Gift, My Regret, My Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: your crown was my gift my regret my revenge
dramabox.description: Sophia Clark opens a high-end restaurant for her husband, Ryan Litt. When she visits the restaurant with Ryan’s mother, they find a cockroach in the food and are extorted for speaking out in their own defense. The manager, Chloe Zimmer, claims to be the owner and Ryan’s wife. Sophia realizes the restaurant has been given to Ryan’s mistress. Even after Sophia reveals her identity, Chloe’s bullying escalates.

dramabox.title: The Return of the Racing God
dramabox.norm_title: the return of the racing god
dramabox.description: Kyle, once hailed as the "God of Street Racing," was devastated by a racing accident six years ago that left his best friend Hans comatose, and he sank into despair, becoming a delivery driver. When Cole from Team Beta had their team's track seized by Bob and others from Team Alpha, he turned to Kyle for help. Driving a dilapidated pickup truck, Kyle repeatedly overtook Alpha's top racers with his incredible driving skills, triggering a series of racing conflicts.

dramabox.title: GOAT: Legend in the Making
dramabox.norm_title: goat legend in the making
dramabox.description: Jake Leed becomes a benchwarmer after an injury. When he's subbed in with only 15 seconds left in a crucial game, the crowd expects a final humiliation. However, he has awakened the Basketball God System. Task by task, skill by skill, Jake embarks on the path to becoming a basketball legend.

dramabox.title: Back to That Summer, Before I Lost You
dramabox.norm_title: back to that summer before i lost you
dramabox.description: Middle-aged tycoon Finn Cadell has built a business empire over the years. However, he is wracked with guilt and haunted by the suicide of his first love, Roxy Stabler. When he dies of cancer, he welcomes death, seeing it as a relief. To his surprise, he returns to the year 2000—before he and Roxy begin dating. Given a second chance, Finn vows to protect Roxy by winning her heart again and building a lifetime of happiness with her.

dramabox.title: When Love Betrays, Power Awaits
dramabox.norm_title: when love betrays power awaits
dramabox.description: After marrying Simon Grant, Isla Steele resigns as a general and spends three years away from home to find a cure for his chronic illness. When she finally returns with the medicine, she discovers that he is seeing another woman, Jodie Dunn, who claims to be a Divine Maiden. Simon even demands that Isla give up her rightful place as his wife. In response, Isla publicly divorces him on the day he plans to marry Jodie.

dramabox.title: When the Supreme Being Checks into the Loser's Life
dramabox.norm_title: when the supreme being checks into the loser s life
dramabox.description: Dark cultivator Clark Lamont loses control while training in the High Realm and falls back into the Mortal Realm. His soul latches onto a timid man who shares his name. This man is imprisoned by his obsessive fiancée and scorned by her sisters. But when the powerful soul awakens within him, the once-weak man transforms overnight, turning humiliation into a ruthless rise to dominance.

dramabox.title: Good Luck！Alpha's Halloween Baby
dramabox.norm_title: good luck alpha s halloween baby
dramabox.description: One night. One mistake. She vanished pregnant—now, six years later, he’ll stop at nothing to find her.

dramabox.title: Vows of Vengeance: The Hidden Immortal Art
dramabox.norm_title: vows of vengeance the hidden immortal art
dramabox.description: On a stormy night, Eleanor Morton witnesses her uncle framing and killing her parents. In despair, she escapes but accidentally falls from a cliff. Zachary White saves her. She begs him to teach her martial arts so she can take revenge. However, all Zachary teaches her is a simple vitality technique. In fact, the seemingly unassuming technique is a peerless immortal art, and it soon becomes clear that Eleanor is exceptionally gifted in cultivation.

dramabox.title: Honey, I'm the Real Queen
dramabox.norm_title: honey i m the real queen
dramabox.description: To live authentically, billionaire heiress Alicia Turner attends school under a false name. Tina Anderson, an ordinary student, impersonates her for status, bullying Alicia and flaunting stolen luxuries. After being drugged and kidnapped by Tina at prom, Alicia escapes and exposes her. Tina is arrested, and Alicia's true identity is revealed. Three years later, her fiancé Liam returns to reunite with her.

dramabox.title: Boss, She Said No Again!
dramabox.norm_title: boss she said no again
dramabox.description: Abandoned for sixteen years, Rowena returns to New York to reclaim her mother's inheritance. Posing as the Kingsley second son's fiancée, she plans a breakup as cover. But she saves Damien Kingsley, the Kingsley's elder son, from a mafia attack. Intrigued, Damien forces into her life. As Rowena navigates traps from her scheming family and ruthless Mrs. Kingsley, her bond with Damien shifts from enemies to allies as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious murder.

dramabox.title: The Immortal's Everyday Life Goes Viral
dramabox.norm_title: the immortal s everyday life goes viral
dramabox.description: Heath Lawson is the world's only Transcendent cultivator. For a century, he abandons worldly ties, dedicating himself to a solitary life of cultivation. But when he fails a tribulation and his path comes to an end, he returns to experience life's pleasures and make amends with his descendants. Yet his family line has long faded into obscurity—except for one surviving great-granddaughter.

dramabox.title: Supreme God of Army
dramabox.norm_title: supreme god of army
dramabox.description: The useless and wretched son-in-law suddenly became powerful and truculent. Turned out, all his obedience was just a foreshadowing of revenge.

dramabox.title: Divorce? No Big Deal (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: divorce no big deal dubbed
dramabox.description: After saving Emily Lawson from taking her own life, Logan Bennett falls out with his father just to marry her, only to later be met with betrayal and distrust—even a divorce never seems to bother her. But things only come to an end after her lover sets up a trap for Logan's new partner, Natalie Quinn, infuriating Logan, who secretly holds power they would never believe he had.

dramabox.title: Runtime Error: Love Not Responding
dramabox.norm_title: runtime error love not responding
dramabox.description: Deaf since childhood, coding prodigy Joel Klein grows up neglected by his family. His only comfort is his fiancée, Peggy Scott. On the eve of their wedding, he suddenly regains his hearing—only to discover her betrayal. Disillusioned, Joel joins a top-secret AI program that demands total isolation and executes the ultimate revenge on their wedding day.

dramabox.title: The Returns of Billionaire Mom
dramabox.norm_title: the returns of billionaire mom
dramabox.description: Harley Carson, the heiress of the Carson family, was betrayed by her stepsister Ivy Carson and fiancé Gavin Gray. She nearly lost her life, but survived by faking her death. Five years later, as the chairwoman of HyperNova Association, she returns with her son to take revenge on Ivy and Gavin. Unexpectedly, Nolan Hamilton, her one-night stand, reappears. For their son's sake, Harley decides to sign a marriage contract with Nolan.

dramabox.title: The Maid With His Blood Came Back to Burn
dramabox.norm_title: the maid with his blood came back to burn
dramabox.description: Five years ago, maid Diana was set up and spent a night with mafia boss Calvin, only to be imprisoned, robbed of her child, and left for dead.Five years later, she returns under a new identity—Elsie—infiltrating an underground auction house and moving step by step toward the center of power, determined to reclaim her daughter and take revenge on Camilla, the woman who stole her place as “Mrs. Becker.”Old love resurfaces, the truth begins to unravel......

dramabox.title: The Tears of Mona Lisa
dramabox.norm_title: the tears of mona lisa
dramabox.description: After Elizabeth came home from the orphanage, she hoped for a warm family life—only to be framed by her adoptive sister Alison, sent to prison, betrayed by her boyfriend, and rejected by her family. Heartbroken, Elizabeth left her family and disappeared without a trace. Five years later, she returned as the acclaimed master painter Q. No longer the fragile girl she once was, she had been reborn—ready to weave a perfect new chapter from the threads of her past.

dramabox.title: Our Love Died First
dramabox.norm_title: our love died first
dramabox.description: Aaron Miller and Sophia Lawson, a couple envied by all, face the greatest challenge of their relationship when he discovers that she has been cheating on him for three years. Devastated by her betrayal, Aaron fakes his death by jumping into the river on their wedding day. As he embraces a new life under a new identity, Sophia is left to drown in regret and agony.

dramabox.title: The Legal Queen's Comeback
dramabox.norm_title: the legal queen s comeback
dramabox.description: Six years ago, after "the Legal Queen" Nora won the rape and murder case, she stepped away from the legal profession for her marriage. However, she returned to the legal world due to her husband Darren's involvement in a major case, exposed Darren's crimes and betrayal, and sent him to prison. With the support of her assistant Ethan, Nora reclaimed the nickname of "the Legal Queen" and took back control of her life, achieving a happy ending in both her career and love life.

dramabox.title: The Last Gambling God
dramabox.norm_title: the last gambling god
dramabox.description: Legendary gambler Henry Smith is framed by his nemesis and fellow gambler, Lip Orville, and forced into hiding after Lip kills his brother, David. On the run and out of options, he's saved by Sophia and assumes a new identity—Carl, a janitor at an underground casino (a speakeasy officially) in Chicago. But when Lip returns, now allied with the mafia, and the infamous mob boss, Don Bazzini, Carl is dragged back into the dangerous world of gambling.

dramabox.title: The Ballerina, Turned Stripper
dramabox.norm_title: the ballerina turned stripper
dramabox.description: A jealous twin, Ha-jung kills their father, sells her prodigy sister Seo-jung to loan sharks, and erases her from the world when the Swiss ballet spot slips from her hands. Stripped of her memories, Seo-jung lives as the stripper "Lee Seoyeon," sinking endlessly until she returns with a new face and a new name, infiltrating the Judith Ballet Company to take back everything- her career, her love, her life.

dramabox.title: Sip the Lies, Toast to True Love
dramabox.norm_title: sip the lies toast to true love
dramabox.description: Seron Corp founder Jeremy Logan suffers a betrayal when his wife Mia Finch believes her vile secretary Vincent Smith over him, dismissing Jeremy's illness as an act. Jeremy breaks free from Vincent's schemes and Mia's control, starting over in Jeston by marrying a childhood flame, Queenie Blain. For the first time ever, he experiences unconditional love and trust as he builds a new life–but an ex's jealousy and a new rival's greed threaten it.

dramabox.title: Mute for Love
dramabox.norm_title: mute for love
dramabox.description: Bella was pushed off the rooftop by her husband Peter and his mistress Farren on their wedding anniversary night. Fortunately, she was rescued by a mysterious gang leader, who helped her embark on a path of revenge. Bella lost her voice due to trauma but unexpectedly regained it when she reunited with her enemies. Her sudden return disrupted all of Peter and Farren's plans, and Bella made new discoveries during her revenge journey...

dramabox.title: Lies That Burn, Love That Bleeds
dramabox.norm_title: lies that burn love that bleeds
dramabox.description: For the sake of Rhea Palmer's future, Elijah Swain stages a betrayal and walks away. Six years later, fate brings them together again—he is now a mafia insider, and she has risen to become a top lawyer. Unwilling to let their story end in a lie, Elijah risks everything to win her back. But when the truth finally comes to light, is love still possible after six years of misunderstanding?

dramabox.title: When Love Pulls the Plug
dramabox.norm_title: when love pulls the plug
dramabox.description: When a heart match is finally found for his gravely ill mother, Lucas Hart is betrayed by his wife of seven years, Nadia Reid. She threatens him, insisting the heart be given to Damon Morse instead. Heartbroken, Lucas leaves with his mother, only to return years later as a renowned heart specialist. Along the way, he not only saves lives but also finds love with Faye Smith—while Nadia is left to face regret as Damon's true nature is finally revealed.

dramabox.title: Marry My Ex After a Drunk Night
dramabox.norm_title: marry my ex after a drunk night
dramabox.description: Fashion heiress Selina and poor athlete Noah fell deeply in love in high school, fighting against her father's disapproval of their relationship. Misled by Sophia, Selina fled abroad without a word, believing she was just a replacement. Years later, at a Las Vegas party, their worlds collided again. Noah was now a top rugby star, while she was bankrupt and humiliated by him. After a drunken night, she awoke to find herself married to him.

dramabox.title: The One I Never Forget
dramabox.norm_title: the one i never forget
dramabox.description: Sofia and Justin, torn apart by a tragic misunderstanding five years ago, reunite in Los Angeles. She is now a renowned journalist, he a baseball star. Past lies and new dangers test their reunion, but uncovered truths and forgiveness allow them to heal old wounds, triumph in their careers, and rebuild their love.

dramabox.title: Hero Should Never Stay Low
dramabox.norm_title: hero should never stay low
dramabox.description: A retired war hero hiding as a humble mechanic is dragged back into conflict when he defends a woman from injustice. As his secret past unfolds, he becomes entangled in love, corruption, and revenge—proving that a true hero can never stay low.

dramabox.title: The World Runs on My Word
dramabox.norm_title: the world runs on my word
dramabox.description: Frank Stroud, once the fearsome leader of Drakefang, now lives quietly as a street vendor in Jendry. On the eve of his son's wedding, he hurries home to help with the preparations, refusing every invitation from his former subordinates. But instead of a warm welcome, he is humiliated and cast out of the house. Just as despair threatens to consume him, fate intervenes—he rescues Nessa Lohan, only to discover she is his long-lost daughter.

dramabox.title: Disguised Power: Undercover Dad in Action
dramabox.norm_title: disguised power undercover dad in action
dramabox.description: Nathan Larson—once the lord of Dracohall, feared and revered as "Lord Warwyn"—vanished six years ago. In disguise as a mere security guard, he quietly hunts for the truth behind his followers' deaths while searching for the woman who once saved his life. But on this day, fate intervenes: he rescues a girl outside his company and discovers she is his daughter—pulling him into unexpected fatherhood and unearthing a long-buried truth.

dramabox.title: Ruling Over All I See
dramabox.norm_title: ruling over all i see
dramabox.description: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

dramabox.title: Jacked Janitor Vs Golden Boy
dramabox.norm_title: jacked janitor vs golden boy
dramabox.description: A bullied janitor turned underground fighter gets his shot at revenge when his childhood tormentor, now a golden-boy champion, joins his gym as a sponsored athlete. But when they're forced to team up to save the gym owner's daughter from a violent ex, their bitter rivalry evolves into an explosive brotherhood, testing what it truly means to win.

dramabox.title: Underlying Dawn: The Rising Ruler (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: underlying dawn the rising ruler dubbed
dramabox.description: There are rumors that if one can gain the favor of Lord Cloud, he will be a man of honor. On this ordinary day, Lars Baxter barges into the conference room of Royal Corp, intending to settle matters quickly and move on to the next delivery. At this time, a meeting about the company crisis is taking place. To everyone’s surprise, Lars suggests the best solution to the problem as if it is nothing to be worried about.

dramabox.title: Dominion Reclaimed: His Path to Supremacy
dramabox.norm_title: dominion reclaimed his path to supremacy
dramabox.description: Vance Zahn, known as Lord Zahn, single-handedly slays the Ten Savage Deities, inscribes the laws of the universe, and ascends as the Deity of Creation across the Nine Realms. After bestowing divine enlightenment upon the Azure Empress, the Human Emperor, and the Demon Emperor, he retreats into a deep slumber. But a hundred thousand years later—before his strength fully returns—the sages strike from the shadows.

dramabox.title: The Way of Her Fist
dramabox.norm_title: the way of her fist
dramabox.description: Cain Ford, the young heir to the Ford-style martial arts legacy, marries into the powerful Roth family to protect his own. Yet his heart still belongs to Iris Blair—a woman the world dismisses as plain. When the Roths discover Cain’s lingering affection for Iris, their fury erupts. To teach him a lesson, they send their strongest fighters to challenge the Fords and leave Cain battered and broken. What they don't know is that Iris has already mastered martial arts in secret.

dramabox.title: Revenge is My Name, Justice My Flame
dramabox.norm_title: revenge is my name justice my flame
dramabox.description: Burdened by vengeance, Penelope Morris is reborn as Molly, a humble maid in a landlord’s household. Outwitting her masters, defying bullies, escaping slavery, and helping those in need, she secretly plots to bring her enemies to justice and reshape her destiny. Determined to change not only her own fate but also the lives of her suffering friends, she leads them toward a future filled with hope and happiness.

dramabox.title: Embers of Betrayal, Flames of Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: embers of betrayal flames of revenge
dramabox.description: After witnessing her mother’s brutal death at the hands of Yuliana Yorke, young Scarlett Byrd and her brother, Ivan, are left for dead in a fire, while her maternal relatives are executed. In a desperate bid to save her, Ivan lures their pursuers away—vanishing without a trace. Thanks to his sacrifice, Scarlett survives, but the flames that nearly consumed her now burn within her as an unyielding thirst for revenge.

dramabox.title: To the Edge of Hell
dramabox.norm_title: to the edge of hell
dramabox.description: After losing his beloved wife, James Foster—the once-feared warrior known as "Lord Invictus"—abandons the battlefield and retreats into a quiet life as a fishmonger. For fifteen years, he dedicates himself to raising his daughter, Madeline Foster, until tragedy strikes again—she is abducted by human traffickers.

dramabox.title: Snatching Back My Destiny
dramabox.norm_title: snatching back my destiny
dramabox.description: Having been betrayed by her stepsister and fiancé, Ruby Scott spends a passionate night with Nelson York, the powerful CEO of a top-tier company. Unmarried, she later gives birth to twins—only to have her son taken from her and face false accusations of infidelity.Years later, she returns with her daughter, determined to reclaim her family business and make her enemies pay.

dramabox.title: Velvet Vendetta: Her Rise, Their Ruin
dramabox.norm_title: velvet vendetta her rise their ruin
dramabox.description: Reborn on the day she returns to the marquis' household, Freya Scott kills Rachel Tucker—the woman who once tried to murder her—accidentally saving the poisoned Crown Prince, Chris Foster. To conceal his health condition from the public, Chris follows Freya to Juset, where she works to purge the poison from his body and prevent the tragic fate she once endured.

dramabox.title: Time-Traveling Mom to the Rescue
dramabox.norm_title: time traveling mom to the rescue
dramabox.description: Only after her death does Sue Shaw learn that she was living in a romance novel where the male lead abandoned her for the female lead and deemed her twin children expendable compared to the female lead's. The story unfolds as follows—her son becomes a delinquent, ridiculed by his schoolmates after failing to win over his crush from the female lead’s genius son, and later ends up in prison for committing crimes.

dramabox.title: Verses of Ascension
dramabox.norm_title: verses of ascension
dramabox.description: Blood stains the earth as evil rises in the world of mortals. Peace is restored only when the Sage steps forward, wielding the power of the heavens to eradicate darkness. As mortals rebuild their empire and establish academies to cultivate new talent, the Sage takes his final breath, marking the decline of Virtue’s Way for the next 10,000 years.

dramabox.title: False Sparks: The Expert Who Wasn't
dramabox.norm_title: false sparks the expert who wasn t
dramabox.description: Sergio Garter, a former professional craftsman in Glenwood, is invited by Nathan Ford, chairman of Ford Machinery, to serve as the factory's technical director following his retirement. What starts as a quiet retirement chapter turns into another decade of invaluable contribution to the industry.

dramabox.title: Riches in Disguise
dramabox.norm_title: riches in disguise
dramabox.description: After achieving success, Trevor Finch opens an electronics factory in his hometown, hoping to bring prosperity to the remote village. However, three years later, the factory remains stagnant and has become a refuge for unsavory individuals. During a festive occasion, Trevor invites his laborer friends to celebrate at his wife Ava Reid's family home, only to face mockery and comparisons from her relatives.

dramabox.title: Blade of Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: blade of vengeance
dramabox.description: Cody Hale possesses the Divine Frame, which makes him a supreme cultivator. He dedicates his efforts to his mentor and seniors, yet is loathed and even mercilessly murdered after his junior framed him. Soon after rebirth, he decisively betrays Skyle Sect and joins Azure Sect instead, becoming a member of the rivaling party. It is only at this moment that his mentor and seniors regret their past behavior.

dramabox.title: Before It Was Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: before it was too late
dramabox.description: When Bryan Lane’s father-in-law falls gravely ill, he calls his wife, Mona Scott, to inform her and urges her to undergo surgery to save her father’s life. However, while keeping her first love’s dog company at a pet clinic, Mona accuses Bryan of fabricating an excuse to get her attention. She dismissively tells him that she’ll return home the next day for her father’s birthday.

dramabox.title: Escape With Boss's Baby
dramabox.norm_title: escape with boss s baby
dramabox.description: Hermione Garcia is a famous computer genius and the heiress to the Garcia family,the wealthiest family in the South. She falls in love with Chris Evans, the President of LM Corporation, after he saves her at a banquet three years ago. To seek a genuine connection, Hermione conceals her identity and takes on the role of Chris's chief secretary, secretly dating him for three years.

dramabox.title: In the Wake of Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: in the wake of betrayal
dramabox.description: On her way to a crucial negotiation, Ayla Young unsuspectingly accepts a drugged bottle of water from her best friend, Karen Lund. Rendered unconscious, Ayla is driven by her husband, Ryan Zell, to a treacherous mountainside, where he and Karen abandon her in a car, leaving her to be buried alive in a devastating mudslide. With no regard for her life, they scheme to take over her company, stooping as low as harming her parents to secure their goals.

dramabox.title: The Love We Almost Lost
dramabox.norm_title: the love we almost lost
dramabox.description: Bella North, an amnesiac and disfigured "orphan," endures the ultimate betrayal when her ex-husband, Damon Sutton, abandons her. Shortly after, a car accident triggers the return of her lost memories, revealing her true identity as the heiress of the powerful North family. Consumed by vengeance, Bella reclaims her identity with a cold resolve. She keeps it a secret from Damon and makes him her personal servant.

dramabox.title: The Ember Reignited
dramabox.norm_title: the ember reignited
dramabox.description: After years of commanding Obsidian Hall with unmatched skill, Shirley Sawyer settles into a quiet retirement as a humble hawker. But her hard-won peace is shattered when her daughter, Anna, is kidnapped by the treacherous Shawn Moran and his wife, desperate to appease the ruthless Javorians. Forced back into the fray, Shirley must reclaim the mantle of a warrior to save her daughter and defend Darlan.

dramabox.title: The Lord of Supremacy
dramabox.norm_title: the lord of supremacy
dramabox.description: The Rising Dragon Hall has been the guardian of Sutherland for generations. Three years ago, the Dragon Lord of the Rising Dragon Hall was betrayed and gravely injured by his subordinate, Wolfe, and subsequently disappeared. With the Dragon Lord missing, Wolfe seized the opportunity to conspire with Edward Hack, the son of the Grand Chancellor, and foreign forces from Janaise, aiming to usurp the Dragon Lord and overthrow Sutherland.

dramabox.title: Code of Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: code of vengeance
dramabox.description: Leah Bell is one of the world’s leading computer experts, yet she chooses to work as a humble programmer at Knox Group out of gratitude. However, her contributions are undermined when Yara Moore steals Leah’s work, leading CEO Neil Knox to form a false impression of her. As a result, Leah is unjustly fired. Moments after her dismissal, Ken Snow, the CEO of the top company in Linton, personally offers her a position at Snow Group.

dramabox.title: Out of the Way, Imposter!
dramabox.norm_title: out of the way imposter
dramabox.description: After being kidnapped and adopted, Vera Gray assumes the name Susan Cole, a name she carries for eighteen years. When her uncles finally find her, she returns home, harboring a deep resentment for her ex-husband, Alex Clark. While Susan has reclaimed her identity, she decides to go undercover at one of the Gray family’s company branches. Meanwhile, Jenny Gray impersonates her as the daughter of the wealthy and powerful Gray family, bullying Susan along the way.

dramabox.title: Return of the Crowned Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: return of the crowned heiress
dramabox.description: Saved by Luke Cole, Jenny Jobe disguises her true identity as the daughter of the richest man and secretly aids him as a token of gratitude. However, she’s met with hostility from his family instead. After three years of escalating tension, Jenny decides to reclaim her identity and live the life she deserves.

dramabox.title: Shadowed Ascension: The Demon Lord's Reckoning
dramabox.norm_title: shadowed ascension the demon lord s reckoning
dramabox.description: After the accidental death of his father, Quinton Zane is left to care for his sister, Layla Zane. In order to survive in the strange and dangerous world, he conceals his true strength and trains hard to become stronger. He reveals his formidable power only after his sister gets hurt, shocking everyone and changing their perceptions of him— the future ruler of Tredon.

dramabox.title: The Power Portal
dramabox.norm_title: the power portal
dramabox.description: Tom Shaw is a diligent security guard who performs his duties with unwavering dedication. Despite his hard work, his gentle nature makes him a target for relentless bullying and teasing from his colleagues. One day, after a simple conversation with Lia Cole, Tom finds himself brutally attacked by a gang of thugs, leaving him on the edge of death.

dramabox.title: Battleborn: The Vengeance Begins
dramabox.norm_title: battleborn the vengeance begins
dramabox.description: After being abandoned by his father, Wyatt Zahn and his sister move to Dynarale with their mother to start a new life. However, their mother soon takes her own life after being betrayed and plotted against. Just before an unknown gang can kill him, a mysterious man intervenes, saving Wyatt and enlisting him in the army. Starting off as a nobody, Wyatt rises to become the Chief General of the Zurius Legion after a decade of bloody battles.

dramabox.title: The Awakened Eyes
dramabox.norm_title: the awakened eyes
dramabox.description: Summer Levin, an employee at an antique shop, is forced by her husband to get a divorce. Through a series of unexpected events, she gains the “Sage Eyes,” which grant her exceptional medical skills and the ability to discern the true value of antiques. With these newfound abilities, she excels in the antiques field, engages in stone gambling, and uses her resources to help others.

dramabox.title: Reborn to Redeem: A '90s Odyssey
dramabox.norm_title: reborn to redeem a 90s odyssey
dramabox.description: Given a second chance, Richard Stone finds himself back in the 90s on the agonizing day he lost his wife, Sara Palmer. Determination flames in his heart as he vows to change his fate and make things right. This time, he is resolved not only to make up for his regrets but also to do everything he can to save his wife and spare his daughter the pain of losing her mother.

dramabox.title: Shadow Pursuit: Unraveling the Facade
dramabox.norm_title: shadow pursuit unraveling the facade
dramabox.description: A young girl, Ada Hunt, is abducted by a big shot who needs her kidney and bone marrow to save his son. Desperate to rescue their daughter, Ada's parents, Ryan and Gina Hunt, spare no effort. Ryan, a retired special agent, leverages his connections to gather leads, uncovering a human trafficking ring along the way. Despite the organization's vast and complex network, Ryan and Gina remain methodical and determined.

dramabox.title: Rule of the Unconquerable
dramabox.norm_title: rule of the unconquerable
dramabox.description: Luke Shaw, once the esteemed lord of Godslayer Fort, loses his memory after a fierce battle with the Four Outer Gods. Wandering the streets in a daze, he is rescued by Eva Cavill, who takes him in and cares for him. Despite her kindness, Luke endures relentless bullying from his superior and mother-in-law, who chase him out and strip him of job.

dramabox.title: The Gifted Quadruplets
dramabox.norm_title: the gifted quadruplets
dramabox.description: Hanna Hale has superpowers, which are inherited by her children. However, her enemies capture her children, and Hanna is forced to live without them. Six years later, they escape from the laboratory using their superpowers and find her. They protect Hanna from vicious attacks from her enemies. Ultimately, they find their father and return home, and they reunite as a happy and complete family.

dramabox.title: The Return of the Unwanted Wife
dramabox.norm_title: the return of the unwanted wife
dramabox.description: I made a deal with the demon for the man I love to reach his peak. The price was harsh: should he never love me in return, I’d have to give up my own life. Yet, after five years of marriage, my hope that his heart might soften towards me shattered completely. Instead of the love I yearned for, I was served divorce papers, a cold reminder of my failure. The demon came to collect its due, but in the twist of fate, a soul sacrificed her own to restore mine. Now that I’m back…

dramabox.title: Return to Fame: Her Second Spark
dramabox.norm_title: return to fame her second spark
dramabox.description: For the sake of her fiancé, the top celebrity Leah Gould sacrifices her career to work behind the scenes. Tragically, she loses her life at the hands of her unfaithful partner and her own sister. Given a second chance through a miraculous rebirth, Leah vows to reclaim everything she lost and rise to the peak of the entertainment industry once again. Since then, she becomes ruthless and cool, seemingly with no sense of warmth in her heart.

dramabox.title: Don't Mess With the Time-Traveling Princess
dramabox.norm_title: don t mess with the time traveling princess
dramabox.description: Lucia Garret, a doctor from the 23rd century, experiences a laboratory accident that thrusts her into the body of a princess consort, rendered mute by a sinister plot orchestrated by her stepmother and stepsister. Determined to right the wrongs inflicted upon the previous occupant of her new body, Lucia treats her damaged vocal cords with modern medicine.

dramabox.title: Treacherous Ties
dramabox.norm_title: treacherous ties
dramabox.description: Yuna Reed, deeply in love with a poor driver, chooses to sever ties with her family to be with him. Tragically, she succumbs to dystocia while giving birth to her daughter, Nina Scott. Gavin Reed spends years searching for his granddaughter, but his adoptive son Henry fears Nina's return could jeopardize everything he holds dear. Secretly manipulating them, Henry strives to sow discord between Gavin and Nina.

dramabox.title: Letters of Sacrifice: Loyalty on Trial
dramabox.norm_title: letters of sacrifice loyalty on trial
dramabox.description: Dracon's genius scientist, Maxton Lloyd, pays Averna a visit for the sake of his country. Ten years later, he returns but is charged with treason and brought to trial. It is not until they read the letters he sent home that they realize how much he has done for Dracon.

dramabox.title: A Night to Remember
dramabox.norm_title: a night to remember
dramabox.description: Zoe Leed accidentally spends the night with a mysterious man and ends up pregnant. Years later, she returns with her adorable little boy, whose dream is to find his mother a tall, fit, and wealthy husband!

dramabox.title: Love After Rebirth: Marrying My Ex's Uncle
dramabox.norm_title: love after rebirth marrying my ex s uncle
dramabox.description: Chloe Park, driven by misguided love for her ex-boyfriend Simon Gray, resorts to stealing confidential information from Gray Group. However, immediately after handing the information to him, he betrays her, along with her sister, Wendy Park. Abandoned in a fire, Chloe faces her final moments. Right then, Lucas Gray rushes in to save her, but tragically, they both perish in the ferocious blaze.

dramabox.title: A Love Rekindled
dramabox.norm_title: a love rekindled
dramabox.description: After falling victim to a scheme orchestrated by her half-sister, Ava Bale, who did not share the same mother, Eve Bale found herself in an unintentional encounter with Ken Stark, resulting in her pregnancy with twins. Upon hearing the news, Ava took one of Eve’s sons, Dean Stark, and replaced Eve as Ken’s fiancée. With no other options, Eve went abroad and raised her other son on her own.Five years later, she returns to expose Ava's scheming plans.

dramabox.title: Underlying Dawn: The Rising Ruler
dramabox.norm_title: underlying dawn the rising ruler
dramabox.description: There are rumors that if one can gain the favor of Lord Cloud, he will be a man of honor. On this ordinary day, Lars Baxter barges into the conference room of Royal Corp, intending to settle matters quickly and move on to the next delivery. At this time, a meeting about the company crisis is taking place. To everyone’s surprise, Lars suggests the best solution to the problem as if it is nothing to be worried about.

dramabox.title: From Anonymity to Stardom
dramabox.norm_title: from anonymity to stardom
dramabox.description: For seven years, I had concealed my true identity and lived among you as an ordinary person. Yet, all that effort has led to nothing but divorce. Now, it's time I reveal who I truly am.

dramabox.title: Nothing Else Compares（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: nothing else compares dubbed
dramabox.description: Shawn Moore locked Kesia Foster up in an asylum, torturing and humiliating her to no end, making her pay for her father’s sin of causing his father’s death.Two years later, he married her, but… “You’re just paying for your family’s sins in another way.”

dramabox.title: Timeless Love: A Heroine's Odyssey
dramabox.norm_title: timeless love a heroine s odyssey
dramabox.description: The top guard of Golden Pavilion was ambushed and killed while carrying out a mission. In a twist of fate, she travels to the future and now inhabits the body of Suzy Lopez, a 21st-century heiress who had previously passed away. Upon her reincarnation, Suzy uncovers the painful experiences endured by the original host, who faced various forms of torture and injustice.

dramabox.title: Fatal Marriage
dramabox.norm_title: fatal marriage
dramabox.description: Shirley Hodge, who has been in a deep sleep for years, wakes up to find her long-trusted medication causing issues. She discovers her perfect husband is having an affair with the maid she hired. Despite this distressing revelation, Shirley must navigate the situation without causing a stir.

dramabox.title: No One Like Her In This World（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: no one like her in this world dubbed
dramabox.description: Zoey Summers made a deal with a mysterious man called Raven Moses to exchange her life for Ian Jennings’ company to be saved. On the day Ian became the richest man in the country, he asked Zoey for a divorce. After Zoey died, she returned as Willow Waters to protect her daughter, and won Ian’s heart in the process.

dramabox.title: The Many Faces of Mrs. Finn
dramabox.norm_title: the many faces of mrs finn
dramabox.description: When the truth was revealed that Charice was not the biological daughter of the Larson family, James Larson found her biological parents and insisted on sending her back to avoid spending money raising her. The Larsons mistakenly thought that Charice’s biological parents were from the countryside and hinted to her not to ever come back, for fear that she would return asking for money in the future.

dramabox.title: No One Like Her In This World
dramabox.norm_title: no one like her in this world
dramabox.description: Zoey Summers made a deal with a mysterious man called Raven Moses to exchange her life for Ian Jennings’ company to be saved. On the day Ian became the richest man in the country, he asked Zoey for a divorce. After Zoey died, she returned as Willow Waters to protect her daughter, and won Ian’s heart in the process.

dramabox.title: The Scheming Maid（DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: the scheming maid dubbed
dramabox.description: 20 years ago, Emma Harrison, the privileged daughter of a wealthy family, enjoyed a life that many envied. However, their world crumbled due to the meddling of a private tutor, Therese Parish. Emma's father became entangled in an affair, her younger brother tragically passed away, and her mother suffered a severe breakdown, shattering their once-happy family.Emma swore to herself that she would definitely make Therese pay back for all the suffering she inflicted on her.

dramabox.title: Nothing Else Compares
dramabox.norm_title: nothing else compares
dramabox.description: Shawn Moore locked Kesia Foster up in an asylum, torturing and humiliating her to no end, making her pay for her father’s sin of causing his father’s death.Two years later, he married her, but… “You’re just paying for your family’s sins in another way.”

dramabox.title: The Scheming Maid
dramabox.norm_title: the scheming maid
dramabox.description: 20 years ago, Emma Harrison, the privileged daughter of a wealthy family, enjoyed a life that many envied. However, their world crumbled due to the meddling of a private tutor, Therese Parish. Emma's father became entangled in an affair, her younger brother tragically passed away, and her mother suffered a severe breakdown, shattering their once-happy family.Emma swore to herself that she would definitely make Therese pay back for all the suffering she inflicted on her.

dramabox.title: Mr. Moore's Secret Wife
dramabox.norm_title: mr moore s secret wife
dramabox.description: Sapphire Wyatt's family was framed and tortured by Logan Moore. Her life became even miserable when she was eventually forced to marry her tormentor. Logan’s exact words were, "Sapphire Wyatt, even in death, you would be subjected to my approval!"

dramabox.title: Spoiling My Sweet Wife to Her Core
dramabox.norm_title: spoiling my sweet wife to her core
dramabox.description: On the day of the engagement, Anne Miller was framed in a cheating scandal. Her fiance, Shawn Smith, was furious and vowed never to marry Anne. She knew that her pretentious step-sister, Elsa Miller, was the mastermind behind it all. Shawn believed entirely in Elsa's lies. Devastated, Anne died with resentment and regret.A soul of a heroine—who shared the same name as Anne—transmigrated into Anne Miller's body and swore to avenge her.

dramabox.title: Love at First Sight
dramabox.norm_title: love at first sight
dramabox.description: An elaborate scheme caused Lisa Shaw to lose her virginity, family, and loved ones. Malicious lies and devious schemes made her the public enemy of the entertainment industry...

dramabox.title: The Unrivaled Dragon King
dramabox.norm_title: the unrivaled dragon king
dramabox.description: The unmatched Dragon King has returned! With overwhelming power and strength, his ironclad rule will have the world trembling in fear.

dramabox.title: Trapped With My Racing Rival
dramabox.norm_title: trapped with my racing rival
dramabox.description: By day, Emilian and William are bitter F1 rivals. At 7 p.m., they're trapped together with a brutal choice: give in to intimacy or inflict pain. Each night pushes them further. But when desire turns real, are they still playing to escape, or looking for an excuse to stay?

dramabox.title: My Rival Captain Made Me His
dramabox.norm_title: my rival captain made me his
dramabox.description: Ethan, a rising hockey star, is forced to share a train seat—and later a hotel room—with Mason, the captain of his fiercest rival team. Mason’s relentless teasing and unexpected care awaken feelings Ethan has never faced. On the eve of the championship, buried desire and a long-hidden secret threaten their careers, their rivalry, and every boundary between them.

dramabox.title: My Boyfriend Wanted Me to Find Him a Girlfriend
dramabox.norm_title: my boyfriend wanted me to find him a girlfriend
dramabox.description: After five secret years, Daphne's boyfriend asks her to set him up with her roommate Maren. Shattered, she leaves. He claims Daphne , dismissing her as "just a sister." To save face, she pretends to love old rival Grant. When a hit-and-run injures her, Caspian ignores her, but Grant rushes over. She learns Grant loved her always, while Caspian's lies broke them. Now with Caspian begging and Grant devoted, she must choose. A tale of betrayal, redemption, and unexpected love.

dramabox.title: Trading Places with My Godly Husband
dramabox.norm_title: trading places with my godly husband
dramabox.description: The sun god Apollo and the moon goddess Artemis—sworn enemies for millennia—are forced into marriage. On their wedding night, a brawl between them accidentally "kills" them both, triggering an ancient contract that swaps their souls. To avoid exposing the truth, they must impersonate each other to maintain cosmic order. But as they search for a way to reverse the spell, love quietly grows between them. Aurora, the goddess of dawn, who secretly loves Apollo......

dramabox.title: Lyanna's Silent Crown
dramabox.norm_title: lyanna s silent crown
dramabox.description: Northern girl Lyanna is sent south as a hostage. To survive, she plays the fool and marries Crown Prince Loren. He seems cruel in public but secretly protects her. With gentle healer Finn's help, Lyanna heals from old wounds. When the Queen's conspiracy is exposed, Lyanna chooses to return north. Loren gives up the throne to follow her—a painful bond takes a new path.

dramabox.title: Magic Rivals
dramabox.norm_title: magic rivals
dramabox.description: Cassian, heir to a failing potion family, is pressured by his father to marry into wealth to save their business. Kael, a high-ranking pureblood wizard who has secretly loved Cassian for years, offers help—but is rejected. Using his influence, Kael makes Cassian his personal assistant. As they grow closer through trials, Cassian finally confronts his feelings. They become lovers, choosing each other at last.

dramabox.title: Fight me,Love me
dramabox.norm_title: fight me love me
dramabox.description: 29-0 champ Callum got dropped in 8 seconds by a no-name challenger, Teo. Then kissed him. Rivals in the ring, lovers in secret—until a doping scandal destroys Teo. Callum fires back: "He's mine." The truth? Tainted supplements. 135 days later, Teo returns—for gold, for his name, for the man who never let go.

dramabox.title: Silent Turmoil Eternal Bond
dramabox.norm_title: silent turmoil eternal bond
dramabox.description: Two rival underworld factions clash in West City. Quinn, young leader of the Old Domain, is betrayed by his trusted ally, crippling his power. Mia, daughter of the enemy boss, rejects her family's cruelty and upholds justice. Enemies turned allies, they expose conspiracies, punish traitors, and fight tyranny. Through trials of power and humanity, they break their doomed fate, end years of chaos, and restore peace to the city.

dramabox.title: Babysitting the Bad boy
dramabox.norm_title: babysitting the bad boy
dramabox.description: Oliver expects to tutor a child, only to meet Marcus, a spoiled, hot-tempered fraternity president. Their constant clashes ignite a passionate romance, but jealousy, secrets, and Oliver's mysterious memory loss force him to choose between staying with the bad boy he loves and walking away for good.

dramabox.title: My Father's Killer Is My Master
dramabox.norm_title: my father s killer is my master
dramabox.description: Hunter heiress Scarlett's family is slaughtered. Vampire lord Cassius claims her as his own, but she plots escape. Kidnapped and nearly sold, Cassius rescues her, cutting ties with his kind. The elder's conspiracy emerges: Cassius spared her not for slaughter but for her blood's power. Forced to fight together, they forge a blood bond. They defeat enemies, end the hunter-vampire war, and marry—from enemies to partners.

dramabox.title: The Dragon King's Pregnant Runaway
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon king s pregnant runaway
dramabox.description: Cursed to die without an heir, Dragon King Draven searches a thousand years for his fated mate—Chloe, the only mortal who survives his fire. He claims her as his bride, but on their wedding day, a siren's trick makes her stab him through the heart. Pregnant and shattered, she escapes to raise their horned daughter Iris alone in hiding. When Draven rises from the volcano, he finds his child—and realizes the curse was never about an heir. It was about her. Love breaks it all.

dramabox.title: Game, Set, Match
dramabox.norm_title: game set match
dramabox.description: NHL rivals Chase and Cole clash in Game 7—Chase scores the winning goal after a violent hit. Forced into a 3-day "enemy bonding" reality show, they share a cabin with one bed, 24-hour wrist ties, and awkward ice challenges. Constant bickering slowly reveals hidden vulnerabilities. As the cameras roll, hatred blurs into something neither expected: attraction.

dramabox.title: Ice Hockey Star Kneels Down Begging for Mercy
dramabox.norm_title: ice hockey star kneels down begging for mercy
dramabox.description: Cruz, a star hockey player with skin hunger disorder, is volatile, injury-prone, and failing classes. Medical student Theo is assigned as his therapist and masseur. Cruz realizes Theo is his rival. Locked in close quarters, both straight men go from loathing to irresistible attraction.

dramabox.title: Fate's Trap
dramabox.norm_title: fate s trap
dramabox.description: Will, a journalist, once accidentally killed one of two mafia twin brothers. Years later, he meets the surviving brother, Carter. They clash—then uncover they were childhood friends torn apart by fate. Hatred turns to fierce protective love. They choose each other, turning fate's cruel twist into a second chance at happiness, a love that surmounts every obstacle.

dramabox.title: Knockout Heart: The Fighter and His Owner
dramabox.norm_title: knockout heart the fighter and his owner
dramabox.description: To save his dying sister, boxing rising star Leo signs a desperate contract with Julian, an arrogant billionaire fighter. Trapped in a luxurious yet brutal training camp, Leo is subjected to Julian's absolute obsession, spanning from violent dominance in the ring to forced surrender in bed. Amid betrayal, humiliation, and uncontrollable desire, two fierce rivals engage in a dangerous game of forbidden love.

dramabox.title: Crossing the Net :Secret Romance with My Rival Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: crossing the net secret romance with my rival stepbrother
dramabox.description: Doris is the perfect defender —— disciplined, untouchable and always nice. Although, there's a one person he can't stand —— Lucas. The violent, arrogant spiker who just became his stepbrother. But Lucas's sheer power and relentless, reckless teasing are breaking something in him. Layer by layer, his perfect mask is falling —— and his body is beginning to want the man he hates...

dramabox.title: Fated to My Vampire Neighbor
dramabox.norm_title: fated to my vampire neighbor
dramabox.description: A pregnant human enters a contract marriage with her arrogant vampire neighbor—only to discover he's her baby's father and fated mate.

dramabox.title: Racing Hearts
dramabox.norm_title: racing hearts
dramabox.description: In 2042, rivals Kane and Elio joined a racing-dating show. On camera they clashed, but Kane secretly saved Elio. Discovering Kane’s sketchbook, Elio learned of his hidden love. Together they fought agency and media pressure. Kane gave up the trophy to cross the finish line with Elio and confessed. They broke free—Elio bore their child, completing mutual redemption.

dramabox.title: Werewolf Academy: Craving The Forbidden Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: werewolf academy craving the forbidden alpha
dramabox.description: One rule at Blackwood Academy: never touch Damien Blackthorne, the cursed Alpha heir. But when he touches Maya Whitefang — his rival's sister — their mate marks ignite. Now Maya must choose: the clan that owns her, or the dangerous Alpha whose wolf calms only for her.

dramabox.title: Lordy! Preacher's Daughter Wants Daddy's Best Friend!
dramabox.norm_title: lordy preacher s daughter wants daddy s best friend
dramabox.description: Lilah, the sheltered daughter of a beloved megachurch preacher, has secretly longed for her father's best friend, Mason—a rugged ex-Navy SEAL. After a bomb threat forces Mason to become her live-in bodyguard, forbidden attraction ignites between them. But as attacks escalate and dark secrets about her father emerge, Lilah must choose between the life she's always believed in and the man willing to risk everything to protect her.

dramabox.title: Kingpin’s Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: kingpin s obsession
dramabox.description: Serena, heeding her mother—the sole heir to the legendary Gambling God—has always hidden her extraordinary gambling skills to avoid deadly peril. But with a father addicted to gambling and a mother critically ill, in need of a life‑saving miracle drug worth hundreds of millions, she has no choice but to go to the Divine Hospital—a place that appears to be a medical facility but is in fact an underground casino.

dramabox.title: The Taming Game
dramabox.norm_title: the taming game
dramabox.description: When Chase, heir to a vast fortune, is asked by his close friend Leo to rein in his unruly younger sister Luna, a game of "taming" begins.

dramabox.title: Coaching My Bad Boy Roommate
dramabox.norm_title: coaching my bad boy roommate
dramabox.description: Falling for the coach wasn't in the contract. Breaking her heart was his plan—until it backfired.

dramabox.title: Bullies and Me
dramabox.norm_title: bullies and me
dramabox.description: On the first day Chloe transfers to Blackstone Academy, she confronts the Hayes brothers—the privileged nobles here. She is labeled "untouchable" and is stuck with the bullying brothers. They become each other's biggest enemies. However, after a series of bullying incidents, Archer develops romantic feelings for Chloe. Will she return those feelings?

dramabox.title: Vampire Elite: The World Between Us
dramabox.norm_title: vampire elite the world between us
dramabox.description: A human girl who lost her parents to vampires must attend a vampire-elite school to save her brother, only to become the unexpected obsession of pureblood vampire prince Caleb Salvatore—a forbidden romance that will either save her or destroy them both.

dramabox.title: Sapphire in the Wasteland
dramabox.norm_title: sapphire in the wasteland
dramabox.description: The sea witch princess Sira is captured by Kale, a general under the tyrant Malak, who intends to use her to find an endless water source. Along the way, the two turn from enemies to lovers. Sira reveals the truth that Malak, in his pursuit of immortality, annihilated the sea witch clan and sealed off the water source. Shattered in his beliefs, Kale joins forces with Sira in a rebellion.

dramabox.title: Wild Ride With My Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: wild ride with my stepbrother
dramabox.description: Emma Wright is the obedient daughter of a strict clergy family, raised to be humble and to follow the rules. To restore her humiliated brother Noah's dignity, she secretly enters an off-road motorcycle race and stuns everyone by defeating Jake Morrison, the school's notorious bad boy and billionaire heir. The victory gives Emma her first taste of freedom and ignites a dangerous, magnetic spark between her and Jake.

dramabox.title: Faking It with the Hockey Captain
dramabox.norm_title: faking it with the hockey captain
dramabox.description: Scholarship girl Julie has one reckless, electric night with the irresistibly hot new hockey captain—only to discover he's Liam, the childhood enemy she can't stand. To kill rumors and keep their exes away, they fake-date… But the chemistry feels anything but fake, and the tension between them is getting dangerously hard to resist.

dramabox.title: My Stepmother's Son
dramabox.norm_title: my stepmother s son
dramabox.description: Olivia hates her stepmother and stepbrother noah because her father abandoned her seriously ill mother, but she becomes his secretary by mistake. During the course of their relationship, the two rivals, who were originally incompatible with each other, gradually develop an ambiguous relationship. At the same time, Olivia discovers that there is a shocking secret behind her family's misfortune.

dramabox.title: Oops, I Lied About Sex with My Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: oops i lied about sex with my stepbrother
dramabox.description:
A good girl's impulsive lie pulls her into a
dangerous, magnetic push-and-pull with the one
boy she was never supposed to want—her new
stepbrother. Forced under the same roof, their
secret games blur the line between pretending and
something forbidden. The harder they try to keep
control, the deeper they fall into a desire that could
ruin them both.

dramabox.title: First Daughter:Forbidden Duty
dramabox.norm_title: first daughter forbidden duty
dramabox.description: After her father, the President, is assassinated, Nova becomes a target of dangerous political enemies. When her father’s best friend and former special forces officer Grant Steele is sent to protect her as her personal bodyguard, Nova immediately distrusts him, seeing him as a hypocrite just like her deceased father. When she uncovers his dark BDSM secrets, she decides to use it against him, trying to seduce him to prove her point.

dramabox.title: QB! Look what you made me do!
dramabox.norm_title: qb look what you made me do
dramabox.description: To cover her grandmother's sky-high medical costs, Nadia crashes a wedding as a faux mistress, escaping in rugby star Benjamin's jersey and unleashing a viral scandal over his inadvertent "cross-dressing" photo. Bound by a forced contractual marriage, she becomes a pawn for idol Paris, tasked with stealing Benjamin's playbook—a betrayal that plunges her into a moral quagmire.

dramabox.title: Love and Bloodlust at Vampire Academy
dramabox.norm_title: love and bloodlust at vampire academy
dramabox.description: A human teenage girl, Margo, attends the first-ever integrated boarding school for the wealthy vampire elite and humans. Surrounded by predators, our heroine must learn to survive while also resisting the allure of the captivating vampire prince, Damien.

dramabox.title: Can't Get Enough of You
dramabox.norm_title: can t get enough of you
dramabox.description: After a one-night stand, Carey is falsely accused of drugging Nolan and is cruelly cast aside. Two years later, she struggles to raise her child alone—until fate brings her face-to-face with her new boss: Nolan himself. Caitlin hides the truth about her pregnancy, and despite facing family pressure, career crises, and the interference of Francis's mother, they remain deeply in love through many struggles.

dramabox.title: One Night Stand with My Husband's Brother
dramabox.norm_title: one night stand with my husband s brother
dramabox.description: As the exclusive heir of the Aksford family, the largest business empire in Europe, Chase had a one night stand with his sister-in-law McKenzie to gain a deeper understanding of her. From their initial misunderstandings and conflicts to their later mutual understanding and reconciliation, the two displayed a series of thrilling emotional entanglements and family disputes.

dramabox.title: Blind Date with My Boss
dramabox.norm_title: blind date with my boss
dramabox.description: The person I went on a blind date with turned out to be my boss!

dramabox.title: The Hot CEO Rejected 500 Ladies For Me
dramabox.norm_title: the hot ceo rejected 500 ladies for me
dramabox.description: She was fleeing pervy photographers. He was in the way. One accidental kiss, one electric jolt—and now Bella, a struggling model, and Cody, a cold (and annoyingly hot) CEO, wake up in each other’s bodies. She’s bluffing her way through high-stakes meetings. He’s strutting in heels and surviving fashion shows. They bicker, clash, and know way too much about each other’s bodies.

dramabox.title: Manny by Day, Billionaire by Night
dramabox.norm_title: manny by day billionaire by night
dramabox.description: Diane, a hard-working single mom, hires a male nanny named "Nick" to look after her son. But little does she know, the man who shows up is actually Ethan, a business heir on the run from danger. Posing as the manny, Ethan blends into Diane's life. Just as their feelings deepen, Diane discovers that Ethan is more than just a manny...

dramabox.title: My Substitute Lover
dramabox.norm_title: my substitute lover
dramabox.description: Everyone in the company knows the proud and aloof CEO, Alexander , harbors a deep love for a mysterious "Goddess" he never mentions.

dramabox.title: Seduced By Playboy Boss
dramabox.norm_title: seduced by playboy boss
dramabox.description: Cora Bowers is a bookworm, that just graduated with an MBA from Harvard. She is a really smart girl, with the weight of the world on her shoulders. She needs a job quickly to be able to help her parents pay the bills. She goes in for an interview for a job that she really needs, and while she is waiting to do her interview, she gets hired for another position, as a Personal Assistant for one of the hottest bachelors in New York.

dramabox.title: Resurgence of a Betrayed Woman
dramabox.norm_title: resurgence of a betrayed woman
dramabox.description: After years as a housewife, Chloe's world shattered when she discovered her husband Jacob's affair with his secretary, Riley. Devastated, she resolved to start anew. By chance, she met Adam, CEO of a prestigious jewelry company—who, as it happened, had also been betrayed by Jacob. Together, Chloe and Adam joined forces to seek justice. Yet as they plotted their revenge, their alliance took an unexpected turn... Could love be in the air?

dramabox.title: The Office Pushover Is The Real Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the office pushover is the real heiress
dramabox.description: Katherine Foden, a wealthy heiress, enters a company as an intern to escape an arranged marriage, only to be bullied in the workplace by a fake heiress, Kathleen who has stolen her identity and claims to be the fiancée of the CEO. Unbeknownst to her at first, the fiancée Katherine’s father has chosen for her, David McGuire, is the CEO of the company she’s interning at. Later, she gradually falls for David as David falls for her as well.

dramabox.title: Marrying My Ex's Boss
dramabox.norm_title: marrying my ex s boss
dramabox.description: Orphaned Sylvia raised her sick sister Ivy, sacrificing her design dreams. Framed by her boyfriend Alan and Daniel (brother of CEO Leo), she entered a fake marriage with Leo to protect his company. Through hardships, Leo saw her talent and kindness. When the truth emerged, she left—but Leo gave up everything to win her back. Together they defeated their enemies and found true love.

dramabox.title: The Christmas Twin Miracle
dramabox.norm_title: the christmas twin miracle
dramabox.description: After losing her newborn twins on Christmas Day, Beth rebuilds her life—until she meets Ethan, a powerful CEO and single father whose twins claim she’s their mother. A marriage of convenience turns real, but when Ethan’s hidden identity and ex-wife resurface, love is pushed to the breaking point.

dramabox.title: My call boy, my loyal CEO！
dramabox.norm_title: my call boy my loyal ceo
dramabox.description: Zoe is a computer genius, but she mistakenly identified Daniel as her benefactor and married him.After three years of marriage, Zoe realized that Daniel didn’t love her at all—instead, he had always looked down on her and used her. Framed by Daniel, she was forced out of their joint company with nothing and lost the patents she had already registered. Choosing to divorce, Zoe started over and launched her own business.

dramabox.title: My Father's Billionaire Boss Treasured Me as His Bride
dramabox.norm_title: my father s billionaire boss treasured me as his bride
dramabox.description: Julia, a bar waitress, is drugged by Peter, her father’s supervisor. She pleads for help from her father but is ignored. While fleeing, she accidentally runs into Eric, the group’s president, and ends up spending a spontaneous night with him. A month later, Julia discovers she’s pregnant. During a violent confrontation with her mother, Eric appears and rescues her. His friend George suspects Julia of deliberately seducing Eric for gain, but Eric dismisses the idea—until he ov

dramabox.title: Silly Daddy, When Are You Gonna Find Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: silly daddy when are you gonna find mommy
dramabox.description: Six years after saving a billionaire and secretly raising their daughter alone, a struggling delivery rider reunites with the now-powerful CEO at a high-stakes modeling contest—where a life-threatening allergy may finally expose the truth.

dramabox.title: Quiet The Office!
dramabox.norm_title: quiet the office
dramabox.description: Kim Na-yul had truly been miserable these days. The workload had already been overwhelming even for three people, and she was constantly left to deal with the messes her junior kept making… Kwon Si-jin, he was a deeply rotten person. With a rotten personality, spewing rotten words—someone who knew better than anyone how to trample on another person's dignity and pride with nothing but his tongue.

dramabox.title: She Chose My Brother, I Married the Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: she chose my brother i married the heiress
dramabox.description: Jordan Steele's company runs into cash flow problems, so he seeks out Hannah Locke, the richest heiress of Crestline, for investment funds. She agrees on the condition that he must marry her. Jordan is already engaged to Sarah Clarke, but he accepts Hannah's proposition, knowing that Sarah's true love is his half-brother. Disheartened, Jordan becomes engaged to Hannah and goes abroad. When he returns, however, Sarah begs him not to leave.

dramabox.title: Daddy, Don't Hurt Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: daddy don t hurt mommy
dramabox.description: Abandoned by the world, six-year-old Bella fights to save her comatose mother, until she's revealed as the secret heir to a billionaire empire. As her ruthless father reclaims her, Bella is dragged into a world of power, lies, and cruelty. When love and money collide, a child must choose: wealth… or the mother who bled for her.

dramabox.title: Fired, Framed, and Fierce
dramabox.norm_title: fired framed and fierce
dramabox.description: Jessica is the star quantitative trader at TB Securities, but she is unjustly fired by the new male-dominated CEO, Jackson. Meanwhile, her achievements and identity are falsely claimed by her scheming colleague, Jessie. Jessie takes advantage of Jackson's misjudgment and steals Jessica's trading model, using it to frame Jessica. At the same time, William, the CEO of Charles Securities, steps in to support Jessica and hires her for his company.

dramabox.title: The Intern is the Undercover Boss
dramabox.norm_title: the intern is the undercover boss
dramabox.description: Don't underestimate the intern because you don't know her true identity.To investigate the truth behind a subsidiary's bullying scandal, CEO Claire goes undercover as an intern, enduring humiliation from the villains. With courage and ingenuity, she uncovers the truth, rebuffs the antagonists, and unexpectedly finds love in the process.

dramabox.title: CEO's Naughty Secret
dramabox.norm_title: ceo s naughty secret
dramabox.description: To take back her mother's hotel, she secretly had a baby with a CEO who was drugged and escaped before he woke up. Little did she know, her evil stepsister pretended to be her, making the CEO believe she was his one-night stand. For the sake of the hotel, she had to see him again, but she misunderstood him as being in a relationship with her stepsister, and then she found out she was pregnant...

dramabox.title: Your Billionaire Bride Is My Cheating Wife
