dramabox.norm_title: your billionaire bride is my cheating wife
dramabox.description: On his birthday, low-profile billionaire Anthony discovers his wife is marrying another man—using his identity, money, and status. Crashing the wedding as a “nobody,” he endures public humiliation until the truth erupts: he is the real CEO and Mafia King. As lies unravel, Anthony reclaims his power, exposing betrayal and delivering ruthless revenge.

dramabox.title: Call Me Stepmom, Fxxkboy
dramabox.norm_title: call me stepmom fxxkboy
dramabox.description: After being cheated on by her boyfriend Brad, programmer Victoria accidentally crosses paths with Dante, Brad's father and CEO of Reyes Group. She hides her ex-lover identity to join Dante's company and develop a programming project named Melova, but falls deeply in love with him. Dante unconditionally supports her career, while Victoria struggles with coming to terms with Dante’s complicated identity.

dramabox.title: Divorced, Then Find My Mr. Right
dramabox.norm_title: divorced then find my mr right
dramabox.description: After a brutal betrayal, Hazel loses her marriage, child, and dignity. Rising from despair, she reunites with Evan, a powerful man who helps her reclaim her career, self-worth, and take control of her fate.

dramabox.title: Our Unscripted Love After Split
dramabox.norm_title: our unscripted love after split
dramabox.description: Charlotte and Arthur enter a contractual marriage, but misunderstandings and Arthur's ex, Stella, lead to three years of pain. As they approach divorce, arguments and flashbacks reveal his true feelings and her past depression. They eventually reconcile, rekindling their love.

dramabox.title: Maybe Love, Maybe Not
dramabox.norm_title: maybe love maybe not
dramabox.description: After Dickson Tennant marries her sister, Eileen Sinden, Linda Sinden buries her love for him deep in her heart. But when Eileen falls gravely ill, she arranges for Linda and Dickson to be together, hoping her children will be left in capable hands. Yet just as Linda begins to believe she can love him openly, Dickson misreads her intentions as scheming and repays her with nothing but misery.

dramabox.title: Love In The Golden Age
dramabox.norm_title: love in the golden age
dramabox.description: After losing her farm due to a sexist will clause, 50-something farmer Teresa marries "farmhand" Augustus in a flash to retain her land—unaware he's a wealthy CEO hiding his identity. Their lies unravel amid ex-wives' sabotage, a long-lost daughter's return, and deadly threats, yet they discover true love that bridges their worlds, fighting to rebuild both the farm and their unexpected bond.

dramabox.title: Moving On Was a Lie
dramabox.norm_title: moving on was a lie
dramabox.description: Five years ago, a food safety scandal shattered Abigail Jensen's world—her father took his own life, her mother lost her sanity, and their family name was ruined. To spare her boyfriend from the fallout, she staged their breakup, breaking both their hearts. Now, when fate brings them together again, resentment turns to regret as he learns the truth and fights to win her back.

dramabox.title: Fate Turned: My CEO Husband Shields Me
dramabox.norm_title: fate turned my ceo husband shields me
dramabox.description: Genius scientist Emma and her sister Samantha became estranged due to a hospital mix-up at birth. After Emma’s successful time machine experiment, she is retaliated against by Samantha, and the two accidentally travel back ten years. Samantha vies for Emma's identity as the Carter family's real daughter and her engagement, while Emma meets Matthew, who hides his identity as a chairman.

dramabox.title: Daddy's Got Girls and Guns
dramabox.norm_title: daddy s got girls and guns
dramabox.description: The mysterious secret agent Peter Rogers was awarded the National Medal of Honor by the President and had retired from the military. While dining out with his daughter Leslie, Peter was mistaken for a blind date by the beautiful CEO Sydney Greenfield, and the two unexpectedly got married. When his classmate and ex-girlfriend, who were unaware of Peter's true identity, encountered him again, they subjected him to various insults and ridicule.

dramabox.title: The Most Painful Kiss in the World
dramabox.norm_title: the most painful kiss in the world
dramabox.description: The protagonist, who has the ability to absorb the wounds and illnesses of others through physical touch, regains true love and destiny after being abandoned by her unfaithful husband.

dramabox.title: Dumped by a Cheater, Spoiled by a Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: dumped by a cheater spoiled by a billionaire
dramabox.description: At 8, Nina goes missing and is raised by Bruce's family. After regaining her memories, she learns her real mother died heartbroken. Her mother's will forces her to marry Mark, or her father loses the inheritance. Forced into marriage with a cheating man, Nina seeks proof to escape. Meanwhile, Bruce, who once confessed to her, finds her just before the wedding.

dramabox.title: All According to His Heart
dramabox.norm_title: all according to his heart
dramabox.description: Niall Hart, a cold man, learns that his longtime crush, Claire Swan, is single again and proposes to her. Claire is stunned; she never expected her aloof boss to suggest a secret marriage. Believing he's only going along with it to get his family off his back about marriage, she reluctantly agrees—until she discovers that Niall has loved her for a decade and planned everything just to be with her.

dramabox.title: My L.A. Fireman
dramabox.norm_title: my l a fireman
dramabox.description: The Palisade wildfire raged as Margaret Foster rushed to save her mother's heirlooms, only to discover her fiancé in bed with her half-sister. Trapped in the flames, Margaret was rescued by a firefighter named Chris. To secure the inheritance of her late mother's company, the heartbroken Margaret impulsively married Chris—the man who had saved her—shattering her father Jacob's plans to forge a political alliance through her marriage to the Los Angeles mayor.

dramabox.title: Divorce A Billionaire To Marry Him!
dramabox.norm_title: divorce a billionaire to marry him
dramabox.description: Alex Blackwell and Lydia Bale were 'married by decree.' After signing a contract, they had no further connection. A year later, Lydia was assigned to Alex as a personal assistant. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually husband and wife. As they gradually developed feelings for each other, they found themselves drifting apart due to their married status...

dramabox.title: Falling for My Fake Dating Coach
dramabox.norm_title: falling for my fake dating coach
dramabox.description: Ashley only wanted to be a quiet secretary. But when she's forced to drag her reckless ex-racer boss, Victor, back into the boardroom, her life turns upside down. He's arrogant, dangerous, and refuses to be tamed—yet he offers her one deal: he'll teach her how to win love, if she keeps his secrets. Every "lesson" blurs the line between business and desire. Every kiss meant as a mistake burns hotter than the last.

dramabox.title: The Beauty Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: the beauty billionaire
dramabox.description: After a car accident and plastic surgery, a part-time worker wakes up with the face of a wealthy heiress. Living someone else's life, she seizes the chance to get revenge on the man who ruined her. But as she gets tangled with the heiress's fiancé, an unexpected romance blooms—and so does the question: how far will she go to keep this borrowed life?

dramabox.title: Fake Princess Diary
dramabox.norm_title: fake princess diary
dramabox.description: A poor girl becomes a "princess" overnight! To pay off her debts, salesgirl Lily agrees to impersonate CEO William's long-lost sister to comfort his dying grandmother. Through a dramatic makeover, the ugly duckling transforms into a graceful swan. But as Lilly and her "brother" William fall for each other, their forbidden love is torn apart by their fake sibling bond.

dramabox.title: Addicted to You, On Air and Off
dramabox.norm_title: addicted to you on air and off
dramabox.description: After a family misfortune, Dakota Noyce becomes Hudson Zerkle's possession for three years while studying abroad—until graduation night, when she finally leaves for home. That same night, the man who was always composed loses control. Convinced a small gesture will bring her back, he doesn't realize she will be soaring free... while he remains behind.

dramabox.title: The Little Healer Who Restored Love (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: the little healer who restored love dubbed
dramabox.description: Bea Ford, a young doctor born into poverty, rescues an elderly woman on her way to the city after being cast out by her mentor. In gratitude, the woman adopts Bea as her granddaughter. This leads Bea to meet her new adoptive father, Jim Hark, the city's wealthiest man, who is confined to a wheelchair by a mysterious ailment.

dramabox.title: Glitched Into His Heart
dramabox.norm_title: glitched into his heart
dramabox.description: Transmigrated into a novel as the villainess, Wanda Reese is tasked with tormenting Jude Somer to fuel his character growth. To survive, she bends the System's rules, secretly winning his favor—only to make him fall for her instead. When the mission ends, she dies and returns to reality. But fate is not finished with her, bringing Jude—and their child—back into her world once more.

dramabox.title: Move to Countryside, Marry a Billionaire!
dramabox.norm_title: move to countryside marry a billionaire
dramabox.description: Forced into a marriage to save her adoptive father, Louise Mitchell leaves the city for the countryside, only to discover her "farmer" husband, Troy Scott, is actually a hidden billionaire. Bound by a three-month contract, their rocky start slowly transforms into trust and passion, as schemes, family conflicts, and secrets test their love.

dramabox.title: Till Truth Do Us Part
dramabox.norm_title: till truth do us part
dramabox.description: A CEO and a barista's flash marriage spirals into chaos as hidden agendas, a jealous ex, and a shocking family secret unravel. Will their hearts survive the lies—or crash harder than their hasty "I do's"? Drama, heat, and humor guaranteed.

dramabox.title: Like Roses, in Summer's Tender Kiss
dramabox.norm_title: like roses in summer s tender kiss
dramabox.description: Freelance photographer Melody Bale is forced into an engagement with CEO Aaron Zahn, a man she deems dull and keeps at a distance. Misreading his kindness as warning signs, she pulls away—only to fall prey to someone who wishes her harm. Through Aaron's steadfast protection and unwavering devotion, Melody discovers the truth of his heart, and love blossoms between them—pure and true, like roses in summer's tender kiss.

dramabox.title: 100 Days to Say Yes to Love
dramabox.norm_title: 100 days to say yes to love
dramabox.description: After saving the gravely wounded Kevin Palmer, Julia Green enters the Palmer family through her grandfather's arrangement, agreeing to a 100-day marriage. Unaware that she is the very woman who saved him, Kevin struggles to keep his feelings in check while searching for his mysterious rescuer. As the truth gradually comes to light, the secrets behind Julia’s identity are revealed—leaving Kevin utterly stunned.

dramabox.title: No More Second Chance
dramabox.norm_title: no more second chance
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Anna was forced to leave Ellison by his controlling mother. To protect his future, she walked away in silence—carrying his unborn child. Unaware of the truth, Ellison was left heartbroken and bitter. Now, fate brings them back together. She's a struggling waitress. He's a successful businessman. Can the wounds of the past be healed, or is it too late for forgiveness and love?

dramabox.title: Baby Deal: Bound to Mr. Infertile
dramabox.norm_title: baby deal bound to mr infertile
dramabox.description: Ian Gray, struggling with infertility, is pushed into a contract marriage by his mother with Mia Shaw, whose exceptionally fertile physiology could be the cure. Believing—mistakenly—that Mia once bullied him in school, Ian mistreats her at work. But when he realizes his error, he must fight to win her heart.

dramabox.title: Your Love Is My Chains
dramabox.norm_title: your love is my chains
dramabox.description: Sienna Quill fakes a betrayal and breaks up with Harry Ford after her father is sent to prison, leaving her a single mother caring for their seriously ill son. Six years later, already burdened by mounting medical bills, she crosses paths with Harry—now a wealthy heir—and is mistaken for a gold-digger. Amid misunderstandings and public humiliation, the truth finally comes to light, and Harry is consumed by regret.

dramabox.title: Divorce, My Happily Ever After
dramabox.norm_title: divorce my happily ever after
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her husband and his mistress while five months pregnant, Rosie Turner is cast out in humiliation despite having sacrificed everything for him. After the divorce, she finds new strength in Andrew Jaffe, a young and charismatic CEO who not only helps her seek revenge but also supports her rise to success. With him by her side, Rosie discovers both triumph in her career and lasting happiness in love.

dramabox.title: I Said Yes to Danger
dramabox.norm_title: i said yes to danger
dramabox.description: Ruth Allen is always blamed and framed because of her sister. Desperate to escape her toxic family, she wishes to marry her parents' enemy—then, to her shock, it actually happens! Life as a daughter is hard, but life as the enemy's wife? Thrilling. She fights back, takes revenge, and finally claims her own life.

dramabox.title: Cited for Stealing My Heart
dramabox.norm_title: cited for stealing my heart
dramabox.description: Working at a club to pay for her mother's surgery, Amelia Scott spends a night with Jacob Shaw and becomes pregnant with his child. When they meet again, she is mistaken for a mistress and an escort. Despite his anger, Jacob proposes a contract marriage to protect her. As they live under one roof, hidden truths emerge—her mother is employed by his family, and the child she carries is his own.

dramabox.title: Our Love, a Choice Away
dramabox.norm_title: our love a choice away
dramabox.description: Sylvia Griffin and Matthew Hart have been married for six years, but they live like strangers despite having a daughter, Emma. When Matthew's first love, Joanne Cole, and her daughter return, he promises to care for them instead. Heartbroken, Sylvia plans to leave with Emma, but seeing her daughter's unwillingness to go, she gives Matthew three chances to change.

dramabox.title: Sweet Poison, No Escape
dramabox.norm_title: sweet poison no escape
dramabox.description: Once paraded as a showpiece for the powerful families, Tara Grant awakens during a piano performance and escapes. She uses Henry Lane to bring down the Grants—unaware she is the very woman he has long searched for: the mysterious Piano Lady. Touched by his unwavering loyalty, Tara falls for him, eventually walking down the aisle toward a new beginning.

dramabox.title: Spoiled by My Billionaire Baby Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: spoiled by my billionaire baby daddy
dramabox.description: Broke and desperate, college student Yuna Lee agrees to a one-night deal with Sejun Han, the cold and powerful heir of a wealthy chaebol family plagued by generations of infertility. When Yuna unexpectedly ends up pregnant—with twins—Sejun is shocked but determined. He brings her into his world, offering protection, luxury, and everything she’s ever been denied.

dramabox.title: Queen Mom Rules
dramabox.norm_title: queen mom rules
dramabox.description: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift is called fake, and she's even banned from the table!

dramabox.title: Scorned Wife's Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: scorned wife s revenge
dramabox.description: Jason Wright, a young and capable general manager, is secretly married to Cindy Sully, the mysterious chairwoman of their company. When Cindy visits the office to deliver Jason's forgotten watch, his secretary Nina—who harbors a secret crush on him—mistakes Cindy for Jason's mistress. Fueled by jealousy, Nina humiliates and assaults Cindy, even causing her to miscarry their unborn child. Upon discovering the truth, Jason and Cindy orchestrate a plan to expose Nina's schemes.

dramabox.title: Death Answers to Me
dramabox.norm_title: death answers to me
dramabox.description: Nina Bale is an immortal who controls life and death. A year ago, the head of the Ford family accidentally severed a geomantic vein, cursing his bloodline. To protect them, he traded his life for Nina's help—for just one year. Now, the Fords, tired of her presence, are ready to cast her out. But just as they do, the powerful Cork family arrives, falling to their knees. Only Nina can save their dying patriarch—and time is running out.

dramabox.title: His Secret 'Man' Crush
dramabox.norm_title: his secret man crush
dramabox.description: Raised by her grandmother, Ashley Muhl learns to protect herself and always disguises herself as a man. One night, she crosses paths with Miguel Smith and sleeps with him. Their encounter leads to the birth of their daughter, Mabel Muhl. Six years later, Ashley joins Smith Corp as Miguel's secretary, still pretending to be a man. Her true identity is eventually revealed, and she finds happiness as Miguel's wife.

dramabox.title: No One Waits Forever
dramabox.norm_title: no one waits forever
dramabox.description: After being in love with Ryan Zeller for seven years, Lydia Russell is devastated to learn that he wants to break up and plans to marry Claire Shaw instead—simply because Claire is as pure and obedient as Lydia once was. Respecting his wishes, Lydia walks away and marries Jonah Brown, the most powerful man in Glayden. Yet on her wedding day, Ryan finally realizes he needs her by his side.

dramabox.title: Lost and Found
dramabox.norm_title: lost and found
dramabox.description: Nailah Vernon is a successful young woman who built multiple businesses and secured her future entirely on her own. However, she suffers from amnesia caused by an accident she experienced as a child-a tragedy that also claimed her mother’s life. As a result, Nailah grew up under the care of Lumi Young's family, completely unaware of her past. Despite her success, Nailah feels incomplete, haunted by the void of forgotten memories.

dramabox.title: Help! I’m Falling In Love With My Rude CEO
dramabox.norm_title: help i m falling in love with my rude ceo
dramabox.description: Hailey Adams becomes the secretary of the rude CEO Mason Anderson. No one else would take the job as Mason had fired five secretaries in a month. Other employees bet on how long she'll last, and when Hailey finds out, she's determined to stay. Mason constantly criticizes her. After a breakdown, Hailey transforms her look and attitude, stunning everyone. Mason's jealous girlfriend, Scarlett, tries to frame Hailey for leaking company info.

dramabox.title: An Affair With My Boss
dramabox.norm_title: an affair with my boss
dramabox.description: Lena is a driven, ambitious executive fighting to maintain control of her family's company in the face of a brewing power struggle. Her world is turned upside down when she begins a secret affair with Finn, a new and much younger employee, while her best friend Rachael is having an affair with her husband, Mark, who is campaigning for a political  seat.Complicating matters further, Liam, a ruthless rival,schemes to undermine Lena's leadership and seize control of the company.

dramabox.title: Drifting Toward You
dramabox.norm_title: drifting toward you
dramabox.description: Having lost her parents at a young age, Mia Walker sells paintings for money to earn a living, only to stumble into the house of the wealthiest family and meet Hugo Young. After a night of passion, Mia flees only to find out about her pregnancy a month later, while Hugo is somewhere out there desperately searching for her.

dramabox.title: Sweetheart Rewind: Triplets in Tow
dramabox.norm_title: sweetheart rewind triplets in tow
dramabox.description: After being betrayed by her boyfriend, Maeve Sinclair spends a lustful night with Tyler Sloane and later gives birth to triplets abroad. Six years later, she returns with her children and joins Sloane Corp, crossing paths with Tyler again. However, after searching for her all those years, Tyler mistakenly believes that she is married, so he becomes her silent guardian—until he finally approaches her and finds out her children are his.

dramabox.title: Ex-Wife 2.0: Richer, Colder, Untouchable
dramabox.norm_title: ex wife 2 0 richer colder untouchable
dramabox.description: Riley Lester, the stunning CEO of Lester Corp in the city of Horrun, has always cherished her husband, Derek Harmon, above all else. She gifts him a Porsche, the luxurious Skyle Villa, and even a Centurion Black Card with a hundred-million-dollar credit limit—while also covering the living expenses of his parents and sister.

dramabox.title: Love Me or I Die
dramabox.norm_title: love me or i die
dramabox.description: Lauretha Thomas, a young woman struggling to find a job after months of rejection, is left feeling hopeless and frustrated. With mounting pressure from her family’s financial crisis and the weight of her own failure, Lauretha decides to escape her problems for a while. She reluctantly agrees to join her best friend, Pamela, at an exclusive, posh nightclub—far beyond her usual standards of living.

dramabox.title: The CEO
dramabox.norm_title: the ceo
dramabox.description: Lucas, once a poor boy raised by his single mother, endured harsh treatment from his wealthy classmates because of his humble background while they were in school. Despite the odds, he grows up determined and becomes a successful CEO of his own thriving company. Ironically, some of his former classmates who once bullied him now work for his company, unaware of his identity because he keeps his life private.

dramabox.title: Faded Threads
dramabox.norm_title: faded threads
dramabox.description: A group of friends meet at a high school ten years later. They were once an inseparable group with one of them secretly out to get them and ruin their lives. Max, one of their friend, drowns under mysterious circumstances but the police rule it out as an accident. They soon find out that that is not so when a video tape from the night resurfaces.Lies and betrayal drive this drama when one of the group members, Sophia Wise, turns out to be the villain.

dramabox.title: Catch Me or Kiss Me Goodbye
dramabox.norm_title: catch me or kiss me goodbye
dramabox.description: After an unexpected turn of events, Lina Cork finds herself pregnant with the child of Jim Lowe, the powerful CEO of Lowe Corp. But just after giving birth, her baby is taken from her—forcing Lina to enter Lowe Corp as a humble cleaner in a desperate search for her missing son. On her very first day, fate intervenes when she unexpectedly crosses paths with him.

dramabox.title: Love's Out of Stock
dramabox.norm_title: love s out of stock
dramabox.description: On their silver wedding anniversary, Louisa Goodall discovers that her husband, Jason Bennett, has been cheating on her for years. While she is desperate to save their marriage, Jason boldly demands a divorce simply because he believes he will soon be promoted to dean. Worse yet, their son and daughter-in-law side with him, leaving Louisa alone in the battle and forcing her to walk away without a single penny.

dramabox.title: You're My Piece, My Whole
dramabox.norm_title: you re my piece my whole
dramabox.description: Tina Lind and Noah Gould grew up side by side, so close that the Gould family eventually decided to adopt her. But before that dream could come true, Tina tragically fell off a cliff and vanished without a trace. Noah was devastated by the loss of his closest friend—and even twenty years later, now a powerful CEO, her absence still haunts him.

dramabox.title: Love On The Run(DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: love on the run dubbed
dramabox.description: Fresh out of college, Hannah Marshall covers her mom's night shift at a hotel, where she crosses paths with Miguel Elsher, who has been drugged. As fate would have it, she ends up spending a night in bed with him. Later, when Hannah applies for a position at Elsher Corporation, she becomes Miguel's assistant.As they spend more time together, a gradual romance blossoms between Miguel and Hannah.

dramabox.title: No Road Too Long for Family
dramabox.norm_title: no road too long for family
dramabox.description: Separated by a tragic accident two decades ago, Alice Smith and her father, Tom Smith, parted ways with heavy misunderstandings clouding their hearts. Now the richest person in the world, Alice begins a heartfelt search for her long-lost father, hoping to make amends and repay the love she once took for granted—unaware that he has been quietly by her side all along.

dramabox.title: Love Found, But Not in Time
dramabox.norm_title: love found but not in time
dramabox.description: After Gwen Stone marries Mark Gregg, Ellie Stone sows discord between them and cruelly takes Gwen's child, unaware that Gwen herself is already on the brink of death. When Flynn Moore—mistakenly believed to be in love with Gwen—arrives, her true identity is finally revealed. With a new future unfolding before her, Gwen leaves with Flynn, while Mark realizes his true feelings only when it's far too late to change anything.

dramabox.title: Married to the Man Who Killed My Husband
dramabox.norm_title: married to the man who killed my husband
dramabox.description: On the day Sophia Smith gives birth, her husband Caleb Levin dies in a sudden car crash, leaving her alone to survive on her own as a widow and single mother. For the next year, Sophia struggles to survive—until Zach Reed enters her life and brings back a hope she thought was long gone. However, a shocking discovery reveals the truth—Zach is the one who orchestrated Caleb's death.

dramabox.title: Marry Again My Billionaire Ex
dramabox.norm_title: marry again my billionaire ex
dramabox.description: After a tragic crash kills her parents, Alexandra Grey assumes a new identity Adrianna for safety. Years later, Lucien, the man she married for protection, asks for a divorce. Heartbroken, she reclaims her true self and returns to take her father‘s company. But claiming her CEO title requires fulfilling a secret arranged marriage—to Lucien. As the danger escalates, he becomes her unlikely ally, and ultimately, her love.

dramabox.title: Where Love Took Root
dramabox.norm_title: where love took root
dramabox.description: Hunted by his enemies, Joshua Fuller flees into the mountains, where he is saved by Nancy Bush, leading to an unexpected night of intimacy. Unfortunately, all he remembers about her is that she was carrying an herbal pouch, making it impossible for him to find her despite years of searching. They cross paths again seven years later when Nancy, now a mother of four sons, stands up for Joshua. However, when he meets Sharon Smith, he mistakes her for the woman from his past.

dramabox.title: Suit Up, It's Love Time
dramabox.norm_title: suit up it s love time
dramabox.description: After her father, David Aston, is murdered by her stepmother, Yara Clark, Nia Aston disguises herself as a man and sneaks into a nightclub to gather proof of Yara's infidelity—only to accidentally sleep with Caleb Dixon. Believing he lost his virginity to a man, Caleb tries to track Nia down, but she escapes by shedding her disguise. Back home, Nia sets out to retrieve her father's Emerald Pendant, only to discover it has been sold to the wealthiest man in Bayton.

dramabox.title: Fragments of Her Final Goodbye
dramabox.norm_title: fragments of her final goodbye
dramabox.description: In the year following her divorce, Lara Nelson retreats from the public eye, leaving netizens to speculate wildly and spread rumors about her losing her mind over Jake Tate's abandonment. The gossip intensifies until a video unexpectedly trends online. The video, broken into seven parts, reveals fragments of Lara’s final journey. The title suggests that, should the video be fully revealed to the public, it would mean that Lara has taken her final breath.

dramabox.title: The Day I Died, Their Hell Began
dramabox.norm_title: the day i died their hell began
dramabox.description: Julia Smith can only watch as her parents and brother shower Emily Smith with love, always choosing her over Julia. Even her own fiancé sides with Emily. Pushed to the brink of despair, Julia sees no way out but to end it all—until fate takes an unexpected turn.

dramabox.title: No Tears Left for You
dramabox.norm_title: no tears left for you
dramabox.description: Sue York, heiress to the York fortune, elopes with Max Dunn, only to face mistreatment from her mother-in-law and sister-in-law, who turn her daughter, Hannah, against her. What was meant to be a celebration spirals into mockery, and Sue seeks a divorce. The Dunns destroy the pendant symbolizing her love with Max, while Hannah stands by without offering support.

dramabox.title: Chains Can't Hide Her Crown
dramabox.norm_title: chains can t hide her crown
dramabox.description: Yael Shaw was always the cherished daughter of the Shaw family—until her 18th birthday, when Sue Lowe appeared, claiming to be the true heiress and accusing Yael of being merely the housekeeper’s daughter. In a single day, Sue steals everything from Yael and traps her in a fake pregnancy with a stranger. Even after five years in prison, Yael’s suffering continues.

dramabox.title: Seducing Mr. Sterling: The Ice-cold Heir
dramabox.norm_title: seducing mr sterling the ice cold heir
dramabox.description: To save her dying sister, Emma agrees to seduce ruthless CEO Ethan Sterling and ruin his reputation. But as she enters his world of power and secrets, she finds herself falling for the man she was meant to destroy. Torn between love and betrayal, Emma must choose: her sister's life—or the man who just might save her own.

dramabox.title: I Loved, But I Let Go
dramabox.norm_title: i loved but i let go
dramabox.description: On their fifth wedding anniversary, Brian Lodge abandons his wife, Linda Grant, and their son, Tim, to spend the day with his childhood sweetheart, Sharon Birch. Heartbroken, Linda takes Tim and leaves. That night, under a relentless downpour, they get into a tragic car accident—one that costs Tim his eye. When Brian returns, begging for forgiveness, Linda gives him a second chance. She can’t bear for Tim to lose both his sight and his father.

dramabox.title: Whirlwind Vows: The Storm of Love (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: whirlwind vows the storm of love dubbed
dramabox.description: After her father ends up in a vegetative state, Sophie Lush is tricked by her stepmother and stepsister into sleeping with a stranger, then kicked out of her home. To pay for her father’s medical bills, she sells the ring left behind by the stranger, not knowing that he is Colin Reid, the CEO of Mirage Corp. Unbeknownst to her, Colin searches for her for years but fails to track her down.

dramabox.title: Their Folly, Their Ruin
dramabox.norm_title: their folly their ruin
dramabox.description: On her brother’s wedding day, Celine Quinn leaves home with her daughter to attend the ceremony, only to encounter a couple walking their unleashed dog through a residential area. When the dog urinates on her car tire, Celine confronts them—but they respond with indifference. Shockingly, the dog even attacks her daughter, leaving the little girl severely injured.

dramabox.title: Kiss or Kill
dramabox.norm_title: kiss or kill
dramabox.description: Wanda Pike swore vengeance after her mother’s murder—and years later, she’s ready to deliver. As the head of an elite security agency, she infiltrates the life of Mayville’s most feared crime lord, Marco Barone, posing as his lover and fiancée.But on their wedding day, her carefully laid trap erupts in chaos. Marco escapes—only to be shot by the woman he trusted most.Justice? Not quite. When fate throws them together again, the line between predator and prey blurs.

dramabox.title: Beyond the Point of No Return
dramabox.norm_title: beyond the point of no return
dramabox.description: They once finished each other's sentences, but now Stella Lindt and Joseph Hall have nothing left to say. As Stella privately battles terminal cancer, Joseph's attention drifts to Lucy Sanders, his vulnerable young secretary, whose emotional needs provide him an escape from his hollow marriage. Each time Joseph chooses Lucy's company over his wife's, Stella's heart breaks a little more—yet she guards her diagnosis fiercely, determined not to be loved out of pity.

dramabox.title: Goodbye, My Once and Forever
dramabox.norm_title: goodbye my once and forever
dramabox.description: Wendy Jensen, a wealthy heiress, begins a relationship with Jerry Hale in college and makes a five-year bet with her parents. She never expects betrayal. Yet, in the fifth year, Jerry brings home his assistant, Tina Sutton. While Wendy is asleep, Tina gives Wendy’s son a glass of wine. Furious, Wendy demands accountability, but Jerry defends Tina, telling Wendy not to overreact. Torn and heartbroken, Wendy decides to file for divorce.

dramabox.title: Regret in the Shape of Her Name
dramabox.norm_title: regret in the shape of her name
dramabox.description: Rose Baker and Nathan Shaw built their success from nothing, standing by each other through every hardship. As husband and wife, they were once inseparable. But after achieving everything they had dreamed of, Nathan betrays the woman who helped him rise. When Rose confronts him, he refuses to take responsibility. Instead, he suggests they live separate lives, convinced she would never leave him—never love anyone else. But he underestimates her.

dramabox.title: Her Crown, Not His Love
dramabox.norm_title: her crown not his love
dramabox.description: On the day Camelia Lautner plans to share the joyous news of her pregnancy with her husband, Jason Chase, she walks in on him with another pregnant woman—his mistress, Sabrina Shaw. Her patience shatters when Sabrina publicly humiliates her, leading to a tragic miscarriage at her mother-in-law’s birthday party. Devastated by betrayal and divorce, Camelia returns to the powerful Lautner family she once left behind for Jason—the wealthiest in the city.

dramabox.title: Three Chances, Then Goodbye
dramabox.norm_title: three chances then goodbye
dramabox.description: Winnie Smith ends her loveless marriage and plans to take her son, Luca, back to Ausmo. But Luca, unwilling to give up on his father, gives Henry Goode three chances—only to be met with cold indifference. Heartbroken, he finally leaves with his mother. Only when they’re gone does Henry realize his mistake, but it’s too late—Luca no longer sees him as his father.

dramabox.title: Billionaire Alpha Won’t Let Me Go
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire alpha won t let me go
dramabox.description: Zoe Lopez returns to New York with her young son and crosses paths with Alexander Blackwood, a past lover—and a werewolf. As old feelings resurface, buried secrets of power, family, and supernatural heritage threaten their lives. With danger looming, their intense romance reignites, forcing them to face a fate beyond their control.

dramabox.title: Reborn to Let Go
dramabox.norm_title: reborn to let go
dramabox.description: The day her husband Owen Whitman's parents are kidnapped, Kaitlyn McGee stops him from going on a camping trip with his mistress and demands that he save them instead, which unfortunately results in the death of his mistress in spite of successfully saving his parents.

dramabox.title: Her Last Anniversary Gift
dramabox.norm_title: her last anniversary gift
dramabox.description: Although Nathan York loves his wife, Laila Smith, he takes a mistress. The day Laila discovers his affair, she is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Given a month to live, she chooses to end it in seven days by ingesting poison. Unaware, Nathan plans a grand anniversary celebration on the day of her death. When the poison takes effect, he mistakes it for a joke—until she collapses, blood on her lips, as divorce papers and photos of his betrayal scatter around him.

dramabox.title: Ablaze With Vengeance (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: ablaze with vengeance dubbed
dramabox.description: Years ago, Layla York, Balton’s Valkyrie, believed Sean Groff had saved her life, and that belief led to their marriage. Over the past three years, she has devoted herself to him and his family, aiding in his ascent to prominence and facilitating his entry into the Onyx Group. She plans to announce his appointment as CEO during the Phoenix Gala.

dramabox.title: This Is Where We End
dramabox.norm_title: this is where we end
dramabox.description: Seven months into her pregnancy, Ashley Young struggles with every movement, her swollen belly making even the simplest tasks difficult. Yet, her husband remains utterly indifferent, as if she means nothing to him. He not only allows his secretary to mock her stretch marks but also forces her to cook for his guests. He even casts her out of their home, shattering her heart.

dramabox.title: Love Fades, I Rise
dramabox.norm_title: love fades i rise
dramabox.description: Wendy Lind is more than just Marcus Grant's assistant—she's his secret wife. But to him, she’s nothing more than a tool, waiting to be used when needed. Seven years ago, a fleeting encounter led to the birth of their son, Timmy Grant. Yet Marcus has never once allowed Timmy to call him “Dad.” Worse, he welcomes another woman into his home, casting Wendy and Timmy aside just to please her.

dramabox.title: I Loved You, But Not Anymore
dramabox.norm_title: i loved you but not anymore
dramabox.description: In her final moments, Alison White discovers the heartbreaking truth—her husband, Sean Haller, has always loved her cousin, Vanessa Gray. But fate grants her a second chance. Reborn, she refuses to live under Sean’s shadow again. This time, she chooses Clive Haller, Sean’s younger uncle—superior to him in every way. What she doesn’t expect is that Sean will stop at nothing to win her back.

dramabox.title: Between Lies and Love
dramabox.norm_title: between lies and love
dramabox.description: Determined to tear apart Emma Boyer's marriage, Penny Chandler orchestrates a meeting between Emma and a stranger, hoping to drive the couple to divorce. However, Emma is unexpectedly rescued by Steve Chandler, who becomes her savior. As their bond deepens, Emma discovers she is pregnant with Steve’s only child.

dramabox.title: When Love Runs Out
dramabox.norm_title: when love runs out
dramabox.description: Wanting to make the most of his life before marriage, Nick Frye pretends to have lost only his memories of Ruby Wright in a car accident. Desperate to help him, Ruby spends all her savings on a rumored cure—only to uncover the truth just as she is about to give it to him. Shattered by the betrayal, she changes her name and moves abroad to escape the unbearable heartbreak.

dramabox.title: Take Me Home
dramabox.norm_title: take me home
dramabox.description: On the day of her son Adam's 6th birthday, Helen Walker, living in a small town, leaves him momentarily to buy a birthday cake, only for him to go missing. At the same time, Elon Hall, a passing businessman, rescues Adam and unknowingly adopts him, taking him to New York. Twenty years later, Adam, now the heir to Hall Group, is sent to Camden to handle a real estate project.

dramabox.title: Before the Divorce: My CEO Husband Can't Get Enough of Me
dramabox.norm_title: before the divorce my ceo husband can t get enough of me
dramabox.description: Sophia is set up for a one-night stand with a man, only to find out that the man she had sex with last night is her husband, Matthew Soro. Unexpectedly, Matthew does not recognize Sophia as his wife, whom he has not seen for three years after getting a marriage license. Sophia is already a PR manager and meets Matthew again while collaborating on a project.

dramabox.title: When Love Ends, Power Begins
dramabox.norm_title: when love ends power begins
dramabox.description: In just three years, Sue Judd rises to success as a CEO with a net worth of three hundred million dollars, while her husband, Finn Knot, still earns a modest monthly salary of only five thousand dollars. As Will Lowe stirs up discord, Sue grows increasingly disdainful of Finn's perceived incapacity, leading her to ultimately decide on a divorce.

dramabox.title: The Sweetest Payback
dramabox.norm_title: the sweetest payback
dramabox.description: Zoe Yale, the rightful daughter of the Yales, is forced into marriage with Jim Shaw—a man she barely knows—simply because her parents want to secure a future for their adopted daughter. Betrayed and cast aside, Zoe severs ties with her family and agrees to Jim's proposal for a contract marriage. What she expects to be a cold, transactional union takes an unexpected turn when Jim showers her with genuine tenderness.

dramabox.title: Sold Out by Greed
dramabox.norm_title: sold out by greed
dramabox.description: In the eighth month of her pregnancy, Freya Summers joyfully receives a five-million-dollar annual bonus after securing a major deal for her company. Taking advantage of her early maternity leave, she plans a surprise for her husband and mother-in-law, playfully joking that she was fired. However, their reaction is nothing she expected—they reveal their true colors, turning on her and even harming her.

dramabox.title: Forever Was a Lie (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: forever was a lie dubbed
dramabox.description: Nicole Quinn is taken in by her mother’s best friend after her family goes bankrupt, beginning a 20-year bond with Colin and Abel from the Smith family. The brothers dote on Nicole, but everything changes when the nanny’s daughter, Mandy Moore, enters the picture. Nicole becomes the target of Mandy’s schemes and humiliation, placing her in a difficult situation where the Smith brothers start distancing themselves and lose interest in her.

dramabox.title: The Beast of Greed Within
dramabox.norm_title: the beast of greed within
dramabox.description: Faith Eaton receives news of her parents' car accident but suspects foul play. Memories of her past life push her to investigate, uncovering Mabel Cohen and Jerry Grimm’s secret affair and threats against her parents. Using her family's resources, she gathers evidence and exposes them at the funeral, but her relatives remain skeptical. Only when she presents undeniable proof do they believe her.

dramabox.title: The Contract of Forever
dramabox.norm_title: the contract of forever
dramabox.description: Tristan Moore forces Sierra Kurt into marriage after discovering she can bear his child, offering her a generous sum. However, he soon learns that she has a genetic disorder, which will likely claim her life after childbirth. Keeping this secret, he plans to use the child to secure his inheritance. As they spend more time together, Tristan falls in love with Sierra, torn between saving her or their unborn child.

dramabox.title: My Mother, The Hidden Tycoon
dramabox.norm_title: my mother the hidden tycoon
dramabox.description: Mary Lane, once the Queen of Velorian Finance, has been living a quiet life, working in a restaurant after stepping away from her esteemed career. She has remained unnoticed—until Zach Gray, CEO of Gray Corp, witnesses her fearless takedown of a fraudster, instantly earning his admiration. Despite her humble occupation, Mary secretly supports her daughter, Luna Lane, helping her company rise to the top of the automobile industry.

dramabox.title: Three Strikes to My Heart
dramabox.norm_title: three strikes to my heart
dramabox.description: As his assistant, Eve Wilde has been deeply in love with Hugh Grimm for years. After Hugh gets her pregnant while drunk one day, they enter into a secret marriage. However, what Eve mistakenly believes is the start of a happy romantic life is, in fact, the beginning of a nightmare—all Hugh cares about is his first crush, and he even hurts Eve and their child mercilessly if it benefits his beloved.

dramabox.title: Forever Starts Tonight
dramabox.norm_title: forever starts tonight
dramabox.description: Stella Page, a 19-year-old student at Joyner University, finds herself in an unexpected situation after a night of passion with Jerry Gray, the CEO of Gray Corp, who is believed to be unable to have children. To her surprise, she later discovers she is pregnant with sextuplets. However, due to a misunderstanding, she and Jerry lose contact, leaving him unaware of her pregnancy.

dramabox.title: My Secret Agent Husband 2
dramabox.norm_title: my secret agent husband 2
dramabox.description: After surviving the chaos of their first adventure, Lucas and his secret agent husband, Wyatt, finally settle into a new chapter of their lives. Lucas is thriving as CryptoLink's CEO, while Wyatt juggles his undercover missions. But just when they think they’ve found stability, old threats resurface, new betrayals unfold, and their long-awaited wedding is once again in jeopardy.

dramabox.title: Clocking In for Love
dramabox.norm_title: clocking in for love
dramabox.description: After a flawed premarital medical examination, Megan Lowe unexpectedly finds herself pregnant with Ethan Gray's child. Without the support of the child’s father, her once stable life unravels, exposing the true nature of those around her. Her boyfriend, mistakenly believing her to be unfaithful, physically assaults her, and her superior humiliates her. Fortunately, Ethan, the CEO of her company, intervenes and offers her a position as his secretary.

dramabox.title: Secrets of the Heart
dramabox.norm_title: secrets of the heart
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her own sister and best friend, Stella Judd spends a passionate night with a stranger. Faced with accusations of transactional relationships, she has no choice but to leave the country. Years later, she returns, only to find herself immediately set up on a date with the heir of Gray Group—a man who feels strangely familiar, though she can’t quite place him.

dramabox.title: Boss! U Almost Got Her
dramabox.norm_title: boss u almost got her
dramabox.description: When childhood sweethearts arrange to reunite at a bridal shop after twenty years apart, a manipulative best friend steals the bride's place and her billionaire groom. Now working as his secretary, the real bride must navigate growing feelings for her boss while unaware he's her long-lost love - even as her friend rushes them toward a wedding built on lies.

dramabox.title: The Bridge to Your Heart
dramabox.norm_title: the bridge to your heart
dramabox.description: After losing her parents in a car accident, Chloe Ford is taken in by Sean Lloyd, who raises her with care. When she turns eighteen, she confesses her love, but Sean rejects her and urges her to focus on her studies. Refusing to give up, Chloe’s persistence forces Sean to fake a fiancée, shattering her heart. Silently, she leaves for a distant school, disappearing from his life.

dramabox.title: When Arrogance Meets the Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: when arrogance meets the heiress
dramabox.description: After studying abroad, Maria Lawson, heiress to Lawson Corp, returns to the company, concealing her identity to start as a regular employee. Her superior, Wayne Cooper—the Vice CEO's arrogant nephew and top salesperson of the year—abuses his connections to bully colleagues, treating Maria as a disobedient newbie. Before the annual party, he falsely accuses her of being a corporate imposter.

dramabox.title: Replaced on My Wedding Day
dramabox.norm_title: replaced on my wedding day
dramabox.description: Ivy York has been with John Snow for six years, and their wedding day is finally set. But John betrays her in the worst way—he marries Stacy Stone to fulfill her mother’s wish, making Stacy the bride at Ivy’s own ceremony. Ivy’s dress is stolen, and she’s framed for hurting Stacy’s mother. Her life shatters, but William Grant, the powerful Lord of Jinton, steps in. He exposes Stacy and her mother’s deceit, helping Ivy see John’s true nature.

dramabox.title: Carrying His Babies, Stealing His Heart
dramabox.norm_title: carrying his babies stealing his heart
dramabox.description:
Ella Reed is a struggling college student who’s barely making ends meet. Desperate
to cover her tuition, she accepts a one-night arrangement with Sebastian Harrington,
a billionaire heir from an affluent family grappling with a legacy of infertility. When
Ella discovers she’s pregnant with twins, Sebastian, eager to secure his family’s
long-awaited heir, brings her into his luxurious world to ensure a safe and peaceful
pregnancy.

dramabox.title: I Became Mrs Grayson by Bragging
dramabox.norm_title: i became mrs grayson by bragging
dramabox.description: On the day of the interview, Alice, an ordinary girl, saved the CEO of the Grayson pharmaceutical group, and bragged that she was the CEO's financee. Unexpectedly, the CEO not only asked her to be his personal assistant, but also married her in a flash.

dramabox.title: Lion's Dawn
dramabox.norm_title: lion s dawn
dramabox.description: Leo was paralyzed and in a coma for three years after a car accident. Davina dropped out of school to care for him. Leo was secretly the heir to the Thorne Group and Brandohr family. During a fundraiser, Joseph tried to take Davina, but Leo woke up and called his family, who stopped Joseph. At their wedding, Davina’s relatives mocked Leo, but Cynthia and the Earl of Brandohr appeared, silencing everyone. Leo then proposed to Davina.

dramabox.title: The Runaway Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the runaway heiress
dramabox.description: The story of a rich girl, Veronica, who is about to marry her beloved fiancé, Logan, but Veronica realizes that Logan's love isn't real, but an elaborate scheme for the benefit of the family. Ellie has been secretly planning to take advantage of Veronica's status and wealth to marry into the family.

dramabox.title: Forever Bound to You
dramabox.norm_title: forever bound to you
dramabox.description: When Eve Hill gave birth to twins after a one-night encounter with Sean Flint, she never imagined the heartbreak that would follow. Her stepsister, Ciara Hill, stole her son and fed Sean a devastating lie about her death. Years later, Eve's journey brings her to Flint Corp, where she reconnects with Sean under unexpected circumstances. As love rekindles, Sean hides his true identity, creating chaos and hilarity at every turn.

dramabox.title: Crossroads of Love
dramabox.norm_title: crossroads of love
dramabox.description: Victoria Morgan, a forty-year-old woman, marries Shawn Snyder, the chairman of a thriving company, to fulfill her daughter's wish for her to find a partner. However, on the very day they register their marriage, Shawn departs abroad for business and disappears from contact for an entire year. When Shawn finally returns, Victoria unknowingly becomes his personal assistant, with neither of them recognizing the other.

dramabox.title: If Only I Had Loved Her More
dramabox.norm_title: if only i had loved her more
dramabox.description: On New Year's Eve, Bella Joslin is hospitalized due to a cancer relapse, while her husband, Hugo Pitt, spends the night at an amusement park with his secretary, Gwen Lowe. Denying Bella's illness, Hugo cuts off her financial support and showers Gwen with expensive gifts. Even as Bella faces a critical surgery, Hugo refuses to sign the consent form, leaving her alone. Yet, when Gwen has an allergic reaction, Hugo rushes her to the hospital in a panic.

dramabox.title: When Hearts Align
dramabox.norm_title: when hearts align
dramabox.description: A tragic accident strips Zoe Page of her true identity as Silvia Frost, the daughter of Naldor’s wealthiest family. Adopted by a humble couple, Zoe grows up unaware of her past, while Sophie Frost, her grieving mother, spends years searching for her lost daughter. Through a twist of fate, their paths cross when Sophie and her son, Larry, meet Zoe by chance. Mistaken for someone insignificant, Zoe faces prejudice and harsh treatment from the Frosts.

dramabox.title: Into the Trap of Love
dramabox.norm_title: into the trap of love
dramabox.description: After falling in love with her brother, who shares no bloodline with her, Xaviera Steele is banished from the country for five long years. Upon her return, she encounters Theodore Hewitt, her brother's notorious and infamous friend. She never expects that she will find herself entangled in a scandalous relationship with him—little does she know, it is all part of Theodore's carefully orchestrated scheme.

dramabox.title: My Lovely Wife is a Big Shot
dramabox.norm_title: my lovely wife is a big shot
dramabox.description: My Lovely Wife is Big Shot-A secretive runaway heiress and a billionaire disguised as a homeless man find themselves in a whirlwind marriage of mistaken identities, outrageous schemes, and laugh-out-loud chaos, as they battle power-hungry exes and uncover shocking truths—one mishap at a time.

dramabox.title: A Toast to Truth
dramabox.norm_title: a toast to truth
dramabox.description: Cade Yale, the chairman of Soar Corp, finds himself mentioned repeatedly in his classmates' group chat, as they urge him to attend Sean Judd’s wedding. Initially, Cade plans to decline the invitation due to his demanding work schedule. However, everything changes when Sean shares a photo of his fiancée in the chat—revealing that the bride-to-be is actually Cade’s wife, Hana Soot.

dramabox.title: Escape to Love
dramabox.norm_title: escape to love
dramabox.description: The day of their blind date, Cadmus Jones sent his assistant to meet Hazel Brennan in his place, while he sat at the next table, disguised, and observed their interaction. Little did he know that Hazel had other tricks up her sleeve—she showed up to the date with hideous makeup and a ludicrous costume. Cadmus could not help but become increasingly attracted to this witty, sharp-tongued girl.

dramabox.title: Love That Comes Too Late
dramabox.norm_title: love that comes too late
dramabox.description: When Jill Shaw uncovers her husband Sam Ford's betrayal with her own sister, Nina Soot, she makes a bold choice to walk away—leaving both her marriage and her job behind. At Ford Corp, she seizes the chance to shine, unleashing her full potential and gaining a clearer picture of Sam's true character. As Jill excels in both her career and love life, she unexpectedly attracts Sam's attention once again—but this time, nothing will ever be the same.

dramabox.title: Love Across Time
dramabox.norm_title: love across time
dramabox.description: A beauty content creator from 2024 traveled back to the 1990s and encountered the younger version of a future billionaire. The story unfolds as they navigate a romantic relationship.

dramabox.title: Love by Contract
dramabox.norm_title: love by contract
dramabox.description: Maya helped her best friend, Cana, deal with her blind date with Finn disguised as the punkish Lina. After the blind date, Maya realized that Finn was her company's new CEO, and she accidentally became his new secretary. She thought she wouldn't see him after the blind date, but after Finn realized the person he had a blind date with wasn't Cana, he became very interested in Lina and signed a contract with her for 10 dates.

dramabox.title: When Love Was All and Nothing
dramabox.norm_title: when love was all and nothing
dramabox.description: After six years of being deeply in love with Dan Irvin, Flora Kent discovers that she was merely a replacement for his first love, Iris Lake. Heartbroken, Flora decides to go through with her family's arranged marriage. Left with Iris, Dan eventually uncovers her true nature and punishes her for it. Later, he receives a wedding invitation from Flora's brother, Evan Kent, and sees this as his chance to win Flora back.

dramabox.title: Love's Masquerade
dramabox.norm_title: love s masquerade
dramabox.description: Nora Gray made herself look unattractive for a blind date but was still chosen by Ryan Jean. She was forced to marry Caden Jean. On their wedding night, Nora mistakenly thought Caden was cheating on her with Riley Griffin. Later, Anna Watson picked on Nora. Nora also discovered that her childhood friend had become her nephew-in-law. Nora caught Riley spiking the soup that Caden later drank. When Caden tried to make a move on her, Nora knocked him out.

dramabox.title: Forever Was a Lie
dramabox.norm_title: forever was a lie
dramabox.description: Nicole Quinn is taken in by her mother’s best friend after her family goes bankrupt, beginning a 20-year bond with Colin and Abel from the Smith family. The brothers dote on Nicole, but everything changes when the nanny’s daughter, Mandy Moore, enters the picture. Nicole becomes the target of Mandy’s schemes and humiliation, placing her in a difficult situation where the Smith brothers start distancing themselves and lose interest in her.

dramabox.title: Mission Possible: Love Rewired
dramabox.norm_title: mission possible love rewired
dramabox.description: After being taken back from the orphanage, Sybil Mull is forced into an arranged marriage with Chad Nicol, the heir to the Nicol family. Enraged by the news, her jealous adoptive sister, Liana Mull, manipulates Mike Nicol into drugging the engaged couple. However, the plan goes awry when Mike mistakenly sends Chad to the wrong room, resulting in an unexpected and passionate night between Chad and Sybil.

dramabox.title: The Fortune-Telling Mrs. CEO
dramabox.norm_title: the fortune telling mrs ceo
dramabox.description: Susan Clark is sent to the mountains as a child, warned by her mentor that she won’t live past 20 without a cure from the outside world. At 20, she leaves to visit her parents’ graves but, facing suspicion from her brother-in-law, heads to Elysium to seek Jim Smith. Along the way, she saves Jim’s grandmother, who appoints her as Jim’s future wife and gives her a family bracelet.

dramabox.title: Lightning Marriage with a Tycoon Husband
dramabox.norm_title: lightning marriage with a tycoon husband
dramabox.description: Professional Ginny was arranged by her grandmother to marry the man she first met, Kesten, who disappeared without a trace after the wedding. Ginny also forgot about getting married and worked hard to get into M Group. A year later, M Group President Allis Miller returned to the United States from Europe. Ginny always thought Allis looked familiar, but couldn't remember where she had seen him. At work, she chanced to discover that Miller and Kesten were the same person?

dramabox.title: Love in the Spotlight
dramabox.norm_title: love in the spotlight
dramabox.description: When the Judds finally find their biological daughter, Mia Judd, they kick Jill Leed out of the house to make room for their long-lost family member. To make matters worse, Jill’s childhood sweetheart, Zac Ford, announces his engagement to Mia and accuses Jill of being the mistress between them. Devastated by the sudden turn of events, Jill drowns her sorrows in alcohol and spends a night with her good friend, Ian Lowe.

dramabox.title: She Came from the Abyss
dramabox.norm_title: she came from the abyss
dramabox.description:
In order to exact her revenge for her mother and older sister's death, Adel infiltrated the Bay family disguised as the maid Kris Frost. Her target? Jamie Suthern, who married into the Bay family. 

She gained others' trust, created conflict, seduced Tony Bay, and destroyed his marriage with Jamie. Jamie was smart, yet she was a lunatic. The two fought, and Adel was kicked out of the Bay family thrice, but she would always return.

dramabox.title: One Step Away from Goodbye
dramabox.norm_title: one step away from goodbye
dramabox.description: Five years have passed since Diana Reid married Ethan Gray, but on her birthday this year, he’s nowhere to be found. As the hours tick by and the diner they reserved for her special day closes, Diana is left alone, forgotten. Ethan, instead of celebrating with his wife, welcomes his mistress—who has just returned from abroad. The moment Diana discovers that he has brought his lover back to their home, something inside her breaks.

dramabox.title: The Second Chance: Her Rules
dramabox.norm_title: the second chance her rules
dramabox.description: Once surrounded by love and hope, Cara Snow drowns in a life of torture the moment she falls in love with Nathan Jaffe. Forced to endure an abortion and stripped of her family, her once-vibrant world is plunged into darkness. In the depths of despair, she makes a bold choice—to fake her death in a fire. However, even when her body turns into ashes, her resolve remains unbroken.

dramabox.title: Vengeance of a Broken Heart
dramabox.norm_title: vengeance of a broken heart
dramabox.description: Zara Linden was the cherished sister of the Linden family. She dated Paul Clark as an ordinary girl. When she was excited to marry Paul, Paul cruelly dumped her. His betrayal, along with his affair with Rainy Linden, who had pretended to be the heiress of the Linden family, broke Zara's heart. Heartbroken, Zara decided to get revenge on Paul and Rainy with the help of her three brothers.

dramabox.title: A Heart Set Free
dramabox.norm_title: a heart set free
dramabox.description: On the day Cora Irwin is set to marry Gavin Royce, her heart shatters when Gavin chooses Leila Black over her. Devastated, Cora ends their relationship and severs all ties with him. By the time Gavin realizes his mistake and regrets his decision, it is already too late.

dramabox.title: Checkmate, My Love
dramabox.norm_title: checkmate my love
dramabox.description: Deceived by Heath Locke's facade of decency, Xena Morse becomes engaged to him, unaware of his true nature—a greedy and licentious man having an affair with her half-sister, Tara Morse. Tara schemes to bring down their family and orchestrates the death of Xena's father. During the wake, Xena catches Tara and Heath in the act. When she learns the truth behind her father's death, Xena rushes to contact the police but is abducted before she can act.

dramabox.title: She Who Stole His Heart
dramabox.norm_title: she who stole his heart
dramabox.description: On the day Scott Ford celebrates the return of his first love, Silvia Lane—the girl he took in as her substitute—receives a devastating cancer diagnosis. Feeling she has lost her worth, Silvia chooses to leave Scott. However, after years spent together, Scott has grown deeply attached to her. It is only when she ends their arrangement that he realizes the depth of his feelings, leaving him heartbroken and shattered upon learning of her illness.

dramabox.title: Crowned in Love: The Mother of Three Big Shots (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: crowned in love the mother of three big shots dubbed
dramabox.description: As a single mother, May Judd raises three exceptional sons on her own, despite the challenges posed by her family. On her father’s seventieth birthday, her mother invites her to return home for a gathering. However, during her visit, May encounters unwarranted hostility from her father and younger sisters. Undaunted, she stands up to their biases and ultimately discovers her own path to happiness.

dramabox.title: Vows, Lies, and Fatal Jealousy
dramabox.norm_title: vows lies and fatal jealousy
dramabox.description: When Brian Gray’s sister, Nancy, returns from abroad for his engagement party, his fiancée, Sharon Lane, mistakes her for Brian’s mistress. In a fit of jealousy, Sharon humiliates and even injures Nancy, revealing her own true colors as well as faking her pregnancy. Later, it is discovered that Sharon and Sam Lange are plotting to kill Brian to seize control of his company. In the end, Sam is imprisoned, while Sharon and her family face a miserable punishment.

dramabox.title: A Reckoning Written in Bloodlines
dramabox.norm_title: a reckoning written in bloodlines
dramabox.description: Zoey Gant is believed to be part of Everich’s wealthiest family, the Gants, until she uncovers her true identity as the long-lost daughter of the Cray family.

dramabox.title: No Haunt, Just Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: no haunt just revenge
dramabox.description: Claire Jordan’s life as a devoted wife turns into a nightmare under the abuse of her husband, Wayne Bond, and his mother, Joanne Lloyd. When they deny life-saving care to her newborn daughter, Lily, leading to her death, they bury Claire alive to hide their crime. But Claire is rescued and learns she is the long-lost heiress of the powerful Jordan family.

dramabox.title: Where Memories Linger, Love Grows
dramabox.norm_title: where memories linger love grows
dramabox.description: Known for her upright and lively nature, Zoe Stone saves Elton Shaw from drowning after he is pushed into a river, leading to a heartfelt five-year promise between them. Years later, Zoe’s world crumbles when her five-year relationship with Ethan Clark ends due to his infidelity with Lydia Gibson. Fate intervenes when Zoe accidentally hits Elton, now a successful CEO, and takes him home—unaware that he is feigning memory loss.

dramabox.title: Defying Age, Defining Herself
dramabox.norm_title: defying age defining herself
dramabox.description: Zoe Ford spent her life in her husband Greg’s shadow, giving up her thriving career in a steel factory to become a housewife. At 60, her world crumbles upon discovering Greg’s decades-long infidelity and financial betrayal. Despite objections from her family and society, who claim it’s too late for her to start over, Zoe defies them all.

dramabox.title: Knock, Knock, Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: knock knock mommy
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Liam Wright was drugged and ended up sleeping with Michelle Taylor, leading to her pregnancy and the birth of a child. However, Michelle's stepmother, Karen Williams, abandoned the child. By chance, the child was adopted by Liam. Michelle had spent five years searching for her child. One day, while passing by a kindergarten, Nina Wright approached Michelle.

dramabox.title: Her Stolen Spotlight
dramabox.norm_title: her stolen spotlight
dramabox.description: When Susan Sloane discovers that her puppy accidentally sent a photo of her sports car to her school’s group chat, she prepares to explain herself. However, her classmate, Lina Zeller, claims the car as her own, saying that Susan used a photo of the car her CEO husband gifted her just to show off. Unbothered by Lina’s accusations, Susan decides not to argue and drives to her villa—only to find Lina already there with a group of friends for a party.

dramabox.title: A Prism of Truths
dramabox.norm_title: a prism of truths
dramabox.description: After eight years of being deceived and hurt by her boyfriend, Ian Bolt, Jane Cole, a jewelry designer, escapes his manipulation and brainwashing with the help of Joe Shaw, the CEO of Shaw Corp. She starts a new life with her newfound confidence and returns to her career of passion, then exposes the person who has been stealing and copying her work, winning the approval of her colleagues and clients while earning herself a place of status in the society.

dramabox.title: Trapped in the Allure
dramabox.norm_title: trapped in the allure
dramabox.description: Tanya Abell sells her virginity at a high price to Taylor Wayne in order to raise money for her sister’s medical treatment. One year later, she bumps into him at a gathering. Taylor recognizes her and traps her against the wall. She escapes and rushes back into the private room, only to be dragged back to Taylor by Jason, who tells her that the only person who has the cure to save her sister is Taylor.

dramabox.title: A Mother's Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: a mother s vengeance
dramabox.description: For the sake of her daughter’s illness, Olivia Walker, a female CEO, worked abroad for five years. Upon returning home, she discovered that her husband, Jaden Walker, his mistress, Julie Adams, and her mother-in-law had been selling her daughter’s life-saving medicine to others. The three of them coerced Olivia into buying them a house by threatening her with her daughter’s medicine and life.

dramabox.title: A Light in the Dark
dramabox.norm_title: a light in the dark
dramabox.description: Willow Stone could not forget about the unresolved death case at Bluestar Corp. related to Sadie Stone, her elder sister. She impersonated Sadie and snuck into that seemingly glamorous corporation full of hidden turmoils. She gained unexpected assistance from Jackson Cohen, the new president. They weaved a complicated net to expose various unfairness and schemes. They grew to love each other as they worked together to plan for countermeasures.

dramabox.title: Blood Doesn't Always Bind
dramabox.norm_title: blood doesn t always bind
dramabox.description: Zara Klein, a village woman, makes a living by selling handmade pastries while raising her biological son, Nate Olson, and searching for her missing adopted son, Kyle Olson. Twenty years later, Nate brings Zara home after achieving success. On the surface, he acts like a good son, but in reality, he uses Zara to further his wealth and reputation. Fortunately, Nate’s plan is thwarted by Kyle, who was adopted by another family and is now known as Jared Locke.

dramabox.title: The Healing Touch of Love
dramabox.norm_title: the healing touch of love
dramabox.description: Despite her reluctance, Selene Dell marries Wayne Locke, who suffers from a leg impairment, in place of her sister and ends up being mistaken as a gold-digger. However, as they spend more time together, they gradually begin to see the good in each other. After navigating misunderstandings, a kidnapping, and memory loss, Wayne ultimately decides to help Selene and support her family’s costly medical bills instead of forcing her into anything she dislikes.

dramabox.title: Reset for Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: reset for revenge
dramabox.description: Due to poor management, Dylan Reed’s company is on the brink of collapse, accumulating a debt of twenty million dollars. However, luck is on Dylan’s side when he wins the lottery, earning one hundred million dollars. To avoid splitting the fortune with his wife and paying off his debts, he fakes his death and goes into hiding. Meanwhile, his wife, Claire Foster, is determined to reclaim everything she unknowingly lost in her past life.

dramabox.title: Crowned by Love: The Heiress' Return
dramabox.norm_title: crowned by love the heiress return
dramabox.description: Yvonne Song was in a car accident and got saved by Nicholas Gale. After discovering that Nicholas was struggling and down on his luck, Yvonne helped him rebuild his dreams from the ground up. She hid her true identity as a rich heiress from him. Once Nicholas got successful, he ruthlessly pushed her away, and his new calculating wife Quinn stole Yvonne's identity as the lady of the distinguished Song family.

dramabox.title: Lottery of Vengeance
dramabox.norm_title: lottery of vengeance
dramabox.description: Nina Shaw wins 300 million dollars in the lottery and shares the news with her best friend, Sue Leed, even giving her two million. However, Sue betrays Nina, conspiring with Nina’s stepbrother, John Shaw, to murder her for the entire fortune. After being reborn, Nina is determined to keep her lottery win a secret, but Sue finds out again. Nina lies, claiming that John took all the money. She then cleverly manipulates John into getting involved with Sue.

dramabox.title: Until We Meet Again
dramabox.norm_title: until we meet again
dramabox.description: Nina Clark grew up abandoned in an orphanage, clinging to a promise made with Tyler Winston, a boy who cared for her like a brother. They vowed to meet again in 15 years, marked by a jade necklace. Now, Tyler is the CEO of Winston Group, but when Nina finally finds him, an accident causes a twist of fate, and she finds her identity stolen by someone she thought was a friend.

dramabox.title: The Long Road Home
dramabox.norm_title: the long road home
dramabox.description: Marlon Ortega's biological daughter kneeled outside his house, but his adopted daughter refused to let her enter. Years ago, his real daughter had run off with a man, and together they had a child. Now, the man had passed away, and her young daughter was left with a brain tumor. Desperate and with nowhere else to turn, she had come back to ask her father for help.

dramabox.title: Love at First Lie
dramabox.norm_title: love at first lie
dramabox.description: Andrea Griffin accidentally ran into Zach Andrews's hotel room while escaping from danger. The two spent a night blinded by passion together, waking up the next morning with mixed emotions. Andrea fled the hotel the next morning after leaving half of the room's fees on the nightstand to attend a speed dating event. Motivated by his mother's nagging for him to find a wife, Zach attended the event himself.

dramabox.title: Behind the Lies
dramabox.norm_title: behind the lies
dramabox.description: Cassandra's world shatters when she discovers that her devoted husband, Wallace, may be involved in a plot to harm their daughter. Even more shocking, their live-in nanny is actually his secret lover. Cassandra witnesses her husband's betrayal and overhears his sinister plans. Surrounded by a web of lies, this grieving mother is determined to expose the truth and strike back.

dramabox.title: In the Snare of Love
dramabox.norm_title: in the snare of love
dramabox.description: To save her sister Nina from heart disease, Cheryl Snow asks Sean Hall for a cure and becomes his lover in the process. Worried that Cheryl will eventually win Sean’s heart, Sienna Zane conspires with Heath Clark to frame Cheryl, resulting in Nina’s death in the operating room. Devastated, Cheryl demands a breakup. It is then that Sean realizes he is already in love with her. Sean later investigates the circumstances surrounding Nina’s death.

dramabox.title: The Forgotten Father
dramabox.norm_title: the forgotten father
dramabox.description: Liam, a widower, raised his daughter, Narla, by selling buns. Fortunately, Narla’s hard work paid off. She was accepted into a prestigious university and soon married a local wealthy man. Many years later, Liam, eager to see his daughter, walked into the big city where Narla had started a family. Alas, Narla denied him, calling Liam a beggar in front of her in-laws.

dramabox.title: She Conquers: Defying the Norm
dramabox.norm_title: she conquers defying the norm
dramabox.description: In Lott Village, where women's rights are neglected and oppressed, Delia Lott is forbidden by her father from continuing her education. However, with the financial support raised by her mother and other elders, she overcomes these barriers and studies abroad. Upon her return, Delia establishes Lott Group and hires Will Jones as her capable assistant.

dramabox.title: Kiss Me Through the Storm
dramabox.norm_title: kiss me through the storm
dramabox.description: Wendy Clark's life changed forever after a night with Julian York, CEO of York Group, leaving her pregnant and cast out by her family. Years later, a twist of fate brings her to cross paths with a little girl, Susie—and into Julian’s life once more. But as secrets of the past and present unravel, and enemies in sheep’s clothing close in, Wendy and Julian’s fragile connection is tested by betrayal and danger. Can love survive the storm?

dramabox.title: The Lost Path Home
dramabox.norm_title: the lost path home
dramabox.description: After surviving a deadly assassination, Nigel Payne, the CEO of Payne Corp, is left with no memory and a disfigured face. His path crosses with Elle Devin—a street-smart homeless girl who becomes his unlikely protector. With Elle's help, he returns home fifteen years later, only to face disbelief and scorn.

dramabox.title: Love Recharged: The Cupid Crew
dramabox.norm_title: love recharged the cupid crew
dramabox.description: Before his death, Jill Allen's father leaves a wish for her to take over the family company—but only after she has grown up and has children. Under the influence of her best friend, Lia Judd, Jill sleeps with Sam Lowe, mistakenly believing him to be a gigolo, and ends up pregnant. After raising her five children in a foreign country for five years, Jill returns to take control of the company. It is then that she reunites with Sam.

dramabox.title: Undercover Temptation: Desire and Deceit
dramabox.norm_title: undercover temptation desire and deceit
dramabox.description: During a mission, special agent Lila accidentally saves Seth Gray, the wealthiest man on earth. The two quickly find themselves drawn to each other and pledge to spend the rest of their lives together. However, Seth is suffering from an eye disease that causes him to mistake Chloe Kurt for Lila after they escape from danger. Later, when Lila approaches Seth as his fiancée, she’s shocked by his cold demeanor.

dramabox.title: All My Love, All for You
dramabox.norm_title: all my love all for you
dramabox.description: To raise money for her tuition, Mona Leed works as a courier, where she meets Jim Judd and unexpectedly becomes pregnant. Her family, however, plans to marry her off to an older man in exchange for 500 thousand dollars. Determined to escape her family’s control, Mona decides to keep the baby and refuses the arranged marriage. Learning of her situation and recognizing Mona’s innocence, Jim steps in, bringing her home and caring for her.

dramabox.title: Veil of Fortune
dramabox.norm_title: veil of fortune
dramabox.description: In a desperate attempt to escape a suffocating arranged marriage, Cecilia Hicks impulsively decided to wed a construction worker. Little did she know that this seemingly ordinary laborer was actually Justin Griffith, a billionaire living in disguise. Their sudden marriage, sparked by her impulsive choice, gradually blossomed into a profound and genuine love as they uncovered each other's true selves, crafting a heartwarming tale of romance.

dramabox.title: My Wife, The Miracle Healer
dramabox.norm_title: my wife the miracle healer
dramabox.description: After being sent to live in the countryside following her mother’s death, Cheryl was taken under the wing of a man who later became her mentor. His guidance enabled her to become an anonymous medical genius known only as "Madame C" to the public. She was soon sent to Southville on a mission to infiltrate the Holberts, and—as fate would have it—she returned home to find that she had been arranged to marry Norman, the Holbert’s scion, when she was still young.

dramabox.title: Meeting My Mother-in-Law
dramabox.norm_title: meeting my mother in law
dramabox.description: Sexy and rich Maggie Spears singlehandedly raised her son Daniel Spears. When Daniel brings Claire Brennan, his first girlfriend, to his home to meet Maggie, they caught her in the middle of an affair with her boytoy. This left a bad impression on Daniel's girlfriend.
