Daniel worked hard to mediate their interactions, but when Maggie realizes Katherine Chase, Claire's best friend, had ulterior motives, she hatches a plan to teach her a lesson.

dramabox.title: Love Beyond Memory
dramabox.norm_title: love beyond memory
dramabox.description: To escape her stepfather’s clutches, Iris Moon returned to the city where she grew up after graduating college. There, she founded a housekeeping firm, but because of poor management, she could not afford rent.One day, a man came to her, offering her a fortune to work as a live-in nanny for him. It was only upon getting into the car that she realized her future boss was none other than Cedric Klein, the man known all over the city for being abusive.

dramabox.title: Time-Skip Love: Married to My Nemesis
dramabox.norm_title: time skip love married to my nemesis
dramabox.description: Emilia and Zane were childhood friends who unfortunately became bitter rivals who could not stand each other. Throughout school, Emilia secretly harbored a crush on Jonathan James, a popular senior. On the day of their university graduation, she mustered the courage to finally confess her feelings, only to have the moment ruined by Zane.

dramabox.title: When Love Comes Knocking
dramabox.norm_title: when love comes knocking
dramabox.description: The night Susan Jenkins was pursued by Bertram Lewis and had all her family assets seized, an adorable girl fell from the heavens and called for the most fearsome man in Chesterville, Elias Stewart, to save Susan. The adorable girl called Susan and Elias her parents, utterly confusing Susan as she stared at the strange man before her. Urged by the adorable girl, Susan moved into the Stewarts’ mansion, unaware that a plot was looming.

dramabox.title: Love on a Whim
dramabox.norm_title: love on a whim
dramabox.description:
Riley Walker was child-trafficked into the notorious Red Blade organization. The organization's leader passed away and her junior, Bryce Gibson, succeeded as the new leader. 

However, Bryce was a sick and paranoid man. He desired Riley and plotted against her without hesitation. As Riley tried to escape during one of his schemes, she bumped into the drunken Tristan Morin. 

Riley mistook Tristan for a gigolo and grabbed him to serve as her antidote.

dramabox.title: Fates Rewritten: Love's New Beginning
dramabox.norm_title: fates rewritten love s new beginning
dramabox.description: Madison Ashfield finds herself suddenly transported into the world of her favorite novel, now living as the main character. Determined not to play the doormat, she stands up to the abusive man who mistreats her and takes down the scheming woman plotting against her. Setting her sights on the cold, handsome CEO, Madison skillfully transforms him into a lovestruck admirer.

dramabox.title: Back With a Bang: The Troublemaker Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: back with a bang the troublemaker heiress
dramabox.description: Stella Swan, once the privileged heiress to Swan Corporation, saw her life take a dramatic turn after her mother’s death years ago. Feeling neglected by her father, Robert Swan, she grew resentful and became a rebellious young woman who spent her waking hours at bars and racing on the streets. One night, she met Jacob Miller, a man who grew up in an orphanage, over a drink at the bar. While chatting, Stella was harassed by a man named Scorpion.

dramabox.title: Caught in the Love Tangle
dramabox.norm_title: caught in the love tangle
dramabox.description: After a medical accident, Ann Judd becomes pregnant with Rowe Corp CEO Joe Rowe’s child through artificial insemination. Joe, unaware at first, later demands she fake a miscarriage and keep the pregnancy secret. However, at a press conference, she encounters her former crush, Sean Rowe, who begins pursuing her, unaware that she is carrying his brother’s child.

dramabox.title: Crown of the Reborn: Vengeance Awaits
dramabox.norm_title: crown of the reborn vengeance awaits
dramabox.description: On the day of Cade Bale’s wedding, Sue Shaw takes her last breath. Her downfall started when she invited him to go to school in the same Maybach as her out of kindness. Despite Cade being the son of the Shaws’ driver, Sue lent him her card, gifted him luxuries, and even handed over the company her father had left for her. Enjoying everything given by her, Cade got in a relationship, doting on his girlfriend while treating Sue as his maid.

dramabox.title: Fate Reversed: The Payback Begins
dramabox.norm_title: fate reversed the payback begins
dramabox.description: Xenia Young wakes up in the school infirmary, realizing she has been reborn and transported back to the past, before all the tragedies had unfolded. At this point in time, she has not yet been betrayed by her boyfriend—the pivotal moment that triggered a series of unfortunate events leading to her death. Then, all of a sudden, she recalls that this is also the day her father took his own life by jumping off a building.

dramabox.title: Bite Me If You Dare
dramabox.norm_title: bite me if you dare
dramabox.description: Evelyn, the Howard family's disposable pawn, is chosen as a blood bride—until she awakens Vincent, a pure-blood vampire dormant for centuries. He's drawn to the secret in her bloodline; she needs his power to escape her cage. As she strikes back at her enemies, a hidden war between vampires, werewolves, and ancient bloodlines surfaces. Bound by fate, their forbidden love will change their world forever.

dramabox.title: Human Luna, Golden Heir
dramabox.norm_title: human luna golden heir
dramabox.description: Ivy wakes from a wild night, pregnant with a wolf pup—impossible. She doesn't remember the father is Asher Kane, the Alpha King hunting for his vanished mate. When they cross paths again, an old mark awakens. Her secret shows its power. This is no ordinary pregnancy—and no ordinary pup.

dramabox.title: Bound to the Cursed Billionaire
dramabox.norm_title: bound to the cursed billionaire
dramabox.description: Witch Evelyn, bound by an ancient seal, must find her twin flame by twenty or die. She saves billionaire Alexander from a cursed crash—he is her twin flame. His life force sustains her seal; his legs are bound by dark magic. From using to loving, they break curses and expose family plots. Evelyn chooses love as her weapon, redeeming destiny.

dramabox.title: S-Rank Throne: Princess Ascends
dramabox.norm_title: s rank throne princess ascends
dramabox.description: The original book, she is cannon fodder who dies in the first episode after being sacrificed in blood to a vampire. When she arrives, she accidentally awakens a sleeping S-rank vampire sealed away for a thousand years. He grants her one wish.Lillian's only wish is to change her cannon-fodder fate and survive.So she wishes for the vampire to follow her until the end of her life. That gives her her first follower.But she knows it is far from enough.

dramabox.title: The Godfather's Guardian Angel
dramabox.norm_title: the godfather s guardian angel
dramabox.description: On a snowy Thanksgiving night, Rita, a young girl with healing powers and supernatural abilities, lives in her uncle William's home. Using her powers, she restores spoiled ingredients and prepares a lavish dinner, but her mischievous cousin Jimmy creates chaos and tears the precious scarf left to Rita by her parents. William's family is ungrateful and cruel. They mistreat Rita, then secretly hire a homeless man to drive her away and sell her.

dramabox.title: Drought Angel
dramabox.norm_title: drought angel
dramabox.description: In 1930s Texas, orphan Flora can talk to animals. Abused by her aunt, she is saved by kind Clara. Her gift brings fortune but also traps her in schemes. With help from her foster brother Daniel, Dr. Lucas, and noble Renard, she clears her name, studies medicine, and becomes a light of hope in the drought.

dramabox.title: His Midnight Prey
dramabox.norm_title: his midnight prey
dramabox.description: Maeve, the police department’s brilliant profiler, is haunted by recurring nightmares. In them, a mysterious man hunts her, torments her, and drinks her blood—yet every time she wakes, real bite marks remain on her skin. As a series of bizarre mummified corpses shocks the city, elite doctor Darius becomes her investigation partner.

dramabox.title: My Assistant is a Hot Super Cat
dramabox.norm_title: my assistant is a hot super cat
dramabox.description: At midnight, exhausted assistant Andria becomes a cat—with superpowers, a CEO’s soft spot, and a dangerous secret serum in her blood. To stay human, she may need her icy boss’s kisses. But when the secret mutant drug spreads, romance turns into rescue, and “super cat” must save everyone before nine lives run out.

dramabox.title: Dr.K
dramabox.norm_title: dr k
dramabox.description: As Planet Origin faces collapse from a deadly energy shortage, elite agent Doctor K is dispatched to Earth to retrieve the mysterious Energy X. But when a chaotic young woman named Na Han-byeol discovers his secret and forces him into an unexpected cohabitation, his mission takes a sharp turn. The closer he gets to finding Energy X, the more he realizes his heart may already have found something far more dangerous.

dramabox.title: Am I the Villain?!
dramabox.norm_title: am i the villain
dramabox.description: Jung Mina is a novelist with a terrible reputation for leaving works unfinished. One day, she wakes up as a character in one of her stories, an irredeemable villain whom she named after herself. Not only is she stuck as such a terrible character, but she's also destined to meet a tragic fate! Can Mina escape her tragic fantasy life while also coming to terms with the struggles she has in her real life?

dramabox.title: Back in Time: The World Bends to My Will
dramabox.norm_title: back in time the world bends to my will
dramabox.description: Muse Wilde, an S-rank assassin renowned for her top-tier medical skills and mastery of poisons, finds herself betrayed during a critical mission. But for Muse, death is not the final chapter. Instead, she awakens to a startling reality: transported to a bygone era in Aurelia of Thronos, where her impending marriage has been abruptly called off by her fiancé, and where she contends with a pair of conniving stepmother and sister.

dramabox.title: After the Abortion, I Married My Ex's Grandpa
dramabox.norm_title: after the abortion i married my ex s grandpa
dramabox.description: When Ivy wakes from an abortion to find her secret boyfriend Julian has publicly claimed another woman as his Luna, she walks into an arranged marriage with a mysterious silver-haired stranger. She thinks she's marrying a minor Harrison heir. She doesn't realize he's the 116-year-old Alpha of the Wolfe family—and Julian's grandfather.

dramabox.title: Falling for My Sugar Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: falling for my sugar daddy
dramabox.description: Heather Kirk, a bullied designer, works nights as a bunny waitress to pay debts. A one-night stand ties her to cold boss Declan Reed. He offers a deal: be his contract lover, and he'll fix everything. She moves in, but feels like just his toy, overshadowed by his ex, Maeve. When her brother betrays her with Maeve in a deadly trap, they realize their bond has become true love.

dramabox.title: Billionaire's Contract Lover
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire s contract lover
dramabox.description: "Charlotte, the adopted daughter of the Harrington family, is maliciously drugged and framed by her stepsister Isabella at her engagement banquet. Locked in a tower, she unexpectedly becomes entangled with William, the heir of the Ashford family. Afterwards, Charlotte becomes pregnant out of wedlock and is cast out of the house by Isabella. For eight years, Charlotte raises her son Leo alone, living in hardship.An alumni dance reunites the three.

dramabox.title: Rent A Billionaire Boyfriend For Christmas
dramabox.norm_title: rent a billionaire boyfriend for christmas
dramabox.description: After catching her boyfriend cheating on Christmas Eve, farm girl Emma impulsively teams up with Alex, a wealthy heir, to fake a relationship and save face. What begins as a deal spirals into escalating lies—fake engagements, a pregnancy bluff, humiliations by elite families, and shocking revelations involving priceless heirlooms.

dramabox.title: Flash Marriage: Sleeping With the President
dramabox.norm_title: flash marriage sleeping with the president
dramabox.description: Poor girl Scarlett is framed by her ex and has an one-night stand with President Elias, falling pregnant afterward. They are forced into a contract marriage. Amid various twists and conflicts, Elias gradually falls in love with her. Later, Scarlett uncovers the complicated truth behind their marriage and learns she is born into aristocracy. Devastated by the deceptive arrangement, she plans to return to her homeland.

dramabox.title: Tutor for the Quarterback
dramabox.norm_title: tutor for the quarterback
dramabox.description: Mia, a money-driven straight-A student, strikes a deal with Chase—the star quarterback of the school team who’s failing calculus and facing a competition ban—to get revenge on her cheating ex-boyfriend. She will tutor him to pull up his grades, while he pretends to be her boyfriend. Mia lays down strict ground rules: every physical touch comes with an extra charge.

dramabox.title: Falling for the Wrong Me
dramabox.norm_title: falling for the wrong me
dramabox.description: To help her best friend run a blind date event, Nora is forced to cross-dress and pose as a guest—only to get unexpectedly entangled with Charles, the new CEO. To dodge an arranged marriage, Charles hires her to be his fake girlfriend. But as double identities and simmering chemistry collide, their pretend romance soon spins out of control.

dramabox.title: Fake It Till You Date It
dramabox.norm_title: fake it till you date it
dramabox.description: Xavier, a brilliant yet solitary scholarship student. Alex, the privileged and reckless captain of the football team. Their accidental “kiss” during a student council debate goes viral overnight. To save Alex’s campaign, he proposes a fake relationship.What begins as a lie soon spirals into something dangerously real. Between the sparks of rivalry and stolen moments of tenderness, love becomes the most forbidden secret on campus.

dramabox.title: Stop heartbreak: She's the one
dramabox.norm_title: stop heartbreak she s the one
dramabox.description: Richie and Lila were childhood sweethearts, but when they were kids, Lila was injured in a kidnapping case and lost in order to save Richie. When Richie grows up, he is forced to marry Sophia in order to find the missing Lila, but due to various misunderstandings, he fails to recognize Sophia as his childhood friend Lila. Sophia is bullied in Alex's home, including being set up by Daphne and misunderstood by Alex.

dramabox.title: Married for Money, Swayed by Love
dramabox.norm_title: married for money swayed by love
dramabox.description: News of the infamous Hugh Xavier entering a whirlwind marriage shakes all of Juset. Everyone assumes he's smitten by the sweet and charming Linnie Trent—but what no one knows is that Linnie only agreed to the marriage as a high-paying part-time job. Little does she realize, what starts as a carefully crafted façade will gradually turn real... and their relationship will never be the same again.

dramabox.title: One Night, One Baby, One Forever
dramabox.norm_title: one night one baby one forever
dramabox.description: After a misunderstanding sparks a special night between ordinary girl Xenia Gregg and CEO Carson Penn, they are forced into a contract marriage when she discovers she's pregnant. Amid business battles, betrayal from her ex-boyfriend, and hidden truths about her past, love quietly blossoms between them. In the end, Carson's heartfelt confession seals their promise, and they build a happy family of three.

dramabox.title: Chained by Affection
dramabox.norm_title: chained by affection
dramabox.description: After three years in a loveless marriage, Skylar Litt finally decides to break free from Julius Vance's indifference—and from the pain of watching him love someone else. Once, she believed his affection was real, but that illusion shattered when he left for two years without a word. Now that he's back, Skylar leaves her ring behind, but Julius refuses to let her go.

dramabox.title: Kisses Laced with Lies
dramabox.norm_title: kisses laced with lies
dramabox.description: A leaked video shatters Stella Quinn's reputation and ends her relationship with her boyfriend—who had been playing her for her sister, Willow Quinn. In despair, Stella takes Willow's place in an arranged marriage and exposes what she did. With her new partner, Stella steps into a new life—but her ex isn't ready to let her go just yet.

dramabox.title: Boxer Boss Can't Get Enough
dramabox.norm_title: boxer boss can t get enough
dramabox.description: UFC champ Leo saves a shy florist from danger—and ends up spending one unforgettable night with her. She vanishes, only to return as his maid… and his contract lover. Cold, rich, and used to control, Leo never expected to fall. But as jealousy flares and a rival socialite schemes, Sela walks away—pregnant and heartbroken. Now Leo must chase the woman who changed everything.

dramabox.title: Married a Lizard，He Ruled the Beasts！
dramabox.norm_title: married a lizard he ruled the beasts
dramabox.description: After ten years of betrayal, rabbit shifter Evelyn bonds with Draven, a penniless “lizard.” But her new mate is secretly the Black Dragon King, ruler of all beasts. As enemies close in, he protects her, helps her fight back, and crowns the once-scorned bunny as his queen.

dramabox.title: She Moved On, He Fell Apart
dramabox.norm_title: she moved on he fell apart
dramabox.description: Vivian Cross discovered her devoted husband Victor Stone was cheating. Without confrontation, she secretly changed her name, melted their wedding ring, and had a lawyer draw up divorce papers. When his assistant sent a pregnancy taunt, Vivian left without looking back. Victor tried everything but never won her back. Years later, Vivian had a happy new family while Victor ended up broke, insane, and lost forever without her.

dramabox.title: After Leaving My Ex, I Became the Duke's Wife
dramabox.norm_title: after leaving my ex i became the duke s wife
dramabox.description: Abandoned at the altar, Eleanor marries Julian, the powerful Duke of Ravenwood. When her obsessive ex returns and destroys their trust with vicious lies, love becomes a gilded cage. After betrayal and separation, Julian must learn to respect her freedom—and earn her heart again as an equal.

dramabox.title: The Demon King's Son Calls Me Mom
dramabox.norm_title: the demon king s son calls me mom
dramabox.description: Cast out of Heaven by her cruel ex-husband, Nora becomes the contract mother of Lucifer's wounded son, Leo. Her kindness heals the little demon and earns Lucifer's trust. When her past returns to humiliate her, Lucifer proudly claims her as his queen. Nora finally finds love, family, and a life of her own.

dramabox.title: The Wolves'Regret for Their Rabbit
dramabox.norm_title: the wolves regret for their rabbit
dramabox.description: Freya, a rabbit beastkin, is adopted by the Hughes family. She helps twin wolf brothers with her healing powers, believing she'll marry one. Fox beastkin Charlotte schemes to frame her, turning the brothers against her. Freya leaves and marries lion heir Grayson. The brothers regret too late.

dramabox.title: Second Chance: The Tech Billionaire’s Secret Family
dramabox.norm_title: second chance the tech billionaire s secret family
dramabox.description: Heiress Milo left penniless Asher to save her family, hiding her pregnancy. Six years later, he's a tech billionaire; she's a desperate mom needing surgery for their son. As the truth unfolds, he wins her back, saves their son, and gets his second chance.

dramabox.title: The Shadow Elf King's Runaway Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the shadow elf king s runaway bride
dramabox.description: Seven years ago, Aurora was taken by Shadow Elf King Kaelen and had his son Leo. Seven years later, Leo's magic is tearing him apart; only the Shadow Core can save him. Aurora infiltrates the court, facing priestess Serafina's torment. Kaelen learns of Leo and searches for him. They reunite and marry after trials.

dramabox.title: The King's Bride Is a Doom Elf
dramabox.norm_title: the king s bride is a doom elf
dramabox.description: Vespera, branded a Doom Elf after her twin brother's stillbirth, was exiled. Years later, she and her daughter Mia return to fulfill a marriage contract to Prince Arvis, but she calls it off and declares she will marry King Lucian instead. She discovers Lucian is the stranger she spent a night with five years ago.

dramabox.title: Three Alphas Abandoned Me for that Omega, Then Regretted It
dramabox.norm_title: three alphas abandoned me for that omega then regretted it
dramabox.description: Lena, secretly married to Isaac, is used as a pawn for inheritance. After a kidnapping, she is saved by Jack Kane—her father-in-law and a ruthless mafia godfather. He rescues her and claims her with obsessive passion.

dramabox.title: Love Beyond Redemption
dramabox.norm_title: love beyond redemption
dramabox.description: Delivery girl Chloe eases CEO Alexander's fatal heartache through intimate touch. He marries her to fund her mother's leukemia cure, hiding the deadly cost to her life. Framed and presumed dead, she gets plastic surgery, loses memory, and meets him again. Pregnant and ill, she is saved by his heart's blood. They reconcile in snow.

dramabox.title: The Ruthless Heir And His Runaway Maid
dramabox.norm_title: the ruthless heir and his runaway maid
dramabox.description: Bullied by her stepmother and stepsister, Sara Fair is forced to marry Kane Aster, the feared heir of the powerful Aster family, to save her sickly brother. After a fateful night at the pool, Kane discovers that the maid sent to marry him is the woman he can't forget. He takes Sara back to Aster Manor, only for misunderstandings, family schemes, and pure-blood politics to tear them apart.

dramabox.title: Moonlit Wilds, A Secret Yearning
dramabox.norm_title: moonlit wilds a secret yearning
dramabox.description: To pay off her father's debts, Diana shares an intimate night with billionaire Ethan Vance and marries him out of guilt. She dreams of being a designer but ends up with a clingy, jealous husband. An ex-boyfriend, a rival, and an imposter stir trouble. Ethan fakes illness to keep her close and fiercely protects her in a heart-fluttering love-hate tug-of-war.

dramabox.title: Rags to Riches: My Baby is a MoneyMagnet
dramabox.norm_title: rags to riches my baby is a moneymagnet
dramabox.description: A wealth spirit reincarnates to help a noble mother in distress. The spirit brings immense fortune, turning the mother from a scorned woman into a business legend. They defeat the ex-husband and his mistress, and the powerful Regent falls for the mother. The spirit gives up its divine status to stay with them forever. A heartwarming story of rise from rags.

dramabox.title: Mommy's Little Savior
dramabox.norm_title: mommy s little savior
dramabox.description: Five years ago, Elena broke up with Killian to protect him, and was imprisoned after giving birth to Luna. Brave Luna tracks down Killian at his company, calling him Daddy. DNA confirms truth, and Killian learns of Elena's sacrifice. He frees her, protects Luna, and wins back the woman he never stopped loving.

dramabox.title: The Barren Alpha Knocked Me Up with Twins
dramabox.norm_title: the barren alpha knocked me up with twins
dramabox.description: Kaelen, the strongest Alpha, struggles with fertility. His grandfather arranges a marriage. Chris, mistreated at home, flees and works at a bar where she is drugged and has a one-night stand with Kaelen, resulting in pregnancy. Kaelen rescues her, insists she keep the babies, protects her, and they live happily ever after.

dramabox.title: Waking Up to My Billionaire Husband
dramabox.norm_title: waking up to my billionaire husband
dramabox.description: Amanda, a foster daughter of the Lucas family, discovers her fiancé Chris faked death and cheated with his sister-in-law. Desperate, she marries Evan, the rumored comatose head of the Reynolds family, to replace her friend. But Evan had awakened a year ago and is the one who saved her in a car accident five years ago. At the wedding banquet, he reveals his identity, supports Amanda, and destroys the Lucas family.

dramabox.title: The Mercenary Wife of a Dissolute Aristocrat
dramabox.norm_title: the mercenary wife of a dissolute aristocrat
dramabox.description: Retired mercenary Louise accepts a high-paying contract from wealthy lady Carter to fake-marry the dissolute heir Felix. She tames him with force, reforms the family, and they go from mutual dislike to true love. They join forces for revenge, turning fake marriage into real love.

dramabox.title: Blood moon lover
dramabox.norm_title: blood moon lover
dramabox.description: Werewolf hybrid Karl takes his human wife Eve to a castle, reunites with his vampire brother Miles, and they swap souls. Their mother schemes claiming Eve must bear a child of all three bloodlines to switch back. After protection, Eve conceives, but a harsh condition still awaits.

dramabox.title: Fake marriage,True love
dramabox.norm_title: fake marriage true love
dramabox.description: Ye Xiang, a wealthy heiress, runs away from her arranged marriage and becomes a nanny for Su Yan, unaware he is her runaway fiancé. He proposes a one-year contract marriage to avoid his mother. They fall in love amidst schemes from rivals, and her hidden talents emerge. Eventually, their fake marriage becomes real.

dramabox.title: Who's Her Father
dramabox.norm_title: who s her father
dramabox.description: Six years ago, Iris spent a night with a masked man to escape her family's sale. She raised her daughter Ella alone. Ella accidentally enters the Blackwood family, and three brothers—Zane, Ethan, and Xavier—all appear to be the father due to identical DNA. Iris becomes a nanny, faces schemes from her stepsister, and falls for Zane. Genetic testing reveals Zane is Ella's real father. The stepsister's fraud is exposed, and Zane marries Iris.

dramabox.title: The Dying Witch King’s Unexpected Heir Grandson
dramabox.norm_title: the dying witch king s unexpected heir grandson
dramabox.description: The Dark Moon Witch King is dying, and a five-year-old boy Caspian arrives seeking his father. His father Silvan and mother Elowen were separated by the king. Caspian, with a blood defect, is framed by priest Olivia but saved by a moon charm. Family elders clear the past, punish the true villains, and the family reunites.

dramabox.title: Love at First Vow
dramabox.norm_title: love at first vow
dramabox.description: Olivia and Ethan are both powerful CEOs who impulsively marry after a drunken night overseas. They try to make each other miserable to get a divorce, but their grandmothers discover the marriage and force them to live together. What starts as a battle of fake identities turns into a sweet romance.

dramabox.title: I Married My Ex’s Uncle at His Wedding
dramabox.norm_title: i married my ex s uncle at his wedding
dramabox.description: Alison was betrayed by her fiancé and stepsister. She agreed to a contract marriage with Alexander, a powerful tycoon. They teamed up to regain equity and took down enemies. He had loved her all along.

dramabox.title: Baby, Daddy Never Gave Up on Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: baby daddy never gave up on mommy
dramabox.description: Pregnant Evelyn was poisoned, and her fiancé Atlas donated half his liver to save her. The stepsister forged her death. Five years later, he saw his daughter and Evelyn alive, realizing they had been alive all along.

dramabox.title: Blind Eye
dramabox.norm_title: blind eye
dramabox.description: Framed for her billionaire father's murder, Emily is thrust into a lethal succession war against her family. To secure his will, she shocks everyone by marrying her estranged childhood protector, who hides a secret identity that could upend the game. Surrounded by assassins and corporate traps, can Emily expose the real killer before the final checkmate?

dramabox.title: The Mechanic I Married Owns Manhattan
dramabox.norm_title: the mechanic i married owns manhattan
dramabox.description: Single mother Clara fled her ex-husband with her daughter. She met mechanic Mason and married him temporarily for custody. At the hearing, his legal team revealed he owned the largest debt claim against her ex's company. He was actually the hidden heir of a Manhattan real estate group.

dramabox.title: 99 Forgiveness,One Goodbye
dramabox.norm_title: 99 forgiveness one goodbye
dramabox.description: Brianna, secretly married to boxer Mark for three years, endures 99 heartbreaks, each marked by a pearl. On his victory night, Mark publicly honors Melin—the 99th and final blow. Brianna leaves divorce papers and walks away. Returning to her wealthy family, she reconnects with Savien; a contract marriage turns into true love. Mark uncovers Melin’s lies and fights underground for a diamond to win Brianna back. She chooses Savien and marries him.

dramabox.title: My Secret Alpha is My Lucky Puppy
dramabox.norm_title: my secret alpha is my lucky puppy
dramabox.description: A talented painter is forced to be a ghostwriter and sold at auction. She is taken by a mysterious billionaire in a contract marriage. He is the Alpha werewolf, the stray dog she saved, and her biggest fan.

dramabox.title: My Bestie’s Father Became My Sanctuary
dramabox.norm_title: my bestie s father became my sanctuary
dramabox.description: Clara is the secret wife of World Cup star Ethan. On her way to visit him, she is harassed by his teammate Victor, who doesn't know who she is. Victor tries to humiliate her but will face consequences.Clara is the secret wife of World Cup star Ethan. On her way to visit him, she is harassed by his teammate Victor, who doesn't know who she is. Victor tries to humiliate her but will face consequences.

dramabox.title: Secret Marriage Swap, The War God’s Late Remorse
dramabox.norm_title: secret marriage swap the war god s late remorse
dramabox.description: Cassandra discovers her fiancé Perseus loves her stepsister, so she swaps marriages and marries Abel. Perseus realizes he actually loved Cassandra all along, but he confused gratitude with love. By the time he knows, she is already married to another.

dramabox.title: Where the Stars Went
dramabox.norm_title: where the stars went
dramabox.description: Stella Hart was tormented by her husband Ashton for three years over a fire he blamed her for. After he publicly humiliated her and broke her hearing aid, she finally signed the divorce and left with Ethan Morrow. Ashton realized his mistake too late, but she had already moved on.

dramabox.title: The Perfect Play
dramabox.norm_title: the perfect play
dramabox.description: When Chloe, a vulnerable cheerleader facing deportation, is publicly betrayed by her fiancé Dylan at a professional football stadium and fired due to her immigration status, superstar quarterback Maxwell impulsively marries her to protect her.

dramabox.title: My Dear 19th Century Husband
dramabox.norm_title: my dear 19th century husband
dramabox.description: In 19th-century Ohio, Georgiana—brutalized by her stepmother and her downtrodden sister Bertha—flees her domestic hell by assuming Bertha's name and marrying Thomas, a wealthy and handsome trapper. After the wedding, Georgiana confesses the truth to Thomas and is forgiven;

dramabox.title: Oops, I Flash Married My Football Star
dramabox.norm_title: oops i flash married my football star
dramabox.description: The team doctor, Iris, unexpectedly ends up in a one-night stand with World Cup star Arthur, and then they get married and obtain a marriage certificate. However, the team does not allow office romances. What she doesn't know is that Arthur has had a crush on her all along. After she breaks up with her cheating boyfriend, he immediately pursues Iris.

dramabox.title: Unexpected Marriage with My Boss
dramabox.norm_title: unexpected marriage with my boss
dramabox.description: After getting drunk, Ace unexpectedly spent a night with the male lead, Christopher. To escape her family’s pressure to marry, she hastily obtained a marriage certificate with him, but after the wedding, the two lost contact and lived apart for an entire year.A year later,her exceptional alcohol tolerance, Ace joined the Olga Group—only to discover that the president was none other than her registered husband.

dramabox.title: Love in a Flash
dramabox.norm_title: love in a flash
dramabox.description: Forced into marriage, Noelle reluctantly endures a series of blind dates until she meets Sebastian, a charming yet seemingly ordinary man. Enchanted by his allure, she marries him, anticipating a simple life. However, she soon discovers that Sebastian is not as he seems. Unveiling Sebastian's true identity as a billionaire, secrets begin to unravel, thrusting Noelle into an unexpected situation as she gradually uncovers the truth about his past...

dramabox.title: My Homeless Billionaire Husband
dramabox.norm_title: my homeless billionaire husband
dramabox.description: When exiled heir Chris Alden walks out of prison disguised as a beggar and impulsively marries indebted waitress Olivia Cooper to save her from a forced engagement, their unexpected romance begins. Chris has secretly loved her for years, but with Olivia’s memories lost, he must hide his true identity to stay by her side. Yet as danger closes in and the truth surfaces, one question remains—can their love survive once his secret is exposed?

dramabox.title: Runway To My Heart
dramabox.norm_title: runway to my heart
dramabox.description: Anna, an independent aircraft mechanic, impulsively wed Dennis, the charming captain at Hargus Airlines. As they soar 30,000 feet in the air, their relationship unfolds. While facing professional biases as a female mechanic, Anna also wards off rivals vying for Dennis' heart. Little does she know that beneath their contract marriage lies a romantic secret from their academy days, waiting to be unearthed and reignite their love.

dramabox.title: The Amazing Mr. and Mrs. Bennett
dramabox.norm_title: the amazing mr and mrs bennett
dramabox.description: To save her dying mother, Hannah enters into a contract marriage with a cold-hearted CEO-only to part ways right after. Three years later, they reunite when she joins his company as an intern, unaware they're married. As love grows between them, the truth threatens to break them apart.

dramabox.title: Pregnant by My Professor, Chased by His Son
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant by my professor chased by his son
dramabox.description: "I got pregnant by my professor—and he's my cheating ex-boyfriend's father! " As Iris's ex fights relentlessly to win her back, the professor refuses to step aside. On campus, father and son are locked in a silent battle over the same woman. Where will this forbidden relationship lead, and who will Iris choose?

dramabox.title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince
dramabox.norm_title: married a gardener got a prince
dramabox.description: Prince Philip of the young Kingdom of Lavinia went to the US to avoid being pressured into marriage. There he met and helped Anna, an American girl who had just been betrayed by her boyfriend. Philip claimed to be a royal gardener and agreed to a flash marriage with Anna. After their marriage, the two worked together to take on Anna's stepmother and stepsister, helping Anna successfully inherit her mother's company and obtain the authorization for royal portraits.

dramabox.title: Pick up A Billionare Husband
dramabox.norm_title: pick up a billionare husband
dramabox.description: On the eve of wedding day, Casey finds her fiancé's affair with her half-sister, who's in her wedding dress for the next day! Left in high and dry, to ensure her wedding proceed as scheduled, she impulsively flashes a marriage to a hot stranger, whom she accidentally saves when he's in crisis. Casey, like everyone else, believes her contract husband is just an ordinary person.

dramabox.title: 30 Days to be the Mafia King's Bride
dramabox.norm_title: 30 days to be the mafia king s bride
dramabox.description: On Valentine's night, nurse Lydia Hale saves a dying stranger—then learns he's Soren Moretti, a feared mafia king. He offers a brutal ultimatum: marry him or die. Trapped in his dangerous world, desire clashes with defiance. As a 30-day love contract ends, Lydia must choose freedom—or life beside a ruthless mafia king.

dramabox.title: Say My Name
dramabox.norm_title: say my name
dramabox.description: After a one-night stand, Charlotte and Nathan were forced to meet and get married because of their respective inheritance rights. Nathan entrusted his assistant to get the marriage certificate, so after the marriage, Charlotte and Nathan did not know each other's appearance. When they met again, they started a love-hate relationship. They fell in love with each other but did not know each other's identities due to various misunderstandings...

dramabox.title: Bought with Gold, Bound by Love
dramabox.norm_title: bought with gold bound by love
dramabox.description: After one night stand, I sold myself to my hot rich husband for one million dollars

dramabox.title: One Night With the Virgin CEO
dramabox.norm_title: one night with the virgin ceo
dramabox.description: Five years ago, No Seoyun was framed and cast out after a night at the Lumina Hotel left her pregnant. Alone, she raised her twins through hardship. A chance encounter leads to a flash marriage with Lee Hyunwoo, unaware of his true identity. As she endures humiliation, he becomes her only light—never knowing he is the man from that fateful night.

dramabox.title: The Mafia King Kept Me in the Dark
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia king kept me in the dark
dramabox.description: 24-year-old college student Isabelle, trying to escape the control of her brother Gavin, accidentally saves Myron, the grandfather of Nathan, the leader of the mafia, only to lose her sight in the process. To repay her kindness, Myron arranges a sudden marriage between Isabelle and Nathan. Suspecting that Isabelle is colluding with her brother, Nathan conceals his true identity and pretends to be poor to test her.

dramabox.title: But Daddy I Love Him
dramabox.norm_title: but daddy i love him
dramabox.description: After losing her memory, a woman is saved by men who hide her identity by making her their bodyguard, known to outsiders as a strong "cat woman." The male lead enters a fake marriage to expand his business, but when his fiancée discovers the bodyguard's true identit

dramabox.title: Memory Reset: Mr. Restraint Begged for Love
dramabox.norm_title: memory reset mr restraint begged for love
dramabox.description: Waking from amnesia, the heroine found herself married to her school crush. His childhood sweetheart schemed against her, but when she stopped chasing him, he fell for her instead. After exposing the truth, he devoted himself to protecting her. In the end, they found happiness together.

dramabox.title: Hit the Jackpot! My Broke Chef Husband Is a Billionaire?!
dramabox.norm_title: hit the jackpot my broke chef husband is a billionaire
dramabox.description: Bankrupt chef Frank arrives for an arranged marriage, but Anna is forced to wed him in place of her sick stepsister. Her greedy stepfather demands a high price; Anna humbly signs, yet her fiancé mistakes her for a gold-digger. Unbeknownst to her, the man behind the chef's disguise is actually the owner of a global food empire, quietly watching the proxy wedding farce unfold. When a billionaire marries in the guise of a chef, who truly is the one chasing wealth?

dramabox.title: The Stolen First Husband
dramabox.norm_title: the stolen first husband
dramabox.description:
Soo-a and Seo-jun have been married for three years. On their wedding anniversary, Soo-a discovers that her younger sister, Eun-a, has returned from abroad and is in bed with Seo-jun. Shocked and devastated, Soo-a demands a divorce and returns to her position as the head of the Madly Group.
As she begins to take revenge on Eun-a and those who tormented her, she gradually clears up the deep misunderstandings between herself and Seo-jun.

dramabox.title: Oh No! My Husband Is My Boss!
dramabox.norm_title: oh no my husband is my boss
dramabox.description: To fulfill her grandmother's wish, Kim Ha-eun rushes into marriage—only for her husband to leave for overseas work the very next day. A year later, the company's CEO, just returned from abroad, has a face that seems strangely familiar to Ha-eun. His true identity shocks her. As they grow closer, her guarded heart begins to open. Though married for a year, the two fall in love again, as if meeting for the first time.

dramabox.title: Love After Losing It All
dramabox.norm_title: love after losing it all
dramabox.description: Once ignored for being plus-size, Claire secretly dated her high school crush Ryan—until a brutal misunderstanding made her disappear. Years later, she returns as a slim, single mother under a fake name, desperate to avoid him. But Ryan has spent years searching for the girl who vanished without a word. When fate forces them together again, will he realize the woman before him is the love he lost?

dramabox.title: Just One Heartbeat Away
dramabox.norm_title: just one heartbeat away
dramabox.description: Trapped in an arranged marriage, Linda Winters is diagnosed with terminal cancer and decides to disappear on her own terms. As she reinvents herself for the time she has left, her distant husband, Ethan Winters, begins to uncover his mistake. When Linda finally defends Ethan and lives as her true self, he realizes—too late—that he has always loved her. With passion reignited and death closing in, their marriage becomes a love story with an expiration date...

dramabox.title: The Awakening of the Heiress
dramabox.norm_title: the awakening of the heiress
dramabox.description: Sophia, the daughter of a wealthy CEO, hides her identity to find true love, posing as a hotel cleaner to date her boyfriend, Jack. However, to secure a contract, Jack drugs Sophia and sends her to bed with another man, unaware that his girlfriend is the real CEO. After a one-night stand, Sophia and Vincent both conceal their identities and get married, seeking revenge on their wicked boyfriend. Eventually, their true identities are revealed...

dramabox.title: Don't be jealous,Your Grace！
dramabox.norm_title: don t be jealous your grace
dramabox.description: Tracy, a pastry chef whose family goes bankrupt, agrees to marry the Duke to save her father. However, she discovers the Duke is as cruel as the rumors say, so she decides to flee. Unexpectedly, the driver who takes her away is the Duke himself. The two enter into a marriage contract: the Duke gives Tracy's family money to save the family, while Tracy and the Duke pretend to be husband and wife, ensuring that the Duke inherits the title on his 30th birthday...

dramabox.title: Fly Me Away My Captain Husband
dramabox.norm_title: fly me away my captain husband
dramabox.description: Alana Davies, dreaming of becoming a flight attendant, unexpectedly discovers she’s pregnant after a one-night stand with the airline's pilot and CEO, Travis Irwin. Sold to a despicable man by her evil stepmother and facing sexual harassment and violence, Alana calls Travis for help. Travis comes to Alana's rescue and offers her a place to stay in his mansion. They fall in love while Emily Cooper, a rich girl who wants to marry Travis and is supported by his mother...

dramabox.title: Dr. Norman, Please Love Me!
dramabox.norm_title: dr norman please love me
dramabox.description: Sanglily, a girl suffering from a terminal illness, unexpectedly saves Dorian, a pharmaceutical genius on the verge of shooting himself, and with a kiss, ignites Dorian’s long-dormant heart. Burdened by a heavy past, Dorian returns to the laboratory with Sanglily’s love and encouragement, determined to develop a drug that could save her life. As the two fall in love on this journey against illness, a sudden turn of events causes Sanglily’s condition to deteriorate rapidly...

dramabox.title: Love Will Tear Us Apart
dramabox.norm_title: love will tear us apart
dramabox.description: A deaf bride trapped in a loveless marriage walks away to reclaim her life -- until the husband who broke her finally fights to win her back.

dramabox.title: Two Alpha Kings, One Virgin Mate
dramabox.norm_title: two alpha kings one virgin mate
dramabox.description: Clara and Barron were chosen by fate, once inseparable until Barron’s grandmother forced Clara to leave. Years later, she returns out of desperation, only to be bound once more to Barron through a cold contract—his love masked by anger, his instinct to protect twisted by years of misunderstanding. Though desire rekindles between them, their bond is poisoned by secrets. Clara conceals her pregnancy from Barron, fearing his power and mistrust...

dramabox.title: Marry By Chance
dramabox.norm_title: marry by chance
dramabox.description: During a high-stakes mission, Clare Brown, a righteous and courageous police officer, mistakes a mysterious stranger, Evan Clinton, for her undercover contact. In a whirlwind of confusion, she forces him into a VIP wedding at a small city hall chapel. Faced with this sudden marriage contract, Evan offers a deal: he will provide Clare with a place to stay and cover her living expenses if she agrees to play the role of his wife to keep his meddling family at bay.

dramabox.title: Daddy, This Is Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: daddy this is mommy
dramabox.description: She had a one-night stand with a stranger and gave birth to a son, whom her father took away to settle his debts. Overwhelmed with sadness, she suffered memory loss, unaware that her stepson is actually her own biological child...

dramabox.title: The Alpha's Fateful Mate
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha s fateful mate
dramabox.description: In the werewolf world, Adriana and her sister were bullied by their foster family. Forced to marry a 70-year-old, Adriana fled and met Christian, an "ordinary" man who was actually the grandson of her saved lady. They impulsively married. Misunderstanding each other, they soon found love. In a crisis, Adriana learned Christian was the Alpha. Meanwhile, Christian uncovered secrets in Adriana's pendant and birthmark.

dramabox.title: No Escape From The Mafia King's Embrace
dramabox.norm_title: no escape from the mafia king s embrace
dramabox.description: On Valentine's night, nurse Lydia Hale saves a dying stranger—then learns he's Soren Moretti, a feared mafia king. He offers a brutal ultimatum: marry him or die. Trapped in his dangerous world, desire clashes with defiance. As a 30-day love contract ends, Lydia must choose freedom—or life beside a ruthless mafia king.

dramabox.title: Snowbound with a Homeless Prince
dramabox.norm_title: snowbound with a homeless prince
dramabox.description: To fulfill her dying mother Margaret’s last wish, Noelle plans to marry fiancé Kevin—until she catches him cheating with Sophie, the mayor’s daughter. Prince Luke, disguised as a homeless man, helps her, and they impulsively marry. As they live together, Luke’s habits—especially his look after bathing and love for hot cocoa—remind Noelle of her childhood memories with a young prince…

dramabox.title: All the Little Ways I Love You
dramabox.norm_title: all the little ways i love you
dramabox.description: After Penny Reese enters a flash marriage with Professor William Neal on a blind date meant for her sister, true love unexpectedly blossoms from what was supposed to be a simple arrangement. As they grow to become each other's strongest support, Penny pursues her artistic dreams. Meanwhile, her sister falls for William's colleague, and both couples ultimately find their happy ending.

dramabox.title: Kisses Laced with Lies (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: kisses laced with lies dubbed
dramabox.description: A leaked video shatters Stella Quinn's reputation and ends her relationship with her boyfriend—who had been playing her for her sister, Willow Quinn. In despair, Stella takes Willow's place in an arranged marriage and exposes what she did. With her new partner, Stella steps into a new life—but her ex isn't ready to let her go just yet.

dramabox.title: Love, Ten Years in the Making
dramabox.norm_title: love ten years in the making
dramabox.description: After a night of unexpected events, Frida Glover ends up in an impulsive marriage with her best friend's brother, Trenton Dixon. She expects it to end soon, but Trenton surprises her with endless love. It is only later that she learns their marriage was his long-laid plan—and she has always been his crush.

dramabox.title: Love, Hidden in His Gaze
dramabox.norm_title: love hidden in his gaze
dramabox.description: Tara Shaw unknowingly marries blind Joe Bale and slowly falls in love with him while caring for him. When her sister Gina returns and exposes Tara as a mere stand-in, she tries to reclaim Joe—unaware he had faked his blindness just to marry Tara. Shocked by the truth but moved by his devotion, Tara chooses to stay. Later, when Gina faces an abusive marriage, Tara selflessly steps in to rescue her.

dramabox.title: Revenge Marriage Sweet Love
dramabox.norm_title: revenge marriage sweet love
dramabox.description: Cate's sister Rebecca had not only stolen her boyfriend Ethan, but had also stripped her of her inheritance. Fueled by desire for revenge, a drunken Cate impulsively decided to seduce Ethan's handsome uncle, Shaun, who later was ignited by Cate and fell madly in love despite his cold demeanor. However, when they both realized Shaun was mistaken as Ethan's uncle, Shaun realized that she initially approached him only for revenge against Ethan, putting their love to the test.

dramabox.title: What Came Out of My Antique Lamp
dramabox.norm_title: what came out of my antique lamp
dramabox.description: In a cyberpunk world, scientist Livia discovers an antique lamp spitting out strange objects—and pouring water into it changes everything. The lamp connects to Edonia, a dying elven kingdom. Bishop Marcus sacrifices his blood to end a drought, then receives a surge of fresh water from the lamp. He and Livia communicate, trading supplies for companionship and healing. They fall in love. But legend says Marcus dies young—and his foretold death is approaching.

dramabox.title: Unleash Her Dragon Heart
dramabox.norm_title: unleash her dragon heart
dramabox.description: Duke Oster of the Northlands finds his long-lost dragon-blooded daughter, Ella, after fifteen years apart. The girl carries dragon blood, her power sealed within a necklace. Ambitious Prince Reynold covets the dragons' power—he unleashes magical beasts, frames the Duke, and poisons him to death. Ella uncovers Reynold's crimes of regicide and treason, and in the final battle at the royal capital, she slays the giant beast and Reynold himself.

dramabox.title: My Mafia Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: my mafia boyfriend
dramabox.description: Sold by her gambler father, Maren flees and rescues amnesiac mafia boss Altair. They cohabit and fall in love. Altair's power-hungry brother Castor conspires with fiancée Nikki and frames Altair for Maren's mother's murder. Altair fakes his death to expose the truth: Castor killed both his mother and Maren's witness-mother. The villains are punished, and healed Altair proposes to Maren.

dramabox.title: The Second Godfather
dramabox.norm_title: the second godfather
dramabox.description: In 1951, taxi driver Liam is dragged into a mob war after crime lord Victor Vance dies in his cab—and Liam mysteriously inherits fragments of Victor's memory. Hunted by Victor's son Marcus, enforcer Dante, and rival boss Moretti, Liam must uncover who ordered the hit while protecting his wife Elena. Instead of ruling through fear, he builds a new kind of power—until the city sees him as the second Godfather.

dramabox.title: Dark Yacht:Escaping My Ex, Falling for the Hitman
dramabox.norm_title: dark yacht escaping my ex falling for the hitman
dramabox.description: A girl tricked by her ex-boyfriend onto a luxury yacht to auction off her first night is rescued by a cold-blooded killer codenamed "The Cleaner"—and the two fall into a deadly attraction while on the run.

dramabox.title: Taken by the Mafia Godfather
dramabox.norm_title: taken by the mafia godfather
dramabox.description: Mob boss Raine keeps bunny-girl Leah captive to break his blood curse—but falls in love and forfeits his cure. Leah falls into the sea, vanishing. Seven years later, she returns with their child. Together they unravel the conspiracy and reunite, proving love outlasts fate itself.

dramabox.title: Falling for a Mafia Boss After Pregnancy
dramabox.norm_title: falling for a mafia boss after pregnancy
dramabox.description: He is a mafia don walking in the shadows—cold-blooded, ruthless, a stranger to tenderness.She is a white-coated nurse bathed in sunlight—resilient, unyielding, the one who shatters every one of his rules.One accident, one night of tangled fate, one unplanned child, binds two souls from opposite worlds together, irrevocably.There are misunderstandings, fiery clashes, and life-or-death devotion; there is unwavering preference, quiet redemption, and a love hidden deep beneath..

dramabox.title: Yes Or No: I'm The Binary King
dramabox.norm_title: yes or no i m the binary king
dramabox.description: Betrayed by his girlfriend and framed for theft, broke burger joint worker Leo awakens a mysterious Yes-or-No System that predicts every outcome. With the system guiding him, he rises from poverty to power, teams up with mafia heiress Olivia, uncovers his true identity, and battles enemies determined to destroy his family and the woman he loves.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Prince's Fake Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia prince s fake bride
dramabox.description: Mia, a broke cleaner, is forced to pose as her real-estate-mogul stepsister at a bachelor auction. Roman, a ruthless mafia prince, falls for Mia at first sight and forces her to be his bride. When her true identity as a cleaner is exposed at their wedding, the terrifying Mafia Prince wages war against the world to protect his fake bride, for he has already fallen deeply in love with her.

dramabox.title: God, Being an Assistant Is Deadly
dramabox.norm_title: god being an assistant is deadly
dramabox.description: Damien, a mafia heir raised in hiding, saved Sebastian Kingsley as a child and became his secretary and bedmate. Over a decade, Damien fell in love—but Sebastian treated him as a tool. Humiliated before Sebastian's engagement, Damien left when the contract expired and reclaimed his own power. When they met again, their positions had reversed—Damien now held all the cards.

dramabox.title: Pregnant with the Mafia Don's Heir
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant with the mafia don s heir
dramabox.description: Elena flees after a night with Ryan. Months later, pregnant and pursued, she gives birth to Vito, who bears the Vitali family birthmark. To survive, she works at Ryan's casino as a bunny dealer. Humiliated by a gambler, she's saved when Ryan storms in with his men, seconds before her son is killed.

dramabox.title: Mafia Obsession: Stop, My Stepbrother!
dramabox.norm_title: mafia obsession stop my stepbrother
dramabox.description: A slum girl has a one-night stand with a wealthy heir, then becomes his stepsister. Engaged to another, he rejects her pregnancy due to false infertility. DNA proves him wrong, but escape plans fail. A matriarch reveals her as her lost daughter, voiding her forced marriage. After her abuser dies and rival falls, the couple settles in Greece with their baby.

dramabox.title: Supernatural Mafia King
dramabox.norm_title: supernatural mafia king
dramabox.description: After five years in prison for a crime he took on for his crew, Kane Black wants only to reunite with his wife and ailing daughter. Then an underworld king entrusts him with the Sovereign Ring and godly power. Hunted by ruthless supernatural mafias and a traitor building an army from corrupted blood, Kane must stop hiding, claim the throne he never wanted and become the protector his family needs.

dramabox.title: Kiss Me, My Mafia Brother
dramabox.norm_title: kiss me my mafia brother
dramabox.description: After years of abuse, Jessica is reclaimed by her biological father, a ruthless mafia kingpin—only to discover that Lucian, the cold assassin who seduced her, is now her adoptive brother. Betrayed and hunted by a hidden syndicate, she must uncover her true identity, seize the empire, and choose between revenge, freedom, and forbidden love.

dramabox.title: Locked by the Mafia Boss
dramabox.norm_title: locked by the mafia boss
dramabox.description: My cold, ruthless Mafia godfather guardian tore off his mask on my twenty-first birthday. He doesn't want me to call him uncle anymore. He wants me as his caged bird.

dramabox.title: Law of the Jungle
dramabox.norm_title: law of the jungle
dramabox.description: Ten years ago, Officer Elias was framed by his partner Hank and Chief Waters, landing him in prison while his pregnant wife was murdered. Now a vengeful "Ghost" leading convicts, he returns to Pingle Town to tear down the corrupt "Zoo" run by criminals and dirty cops. Hank seeks redemption as Detective Ella fights for justice. Elias enforces brutal law, dragging the rotten system to destruction.

dramabox.title: 365 Nights with the Mafia King
dramabox.norm_title: 365 nights with the mafia king
dramabox.description: On her coming-of-age night, Ella Connor is confessed to by Dante De Luca—her guardian, godfather of the Luca family, and the man she's loved for five years. He is obsessed with her, but their rival Marco threatens to exploit her as a weakness. Her father's arranged contract sends childhood friend Sebastian to her door. When evidence points to Dante as her father's killer, Ella must decide whether to pull the trigger.

dramabox.title: The Double Life of My Mafia Husband
dramabox.norm_title: the double life of my mafia husband
dramabox.description: Three years ago, Raymond had a one-night stand with a stranger. He is tricked into a funeral that turns out to be a marriage trap to sell him to a rich pervert. Alan, a top neurosurgeon and mafia heir, rescues him, and they enter a contract marriage. Raymond falls for him, but discovers Alan was the stranger from three years ago, and his mother's accident is linked to Alan's family.

dramabox.title: Step by Step into the Mafia's Embrace
dramabox.norm_title: step by step into the mafia s embrace
dramabox.description: To escape the desperate fate of being sold by her cousin, destitute heiress Grace fakes blindness and flees—only to stumble into the private chamber of mafia boss Thomas. A fateful night of chaos leaves her pregnant with the child of this ruthless killer. Seething with rage, Thomas initially vows to silence her for good, yet family rules bind him to marry her against his will.

dramabox.title: Wow! My Mom is the Mob Queen!
dramabox.norm_title: wow my mom is the mob queen
dramabox.description: She chooses to leave the gang to protect her daughter, hiding her true identity as a gang leader and becoming a chef instead. Yet, a rival gang kidnaps her daughter, marking the beginning of the story. How will the woman seek revenge for her daughter?

dramabox.title: Forced to Marry, Saved by a Killer
dramabox.norm_title: forced to marry saved by a killer
dramabox.description: Lucas, an illegitimate son of the Hamilton family, flees his arranged marriage and gets caught in a chase with mafia boss Diego. They fake being a couple and go on the run, uncovering family conspiracies and drug networks while developing feelings for each other.

dramabox.title: The Mafia King's Little Spy
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia king s little spy
dramabox.description: At her wedding, Eve thinks she's found the man of her dreams—until Lucifer, a cute dog who crashes the ceremony, reveals the truth: her fiancé is cheating with her sister, and her unborn baby's father is Butler, the feared mafia godfather from a one-night stand. Swept into his dangerous, luxurious world, Eve faces schemes at every turn. With Lucifer exposing every trap, Eve fights back, falls for Butler, and faces a conspiracy that could change them all.

dramabox.title: Oops! The Mafia Boss Is in My Body
dramabox.norm_title: oops the mafia boss is in my body
dramabox.description: A falling brick causes Jesse and ruthless mafia boss Enzo to swap bodies. Jesse must play the feared boss while Enzo is trapped in Jesse's fragile body. Forced into one bed and one war, Jesse discovers he is Enzo's only weakness—the one boy the mafia boss would risk everything to protect.

dramabox.title: Captive Bride of the Ruthless Do
dramabox.norm_title: captive bride of the ruthless do
dramabox.description: Bellhaven is a fictional East Coast port city, with its old docks, nightlife and port logistics largely controlled by criminal syndicates. The ruling Vitale Family cleanses their underground business through the legitimate Vitale Group, which operates nightclubs, real estate and port logistics. Young don Dante Vitale rules the city with an iron fist and a brutal reputation.Hidden in Bellhaven is The Aviary, a masked underground den for both law and the underworld.

dramabox.title: The Substitue Groom is a Mafia Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: the substitue groom is a mafia daddy
dramabox.description: Burdened by her father's mountainous debt, Anna has no choice but to enter a forced marriage with Valentin, the ruthless, iron-fisted head of a powerful mafia financial empire. Cold, domineering, and accustomed to absolute control, he is a feared tyrant of the underworld—until a fateful accident leads Anna to his private BDSM chamber, pulling both of them into a tense, dangerous dance of desire and submission.

dramabox.title: My Silent Brother
dramabox.norm_title: my silent brother
dramabox.description: Chatty orphan Scarlett is chosen by mafia godfather Enzo to be the white noise companion for Valentino, a successor with PTSD and mutism. Her endless chatter breaks his three-year silence and helps him heal. They face bullying, family power struggles, and global tech showdowns. Valentino regains control, Scarlett becomes a top geek, and they find a true home in each other.

dramabox.title: Taming Her Dominant Mafioso
dramabox.norm_title: taming her dominant mafioso
dramabox.description: On the run after her mafia family falls, Olivia strikes a dangerous deal with feared Don Vince Luciano. As desire and secrets collide, will she escape him—or surrender to him?

dramabox.title: Mafia's Desire for the Wet Nurse
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s desire for the wet nurse
dramabox.description: Elina is drugged and spends a night with Vincent, who cannot touch any woman due to childhood trauma. She gives birth to a son Leo, who is sent to an orphanage. Vincent adopts Leo. Elina applies as a wet nurse, not recognizing each other. Leo only drinks her milk. They fall in love as Vincent can only touch her. After schemes and revelations, Vincent discovers Leo is his son and Elina is his masked lover. He fights his family, and they marry.

dramabox.title: Mafia Son: Unbroken By Betrayal
dramabox.norm_title: mafia son unbroken by betrayal
dramabox.description: Sebastian Vale, founder of Vale Tech and former mafia son, broke from his family 25 years ago. His company's AI goes rogue, crippling global infrastructure. He discovers his wife Claire and COO Marco are having an affair, and Marco is actually his half-brother, exploiting a bloodline loophole to steal his life. With his mafia father's help, he fights to save Claire, stop the AI, and make a final choice between revenge and justice.

dramabox.title: The Mob Boss Demands Her Perfect Genes
dramabox.norm_title: the mob boss demands her perfect genes
dramabox.description: Elite doctor Christine catches mafia boss Damon's eye for her genes. She hates him for driving her mom to suicide. She rushes a wedding to escape, but Damon crashes it and locks her up. He fights for her, and she slowly sees his twisted love, drops the grudge, and they end up together.

dramabox.title: Disciplined by My Mafia Master
dramabox.norm_title: disciplined by my mafia master
dramabox.description: An obedient psychology student gets involved with Dom, the most dangerous gang leader, for her BDSM project. What starts as a master-slave contract becomes a fatal redemption.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Queen Fell for Her Assassin
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia queen fell for her assassin
dramabox.description: Harper, a tactical medic, infiltrated crime queen Valentina's circle to avenge her mother, but saved Valentina in an assassination. They hunted the same black ledger and learned their loved ones died in the same coup. They chose whether to rule or burn it down.

dramabox.title: I fell in love with my fiance's bodyguard
dramabox.norm_title: i fell in love with my fiance s bodyguard
dramabox.description: Port heiress Alessia was forced to marry mafia heir Dante, who assigned bodyguard Sloane to watch her. They grew close and uncovered a conspiracy to seize her company and kill her. Sloane chose to take Alessia away and overthrow both families.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Heir Hid Me in His Bed
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia heir hid me in his bed
dramabox.description: Auditor Noah caught mafia uncle poisoning the patriarch. He turned to heir Adrian for protection. They grew close while probing the murder, but Noah suspected Adrian in his sister's death. Together they rooted out family moles.

dramabox.title: The Alpha Wolf Is a Husky
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha wolf is a husky
dramabox.description: Dr. Evelyn blamed Northern Wolf King Kane for her mother's death. She married him with a knife to seek revenge. But Kane turned into a clingy husky at midnight and offered clues. She realized someone else was the mastermind and chose to stand with him.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Boss's Rose Boy
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia boss s rose boy
dramabox.description: College student Cecil saves mafia leader Kane, who falls for him. After betrayal and suicide attempt, Kane trains Cecil to be his right hand. They grow close, but Kane's fiancée causes conflict. Cecil fakes his death and disappears for five years. They reunite in a snowy night, reconcile, and embrace.

dramabox.title: Reborn at My Mafia Wedding: I Chose His Enemy
dramabox.norm_title: reborn at my mafia wedding i chose his enemy
dramabox.description: Sibling heirs of Moretti are forced into marriage with Kane family. Lorenzo falls for his sister's fiancé Adrian, while Valentina loves Mara, Adrian's bodyguard. Their romances turn a truce into a succession war.

dramabox.title: One Kiss Is All It Takes
dramabox.norm_title: one kiss is all it takes
dramabox.description: Zhong Ying, a transmigrator, becomes a sacrificial bride to the villain Zhao Wuqi. Fearing death, she uses his weakness—a kiss creates a sensory link—to bind him to her. She then takes revenge on her enemies while navigating their dangerous relationship.

dramabox.title: The Mafia King’s Fake Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia king s fake boyfriend
dramabox.description: Noah, a nurse, found mafia heir Adrian shot in a bathroom. Adrian kissed him publicly and declared him his boyfriend to avoid an arranged marriage. They hid together, and Noah realized Adrian truly cared for him. When the tribunal demanded Noah renounce, he refused, and Adrian took a bullet for him again.

dramabox.title: Godfather, Your Wife Is So Wet
dramabox.norm_title: godfather your wife is so wet
dramabox.description: Five years after barely surviving uncle Damian's coup, Kevin returns as physician Miles to treat Damian's wife Seraphina. His aim: destroy Damian. Through intimate therapy, he turns Seraphina into a pawn, and uses Aria's desire for freedom to sow rebellion. Enduring Damian's brutal tests, Miles rescues his father's loyalists, eroding the empire. Finally, he sheds the doctor's disguise, becoming a vengeful fiend for a bloody reckoning.

dramabox.title: Seven Days Before Rebirth-I Married the King of the Gang
dramabox.norm_title: seven days before rebirth i married the king of the gang
dramabox.description: Cole was killed on his wedding night to mafia heir Dante. Reborn seven days before, he tried to flee but faced assassination attempts. He married Dante to uncover the truth and found Dante had been shielding him. The real culprit was within the Moretti family.

dramabox.title: Locked in the Abyss with the Tycoon
dramabox.norm_title: locked in the abyss with the tycoon
dramabox.description: Avery returns home for her father's funeral and finds her stepmother has taken over, with help from her ex-boyfriend Sebastian, a mafia tycoon. She learns of a bank key to a money laundering network and plots revenge. Sebastian seems to protect her, but he is actually an undercover agent. They join forces and defeat the stepmother in a final confrontation.

dramabox.title: I Was Sent to Spy on the Mad Mafia Heir
dramabox.norm_title: i was sent to spy on the mad mafia heir
dramabox.description: In the Winters family, twins are cursed. Violet is loved, but her sister is used as a blood supply and replacement. She has no name, just "Winters." Then Liam Winslow, heir to the richest family, falls for her when she replaces Violet on a date, giving her light.

dramabox.title: Dirty Water
dramabox.norm_title: dirty water
dramabox.description: Deon's family is in crisis—his son needs expensive surgery and his shop is failing. He is forced into a drug trafficking ring, and his brother Marcus has become a gang enforcer. Deon goes undercover, but discovers Marcus has abandoned all principles. The story explores the dilemma between family loyalty and justice.

dramabox.title: The Island Club
dramabox.norm_title: the island club
dramabox.description: After her daughter is brutally murdered by a powerful crime family, single mother Grace reinvents herself as the perfect weapon and infiltrates the enemy’s inner circle in search of revenge. But when she falls for the family’s adopted son—the very man who trained her, the truth behind her daughter’s death begins to unravel, exposing a web of lies and dark family secrets. Will Grace finally get the justice she seeks, or will she become the next victim in this deadly game?

dramabox.title: Marry me, My enemy
dramabox.norm_title: marry me my enemy
dramabox.description: Undercover DEA agent Louis is captured by the Mafia. Daniel, the second-in-command, claims him and takes him away. Louis is shocked, but Daniel asks him out on a date. The two navigate their unexpected relationship.

dramabox.title: Mafia's forbidden captive
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s forbidden captive
dramabox.description: Chloe, raised in the countryside, returns to Washington to find the truth behind her sister's brutal murder. She accidentally saves Vincent, the leader of the East Coast mafia. She discovers her sister was killed by a rival gang, and her stepmother colluded with Natalie, the wife of the Moretti family, to cover up the crime. Using Vincent's power, Chloe exacts revenge, and the two fall in love amidst the violence.

dramabox.title: Return of the King
dramabox.norm_title: return of the king
dramabox.description: Leon Taylor spent three years in prison taking the fall for his girlfriend, Ginny. On the day of his release, Ginny showed up with her new boyfriend, Jack, to humiliate him—and revealed the truth: the real hit‑and‑run driver was Jack, and Ginny had been using Leon from the very beginning.

dramabox.title: After the Divorce, the Mafia Boss Went crazy
dramabox.norm_title: after the divorce the mafia boss went crazy
dramabox.description: This series tells the story of marital redemption between Italian Mafia Don Damian and his wife, Alessia. On their seventh anniversary, Alessia discovers her husband's affair with her own sister, Bianca. Heartbroken, she erases her identity, takes the alias Elena, and decides to raise her daughter alone.After uncovering the truth and losing the woman he loves, Damian approaches her secretly as a donor.

dramabox.title: Mafia Husband, Detective Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: mafia husband detective boyfriend
dramabox.description: Ava marries mafia don Jackson to avenge her father, but her wedding-night kill plan is derailed when her ex-fiancé Duncan infiltrates as her bodyguard. Torn between two men, she questions the "truth" she thought she knew.

dramabox.title: Farewell My Mafia Boss Lover
dramabox.norm_title: farewell my mafia boss lover
dramabox.description: Nolan Miller appears to be nothing more than a "plaything" chosen by mob boss Marshall Graves—but in truth, he harbors a shattering secret. Five years ago, he was Vincent Morley, a boy taken from an orphanage and doted upon by Marshall.

dramabox.title: Professor by Day, Master by Night
dramabox.norm_title: professor by day master by night
dramabox.description: Lucy, a medical student suffering from long‑term domestic abuse, seeks solace in a secret D/s relationship with a mysterious dominant she calls "Daddy." When her new anatomy professor, Ethan—strict and stern, yet with a voice identical to Daddy's—arrives, she is thrown into confusion.

dramabox.title: Don't Cross the Queenpin Mom
dramabox.norm_title: don t cross the queenpin mom
dramabox.description: This scumbag thought his wife was just a punching bag. Little did he know, the "easy target" he's been torturing is the precious daughter of a legendary Mafia Godmother. Now she's coming to take her daughter back—and hand-deliver him to hell....

dramabox.title: Caught! The Mafia King's Runaway Bride
dramabox.norm_title: caught the mafia king s runaway bride
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her boyfriend. Sold by her father. Forced to marry a legendary Mafia Boss. Julie thought her life was over until she accidentally bumped into a dangerous, magnetic stranger on a train. To survive, she accepted fake marriage proposal from that stranger, however totally unaware that her "contract husband" is Vincenzo, the very Mafia King she’s trying to escape...

dramabox.title: Mafia Prince Little Liar
dramabox.norm_title: mafia prince little liar
dramabox.description: When broke cleaner Aria Sinclair is forced to attend a bachelor auction under her stepsister’s name, she accidentally wins Dante Romano, the city’s most dangerous mafia prince. But Dante already knows she is lying. Bound by a ruthless marriage contract, Aria must survive jealous rivals, family wars, and a hidden bloodline—while discovering the man who claimed her may be the only one willing to burn for her.

dramabox.title: The Bodyguard Godfather's Good Girl
dramabox.norm_title: the bodyguard godfather s good girl
dramabox.description: Born a mafia princess, Zoe has always been a pawn in her ruthless father’s game. Forced to marry Delon in place of her stepsister, she refuses to become a sacrifice for her family’s ambitions.Desperate to escape, she sets her sights on Nick, her cold and disciplined bodyguard—unaware that he is secretly the powerful Godfather of the Voss family. As Nick witnesses Zoe’s resilience beneath her pain, an irresistible bond forms between them.

dramabox.title: The King of Beggars
dramabox.norm_title: the king of beggars
dramabox.description: A billionaire CEO Drew survives his wife Vivian's brutal murder attempt, waking as an amnesiac mute beggar. Rescued by a kind-hearted mute woman who brings him into her family restaurant, love blossoms between them. When his memory returns, he hides his identity to protect her from his ruthless ex-wife...

dramabox.title: The Blackmailed Bride: Falling in Love With a Criminal Boss
dramabox.norm_title: the blackmailed bride falling in love with a criminal boss
dramabox.description: Mia Espinosa was just a nursing school dropout working the night shift when she saved a bleeding stranger in an alley. That stranger turned out to be Emilio Reyes—the most feared cartel boss on the East Coast. Three months later, he reappears with an offer she can't refuse: marry him for one year and inherit a fortune. But nothing is what it seems. The inheritance is a lie. Her long-lost cousin is a pawn.

dramabox.title: Accidentally Pregnant with the Mafia Boss
dramabox.norm_title: accidentally pregnant with the mafia boss
dramabox.description: A 21-year-old florist, Alice, lives a life of quiet misery—bullied by her family and preyed upon by the world around her—until one fateful night with Brayven, the ruthless mafia king. A single night of passion changes everything when she discovers she’s carrying his child.

dramabox.title: Fallen For The Black Rose
dramabox.norm_title: fallen for the black rose
dramabox.description: Mafia heiress Rose has spent her life trapped under her father’s iron rule and her brother’s constant schemes—obedient on the surface, but merely a pawn in their ruthless power games. Fierce on the outside yet deeply scarred within, she trusts no one… until she crosses paths with undercover cop Leo, who infiltrates her world disguised as a waiter.

dramabox.title: Mafia Single Daddy’s Stolen Bride
dramabox.norm_title: mafia single daddy s stolen bride
dramabox.description: On her wedding day, Lucia catches her fiancé cheating—only to be sold to ruthless mafia boss Nico Romano to pay off a gambling debt. Forced into a one-year contract marriage with Nico, she becomes nanny to his traumatized young niece and gradually uncovers the caring man hidden beneath his cold, dangerous facade. But as enemies close in and their forbidden attraction deepens, Lucia must decide whether trusting a mafia boss is worth risking her heart—and her life.

dramabox.title: Chained to My Ruthless Mafia Dom
dramabox.norm_title: chained to my ruthless mafia dom
dramabox.description: Bella, a caregiver desperate to pay for her grandmother's life-saving surgery, decides to sell her eggs. Instead, she accidentally stumbles into the room of Cosimo, a ruthless mafia boss. Forced into a collar, she inadvertently signs a "domestication contract" with him. Through a series of intense sensory games and life-or-death confrontations, the cold-hearted Dom finds himself genuinely falling in love.

dramabox.title: Billionaire's Canvas Cinderella
dramabox.norm_title: billionaire s canvas cinderella
dramabox.description: Impoverished artist Ella, sold to gangster Derek by her mother, was rescued by billionaire Victor. A drugged encounter left her pregnant, triggering his abrupt marriage. Unbeknownst to him, childhood love Selena retaliated with schemes exposing Ella's true heritage. Ultimately, they overcame threats and lies to build a life together, defying all odds.

dramabox.title: Mafia Housewife
dramabox.norm_title: mafia housewife
dramabox.description: Juliet seems like the perfect housewife—calm, composed, and always smiling. But behind that polished exterior hides a woman with a painful past as the long-lost heiress of the notorious Blackstone mafia. She thought she left that life behind when she married Jack, trading power for a chance at a simpler life.
