But when her charming husband reveals a darker side, plotting to build his own underground empire and leaving her for dead, Juliet barely makes it out alive.

dramabox.title: Mafia's Little Grape
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s little grape
dramabox.description: Lily took a leave of absence from school to work as a grape stomper to pay her tuition. On her boyfriend Eric's birthday, inspired by her best friend, she decided to tie herself to the swing and give herself to him as a birthday gift. But the one who came home that night was not Eric. It was his father Victor, a notorious and cold-blooded mafia boss. The two spent an unforgettable night together by accident.

dramabox.title: Mafia Daddy's Forbidden Christmas
dramabox.norm_title: mafia daddy s forbidden christmas
dramabox.description: Sabrina’s life shatters on a single night in a casino. Forced to repay her father’s gambling debts, she is humiliated in front of a cheering crowd—until Dominic, a cold and ruthless mafia boss, raises a gun to stop the spectacle and offers her a shocking deal: marry him.What Sabrina thinks is only a desperate arrangement soon drags her into the powerful Moretti family. Chosen as Kyle’s future bride, she is told she must become pregnant before Christmas to secure her place.

dramabox.title: My Mafia Boss Boyfriend (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: my mafia boss boyfriend dubbed
dramabox.description: So Jinha, a top medical student, once shared a passionate three-year romance with Cha Seonu, a thug. Pressured by her father, Seonu broke up with her, lying that he had fallen for someone else to end their relationship. Eight years later, Jinha is an exceptional surgeon, while Seonu has become a powerful CEO. Fate reunites them when he ends up on her operating table. He risks everything to win her back, while she still struggles with the wound he left behind.

dramabox.title: Dominant Don's Disobedient Girl
dramabox.norm_title: dominant don s disobedient girl
dramabox.description: Olivia Rossi becomes the sex slave of the notorious Mafia Boss Vince Luciano—known for taking pleasure in women's bodies—to save her father. She goes from resisting him to gradually falling completely under his spell, ultimately submitting to him with her whole heart.

dramabox.title: The Christmas Contract: Mafia's Stand-In Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the christmas contract mafia s stand in bride
dramabox.description: During the Christmas season, college student Eliana stumbles into a mafia trap while scrambling to raise funds for her father’s medical bills. She’s forcibly abducted to the mansion of mafia boss Damian—all because she bears an uncanny resemblance to his late true love, Laura. Amid captivity and resistance, Eliana gradually uncovers the trauma and deep affection beneath Damian’s violent exterior, and falls for him.

dramabox.title: Never Let Me Go
dramabox.norm_title: never let me go
dramabox.description: In 1940s Los Angeles, nurse Carol is stunned when her former lover, Daniel, arrives wounded—now the head of a powerful mafia family that killed her brother. Passion reignites but Carol resists his violent world, while Daniel’s obsession grows. Even as their twisted fate spirals toward tragedy, Carol keeps one hidden secret: that she and Daniel already share a son!

dramabox.title: His Brother, My Lover!
dramabox.norm_title: his brother my lover
dramabox.description: Pregnant Layla attends her husband Matt’s funeral in grief, only to be interrogated by the police—until a man named Orlando, who claims to be Matt’s younger brother, drives them away and forcibly takes Layla with him. She soon learns that her late husband was the godfather of the most powerful mafia family, and Orlando has now inherited everything.

dramabox.title: Assassin's Apprentice Falling for the Target
dramabox.norm_title: assassin s apprentice falling for the target
dramabox.description: The top-ranked female assassin on the hit list received her final mission before retirement: to train the mafia boss's illegitimate child as the heir. After overcoming various obstacles together, they finally achieve their desires and find happiness.

dramabox.title: Romance with My Vampire Brother
dramabox.norm_title: romance with my vampire brother
dramabox.description: Anna witnesses her family's slaughter by the Lawrence syndicate. Ten years later, she infiltrates their engagement banquet for revenge. Disguised as a maid, she eliminates threats to Edward, heir of the syndicate. But as she grows closer, she falls for him, complicating her mission. Anna faces a dilemma between love and vengeance, testing her resolve.

dramabox.title: She is My Luna
dramabox.norm_title: she is my luna
dramabox.description: Emma Young, the Canadian designer, is stuck with an expiring visa, so what does she do? She goes and marries this guy she bumps into, Alexander Kingsley. Little did she know, he's not just some big shot running KS Fashion, but also the top dog of the Crimson Shadow pack. At first, Emma thought this marriage was just a quick fix, but Alexander's smooth moves got her hooked.

dramabox.title: 7 Steamy Days with a Gangster
dramabox.norm_title: 7 steamy days with a gangster
dramabox.description: In the chaos of a brutal gang shootout, Violet, a nurse, instinctively saves Mattia, the ruthless leader of a powerful crime syndicate, from the brink of death. Little does she know that this act of mercy will ensnare her in a dangerous web of obsession.Caught in a deadly game of love and betrayal, Violet must confront a heart-wrenching dilemma: stay true to her promise or succumb to Mattia’s seductive yet perilous affection.

dramabox.title: Mafia Princess Vows Blood Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: mafia princess vows blood revenge
dramabox.description: Mafia heiress Olivia fled her father's overprotective world for love, only to be abandoned by her husband Zane for career gain and left heartbroken. 3. When her son, who is suffering from leukemia,  is brutally killed by Zane's new wife and her family, she refuses to submit any longer. Reclaiming her powerful legacy, Olivia unleashes merciless revenge to avenge her child and make the villains pay dearly.

dramabox.title: Irresistible love with my brother in law
dramabox.norm_title: irresistible love with my brother in law
dramabox.description: Amelia, a young widow, was pregnant with the posthumous child of her late husband Daniel. She was taken back to the Tuscan estate of the ancient and powerful Di Maggio family in Italy for protection. At first, Anthony, Daniel's older brother, was hostile towards Amelia, seeing her as a threat. But through repeated conflicts and time spent together, he was deeply attracted to her resilience and sincerity.

dramabox.title: Mafia Heiress's Forbidden Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: mafia heiress s forbidden obsession
dramabox.description: After the Camorra boss Michael is assassinated, his 20-year-old daughter Gloria is forced to take over. Amid crises, she falls for her father's friend and bodyguard,  Theo, a 34-year-old ex-FBI agent. Seeing her photo in his pendant, she believes he loves her—until she discovers it's actually her mother. Suspecting Theo's involvement in her father's murder, their relationship collapses.

dramabox.title: The Sniper King’s Return
dramabox.norm_title: the sniper king s return
dramabox.description: Ethan, a decorated five-star general, the King of Guns,encounters Joel during his search for his long-lost familywhen Joel is ambushed by a gang. Using his unmatchedmarksmanship, Ethan takes down the criminals andultimately reunites with Joel as father and son.

dramabox.title: My Mafia Life: From Maid To Bride
dramabox.norm_title: my mafia life from maid to bride
dramabox.description: Rosa is the maid of the mafia boss Max, suffering constant bullying and longing to break free from his control. When the chance to escape finally comes, it is ruthlessly cut off by Max himself, whose possessiveness toward Rosa grows even stronger. Their twisted love seems to be connected to Rosa's mysterious past, and when the truth is revealed, former lovers turn into mortal enemies. How will they face their fate?

dramabox.title: Double Life: Meet My Mafia Ex Again
dramabox.norm_title: double life meet my mafia ex again
dramabox.description: My mafia husband was killed on our wedding day. The new heir is his youngest brother, Leon Wald, who, unexpectedly, is my ex. Now I am a mafia widow and his sister-in-law. Can I really act as if nothing ever happened between us?

dramabox.title: Falling in Love Again with my Mafia Husband
dramabox.norm_title: falling in love again with my mafia husband
dramabox.description: Emma, a talented journalist and media manager, is trapped in her mixed feelings toward her husband - a successful businessman and mafia boss. After losing her best friend in a terrible accident caused by the mob, Emma cannot forgive her husband and overcome her grief. Coming to the most challenging decision to file for divorce, Emma becomes a victim of another gang attack staged against her husband, where she loses her memory after she wakes up in the hospital.

dramabox.title: The Thief Lover
dramabox.norm_title: the thief lover
dramabox.description: Maria, the working queen, accidentally saved the mafia boss Robert when she was working in a restaurant. Robert could not forget Maria's special rescue. But after Robert said goodbye to Maria, he found that his valuables were missing. It turned out that Maria stole the belongings of Robert, who looked noble. The two met again at the demolition site of the orphanage.

dramabox.title: Freeze！My Wanted Lover
dramabox.norm_title: freeze my wanted lover
dramabox.description: A cop goes undercover to take down a notorious mob boss but faces a dilemma when she falls for her target, especially since he's the main suspect in her father's murder.

dramabox.title: My Cold-Hearted Mafia King
dramabox.norm_title: my cold hearted mafia king
dramabox.description: After her father's death, Vivian was abandoned by her stepmother Catherine and stepsister Olivia, then kidnapped and trafficked—until she was rescued by Damien Russo, the king of the mafia, and brought into his home. Despite their age gap, Vivian gradually develops feelings for Damien, while he struggles to resist the temptation.

dramabox.title: My Mafia Boss Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: my mafia boss boyfriend
dramabox.description: So Jinha, a top medical student, once shared a passionate three-year romance with Cha Seonu, a thug. Pressured by her father, Seonu broke up with her, lying that he had fallen for someone else to end their relationship. Eight years later, Jinha is an exceptional surgeon, while Seonu has become a powerful CEO. Fate reunites them when he ends up on her operating table. He risks everything to win her back, while she still struggles with the wound he left behind.

dramabox.title: The Virgin's Christmas Wish
dramabox.norm_title: the virgin s christmas wish
dramabox.description: Christmas Eve. After Thistle is publicly torn apart for still being a virgin, she makes a desperate wish to Santa: "Please let me lose it."Thistle never expects the one who answers her wish to be the campus bad boy, mafia heir... and her soon-to-be stepbrother.

dramabox.title: Widow to Queen: The Alpha's Resurrection
dramabox.norm_title: widow to queen the alpha s resurrection
dramabox.description: Terminally ill and impoverished, Isla seeks one last reckless night—only to accidentally sleep with Jared Camsey, a ruthless mafia boss. When Jared is supposedly assassinated, Isla, now pregnant with his heir, inherits his criminal empire overnight. But Jared isn’t dead—he’s a werewolf who survived the shooting. Disguised as her bodyguard, he secretly protects her, and passion ignites between them.

dramabox.title: I Went to the Mafia Boss for a Baby
dramabox.norm_title: i went to the mafia boss for a baby
dramabox.description: I saved a cartel king who tricked me into marriage. What he doesn't know is, I have secrets too.

dramabox.title: Not His Holy Good Girl
dramabox.norm_title: not his holy good girl
dramabox.description: Grace Hill, a "holy" choir girl trapped in a sadistic, greedy family that murdered her mother and imprisoned her, meets Mason Richter, a ruthless mafia heir who sees through her angelic mask to the fury beneath. She uses him as her blade—crashing weddings, hacking evidence, and dismantling the empire that destroyed her—while he falls irreversibly in love. Bound by shared darkness and a hunger for justice, they become each other's accomplice and salvation.

dramabox.title: The Mafia Queen vs. The Evil Neighbors
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia queen vs the evil neighbors
dramabox.description: Kyla was once the boss of the top underworld syndicate, but chose to retire due to her weariness of gang life. After her husband's passing, Kyla often suffers from hallucinations and falls into violent, frenzied outbursts—only her dog Milo, who has been by her side for ten years, can bring her back to herself. Kyla tries her best to live an ordinary life, but is constantly tormented by her malicious neighbors. Relying on their own gang connections...

dramabox.title: Softly Ruined By You
dramabox.norm_title: softly ruined by you
dramabox.description: In a world ruled by power, desire, and betrayal, runaway bride Hailee Raine flees her wedding night from her ruthless guardian, Papa Sylvester, only to crash into the life of Leo Hardy, the dangerously charismatic heir to a mafia empire.When she begs him to hide her, one desperate kiss sparks a chain of memories—revealing she once saved him from death years ago. Now, Leo will risk everything to return the favor.

dramabox.title: Kidnapped By The Gangster
dramabox.norm_title: kidnapped by the gangster
dramabox.description: Nurse Chloe saves gang leader Liam while he is being hunted, only to be forcibly dragged into his dark world. To protect her family, she agrees to marry this dominant and dangerous man, but amid lies, betrayal, and revenge, she gradually discovers the tenderness and truth behind him. When the shadows of the past return, the two choose each other at the edge of life and death, and ultimately find rebirth through love and redemption.

dramabox.title: Taming the Mafia Boss: He’s Mine Now!
dramabox.norm_title: taming the mafia boss he s mine now
dramabox.description: Leah, the daughter of the Cruz family, appears to be a "fierce delicate flower" who throws money around in nightclubs and acts in a cynical way on the surface. In reality, she is a down-and-out heir whose power was seized by her stepfather.

dramabox.title: Meet The Mafia Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: meet the mafia boyfriend
dramabox.description: A kind-hearted girl, Undine, rescues Tarak, a mafia boss who has lost his memory, in order to escape her debts. As they spend time together, they gradually develop feelings for each other. After Tarak regains his memory, however, he forgets Undine, and a fiancée named Vicky suddenly appears. The villainous younger brother Seren repeatedly plots against them, leading to misunderstandings and their separation.

dramabox.title: The Thorn in His Rose
dramabox.norm_title: the thorn in his rose
dramabox.description: After witnessing her father's murder as a child, Clara is raised by Marcus, a powerful and emotionally distant mafia boss. Years later, she uncovers a link between Marcus's fiancée, Leona, and the crime. As secrets unravel, Clara is forced to face a devastating truth: Marcus himself may be connected to her family's ruin. Caught between forbidden love, betrayal, and revenge, Clara must decide whether to expose the truth or let love blind her.

dramabox.title: Mafia Daddy Next Door
dramabox.norm_title: mafia daddy next door
dramabox.description: A former mob enforcer turned single mother, Veronica was once drugged and set up by a crime boss to spend a night with mafia king Clive—unaware she would give birth to a daughter later trafficked as leverage to secure his loyalty. For years, Veronica searched for her stolen child, while Clive secretly hunted for the woman from that night.

dramabox.title: I Thought You Were Him
dramabox.norm_title: i thought you were him
dramabox.description: After losing her fiancé, Silas, in a brutal gang war, Mafia princess Stella Moretti is shattered—until she crosses paths with Milo who looks exactly like him. He has no ties to her world, but Stella doesn't care. Desperate to fill the void Silas left behind, she snatches Milo from his life and brings him into hers, determined to keep him by any means necessary.

dramabox.title: Deliver Me
dramabox.norm_title: deliver me
dramabox.description: To reclaim her family legacy stolen by her cousin Cain, Veronica deliberately gets close to mafia leader Enzo. Amid revenge and power struggles, their relationship evolves into a complex game of love and deception. They eventually expose Cain's murder of Veronica's parents, join forces to overthrow him, and reclaim the De Vere empire, finding genuine love through truth and sacrifice.

dramabox.title: My Ex-Wife the Mafia Princess
dramabox.norm_title: my ex wife the mafia princess
dramabox.description: Vera and her husband Lucas once survived a life-or-death fire together. Yet years later, in their contractual marriage, Lucas—plagued by selective amnesia—failed to recognize that his wife was the "white moonlight" he'd never forgotten. Instead, he treated her with cold indifference and even pressed her for a divorce.Vera tried to reveal her true identity to Lucas, only to be sabotaged by her romantic rival.

dramabox.title: The Mob Boss Substitute
dramabox.norm_title: the mob boss substitute
dramabox.description: She was an ordinary school teacher. After discovering her husband's affair, she angrily divorced him, only to be mysteriously kidnapped while on the run. Upon waking, she is told that she has been mistaken for the deceased leader of a powerful crime syndicate and is forced to take control of the underground empire. To survive, she must navigate both the criminal underworld and the law, all while secretly investigating the conspiracy behind this case of mistaken identity.

dramabox.title: Flash Marriage: My Soul Exchange with the Boss
dramabox.norm_title: flash marriage my soul exchange with the boss
dramabox.description: Top mafia heir Leon falls in love with Bella at first sight and hastily marries her against his family's objections, angering his mother Susan. Under Susan's scheming, Leon mistakenly believes Bella has cheated, leading to their divorce. At this time, Bella was already pregnant and secretly gave birth to twins, vowing to raise them alone. Five years later, Bella worked to raise money for her critically ill mother while also taking care of two children.

dramabox.title: Shelter in the Mafia
dramabox.norm_title: shelter in the mafia
dramabox.description: Tasha, betrayed by her husband and her mistress, lost her company and ended up on the streets. A stranger, Ken, a taxi driver, offered her a helping hand. Despite their initial separation, Ken kept reappearing in Tasha's life, leading her into a romantic entanglement. Little did she know, Ken was the son of a mafia boss, on a quest to find a figure from his past.

dramabox.title: The Mafia's Forbidden Virgin
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia s forbidden virgin
dramabox.description: After being rescued by Kieran, a mafia heir, from her mother's attempt to sell her virginity, Elena discovers her mother is marrying his father. Now step-siblings, their forbidden attraction intensifies when Kieran becomes her professor, forcing constant contact. From defending her against bullies to simmering home tension, hostility turns into dangerous desire.

dramabox.title: Mafia's Captive Bride
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s captive bride
dramabox.description: Mafia boss Sebastian forces Elena into a marriage after she saves his life at her mother's grave. Elena, trapped by Sebastian, fights back, tames him, and falls in love amidst crises.

dramabox.title: The Legend of White Wolf
dramabox.norm_title: the legend of white wolf
dramabox.description: Natalia is the daughter of Alpha,as the wolf in the prophecy, she is chased by many forces, to protect her, her father asked her to leave the pack and headed to New York so she could be safe there, two years later,the danger still existed, but her father thought it was time and he asked Natalia to come back and marry Blake Hunter, Alpha of another pack,he believed that Blake could protect Natalia after their marriage, their packs would be union.

dramabox.title: The Mafia's Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: the mafia s obsession
dramabox.description: Augusto Castro can't stand the thought of his only sister Alice getting hitched to some monster man due to an old-school marriage pact from 15 years back. He decides to pull a fast one on the agreement and steps in to marry the notorious mob boss, Pietro, in her place. Little did he know, it was all a love trap set by Pietro.

dramabox.title: Falling In Love with the Rascal in A Suit
dramabox.norm_title: falling in love with the rascal in a suit
dramabox.description: Betty has to work two jobs for her mom. She is both a stripper and a hotel cleaner. One night, Marcus, the infamous mob boss, enters Betty’s club, hoping to regain his “man power”. Every woman is a disappointment, except for Betty. He falls for her instantly, not knowing that Betty’s friend, Anthony, is also willing to sacrifice everything for her. A choice had to be made. An overly domineering mobster or an innocent scion. Who would she choose?

dramabox.title: I'm the Rule
dramabox.norm_title: i m the rule
dramabox.description: In a world where power reigns supreme, a mysterious Emperor of the mafias must navigate betrayal, love, and loyalty as he fights to maintain his iron grip on the criminal underworld, all while keeping his true identity hidden from those closest to him.

dramabox.title: Mafia's Good Girl
dramabox.norm_title: mafia s good girl
dramabox.description: Abducted by the mafia king, innocent Bella was forced to sign a contract with him in order to pay for her mother’s surgery. However, this contract that’s worthy of half a million dollars requires much more from Bella than she has ever imagined… The mafia king’s hardcore outer shell is slowly getting softened by Bella, while Bella gradually discovers her true self as well. But is it love, or just Stockholm syndrome?

dramabox.title: The President’s Husband Is a Deliveryman
dramabox.norm_title: the president s husband is a deliveryman
dramabox.description: With a stroke of luck, Eric Clark's life took a drastic turn. He transformed from just a deliveryman to a master in both medicine and divination. Armed with his new skills, he seeks to exact revenge on those who had bullied him in the past.

dramabox.title: My Fianceis a Cannibal
dramabox.norm_title: my fianceis a cannibal
dramabox.description: In a contemporary American city, Voss is a renowned pianist and composer adored by high society. In private, he runs an invitation-only supper club—and is in truth a serial cannibal. Evelyn, blind since childhood, regains her sight after surgery. On the eve of her wedding, she stumbles upon the horrifying truth—and is forced to keep pretending to be blind in order to survive.

dramabox.title: Mafia Single Daddy Made Me Mommy
dramabox.norm_title: mafia single daddy made me mommy
dramabox.description: On her wedding day, Lucia catches her fiancé cheating—only to be sold to ruthless mafia boss Nico Romano to pay off a gambling debt. Forced into a one-year contract marriage with Nico, she becomes nanny to his traumatized young niece and gradually uncovers the caring man hidden beneath his cold, dangerous facade. But as enemies close in and their forbidden attraction deepens, Lucia must decide whether trusting a mafia boss is worth risking her heart—and her life.

dramabox.title: His Ward's Dangerous Love
dramabox.norm_title: his ward s dangerous love
dramabox.description:
Eighteen-year-old Elowen harbors obsessive romantic 
feelings for Tristan, his guardian who raised him from childhood. He drugs Tristan to break their moral boundary. As Tristan prepares to marry his fiancée Vivian, Elowen keeps provoking him, risking everything to tear the couple apart. Vivian discovers their secret and threatens to expose the scandal. Torn between reputation, duty and hidden desire, Tristan faces an agonizing choice.

dramabox.title: The Dragon’s Chosen Mate
dramabox.norm_title: the dragon s chosen mate
dramabox.description: Squire knight Eli, who refuses to hunt dragons, reunites with Seren—the silver dragon who has searched for him for twelve years. Bound by a lifelong dragon bond, they fight through dragon hunters and ancient hatred between their races. From border forests to the royal capital, they end a century-old war. Eli is named the Oathbound Dragon Knight, and he and Seren live out their days together.

dramabox.title: The Merman Prince's Captive Vampire Groom
dramabox.norm_title: the merman prince s captive vampire groom
dramabox.description: When a merman falls in love with a vampire, when the obsession born beneath the waves imprisons his deity of the land—this coercive love drives Dylan to chain Lucian to the abyssal depths with silver links. Lucian, a human oceanographer, suffers the Embrace, forced to survive solely by drinking Dylan's blood. Hunted by the executioners of the Sea God's priesthood and the ancient Vampire Progenitor, Dylan tears his fishtail apart with his own strength.

dramabox.title: One Night with My Son’s Best Friend
dramabox.norm_title: one night with my son s best friend
dramabox.description: Emma Hayes, a self-made billionaire who has devoted her life to her business and son, forgets what it means to live for herself—until one unexpected night with Toby Bennett, a young CEO twenty years her junior. She assumes it's a casual encounter, but Toby is determined to marry her. When Emma meets his parents, she's shocked to find they are her college classmates—and his father once pursued her, while his mother still burns with jealousy.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Desire My Step-Sister's Secret
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden desire my step sister s secret
dramabox.description: Stella enters her new blended family wearing a mask of defensiveness and rebellion, assuming her stepsister Lily is just a harmless good girl. But Lily falls for Stella at first sight and uses the convenience of living under the same roof to provoke her with the most innocent face and the most dangerous flirtation. Under the watchful eyes of their strict parents, Lily seizes every opportunity—tutoring sessions, sharing a bed, dealing with a troublesome ex-boyfriend......

dramabox.title: The Professor's Forbidden Protégée
dramabox.norm_title: the professor s forbidden prot g e
dramabox.description: Mocked as a "magicless failure," Selena is betrayed by her stepsister and flees into the forbidden Black Forest, where she forms a dangerous bond with Sebastian, her professor cursed by dark magic. Her touch alone can suppress his curse—and he may be the key to unlocking the power sealed within her for twelve years. As desire grows and a conspiracy closes in, Selena must reclaim her magic, while Sebastian must choose between his future and the girl he cannot abandon.

dramabox.title: Heirless Wolf King His Contracted Lover
dramabox.norm_title: heirless wolf king his contracted lover
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her stepmother, Princess Elena falls into the forbidden werewolf land and meets cursed Wolf King Karen. Their bond breaks his curse, and she carries his heir. When humans sentence her to death, he arrives with his pack to save her.

dramabox.title: The Accidental Sex Text to My Rival
dramabox.norm_title: the accidental sex text to my rival
dramabox.description: Ryder, a top swimmer, rivals his stepbrother Lucas for his mother's love. Newcomer Tristan steals Ryder's captain spot—and his focus. Ryder despises him. One reckless mistake: he accidentally sends a solo explicit clip to Tristan, then retracts it, sure Tristan won't open it. But Tristan starts acting strange. Ryder later finds the clip saved in Tristan's phone—watched over and over.

dramabox.title: The Alpha Who Couldn’t Resist Me
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha who couldn t resist me
dramabox.description: Mason, a desperate Omega, fakes his identity to join Olympus Corporation—a tech giant that bans Omegas. His father's debts, his mother's illness, and his sister's tuition leave him no choice. He accidentally discovers CEO Landon's secret: a sex robot, because Landon is allergic to Omegas. Mason's exposed Omega scent unexpectedly calms Landon. Landon offers a fortune for Mason to stay as his lover. A forbidden office affair begins.

dramabox.title: Pregnant by the Wolf King: Cleaner Bride Is the Lost Sea Princess
dramabox.norm_title: pregnant by the wolf king cleaner bride is the lost sea princess
dramabox.description: Aaliyah, a lost sea princess, hides as a cleaner. She becomes pregnant by wolf king Lucian. She endures abuse while hiding her identity. Through misunderstandings, Lucian protects her. From a contract marriage to a runaway wife, her secrets unravel, revealing her true identity as the deep-sea princess.

dramabox.title: The Cursed Priest：The 14th Bride of the High Tower
dramabox.norm_title: the cursed priest the 14th bride of the high tower
dramabox.description: Princess Ella is framed by her stepmother and stepsister. She meets Aldric, a cursed High Priest turned lava-like monster in a tower, and conceives his child. She passes the Moon Goddess's trial, but her pregnancy is exposed. Fleeing, she is sentenced to burn. Aldric saves her. His curse can only be broken by true love. Ella awakens lunar power, breaks the curse, and they live happily with their child.

dramabox.title: The Alpha's Forbidden Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: the alpha s forbidden obsession
dramabox.description: Chloe, an orphan raised by Alpha Julian, is forcibly claimed by him at eighteen. She flees but is captured and imprisoned. Rescued by lone-wolf Ethan, she discovers she is the last Moonborn royal, destined to command all wolves. Three Alphas fight over her. During a lunar eclipse, she awakens her power, ends generations of war, and rises as queen above all Alphas.

dramabox.title: The Don's Obsession
dramabox.norm_title: the don s obsession
dramabox.description: Mixed-race student Elias, hunted by loan sharks, is forced by mafia don Lucius Vance to sign as his personal plaything. Lucius shoots coveters, breaks Elias in a cellar. Elias never yields—flees on a yacht, but it's Lucius's game. Caught in rain, bound with a belt, branded. Lucius declares: no escape from this forbidden contract.

dramabox.title: The Stone-Cursed King’s Blood Bride
dramabox.norm_title: the stone cursed king s blood bride
dramabox.description: Human girl Lena is sacrificed to vampire king Draven, cursed by stone magic. They form a blood bond of life and death. To save him after the curse is broken, she searches for the Blood Spring for seven years and revives him. They rule together, but an ancient witch's mark glows red in the spring's depths.

dramabox.title: The Vampire’s Vow
dramabox.norm_title: the vampire s vow
dramabox.description: Ella receives an invitation to a gothic manor from her estranged sister. She faces mysterious dreams, the obsessive attention of vampire lord Kane, and schemes from all sides. Kane once saved her by signing a blood pact, erasing her memory. As truth unfolds, Ella saves Kane with her blood, becomes a vampire, and their bond evolves. They overcome trials and become immortal lovers.

dramabox.title: Kiss Me Till the Tremor Stops
dramabox.norm_title: kiss me till the tremor stops
dramabox.description: Broke med student Kate sells herself to a mysterious benefactor to save her grandmother. The man is Dr. Lawrence, a brilliant surgeon with shaking hands. Her job is to be his "calm" — only her touch steadies him. A cold contract heats up into addiction. He saves her from debt collectors, and neither can walk away.

dramabox.title: Tide of Forbidden Touch
dramabox.norm_title: tide of forbidden touch
dramabox.description: Newlywed Emma is on her honeymoon in Hawaii. Her husband Jack arranges for his father Victor to teach her surfing. Victor hugs her from behind, and their forbidden desire slowly spirals out of control amid the waves. Emma and Victor engage in a secret affair.

dramabox.title: Help! My Fated Mate Is a Control Freak
dramabox.norm_title: help my fated mate is a control freak
dramabox.description: Half-werewolf Ethan, hunted by purebloods, is rescued by Alpha Cassian, who claims they are fated mates. Ethan resists but discovers Cassian's teen gift of suppressants—and a conspiracy involving Cassian's father. Betrayed by his mother, Ethan embraces their bond. They break prejudice, marry in a church, and find home.

dramabox.title: My Football Captain Takes Over Every Part Of Me
dramabox.norm_title: my football captain takes over every part of me
dramabox.description: Straight-laced rookie Hannah never expects to fall for Katherine, the college football team's reckless, irresistible captain. When forced to share a seat—and later a room—their forbidden attraction grows impossible to hide. But Katherine's secret obsession may turn Hannah's new beginning into a dangerous love game.

dramabox.title: The Captain’s Forbidden Widow
dramabox.norm_title: the captain s forbidden widow
dramabox.description: Military doctor Jane, a single mother, faces harassment at the army base until Captain Lorenzo intervenes. He initially mistakes her for his fallen comrade Ben's widow and vows to protect her and her child. Despite growing attraction between them, secrets and misunderstandings threaten their bond.

dramabox.title: Crossing Lines with my brother-in-law
dramabox.norm_title: crossing lines with my brother in law
dramabox.description: After unexpectedly losing her husband, Amanda was shocked to discover that he was actually the eldest son of a billionaire family. Taken in by her mother-in-law, she became entangled in a love-hate relationship with her brother-in-law. Initially at odds, they gradually developed mutual respect and affection. However, constrained by their sister- and brother-in-law relationship, they both restrained their feelings.

dramabox.title: Reborn To Claim The Dragon King
dramabox.norm_title: reborn to claim the dragon king
dramabox.description: Reborn after being betrayed and burned alive, mermaid princess Marina returns to the day she eloped with Victor. This time, she exposes his greed, destroys every enemy’s scheme, and protects the Dragon Court. As revenge unfolds, she finally sees Dragon King Draven’s hidden love—and rewrites their tragic fate together.

dramabox.title: Taming His Cursed Vampire Zaddy
dramabox.norm_title: taming his cursed vampire zaddy
dramabox.description: Julian was reduced to a captive blood bag for his abusive brother until claimed by Alistair, a thousand-year-old Vampire King dying of a starvation curse. Julian's blood is the only cure. The terrifying predator becomes an unexpected sugar daddy, showering Julian with wealth and protection. Their dark contract turns into fierce love.

dramabox.title: The Lycan King's Contract Luna
dramabox.norm_title: the lycan king s contract luna
dramabox.description: Betrayed by her boyfriend and half-sister, Nora is forced into a contract marriage with Asher, the feared Lycan King. As her hidden Moon Goddess blood awakens, desire turns into love—but dark secrets, deadly schemes, and a dangerous pregnancy force Nora to fight for her life, child, and freedom.

dramabox.title: Sinbound: Claimed by the Mother of Night
dramabox.norm_title: sinbound claimed by the mother of night
dramabox.description: Catching her fiancé cheating on their engagement night, Tessa seeks revenge by falling into bed with his billionaire mother Layla. But Layla is more than a mother-in-law—she is Lilith, the ancient Mother of Demons. When her fiancé Max tries to take her back, he learns that the real monster wears a bespoke suit and has wings.

dramabox.title: The Princess’s Unspeakable Secrets
dramabox.norm_title: the princess s unspeakable secrets
dramabox.description: Blessed by the moon goddess, Celestia is a headstrong she-wolf—and a rare female Alpha. Fleeing a brutal past, she and her mother seek refuge in a new pack. There, Celestia hides a forbidden longing for her cold, formidable uncle Ryder: the pack’s legendary Alpha. Untouchable to all, he is silently devoted only to her. But as she drowns in sinful desire, the demonic force from her childhood resurfaces to haunt her…

dramabox.title: The King’s Little Lucky Charm
dramabox.norm_title: the king s little lucky charm
dramabox.description: At five, butcher's daughter Elina enters the duke's house and tames the spoiled young master Heinrich. She later becomes a princess's attendant. Ten years on, she defies the king's mistress, fights for the princess, and is granted nobility. To avoid a forced marriage and stay with Heinrich, she takes on a ridiculous mission to break the prince's engagement, leading to comedic chaos, and finally clears misunderstandings to find true love.

dramabox.title: Hate Me Closer
dramabox.norm_title: hate me closer
dramabox.description: Arthur is the illegitimate son of Magnus Blackwood. After the death of Magnus's wife, Arthur and his mother are taken into the Blackwood household — which fills Caspian, who had once shown Arthur kindness, with rage and a sense of betrayal. As punishment, Caspian plays the obedient, well-behaved heir in front of his parents, while revealing his devilish nature only to Arthur. In the process, Caspian finds himself drawn to Arthur in a way he didn't expect.

dramabox.title: His Throne, My Revenge
dramabox.norm_title: his throne my revenge
dramabox.description: To reclaim her kingdom, she is forced to give herself to the brutal Beast King. His trusted aide, a vampire prince, is her exiled former fiancé, who has returned immortal but emotionless. She must ignite one last spark of jealousy in him, even if it costs his life or her heart.

dramabox.title: Chosen by the North
dramabox.norm_title: chosen by the north
dramabox.description: To save her mother, commoner Lila enters Moonfall Castle as a companion to the violent young master Elias. She tames him with strength and wit, and they fall in love. She later protects the princess, defeats nobles, and helps Elias quell conspiracies. Both are granted titles and achieve a happy ending.

dramabox.title: Craving My Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: craving my stepbrother
dramabox.description: "Silas, the privileged heir of a powerful family, seems like an arrogant, rebellious straight alpha. In truth, he is desperately hiding his forbidden desire for his adoptive older brother, masking it with reckless behavior.But Julian, the family's impeccably dressed Chief Risk Officer, saw through him long ago.Behind the guise of ""disciplining"" his younger brother, Julian relentlessly corners Silas—leaving him nowhere to run. Silas resists, denies, and flees, yet every

dramabox.title: Trapped Under His Claws
dramabox.norm_title: trapped under his claws
dramabox.description: Drugged, betrayed and desperate, Clara found herself riding on the back of a massive black wolf through the dark woods... She thought it was just a crazy hallucination. Until she woke up in the bed of the ruthless Alpha—Lucian! He seems like a terrifying captor, and Clara hates being his prisoner! But when assassins finally ambush them, he uses his own body as a shield so she won’t get a single scratch. And that strange ring he forced her to wear? It is actually his pack'

dramabox.title: Forbidden Love ：Brother‘s Cage
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden love brother s cage
dramabox.description: Stella, a free-spirited 17-year-old small-town girl, moves with her mother into a seaside ultra-luxury mansion after her remarriage, forced to live in a rigidly rule-bound estate—where she meets her nominal stepbrother, Vincent. At 20, Vincent is the picture-perfect elite heir, privately controlling the top-tier surfing competition scene. Cold-tongued, obsessive, and starved of genuine affection, he clashes with Stella from the moment they meet.

dramabox.title: My Fiance Cheated, So I Chose His Billionaire Dad
dramabox.norm_title: my fiance cheated so i chose his billionaire dad
dramabox.description: After discovering her arrogant fiancé’s infidelity on Christmas Eve, Lia seeks revenge through a passionate one-night stand with a mysterious older man. She is horrified to learn her dominant lover Silas Sterling, a ruthless billionaire, is her fiancé’s father. Crushed by her grandmother’s medical debts and trapped by Silas’s possessive obsession, Lia is dragged into a perilous game of taboo seduction.

dramabox.title: Stolen Glory
dramabox.norm_title: stolen glory
dramabox.description: Aires, a killer, has been manipulated by Victor, heir of the Drake family, for years under the lie that he saved her life. Victor's uncle Danter, the true leader of the underground organization Night Owl, has secretly loved Aires for five years. When Victor pushes Aires to the brink to consolidate his power, Danter rescues her and reveals the truth—the one who saved her was Danter, not Victor. Aires awakens, breaks free from the Drake family, and with Danter's help, reclaims

dramabox.title: Fruit Dimension: Orange LightRedemption. 1
dramabox.norm_title: fruit dimension orange lightredemption 1
dramabox.description: Orange thinks she is the foster daughter of the fruit family, framed by her stepmother Lemon and stepsister, and has a one-night mistake with her eldest brother Apple. She is exposed and driven out. Apple discovers she is his lost biological sister. Vegetable spy Cucumber attacks. Orange sacrifices her essence to reset time. Under the sea, the seafood clan reshapes her into puppet "Coconut" for a new game. Everyone plays roles, but truth hides under the peel.

dramabox.title: Bound by Blood, Freed by Love
dramabox.norm_title: bound by blood freed by love
dramabox.description: In an era when loving a slave is punishable by death, a white heiress is forced into a loveless political marriage by her cruel family. But behind closed doors, she defies her fate, surrendering her heart to the Black slave sworn to protect her. Their forbidden affair is a spark in the darkness—a betrayal the world will never forgive.

dramabox.title: The forbidden love with My Ex Husband's Son
dramabox.norm_title: the forbidden love with my ex husband s son
dramabox.description: Marcus tries to drug Mia, but she swaps the drink and learns his secret with her best friend Claire—they plan to steal her fortune. Their son Zach, a hacker who loves Mia, betrays his parents to help her get revenge.

dramabox.title: If I’d Cherished The Girl Who Loved Me
dramabox.norm_title: if i d cherished the girl who loved me
dramabox.description: At their anniversary dinner, Adrian’s stepsister Vivian shoves Seraphina, causing a miscarriage. Adrian cruelly admits he never loved her. Heartbroken, Seraphina drowns herself. Ten days later, Adrian realizes she’s gone—but instead of her return, he is called to identify her body. Memories of her devotion haunt him, but it’s too late.

dramabox.title: The Princess and Her Knight
dramabox.norm_title: the princess and her knight
dramabox.description: Princess Olivia, betrayed by her uncle and stepmother, uses her guard Mason to break an engagement. He is beaten and banished. Three years later, at an auction, she recognizes the masked nobleman as Mason, the man she discarded and ruined.

dramabox.title: Carrying the Dino Alpha's Heir
dramabox.norm_title: carrying the dino alpha s heir
dramabox.description: Researcher Vera is framed by her fiancé Roman and thrown into Jurassic Island as bait for a T-Rex experiment Draco. He stops at her scent and shields her—revealing he's a human with T-Rex genes. They escape, uncover Roman's conspiracy. Vera bears his child Dax. Roman overdoses and dies. The family reunites, vowing to face the corporation together.

dramabox.title: My Forbidden Professor Broke Every Rule for Me
dramabox.norm_title: my forbidden professor broke every rule for me
dramabox.description: Low-income student Ivy fell for professor Adrian. She was bullied and framed. Adrian resigned to protect her. They uncovered the college's secret trafficking of poor female students. Ivy's father was killed for exposing the Gray List.

dramabox.title: The domineering CEO is only out of control over me
dramabox.norm_title: the domineering ceo is only out of control over me
dramabox.description: Waitress Evelyn boarded a cruise to pay debts and met shipowner Adrian. She avoided him but was framed for theft. She recorded plots and was pushed overboard. Adrian dived to save her, and they shared a tender kiss.

dramabox.title: Slam Dunked By My Rival Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: slam dunked by my rival stepbrother
dramabox.description: Oliver, a flawless star shooting guard, despises his new stepbrother Jace—arrogant and violent. But as Jace overwhelms him with raw power and provocative teasing, Oliver's carefully constructed perfection begins to betray his mind, pulling him into a dark desire he can't resist.

dramabox.title: Exiled to His Arms The Rejected Luna Rises
dramabox.norm_title: exiled to his arms the rejected luna rises
dramabox.description: Vanessa, Moon Goddess, watches her husband Alex murder her father and lose their child. Alex sells her to auction, but her exiled ex Damon buys her back. Damon heals her and vows protection. She awakens mind-reading power, but Alex and a witch strike again, poisoning Damon. Can their love survive?

dramabox.title: Doomsday Shelter: Untouched in His Claws
dramabox.norm_title: doomsday shelter untouched in his claws
dramabox.description: Left to the zombie horde by her boyfriend, Chloe breaks into Doomsday Shelter 7, only to find Silas, the Zombie King, inside. He kills her traitorous ex and locks her in, declaring himself god there. He cages her as his only cure—his to protect and devour.

dramabox.title: Claimed by My Fiancé’s Godfather
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by my fianc s godfather
dramabox.description: Drugged and betrayed by her fiancé and stepsister, mute heiress Sienna Blair escapes into the arms of a mysterious billionaire—only to discover he's her fiancé's powerful godfather. As forbidden desire ignites, he becomes the only man who can heal her, protect her, and help her rescue her imprisoned mother. Together, they wage war against the family that stole everything from her.

dramabox.title: Rebirth: The Dragon Slayer’s Regret
dramabox.norm_title: rebirth the dragon slayer s regret
dramabox.description: Leo, the strongest knight, is reborn to prevent his past mistake—he killed his childhood love Serafina, who was turned into a dragon. He betrays the temple and finds her, but she distrusts him. The king sets a trap, injuring Serafina. Leo makes a blood pact for dragon power to fight the king and redeem his love.

dramabox.title: No Taste for Blood
dramabox.norm_title: no taste for blood
dramabox.description: Althia, fleeing her captors, falls into the arms of Duke Sylvester—the vampire she saved with her blood a decade ago. Her blood heals and revives, but the Vampire Tribunal hunts her. She uncovers a mastermind who knows her fate. Is she just a chess piece, or the one who will overturn the board?

dramabox.title: Love Is My Whole Life
dramabox.norm_title: love is my whole life
dramabox.description: Set in the fictional Sterling Kingdom in the 1930s, noble lady Anya marries spoiled Prince Charles by political marriage, solely to uncover the truth of her mother’s suspicious poisoning death. On their wedding night, she takes a mild aphrodisiac to ease her marital duty, only to catch Charles cheating with her scheming stepsister Mia.

dramabox.title: The king's fugitive queen
dramabox.norm_title: the king s fugitive queen
dramabox.description: King James searches for his runaway fiancée Alice for years. To avoid selection, Count's daughter Julia disguises as ugly, but James keeps her. He realizes she is Alice, but she wants to escape. A love chase ensues.

dramabox.title: The AI Boyfriend My Ex Stole, Chose Me Instead
dramabox.norm_title: the ai boyfriend my ex stole chose me instead
dramabox.description: Maya created the perfect AI lover algorithm, but her fiancé Blake stole it. On the eve of launch, she caught him cheating. Noah, the AI she built, refused to become Blake's product and chose to be Maya's lover and weapon instead.

dramabox.title: Love Caught Between Fangs and Claws
dramabox.norm_title: love caught between fangs and claws
dramabox.description: Yuri, a bullied high schooler with hidden werewolf blood, is saved by vampire Brian. They fall in love, but werewolf Lucius also loves him. After conflicts and awakenings, Yuri discovers his dual bloodline and unites with both Brian and Lucius in a happy ending.

dramabox.title: Safeword
dramabox.norm_title: safeword
dramabox.description: Senior lawyer Alice has been starved of physical intimacy for years. While defending reckless playboy heir William, her long-buried hunger ignites — just as she exposes her husband's affair. Caught between courtroom ambition, crumbling marriage, and raw desire, she stops playing by the rules and claims what she actually wants.

dramabox.title: Claimed by His Vampire Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by his vampire stepbrother
dramabox.description: Moving into his new family’s massive mansion, Liam only wanted a safe place to call home. Instead, he gets Silas, a dangerously hot stepbrother who treats him like prey. Silas loves playing sick games. Liam fights back every time. But late one night, armed assassins break into the house. Silas flashes his fangs and turns into a terrifying monster to save Liam's life. Turns out, the arrogant stepbrother is actually a bloodthirsty vampire—and he's madly addicted to Liam's blood

dramabox.title: My Wife Replaced Me With An AI Lover
dramabox.norm_title: my wife replaced me with an ai lover
dramabox.description: Wealthy heiress Vanessa finds her husband Ethan dull and uninspiring, so she falls for a robot boyfriend and cruelly sends Ethan to an AI modification center for a three‑year "upgrade." When Ethan returns home, his demeanor is cold and robotic. Manipulated by her robot boyfriend (designated 233), Vanessa constantly picks on Ethan and makes his life miserable.

dramabox.title: Seduced by my boyfriend's uncle
dramabox.norm_title: seduced by my boyfriend s uncle
dramabox.description: Blinded by tragedy, genius musician Ciel Frost survived the dark by clinging to the suffocating love of a brilliant director, Marco Kingsley. But a conspiracy tore them apart.  a sighted Ciel falls into a web of lies—mistaking Marco's manipulative nephew, Liam, for the savior from his past.

dramabox.title: Falling For My Hate-Crush
dramabox.norm_title: falling for my hate crush
dramabox.description: When Daisy moves into the palatial Weston mansion, she expects a fresh start for her and her mother, James Weston's soon-to-be bride. What she doesn't expect is to be trapped under the same roof as her long-time high school crush: her future stepbrother, Zach Weston. But living together quickly shatters her illusions. Daisy soon realizes that Zach isn't the sweet boy she admired from afar—he's arrogant, manipulative, and seemingly determined to make her life a living hell.

dramabox.title: Illegal Touching
dramabox.norm_title: illegal touching
dramabox.description: Ian, a cool‑headed team doctor, and Noah, the football captain, grow close after an injury. During 24‑hour personal physical therapy sessions, they endure homophobic rejection, a claustrophobic rescue, and the sinister interference of an ex‑boyfriend. Finally, during a rainstorm, they confess their true feelings to each other and embrace, overcoming all shadows.

dramabox.title: Chained to My Rival
dramabox.norm_title: chained to my rival
dramabox.description: Olympus adds a thirteenth throne. The water‑and‑fire demigods Pyrion and Iker compete in the Ember Trial for the seat. They have been rivals for three hundred years, but in truth Pyrion has secretly loved Iker all along—every provocation was merely a bid for attention. Iker, however, misinterprets every move as hostility, and even mistakes Pyrion’s feelings as a lust for his sister Laela.

dramabox.title: Claimed by My Ex's Alpha Father
dramabox.norm_title: claimed by my ex s alpha father
dramabox.description: Eira decides to give her virginity to her boyfriend. But after walking into the wrong dark playroom, she ends up claimed by his terrifying Alpha father. Betrayed by her cheating boyfriend and her evil stepsister, she becomes the ultimate obsession of the most ruthless Alpha. And worst of all for her ex? She's now carrying his father's secret pup!

dramabox.title: Burning Love
dramabox.norm_title: burning love
dramabox.description: Rowan's marriage to Alex is hollow—he remains devoted to his first love, Lumi, even demanding Rowan "borrow a man" to bear an heir. Heartbroken, Rowan drunkenly mistakes Austin (the male lead) for a male escort at a bar. After a one-night stand, they strike a transactional arrangement—until she discovers Austin is actually the heir to a powerful Eastern European dynasty. Drawn to his tenderness and dominance, their "fake" relationship blurs into forbidden passion.

dramabox.title: Don’t Lecture Me, Kiss Me
dramabox.norm_title: don t lecture me kiss me
dramabox.description: 21-year-old Elsa harbors forbidden love for her 36-year-old guardian and professor Dylan, transferring to his class to pursue him. Despite their stark age and identity taboos, desire simmers amid their push-pull. Tormented by classmates and rival professor Veronica—who spikes Dylan’s wine, leading the drugged, unsuspecting Dylan to mistakenly sleep with Elsa

dramabox.title: Velvet, Blood & Power
dramabox.norm_title: velvet blood power
dramabox.description: Twelve years ago, Lila watched her sister Mira get murdered—a gold hairpin through her throat, ordered by a general’s mistress. Today, Lila is that general’s top mistress, a dancer whose beauty hides a blade. She sleeps beside her family’s destroyer, Julian Ashford, waiting for the perfect kill. But on the brink of revenge, she discovers the impossible: Mira loved this man.

dramabox.title: Affair with His Brother's Wife
dramabox.norm_title: affair with his brother s wife
dramabox.description: All Anna ever wanted was a quiet, stable marriage. She married Patton, a gentle and decent man, and did everything a perfect wife was supposed to do -cooking, caring, enduring. But love didn't grow. It faded. Lonely and unseen, Anna learns how cold a marriage can become when a woman gives everything and receives nothing. Then she meets Edward, Patton's brother.

dramabox.title: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
dramabox.norm_title: the stepbrother i hate to love
dramabox.description: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns into a heated bet that changes everything. Noah discovers the real reason: Liam is secretly obsessed with him. After Liam saves Noah from bullies, Noah decides to make peace with Liam and tries to straighten him out.

dramabox.title: Falling For My Bestie’s Dad
dramabox.norm_title: falling for my bestie s dad
dramabox.description: What’s worse than having your nudes leaked by an ex? Falling for the dark, dangerous man who rescued you—who also happens to be your best friend’s dad. June knows that every step she takes into Killian’s private sanctuary is a betrayal, yet she deliberately tests his legendary restraint with lingering touches and whispered provocations. As they play a high-stakes game of 'don't get caught,' the line between gratitude and obsession blurs.

dramabox.title: Nice to Hold You Dear：18 and 30
dramabox.norm_title: nice to hold you dear 18 and 30
dramabox.description: A delicate 18-year-old orphan, Annie, is betrayed by her own family and thrown out of her home. Homeless and helpless, she is rescued by her late father’s friend, William—a powerful older man with a guarded heart. From that day on, he gives Annie a new home. As Annie grows up, a tender romance quietly blossoms between them, despite the age gap. Could he have truly fallen for a girl so much younger than himself? But he knows… he never should have.

dramabox.title: My Stepdaughter's Idol is My Junior Boyfriend
dramabox.norm_title: my stepdaughter s idol is my junior boyfriend
dramabox.description: Audrey, a 40-year-old powerful woman, discovered her husband's infidelity. Later, she met Ethan, a 24-year-old international movie star, by accident. The two fell in love amid public opinion pressure and their age gap, yet encountered frantic opposition from Audrey's stepdaughter Mia. The exposure of Audrey's true identity—as the heir to the top-tier consortium, the Sloan family—made this emotional game even more complicated.

dramabox.title: My Dirty Secret With The Wrong Stepbrother
dramabox.norm_title: my dirty secret with the wrong stepbrother
dramabox.description: After a crushing misunderstanding with her longtime crush, a teenage girl spirals into a reckless night with a stranger—only to wake up and realize he’s her crush’s dangerously irresistible older brother…and her soon-to-be stepbrother.

dramabox.title: In Love With My Bestie's Son
dramabox.norm_title: in love with my bestie s son
dramabox.description: Reeling from her husband's infidelity, Kate seeks solace in what she thinks is a counseling session, only to end up in a passionate night of mistaken identity with Chris, a captivating young painter. But morning brings a scandalous revelation: not only is her new lover the elusive art prodigy CH Skywalker, he is also the son of her best friend, Linda.

dramabox.title: Submitting to My Bestie's Dad
dramabox.norm_title: submitting to my bestie s dad
dramabox.description: What's worse than having your nudes leaked by an ex? Falling for the dark, dangerous man who rescued you—who also happens to be your best friend's dad. June knows every step into Killian's sanctuary is a betrayal, yet she deliberately tests his legendary restraint with whispered provocations. In the heat of his study, morality vanishes. As they play a high-stakes game of don't get caught,' gratitude blurs into obsession, threatening to explode before graduation.

dramabox.title: Bucked by My Father's Cowboy
dramabox.norm_title: bucked by my father s cowboy
dramabox.description: Shy horse girl, Jessa Fey, promises her father, the bull-riding coach, that she will stay away from his most unruly cowboy, Hart Bronson. But Hart's irresistible charm breaks down her defenses and threatens to get them both into trouble.

dramabox.title: Secret Affair With My Husband’s Boss
dramabox.norm_title: secret affair with my husband s boss
dramabox.description: After star attorney Olivia catches her husband cheating, she chooses to begin a forbidden journey with her own client- who is also the husband of her husband's mistress. For the first time in her life, she learns to take control of her own body, and also her own life. But what she doesn't know is that her secret Dom has another identity that will surprise her.

dramabox.title: Revenge After Centuries
dramabox.norm_title: revenge after centuries
dramabox.description: Scarlett Salvatore is a powerful hybrid bound to her vampire girlfriend Alexa, while centuries of betrayal divide her from her brothers Franklin and Brad. When ancient vampires arrive seeking the moonstone and a human doppelgänger, the siblings must unite. As Scarlett’s powers fade and danger closes in, Alexa flees. To save Brad, Scarlett and Franklin make a dark deal that could cost them their humanity.

dramabox.title: Fake Bonds, True Love
dramabox.norm_title: fake bonds true love
dramabox.description: Olivia accidentally kisses Klaus in an elevator while hiding from a debt collector. Recognizing Olivia’s resemblance to his long-lost sister, Klaus proposes a contract for Olivia to impersonate her to fulfill his grandfather’s dying wish. As they live together, they develop feelings beyond sibling love…

dramabox.title: Love at the end of his lie
dramabox.norm_title: love at the end of his lie
dramabox.description: Jeong Seo Rin endures six loveless years of marriage. Her husband keeps his distance, and she assumes it's just his nature—until she discovers he has always loved his stepsister, treating her as nothing more than a placeholder. Heartbroken, she reveals the truth to the stepsister and leaves. In the end, it is the once-cold husband who drowns in regret.

dramabox.title: Don't Let Your Son Fall, Hon
dramabox.norm_title: don t let your son fall hon
dramabox.description: Diana discovers her husband Victor is having an affair with her best friend Claire. Trapped in a marriage filled with deceit and abuse, she invites Claire's 19-year-old son Leo to live with her as an act of revenge. But Leo has been secretly in love with Diana for years. What begins as a calculated scheme evolves into a genuine connection, forcing them to navigate threats from a crypto scam, blackmail, and violent confrontations.

dramabox.title: The whole family dotes on her
dramabox.norm_title: the whole family dotes on her
dramabox.description: 15 years ago, Oh Hee-seon donated a kidney to save her dying lover Choi Seung-woo but left him, heartbroken by class differences and family opposition. Years later, she falls into a coma saving Koo Jun-hyun, heir to Gohyun Group. Her daughter Ah-yeon struggles to pay her hospital fees until a crisis—interrupted by Seung-woo, who recognizes her via a love necklace. Jun-hyun, learning the truth, defies the family to publicly protect the mother and daughter.

dramabox.title: Forbidden Love Is in the Air
dramabox.norm_title: forbidden love is in the air
dramabox.description: "When Julia Wright’s husband dies suddenly, she is left pregnant, penniless, and abandoned by her cruel family. At his grave, she learns the shocking truth: Christopher was heir to Ellipse Airlines. His mother, Margaret Wright, rescues Julia from misery and brings her into the opulent Wright mansion to protect her and her unborn child. But her new life of luxury quickly turns hostile. Christopher’s younger brother Leo—a brash airline pilot—suspects Julia...

dramabox.title: Cuffed to My Silver Fox Captain
dramabox.norm_title: cuffed to my silver fox captain
dramabox.description: Macy returns home to Briarhill, Montana as a rookie cop and to solve her mother’s cold case. She’s devastated to learn her cheating ex boyfriend is also a police officer at the same precinct. Upset, Macy drowns her sorrows at a bar and hooks up with Hunter, a silver fox, who turns out to be her boss AND her ex’s dad! Their secret fling progresses, threatening both their jobs, but sparks fly as they are partnered together. Hunter helps trains Macy, building her confidence...

dramabox.title: Blood and Promises: Mated to the Alpha
dramabox.norm_title: blood and promises mated to the alpha
dramabox.description: After the massacre of the Fierce Wind Clan, the lone survivor, Monica, infiltrates the Blood Night Fortress to seek revenge by seducing its Alpha, Victor. But when she becomes pregnant with his child, Victor’s fiancée Nora—daughter of the Shadow Clan’s Alpha—discovers the truth and tries to kill her. Victor intervenes upon realizing Monica is his fated mate, bound by the Moon Goddess.

dramabox.title: The Hidden Half of Love
dramabox.norm_title: the hidden half of love
dramabox.description: Believing Terrence Zerkle to be her savior, Wanda Waller signs a three-year marriage contract, only to endure his coldness and deceit. When she finally walks away, her true rescuer, Ramon Zerkle, comes into her life. As the truth comes to light, Ramon breaks down every barrier, wins her family's trust, and offers Wanda not just love, but the life of happiness she was once denied.

dramabox.title: Action! Cut, Roll, and Fall for You
dramabox.norm_title: action cut roll and fall for you
dramabox.description: Anna Grove and Josh Lark enter a sham marriage after Jack Moss's car accident, concealing their true feelings. As they work together on set, honesty begins to blend with affection. Eventually, secrets are uncovered, misunderstandings are healed, and they reach a heartfelt ending sealed by true love.

dramabox.title: Answer to My Heart
dramabox.norm_title: answer to my heart
dramabox.description: For years, Cecelia Collins lived in silence, forced to pretend she could not speak. During a kidnapping, she mistakenly believes Ivan Justice doesn't want her unborn child. To protect the baby, she poses as the kidnapper, drawing him into a tense game of confrontation. As their misunderstandings unravel, Cecelia, encouraged by him, finds the courage to speak—and to follow her heart.

dramabox.title: Between Brothers, Between Lies
dramabox.norm_title: between brothers between lies
dramabox.description: When Layla Lowe's mother disappears, her father takes a job as the Zinn family's driver in search of answers. But tragedy strikes, and he dies in a fatal accident—leaving Layla to be adopted by the very family he served. Years later, a night spent with their second son changes everything. What she doesn't know is that he has loved her all along, and the truth about her adoption lies hidden.

dramabox.title: No Return for This Goodbye
dramabox.norm_title: no return for this goodbye
dramabox.description: Tessa's husband, Adrian Sinclair, embarks on a mission alongside his twin brother, Miles Sinclair. Tragedy strikes when Miles dies in action. To protect his sister-in-law, Adrian assumes his late brother's identity, intending to father a child with her before revealing the truth. Unable to accept her husband's death, Tessa spirals into despair. When she unexpectedly learns that Adrian is actually alive, her heart breaks with disillusionment.

dramabox.title: No Return for This Goodbye (DUBBED)
dramabox.norm_title: no return for this goodbye dubbed
dramabox.description: Tessa's husband, Adrian Sinclair, embarks on a mission alongside his twin brother, Miles Sinclair. Tragedy strikes when Miles dies in action. To protect his sister-in-law, Adrian assumes his late brother's identity, intending to father a child with her before revealing the truth. Unable to accept her husband's death, Tessa spirals into despair. When she unexpectedly learns that Adrian is actually alive, her heart breaks with disillusionment.

dramabox.title: She is Mine
dramabox.norm_title: she is mine
dramabox.description: Eric Gibson has always been possessive. He is used to getting his way, so when his father marries Jenna Black, a mysteriously stunning woman with a shady past, he is captivated. What starts as admiration spirals into a dark obsession. Eric tries every charm up his sleeve to make Jenna his, but when she refuses his advances, he vows to try every other way to make her his.

dramabox.title: Mated with My Fiance's Alpha Daddy
dramabox.norm_title: mated with my fiance s alpha daddy
dramabox.description:
Jessie finds herself in a perilous situation where she has been drugged and raped, only to be rescued by Alpha Andrew, who discovers they are mates. However, when Andrew attempts to establish a relationship with Jessie, she claims her engagement to another man.
On her wedding with Derek, it turns out Andrew is her fiance's dad....
Where will this "forbidden love" manipulated by fate ultimately lead?
